papers.title: Data assimilation for subsurface flow using latent diffusion model parameterization: performance of ensemble-Kalman and Monte Carlo techniques
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) in subsurface flow entails calibrating model parameters to match observed data, typically at wells, while preserving geological realism. Latent diffusion models (LDMs) provide efficient mappings from high-dimensional geological model space to a low-dimensional latent variable, reducing the dimensionality of the inverse problem while maintaining plausibility in posterior geomodels. However, the high nonlinearity in the LDM mapping may degrade the performance of Kalman-gain-based ensemble updates. We present a systematic comparison of DA algorithms applied to large-scale 3D channelized geomodels with hierarchical geological uncertainty. We compare model-space and latent-space DA using the ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ESMDA), and demonstrate a key trade-off: model-space updates achieve significant uncertainty reduction but produce geologically unrealistic posterior models, while latent-space updates preserve realism but exhibit limited uncertainty reduction. Motivated by this, we explore rigorous Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) and Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithms in the 3D-LDM latent space. To accommodate their high computational demands, we develop a fast surrogate flow model that approximates well-rate responses. MCMC and SMC are evaluated against ESMDA across three synthetic test cases, with DA performed in the LDM latent space. All models maintain geological realism due to the LDM parameterization. MCMC and SMC are consistent with one another and achieve lower data mismatch and more uncertainty reduction than latent-space ESMDA. Our overall results demonstrate that ensemble Kalman methods may provide overestimated posterior uncertainty with highly nonlinear parameterizations, while rigorous Monte Carlo sampling, enabled by fast surrogate models, can provide a more reliable alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了地下水流数据同化（DA）中不同算法在潜在扩散模型（LDM）参数化下的表现，重点对比了模型空间和潜在空间的集成平滑器（ESMDA）与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）及序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法。在大规模三维通道化地质模型上，潜在空间ESMDA虽保持地质现实性但不确定性降低有限，而MCMC和SMC在代理模型加速下实现了更低的数据不匹配和更多的不确定性减少。
Motivation: 地下水流数据同化面临高维地质模型参数校准与地质现实性保持的权衡，而LDM引入的非线性映射可能削弱卡尔曼增益类集成方法的性能，需要探索更鲁棒的采样方法。
Method: 采用潜在扩散模型（LDM）将高维地质参数映射到低维潜在变量，比较模型空间和潜在空间的ESMDA，并构建快速代理模型以支持潜在空间中的严格MCMC和SMC算法。
Result: 潜在空间LDM参数化可保证后验地质模型真实性，但ESMDA在潜在空间的不确定性降低有限；MCMC与SMC结果一致，相比潜在空间ESMDA实现了更低的数据不匹配和更多不确定性减少。
Conclusion: 对于高度非线性参数化，集成卡尔曼方法可能高估后验不确定性，而借助快速代理模型的严格蒙特卡洛采样提供了更可靠的替代方案。

papers.title: First-Order Trajectory Matching: Fast Ensemble Predictions of Chaotic, Turbulent, Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract_en: We introduce First-Order Trajectory Matching (FTM), a surrogate-modeling method that learns the first-order local transport of probability mass from trajectories of stochastic systems. By matching the symmetric first-order motion of trajectories, FTM learns the probability current velocity, whose flow preserves time marginals to match ensemble averages, while also capturing current-like trajectory quantities such as fluxes, circulations, and barrier-crossing currents. FTM learns the current velocity directly from trajectories, avoiding drift, diffusion, and score estimation. Our stability analysis separates discretization error from sampling variance and shows that the one-step simulation-free FTM loss is stable when temporal resolution and sample size are properly balanced. Across stochastic dynamical systems and PDE examples, we empirically demonstrate that FTM provides trajectory-aware ensemble predictions at low, deterministic-rollout cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出First-Order Trajectory Matching (FTM)，一种从随机系统轨迹中学习概率流速度的代理建模方法。该方法通过匹配轨迹的一阶运动来捕捉集合平均及通量、环流等轨迹相关量，无需估计漂移、扩散或得分。稳定性分析表明，在合理平衡时间分辨率和样本量时，一步无仿真FTM损失是稳定的。实验在随机动力系统和PDE示例上展示了其以低确定性滚动成本提供轨迹感知的集合预测能力。
Motivation: 现有代理建模方法常需估计漂移、扩散或得分，或依赖昂贵的时间积分，难以同时高效捕捉集合平均和轨迹电流量。FTM旨在直接学习概率流速度，降低计算成本并保持轨迹感知能力。
Method: FTM通过最小化一步无仿真损失来学习概率流速度，该损失匹配轨迹的对称一阶运动。方法直接从轨迹数据学习，避免了漂移、扩散和得分估计，并分析了离散化误差与采样方差之间的稳定性条件。
Result: 在随机动力系统和PDE示例上，FTM以低确定性滚动成本实现了轨迹感知的集合预测，且稳定性分析表明损失函数在时间分辨率和样本量平衡时稳定。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Dyadic Regression Under Complex Missingness
papers.abstract_en: We develop a framework for conformal prediction in dyadic regression problems under complex missingness mechanisms. At the theoretical level, we establish super-uniformity of conformal prediction under distributional invariance conditions weaker than exchangeability. A key result handles the case where the sample itself is a random subset of the index set, a setting not covered by existing theory, via a novel bijection argument that constructs an explicit measure-preserving correspondence between events. In addition, we propose conformal prediction procedures for jointly exchangeable arrays, including full conformal, split conformal, a row-column approach exploiting similarities within rows and columns, and a selective conformal procedure achieving mask-conditional validity. For missing elements, we establish asymptotic validity of a graphon-weighted conformal procedure under a nonparametric graphon model for the missingness mechanism. We further establish conditional validity results for both continuous and discrete responses; to the best of our knowledge, this is first formal proof of asymptotic conditional validity for weighted conformal prediction under a missing-not-at-random assumption. The proposed methods are illustrated on synthetic and real network data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二元回归中复杂缺失机制下的共形预测问题，建立了在比可交换性更弱的分布不变条件下的超均匀性理论。通过新的双射论证处理样本为索引集随机子集的情况，提出了联合可交换数组的共形预测方法，包括全共形、分裂共形、行列方法以及选择性共形过程，并在图模型下证明了缺失元素的渐近有效性。此外，首次在非随机缺失假设下给出了加权共形预测的渐近条件有效性证明。
Motivation: 现有共形预测理论通常假设数据可交换，但在二元回归等复杂缺失场景中样本往往是索引集的随机子集，现有理论无法覆盖。
Method: 提出基于分布不变条件（弱于可交换性）的超均匀性理论，利用双射构造建立测度保持映射；针对联合可交换数组设计全共形、分裂共形、行列方法和选择性共形过程；并引入图权重共形过程处理缺失机制。
Result: 在理论上证明了超均匀性和渐近条件有效性，包括连续和离散响应；在合成和真实网络数据上进行了方法验证。
Conclusion: 本文为复杂缺失机制下的共形预测提供了严格的理论框架，首次在非随机缺失假设下实现了渐近条件有效性。

papers.title: UniPET: a universal network for high-quality PET image denoising across varied dose reduction factors
papers.abstract_en: Most existing deep learning-based PET image denoising methods assume a fixed and known dose reduction factor (DRF) for low-dose PET images. However, these methods encounter significant performance degradation when the DRF varies beyond the assumed one in practical applications. To address the challenge posed by varied DRFs, several preliminary studies focus on the task of universal PET image denoising, aiming to train a universal model over low-dose data across DRFs. Nonetheless, these vanilla universal models often struggle with misaligned styles present in different DRF data, leading to the \textit{style elimination issue} with a significant over-smoothing effect. To deal with this issue, we innovatively introduce domain generalization to PET image denoising and propose a universal PET image denoising network (UniPET) to achieve high-quality PET image denoising across diverse DRFs. UniPET comprises two primary innovations: a style alignment network (SAN) and a region-aware learning strategy (RALS). Specifically, SAN utilizes style alignment techniques derived from domain generalization to align and recover styles across different DRFs, ensuring the model's generalizability across various DRFs while effectively preserving styles. Furthermore, to enhance style recovery, RALS distinguishes between flat and stylized regions, exclusively conducting adversarial learning on the latter, thereby more effectively guiding the model's focus towards learning stylized regions. It is demonstrated that our proposed UniPET can adaptively recover different DRF styles and achieve high-quality PET image denoising across DRFs. Comprehensive experiments show that UniPET exhibits comparable performance to individual DRF-specific models at specific DRFs and realizes state-of-the-art performance in universal PET image denoising quantitatively, perceptually, and clinically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不同剂量减少因子（DRF）下PET图像去噪的通用模型需求，提出UniPET网络。该网络引入域泛化中的风格对齐技术，通过风格对齐网络（SAN）对齐和恢复不同DRF下的风格，并采用区域感知学习策略（RALS）区分平坦与风格化区域，仅在后者上进行对抗学习以避免过度平滑。实验表明UniPET在特定DRF上与专用模型性能相当，并在通用PET去噪任务上达到定量、感知和临床最优。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法假设固定已知的DRF，实际应用中DRF变化时性能显著下降。已有的通用模型因不同DRF数据间风格不匹配而出现风格消除问题，导致严重过平滑。因此需要一种能处理多样DRF且保留风格的高质量去噪方法。
Method: 提出包含两个主要创新的UniPET：1) 风格对齐网络（SAN），利用域泛化的风格对齐技术对齐并恢复不同DRF的风格，增强模型跨DRF的泛化能力；2) 区域感知学习策略（RALS），区分平坦区域与风格化区域，仅在风格化区域实施对抗学习，以更有效地指导模型聚焦于风格特征的恢复。
Result: 综合实验显示，UniPET在特定DRF下与针对该DRF的专用模型性能相当，并在通用PET去噪任务上实现了定量指标、感知质量和临床评估方面的最优性能。
Conclusion: 本文通过引入域泛化思想，有效解决了通用PET去噪中的风格消除问题，使UniPET能够自适应恢复不同DRF的风格，实现跨DRF的高质量去噪，为可变剂量场景下的PET图像处理提供了新方案。

papers.title: Robust Regression of General ReLUs with Queries
papers.abstract_en: We study the task of agnostically learning general (as opposed to homogeneous) ReLUs under the Gaussian distribution with respect to the squared loss. In the passive learning setting, recent work gave a computationally efficient algorithm that uses $poly(d,1/ε)$ labeled examples and outputs a hypothesis with error $O(opt)+ε$, where $opt$ is the squared loss of the best fit ReLU. Here we focus on the interactive setting, where the learner has some form of query access to the labels of unlabeled examples. Our main result is the first computationally efficient learner that uses $d polylog(1/ε)+\tilde{O}(\min\{1/p, 1/ε\})$ black-box label queries, where $p$ is the bias of the target function, and achieves error $O(opt)+ε$. We complement our algorithmic result by showing that its query complexity bound is qualitatively near-optimal, even ignoring computational constraints. Finally, we establish that query access is essentially necessary to improve on the label complexity of passive learning. Specifically, for pool-based active learning, any active learner requires $\tildeΩ(d/ε)$ labels, unless it draws a super-polynomial number of unlabeled examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在平方损失下对一般（非齐次）ReLU函数进行不可知学习的问题，聚焦于交互式学习场景。作者提出首个计算高效的学习器，使用d polylog(1/ε)+Õ(min{1/p, 1/ε})次黑盒标签查询即可达到O(opt)+ε误差，并证明该查询复杂度在定性上接近最优。此外，证明了对于基于池的主动学习，任何主动学习器都需要Ω̃(d/ε)个标签，除非抽取超多项数量的未标记样本。
Motivation: 在被动学习设置中已有高效算法，但交互式学习（学习者可以查询未标记样本的标签）的样本复杂度尚未明确。本文旨在利用查询访问来降低标签复杂度。
Method: 提出一个计算高效的学习器，在黑盒标签查询模型下工作，使用d polylog(1/ε)+Õ(min{1/p, 1/ε})次查询达到误差O(opt)+ε。同时通过信息论下界证明查询复杂度的近最优性。
Result: 学习器的查询复杂度界为d polylog(1/ε)+Õ(min{1/p, 1/ε})，误差为O(opt)+ε；并证明该复杂度在忽略计算约束时是近最优的。此外，建立了主动学习所需标签数的下界Ω̃(d/ε)。
Conclusion: 查询访问（特别是主动学习）对于改进被动学习的标签复杂度是本质必要的，因为即使允许主动学习，仍需要Ω̃(d/ε)个标签（除非使用超多项式数量的未标记样本）。

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model evaluation into three complementary dimensions. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to assess whether generated videos follow interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal phenomena, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos with Gaussian splatting and evaluates structural consistency, cross-view coherence, and camera-trajectory alignment. The interaction track assesses whether generated rollouts follow complex action prompts and maintain smooth, coherent transitions across consecutive video chunks. WorldOlympiad further covers three major downstream scenarios, including gaming, robotics, and general real-world videos, capturing diverse challenges from interactive control and embodied manipulation to open-domain motion and camera dynamics. Together, these tracks and scenarios form a scalable and interpretable evaluation suite that exposes failure modes beyond generic video quality. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps in physical reasoning, 3D consistency, and long-horizon interaction, underscoring the need for more structured evaluation protocols for generative world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WorldOlympiad基准，用于从物理忠实度、几何一致性和交互保真度三个维度诊断基于视频的世界模型。该基准涵盖游戏、机器人和通用真实视频场景，通过物理轨迹、几何重建和交互动作评估暴露模型在物理推理、3D一致性和长程交互方面的不足。实验表明现有模型在这些维度存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准集中于视觉质量或短期时序一致性，缺乏对物理规则遵循、三维结构保持和长期可控交互的系统评估。
Method: 将世界模型评估分解为三个互补维度：物理轨迹（分割+MLLM判断规则）、几何轨迹（高斯泼溅重建评估结构一致性）、交互轨迹（评估动作提示跟随和跨片段连贯性），并覆盖游戏、机器人、通用视频三大场景。
Result: 对当前最优模型的实验显示，它们在物理推理、3D一致性和长程交互方面存在显著缺陷。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了生成式世界模型在结构化评估协议上的需求，未来应关注更严格的物理、几何和交互约束。

papers.title: Provenance-Grounded Gating and Adaptive Recovery in Synthetic Post-Training Data Curation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic post-training pipelines commonly filter generated samples with reward models or holistic LLM judges, yet two practices remain rarely examined together: whether the filtering signal is grounded in the source evidence that induced each generation, and whether rejected samples can be systematically recovered rather than permanently discarded. We present a controlled study of both questions across gate configurations, recovery strategies, and generator scales, using adversarially injected corpora to provide ground-truth failure labels. We find that exact source provenance improves faithfulness gating for stronger judges, that hallucination and reward gates reject largely disjoint sample populations making both necessary, and that an adaptive recovery pipeline combining failure diagnosis with targeted regeneration achieves higher yield, recovery rate, and injection recall than naive resampling. Downstream fine-tuning quality is driven primarily by generator scale, with filtration and recovery conditions contributing meaningfully but secondarily.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了合成后训练数据筛选中的两个问题：筛选信号是否基于导致生成的来源证据，以及被拒绝的样本能否系统恢复。通过对抗注入语料进行控制实验，发现精确来源溯源能提高强评判器的忠实性门控，幻觉门和奖励门拒绝的样本群体大多不重叠，自适应恢复流程比简单重采样效果更好。下游微调质量主要由生成器规模决定，过滤和恢复条件有意义但次要。
Motivation: 合成后训练流程常用奖励模型或整体LLM评判器来过滤生成样本，但很少检查筛选信号是否基于导致生成的来源证据，以及被拒绝的样本能否系统性恢复。
Method: 通过对抗注入语料提供真实失败标签，在不同门控配置、恢复策略和生成器规模下进行控制实验。
Result: 精确来源溯源提高了强评判器的忠实性门控；幻觉门和奖励门拒绝的样本群体大多不重叠；自适应恢复流程（结合故障诊断和定向再生）在产出、恢复率和注入召回率上优于简单重采样。
Conclusion: 下游微调质量主要受生成器规模驱动，过滤和恢复条件有次要贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DMT: Demographic Conditioning, Morphology-Enhanced Transformer for Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG Signals
papers.abstract_en: Blood pressure (BP) is a key marker for cardiovascular risk assessment and therapeutic decision-making, and Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost, wearable-friendly cuffless BP estimation. However, even with recent progress, many PPG-based models are trained with BP regression alone and may rely on amplitude-dominated shortcuts. In addition, demographic covariates that systematically modulate vascular compliance are often incorporated only via late fusion, limiting subject-specific representation learning. We propose a Transformer-based network for cuffless BP estimation from PPG signal, leveraging self-attention to capture long-range dependencies across multiple cardiac cycles. To account for subject-specific vascular differences, the model is conditioned on demographics via FiLM-style feature modulation applied through the attention and feed-forward sublayers of Transformer blocks. In addition, we add an auxiliary morphology head to guide the model to attend to BP-relevant waveform morphology associated with arterial stiffness and wave reflection. Under calibration-based evaluation protocols on the large-scale PulseDB dataset, the proposed method achieves MAE of 4.56 mmHg for systolic BP and 2.62 mmHg for diastolic BP, reducing errors by 47% and 50% compared with prior demographic-enhanced PPG baselines. The resulting lightweight, single-sensor model supports scalable and clinically grounded cuffless BP estimation in calibration-enabled deployment settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的无袖带血压估计方法，通过人口统计学条件化（FiLM调制）和辅助形态学头改进PPG信号的血压预测。在PulseDB数据集上，收缩压MAE为4.56 mmHg，舒张压MAE为2.62 mmHg，相比之前的人口统计学增强PPG基线错误降低47%和50%。
Motivation: 现有PPG血压模型主要依赖回归，可能利用基于振幅的捷径，且人口统计学协变量仅通过晚期融合，限制了特定于主体的表示学习。
Method: 提出Transformer网络，通过自注意力捕获多心动周期的长程依赖；在Transformer块的注意力和前馈子层中使用FiLM风格的特征调制以条件化人口统计学信息；添加辅助形态学头引导模型关注与动脉硬化相关的波形形态。
Result: 在PulseDB数据集上，校准评估协议下，收缩压MAE 4.56 mmHg，舒张压MAE 2.62 mmHg，错误比之前基于人口统计的PPG基线降低47%和50%。
Conclusion: 该轻量级单传感器模型支持可扩展的、临床基础的无袖带血压估计，适用于校准启用的部署场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overcoming Rank Collapse in Feedback Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation (BP) is widely viewed as biologically implausible, in part because it requires feedback weights to be the transpose of forward weights for error propagation. Interestingly, when training a network with fixed random feedback weights to circumvent this issue, learning aligns the forward weights with the feedback weights, leading the backpropagated error signal to become an approximation of the standard gradient used by BP. This process, called Feedback Alignment (FA), occurs in MLPs and very shallow CNNs but does not scale well to deeper architectures. In this work, we first investigated differences between BP and FA models, trained on CIFAR10, specifically focusing on the effective rank of the signal. We found that the FA error has a considerably lower rank and hence is constrained to a lower-dimensional subspace compared to BP, limiting exploration of the parameter space. Motivated by this observation, we evaluated two mechanisms for increasing the effective dimensionality of FA: Muon, an optimiser that orthogonalises weight updates; and hidden activity normalisation, which promotes activation orthogonality. Across larger architectures and benchmarks, we find that these methods consistently improve over FA baselines, for example, on CIFAR100 with a Resnet-18, accuracy increases by 9 percentage points. Our results identify low-dimensional gradient dynamics as a key obstacle to scaling FA and suggest that inducing higher-dimensional update geometry is a promising route toward scaling alternatives to backpropagation.
papers.comment: 9 pages and 4 figures, 1 table for main text. Total of 28 pages and 13 figures with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究反馈对齐（Feedback Alignment, FA）中信号有效秩低导致深度架构训练困难的问题。实验发现FA误差信号秩显著低于BP，限制参数空间探索。提出使用Muon优化器和隐藏活动归一化增加信号有效维度，在CIFAR100/ResNet-18上准确率提升9个百分点。
Motivation: FA使用固定随机反馈权重，但无法有效扩展到深层架构，原因未知。
Method: 分析BP和FA误差信号有效秩差异，提出Muon优化器正交化权重更新和隐藏活动归一化促进激活正交性两种机制。
Result: 在CIFAR100/ResNet-18上准确率提升9个百分点，证明低维梯度动力学是FA缩放的关键障碍。
Conclusion: 诱导高维更新几何是扩展FA替代BP的有前途方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monte Carlo Pass Search: Using Trajectory Generation for 3D Counterfactual Pass Evaluation in Football
papers.abstract_en: We recast pass evaluation in football (soccer) as a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-like evaluation problem whose components mostly exist in the literature under different names: a value model (possession value), a world model (multi-agent trajectories with ball interactions), and a policy over counterfactual actions (sampling pass variants with noise). Building on the first public high-fidelity tracking dataset with 3D ball trajectories from the Bundesliga, we introduce Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS), which infers kick parameters for each observed pass, samples execution variants and option variants, rolls each candidate forward with a ball-conditioned world model until the next ball interaction, and scores outcomes with a learned value model to obtain a distribution over gained value. This distribution enables distribution-aware attribution with two complementary execution-surplus scores used for analysis and ranking: mean-based and percentile-based scores. To make the world model sample-efficient under limited public data, we adapt a discrete-token, autoregressive trajectory generator from autonomous driving (SMART) and show it yields strong best-of-20 forecasting accuracy compared to baselines, while supporting fully hypothetical rollouts for downstream evaluation. We have released model checkpoints and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将足球传球评估重新定义为类似蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的问题，提出蒙特卡洛传球搜索（MCPS）。利用德甲联赛首个高保真3D球轨迹数据集，MCPS推断每个实际传球的踢球参数，采样执行变体和选项变体，通过球条件世界模型（改编自自动驾驶的SMART模型）进行滚动预测，直至下一次球交互，并用学习的价值模型评估结果，得到价值分布。基于该分布，提出两种执行盈余分数（均值型和百分位型）用于分析和排序。
Motivation: 现有传球评估方法缺乏对反事实执行变体的系统考虑，且缺少高保真3D轨迹数据来支撑细粒度的反事实推理。
Method: 提出MCPS框架：①从观测轨迹逆推踢球参数；②采样执行扰动和选项扰动生成候选传球；③用球条件自回归轨迹生成器（基于自动驾驶领域的SMART模型）滚动预测候选传球；④用学习到的价值模型对每个候选结果评分，形成价值分布；⑤基于分布计算执行盈余分数。
Result: 在有限公开数据下，改编的SMART模型在best-of-20预测准确率上优于基线，支持全反事实滚动用于下游评估。
Conclusion: MCPS实现了分布感知的传球评估，开源了模型和代码，为足球分析提供了新的反事实评价工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for enhancing reasoning and agentic behavior in large language models. However, rollout-intensive policy optimization is often limited by insufficient reward contrast, arising when overly simple or complex prompts generate low-variance feedback and when outcome-only rewards assign the same terminal assessment to every decision in a multi-turn rollout. Past efforts have focused on allocating available rollout resources to promising prompts, yet they only leverage sample informativeness at the prompt level and neglect variation in prefix-level informativeness across turns within the same rollout. This work targets multi-turn agentic RL by modeling each ReAct-style thought-action-observation turn as a semantically distinct node, allowing budget allocation to extend from prompt roots to turn-level prefixes with further continuations, which naturally forms tree-structured rollouts. We introduce Tree Rollout Allocation for Contrastive Exploration (TRACE), a unified rollout allocation framework that enhances reward contrast within a fixed sampling budget. Technically, TRACE allocates rollout budget to both prompt roots and intermediate prefixes that are most likely to yield mixed terminal rewards. A shared generalizable predictor estimates conditional success probability at these anchors from prefix histories to guide this allocation. The resulting adaptive tree structure enriches outcome-only feedback and amplifies the policy-update signal. Empirically, TRACE achieves competitive performance and efficiency gains on typical agentic benchmarks, e.g., improving Qwen3-14B Multi-Hop QA average accuracy by 2.8 points over competitive baselines at equal sampling cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，用于多轮智能体强化学习中固定采样预算下的奖励对比增强。通过将ReAct风格的回合建模为树节点，将预算分配到可能产生混合奖励的前缀上，提高策略更新信号。在多个智能体基准上，TRACE在相同采样成本下提升了Qwen3-14B多跳QA准确率2.8个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法仅将样本信息性用于提示级别，忽略了回合内不同前缀级别的信息变化，导致低方差反馈和奖励对比不足。
Method: 提出树形回滚预算分配框架TRACE，将每个ReAct回合作为节点，构建树形展开结构；利用可泛化的预测器从前缀历史估计条件成功概率，指导预算分配至可能产生混合终端奖励的根节点和中间前缀。
Result: 在智能体基准上，TRACE在相同采样成本下使Qwen3-14B多跳QA平均准确率提升2.8个百分点。
Conclusion: TRACE通过自适应树结构丰富结果奖励，放大策略更新信号，在固定预算下实现竞争性性能和效率提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Autonomous Accelerator Design: FPGA Accelerator Generation with SECDA
papers.abstract_en: Designing FPGA-based accelerators for modern artificial intelligence workloads requires exploring a large and complex hardware design space that involves architectural parameters, data flow strategies, and memory hierarchies, making the process very time consuming. While existing methodologies such as SECDA enable rapid hardware-software co-design through SystemC simulation and FPGA execution, identifying efficient accelerator configurations remains a largely manual process requiring extensive domain knowledge. SECDA-DSE is a framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) into the SECDA ecosystem to guide design space exploration (DSE) of FPGA-based accelerators. It combines a structured DSE Explorer for generating candidate architectures with an LLM Stack that performs reasoning-guided exploration using retrieval-augmented generation and chain-of-thought prompting, coupled with a feedback loop for iterative and reinforced refinement. Building on our previous work introducing SECDA-DSE, this paper extends its evaluation by generating three accelerator designs, including element-wise vector multiplication, 2D convolution, and matrix transpose, and performing end-to-end execution on FPGA hardware. The results show that SECDA-DSE can generate SECDA-compliant accelerator designs that are successfully synthesized and executed on FPGA hardware. Furthermore, the generated designs capture kernel-specific trade-offs between compute parallelism and data movement, highlighting the potential of LLM-guided exploration to adapt architectural configurations across diverse workloads while reducing exploration time and the need for extensive human expertise.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Machine Learning for Architecture and Systems Workshop (MLArchSys), co-located with ISCA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SECDA-DSE框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到SECDA生态系统中，用于指导FPGA加速器的设计空间探索（DSE）。该框架结合了结构化DSE探索器和LLM栈（使用检索增强生成和思维链提示），并通过反馈循环迭代优化。论文扩展了先前工作，生成了逐元素向量乘法、2D卷积和矩阵转置三种加速器设计，并在FPGA硬件上进行了端到端执行。结果表明，SECDA-DSE能够生成符合SECDA规范的加速器设计，成功综合并执行，同时捕捉了不同工作负载下计算并行性与数据移动之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有FPGA加速器设计需要大量手动探索和领域知识，过程耗时且效率低，缺乏自动化引导。
Method: 提出SECDA-DSE框架，包含结构化DSE探索器用于生成候选架构，以及LLM栈通过检索增强生成和思维链提示进行推理引导的探索，并加入反馈循环实现迭代强化改进。
Result: 生成了三种加速器设计（逐元素向量乘法、2D卷积、矩阵转置），均成功在FPGA上综合并执行，展示了LLM引导的探索能够适应多样化工作负载，减少探索时间和人工需求。
Conclusion: LLM引导的设计空间探索在FPGA加速器设计中具有潜力，能够自动适应不同工作负载并降低对人类专家知识的依赖。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出SECDA-DSE框架，包含结构化DSE探索器用于生成候选架构，以及LLM栈通过检索增强生成和思维链提示进行推理引导的探索，并加入反馈循环实现迭代强化改进。
summary_sections.result: 生成了三种加速器设计（逐元素向量乘法、2D卷积、矩阵转置），均成功在FPGA上综合并执行，展示了LLM引导的探索能够适应多样化工作负载，减少探索时间和人工需求。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM引导的设计空间探索在FPGA加速器设计中具有潜力，能够自动适应不同工作负载并降低对人类专家知识的依赖。

papers.title: Designed by Journalists, but Is It for Readers? Rethinking AI Disclosures and Transparency in News
papers.abstract_en: As newsrooms integrate generative AI, journalists face a disclosure challenge: how to communicate AI involvement in ways that maintain reader trust. Current practice offers two approaches: brief one-line labels or detailed disclosures specifying human oversight, editorial accountability, and error reporting mechanisms. Neither achieves journalists' goal of building trust through transparency. An existing controlled experiment with 34 news readers show that detailed disclosures trigger a \textit{transparency dilemma}, reducing trust rather than increasing it, and risk introducing dark patterns that readers scroll past with the illusion of transparency. One-line disclosures avoid this effect but can create an information gap, prompting readers to expend cognitive effort searching for signs of AI involvement that the disclosure indicates but does not explain. Yet readers are not rejecting transparency, they proposed disclosure designs centered on user agency: detail-on-demand interactions, proportional AI-ratio visualizations, outlet-level signals, and explicit "no AI" labels. I argue that this disconnect between what practitioners believe is responsible disclosure and what users actually need is a design problem for the HCI community.
papers.comment: Accepted to CHIWORK Workshop (Interrogating GenAI Augmentation for CHIworkers: Strategies for Professional Autonomy and Accountability)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨新闻编辑部中生成式AI的披露困境：现行简短标签与详细披露均未能有效建立读者信任。受控实验显示详细披露反而降低信任，造成透明度悖论；而简短标签导致信息缺口。读者提出基于用户代理的披露设计，如按需详情、AI比例可视化等。作者认为实践者与用户对负责任披露的理解存在设计脱节。
Motivation: 新闻记者希望以透明方式披露AI参与以维护读者信任，但现有两种披露方式（简短标签与详细披露）均未达到预期效果，反而引发信任下降或信息缺口。
Method: 通过受控实验比较两种披露方式对34名新闻读者的影响，并分析读者提出的披露设计建议。
Result: 详细披露触发透明度悖论，降低信任；简短披露造成信息缺口，迫使读者额外认知努力。读者倾向按需详情、AI比例可视化、媒体级信号和明确‘无AI’标签。
Conclusion: 当前披露实践与用户需求之间的脱节是HCI领域的设计问题，需要重新设计以增强用户代理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FADA: Accessible fetal ultrasound interpretation and annotation with a selectively distilled unified vision-language model
papers.abstract_en: A global shortage of trained sonographers limits prenatal ultrasound screening in low- and middle-income countries, where over half of pregnant women receive no skilled sonography. Current deep learning approaches address detection, segmentation, or classification in isolation, each demanding a separate model and expert-specified labels at inference. We present FADA, a unified vision-language model built on Qwen3.5-VL that performs clinical interpretation, classification, detection, and segmentation through a single interpretation-first pipeline without external labels. FADA distills knowledge from four domain-specific foundation models (FetalCLIP, UltraSAM, USF-MAE, UltraFedFM) via offline pre-computed feature caching. Selective distillation, which applies feature alignment only to annotation tasks while interpretation relies on standard fine-tuning, consistently outperforms full distillation across most evaluation axes. The recommended variant, FADA-SKD, achieves 0.8820 mean Dice for segmentation, 0.7671 mAP@0.50 for detection, and 100% structured interpretation compliance. Expert sonographer validation across 237 images confirms clinically acceptable outputs in both autonomous and human-in-the-loop modes, with 73.5% of interpretations scoring perfectly under clinician guidance. The system is trainable on a single consumer GPU and deployable without cloud connectivity. We validate edge deployment by running the compressed 0.8B model on a commodity smartphone (Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 1, 12 GB RAM) using llama.cpp with GGUF quantization, completing the full 5-phase pipeline in approximately 60 seconds entirely offline. This establishes a practical pathway for integrating AI-assisted fetal assessment with portable ultrasound devices, directly addressing diagnostic access gaps in resource-constrained settings. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/mahmoodphd/FADA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FADA，一个基于 Qwen3.5-VL 的统一视觉语言模型，用于胎儿超声的临床解读、分类、检测和分割，无需外部标签。通过选择性蒸馏从四个领域特定基础模型中提取知识，FADA-SKD 变体在分割、检测和结构化解读上表现优异，并可在消费级 GPU 和手机上离线运行。
Motivation: 全球缺乏训练有素的超声技师，导致中低收入国家产前超声筛查不足。现有深度学习方法需要针对检测、分割或分类分别训练模型，且推理时需要专家标注，不适用于资源受限环境。
Method: 构建基于 Qwen3.5-VL 的统一视觉语言模型，通过离线预计算特征缓存，从 FetalCLIP、UltraSAM、USF-MAE、UltraFedFM 四个基础模型进行知识蒸馏，并采用选择性蒸馏策略（仅对注释任务进行特征对齐，解读任务使用标准微调）。
Result: FADA-SKD 在分割任务上达 0.8820 平均 Dice，检测任务上达 0.7671 mAP@0.50，结构化解读合规率 100%。专家验证 237 张图像，自主模式和人机循环模式下临床输出可接受，73.5% 解读在医生指导下得满分。压缩的 0.8B 模型可在骁龙 7 Gen 1 手机（12GB RAM）上离线运行完整 5 阶段流程约 60 秒。
Conclusion: FADA 提供了一个统一、可离线部署的胎儿超声 AI 辅助系统，直接解决资源受限环境下的诊断可及性问题。代码、模型和数据均已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhantomBench: Benchmarking the Non-existential Threat of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations, where language models (LMs) generate factually ungrounded responses, pose serious risks, as users tend to blindly rely on them. This is particularly concerning in high-stakes domains, where consequences of such model behavior can lead to significant harms. Despite notable progress in understanding hallucinations, it remains unclear how reliably these models can recognize the limits of their knowledge. We introduce PhantomBench, the first large-scale benchmark of its kind, comprising more than 60K non-existent terms and entities derived from real concepts across diverse domains. Using our benchmark, we evaluate a total of 21 models of various types and sizes. We show staggering hallucination rates across the board (with average rates as high as 86.7% in some cases), and note that even frontier models surprisingly fail to abstain on non-existent concepts, especially when the input presumes their existence. We then show that PhantomBench can serve as a proxy for studying model behavior on rare concepts for which models are more prone to hallucinate. We also provide a pipeline to construct PhantomBench, enabling scalable generation of non-existent concepts tailored to the specific needs of researchers and practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PhantomBench，首个大规模的非存在概念基准测试，包含超过 6 万个从真实概念衍生出的虚构术语和实体。通过对 21 个不同规模和类型的语言模型进行评估，发现平均幻觉率高达 86.7%，前沿模型在输入暗示存在时也难以避免。PhantomBench 还可作为研究罕见概念幻觉的代理，并提供可扩展的构建流程。
Motivation: 语言模型幻觉在高风险领域带来严重风险，但现有研究尚不清楚模型能否可靠地识别自身知识边界，因此需要专门针对非存在概念的基准来评估这一能力。
Method: 从多个领域的真实概念出发，系统性地构建超过 6 万个不存在的术语和实体，形成 PhantomBench 基准。采用该基准评估 21 个不同规模与类型的语言模型，测试其在面对虚构概念时的拒绝能力。
Result: 平均幻觉率高达 86.7%，前沿模型同样表现不佳，尤其在输入预设概念存在时错误率更高。PhantomBench 可用于代理研究模型在稀有概念上的幻觉倾向。
Conclusion: PhantomBench 提供了一个评估语言模型知识边界的有效工具，其构建流程可扩展，支持研究人员和从业者针对特定需求生成非存在概念。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Limitations of Learning Tanh Neural Networks with Finite Precision
papers.abstract_en: We investigate limitations of learning $\tanh$ neural networks from point evaluations under finite-precision computations and $L^p$ accuracy guarantees, building on Berner, Grohs, and Voigtländer (2023). Our approach is based on a novel construction of sharply localized bump functions via iterated $\tanh$ activations. Using this mechanism, we show that, in a finite-precision setting, no adaptive randomized algorithm based on $m$ samples can achieve a convergence rate higher than the Monte Carlo rate $O(m^{-1/p})$ in the $L^p$ norm, unless the sampling budget grows exponentially with the size of the network parameters and architecture. The results reveal fundamental limitations imposed by finite precision on the learnability of classes containing localized bump functions, extending previous results for ReLU networks to the $\tanh$ setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限精度下基于点评估学习tanh神经网络的局限性，证明在L^p范数下，任何自适应随机算法基于m个样本的收敛率不能超过蒙特卡洛率O(m^{-1/p})，除非样本预算随网络参数和架构大小指数增长。该结果通过迭代tanh激活函数构造尖锐局部化凸包函数得到。
Motivation: 理解有限精度计算对学习tanh神经网络的内在限制，特别是对于包含局部化凸包函数的类别。
Method: 基于迭代tanh激活函数构造尖锐局部化凸包函数，并分析有限精度下自适应随机算法的信息复杂度。
Result: 在有限精度下，任何自适应随机算法的L^p误差收敛率被限制为蒙特卡洛率O(m^{-1/p})，且该下限在样本预算指数增长前不可突破。
Conclusion: 揭示了有限精度对学习tanh网络的根本限制，将先前ReLU网络的结果推广到tanh激活函数。

papers.title: Do Transformers Actually Help Intrusion Detection? A Temporal Sequence Evaluation on CIC-IDS2017
authors: Hany Ragab (1) ((1) Royal Military College of Canada
papers.abstract_en: Recent deep learning approaches for network intrusion detection increasingly incorporate temporal architectures such as recurrent networks and Transformers, often reporting near-perfect performance on CIC-IDS2017. However, many existing studies neither supply their temporal modules with genuine sequence inputs nor evaluate under realistic, leakage-free conditions, making it unclear whether reported gains arise from true sequence-modeling capability. In this work, we reformulate CIC-IDS2017 as a temporal intrusion-detection task by constructing ordered flow sequences from network conversations and benchmarking nine classical and deep learning architectures under a random split, two leakage-free splits, and a padding-scheme ablation. The central finding is that padding convention, not architecture, determines the Transformer's performance: on genuinely sequential (non-padded) windows the Transformer achieves the highest macro-F1 of any model in the experiment (0.89); under zero-pad+mask evaluation it drops markedly (-0.24 macro-F1), while LSTM, GRU, and 1D-CNN remain stable. Under leakage-free group evaluation the Random Forest is the most robust model (+0.009), while the Transformer's false-alarm rate grows from 0.04% to 2.7%, a 67-fold increase invisible under conventional protocols. These findings demonstrate that evaluation methodology -- specifically padding convention and split protocol -- has a larger effect on reported performance than architectural choice, and that widely used random splits with repeat-last padding can overestimate model robustness by up to 0.24 macro-F1. We advocate leakage-free splits, explicit padding disclosure, and sequence-aware benchmarking as standard practice in future IDS research. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/zachmocz/temporal-ids-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Transformer等时序架构在入侵检测中的应用，发现评估方法（填充方式和数据划分）对性能的影响远大于架构选择。在CIC-IDS2017数据集上，Transformer在非填充序列上取得最高macro-F1（0.89），但在零填充掩码评估下下降0.24，而随机森林在无泄漏划分下最鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有时序入侵检测研究常在不提供真实序列输入或有泄漏条件下评估，导致性能增益来源不明。
Method: 将CIC-IDS2017重构为时序任务，构建有序流序列，在随机划分、两种无泄漏划分和填充方案消融下基准测试9种模型。
Result: 填充方式决定Transformer性能：非填充窗口macro-F1=0.89，零填充掩码下下降0.24；LSTM、GRU和1D-CNN保持稳定。无泄漏评估下随机森林最鲁棒，Transformer误报率从0.04%升至2.7%。
Conclusion: 评估方法（填充约定和划分协议）对性能影响大于架构选择，建议未来IDS研究采用无泄漏划分、明确填充披露和序列感知基准。

papers.title: IDEAL: In-DEpth ALignment Makes A Discrete Representation AutoEncoder
papers.abstract_en: Built on pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs), representation autoencoders (RAEs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for constructing semantically rich latent spaces for image generation. However, their reconstruction quality often remains suboptimal, largely because deep VFM representations do not preserve sufficient fine-grained visual detail. This limitation becomes even more severe after discretization, where missing low-level information is difficult to recover. In fact, we observe that shallow VFM features retain considerably richer local appearance and structural detail, which complements the high-level semantics carried by deep features used in existing RAEs. Motivated by this complementary property, we propose Ideal, an In-depth Alignment framework for discrete representation autoencoding. By jointly aligning quantized tokens with both shallow and deep VFM features, Ideal enables the resulting discrete visual tokens to preserve both visual fidelity and rich semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ideal yields superior reconstruction performance, achieving 0.61 rFID on ImageNet and outperforming the previous best method by 0.28. When used for autoregressive image generation, Ideal further produces a gFID of 1.89, establishing a new state of the art for autoregressive image generation.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有表示自编码器（RAE）在离散化后丢失了浅层VFM特征中的细粒度视觉细节，导致重建质量受限。

Result: 在ImageNet上，重建rFID为0.61，比之前最优方法提升0.28；用于自回归图像生成时，gFID达到1.89，创下新纪录。
Conclusion: 浅层VFM特征与深层语义特征互补，IDEAL通过深度对齐有效提升了离散表示的重建质量，并推动了自回归生成性能。

papers.title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Expressive continuous control policies, such as diffusion and flow models, form the backbone of recent advances in scaling imitation learning for simulated and real robot control. While they are known to scale stably in the supervised imitation learning setting, incorporating them into reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for policy improvement has proven more difficult. It often requires specialized training objectives or backpropagating through denoising processes, which cause well-known issues with stability and affect scalability. In this paper we study the question of whether simple policy improvement schemes at test time alone, leaving stable supervised policy training intact, can be a competitive alternative which sidesteps these issues. To this end, we propose QGF (Q-Guided Flow), an RL algorithm that performs policy optimization entirely at test time. QGF works by pre-training both a reference flow policy (via a standard behavioral cloning objective) and a value function critic and, at test time, using the value gradient to guide the reference policy to generate higher-value actions without any additional policy learning. Empirically, QGF outperforms prior test-time RL methods on single-task and goal-conditioned offline RL benchmarks with high-dimensional action spaces, and is competitive with state-of-the-art training-time algorithms while being much cheaper to run. Moreover, it exhibits favorable scaling with model size by avoiding the instability of actor-critic training, offering a practical and effective alternative RL algorithm with expressive policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QGF（Q-Guided Flow），一种完全在测试时进行策略优化的强化学习算法。它预训练一个参考流策略（通过行为克隆）和一个价值函数评论家，然后在测试时使用值梯度引导参考策略生成更高价值的动作，无需额外的策略学习。实验表明，QGF 在单任务和目标条件的离线 RL 基准上优于先前的测试时 RL 方法，与最先进的训练时算法竞争力相当，且运行成本更低，随模型大小扩展良好。
Motivation: 将扩散和流模型等表达性连续控制策略整合到 RL 策略改进中面临挑战，现有方法需要专门的训练目标或通过去噪过程反向传播，导致稳定性和可扩展性问题。本文研究是否仅通过测试时的简单策略改进方案（保持监督策略训练不变）可以作为有竞争力的替代方案。
Method: 提出 QGF 算法：预训练参考流策略（使用标准行为克隆目标）和价值函数评论家；在测试时，使用值梯度引导参考策略生成更高价值的动作，不进行额外的策略学习。
Result: QGF 在具有高维动作空间的单任务和目标条件离线 RL 基准上优于先前的测试时 RL 方法，与最先进的训练时算法竞争力相当，且运行成本更低。
Conclusion: QGF 通过避免 actor-critic 训练的不稳定性，提供了一种实用且有效的替代 RL 算法，并且随模型大小具有良好的扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unifying Local Communications and Local Updates for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Communication-efficient pre-training of LLMs is increasingly important as training draws on compute distributed across clusters, data centers, and lower-bandwidth links. Many practical methods reduce communication frequency but still rely on synchronous All-Reduce operations that maintain identical model states and tie progress to global collectives. This can become a bottleneck when bandwidth or worker speed is heterogeneous. We introduce GASLoC, a novel decentralized pre-training algorithm that generalizes the notion of communication acceleration to the recently popular "outer optimizer" to allow a practical gossip-based training framework that is compatible with adaptive optimizers, allows for local optimizer steps, and can utilize sparse randomized peer communication. Empirically, on a number of standard LLM training tasks, we demonstrate that GASLoC outperforms state-of-the-art decentralized algorithms in single step per communication setting for a number of topologies and, unlike existing decentralized methods in the LLM setting, it allows to obtain performance competitive with DiLoCo when utilizing multiple local steps. In the heterogeneous bandwidth setting we demonstrate the advantage of GASLoC showing that it can significantly outperform DiLoCo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GASLoC，一种去中心化的LLM预训练算法，通过泛化通信加速到外部优化器，支持自适应优化器、局部步骤和稀疏随机对等通信。实验表明，在单步通信设置中GASLoC优于现有去中心化算法，在多局部步骤下性能与DiLoCo相当，在异构带宽场景下显著优于DiLoCo。
Motivation: 现有通信高效LLM预训练方法依赖同步All-Reduce，在带宽或worker速度异构时成为瓶颈。
Method: GASLoC将通信加速泛化到外部优化器，实现基于gossip的训练框架，兼容自适应优化器，允许局部优化步骤，并利用稀疏随机对等通信。
Result: 在标准LLM训练任务中，GASLoC在单步通信设置下优于现有去中心化算法；多局部步骤下性能与DiLoCo相当；在异构带宽场景下显著优于DiLoCo。
Conclusion: GASLoC提供了一种实用的去中心化训练方案，在异构带宽下具有优势，但未提及对天气或降水任务的适用性。

papers.title: A History-Aware Visually Grounded Critic for Computer Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Various test-time interventions for Computer Use Agents (CUAs), including critic models, have been developed to improve performance through pre-execution action evaluation in complex Graphical User Interface (GUI) environments. However, existing critics suffer from two key limitations: they (1) focus primarily on short-sighted decision loops (e.g., forgetting earlier actions) and (2) lack the visual grounding needed to detect flawed actions (e.g., clicking wrong UI elements). To address these, we introduce HiViG, a History-aware Visually Grounded test-time framework, built around a multimodal critic trained on real GUI trajectories to abstract past interactions into a compact record and to evaluate actions with visual grounding. At test time, HiViG integrates the critic into the policy decision loop to provide macro-action history, which summarizes the policy's completed achievements, and visually grounded critique, which verifies raw execution coordinates against the current screenshot to intercept errors before execution. Across web, mobile, and desktop benchmarks, HiViG consistently outperforms existing scalar and verbal critics, improving average success rates over the strongest baseline by 5.8% for Qwen3-VL-32B and 9.0% for Gemini-3-Flash, and demonstrates strong cross-platform generalization. Ablations show that macro-action history mitigates short-sighted planning and visually grounded critique reduces execution errors, with both components being critical for test-time scaling in long-horizon GUI tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiViG，一种历史感知的视觉基础测试时框架，针对计算机使用代理（Computer Use Agent, CUA）的短期决策和缺乏视觉定位问题。该方法通过多模态评论家（critic）在真实 GUI 轨迹上训练，将历史交互抽象为紧凑记录，并对动作进行视觉定位评估。在 Web、移动和桌面基准上，HiViG 平均成功率提升 5.8%（Qwen3-VL-32B）和 9.0%（Gemini-3-Flash），并展示了跨平台泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有的 CUA 评论家模型存在两个关键局限：过度关注短期决策循环（遗忘早期动作）和缺乏检测错误动作的视觉定位能力（如点击错误 UI 元素）。
Method: 提出 HiViG，一个历史感知的视觉基础测试时框架，包含一个在真实 GUI 轨迹上训练的多模态评论家，用于将过去交互抽象为紧凑记录，并通过视觉定位评估动作。测试时将评论家集成到策略决策循环中，提供宏观动作历史（总结已完成任务）和视觉定位批评（验证执行坐标与当前截图的一致性），以在动作执行前拦截错误。
Result: 在 Web、移动和桌面基准上，HiViG 在平均成功率上比最强基线提升 5.8%（Qwen3-VL-32B）和 9.0%（Gemini-3-Flash），并展示了强大的跨平台泛化能力。消融实验表明，宏观动作历史缓解了短视规划，视觉定位批评减少了执行错误，两者对于长程 GUI 任务的测试时缩放至关重要。
Conclusion: HiViG 通过历史感知和视觉定位的测试时干预，有效提升了计算机使用代理在长程 GUI 任务中的性能，且跨平台泛化能力强。

papers.title: Exploring the Design Space of Reward Backpropagation for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Aligning text-to-image flow matching models with human preferences via direct reward backpropagation is sample-efficient but hampered by two well-known pathologies: activations cannot be stored across the full sampling trajectory at modern model scale, and chained Jacobian products across steps inflate the reward gradient as it travels back to early indices. Connector-based methods, such as LeapAlign, address these issues by replacing the full backward trajectory with a short pinned path, highlighting a useful decoupling between sampling and optimization. However, the quality of the resulting gradient depends on how accurately this short path approximates the full rollout, especially over long intervals. We propose FlowBP, a unified surrogate-trajectory framework that treats the backward trajectory itself as the design object. FlowBP keeps a no-gradient cached rollout for sampling, then builds a lightweight backward surrogate from cached and selectively re-forwarded velocities. This view separates four choices: the reward-model input, active set, integration weights, and bridge coupling, and recovers prior direct-gradient methods as particular settings. Within this framework, we instantiate three variants: FlowBP-Sparse uses sparse Euler reconstruction, FlowBP-Bridge adds controlled bridge coupling, and FlowBP-Lagrange raises the order of leap quadrature. All three bound memory by the active-set size and limit gradient chaining to at most one Jacobian factor. Across SD3.5-M, FLUX.1-dev, and FLUX.2-Klein-base on preference, quality, and compositional metrics, the three variants improve over direct-gradient baselines on most metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowBP，一个统一的代理轨迹框架，用于文本到图像流匹配模型的直接奖励反向传播。FlowBP通过缓存无梯度的轨迹并构建轻量级反向代理，解决了全轨迹存储和梯度链式乘积的问题。它分离出四个设计选择：奖励模型输入、活动集、积分权重和桥耦合，并实例化三个变体。在多个模型和指标上，这三个变体在大多数指标上优于直接梯度基线。
Motivation: 直接奖励反向传播对齐文本到图像流匹配模型存在两个问题：全采样轨迹的激活无法存储，以及跨步骤的雅可比链式乘积膨胀梯度。现有Connector方法（如LeapAlign）通过短固定路径缓解，但路径近似质量取决于长间隔下的准确性。
Method: 提出FlowBP框架，将反向轨迹本身作为设计对象。保持无梯度的缓存轨迹用于采样，然后从缓存和选择性重前向的速度中构建轻量级反向代理。框架分离四个设计选择：奖励模型输入、活动集、积分权重和桥耦合。实例化三个变体：FlowBP-Sparse（稀疏欧拉重构）、FlowBP-Bridge（受控桥耦合）、FlowBP-Lagrange（提高跳点积分阶数）。所有变体通过活动集大小限制内存，梯度链式乘积最多一个雅可比因子。
Result: 在SD3.5-M、FLUX.1-dev和FLUX.2-Klein-base上，针对偏好、质量和组合指标，三个变体在大多数指标上优于直接梯度基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FlowBP框架统一了现有方法，并提供了更好的梯度近似效果，同时保持内存和计算效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: T1-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Scenario Agents in Real-World Domains
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in reasoning and tool-calling capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have enabled increasingly capable agentic systems. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in task complexity, realism, and domain diversity, and often fail to capture interactions that span multiple domains, limiting their ability to evaluate agents in realistic multi-step settings that require sustained reasoning and coordination. To address these limitations, we introduce T1-Bench, a high-fidelity, comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic systems in realistic customer-facing, multi-domain environments, featuring interleaved scenarios that require structured reasoning across multi-turn user-assistant interactions and substantially increasing both compositional complexity and evaluative rigor across 25 domains of varying difficulty. We evaluate T1-Bench using 12 proprietary and open-weight models, providing a reproducible and standardized framework for assessing agent behavior, tool utilization, and conversational quality in complex, multi-step environments. We further complement automatic evaluation with human judgments to strengthen the assessment of qualitative performance. Overall, T1-Bench substantially advances prior benchmarks by increasing task complexity, interaction depth, and domain coverage in simulated multi-domain environments. To facilitate future research on agentic systems, we will publicly release data and evaluation code as open source.

papers.title: GRAFT: Gain-Recalibrated Adapters for Transformer-Based Neural Population Activity Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Neural population activity models can recover rich temporal structure from binned spikes, but their read-in and readout layers often remain tied to a fixed set of recorded neurons. This coupling limits reuse in long-term brain-computer interfaces, where recorded neuron identities, counts, and response statistics can change across days. We introduce GRAFT, a Transformer-based neural population activity model that separates reusable temporal dynamics from a recalibratable neuron interface. The neuron interface controls how recorded neurons enter and leave the shared backbone, and auxiliary gain and positional mechanisms support neural activity modeling inside the Transformer. On MC Maze under the standard NLB'21 protocol, GRAFT reaches 0.3866 co-bps as an ensemble, setting a new state of the art on the primary co-bps metric among public and reported NLB'21 results. In a cross-day protocol constructed from the NLB'21 MC Maze dataset series, GRAFT recalibrates from MC Maze to the scaled MC Maze datasets (Large/Medium/Small) by updating only 9.21% of parameters, reaching 0.3749, 0.3112, and 0.3152 co-bps with restricted target-day support sets. These results show that the same interface-backbone separation supports both strong Transformer-based neural population activity modeling and data-efficient cross-day recalibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRAFT，一种基于 Transformer 的神经群体活动模型，通过分离可重用的时间动态和可重新校准的神经元接口，解决长期脑机接口中神经元身份、数量和响应统计跨天变化的问题。在 NLB'21 MC Maze 标准协议下，GRAFT 集成达到 0.3866 co-bps，创下新最优；在跨天协议中，仅更新 9.21% 参数即可有效重新校准。
Motivation: 现有神经群体活动模型的读写层通常与固定神经元集合绑定，无法适应长期脑机接口中跨天的神经元变化，限制了模型的复用。
Method: GRAFT 采用 Transformer 架构，将可重用的时间动态与可重新校准的神经元接口分离，神经元接口控制神经元进出共享骨干，并引入辅助增益和位置机制。
Result: 在 NLB'21 MC Maze 标准协议下，GRAFT 集成达到 0.3866 co-bps，创下新最优；在跨天协议中，仅更新 9.21% 参数即可在 Large/Medium/Small 缩放数据集上分别达到 0.3749、0.3112 和 0.3152 co-bps。
Conclusion: 接口-骨干分离策略支持强 Transformer 神经群体活动建模和数据高效的跨天重新校准，有望推广到其他动态神经记录场景。

papers.title: CIAware-Bench: Benchmarking Control Intervention Awareness Across Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract_en: AI control protocols oversee untrusted models by monitoring their actions and modifying potentially unsafe steps, often using a trusted model. This partially tampers with the untrusted model's trajectory. If the trusted model detects such an intervention, it may infer properties of the monitor and adapt to evade control. We introduce \textbf{CIAware-Bench}, a benchmark for measuring \textbf{c}ontrol \textbf{i}ntervention (CI) awareness across frontier models. CIAware-Bench tests whether models can distinguish their own trajectories from those modified by a control intervention. The benchmark is comprised of a suite of four task domains (essay writing, BigCodeBench, Bash Arena, and SHADE-Arena), while varying trajectory watermarking, side-task presence, and the control protocol. Evaluating eleven frontier models, we find low to moderate CI awareness under default settings (up to 0.87; random chance balanced binary classification accuracy is 0.5) with substantial variation across task domains and model pairs. Detection is generally easier across model families, suggesting that models exploit provider-specific differences in style or post-training. Overall, CI awareness is not a fixed model-level property, and should be measured for each new model release and deployment scenario. We release CIAware-Bench to track CI awareness and inform control protocols whose interventions are harder to detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIAware-Bench，一个用于衡量前沿大语言模型对控制干预（Control Intervention）感知能力的基准。该基准包含四个任务域（essay writing、BigCodeBench、Bash Arena、SHADE-Arena），并变化轨迹水印、侧任务存在与否以及控制协议。评估十一个前沿模型发现，在默认设置下模型对控制干预的感知能力较低至中等（最高0.87，随机平衡二分类准确率为0.5），且跨任务域和模型对差异显著。检测通常在不同模型族之间更容易，表明模型利用了提供商特定的风格或后训练差异。总体而言，控制干预感知不是一个固定的模型属性，应针对每个新模型发布和部署场景进行测量。
Motivation: AI控制协议通过监控和修改不可信模型的行为来确保安全，但如果不可信模型感知到这种干预，它可能推断出监控器的特性并试图规避控制。因此，量化模型对控制干预的感知能力对于设计更安全、不易被检测的控制协议至关重要。
Method: 构建 CIAware-Bench 基准，包含四个任务域，通过控制协议（如替换、修改输出）生成干预轨迹与原始轨迹，并测试模型能否区分自身轨迹与被干预轨迹。实验中变化轨迹水印、侧任务存在与否等设置，评估模型在不同条件下的检测准确率。
Result: 在11个前沿模型上，默认设置下模型对控制干预的检测准确率在0.5（随机）到0.87之间，表明感知能力总体较低到中等。跨模型族的检测更容易，提示模型利用了提供商特定风格。不同任务域和模型对之间结果差异大。
Conclusion: 控制干预感知不是一个固定的模型属性，而是依赖于具体模型、任务域和控制协议。论文建议每个新模型发布和部署场景都应测量该属性，并发布 CIAware-Bench 以跟踪感知能力，帮助设计更难被检测的控制协议。

papers.title: Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Despite its importance to applications in protein design, predicting protein properties like binding affinity and thermostability from sparse experimental data remains a significant challenge. Accordingly, we introduce a class of sequence kernels that exploit evolutionary substitution matrices as well as local linearity and demonstrate that the resulting Gaussian processes provide data-efficient models of protein property landscapes, frequently outperforming alternatives that rely on foundation model embeddings. Furthermore--by learning what are in effect structure-aware substitution matrices--we show that our kernels can readily incorporate structural information from foundation models. We demonstrate that these structure-conditioned kernels are well suited to multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes and can decisively outperform local supervised learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类利用进化替换矩阵和局部线性性的序列核，用于高斯过程模型预测蛋白质属性（如结合亲和力和热稳定性）。实验表明，这类数据高效模型常优于基于基础模型嵌入的方法，且通过学习结构感知的替换矩阵，核可融入基础模型的结构信息，适合多任务学习，并显著超越局部监督学习方法。
Motivation: 从稀疏实验数据预测蛋白质属性（如结合亲和力、热稳定性）是蛋白质设计中的关键挑战，现有方法依赖基础模型嵌入，但数据效率有限。
Method: 引入一类序列核，利用进化替换矩阵和局部线性性构建高斯过程模型；进一步通过学习结构感知替换矩阵，将基础模型的结构信息整合到核中，实现多任务学习。
Result: 该高斯过程模型在蛋白质属性预测上数据效率高，常优于基于基础模型嵌入的替代方法；结构条件核在多任务学习中显著优于局部监督学习方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的核方法为蛋白质属性预测提供了一种数据高效的替代方案，尤其适合多任务学习场景。

papers.title: What Fits (Into Few Tokens) Doesn't Overfit: Compression and Generalization in ML Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reusing a held-out benchmark adaptively should, in principle, invite overfitting. Yet benchmark-driven machine learning (ML) has produced surprisingly little overfitting in practice. An attractive hypothesis is that successful ML strategies are highly compressible. We study this in the setting of LLM-driven research agents, where the hypothesis becomes directly testable via two complementary information bottlenecks. In \emph{output compression}, an exploration agent adaptively searches for high-performance models using a validation set, and we test whether a fresh ``reproducer agent'' can reproduce its performance given only an extremely short prompt and the training data. In \emph{input compression}, the explorer receives only one-bit feedback indicating whether each submitted model improves on the running best. Across 8 datasets spanning tabular classification, vision, language modeling, diffusion modeling, and reward modeling, we find that these bottlenecks have little effect on performance: short prompts and compressible feedback are sufficient to reproduce and find high-performance models. The hypothesis is falsifiable: when we deliberately induce validation-set overfitting, the results fail to reproduce with short prompts. Taken together, our results support a description-length explanation for the lack of overfitting in benchmark-driven ML: successful strategies occupy a low-complexity region of strategy space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究LLM驱动的研究代理在自适应搜索基准时不出现过拟合的原因，通过输出压缩（复现代理仅用短提示）和输入压缩（仅一位反馈）两种信息瓶颈进行测试。在8个数据集上的实验表明，短提示和可压缩反馈足以复现高性能模型，而当故意诱导过拟合时则无法复现，支持成功策略占据低复杂区域（描述长度解释）。
Motivation: 基准驱动机器学习实践中很少出现过拟合，但理论上自适应使用保留基准会引发过拟合，本文旨在解释这一矛盾。
Method: 使用LLM驱动的探索代理在验证集上搜索模型，然后通过两种信息瓶颈测试：输出压缩中复现代理仅用极短提示和训练数据复现性能；输入压缩中探索代理仅接收一位反馈（是否优于当前最佳）。在8个数据集（表格分类、视觉、语言模型、扩散模型、奖励模型）上评估。
Result: 两种瓶颈对性能影响很小，短提示和可压缩反馈足以产生高性能模型；当故意诱导验证集过拟合时，短提示无法复现，验证了假说的可证伪性。
Conclusion: 支持描述长度解释：成功策略复杂度低，因此不会过拟合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalized Conformal Predictive Systems Under Distributional Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Conformal predictive systems (CPS) output calibrated bands of CDFs under exchangeability. We extend generalized CPS to non-exchangeable settings by encoding distributional shifts through observation-specific permutation weights. This yields shift-aware predictive systems that remain valid whenever the test point is, conditionally on the unordered sample, a weighted draw from the observed atoms. Since such weights are typically estimated, we introduce weight-uncertainty boxes and construct robust CPS envelopes with finite-sample or asymptotic confidence guarantees. We derive efficient computation for conformity-measure CPS, conformal binning, and conformal isotonic distributional regression. Experiments under covariate shift and feedback-driven biomolecular design show calibrated predictive bands that widen under stronger shifts and tighten as sample size increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将广义共形预测系统（CPS）扩展到非可交换环境，通过观测特定的排列权重编码分布偏移，产生对偏移感知的预测系统。在协变量偏移和反馈驱动的生物分子设计实验中，校准的预测带在偏移增强时变宽，随样本量增大而收紧。
Motivation: 现有共形预测系统要求数据可交换，无法处理分布偏移。需要一种方法在非可交换条件下仍能提供有效的校准预测分布。
Method: 引入观测特定的排列权重，构建偏移感知的预测系统；当权重需估计时，引入权重不确定性盒并构造鲁棒CPS包络，提供有限样本或渐近置信保证。推导了符合性度量CPS、共形分箱和共形保序分布回归的高效计算方法。
Result: 在协变量偏移和反馈驱动的生物分子设计实验中，校准的预测带在偏移增强时变宽，随样本量增大而收紧。
Conclusion: 所提方法在非可交换环境下仍能提供有效校准的预测分布，且计算高效。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.method: 引入观测特定的排列权重，构建偏移感知的预测系统；当权重需估计时，引入权重不确定性盒并构造鲁棒CPS包络，提供有限样本或渐近置信保证。推导了符合性度量CPS、共形分箱和共形保序分布回归的高效计算方法。
summary_sections.result: 在协变量偏移和反馈驱动的生物分子设计实验中，校准的预测带在偏移增强时变宽，随样本量增大而收紧。
summary_sections.conclusion: 所提方法在非可交换环境下仍能提供有效校准的预测分布，且计算高效。

papers.title: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the rapid evolution of AI agents toward handling increasingly complex, real-world tasks. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can operate graphical user interfaces to complete long-horizon, high-value professional workflows across diverse domains. Current GUI benchmarks still predominantly focus on general-purpose software, relatively simple applications, and short-horizon tasks, leaving it largely unknown whether modern agents can follow user instructions to autonomously operate domain-specific professional software and accomplish economically valuable work in an end-to-end manner. To bridge this gap, we introduce Workflow-GYM, a benchmark for long-horizon GUI tasks centered on professional domains and specialized software environments. Through extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models, we find that even the strongest models achieve only slightly above 30% success rates, highlighting that professional long-horizon GUI workflows remain highly challenging for current GUI agents. Further analysis reveals that current agents struggle to maintain long-horizon workflow consistency, frequently exhibiting workflow stage omission, error propagation, objective drift, and insufficient understanding of professional software environments. Our findings provide important insights into the limitations of current agent systems and suggest key directions for the next generation of GUI-agent research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Workflow-GYM，一个评估AI代理在专业领域软件中完成长时程GUI任务的基准。在多个当前最优模型上测试，最高成功率仅略超30%。论文指出代理在长流程一致性上存在阶段遗漏、错误传播、目标漂移和对专业软件环境理解不足等问题。
Motivation: 现有GUI基准主要关注通用软件、简单应用和短时程任务，缺乏对专业领域长时程、高价值工作流的评估，导致无法了解现代代理在端到端自主操作专业软件方面的能力。
Method: 构建了Workflow-GYM基准，聚焦专业领域和专用软件环境的长时程GUI任务，并对多个先进模型进行实验评估。
Result: 最强的模型在基准上的成功率仅略高于30%，表明专业长时程GUI工作流对当前GUI代理仍然极具挑战性。
Conclusion: 当前代理在维持长时程工作流一致性方面存在困难，包括阶段遗漏、错误传播、目标漂移及对专业软件环境理解不足，这些发现为下一代GUI代理研究提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AuRA: Internalizing Audio Understanding into LLMs as LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Recent efforts to extend large language models (LLMs) to speech inputs typically rely on cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines, end-to-end speech-language models, or bridge/distillation-based adaptation. While these routes respectively reuse strong pretrained components, enable native speech-language interaction, or offer lightweight adaptation, they often suffer from transcript-interface latency, costly multimodal training, or sequential speech-language coupling. To address these limitations, we present AuRA, a method that distills audio encoding capability into the LLM. Specifically, AuRA feeds the same speech input to an ASR encoder (as a teacher) and a LoRA-adapted LLM (as a student) through a lightweight audio embedding layer, and uses layer-wise distillation to align the student's hidden states with corresponding teacher representations, thereby internalizing speech representations into lightweight LLM-side adaptations. Compared with cascaded and serial bridge methods, AuRA enables tighter speech-language joint modeling and efficient parallel end-to-end inference, while also reusing pretrained speech and language models rather than requiring large-scale multimodal training. On multiple speech-language benchmarks, AuRA consistently outperforms cascaded systems, speech-to-LLM adaptation baselines, and large-scale speech-language and multimodal models in both effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AuRA 方法，通过知识蒸馏将音频编码能力内化到 LLM 中。具体而言，该方法使用 ASR 编码器作为教师，LoRA 适配的 LLM 作为学生，通过轻量音频嵌入层和层间蒸馏对齐隐藏状态，实现端到端并行推理。在多个语音语言基准上，AuRA 在效果和效率上均优于级联系统、语音到 LLM 自适应基线以及大规模语音语言和多模态模型。
Motivation: 现有将 LLM 扩展到语音输入的方法（如级联 ASR-LLM 流水线、端到端语音语言模型、桥接/蒸馏自适应）存在转录接口延迟、多模态训练成本高或语音-语言耦合顺序等问题。
Method: AuRA 将同一语音输入分别输入 ASR 编码器（教师）和 LoRA 适配的 LLM（学生），通过轻量音频嵌入层，并利用层间蒸馏使学生隐藏状态对齐教师表示，从而将语音表示内部化为轻量级 LLM 端适配。
Result: 在多个语音语言基准上，AuRA 一致优于级联系统、语音到 LLM 自适应基线以及大规模语音语言和多模态模型，在效果和效率上均更优。
Conclusion: AuRA 实现了更紧密的语音-语言联合建模和高效的并行端到端推理，同时复用了预训练的语音和语言模型，无需大规模多模态训练。

papers.title: U-TTT: Towards Generalizable PET Image Denoising via Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep learning models for Positron Emission Tomography (PET) image denoising often suffer from severe performance degradation under distribution shifts, fundamentally restricting their robust clinical deployment. This lack of generalization stems from the conventional paradigm of fixed-parameter models that cannot adapt to variations in test data (e.g., dose levels or scanner types) after training. To overcome this limitation and achieve robust generalization, we introduce U-TTT, a novel U-shaped model that integrates Test-Time Training (TTT) layers to dynamically adjust model parameters during inference through self-supervision, thereby adapting to the specific characteristics of each test instance. Furthermore, to comprehensively capture the complex degradations of 3D PET data, U-TTT features a dual-domain adaptation mechanism comprising a Spatial Test-Time Training (S-TTT) layer and a Frequency Test-Time Training (F-TTT) layer. The S-TTT layer captures and corrects spatial structural degradations, while the F-TTT layer suppresses global noise spectra and restores delicate high-frequency details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that U-TTT achieves state-of-the-art PET denoising performance and exhibits superior generalization under challenging distribution shifts, including both unseen dose levels and unseen scanners. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Yaziwel/U-TTT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: U-TTT 是一种结合测试时训练 (Test-Time Training) 的 U 形网络，用于 PET 图像去噪。它通过自监督方式在推理时动态调整模型参数，以适应不同剂量水平或扫描仪类型等分布偏移，从而提升泛化能力。模型包含空间域和频率域两个 TTT 层，分别处理结构退化与噪声频谱。实验表明该方法在未见过的剂量和扫描仪上均达到 SOTA 性能。
Motivation: 现有的 PET 去噪模型在分布偏移下性能严重下降，原因是固定参数模型无法适应测试数据的变化（如剂量水平或扫描仪类型），限制了临床应用。
Method: 提出 U-TTT，包含空间测试时训练 (S-TTT) 层和频率测试时训练 (F-TTT) 层，在推理时通过自监督学习动态调整模型参数，适应每个测试实例的特定退化特征。
Result: 在多个分布偏移场景下（包括未见过的剂量水平和扫描仪类型）均取得 SOTA 去噪性能，展现出优越的泛化能力。
Conclusion: U-TTT 通过测试时训练有效提升了 PET 去噪模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，为模型在临床中的稳健部署提供了新思路。

papers.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of the true policy divergence, leading to over-constraining in some regions of the trajectory and under-constraining in others. We propose Flow-DPPO (Flow Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization), which replaces ratio clipping with a divergence proximal constraint. A key observation is that the per-step policy in flow models is Gaussian, enabling exact and cheap computation of the KL divergence between old and new policies. Flow-DPPO employs an asymmetric divergence mask that blocks gradient updates only when they simultaneously move away from the trusted region and violate the divergence threshold. Experiments show that Flow-DPPO achieves higher rewards with better KL-proximal efficiency, alleviates catastrophic forgetting, promotes balanced multi-objective optimization, and enables stable multi-epoch training where ratio clipping degrades. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/UniRL/tree/main/FlowDPPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Flow-DPPO，一种针对流匹配模型的近端策略优化方法，用KL散度约束替代传统的比率裁剪，以解决流模型中策略更新不稳定的问题。实验表明该方法在奖励、KL近端效率和多目标优化上优于现有方法，支持稳定多轮训练。
Motivation: 现有在线强化学习方法（如Flow-GRPO）在流匹配模型中使用PPO风格的比率裁剪，但比率裁剪在流模型中会导致策略更新在不同轨迹区域过度或不足约束，因为概率比是真实策略散度的有噪单样本估计。
Method: Flow-DPPO将比率裁剪替换为散度近端约束（divergence proximal constraint），利用流模型每步策略为高斯分布的特性，精确且廉价地计算新旧策略之间的KL散度，并采用非对称散度掩码（asymmetric divergence mask）仅在梯度同时远离信任区域且超过散度阈值时阻止更新。
Result: 实验显示Flow-DPPO相比比率裁剪方法获得更高的奖励，具有更好的KL近端效率，减轻了灾难性遗忘，促进了均衡的多目标优化，并支持稳定的多轮训练。
Conclusion: 论文认为比率裁剪不适用于流模型，所提出的散度近端约束能更稳定有效地优化流匹配生成模型。

papers.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommendation aims to predict users' next interaction with items by analyzing their historical behavior. However, the limited quality of item representations remains a critical bottleneck. While pre-trained large language models (LLMs) can provide rich semantic representations, existing approaches only rely on static encoding of fixed attributes, overlooking the crucial role of target audiences in defining item identity. Moreover, the semantic space struggles to reflect actual user behavior, resulting in a significant gap between semantic representations and behavioral patterns. To address these limitations, we propose GenAIR, a general framework that empowers sequential recommendation with Generative Archetype-grounded Item Representations. Specifically, we first leverage an LLM to analyze item metadata and infer textual description of the Archetype, which represents the conceptual profile of the item's ideal target audience. We then extract the corresponding embeddings in a single forward pass. Further, to ground these generative archetypes in real-world behavior, we introduce a behavioral calibration objective, which explicitly incorporates behavioral signals from actual interactions. This objective adjusts the structure of the embedding space to reflect empirical patterns. GenAIR enables seamless integration with most existing models while maintaining high efficiency. Comprehensive experiments conducted on three real-world datasets demonstrate that GenAIR significantly improves the performance of various sequential recommendation models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baseline approaches. Implementation codes are available at https://github.com/AI-Santiago/GenAIR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对序列推荐中物品表示质量有限的问题，提出GenAIR框架，通过大语言模型（LLM）推断物品目标受众的原型（Archetype）并提取嵌入，再引入行为校准目标利用实际交互信号调整嵌入空间。在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，GenAIR显著提升了多种序列推荐模型的性能，并一致优于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐方法中，物品表示质量是瓶颈；静态LLM编码忽略目标受众对物品身份的定义，且语义空间与实际用户行为存在差距。
Method: GenAIR先利用LLM分析物品元数据生成描述目标受众的原型文本，再单次前向提取嵌入；然后通过行为校准目标，融入实际交互中的行为信号来调整嵌入空间结构。
Result: 在三个真实数据集上，GenAIR显著提升多种序列推荐模型的性能，并持续优于最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: GenAIR可高效集成至多数现有模型，且通过行为校准缩小了语义表示与行为模式之间的差距。

papers.title: Diffusion Forcing Planner: History-Annealed Planning with Time-Dependent Guidance for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based motion planners, despite recent progress, often suffer from temporal inconsistency. Small perturbations across frames can accumulate into unstable trajectories, degrading comfort and safety in closed-loop driving. Several methods attempt to inject history as a static conditioning signal to stabilize outputs, only to induce the planner to copy historical patterns instead of adapting to environment contexts. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Forcing Planner (DFP), a diffusion-based planning framework driven by history-guided control. Specifically, DFP decomposes the full trajectory into history, current and future segments, and assign independent noise levels to each segment. The model jointly denoises the historical and the future segments, enforcing a heterogeneous joint diffusion process. At inference, classifier-free guidance (CFG) is applied to steer future sampling using annealed history in a controllable manner. Closed-loop evaluation and comprehensive ablations on nuPlan show that DFP achieves competitive performance while producing continuous, stable, and controllable motion plans in complex driving scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion Forcing Planner (DFP)，一种基于扩散的自动驾驶运动规划框架，通过将轨迹分解为历史、当前和未来段并分配独立噪声水平进行异质联合扩散，推理时利用退火历史引导未来采样。在 nuPlan 闭环评估中，DFP 实现了连续、稳定、可控的运动规划，解决了时间不一致性问题。
Motivation: 现有运动规划器因帧间小扰动积累导致轨迹不稳定，而直接注入历史作为静态条件会使规划器复制历史模式而非适应环境上下文。
Method: 将完整轨迹分解为历史、当前和未来三段，每段分配独立噪声水平，在训练中联合去噪历史与未来段；推理时通过无分类器引导 (CFG) 对退火历史进行可控引导。
Result: 在 nuPlan 上的闭环评估和全面消融实验显示，DFP 在复杂驾驶场景中生成连续、稳定、可控的运动规划，并达到竞争性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DFP 通过历史退火引导的异质联合扩散有效提升时间一致性，为自动驾驶规划提供稳定可控的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data-Driven Runway and Taxiway Exits Prediction of Landing Aircraft: A Case Study at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport
papers.abstract_en: Airport surface operations increasingly constrain performance at high-throughput hubs. This study examines arrival taxi-in decisions at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (KATL) and proposes a two-stage, data-driven decision aid that mirrors controller workflow. Stage I predicts the runway exit selected by an arriving aircraft. Stage II predicts whether, given that exit, the aircraft will cross the active departure runway at a designated point or use the end-around taxiway. Models are trained using ASDE-X surface trajectories, aircraft characteristics, ramp destinations, short-horizon traffic rates, and weather across multiple look-back windows. We benchmark nine classifiers, including Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, and evaluate accuracy, macro-F1, precision-recall behavior, confusion matrices, Brier score, and Expected Calibration Error. Across east and west flows, XGBoost and LightGBM outperform Random Forest. Stage I achieves 0.86-0.89 accuracy with macro-F1 scores of 0.40-0.50, while Stage II achieves 0.70-0.74 accuracy with macro-F1 scores of 0.28-0.55. Feature-importance analysis shows that approach speed is the main driver of exit choice. Departure rate, crossing rate, ramp destination, and, for west flow, the selected exit are the strongest predictors of crossing versus end-around routing. Minority classes remain harder to predict because of feature-space overlap, as shown by t-SNE and UMAP analyses. The proposed framework supports controller situational awareness through calibrated, explainable predictions while preserving human responsibility for final routing decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究亚特兰大机场到达滑行决策的两阶段数据驱动模型。阶段一预测着陆飞机选择的跑道出口，阶段二预测飞机是否穿越活动起飞跑道或使用滑行道绕行。模型基于ASDE-X轨迹、飞机特征、机位目的地、短时交通率和天气训练。XGBoost和LightGBM表现最佳，阶段一准确率0.86-0.89，阶段二0.70-0.74。进近速度是出口选择的关键特征。
Motivation: 机场地面运行在繁忙枢纽成为性能瓶颈，现有研究缺乏对到达飞机出口选择和穿越跑道决策的联合预测。
Method: 提出两阶段数据驱动决策辅助工具：阶段一分类预测跑道出口，阶段二分类预测是否穿越跑道。使用多种机器学习分类器（随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost等）训练，特征包括轨迹、飞机参数、流量和天气。
Result: 阶段一准确率0.86-0.89，宏F1 0.40-0.50；阶段二准确率0.70-0.74，宏F1 0.28-0.55。进近速度是最重要的特征；跨跑道决策受离港率、穿越率、机位目的地和所选出口影响。少数类预测难度大。
Conclusion: 框架可为管制员提供校准、可解释的预测，增强态势感知，同时保留最终决策权。少数类预测因特征空间重叠仍具挑战。

papers.title: Superficial Beliefs in LLM Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) merely imitate rationales when choosing between two options, or whether their choices reflect a systematic underlying decision structure. Using synthetic binary decision settings in which models choose between profiles defined by graded attributes, we compare the attribute a model says mattered most with the attribute that best explains its choice under a behavioural model fit to prior decisions. The behavioural model predicts held-out choices well, showing that model behaviour is systematically related to the visible attributes rather than being random. However, direct self-reports and a separate score-based judge recover the behaviourally inferred driver only partially. The resulting picture is neither one of arbitrary behaviour nor one of fully articulated belief - outputs are structured enough to support prediction, but explicit reasons track the recovered driver only imperfectly. This qualitative pattern persists across prompt-order and sampling perturbations, alternative behavioural models, targeted occlusion analyses, and structurally varied decision settings. We interpret this as evidence for ``superficial belief'' in LLM decision-making: models behave as if guided by probabilistic local priorities over attributes, while having only limited verbal access to the attributes that drive their decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）在二元决策任务中是否仅模仿理由，还是具有系统性的决策结构。通过合成二选一决策场景，对比模型声称的最重要属性与行为模型推断出的实际驱动属性，发现模型行为可预测但自述理由不准确，表明存在“表面信念”（superficial belief）。
Motivation: 现有研究对LLM决策是否具有系统性结构存在争议，该论文旨在通过行为模型与自述理由的对比，揭示LLM决策的内在一致性及其可解释性。
Method: 设计合成二元决策任务，让模型在具有分级属性的选项中选择，并报告哪个属性最重要；同时用行为模型（如逻辑回归）基于先前选择拟合出属性权重，将模型自述与行为推断的驱动属性进行比较。实验包括顺序扰动、采样扰动、替代行为模型、遮挡分析等。
Result: 行为模型能很好预测未参与拟合的决策，表明模型行为与可见属性系统相关；但自述理由仅部分匹配行为推断的驱动属性。该定性模式在多种扰动和设置下均稳定。
Conclusion: LLM决策既非任意也非完全理性，而是表现为具有概率性局部优先级的行为，但对真正驱动决策的属性仅有有限的言语访问能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure from Reasoning, Numbers from Search: On-Premise Open LLMs as Structural Priors for Coupled MIMO Controller Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Tuning controllers for strongly coupled multi-input multi-output (MIMO) industrial processes is hard: decentralized classical auto-tuning ignores loop interaction, and local numerical optimization from natural initializations stalls in the resulting non-convex cost landscape. We ask whether on-premise open-source large language models (LLMs), which keep data on-site and need no plant model, can help. On a single-loop CSTR, classical relay-feedback tuning (IAE 0.106, near the 0.102 optimum) beats an LLM tuner (0.162): for simple loops the LLM adds nothing. The picture inverts on a strongly coupled quadruple-tank with conflicting set-points, scored by a penalized cost J = IAE + lambda*TV(u) that rewards tracking without chattering actuators. There, naive relay tuning (J ~ 28.6) and naive LLM tuning (29.7) are no better than open loop (22.7), and a local optimizer from balanced starts fails in 10/10 runs. A scaffolded open LLM instead reasons about the coupling, proposes the counter-intuitive asymmetric structure, and reaches J ~ 16.9 +/- 0.2 from any start; refining it with a classical optimizer attains the smooth global optimum (J ~ 12.0, 10/10 vs. 0/10), which even applies a non-obvious negative integral correction decentralized tuning cannot. A global optimizer (differential evolution) also reaches this optimum, so the LLM is not the only route; its advantage is sample efficiency and interpretability: a usable controller in 18 evaluations (where the global optimizer is worse than open loop) plus a stated rationale. This edge grows with dimension, reaching ~6x fewer evaluations on a 3x3 plant. The behaviour generalizes across four open models, and on a benign plant the LLM offers no advantage, sharpening the boundary. We contribute a reproducible benchmark delimiting when open LLMs help in control tuning: not as optimizers, but as a sample-efficient, interpretable structural prior.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在强耦合多输入多输出（MIMO）工业过程控制器调优中，使用本地开源大语言模型（LLM）是否有效。在简单回路（CSTR）上LLM无优势，但在强耦合四水箱系统上，LLM能推理耦合关系并提出反直觉的非对称结构，结合经典优化达到全局最优（代价J~12.0，10/10成功），而传统去中心化调优和局部优化均失败。LLM的优势在于样本效率（18次评估即可得到可用控制器）和可解释性，在3x3系统上评估次数减少约6倍。该行为在四个开源模型上通用，在良性系统上无优势。论文贡献了一个可重复的基准，划定了LLM在控制调优中的有用边界：作为样本高效、可解释的结构先验，而非优化器。
Motivation: 现有去中心化经典自调优忽略回路耦合，局部数值优化从自然初值出发会在非凸代价景观中停滞，且需要植物模型。需要一种既能处理耦合、保护数据隐私又无需模型的调优方法。
Method: 使用本地开源LLM（无需植物模型，数据本地化）作为结构先验：LLM推理耦合关系，提出反直觉的非对称控制器结构，然后结合经典优化器（如局部优化）进行细化。与全局优化器（差分进化）对比，比较样本效率和可解释性。
Result: 在强耦合四水箱系统上，朴素继电调优（J~28.6）和朴素LLM调优（29.7）均不如开环（22.7），但有支持的LLM达到J~16.9±0.2，再经经典优化达到全局最优J~12.0（10/10成功）。LLM在18次评估内得到可用控制器，而全局优化器在同样评估次数下比开环更差。在3x3系统上评估次数减少约6倍。该行为在四个开源模型上通用，在良性CSTR上无优势。
Conclusion: 论文划定了开源LLM在控制调优中的有用边界：不是作为优化器，而是作为样本高效、可解释的结构先验。提供了一个可重复的基准，并强调其优势在高维耦合系统中更为显著。
Relevance: 10
