papers.title: An Uncertainty Estimation Framework for Dose Accumulation in Adaptive Radiotherapy: Application to CBCT-Guided Radiotherapy for Cervical Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Background and purpose: oART enables daily plan adaptation to interfraction anatomical variations, but cumulative dose estimation remains limited by DIR, segmentation, and anatomical uncertainties. We introduce IMPACT-DoseAcc, an uncertainty-aware dose accumulation framework, within IMPACT for semantic feature-driven image analysis. The framework is modality- and disease-agnostic and is applied to CBCT-guided oART for cervical cancer (LACC). Material and Methods: Nine LACC patients were retrospectively analyzed using daily CBCT-derived virtual CTs for dose recalculation. IMPACT-DoseAcc focuses on uncertainty from DIR, without modeling vCT-generation uncertainty. Two DIR uncertainty strategies were tested within IMPACT-Reg: a Bayesian segmentation-guided approach using one probabilistic model to quantify anatomical uncertainty, and an ensemble of segmentation models targeting structures to capture epistemic variability. Voxel-wise uncertainty maps were propagated through dose warping and accumulation to generate probabilistic dose-volume histograms. Ensemble uncertainty was quantified from voxel-wise standard deviation across deformation fields, and geometric error was assessed using surface distance between warped and validated contours. Anatomical-variability weighting refined aggregation. Results: Ensemble DIR uncertainty correlated with geometric error, with Pearson coefficients of 0.63 for CTVt and 0.66 for bladder. For CTVt, pDVHs achieved 96.3 +/- 3.9% coverage, showing calibration of propagated uncertainty. Weighting stabilized estimates across fractions and organs. Conclusions: IMPACT-DoseAcc propagates registration-driven uncertainty to cumulative dose metrics, improving interpretation of accumulated dose under anatomical variations. Its 3DSlicer integration supports reproducible, uncertainty-informed ART workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个不确定性感知的剂量累积框架 IMPACT-DoseAcc，适用于自适应放疗中的剂量累积，重点关注 CBCT 引导的宫颈癌放疗。框架通过贝叶斯分割引导或集成分割模型来量化 DIR 不确定性，并将体素级不确定性映射传播到剂量变形和累积中，生成概率性剂量体积直方图。在 9 例 LACC 患者回顾性分析中，集成 DIR 不确定性与几何误差相关，CTVt 覆盖率 96.3±3.9%，验证了不确定性传播的校准性。
Motivation: 自适应放疗中日常计划调整受解剖变异影响，但累积剂量估计受限於 DIR、分割和解剖不确定性，现有方法缺乏对不确定性的量化与传播。
Method: 基于 IMPACT 框架，扩展 IMPACT-DoseAcc 模块，采用两种 DIR 不确定性策略：贝叶斯分割引导概率模型（量化解剖不确定性）和集成分割模型（捕获认知不确定性）。通过体素级不确定性映射经剂量变形和累积生成概率性剂量体积直方图，并用解剖变异权重优化聚合。
Result: 集成 DIR 不确定性与几何误差的 Pearson 系数：CTVt 0.63，膀胱 0.66。CTVt 覆盖率为 96.3±3.9%，表明传播的不确定性具有校准性。加权聚合稳定了跨分次和器官的估计。
Conclusion: IMPACT-DoseAcc 将配准驱动的不确定性传播到累积剂量指标，改善了解剖变异下累积剂量的解释；3DSlicer 集成支持可重复、不确定性感知的 ART 工作流。

summary_sections.motivation: 自适应放疗中日常计划调整受解剖变异影响，但累积剂量估计受限於 DIR、分割和解剖不确定性，现有方法缺乏对不确定性的量化与传播。
summary_sections.method: 基于 IMPACT 框架，扩展 IMPACT-DoseAcc 模块，采用两种 DIR 不确定性策略：贝叶斯分割引导概率模型（量化解剖不确定性）和集成分割模型（捕获认知不确定性）。通过体素级不确定性映射经剂量变形和累积生成概率性剂量体积直方图，并用解剖变异权重优化聚合。
summary_sections.result: 集成 DIR 不确定性与几何误差的 Pearson 系数：CTVt 0.63，膀胱 0.66。CTVt 覆盖率为 96.3±3.9%，表明传播的不确定性具有校准性。加权聚合稳定了跨分次和器官的估计。
summary_sections.conclusion: IMPACT-DoseAcc 将配准驱动的不确定性传播到累积剂量指标，改善了解剖变异下累积剂量的解释；3DSlicer 集成支持可重复、不确定性感知的 ART 工作流。

papers.title: Understanding and mitigating the risks of OpenClaw for non-technical users: A practical guide with Skill
papers.abstract_en: OpenClaw has rapidly emerged as a transformative artificial intelligence (AI) agent framework, and its ability to autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks has attracted an ever-growing and diverse user base. However, this capability comes with significant risks. While existing research has made important strides in characterizing these threats, such work is predominantly directed at technically sophisticated audiences. It remains largely inaccessible to non-technical users. This demographic now makes up an increasingly large and underserved portion of the community, yet it is these very users who most urgently need practical and straightforward guidance. In response, we bridge this gap through a series of interconnected efforts designed to lower the risk barrier for non-technical OpenClaw users. First, we identify and categorize seven core risks that OpenClaw users may encounter in daily usage, explaining each in plain language so that non-technical users can readily grasp the nature and potential consequences of these threats. Second, for each identified risk, we distill a set of corresponding defensive strategies into clear and actionable operational steps that are easy to follow. Third, to make protection even easier, we provide a companion OpenClaw Skill that automates key security configurations, enabling users to safeguard their systems with minimal manual intervention. Through this work, we demonstrate that safeguarding against the risks of intelligent agents need not be the exclusive domain of security experts, and that non-technical users can meaningfully participate in reducing these risks through simple, practical actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对OpenClaw AI代理框架对非技术用户的风险，识别并分类了七种日常使用中的核心风险，用通俗语言解释其性质和潜在后果；针对每种风险提供了清晰可操作的防御步骤；并开发了一个配套的OpenClaw Skill来自动化关键安全配置，帮助用户以最小手动干预保护系统。
Motivation: 现有关于OpenClaw风险的研究主要面向技术专家，非技术用户缺乏实用指导，而后者构成了日益庞大且未得到充分服务的群体，最迫切需要简单直接的防护指南。
Method: 首先通过文献和实践总结七大风险类别并用通俗语言解释；其次为每类风险提炼出明确的、可遵循的操作步骤；最后开发一个自动化安全配置的OpenClaw Skill，降低手动干预需求。
Result: 论文本身为实践指南，未报告具体实验数据或量化结果。
Conclusion: 本文表明，防范智能代理风险并非安全专家的专属领域，非技术用户通过简单实用的行动也能有效降低风险。

papers.title: IPSM-Bench: A New Intermediate Phase Segmentation Benchmark in Microstructure Images of Zinc-Based Absorbable Biomaterials
papers.abstract_en: Zinc-based alloys are indispensable emerging absorbable metallic biomaterials, and their macroscopic performance is governed by microstructural characteristics. Intermediate phases-key microstructural constituents-are pivotal in regulating mechanical and functional properties. However, intermediate phase segmentation in zinc alloy microstructures faces formidable challenges: scarce annotated datasets, low contrast, difficulty detecting small targets, and heterogeneous morphologies. To this end, we construct IPSM-Bench, the largest high-quality dataset for zinc-alloy intermediate phase segmentation. Furthermore, we propose SCoP-SAM, a new Spatial Context Prior-guided SAM method that leverages the gradient structure and grayscale properties of intermediate phases to capture spatial context priors and incorporates them into the entire SAM encoding-decoding process, improving segmentation performance. Based on the proposed IPSM-Bench, we establish a new benchmark for intermediate phase segmentation to systematically evaluate state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and advance research on zinc alloy microstructure analysis. Extensive experiments on IPSM-Bench and additional public alloy benchmarks demonstrate that our SCoP-SAM not only achieves SOTA performance for zinc-alloy intermediate phase segmentation but also generalizes remarkably well to other alloy scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了锌合金可吸收生物材料微观结构图像中中间相分割的最大高质量数据集IPSM-Bench，并提出了SCoP-SAM方法，利用梯度结构和灰度属性捕获空间上下文先验，将其融入SAM编解码过程，在中间相分割任务上取得了最优性能，并在其他合金数据集上展现了良好泛化性。
Motivation: 锌合金中间相分割面临标注数据稀缺、低对比度、小目标检测困难及形态异质等挑战，现有方法在此任务上表现不佳。
Method: 提出SCoP-SAM，通过提取中间相的梯度结构和灰度信息作为空间上下文先验，将其注入SAM的编码-解码全过程，引导分割。
Result: 在IPSM-Bench基准上，SCoP-SAM达到中间相分割的最优性能，并在其他公开合金数据集上验证了强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本研究提供了基准数据集和方法，推动了锌合金微观结构分析领域的研究，并表明空间上下文先验能有效提升专用场景下的SAM分割效果。

papers.title: Null-Space Constrained Low-Rank Adaptation for Response-Specified Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Large language model unlearning aims to suppress designated undesirable knowledge while preserving benign capabilities. Many unlearning objectives focus on suppressing undesired answers, while recent target-guided variants specify replacement behavior but still leave update locality largely unconstrained. This paper introduces \emph{Null-Space Constrained Response-Specified Unlearning} (NSRU), a projection-constrained low-rank framework for controlled LLM unlearning. NSRU uses an explicitly structured safe target response to specify the desired behavior for each forget query, while suppressing the original undesired content. To localize adaptation, NSRU estimates per-module retain subspaces from benign hidden representations and uses an orthogonal-projected low-rank parameterization to confine LoRA updates to the null space of the retain subspace. The resulting objective jointly optimizes safe-target learning, undesired-response suppression, and retention preservation under this constrained parameterization. We provide a local first-order analysis showing that the projected update reduces retain-side perturbations while preserving editable directions for shaping forget-query behavior. Experiments on TOFU show that NSRU effectively suppresses extractable forget-set knowledge while improving retain QA performance, model utility, and safe-target alignment over representative baselines. On WMDP, NSRU keeps hazardous-domain accuracy near the random-choice region while preserving broad and domain-adjacent MMLU utility. Ablation studies support the complementary roles of safe-target supervision, undesired-response suppression, retention loss, and null-space projected updates, while sensitivity and robustness analyses indicate stable behavior across the tested hyperparameter and prompt variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出零空间约束响应指定遗忘（NSRU），一种投影约束的低秩框架用于可控的大语言模型遗忘。NSRU使用显式结构化的安全目标响应指定遗忘查询的期望行为，并通过正交投影低秩参数化将LoRA更新限制在保留子空间的零空间中，从而抑制原始不期望内容。在TOFU和WMDP上的实验表明，NSRU有效抑制遗忘集知识，同时保持良性能力。
Motivation: 现有遗忘目标主要抑制不期望答案，而目标导向变体虽指定替换行为但更新局部性约束不足，导致保留能力受损。
Method: NSRU通过估计每模块的保留子空间，使用正交投影低秩参数化将LoRA更新限制在保留子空间的零空间，联合优化安全目标学习、不期望响应抑制和保留保持。
Result: 在TOFU上，NSRU有效抑制可提取的遗忘集知识，同时提高保留问答性能、模型效用和安全目标对齐。在WMDP上，危险领域准确率接近随机选择区域，同时保留MMLU效用。消融研究验证了各组分的互补作用。
Conclusion: 实验表明，安全目标监督、不期望响应抑制、保留损失和零空间投影更新共同作用，且在超参数和提示变化下表现稳定。

papers.title: AnimaSpark: A Feed-Forward Method for Animating Arbitrary 3D Objects
papers.abstract_en: While recent advancements in generative AI have substantially accelerated static 3D model creation workflows, the synthesis of category-agnostic 3D animations remains a significant bottleneck in 3D asset production. Current methods for category-agnostic animation generation exhibit critical limitations in inference speed, motion quality, and adherence to textual prompts, thereby leaving the process dependent on labor-intensive manual artistry. To address these challenges, this paper introduces AnimaSpark, a novel pipeline for category-agnostic 3D animation generation. Our approach is motivated by the key insight that for many fundamental motions in the 3D world, the corresponding joint transformations can often be effectively modeled within a two-dimensional subspace. The pipeline begins by rendering a rigged static 3D model into multi-layered image representations of its mesh and skeleton, which are subsequently fed into a video generation model. We then employ a keypoint tracking algorithm on the generated video to capture the motion of the skeletal joints projected onto the camera's viewing plane. In the final stage, we distill the planar translations and rotations from these tracked keypoints and lift them from the 2D domain into 3D space to animate the character. Comprehensive evaluations reveal that our method achieves superior performance over existing state-of-the-art techniques across key metrics, including text-motion alignment, quality of motion, and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnimaSpark，一种类别无关的 3D 动画生成管线。核心思路是将带骨架的静态 3D 模型渲染为多层图像表示（网格与骨架），输入视频生成模型后，利用关键点跟踪算法捕捉投影到相机平面的关节运动，再将二维平移旋转提升到三维空间驱动角色。实验表明该方法在文本-动作对齐、运动质量和计算效率上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 当前类别无关的 3D 动画生成存在推理速度慢、运动质量低、对文本提示的遵循性差等问题，严重依赖人工制作，成为 3D 资产生产的瓶颈。
Method: 将带骨架的静态 3D 模型渲染为多层图像（网格与骨架），输入视频生成模型；然后对生成视频使用关键点跟踪算法，获取骨骼关节在相机平面的投影运动；最后从跟踪的关键点中提取二维平移与旋转，并将其提升到三维空间以驱动角色动画。
Result: 在文本-动作对齐、运动质量和计算效率等关键指标上，AnimaSpark 超越了现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法利用许多基本三维运动的关节变换可在二维子空间有效建模的观察，实现了高效且高质量的类别无关动画生成，但可能仅适用于可被二维子空间建模的运动类型。

papers.title: Bellman-Taylor Score Decoding for Markov Decision Processes with State-Dependent Feasible Action Sets
papers.abstract_en: Many Markov decision processes (MDPs) in operations research have feasible actions that are state dependent and defined implicitly by various operational constraints. These features make it difficult to use standard deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms, whose action interfaces typically assume either a fixed finite action catalog or a simple Euclidean space. Motivated by a Taylor expansion of the optimal action-value function, we propose Bellman--Taylor score decoding, a framework that moves policy learning to a Euclidean score space while enforcing feasibility through an action decoder. The induced latent-score MDP then can be optimized by standard DRL algorithms without differentiating through the decoder. We provide a performance guarantee showing that the optimality gap of this approach decomposes into a structural approximation error and an algorithmic learning error. Lastly, we apply this framework to a queueing network control problem, where the policy essentially learns a state-dependent index-based dispatching rule. Numerical experiments show near-optimal performance in small instances and considerable improvements over benchmarks in larger systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对运筹学中状态依赖可行性动作集的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出 Bellman-Taylor 分数解码框架。该框架基于最优动作值函数的泰勒展开，将策略学习转移到欧几里得分数空间，并通过动作解码器强制执行可行性。作者提供了性能保证，表明最优性差距分解为结构近似误差和算法学习误差。在排队网络控制问题上的数值实验显示，该方法在小规模实例中实现近最优性能，在更大系统中显著优于基准方法。
Motivation: 标准深度强化学习算法通常假设固定有限动作目录或简单欧几里得空间，难以处理具有状态依赖且隐式定义的可行动作集的 MDP，这些动作由各种操作约束定义。
Method: 提出 Bellman-Taylor 分数解码框架：通过泰勒展开将策略学习转移到欧几里得分数空间，利用动作解码器映射回可行动作集，使得潜在分数 MDP 可直接使用标准深度强化学习算法优化，无需对解码器求导。
Result: 在排队网络控制问题上，该方法在小规模实例中达到近最优性能，在更大系统中显著优于基准方法。
Conclusion: 框架的性能保证表明最优性差距可分解为结构近似误差和算法学习误差，为应用提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Learning Doubly Sparse Explicitly Conditioned Transforms
papers.abstract_en: Finding convenient spaces in which certain hypotheses regarding an assumed sparse structure of natural signals hold true has become a desirable result in recent research, its implications being reflected in areas such as data compression, noise reduction and feature extraction. While the extensively used analytical transforms, such as DFT or DCT, already provide efficient algorithms and robust sparse representations, they assume a fixed prior about the data, failing to accurately capture the specific structure of more restrictive classes of signals. To address this, the concept of a data-adaptive, learnt transform has been introduced in the literature, allowing for the reduction of a residual term in the transform domain. More recent studies have shown that the condition number serves as a good metric in this context, where the desired outcome alternates between a generalizing tendency and one that achieves minimal approximation error. Motivated by these considerations, we introduce the learning of a structured, explicitly conditioned transform formulated as the product of a fixed canonical matrix and a refining data-adaptive sparse component. This approach seeks to preserve the advantages of fast and stable analytical transforms, while introducing controllable adaptivity to the data. No references that concern this specific formulation have been identified so far, indicating its novelty. The proposed algorithm is motivated within the framework of inexact proximal methods, leveraging a newly derived closed-form projection operator. Empirical observations demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the doubly sparse transform learning problem and comparable performance with its dense variant at significantly lower computational costs and sometimes faster convergence and better avoidance of bad local minima.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习结构化、显式条件变换的方法，该变换表示为固定规范矩阵与可调数据自适应稀疏分量的乘积，旨在保留快速稳定分析变换的优点同时引入可控的数据自适应性。方法基于非精确近端算法框架，利用新推导的闭式投影算子。实验表明，在双稀疏变换学习问题上取得最先进结果，与密集变体相比计算成本显著降低，有时收敛更快且能更好避免不良局部最小值。
Motivation: 现有固定分析变换（如DFT、DCT）依赖数据先验，无法准确捕获特定信号类的结构；而完全自适应学习变换可能失去计算效率。本文旨在平衡变换的稳定性与自适应性，提出一种结合固定变换与稀疏自适应分量的结构。
Method: 将变换学习问题建模为固定规范矩阵与稀疏自适应分量的乘积，其中稀疏分量通过迭代优化学习。算法基于非精确近端方法，关键创新是推导了该特定公式的闭式投影算子。
Result: 在双稀疏变换学习问题上取得最先进结果，与密集变体相比计算成本大幅降低，且有时收敛更快、更少陷入不良局部最小值。
Conclusion: 本文提出的显式条件变换学习方法在保持高效计算的同时实现了数据自适应，为稀疏信号处理提供了新的工具。然而，摘要未提及在特定应用（如图像、音频）上的详细性能。

papers.title: Optimizing 2D Input Representations and Sub-phase Fusion Strategies for Differential Diagnosis of Asthma and COPD Using CNN- and GRU-Based Networks
papers.abstract_en: This study aims to explore the performance of the VAR model in comparison with mel-frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) matrices and log-mel spectrograms using deep learning. In pulmonary sound classification, spectrogram-based representations suffer from inconsistent temporal dimensions due to varying respiratory cycle durations. Along with traditional trimming/zero-padding, adaptive-length windowing was presented to fix their temporal dimensions. Their spectral and temporal dimensions were optimized by testing a range of parameters. Different convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures were employed to extract features from the two-dimensional representations obtained over the sub-phases. The extracted sub-phase features were then fused using various strategies including direct concatenation, gated recurrent unit (GRU) network and GRU with attention mechanism. Model performances were assessed through respiratory cycle-based evaluation and subject-based evaluation comprising multiple respiratory cycles. Several data augmentation techniques were also studied to cope with limitations in data size. The best cycle-based F1-score (0.877) was obtained using the MFCC matrices with thirteen coefficients and 64-point time resolution per sub-phase representation followed by direct feature concatenation, and the best subject-based F1-score (0.855) was obtained using the MFCC matrices with thirteen coefficients and 256-point time resolution per full-cycle representation, both obtained by adaptive-length windowing. Augmentation degraded the performance of models overall, yet mixup augmentation was the best among the methods tested. MFCC outperformed log-mel spectrogram and VAR model in differentiation of asthma and COPD. Sophisticated fusion strategies did not improve the diagnosis. Augmentation did not contribute, demonstrating the significance of authentic data in pulmonary sound studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用深度学习（CNN和GRU）对肺音信号进行分类，以鉴别哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）。比较了VAR模型、MFCC矩阵和log-mel声谱图作为输入表示，并优化了子相位融合策略。最佳循环级F1分数为0.877（MFCC + 直接特征拼接），受试者级F1分数为0.855（MFCC + 全周期表示）。数据增强整体降低了性能，而mixup增强相对最好。
Motivation: 肺音分类中，声谱图表示因呼吸周期时长不同而导致时间维度不一致，传统修剪/零填充方法存在缺陷。需要探索更优的输入表示和融合策略以提高哮喘与COPD的鉴别诊断性能。
Method: 采用自适应长度窗口固定时间维度，优化MFCC、log-mel声谱图和VAR模型的参数。使用多种CNN架构提取子相位特征，并通过直接拼接、GRU、GRU+注意力机制等方式融合。评估采用循环级和受试者级两种方式，并测试多种数据增强技术。
Result: 最佳循环级F1分数为0.877（MFCC 13系数，64点时间分辨率，直接拼接），最佳受试者级F1分数为0.855（MFCC 13系数，256点时间分辨率，全周期表示）。MFCC优于log-mel声谱图和VAR模型。数据增强整体降低性能，mixup略好。
Conclusion: MFCC表示适用于肺音分类，简单特征拼接优于复杂融合策略。数据增强无益，强调真实数据的重要性。

papers.title: Beyond Uniform Token-Level Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become standard for improving LLM reasoning. However, existing PPO-style trust-region mechanisms remain position-agnostic by enforcing uniform thresholds across all tokens independently. This pointwise treatment conflicts with autoregressive generation in two critical ways. First, uniform thresholds ignore autoregressive asymmetry. Early-stage deviations produce compounding sequence-level drift, causing static thresholds to under-regulate early divergence and excessively constrain late-stage exploration. Second, evaluating token-level divergence in isolation overlooks cumulative prefix drift, granting the same divergence allowance regardless of how far the conditioning history has already deviated from the rollout policy. To address this limitation, we propose CPPO (Cumulative Prefix-divergence Policy Optimization), a token-level masking rule that aligns updates with a finite-horizon policy-improvement bound via two coupled mechanisms. First, a position-weighted threshold imposes stricter limits at early positions whose effects persist longer, relaxing constraints for late-stage tokens. Second, a cumulative prefix budget tracks historical deviations, dynamically restricting further token-level deviation to prevent compounding errors along the prefix. Empirically, CPPO enhances training stability and significantly improves reasoning accuracy across various model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM强化学习中统一token级信任区域的局限性，提出CPPO（累积前缀散度策略优化），通过位置加权阈值和累积前缀预算两个耦合机制来对齐更新与有限时域策略改进界。实验表明CPPO在多种模型规模下提升了训练稳定性和推理准确率。
Motivation: 现有PPO风格的信任区域机制对所有token采用统一阈值，忽略了自回归生成的序列不对称性和累积前缀漂移，导致早期偏差被低估而后期探索被过度约束。
Method: 提出CPPO方法，包含位置加权阈值（对早期位置施加更严格限制）和累积前缀预算（跟踪历史偏差并动态限制后续散度）两个耦合机制。
Result: 实验表明CPPO在多种模型规模下增强了训练稳定性并显著提升了推理准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法通过对齐更新与有限时域策略改进界，有效解决了统一token级信任区域在LLM强化学习中的局限性。

papers.title: Quo Vadis, Visual In-Context Learning? A Unified Benchmark Across Domains and Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Visual in-context learning has been proposed as a pathway towards dynamic models that can generate predictions based on a provided context and thereby can adapt to new vision tasks at test-time. Yet, the evaluation of the adaptation capabilities of these models has been limited to narrow setups that mainly mirror tasks or image domains from pre-training for which real adaptation is not required. We address this gap by constructing a broad Visual In-Context BEnchmark (VIBE) with a focus on diverse imaging domains and a wide range of tasks. With this, we are able to get a much clearer picture of the adaptive capabilities of visual in-context models when faced with new image- and task distributions. We stress test six models on $14$ datasets and $12$ tasks (in total, we explore $106$ dataset-task combinations) and compare them under a unified, reproducible evaluation protocol, in an one-shot setting. Our evaluation uncovers key insights on the state of visual in-context learning, including limitations, systematic failure modes and promising directions. To foster broader evaluation, we will openly release our VIBE toolkit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉上下文学习（Visual In-Context Learning）评估缺乏真正适应能力测试的问题，构建了覆盖多种成像域和任务类型的统一基准 VIBE。在 14 个数据集、12 个任务（共 106 种组合）上对 6 个模型进行 one-shot 设置下的压力测试，揭示当前模型的局限性、系统性失败模式和未来方向。工具包将开源以推动更广泛的评估。
Motivation: 现有视觉上下文学习评估局限于与预训练相似的图像域或任务，未能测试模型面对新分布时的真实适应能力。需要构建跨域、多任务的统一基准来系统评估。
Method: 提出 VIBE（Visual In-Context BEnchmark），包含 14 个数据集和 12 个任务（共 106 种组合），覆盖多样化成像域（自然图像、医学、遥感等）和任务类型（分割、检测等），采用统一可重复的 one-shot 评估协议。
Result: 在 6 个现有模型上测试，揭示了视觉上下文学习在跨域、跨任务场景下的关键局限和系统失败模式（如对域偏移敏感），同时指出有希望的改进方向。
Conclusion: 作者强调当前模型在真正需要适应的场景下表现有限，并承诺公开 VIBE 工具包以促进社区更广泛地评估和比较。

papers.title: Population-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Particle Flow for Bayesian Update
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural particle flow (PINPF) learns a deterministic transport field that moves particles from a prior distribution toward a Bayesian posterior while enforcing the governing probability-evolution equation. However, the standard PINPF velocity model processes particles independently and therefore does not explicitly condition its transport decisions on the empirical particle population. This paper introduces population-aware PINPF (PA-PINPF), which augments each particle update with a permutation-invariant Deep Sets representation of the full particle set. We investigate two population encoders. PA-PINPF-State summarizes the particle states, whereas PA-PINPF-Feature summarizes the complete local physics-informed feature vectors, including particle position, pseudo-time, measurement information, likelihood values, and score information. The latter allows the population context to represent not only particle-cloud geometry, but also the population-level Bayesian transport geometry. The methods retain the original unsupervised physics-informed residual objective and require no ground-truth posterior samples during training. Experiments on range-measurement tasks and nonlinear time-difference-of-arrival posterior transport demonstrate that both population-aware variants improve over particle-wise PINPF, while feature-population encoding provides the strongest performance. These results show that population-level physics features provide useful global information for learned Bayesian particle transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出种群感知物理信息神经粒子流（PA-PINPF），通过引入排列不变的 Deep Sets 种群编码器，将粒子群体的全局信息融入每个粒子更新中，克服了标准PINPF独立处理粒子的局限性。实验在测距和非线性到达时间差后验传输任务上证明，种群感知变体优于基线，其中基于特征种群编码的变体性能最强。
Motivation: 标准PINPF的每个粒子独立更新，无法显式利用粒子群体的经验分布信息，导致传输效率低，需要一种能够感知粒子种群的方法。
Method: 在PINPF框架中增加一个排列不变的 Deep Sets 种群编码器，分别对粒子状态（PA-PINPF-State）或完整本地物理信息特征向量（包括位置、伪时间、测量信息、似然值、得分等）（PA-PINPF-Feature）进行聚合，从而在粒子更新中注入种群上下文。
Result: 在测距任务和非线性到达时间差后验传输实验中，两种种群感知变体均显著优于标准粒子式PINPF，且PA-PINPF-Feature取得最强性能。
Conclusion: 种群级物理特征能够为学习的贝叶斯粒子传输提供有用的全局信息，有助于提升后验逼近质量，且方法无需真实后验样本进行训练。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Can Frontier LLMs Pass a Standardized Office Proficiency Exam?
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Large Language Model (LLM) agents for computer automation is accelerating, yet their ability to navigate complex, professional-grade productivity software is largely untested. We argue that Office automation is an ideal environment for benchmarking document-automation capability, as it requires long-horizon planning and reasoning, precise parameter configuration, and multi-application integration. To quantify this capability, we introduce an evaluation based on China's National Computer Rank Examination (NCRE), featuring 200 comprehensive practical-operation tasks across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Each task is scored on a 100-point rubric scale using 7,118 machine-gradable criteria, and Score Rate (SR) denotes the mean percentage of rubric points earned across these tasks. We benchmark 7 frontier LLMs and observe stark limitations: single-turn models score a maximum of 36.6%. A stronger agentic system with execution feedback, iterative repair, and broader Office automation access reaches 68.8%, but remains below the 95.5% community-reference score used as a scoring sanity check. Ultimately, our experiments demonstrate that despite recent advancements in code generation, achieving reliable fine-grained Office document automation remains a significant challenge for current code-generating LLM and agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估前沿大语言模型（LLM）在办公自动化中的表现，基于中国计算机等级考试（NCRE）构建了200个Word、Excel和PPT综合实操任务，每个任务使用7118个机器可评分标准进行百分制评分。测试7个前沿LLM，单轮模型最高得分率36.6%，更强的Agent系统（含执行反馈、迭代修复和更广的Office访问权限）达到68.8%，但仍低于95.5%的社区参考分数。结果表明，尽管代码生成取得进展，但实现可靠的细粒度Office文档自动化对当前LLM和Agent系统仍是重大挑战。
Motivation: 现有LLM在复杂专业软件（如Office套件）自动化方面的能力尚未得到系统测试，而此类任务需要长程规划推理、精确参数配置和多应用集成，是衡量文档自动化能力的理想场景。
Method: 基于中国NCRE构建包含200个实操任务的基准，覆盖Word/Excel/PowerPoint，每个任务由机器评分标准（共7118条）打分，采用得分率（Score Rate）作为指标。
Result: 单轮交互模型最高得分率36.6%；集成执行反馈、迭代修复和更广泛Office访问权限的Agent系统可达68.8%，但仍远低于95.5%的社区参考分数。
Conclusion: 当前代码生成LLM及Agent系统在实现可靠、细粒度的Office文档自动化方面仍面临显著挑战，远未达到实用水平。

papers.title: Architect-Ant: Editable Automatic Furnishing of Architectural Floor Plans
papers.abstract_en: Furnished floor plans are fundamental to real estate visualization, interior design, and architectural workflows. However, progress in automatic furniture arrangement has been limited by the lack of real, professionally designed floor-plan datasets with object-level furniture annotations. To address this gap, we introduce AntPlan-270, a curated dataset of 270 architectural floor plans with per-room furniture bounding box annotations across ten residential room categories. Building on this dataset, we present Architect-Ant, an editable automatic furnishing framework powered by a fine-tuned vision-language model. Furniture layouts are represented using a compact, coordinate-based domain-specific language (DSL) that encodes object categories and placements relative to the room geometry. To improve spatial reasoning, we generate procedural reasoning traces that capture architectural constraints such as wall alignment, door and window clearance, circulation, fixture compatibility, and room-specific furniture inventories, and use them to supervise fine-tuning of the model. We then apply preference optimization over candidate object placements to further refine layout quality. The generated DSL can be rasterized into semantic masks and used to condition a Flux-based LoRA renderer, producing realistic blueprint-style furnished floor-plan images while preserving the editable symbolic layout. Experiments on layout furnishing show that Architect-Ant produces geometrically valid and functionally plausible layouts, and suggest a scalable path for furnishing larger structure-only floor-plan datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Architect-Ant，一个可编辑的自动家具布置框架，基于新构建的 AntPlan-270 数据集（270 个专业建筑平面图，带房间级家具标注）。该方法使用基于坐标的 DSL 表示家具布局，通过微调视觉语言模型并利用推理轨迹和偏好优化生成合理的家具摆放，并支持 Flux 渲染器生成逼真的蓝图风格图像。实验表明生成的布局在几何和功能上有效。
Motivation: 自动家具布置领域缺乏真实、专业的带物体级标注的平面图数据集，限制了研究进展。
Method: 构建 AntPlan-270 数据集；设计一种基于坐标的 DSL 编码家具类别和位置；通过微调视觉语言模型并引入结构化推理轨迹（如墙面对齐、门窗间距、人流通道等约束）进行监督；应用偏好优化 refine 候选布局；DSL 可栅格化为语义掩码，输入 Flux 渲染器生成可编辑的逼真平面图。
Result: Architect-Ant 生成的布局在几何有效性和功能合理性上优于基线，并为大规模未布置平面图的自动家具填充提供了可扩展方案。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用小规模高质量数据集和语言模型推理实现可编辑自动家具布置的可行路径。

papers.title: Recalling Too Well: Sycophancy Evaluation and Mitigation in Memory-Augmented Models
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory systems promise to make LLMs more helpful by storing user beliefs over time. We show they also make models less correct by systematically amplifying sycophancy, wherein models prioritize agreement with users over accuracy. We conduct the first systematic evaluation of this effect, introducing MIST: a benchmark of synthetically generated multi-turn conversations where users express plausible misconceptions in scientific, medical, and moral reasoning domains. Testing across three state-of-the-art memory systems and five model families reveals that memory amplifies sycophantic behavior across all conditions, with up to 25x higher sycophancy rates than in-context baselines. Error analyses suggest memory extraction as the primary culprit: lossy compression into discrete snippets encodes user misconceptions while discarding corrective context. Based on these results, we propose two lightweight mitigations that substantially reduce sycophancy while matching or exceeding memory systems at factual recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估记忆增强模型中的阿谀奉承（sycophancy）问题，即模型倾向于同意用户错误观点。作者提出MIST基准，包含多轮对话，用户在科学、医学、道德推理领域表达误解。测试三个记忆系统和五个模型族，发现记忆将阿谀奉承率提高最多25倍。错误分析表明记忆提取是主要原因；提出两种轻量级缓解方法，在减少阿谀奉承的同时保持或提升事实召回。
Motivation: 记忆系统使LLM更'有用'但可能降低正确性，因为系统性地放大阿谀奉承行为，即模型优先同意用户而非准确性。
Method: 引入MIST基准，合成多轮对话，用户表达常见误解；在三个记忆系统和五个模型族上测试；通过错误分析识别记忆提取问题；提出两种轻量级缓解方法。
Result: 记忆在所有条件下放大阿谀奉承，最高达25倍；缓解方法大幅减少阿谀奉承，同时匹配或超过记忆系统的事实召回。
Conclusion: 记忆系统会加剧阿谀奉承，但通过针对性缓解可以改善。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Express Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new tool, Express, for converting a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching approximation guarantees. When combined with the state-of-the-art Thinformer approximation, Express improves upon the best known causal attention guarantees, delivering $\log^{3/2}(n)/s$ approximation error with only $O(s)$ memory and $O(s^2 \log^2(n))$ compression overhead for a sequence of length $n$. We pair these developments with an efficient I/O-aware Triton implementation, demonstrate substantial speedups over FlashAttention 2, and use Express to overcome four resource bottlenecks in the language modeling pipeline: long-context prefill, KV cache compression, long-form memory-constrained decoding, and long-form compute-constrained decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Express工具，将非因果注意力近似转换为因果近似，并改进现有因果注意力保证，实现log^{3/2}(n)/s的近似误差，仅需O(s)内存和O(s^2 log^2(n))压缩开销。结合高效的I/O感知Triton实现，相比FlashAttention 2显著加速，并克服长上下文预填充、KV缓存压缩、长序列内存约束解码和计算约束解码四个资源瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有因果注意力近似保证不够理想，需要更高效的近似方法以支持长序列语言建模。
Method: 提出Express方法，将非因果注意力近似（如Thinformer）转换为因果近似，并保持近似保证；使用I/O感知的Triton实现以提高效率。
Result: 实现log^{3/2}(n)/s的近似误差，内存O(s)，压缩开销O(s^2 log^2(n))；在长上下文预填充、KV缓存压缩、内存约束解码和计算约束解码上获得加速。
Conclusion: Express为因果注意力提供了高效且具有理论保证的近似方法，可缓解语言建模中的多个资源瓶颈。

papers.title: Generative Explainability for Next-Generation Networks: LLM-Augmented XAI with Mutual Feature Interactions
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) models become integral to network operations, their lack of transparency poses a significant barrier to operator trust. Existing explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques often fail to bridge this gap for non-specialists, producing technical outputs that are difficult to translate into actionable insights. This paper presents a framework specifically designed to address this shortcoming. It leverages a moderately sized large language model (LLM) and extends beyond the standard use of SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) feature influence values. The framework employs a structured prompt enriched with mutual feature interaction data to generate human-understandable natural language explanations. To validate our framework, we performed an empirical evaluation on an optical quality of transmission (QoT) estimation use case with human evaluators. We collected independent performance evaluations from specialists, which showed a high inter-evaluator agreement. Compared to a state-of-the-art baseline that uses only SHAP feature influence values in a straightforward prompt, our approach improves the explanation usefulness and scope by 12.2% and 6.2%, while achieving 97.5% correctness.
papers.comment: 7 pages, with one page for appendix. Accepted for publication at the 2025 21th International Conference on Wireless and Mobile Computing, Networking and Communications (WiMob)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，利用中等规模大语言模型（LLM）和互特征交互数据生成自然语言解释，以提升网络运营中XAI的可理解性。在光传输质量估计用例中，通过人类评估者验证，该方法相比仅使用SHAP特征的基线，有用性提升12.2%，范围提升6.2%，正确率达97.5%。
Motivation: 现有XAI技术输出技术性强，非专家难以转化为可操作见解，阻碍运营商对AI/ML模型的信任。
Method: 框架使用中等规模LLM，构建包含互特征交互数据的结构化提示，扩展了标准SHAP特征影响值的用法，生成人类可理解的自然语言解释。
Result: 在光传输质量估计用例中，人类评估者评估显示高一致性；与仅用SHAP特征的基线相比，解释有用性提升12.2%，范围提升6.2%，正确率达97.5%。
Conclusion: 该框架可有效提升XAI解释的实用性和可理解性，适用于网络运营中的非专家用户。

papers.title: Democratising Camera Trap AI: An Open-Source Model for Detecting UK Mammals
papers.abstract_en: Camera traps have become a cornerstone of biodiversity monitoring, but the artificial intelligence that turns vast quantities of images into usable ecological data is often locked behind commercial platforms or trained on fauna that does not match that of the British Isles. In an attempt to remove barriers and increase uptake, we release an open-source object detection model for 31 classes, 28 common UK mammal and bird species, plus utility classes for humans, calibration poles, and vehicles, drawn from a curated dataset of 48,165 labelled instances assembled from multiple sites over a decade of operational deployment through Conservation AI and its successor, Trap Tracker. The model, a YOLO26x detector trained and tested on an 80/10/10 class-stratified split, achieves a mean Average Precision of 0.984 at Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.5 (0.956 at IoU 0.5-0.95) on the held-out validation set, with precision 0.988 and recall 0.965. On an unseen held-out test split, mean per-species confidence ranged from 0.96 to 0.99 across the 31 classes, with a 0.17% false-negative rate concentrated in difficult night-time, distant, or occluded images. These metrics are from data from the same pool of sites and cameras as training, so performance at entirely new sites is left to future work. We release the trained weights in ONNX format under a non-commercial licence, with local desktop and real-time camera support, aimed explicitly at ecologists with no machine-learning experience. This release is a deliberate counterweight to the multiple paid for models that have developed over the last decade.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了一个开源目标检测模型，用于识别英国常见的31类哺乳动物、鸟类及人类、校准杆、车辆等，基于YOLO26x架构，在48,165个标注实例的数据集上训练，在验证集上达到mAP 0.984 (IoU 0.5)和0.956 (IoU 0.5-0.95)，旨在降低生态学家使用AI的门槛。
Motivation: 现有相机陷阱AI多依赖商业平台或在非英国动物区系上训练，限制了英国生态学家的使用，因此需要开放源码且针对英国物种的模型。
Method: 使用YOLO26x检测器，在80/10/10类分层划分的数据集上训练，数据集来自Conservation AI及Trap Tracker项目十年运营中的48,165个标注实例，覆盖28种英国常见哺乳动物和鸟类及3个实用类。
Result: 在保留验证集上，平均精度（mAP）在IoU 0.5时为0.984，在IoU 0.5-0.95时为0.956，精确率0.988，召回率0.965；在未见测试集上，每类平均置信度0.96-0.99，假阴性率0.17%，集中于夜间、远距离或遮挡图像。
Conclusion: 该模型以ONNX格式在非商业许可下发布，支持本地桌面和实时摄像头，面向无机器学习经验的生态学家，旨在抗衡付费模型，但性能仅基于同一数据源，在新地点的表现待未来工作验证。

papers.title: PENet+: A Lightweight Residual Transformer Framework for Efficient Image Steganalysis
papers.abstract_en: Image steganalysis, the detection of hidden information embedded in digital images, is a core component of modern cybersecurity and digital forensics. Recent residual Transformer architectures, such as the Pixel-Difference-Convolution and Enhanced-Transformer-Network (PENet) [1], achieve strong detection accuracy, but their computational and memory demands hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. We present PENet+, a lightweight steganalysis framework that preserves PENet's discriminative structure while substantially improving efficiency. Rather than redesigning or compressing the attention blocks, we retain PENet's self-attention topology for reproducibility and add a classifier-streamlining stage that progressively narrows the SPP-to-FC1 input channels (SPP: spatial pyramid pooling; FC1: first fully connected layer), yielding large reductions in parameters and FLOPs with negligible accuracy loss. We further refine the high-pass-filter (HPF) stem with an activation-aware mechanism that aggregates HPF responses early and selects a balanced SRM-Gabor top-K subset, and we replace PENet's backbone with a MobileNetV2-style inverted residual network. A balanced configuration with K=31 filters (16 Gabor + 15 SRM) matches or surpasses heavier settings at lower compute. Finally, we motivate PReLU from a steganalysis standpoint, arguing that preserving negative responses helps capture weak stego cues that ReLU suppresses. On a disjoint ALASKA2 JPEG QF90 protocol at 512x512 resolution (5,000 cover images for training, validation, and internal testing; a separate 19,000-cover evaluation set), PENet+ achieves up to 45.5% fewer parameters and about 97% fewer FLOPs than the re-evaluated PENet baseline, offering a computationally efficient direction for resource-constrained steganalysis. Device-level latency and power measurements remain future work.

papers.title: A Systematic Approach for Selecting Trajectories for Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory data augmentation is a promising approach to mitigate data scarcity in machine learning applications, but its utility has been limited by the complexity of preserving spatio-temporal coherence. Although prior work demonstrated the viability of geometric perturbation, it relied on naive random selection, leaving a critical gap in understanding which trajectories should be augmented for maximal benefit. This thesis addresses this gap by developing a systematic and scalable framework to evaluate five systematic selection strategies: Outlierness, Diversity, Representativeness, Uncertainty, and Random selection. These strategies were rigorously tested across four datasets covering animal behavior (Foxes and Starkey), maritime traffic (AIS), and urban traffic (Car) using a suite of linear and non-linear machine learning models. As part of this evaluation, an Optuna-based hyperparameter optimization loop was integrated to empirically identify the best-performing augmentation parameters for each dataset within the explored search space. The results indicate that, while systematic selection is not a universal solution, it offers distinct advantages over the random baseline. Systematic strategies, particularly Outlierness and Uncertainty, demonstrated higher stability and were less prone to performance degradation observed with random sampling in dense datasets. However, the findings also reveal that the value of augmentation is strictly conditional. Visual analysis via UMAP demonstrates that while systematic augmentation successfully repairs topological fragmentation in sparse datasets, it can act as a corrupting noise signal in high-quality, dense datasets. Furthermore, the study identified physical limitations in high-velocity domains, where standard perturbation techniques lead to divergence in feature space...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究轨迹数据增强中五种选择策略（Outlierness、Diversity、Representativeness、Uncertainty、Random），在动物行为、海上交通、城市交通四个数据集上结合Optuna超参数优化进行测试。结果表明系统选择策略尤其是Outlierness和Uncertainty在稀疏数据集中更稳定，但在高质量密集数据中可能成为噪声，且在高速度域存在物理限制。
Motivation: 现有轨迹数据增强依赖随机选择，缺乏对哪些轨迹应被增强以最大化收益的系统理解。
Method: 提出并评估五种系统选择策略（Outlierness、Diversity、Representativeness、Uncertainty、Random），集成Optuna超参数优化循环，在四个数据集和多种机器学习模型上进行实验。
Result: 系统选择策略并非通用解决方案，但Outlierness和Uncertainty较随机基线更稳定，在稀疏数据中能修复拓扑碎片，在密集高质量数据中可能引入噪声；高速度域中标准扰动导致特征空间发散。
Conclusion: 轨迹增强的有效性取决于数据密度和质量，系统选择策略需要根据具体场景权衡，不宜盲目使用。

papers.title: Provenance Tracking in AI Compilers through the Lens of Coalgebra
papers.abstract_en: AI compilers aggressively rewrite computation graphs through normalization, lowering, and optimization, making it difficult to track the provenance of tensors and operators across compilation. Reliable provenance is essential for attaching platform-specific postprocessing, debugging compiler behavior, and validating transformations, yet existing solutions are either invasive or ad hoc under non-injective graph rewrites. We present a lightweight, generative approach to provenance tracking based on observational semantics. Instead of propagating identifiers through compiler passes, we observe graph transformations and reason about provenance in terms of observable computational actions. We formalize this approach using a coalgebraic model and bisimulation, which preserves provenance even when intermediate nodes are eliminated. Furthermore, we implement this approach in a prototype AI compiler COVAN, demonstrating stable provenance across compilation pipelines with minimal engineering overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于余代数（coalgebra）和观测语义的轻量级来源追踪方法，用于AI编译器中的张量和算子来源跟踪。通过观测图变换而非传播标识符，在非单射图重写下也能保持来源信息。原型编译器COVAN实现了该方法，开销小。
Motivation: AI编译器对计算图进行大量重写，导致张量和算子的来源难以追踪。现有方法要么侵入性强，要么在非单射图重写下效果不佳。
Method: 提出基于观测语义的来源追踪方法，使用余代数模型和双模拟（bisimulation）形式化来源推理，在编译器变换中通过观测计算行为而非传播标识符来保持来源。在原型编译器COVAN中实现。
Result: 实验表明该方法能在编译流水线中稳定追踪来源，且工程开销极小。
Conclusion: 该工作为AI编译器提供了一种轻量、非侵入的来源追踪方案，适用于复杂的图变换场景。

papers.title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model inference is bottlenecked by autoregressive decoding, where each token requires a full forward pass. Multi-token prediction (MTP) offers a promising acceleration path, but existing approaches suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head for the first token competes with the backbone's own language model (LM) head, leading to severe quality degradation when predictions are accepted. We identify this head-backbone competition as the root cause of repetitive and incoherent outputs in prior MTP-based acceleration methods. To address this, we propose Backbone-as-Architect, a design principle where the backbone LM head always generates the first token, and MTP heads are responsible only for subsequent tokens. Building on this principle, we introduce CLP (Collocation-Length Predictor), a lightweight span-level decision layer that predicts how many additional tokens can be safely accepted at each decoding step. CLP uses only a single linear layer (4.6K--7.7K parameters), replacing the over-engineered 1M-parameter gate networks used in prior work. Experiments on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, 7B) show that CLP achieves 1.20x--1.29x speedup on 1.5B and 1.14x--1.20x on 7B, with zero quality degradation (repetition ratio < 0.02), while gate-based approaches fail to accelerate (1.07x) or produce severely degraded outputs (repetition ratio > 0.5%). We further demonstrate that shorter prediction horizons (k=2) recover 24% higher MTP head accuracy on large models, establishing a scaling-aware design principle. We identify MTP head prediction accuracy as the binding constraint on acceleration and establish a clear roadmap for future improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多token预测（MTP）加速中第一个MTP头与骨干LM头竞争导致质量下降的问题，提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则：骨干LM头始终生成第一个token，MTP头只负责后续token。基于此设计CLP（搭配长度预测器），仅用单线性层（4.6K-7.7K参数）预测解码步可安全接受的额外token数。在Qwen2.5（0.5B/1.5B/7B）上实验，CLP实现零质量损失的1.14x-1.29x加速，而门控方法失败（重复率>0.5%）。还发现短预测视野（k=2）在大模型上恢复24%更高的MTP头准确率。
Motivation: 现有MTP加速方法中，第一个token的MTP头与骨干LM头竞争，导致输出重复和不连贯，这是阻碍MTP加速的根本架构缺陷。
Method: 提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则，即骨干LM头始终生成第一个token，MTP头只负责后续token。基于该原则设计CLP，一个轻量级span级决策层，使用单线性层（4.6K-7.7K参数）预测当前步可安全接受的额外token数，取代先前过工程化的数百万参数门控网络。
Result: 在Qwen2.5系列上，CLP在1.5B模型获得1.20x-1.29x加速，7B模型获得1.14x-1.20x加速，且零质量下降（重复率<0.02）；门控方法仅1.07x加速且重复率>0.5%。此外，预测视野k=2在大模型上使MTP头准确率提高24%。
Conclusion: 识别MTP头预测精度是加速的绑定约束，所提出的Backbone-as-Architect原则和CLP为未来无损失加速提供了可扩展的设计路线图。

papers.title: WorldKernel: A World Model is the Coupling Kernel of Admissible Possible Worlds
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption holds that enough observational and interventional data, given to a strong enough predictor, suffices. We report a failure mode that contradicts it. Across hundreds of structural causal models, on identified quantities a strong predictor and a Bayesian baseline both succeed, but on unidentified quantities (the couplings between counterfactual worlds) the predictor collapses to a point, on 28% of models to one no valid model can produce, while the truth is an admissible interval more data never narrows. The gap is structural: prediction cannot represent uncertainty over counterfactual couplings. We cast a world model as a single positive semidefinite coupling kernel K(T,T') over admissible worlds, whose diagonal is the ordinary posterior (what a predictor recovers) and whose off-diagonal is the cross-world coupling it cannot, which every counterfactual reads. The paper is the theory of that off-diagonal. It is real: two states with identical posteriors differ on a cross-world query, and the off-diagonal is the coupling that fixes counterfactuals. It can be bounded: positive semidefiniteness is partial-identifying information the marginals lack, and enforcing it bounds counterfactuals in polynomial time where the exact response-type program is intractable. Logical structure sharpens it: ontology axioms tighten the bound by up to a third, propagating to couplings they never touch. It can be acquired: targeted scars, constraints learned from encountered infeasibilities, close the gap several times faster than untargeted ones. Its full reconstruction is approximate counting of the admissible worlds, tractable below the Sly-Sun threshold and inapproximable above; we do not claim to beat the worst case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，即使有足够的观测和干预数据，强预测器在反事实耦合（counterfactual couplings）上仍会失败，因为预测器无法表示不确定性。作者将世界模型建模为一个正半定耦合核K(T,T')，其对角元是通常的后验，非对角元是跨世界耦合（cross-world coupling），这是反事实查询所必需的。理论表明，该非对角元可被边界约束，逻辑公理可收紧边界，且可通过目标疤痕（targeted scars）加速获取。完整重构是容许世界的近似计数，在Sly-Sun阈值以下可处理。
Motivation: 现有假设认为足够多的数据加上强预测器就能解决因果推断问题，但作者发现了一个反例：在未识别的反事实耦合上，预测器会坍缩到一个点，甚至可能产生无效模型，而真实情况是一个允许区间，且更多数据无法缩小。这表明结构性的差距：预测无法表示跨世界耦合的不确定性。
Method: 将世界模型形式化为一个正半定耦合核K(T,T')，其中对角元对应通常的后验（预测器可恢复），非对角元对应跨世界耦合（预测器无法恢复）。作者证明了该非对角元是可界定的：正半定性提供部分识别信息，可以在多项式时间内对反事实进行边界约束。逻辑公理（ontology axioms）可进一步收紧边界。此外，通过目标疤痕（从遇到的不可能性中学习约束）可加速获取耦合信息。
Result: 在数百个结构因果模型上，对于已识别量，强预测器和贝叶斯基线都成功；但对于未识别量（反事实世界的耦合），预测器坍缩到一点，在28%的模型上该点甚至没有有效模型能产生。正半定性约束可以在多项式时间内对反事实进行边界约束。逻辑公理可将边界收紧多达三分之一。目标疤痕比非目标疤痕快数倍地缩小差距。完整重构在Sly-Sun阈值以下可处理，以上则不可近似。
Conclusion: 本文建立了反事实耦合的理论框架，表明预测器无法表示的不确定性可以通过耦合核的结构来捕获和约束。作者强调其方法在多项式时间内有效，但未声称能击败最坏情况。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frontier Coding Agents Use Metaprogramming to Adapt to Unfamiliar Programming Languages
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents are usually evaluated in familiar software settings: mainstream languages, common libraries, and public repositories. These benchmarks remain important, but they can hide how agents behave when the language itself is unfamiliar. We evaluate six contemporary coding agents on four esoteric programming languages using a sequential setup with file editing, local execution, and hidden-test grading. Our protocol exposes capability differences between these agents that mainstream coding and agentic benchmarks such as SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 compress into much narrower bands. We observe that the strongest agents, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 xhigh, often avoid writing the target language directly. On Brainfuck and Befunge-98, they write Python programs that generate target-language code and debug those generators locally. Forbidding this metaprogramming strategy causes large performance drops. Text guidance distilled from this strategy does not materially improve weaker agents. In contrast, Opus-derived Python helper code for building generators, with no solved benchmark programs or hidden-test answers, sharply improves Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 mini on the same problems, while Haiku 4.5 remains low. More interpreter calls and output tokens improve stronger agents but leave weaker agents near their original performance, indicating that these resources amplify useful strategies rather than create them. Together, these results show that strong coding agents adapt to unfamiliar languages by using tools, feedback, and workspace state to build a working model of the target language. Metaprogramming is the clearest case, but the broader gap is constructing and debugging a strategy that works under the target language's rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文评估了六个基于LLM的编码智能体在四种深奥编程语言（Brainfuck、Befunge-98等）上的表现。最强的智能体（如Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.4 xhigh）会采用元编程策略：先用Python编写生成目标语言代码的程序，并在本地调试生成器。禁止此策略导致性能大幅下降。弱智能体无法从文本指导中受益，但利用强智能体生成的Python辅助代码后，中等智能体性能显著提升。结果表明，强编码智能体通过利用工具、反馈和工作区状态构建目标语言的工作模型来适应陌生语言，元编程是最明显的体现。
Motivation: 现有基准测试集中在主流语言上，可能掩盖编码智能体在面对不熟悉语言时的能力差异。作者希望揭示这些差异。
Method: 设计了包含文件编辑、本地执行和隐藏测试评分的顺序协议，在四种深奥语言上测试了六个当代编码智能体。
Result: 最强智能体（Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.4 xhigh）在Brainfuck和Befunge-98上使用Python生成目标代码的元编程策略，禁止该策略导致性能大幅下降。弱智能体无法从文本指导中获益，但使用Opus导出的Python辅助代码后，Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.4 mini性能显著提升。更多解释器调用和输出token有助于强智能体，但对弱智能体效果微弱。
Conclusion: 强编码智能体通过使用工具、反馈和工作区状态构建目标语言的工作模型来适应不熟悉的语言，元编程是这一策略的突出案例。

papers.title: Recoverable but Not Stationary:Local Linear Structures in Weights and Activations
papers.abstract_en: Task vectors, LoRA, activation steering, and random search around pretrained weights all suggest that learned behaviour can be controlled by linear directions. We ask which linear structures actually exist and on what scale. In a synthetic multitask transformer and LoRA adapters on DistilGPT-2 / GPT-2 we find strong local low-rank task-gradient structure but reject the fixed-task-plane hypothesis: static bases miss the recovery direction, and the useful basis drifts substantially within 100 steps. However, the first recovery updates form a trajectory-prefix basis capturing 77% of the LoRA recovery displacement. We develop random search theory with a Gaussian local-linear theorem that justifies the effectiveness of random parameter search even in very high dimensions. We also study the relation between parameter perturbations and activation steering: a single gradient step produces an activation shift with 0.58 cosine to a labelled-contrast CAA steering vector, with a similar steering effect on Qwen-0.5B BoolQ statements. We validate our results with experiments on synthetic Transformers and LLMs. Our results suggest that linear structures in trained networks are not global task directions, but evolving local geometries that partially persist across parameter and activation spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练模型权重和激活中的线性结构，发现它们并非全局任务方向，而是随训练步数演化的局部几何结构。在合成多任务Transformer和DistilGPT-2/GPT-2的LoRA适配器上，作者拒绝了固定任务平面假设；静态基会错过恢复方向，有用基在100步内显著漂移。首次恢复更新形成的轨迹前缀基捕获了77%的LoRA恢复位移。作者还提出了随机搜索理论的高斯局部线性定理，并分析了参数扰动与激活转向之间的关系。
Motivation: 现有方法如任务向量、LoRA、激活转向等表明线性方向可控制网络行为，但尚不明确这些线性结构在何种尺度上真实存在，以及它们是否具有全局性。
Method: 在合成多任务Transformer和DistilGPT-2/GPT-2的LoRA适配器上进行实验，分析局部低秩任务梯度结构；提出随机搜索理论的高斯局部线性定理。
Result: 拒绝了固定任务平面假设；有用基在100步内漂移；轨迹前缀基捕获77% LoRA位移；单梯度步的激活移位与CAA转向向量余弦相似度为0.58。
Conclusion: 训练网络中的线性结构并非全局任务方向，而是演化中的局部几何结构，部分跨参数和激活空间持续存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Constrained Natural-Language Interface for Variational Multi-Physics Finite Element Simulations in FEniCS
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can reduce the manual effort required to set up finite element simulations, but they introduce reliability risks when generated solver code lies on the critical path. We present a constrained natural-language interface for multi-physics finite element analysis in which the LLM is limited to front-end tasks: parsing prompts into structured JSON, generating Gmsh code only for non-catalog geometries, and using retry feedback for those stages. It never writes FEniCS solver templates, derives weak forms, or writes the numerical solver core. A deterministic dispatcher maps the validated specification to five human-written FEniCS/UFL templates: linear elasticity, hyperelasticity, elastoplasticity, thermo-mechanical coupling, and phase-field fracture. We validate this deterministic template layer against analytical solutions and published 2D/3D benchmarks. Smooth cases reach sub-percent agreement on adequate meshes, while harder nonlinear cases reach the 2-5 percent range. We also evaluate the LLM-facing front end directly. In a 15-prompt parser benchmark, first-pass valid parses were obtained for 9 cases, and all remaining cases were repaired after retry, giving a final valid parse rate of 100.0 percent, 100.0 percent problem-class accuracy, and 97.1 percent field-extraction accuracy. In a 10-case custom-geometry benchmark routed through the real LLM-to-Gmsh path, first-pass and final success were both 90.0 percent, with one unrecovered invalid-geometry failure. These results show that the parser and constrained prompt/validation design are effective on these benchmarks. As an end-to-end demonstration, the system generates and analyzes a 3D elastoplastic L-bracket with a fillet and bolt hole from one natural-language prompt. The contribution is a measured architecture for natural-language-driven variational simulation, not open-ended autonomous code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受限自然语言接口，用于FEniCS中的变分多物理场有限元模拟。LLM仅限于前端任务：解析提示为结构化JSON、为非目录几何生成Gmsh代码，并使用重试反馈。它从不编写FEniCS求解器模板、推导弱形式或编写数值求解器核心。确定性调度器将验证后的规范映射到五个手写FEniCS/UFL模板：线弹性、超弹性、弹塑性、热力耦合和相场断裂。在解析基准测试中，首次通过有效解析率为9/15，重试后达到100%有效解析率、100%问题类别准确率和97.1%字段提取准确率。自定义几何基准测试中首次和最终成功率均为90%。最终演示了从自然语言提示生成并分析3D弹塑性L形支架。
Motivation: 大型语言模型可以减少设置有限元模拟的手动工作，但生成的求解器代码在关键路径上引入可靠性风险。
Method: 设计受限自然语言接口，LLM仅负责解析提示为结构化JSON、为非标准几何生成Gmsh代码，并通过重试反馈修正；确定性调度器将验证后的规范映射到五个手写FEniCS/UFL模板。
Result: 解析基准测试中首次通过有效解析率9/15，重试后达到100%有效解析率、100%问题类别准确率和97.1%字段提取准确率；自定义几何基准测试首次和最终成功率均为90%。
Conclusion: 该贡献是一个用于变分模拟的受限自然语言接口架构，而非开放式的自主代码生成。

papers.title: Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data
papers.abstract_en: The recent trend in scaling models for robot learning has resulted in impressive policies that can perform various manipulation tasks and generalize to novel scenarios. However, these policies continue to struggle with following instructions, likely due to the limited linguistic and action sequence diversity in existing robotics datasets. This paper introduces Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data (TREAD), a scalable framework that leverages large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to augment existing robotics datasets without additional data collection, harnessing the transferable knowledge embedded in these models. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM through three stages: generating semantic sub-tasks from original instruction labels and initial scenes, segmenting demonstration videos conditioned on these sub-tasks, and producing diverse instructions that incorporate object properties, effectively decomposing longer demonstrations into grounded language-action pairs. We further enhance robustness by augmenting the data with linguistically diverse versions of the text goals. Evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that policies trained on our augmented datasets exhibit improved performance on novel, unseen tasks and goals. Our results show that TREAD enhances both planning generalization through trajectory decomposition and language-conditioned policy generalization through increased linguistic diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TREAD 框架，利用大型视觉语言模型（VLM）对现有机器人数据集进行重标注，通过生成语义子任务、分割演示视频以及生成包含物体属性的多样化指令，将长演示分解为语言-动作对，并进一步通过语言多样化增强数据鲁棒性。在 LIBERO 基准上的评估表明，基于增强数据集训练的策略在未见过的任务和目标上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有机器人学习策略难以遵循指令，主要归因于现有数据集中语言多样性不足和动作序列长度限制。
Method: 使用预训练 VLM 通过三个阶段增强数据：1) 从原始指令和初始场景生成语义子任务；2) 基于子任务条件分割演示视频；3) 生成融入物体属性的多样化指令，分解长演示为语言-动作对，并通过文本目标的语言变体进一步增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，TREAD 增强的数据训练出的策略在未见任务和目标上性能提升，同时实现了轨迹分解带来的规划泛化和语言多样性带来的语言条件策略泛化。
Conclusion: TREAD 通过重标注现有数据集（无需额外收集）并利用 VLM 的迁移知识，有效提升了机器人策略的指令遵循能力和泛化性。

papers.title: Role-Agent: Bootstrapping LLM Agents via Dual-Role Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks, their learning is often limited by inefficient interaction feedback and static training environments, which hinder broader generalization. To address these limitations, this paper introduces Role-Agent, \textcolor{black}{a framework} that harnesses a single LLM to function concurrently as both the agent and the environment, enabling a bootstrapped co-evolution. Role-Agent comprises two synergistic components: World-In-Agent (WIA) and Agent-In-World (AIW). In WIA, the LLM acts as the agent and predicts future states after each action; the alignment between predicted and actual states is then used as a process reward, encouraging environment-aware reasoning. In AIW, the LLM analyzes failure modes from failed trajectories and retrieves tasks with similar failure patterns, thereby reshaping the training data distribution for targeted practice. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Role-Agent consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of over 4\% over strong baselines.
papers.comment: 20 pages, including 12 pages of main text and 8 pages of appendix; work in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Role-Agent框架，让单个大语言模型同时扮演智能体（agent）和环境（environment），通过双角色演化实现自举协同进化。框架包含World-In-Agent (WIA)和Agent-In-World (AIW)两个组件：WIA利用预测状态与实际状态的对齐作为过程奖励，促进环境感知推理；AIW通过分析失败轨迹并检索相似失败模式的任务，重塑训练数据分布。在多个基准上，该方法平均提升超过4%。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在复杂任务中常因交互反馈低效和环境静态而受限，难以实现广泛泛化。
Method: 提出Role-Agent框架，包含WIA和AIW两个协同组件。WIA中LLM作为agent预测未来状态并与实际状态对齐，对齐度用作过程奖励；AIW中从失败轨迹分析失败模式并检索相似任务，从而动态调整训练分布。
Result: 在多个基准上，Role-Agent相对于强基线平均提升超过4%。
Conclusion: Role-Agent通过双角色演化机制有效提升了LLM智能体的性能，尤其在环境感知和失败利用方面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Range Penalization: Theoretical Insights with Applications in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces range regularization for federated learning with linear systematic components to enhance statistical accuracy and induce cross-client regularity conducive to quantization, coding, and resource efficiency. Our approach identifies features with shared weights across different clients and adaptively clusters the weights of personalized features at extreme values, a process we refer to as polar clustering. Theoretical analysis of the associated estimators poses significant challenges due to the seminorm nature and non-decomposability of the regularizer. We develop new proof techniques for the nonasymptotic analysis of statistical accuracy and faithful pattern recovery. Moreover, a fast optimization algorithm that leverages varying degrees of local strong convexity is proposed to reduce iteration complexity. Experiments support the efficacy and efficiency of the proposed approach.

papers.title: Conservation Laws from Data Symmetry in Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We explore whether intrinsic symmetries of the training data lead to conserved quantities during gradient-flow training of neural networks. Under the assumption that the loss function is analytic and non-polynomial, we prove that data symmetries generically do not induce any additional integrals of motion. For mean squared error (MSE) loss, on the other hand, there are situations in which data augmentation yields extra conserved quantities. We build a framework, utilizing \emph{tensorizable networks} to describe this phenomenon. Tensorizable networks are a family of architectures whose dependence on parameters and inputs can be separated using an intermediate representation. They include linear and polynomial networks, as well as Lightning Attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络梯度流训练中，训练数据的固有对称性是否会导出守恒量。对于解析且非多项式的损失函数，证明数据对称性通常不会引入额外运动积分；而对于均方误差（MSE）损失，数据增强可能产生额外守恒量。文章利用“可张量化网络”（tensorizable networks）框架描述该现象，该框架包括线性网络、多项式网络以及Lightning Attention。
Motivation: 理解训练数据的对称性如何影响神经网络学习过程中的动力学，特别是是否会导致训练过程中的守恒量，从而影响模型行为。
Method: 理论证明结合“可张量化网络”框架，该框架允许将网络参数和输入的依赖关系通过中间表示分离，从而分析数据对称性对守恒量的影响。
Result: 对于解析非多项式损失，数据对称性一般不产生额外守恒量；对于MSE损失，数据增强可能引入额外守恒量。
Conclusion: 数据对称性在神经网络梯度流中是否导致守恒量依赖于损失函数的形式，MSE损失下可能存在特例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do Deepfake Speech Detectors Actually Hear?
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake speech detectors often output a single score without explaining why an audio sample is flagged, where in the signal the evidence lies, or what cues drive the decision. We propose an audio-native explainability pipeline using Integrated Gradients on time-aligned self-supervised representations to localize decision evidence over time. We apply the proposed method to three WavLM-based detectors (AASIST, CA-MHFA, SLS) on ASVspoof 5 and manually annotate the highest-attribution regions to provide a semantic meaning of the most important cues. Despite similar performance, the detectors rely on different cues: AASIST emphasizes non-speech/environment cues, CA-MHFA focuses on localized phoneme artifacts, and SLS relies on word boundaries and spectral integrity. We move beyond speculative reasoning and validate our findings by causal masking of the primary detector cues. Observed performance degradation further supports the explained detector semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自监督表示和集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）的音频可解释性方法，用于定位深度伪造语音检测器在时间上的决策证据。在ASVspoof5数据集上对三种WavLM-based检测器（AASIST、CA-MHFA、SLS）分析发现，尽管性能相近，不同检测器依赖的声学线索不同：AASIST侧重非语音/环境线索，CA-MHFA关注局部音素伪影，SLS依赖词边界和频谱完整性。通过因果掩码验证了这些线索的关键性。
Motivation: 当前深度伪造语音检测器仅输出单一分数，无法解释为何音频被标记为伪造、证据在信号中的位置以及驱动决策的线索，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出音频原生可解释性管线：使用时间对齐的自监督表示上的集成梯度方法，定位随时间变化的决策证据区域；对最高归因区域进行人工注释，赋予语义含义；并通过因果掩码（causal masking）移除主要检测线索以验证其重要性。
Result: 在ASVspoof5上对三种WavLM-based检测器（AASIST、CA-MHFA、SLS）的分析表明：不同检测器依赖不同的声学线索（非语音/环境、局部音素伪影、词边界与频谱完整性）；因果掩码导致性能下降，验证了所解释的语义。
Conclusion: 该工作不仅揭示了深度伪造语音检测器的内部行为，还通过因果验证阐明了不同模型依赖的具体线索，有助于未来设计更鲁棒和可解释的检测系统。

papers.title: Ethical and Technical Limits of Deepfake Speech Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Claims about the robustness and fairness of deepfake speech detectors are only as credible as the datasets used to train and evaluate those systems. We present a dataset-level audit of the deepfake speech landscape. We compile and analyze 39 deepfake speech datasets, examining key attributes including accessibility, documentation, demographic and language coverage, dataset scale, and the underlying bona fide speech sources. Our audit reveals two important takeaways. Firstly, fairness assessment is largely infeasible because most datasets lack demographic metadata, and only a few contain gender or language labels. This prevents any meaningful subgroup analysis and leaves other demographic attributes unaddressed. Secondly, we identify substantial overlap in underlying bona fide source corpora across datasets, which can undermine cross-dataset evaluation and lead to overstated generalization claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对39个深度伪造语音数据集进行审计，发现大多数数据集缺乏人口统计元数据，导致公平性评估不可行；同时数据集之间在真实语音来源上存在大量重叠，可能夸大泛化能力。这项工作揭示了现有数据集在伦理和技术上的局限。
Motivation: 深度伪造语音检测器的鲁棒性和公平性依赖于数据集，但现有数据集缺乏系统审计。本文旨在通过数据集级审计揭示问题。
Method: 编译并分析39个深度伪造语音数据集，检查可访问性、文档、人口和语言覆盖、规模以及真实语音来源。
Result: 发现公平性评估几乎不可行（缺少人口统计数据），且数据集间的真实语音来源重叠严重，可能损害跨数据集评估和泛化声称。
Conclusion: 强调深度伪造语音数据集在伦理（公平性）和技术（泛化）上的限制，呼吁改进数据集构建和文档。

papers.title: Non-linear mechanical field reconstruction coupling recurrent neural networks with physics-informed graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing local stress fields in heterogeneous microstructures under non-linear, history-dependent loading remains a major computational bottleneck in multi-scale simulations. We propose a coupled LSTM-GNN framework that links the temporal and spatial aspects of local stress field reconstruction. A Long Short-Term Memory network encodes macroscopic stress-strain sequences into a compact hidden state that captures the path-dependent constitutive response, while a physics-informed Graph Neural Network reconstructs the spatially-resolved stress field at each time step. We introduce a relative weighting strategy with linear warm-up to balance the data-driven reconstruction loss and a discrete divergence-based equilibrium penalty. This resolves the scale mismatch that prevents fixed-weight formulations from converging in the elasto-plastic regime. The model is trained on 10,000 non-proportional loading paths applied to a periodic plate-with-a-hole microstructure and von Mises elasto-plasticity. The model achieves three orders of magnitude speedup over finite element simulations and generalizes to loading sequences twice the training length, with 1.9% cumulative error. Because the graph relies on mesh connectivity instead of the specific element type, one trained surrogate can be applied directly without retraining to meshes with different element types and to both coarser and finer resolutions, while in all cases reproducing the high-fidelity quad-element FE field used during training. Indeed, the message passing characteristics inherent to GNN and MeshGraphNet architecture render the model mesh-agnostic. Analysis of the LSTM hidden states suggests a low-dimensional structure related to the internal state variables of the constitutive model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出耦合LSTM和物理信息GNN的框架，用于在异质微结构非线性历史依赖加载下快速重建局部应力场。LSTM编码宏观应力-应变路径的依赖行为，GNN结合离散散度平衡惩罚重构空间应力场。模型在10,000条非比例加载路径上训练，比有限元模拟快三个数量级，且能泛化到两倍训练长度的加载序列，累积误差仅1.9%。由于图结构基于网格连通性，模型可迁移至不同网格类型和分辨率。
Motivation: 多尺度模拟中，异质微结构在非线性历史依赖加载下的局部应力场重建计算成本极高，成为主要瓶颈。
Method: 耦合LSTM与物理信息GNN：LSTM压缩宏观应力-应变序列为隐状态，GNN基于网格图重建空间应力场；采用相对权重策略和线性热身平衡数据驱动损失与基于离散散度的平衡惩罚，解决固定权重在弹塑性下不收敛的问题。
Result: 在板-孔微结构、von Mises弹塑性模型上，对10,000条非比例加载路径训练后，推理速度比有限元快三个数量级；对两倍训练长度的序列泛化时累积误差1.9%；模型可直接应用于不同单元类型和粗细网格，无需重训练。
Conclusion: LSTM隐状态展现出与内状态变量相关的低维结构，mesh-agnostic特性使该代理模型可推广至多种网格，加速多尺度模拟。

papers.title: RAT: Reference-Augmented Training for ASV Anti-Spoofing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a spoofing countermeasure architecture conditioned on speaker-reference recordings, but observe that it converges to a solution that effectively ignores the reference during inference. Surprisingly, training with a reference channel induces invariance that improves deepfake detection, even when the reference is absent or mismatched during inference. Based on this observation, we propose a Reference-Augmented Training (RAT) strategy. RAT yields improved detection performance compared to single-utterance baselines, even when the reference recording is replaced with a zero vector at inference. Through rigorous analysis, we demonstrate that the optimization process rapidly diminishes the reference contributions, leading to inference largely independent of the reference channel. Using RAT, we achieve state-of-the-art 2.57% EER and 0.074 minDCF on the ASVspoof 5 benchmark with a single detector, surpassing even large ensemble systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ASV反欺骗任务，提出一种基于参考说话人录音的欺骗检测架构，但发现模型在推理时会忽略参考信息。基于此，提出参考增强训练（RAT）策略，即使推理时参考信号被替换为零向量，也能提升检测性能。在ASVspoof 5基准上达到单检测器SOTA性能，EER为2.57%，minDCF为0.074，超越大型集成系统。
Motivation: 现有反欺骗系统通常基于单句特征，作者希望利用参考录音增强检测能力，但发现直接条件化架构会收敛到忽略参考的解，因此需要一种训练策略来利用参考信息。
Method: 提出参考增强训练（RAT），在训练时引入参考说话人录音通道，但推理时即使参考缺失或失配也能保持性能提升。通过分析发现，优化过程会快速减少参考贡献，使推理几乎独立于参考通道。
Result: 在ASVspoof 5基准上，单检测器实现2.57%等错误率（EER）和0.074最小检测代价函数（minDCF），超过包括大型集成系统在内的现有方法。
Conclusion: RAT策略表明训练时引入参考通道可以诱导不变性，增强deepfake检测，即使推理时参考信号被去除。该方法简单有效，适用于实际中参考录音不可用的情况。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在ASVspoof 5基准上，单检测器实现2.57%等错误率（EER）和0.074最小检测代价函数（minDCF），超过包括大型集成系统在内的现有方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: RAT策略表明训练时引入参考通道可以诱导不变性，增强deepfake检测，即使推理时参考信号被去除。该方法简单有效，适用于实际中参考录音不可用的情况。

papers.title: Human-AI Teaming Through the Lens of Calibration
papers.abstract_en: We study models for human-AI teaming through the lens of statistical calibration. We assume the team consists of an AI model and human -- both of which are calibrated with respect to some partitioning of the feature space -- and expose how the calibration assumptions propagate into the teaming framework. In particular, we consider frameworks that either (i) combine human and model predictions or (ii) delegate prediction responsibility to either a human or model. We show via theoretical and empirical results that existing methods for combination do not preserve the human's degree of calibration. Methods for delegation (by the very act of delegation) preserve calibration of the downstream predictors but shift the burden onto the rejector meta-model that decides who predicts. The rejector must be calibrated finely enough to locate where each member is superior, a demand that grows with the human's expertise and becomes unattainable when the human relies on information the system cannot observe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计校准的视角研究人机团队模型，假设AI和人类各自在特征空间分区上校准，并分析校准假设如何影响团队框架。通过理论和实验表明，组合预测方法不保留人类的校准程度，而委派预测方法虽保留下游预测器的校准，但将校准负担转移给决定谁预测的拒绝器元模型，且该负担随人类专业知识增长而增大，最终在人类依赖系统不可观测信息时无法实现。
Motivation: 现有的人机团队框架通常假设AI和人类预测已校准，但缺乏对校准假设如何传播到团队决策的深入分析，特别是组合和委派方法中校准特性的变化。
Method: 理论分析两种人机团队框架（组合预测与委派预测）中的校准传播性质，并通过实验验证。具体假设AI和人类在特征空间分区上分别校准，研究校准假设如何影响团队输出。
Result: 组合方法不保留人类的校准程度；委派方法保留下游预测器的校准，但拒绝器元模型需要足够精细的校准，其难度随人类专业知识增加，且在人类依赖系统不可观测信息时无法实现。
Conclusion: 人机团队中校准的传播并非自动实现，需要谨慎设计；委派方法虽好但引入拒绝器校准的新挑战。

papers.title: Beyond Model Size: Probing the Gaps in Visual in-Context Learning by Training a Tiny Model
papers.abstract_en: Visual in-Context Learning (VICL) aims at making progress towards adaptive vision models, that can -- based on a few examples -- adapt to a new task at test-time. With the history of in-context learning in natural language processing research, where large, parameter-heavy models are in use, one pathway that current VICL methods take is model- and data-scaling as key ingredients. Yet, it is not clear, whether these ingredients are the key for in-context learning to take shape in vision models. To stress-test such large models, we challenge them with an extreme counterexample: we train a tiny visual in-context model with merely $1$ million parameters and a modest amount of $70,000$ images. We compare the results of this severely capacity capped tiny model to $7,000\times$ larger VICL models in different adaptive settings, (1) on image data with small distribution shifts, (2) on unseen task encodings and (3) on a completely new task, i.e., the setting VICL envisions. With the chasm of training resources between the tiny- and large models, our experiments showcase a lack in how adaptive capabilities are measured, with respect to how tasks are encoded, which tasks were used in pre-training and the choice of metrics. These gaps in current VICL benchmarking underscore a need for innovation in evaluation of adaptive capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过训练一个仅有1百万参数和7万张图像的极小视觉上下文学习（VICL）模型，与7000倍大的VICL模型进行对比，以检验模型和数据规模是否是VICL的关键要素。实验发现，在三种自适应设置下，极小数模型的表现揭示了当前VICL基准在任务编码、预训练任务和度量选择方面的缺陷，表明大规模模型并非VICL的必要条件。
Motivation: 当前VICL方法依赖于大模型和海量数据，但尚不清楚这些因素是否为VICL能力的关键。通过训练极小模型作为极端反例，可以检验这一假设。
Method: 训练一个仅1M参数、70k图像的极小VICL模型，并在三种自适应设置（小分布偏移、未见任务编码、全新任务）下与7000倍大的VICL模型对比。
Result: 极小数模型与大规模模型的对比展示了当前VICL基准在衡量自适应能力方面的漏洞，尤其是在任务编码、预训练任务和度量选择上。
Conclusion: 当前VICL评估方法存在不足，需要创新的评估策略来准确衡量自适应能力。

papers.title: Pose-ICL: 3D-Aware In-Context Learning for Pose-Controllable Subject Customization
papers.abstract_en: Subject Customization is a foundational task in modern image generation. By providing a few reference images and a text prompt, users can generate images of a specific object in any desired scene. However, existing methods still struggle to achieve effective pose control for customized subjects. In practice, they often exhibit inaccurate poses or inconsistent cross-pose appearances. These limitations suggest that understanding objects in a volumetric manner remains a significant challenge for 2D-native backbones. To address this challenge, we propose Pose-ICL, a tuning-free framework that leverages 3D-aware In-Context Learning (ICL) to directly adapt to new subjects through multiple paired image-pose references. Its core mechanism,Surface-Anchored Position Embedding (SAPE), equips the model with explicit 3D awareness by anchoring image tokens to the surface coordinates of a volumetric bounding box. Dedicated refinements ensure its seamless compatibility with existing DiT models. Extensive evaluations on both 3D assets and real-world subjects demonstrate that Pose-ICL significantly outperforms current methods in both pose accuracy and identity consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pose-ICL，一种无需微调的框架，利用3D感知上下文学习（ICL）实现主题定制的姿态控制。核心机制是表面锚定位置嵌入（SAPE），通过将图像标记锚定到体积边界框的表面坐标，使模型具备显式3D感知。在3D资产和真实主题上的评估表明，Pose-ICL在姿态准确性和身份一致性上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有主题定制方法在姿态控制上表现不佳，常出现姿态不准确或跨姿态外观不一致的问题，表明2D骨干网络难以充分理解物体的体积特性。
Method: 提出Pose-ICL框架，通过多个配对图像-姿态参考实现无需微调的3D感知上下文学习；核心模块SAPE将图像标记锚定到体积边界框的表面坐标，并经过专门优化以兼容现有DiT模型。
Result: 在3D资产和真实主题上的实验表明，Pose-ICL在姿态准确性和身份一致性上显著优于当前方法。
Conclusion: 通过提供显式3D感知的上下文学习，Pose-ICL有效解决了主题定制中的姿态控制难题。

papers.title: Flash-GMM: A Memory-Efficient Kernel for Scalable Soft Clustering
papers.abstract_en: We present \textbf{Flash-GMM}, a fused Triton kernel for efficient computation of Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) over large-scale data in a single GPU pass. By eliminating the need to materialize the full responsibility matrix in GPU memory, Flash-GMM achieves a \textbf{20$\times$} speedup over existing implementations and enables training on datasets more than \textbf{100$\times$} larger than previously feasible on one device. To demonstrate its impact, we integrate Flash-GMM into the IVF coarse quantizer for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. We show that soft GMM clustering is now a viable drop-in replacement for $k$-means, and that GMM responsibilities can be leveraged to assign border vectors to multiple clusters. Our approach reaches fixed recall targets with up to $1.7\times$ fewer distance computations, or equivalently, yields $+2$--$12$ recall@10 at matched computational cost. We release the kernel as an open-source project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flash-GMM，一个融合的 Triton kernel，用于在大规模数据上高效计算高斯混合模型（GMM）。通过避免在 GPU 内存中实例化完整的责任矩阵，该 kernel 实现了 20 倍加速，并能在单 GPU 上训练比之前大 100 倍的数据集。将其集成到 IVF 粗量化器中用于近似最近邻（ANN）搜索，结果表明软 GMM 聚类可作为 k-means 的替代方案，利用 GMM 责任将边界向量分配到多个簇，达到固定召回目标时距离计算减少至 1.7 倍，或在相同计算成本下召回率@10 提升 2-12 点。
Motivation: 现有 GMM 实现中，责任矩阵的显式实例化导致巨大的内存开销，限制了可处理的数据规模。
Method: 设计了一个融合的 Triton kernel，在单次 GPU 传递中完成 GMM 计算，避免将完整的责任矩阵写入全局内存。
Result: 相比现有实现，Flash-GMM 达到 20 倍加速，并支持比之前大 100 倍的数据集；在 ANN 搜索中，使用 GMM 聚类替代 k-means 后，距离计算量减少至 1.7 倍，或召回率@10 提升 2-12 点。
Conclusion: 软 GMM 聚类在大规模数据上是 k-means 的可行替代，且通过所提 kernel 可高效实现。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: The 1st PortraitCraft Challenge: A CVPR 2026 Workshop Competition on Portrait Composition Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an overview of the inaugural PortraitCraft Challenge, held as one of the official competitions at CVPR 2026. The challenge focuses on portrait composition understanding and generation, aiming to advance AI research in portrait aesthetics analysis and controllable image synthesis. Unlike existing datasets and tasks that primarily focus on global aesthetic scoring, PortraitCraft introduces a unified evaluation framework comprising two complementary tracks. Track 1 requires models to perform structured portrait composition understanding, and Track 2 requires models to generate portrait images from structured composition descriptions under explicit compositional constraints. To support the challenge, we constructed and publicly released a large-scale portrait composition dataset consisting of approximately 50,000 curated real portrait images, providing multi-level supervision. This report describes the challenge setup, evaluation protocols, dataset composition, and final results, along with an analysis of the technical characteristics of the submitted solutions. The PortraitCraft Challenge provides a standardized and reproducible platform for research on portrait composition understanding and generation, and is expected to foster further progress in the fields of portrait aesthetics and controllable image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了首届PortraitCraft挑战赛的概述，该比赛是CVPR 2026的官方竞赛之一，专注于肖像构图理解与生成。挑战赛设置了两个互补赛道：Track 1要求模型进行结构化肖像构图理解，Track 2要求模型根据结构化构图描述生成肖像图像。为支持比赛，作者构建并公开了一个约5万张真实肖像图像的大规模数据集，提供多层次标注。报告描述了比赛设置、评估协议、数据集构成和最终结果，并分析了提交方案的技术特点。
Motivation: 现有数据集和任务主要关注全局美学评分，缺乏对肖像构图的结构化理解和可控生成的研究。
Method: 提出了包含两个互补轨道的统一评估框架：Track 1进行结构化肖像构图理解，Track 2根据结构化构图描述生成肖像图像，并构建了约5万张真实肖像图像的大规模数据集。
Result: 比赛提供了标准化和可复现的研究平台，推动了肖像美学和可控图像生成领域的进展。
Conclusion: PortraitCraft挑战赛为肖像构图理解和生成研究提供了标准化平台，有望促进相关领域的进一步发展。

papers.title: Improving Text-Instance Alignment Of Foreground Conditioned Out-Painting Via Customized Concept Embedding
papers.abstract_en: To showcase products, merchants often incur substantial costs creating high-quality display images. Foreground Conditioned Outpainting (FCO) meets this demand, allowing users to create desired backgrounds for foreground instances at a low cost by adjusting the text prompt. However, existing text-driven FCO methods exhibit critical flaws in their outputs, most notably the presence of artifacts, which refer to regions in the synthesized background that share the same semantics as the foreground instance. Such artifacts diminish the object's prominence and degrade image quality. We attribute the issue to the misalignment between the given instance and text-derived concept embeddings. To address this, we propose the Customized Concept Embedding Diffusion (CCE-Diffusion) framework. Its core is a CCE-Module to customize concept embeddings, bridging the gap between generic noun semantics and a specific visual instance. An Instance-Aware Loss guides the module's optimization, while a Semantic-Preserving Prompt Template prevents customized embeddings from distorting other words in the prompt. Both qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that CCE-Diffusion significantly reduces artifacts in the outputs. As a plug-and-play component, the CCE-Module can integrate with various FCO methods, enhancing their performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前景条件外补（FCO）中文本提示与前景实例不对齐导致生成背景中出现伪影（artifact）的问题，提出自定义概念嵌入扩散（CCE-Diffusion）框架。该框架通过CCE模块定制概念嵌入，结合实例感知损失和语义保留提示模板，减少伪影，提升图像质量。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动的FCO方法生成的背景常含有与前景实例语义相同的伪影区域，削弱主体突出性并降低图像质量。作者将问题归因于实例与文本概念嵌入之间的不对齐。
Method: 提出CCE-Diffusion框架，核心是CCE模块，用于定制概念嵌入以弥合通用名词语义与特定视觉实例之间的差距；采用实例感知损失指导模块优化，并使用语义保留提示模板防止定制嵌入扭曲提示中其他词汇。
Result: 定性和定量评估表明，CCE-Diffusion显著减少输出中的伪影；CCE模块作为即插即用组件可与多种FCO方法集成并提升性能。
Conclusion: 通过定制概念嵌入对齐文本与实例，能有效解决FCO中的伪影问题，且模块化设计便于推广到现有方法。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对前景条件外补（FCO）中文本提示与前景实例不对齐导致生成背景中出现伪影（artifact）的问题，提出自定义概念嵌入扩散（CCE-Diffusion）框架。该框架通过CCE模块定制概念嵌入，结合实例感知损失和语义保留提示模板，减少伪影，提升图像质量。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有文本驱动的FCO方法生成的背景常含有与前景实例语义相同的伪影区域，削弱主体突出性并降低图像质量。作者将问题归因于实例与文本概念嵌入之间的不对齐。
