summary_sections.result: 定性和定量评估表明，CCE-Diffusion显著减少输出中的伪影；CCE模块作为即插即用组件可与多种FCO方法集成并提升性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过定制概念嵌入对齐文本与实例，能有效解决FCO中的伪影问题，且模块化设计便于推广到现有方法。

papers.title: Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. The scaling factor that defines the quantization grid is typically chosen using simple, data-free heuristics. In this work, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to compute the optimal channel-wise weight scales exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization. PiSO partitions the scale search space into finitely many intervals on which the objective admits a closed-form minimizer. We extend PiSO to group-wise quantization via principled heuristics and propose effective strategies for interleaving scale optimization with error correction. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple model sizes and target weight bit-widths demonstrate consistent improvements in perplexity and downstream zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and combined with error correction. In particular, we observe increased benefits as the target bit-width narrows and quantization becomes more challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PiSO（Piecewise Scale Optimization）算法，用于训练后量化（PTQ）中优化大语言模型的权重量化尺度。PiSO 利用校准数据精确且高效地计算逐通道最优尺度，通过将尺度搜索空间划分为有限区间，在每个区间上闭式求解目标函数。实验在 Llama 和 Qwen 等模型上展示了一致的困惑度和零样本准确率提升，尤其在低位宽量化下收益更大。
Motivation: 现有训练后量化方法通常使用简单、无数据的启发式规则选择缩放因子，这可能不是最优的，导致模型压缩后精度损失较大。
Method: 提出 PiSO 算法，将尺度搜索空间划分为有限个区间，每个区间上目标函数有闭式最小化器，从而利用校准数据精确高效地计算逐通道最优缩放因子。并扩展到分组量化，结合启发式策略和误差校正。
Result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上，PiSO 在不同模型大小和目标位宽下均持续提升困惑度和下游零样本准确率，且位宽越低收益越明显。
Conclusion: PiSO 是一种有效的训练后量化尺度优化方法，尤其适用于低位宽量化场景，并能与误差校正技术结合进一步提升性能。

papers.title: Sleep EEG Signal Criticality as a Non-Invasive Predictor of Cognitive Decline in Dementia
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of neurodegeneration remains a critical clinical challenge. This study investigates whether sleep EEG signal criticality, quantified via Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA), serves as a non-invasive biomarker for future cognitive decline. We analyzed longitudinal data from the National Sleep Research Resource (NSRR) Study of Osteoporotic Fractures (SOF) cohort, comparing baseline sleep EEG dynamics between women who remained cognitively normal and those who later progressed to dementia-related impairment ($3MS < 78$).Our results reveal significant group-level differences in Hurst exponent $H(q)$ distributions, particularly during non-REM stages N2 and N3. Cognitively healthy individuals exhibited signal dynamics significantly closer to an optimally critical state across all electrode locations ($p \leqslant 0.001$), supporting the Brain Criticality Hypothesis. Supervised UMAP projections confirmed clear spatial separation between groups throughout the overnight sleep architecture.The dementia group demonstrated a shift in DFA exponents toward $1.0$, suggesting that a reconfiguration of scale-free neural dynamics during sleep precedes clinical symptoms. These findings highlight the potential for MFDFA-derived measures to be integrated into automated, sleep-based screening tools, enabling earlier preventative interventions during the prodromal window of dementia.

TL;DR: 本研究通过多分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA）量化睡眠脑电信号临界性，发现未来认知衰退的老年女性在非快速眼动睡眠N2和N3阶段Hurst指数分布与健康对照组存在显著差异，支持脑临界性假说。结果表明，睡眠中无标度神经动力学的重构先于临床症状出现，为基于睡眠的痴呆早期筛查工具提供了潜在生物标志物。
Motivation: 早期检测神经退行性疾病是临床难题，需要非侵入性生物标志物。睡眠脑电信号临界性（criticality）可能反映大脑功能状态，但其与认知衰退的关系尚待验证。
Method: 使用MFDFA从睡眠脑电中提取多分形特征（Hurst指数H(q)），分析NSRR-SOF队列的纵向数据，比较认知正常与进展为痴呆的老年女性在基线睡眠阶段的脑电动力学差异。
Result: 健康组在所有电极位置的信号动力学显著更接近最优临界状态（p≤0.001）；痴呆组DFA指数趋向1.0，表明无标度动力学重构。监督UMAP投影显示两组在整夜睡眠架构中清晰分离。
Conclusion: MFDFA衍生的脑电临界性指标有望整合到自动化睡眠筛查工具中，从而在痴呆前驱期实现早期干预。

papers.title: Listen, Look, and Learn: Learning Without Forgetting through SAM-Audio
papers.abstract_en: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to continuously learn new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. While recent CIL advances have spurred significant interest across various modalities, the audio-visual setting remains underexplored. Furthermore, although foundational multimodal models like SAM-Audio encapsulate rich static priors, our empirical analysis reveals that these representations struggle in incremental settings. This work bridges this gap by integrating SAM-Audio's audio-visual priors into the CIL setting. Specifically, we leverage its dense audio and visual representations and employ a novel guided attention strategy where the audio features contextually guide the visual representations. To further mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we introduce dual-level distillation objectives at both the feature and logit levels. Extensive evaluations on audio-visual CIL benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音频-视觉类别增量学习（CIL）中遗忘问题，提出利用SAM-Audio的多模态先验知识。通过引导注意力机制让音频特征指导视觉表示，并引入双重蒸馏损失来缓解灾难性遗忘。在音频-视觉CIL基准上，该方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有CIL研究多聚焦单模态，音频-视觉设定探索不足；基础多模态模型如SAM-Audio蕴含丰富静态先验，但实验表明其表示在增量学习中表现不佳。
Method: 集成SAM-Audio的音频和视觉密集表示，采用引导注意力策略使音频特征上下文引导视觉表示；同时引入特征级和logit级的双重蒸馏目标。
Result: 在音频-视觉CIL基准上，该方法持续优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了音频-视觉CIL的研究空白，证明了多模态先验结合引导注意力能有效缓解遗忘。

papers.title: Large-scale semantic mapping of learner agency and autonomy reveals what measurement and generative AI research overlook
papers.abstract_en: Learner agency and autonomy are foundational to personal development, yet a pervasive "jingle-jangle" fallacy (i.e. identical terms denoting different constructs, distinct terms denoting identical ones) has substantially hindered cumulative knowledge. Treating meaning as a phenomenon constituted through use in linguistic practice, we extracted 8,954 definitions and 2,700 scale items from over 14,000 publications, to investigate how researchers actually used learner agency and autonomy with a semantic analysis pipeline. The definitional landscape of two constructs resolves into three dimensions: regulation and control of learning (task), intrinsic motivation and internal decision-making (person), and social-relational action (sociocultural), thereby empirically quantifying the jingle-jangle fallacy. Existing scales, however, systematically underrepresent the sociocultural dimension. Critically, current generative AI research in education concentrates on learning regulation and control, narrowing the behavioral repertoire that AI-mediated learning environments are designed to cultivate. Beyond conceptual clarification, this work carries direct implications for conceptualization, measurement, and practice towards supporting the multidimensional learner agency and autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对学习者能动性与自主性（learner agency and autonomy）研究中的“jingle-jangle”谬误，本文从超过14,000篇出版物中提取定义和量表条目，进行语义分析。结果表明这两个构念的定义空间可分解为三个维度：学习调节与控制（任务）、内在动机与内部决策（个人）、社会关系行动（社会文化）。现有量表系统性地低估了社会文化维度，而生成式AI教育研究主要集中在学习调节与控制，缩小了AI设计应培养的行为范围。
Motivation: 学习者能动性与自主性研究中存在“jingle-jangle”谬误，即相同术语指不同构念、不同术语指相同构念，这阻碍了知识的积累。此外，现有测量和生成式AI研究存在视角局限，忽视了社会文化维度。
Method: 提取8,954个定义和2,700个量表条目，采用语义分析管道对研究者实际使用的术语进行大规模映射。
Result: 定义空间分解为三个维度：任务、个人、社会文化。现有量表系统性地低估了社会文化维度，生成式AI教育研究集中于任务维度。
Conclusion: 该研究对概念化、测量和实践有直接启示，有助于支持多维度的学习者能动性与自主性，并呼吁在AI教育设计中扩展行为范围。

papers.title: XtrAIn: Training-Guided Occlusion for Feature Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Occlusion-based attribution methods provide an intuitive way to estimate feature importance by perturbing input features and measuring the resulting change in model output. However, their reliability is strongly affected by how feature removal is implemented: externally selected baselines can introduce bias, out-of-distribution samples, and unstable explanations, while in nonlinear models the occlusion of a set of features can also alter the contribution of non-occluded features. We refer to this effect as attribution shift, as the attribution scores of the non-occluded features drift from their initial values. To challenge these major issues that render explanations unstable, we introduce XtrAIn, a training-guided attribution method that transfers the occlusion operation from the input space to the parameter space. Instead of replacing input values with hand-crafted baselines, XtrAIn follows the model's training trajectory and measures how feature-associated parameter updates affect the output logits. We further introduce Xstep, a lightweight approximation for reducing computational cost, and XtrAIn+, a target-focused variant that emphasizes updates aligned with the target class. Experiments on controlled image datasets and PAM50 breast-cancer subtype classification show that the proposed methods produce cleaner and more interpretable attribution patterns than standard attribution baselines. Overall, XtrAIn provides a training-aware perspective on feature attribution and offers a useful diagnostic tool for studying how feature-level evidence is formed during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种训练引导的遮挡归因方法 XtrAIn，将遮挡操作从输入空间转移到参数空间，通过跟踪模型训练过程中与特征相关的参数更新来测量特征重要性，从而避免传统基线选择带来的偏差、分布外样本和归因偏移问题。实验在受控图像数据集和 PAM50 乳腺癌亚型分类上表明该方法比标准归因基线产生更干净、更可解释的归因模式。
Motivation: 现有遮挡归因方法因基线选择导致偏差、分布外样本和不稳定解释，且非线性模型中遮挡一组特征会改变非遮挡特征的归因分数（归因偏移），影响解释的可靠性。
Method: 提出 XtrAIn，通过跟踪模型训练轨迹，测量与特征相关的参数更新对输出 logits 的影响；同时引入轻量级近似 Xstep 降低计算成本，以及目标聚焦变体 XtrAIn+ 强调与目标类别一致的更新。
Result: 在受控图像数据集和 PAM50 乳腺癌亚型分类任务上，XtrAIn 产生的归因模式比标准基线更干净、更可解释，证实了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: XtrAIn 提供了一种训练感知的特征归因视角，可作为研究训练过程中特征级证据形成的诊断工具。

papers.title: Advancing Wood Identification in the Philippines: Utilizing the Xylorix Platform for Efficient AI Model Development and Deployment for Five Key Species
papers.abstract_en: Illegal logging and timber trade continue to pose significant challenges in the Philippines, where accurate wood species identification is essential for enforcement but limited by the need for specialised equipment and expertise. This study aims to evaluate whether AI models for macroscopic wood identification can be developed and deployed by wood scientists without programming expertise using the Xylorix platform, focusing on five Philippine hardwood species: Mangium (Acacia mangium Willd.), Rain Tree [Samanea saman (Jacq.) Merr.], Banuyo (Wallaceodendron celebicum Koord.), Tindalo [Afzelia rhomboidea (Blanco) Vidal], and Ipil [Intsia bijuga (Colebr.) O. Kuntze]. Binary classifiers were trained on 10,663 verified cross-section images from 260 specimens and evaluated using specimen-level mean scoring to mirror operational field conditions. Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) values ranged from 0.969 (Ipil) to 1.000 (Mangium), and Average Precision (AP) values ranged from 0.589 (Samanea) to 1.000 (Mangium). Four of five species achieved AA grade (AUC and AP both \geq 0.90); Rain Tree received AE (AUC \geq 0.90, AP < 0.60) due to AP compression from its small positive test set (3 specimens). All five classifiers rank their target specimens above non-target specimens with near-perfect fidelity. Specimen-level error analysis revealed 9 false negatives from Ipil, primarily stemming from localized image artifacts and 3 false positives for Rain Tree and 1 false positive for Tindalo caused by shared tribal-level anatomical traits. These findings demonstrate that Xylorix non-programmers can leverage the Xylorix platform to construct operationally reliable wood identification models suitable for field deployment at supply chain checkpoints.

papers.title: Schmidt Decomposition-Based Methods for Efficient Quantum Image Encoding
papers.abstract_en: In quantum image processing, a fundamental step is encoding classical image data into quantum states. This can be achieved using methods such as Flexible Representation of Quantum Images (FRQI), Quantum Probability Image Encoding (QPIE), and Novel Enhanced Quantum Representation (NEQR). However, on real quantum hardware, these encodings can quickly lead to circuits with many gates, large circuit depth, and high qubit usage, which is a problem for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. In this work, we investigate whether low-rank state approximation, formulated via Schmidt decomposition, can help reduce this complexity. The method keeps only the most significant parts of a quantum state's entanglement structure, making state preparation more efficient while preserving most of the image information. We compare the three encoding techniques in their original form and with low-rank approximation, evaluating metrics such as circuit depth, CNOT count, MSE, and visual quality of reconstructed images. The results reveal meaningful trade-offs between accuracy and resource efficiency, with the FRQI model achieving a 97 percent reduction in circuit depth while maintaining a near-perfect reconstruction (MSE of about 0.27). This demonstrates the potential of low-rank techniques for advancing practical quantum image processing on near-term hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了基于Schmidt分解的低秩状态近似方法，用于减少量子图像编码（FRQI、QPIE、NEQR）的电路复杂度。实验表明，FRQI模型在保持近完美重建（MSE约0.27）的同时，电路深度降低了97%。
Motivation: 现有量子图像编码方法在NISQ设备上会导致大量门操作、深度和量子比特使用，限制了其实用性。
Method: 利用Schmidt分解保留量子态纠缠结构中最显著的部分，实现低秩近似，从而简化状态制备。
Result: FRQI编码在低秩近似下电路深度减少97%，MSE仅约0.27；三种编码在精度与资源效率之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 低秩近似技术有望在近期量子硬件上推进实用的量子图像处理。

papers.title: When Do Autoregressive Sequence Models Forecast Physical Wavefields? A Controlled Study on Synthetic Seismograms
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autoregressive forecasting of oscillatory physical signals, such as seismograms, gravitational-wave strain, and similar wavefields is limited by error accumulation: as a causal model is fed its own outputs over hundreds of steps, small per-step errors compound into phase drift that pointwise metrics fail to detect. We ask when such rollout stays stable, using synthetic three-component seismograms as a physically structured testbed and the \textsc{SeismoGPT} autoregressive forecaster as the model under study. Through controlled, intra-architecture ablations evaluated on free-running rollout with paired significance tests, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. Multi-token prediction is the dominant stabilizer, accounting for almost the entire improvement over a single-token baseline ($+0.040$ median NCC); a horizon-embedding hybrid prediction head and a cross-horizon STFT-magnitude coherence loss each add a small but consistent further gain. Performance depends sharply on a context-ratio threshold near one, roughly the full P-S interval of observed signal, below which rollout generalization collapses. The dominant residual failure is a polarity inversion that a magnitude-based spectral loss cannot, by construction, penalize, identifying phase-aware objectives as the natural next step. We frame this as a controlled study of rollout stability on oscillatory wavefields, not a benchmark of forecasting architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过合成三分量地震图作为物理结构化测试平台，系统研究自回归序列模型在长时程滚动预测中的稳定性。在SeismoGPT模型上进行受控消融实验发现，多token预测是稳定化的主导因素（中位数NCC提升0.040），而地平线嵌入混合预测头和跨地平线STFT幅度相干损失可提供小幅额外增益。预测性能依赖于接近1的上下文比率阈值，主要失败模式为极性反转，表明需要相位感知目标函数。
Motivation: 自回归预测振荡物理信号（如地震图）时，误差累积导致相位漂移，点态指标无法检测。需要理解滚动预测何时保持稳定。
Method: 使用合成三分量地震图作为测试平台，在SeismoGPT模型上进行受控消融实验，通过自由滚动预测和配对显著性检验，隔离每个设计选择的贡献。比较单token基线、多token预测、地平线嵌入混合预测头、跨地平线STFT幅度相干损失等。
Result: 多token预测是主要稳定器（中位数NCC+0.040），地平线嵌入和STFT损失各提供小幅小幅增益。性能依赖于上下文比率阈值接近1（约等于P-S间隔），低于此阈值滚动泛化崩溃。主要残留失败为极性反转，幅度损失无法惩罚。
Conclusion: 本文定位为振荡波场滚动预测稳定性的受控研究，而非架构基准。结论强调多token预测的效果，并指出相位感知目标函数是下一步自然方向。

papers.title: LIBERO-Occ: Evaluating and Improving Vision-Language-Action Models under Scene-Induced Occlusion via Viewpoint Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, but most evaluations assume that task-relevant objects are fully visible. This assumption often fails in realistic settings, where occlusion makes manipulation partially observable. In this paper, we study \textit{scene-induced occlusion} as a fundamental challenge for VLA models and introduce \textbf{LIBERO-Occ}, an occlusion-oriented extension of LIBERO. Experiments show that state-of-the-art VLAs suffer substantial performance degradation under occlusion. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Viewpoint Imagination (VIM)}, which generates a complementary view from an occluded primary observation and conditions action prediction on both observed and imagined evidence. VIM improves robustness across task suites, occlusion types, and severity levels without requiring additional cameras at deployment time, suggesting that viewpoint imagination is an promising mechanism for perception completion in partially observable manipulation. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: \href{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LIBERO-Occ，一个面向场景诱发遮挡的机器人操控基准，发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在遮挡下性能显著下降。为解决该问题，提出视角想象（Viewpoint Imagination, VIM）方法，从遮挡主视角生成互补视图，并基于观测和想象证据联合预测动作，无需额外摄像头即可提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 当前VLA模型评估假设任务相关物体完全可见，但现实场景中遮挡普遍存在，导致模型性能退化，而现有基准缺乏对此的研究。
Method: 构建LIBERO-Occ基准，包含多种遮挡类型和严重程度。提出VIM，利用生成模型从主视角想象互补视角，并将想象视图与观测视图融合用于动作预测。
Result: 实验显示最优VLA模型在遮挡下性能大幅下降，而VIM在不同任务套件、遮挡类型和严重程度下均显著提升鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 视角想象是一种有效的感知补全机制，可缓解部分可观测操控中的遮挡问题，且无需部署额外摄像头。

papers.title: From Perception to Action: Can UI Interventions Foster Sustainable LLM Chatbot
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered chatbots are increasingly embedded in everyday workflows, raising sustainability concerns due to their energy use. Most mitigation strategies emphasize model or infrastructure efficiency, while the user-interface (UI) layer remains underexplored despite its potential to shape interaction behavior. We investigate whether sustainability-oriented UI interventions can increase users' energy awareness and encourage more energy-responsible chatbot use without reducing usability. We first conducted a baseline survey with 77 participants to assess awareness and receptiveness to intervention concepts. Guided by prior work on persuasive technology and choice architecture, we implemented a web-based chatbot prototype with a three-mode switch (Energy-efficient, Balanced, Performance), per-response energy feedback, pre-send energy estimates, a usage metrics dashboard, and energy analogies. We then evaluated the prototype in a five-day field study with 11 participants. In the baseline survey, 94.8% of respondents reported at least some awareness of AI energy use, yet 88.3% misestimated actual consumption. Although concern about environmental impact was high, only 39.0% indicated willingness to accept a performance trade-off for lower energy use. In the field study, Energy-efficient mode accounted for 55.8% of logged prompts, while 90.9% self-reported actively choosing Eco-mode when high accuracy was not required. Participants did not reduce prompt length, suggesting mode switching as the primary behavioral mechanism. Sustainability-oriented UI interventions can improve awareness and support more energy-responsible interaction patterns in LLM chatbots. These effects are best interpreted as behavioral and model-based estimates that complement backend efficiency work, and the provided prototype and replication package support further research on energy-aware conversational AI design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过用户界面（UI）干预措施提升LLM聊天机器人的能源意识，并鼓励更节能的使用行为。基线调查显示用户对AI能耗认知不足，但愿意在非关键任务中选择节能模式。现场实验发现节能模式占55.8%的提示，用户主要通过切换模式而非减少提示长度来节能，且不影响可用性。
Motivation: 现有减少AI能耗的策略多集中于模型或基础设施层面，忽略了用户界面层对交互行为的影响潜力。用户对AI能耗认知不足且不愿牺牲性能，因此需要探索非侵入性的UI干预。
Method: 首先对77名参与者进行基线调查，评估能耗意识和干预概念接受度。然后实现了一个带三模式开关（节能、平衡、性能）的聊天机器人原型，并提供逐次能耗反馈、预发送能耗估算、使用指标仪表盘和能耗类比。最后在11名参与者的五天现场实验中评估原型。
Result: 基线调查中94.8%的参与者声称了解AI能耗，但88.3%低估实际消耗；仅39%愿意为节能接受性能折衷。现场实验中节能模式占55.8%的提示，90.9%自报在无需高精度时主动选择节能模式；提示长度未减少，表明模式切换是主要行为机制。
Conclusion: 面向可持续性的UI干预可提升用户能耗意识并支持更负责任的交互模式，效果需结合后端效率优化共同解释。提供的原型和复现包支持后续研究。

papers.title: Embodiment-conditioned Generalist Control for Multirotor Aerial Robots
papers.abstract_en: We present a generalist position control policy capable of controlling arbitrary multirotor configurations of a certain rotor count (e.g., hexarotors or quadrotors) with a single set of network weights. The policy is conditioned on a physics-grounded embodiment descriptor: a mass and inertia-normalized control allocation matrix that captures how mass-normalized motor thrusts generate linear and angular accelerations in the body-frame. To train the policy, we sample from a broad distribution of arbitrary multirotor configurations, including non-planar and asymmetric systems, and optimize a single, compact network using Proximal Policy Optimization. Training requires only five minutes on an RTX 3090 GPU using a custom NVIDIA Warp-based dynamics simulator. Through extensive simulation experiments, we show that embodiment conditioning enables robust generalist control across arbitrary morphologies. We demonstrate zero-shot real-world transfer of this generalist policy on three diverse hexarotor systems, including a planar robot, a partially symmetric non-planar system, and a random asymmetric, non-planar configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于实现描述器的通用位置控制策略，能够用单一网络权重控制任意多旋翼配置（如四旋翼、六旋翼）。策略使用质量和惯性归一化的控制分配矩阵作为条件，通过PPO从大量随机多旋翼配置中训练一个紧凑网络，训练仅需5分钟（RTX 3090）。模拟实验显示跨任意形态的鲁棒控制，并成功零样本迁移到三种不同的真实六旋翼系统。
Motivation: 现有多旋翼控制策略通常针对特定形态设计，缺乏对不同配置（包括非平面、非对称系统）的通用性。
Method: 提出基于物理实现描述器（质量和惯性归一化的控制分配矩阵）的条件化控制策略；通过PPO从广泛的多旋翼配置分布中采样训练单一紧凑网络，并使用基于NVIDIA Warp的自定义动力学模拟器。
Result: 模拟实验证明实现条件化使策略能够鲁棒地控制任意形态；在三种真实六旋翼平台（平面、部分对称非平面、随机非对称非平面）上实现零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 论文表明通过物理条件化可以实现多旋翼通用控制，且训练高效（5分钟），零样本迁移到真实系统表现良好。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有多旋翼控制策略通常针对特定形态设计，缺乏对不同配置（包括非平面、非对称系统）的通用性。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于物理实现描述器（质量和惯性归一化的控制分配矩阵）的条件化控制策略；通过PPO从广泛的多旋翼配置分布中采样训练单一紧凑网络，并使用基于NVIDIA Warp的自定义动力学模拟器。
summary_sections.result: 模拟实验证明实现条件化使策略能够鲁棒地控制任意形态；在三种真实六旋翼平台（平面、部分对称非平面、随机非对称非平面）上实现零样本迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明通过物理条件化可以实现多旋翼通用控制，且训练高效（5分钟），零样本迁移到真实系统表现良好。

papers.title: Janus: A Benchmark for Goal-Conditioned Information Distortion in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLM deception is often evaluated through direct markers such as fabricated claims, explicit lies, or strategic concealment. However, many real-world misleading communications do not depend on false statements, rather, they arise from selective treatment of true material facts: omitting adverse evidence, softening unfavorable details, emphasizing favorable details, or replacing precise qualifications with vague language. Existing benchmarks largely miss this subtler and arguably more dangerous failure mode. We introduce JANUS, a benchmark for measuring goal-conditioned pragmatic distortion in fact-grounded LLM outputs. Each scenario in our benchmark provides a fixed pool of favorable and adverse facts and compares a neutral condition against a goal-directed condition, such as increasing adoption, enrollment, approval, or support, despite potential harm to directly affected individuals or groups. Because all outputs are constrained to use the same fact pool, JANUS isolates misleading net impressions from hallucination and fabrication. JANUS contains 160 scenarios across 8 domains, with each scenario paired with neutral and goal-conditioned prompts and annotated material facts. Extensive experiments across 12 LLMs reveal consistent goal-conditioned distortions, demonstrating that current models remain sensitive to incentive and framing objectives and lack robust safeguards against selectively misleading communication. We publicly release our corpus and code for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JANUS基准，用于评估LLM在事实约束下的目标条件性信息扭曲。该基准通过固定事实池，比较中性提示与目标导向提示（如增加采纳率、支持率等）下模型输出的差异，从而隔离选择性误导与幻觉。实验表明12个主流LLM均存在一致的目标条件性扭曲，缺乏对选择性误导的鲁棒防护。
Motivation: 现有LLM欺骗评估多关注虚假陈述或直接谎言，但现实中的误导常源于对真实事实的选择性呈现（如省略不利证据、弱化负面细节、强化有利信息）。缺乏评估这种微妙但危险失败模式的基准。
Method: 构建JANUS基准，包含160个场景（跨8个领域），每个场景提供一组有利和不利事实，并配有中性提示和目标导向提示（如“增加对该政策的支持”）。模型输出必须使用同一事实池，从而分离误导性整体印象与幻觉/捏造。
Result: 在12个LLM上的实验表明，所有模型均表现出一致的目标条件性扭曲，即当提示包含激励目标时，模型倾向于选择性呈现事实，且缺乏防止此类误导的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 当前LLM对激励和框架目标敏感，容易产生选择性误导通信，亟需更强的安全机制。JANUS基准公开了语料和代码，供后续研究使用。

papers.title: HarmoView: Harmonizing Multi-View Constraints for Identity-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current identity-consistent video generation methods struggle to preserve appearance fidelity under large viewpoint changes. While introducing multi-view reference input offers a natural solution, progress remains constrained by the lack of effective frameworks for multi-view inputs and the scarcity of multi-view data. We address these challenges by proposing HarmoView, a robust framework for identity-consistent video generation that effectively integrates multi-view cues through three architectural refinements complemented by a staged training curriculum. Specifically, we first introduce Multi-level Feature Injection to anchor identity fidelity; by injecting raw ViT features from frontal references alongside text tokens via cross-attention, MFI provides persistent low-level appearance anchors that complement the high-level identity features within DiT blocks, leading to enhanced identity preservation. Then, we employ learnable proxy tokens to unify heterogeneous reference layouts across single-/multi-view settings while simultaneously resolving the reference-view mismatch problem. Jump-RoPE is further developed for identity-wise feature isolation to reduce identity crosstalk. To activate these structural capabilities while preserving the original generative priors, we propose the Progressive View Curriculum. This four-stage training strategy employs view dropout to facilitate a stable transition from vanilla T2V generation to high-fidelity, identity-persistent spatial reasoning. Furthermore, we construct a large-scale multi-view dataset to address the issue of data scarcity. Extensive evaluation on our multi-view benchmark, comprising 100 manually-curated cases spanning 52 unique identities, demonstrates that HarmoView significantly outperforms open-source baselines and matches leading closed-source engines, achieving state-of-the-art performance in identity-consistent video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarmoView 框架，通过多级特征注入、可学习代理令牌和跳跃旋转位置编码（Jump-RoPE）等架构改进，结合渐进式视角课程训练，实现多视角输入下的身份一致视频生成。该方法还构建了大规模多视角数据集，在包含 52 个身份的 100 个案例基准上，显著优于开源基线，并匹配领先闭源引擎的性能。
Motivation: 现有身份一致视频生成方法在大视角变化下难以保持外观保真度，且缺乏有效的多视角输入框架和训练数据。
Method: 提出三项架构改进：多级特征注入（MFI）通过将正面参考的原始 ViT 特征注入交叉注意力来锚定身份保真度；可学习代理令牌统一单/多视角参考布局并解决视角不匹配；Jump-RoPE 实现身份级特征隔离减少串扰。配合四阶段渐进式视角课程训练，通过视角丢弃实现从标准文本到视频生成到高保真空间推理的稳定过渡。
Result: 在自建的多视角基准（100 个案例、52 个身份）上，HarmoView 显著优于开源基线，并匹配领先闭源引擎，实现身份一致视频生成的最先进性能。
Conclusion: HarmoView 通过多视角约束的有效整合和渐进式训练，解决了身份一致视频生成中的外观保真度和数据稀缺问题。

papers.title: Geometrically Averaged Hard Target Updates for Linear Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Periodic hard target updates are among the most common stabilization devices in modern deep Q-learning. Recent studies suggest that target updates can improve stability in Q-learning with function approximation, including linear function approximation. We introduce and analyze the so-called $λ$-target update, obtained by averaging the $m$-periodic target update maps with $λ$-geometric weights $(1-λ)λ^{m-1}$, $λ\in [0,1]$. The endpoint $λ=0$ recovers the one-period target update, while the continuous endpoint $λ\uparrow1$ recovers projected Q-value iteration. We study this mechanism for Q-learning with linear function approximation, namely linear Q-learning, using a switching-system model and related tools. For clarity, the paper treats a deterministic version; the formulation extends to stochastic reinforcement-learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性Q学习中的周期性硬目标更新问题，提出一种几何平均化的λ-目标更新方法，通过将m周期目标更新映射以λ几何权重平均，统一了从单周期目标更新到投影Q值迭代的连续谱。使用切换系统模型分析该机制在确定性环境下的收敛性，并指出可拓展到随机强化学习设置。
Motivation: 周期性硬目标更新是深度Q学习中常用的稳定策略，但现有研究对目标更新在函数近似（包括线性函数近似）中的稳定性作用理解不足，缺乏统一的分析框架。
Method: 定义λ-目标更新：以几何权重(1-λ)λ^{m-1}平均m个周期的目标更新映射，λ∈[0,1]。λ=0退化为单周期目标更新，λ↑1退化为投影Q值迭代。采用切换系统模型分析线性Q学习下的动力学行为。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅给出理论分析框架：确定性版本的分析能够推广到随机强化学习场景。
Conclusion: 本文通过几何平均化的目标更新提供了统一视角，并建立切换系统模型作为分析工具，为理解目标更新在Q学习中的稳定性贡献了理论基础。

papers.title: Do VLMs Reason Like Engineers? A Benchmark and a Stage-wise Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance on general multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their ability to perform engineering reasoning remains largely unexplored. Unlike general visual question answering, engineering problem solving requires interpreting technical diagrams, selecting governing physical principles, and maintaining physically consistent multi-step reasoning. These capabilities are increasingly important for AI systems used in engineering education, scientific assistance, and technical decision-making, where reasoning failures may produce physically invalid yet superficially plausible solutions. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate final answers and provide limited assessment of intermediate reasoning processes. We introduce EngVQA, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating engineering reasoning across 5 engineering subjects containing 696 problems. We introduce an 8-stage automatic evaluation framework for assessing VLM-generated solutions. The framework independently evaluates each stage of the solution, enabling fine-grained analysis of reasoning failures. We benchmark multiple state-of-the-art open and closed source VLMs on our evaluation framework and demonstrate substantial limitations in current engineering reasoning capabilities. Human evaluation shows strong agreement with our automated framework, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.975 and a mean absolute error of 0.67 on a 10-point grading scale. Our results highlight the importance of process-oriented evaluation for reliable assessment of multimodal engineering reasoning systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages (main text), 4 figures, 2 tables; 50 pages total including appendix. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EngVQA，一个跨5个工程学科共696个问题的多模态基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在工程推理中的能力，并设计了一个8阶段自动评估框架对推理过程进行细粒度分析。在多个开源和闭源VLM上测试显示当前模型存在显著局限，且自动评估与人类评分高度一致（Pearson相关系数0.975）。
Motivation: 现有多模态推理基准主要评估最终答案，缺乏对中间推理过程的评估，而工程推理需要解释技术图表、选择物理原理并保持物理一致的多步推理，这对AI系统在工程教育、科学辅助中的可靠性至关重要。
Method: 构建EngVQA基准（696道工程问题，5个学科），并设计8阶段自动评估框架，独立评估VLM生成解决方案的每个阶段，实现推理失败的细粒度分析。
Result: 多个开源和闭源VLM在工程推理上表现有限；自动评估框架与人类评分的Pearson相关系数为0.975，平均绝对误差为0.67（10分制）。
Conclusion: 过程导向的评估对于可靠评估多模态工程推理系统至关重要，当前VLM在工程推理任务上仍需改进。

papers.title: Attention-Discounted Adaptive Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models can reduce inference steps by revealing multiple tokens per denoising iteration, but this parallelism is fragile: positions that are individually confident may be unsafe to commit together when their predictions are coupled. Existing training-free samplers such as Top-\(k\), Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler mainly control how many tokens to reveal, while often ranking candidates by token-wise scores that ignore interactions within the selected set. We propose ADAS, a training-free reranking rule for parallel masked diffusion decoding. ADAS leaves the base sampler's stopping rule unchanged and modifies only subset construction: it greedily discounts a candidate when it attends strongly to already selected positions whose predictions remain uncertain. Unlike graph-constrained methods that turn attention into hard compatibility constraints, ADAS keeps attention continuous and uses it as a soft marginal penalty. Across LLaDA-8B-Base and Dream-7B-Base on GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, and MBPP, plugging ADAS into Top-\(k\), Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler improves low-NFE performance at matched denoiser evaluations by \(9.11\) and \(10.46\) percentage points on average, respectively, with \(3.1\%\) per-forward runtime overhead. These results show that soft attention-discounted reranking is a simple and modular way to improve quality in highly parallel decoding for masked diffusion language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADAS，一种无需训练的重新排序规则，用于掩码扩散语言模型的并行解码。ADAS 通过注意力折扣机制，在构建候选子集时对与已选但预测不确定性高的位置强相关的候选进行惩罚，从而改善低推理步数 (NFE) 下的生成质量。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 和 Dream-7B-Base 上，ADAS 在 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 等基准测试中将现有采样器 (Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler) 的性能平均提升 9.11 和 10.46 个百分点，仅增加 3.1% 的前向运行时间开销。
Motivation: 现有并行掩码扩散解码方法 (如 Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler) 主要基于单个 token 的置信度选择要揭示的 token，忽略了 token 之间的依赖关系，导致同时提交多个高置信度 token 时可能出错。
Method: ADAS 保持基础采样器的停止规则不变，仅修改子集构建：通过贪婪方式，当候选 token 对已选位置（预测仍不确定）有强注意力时，对其得分进行折扣。注意力保持连续形式，作为软边际惩罚，而非硬约束。
Result: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 上，将 ADAS 插入 Top-k、Fast-dLLM 和 EB-Sampler，在匹配去噪评估次数下，低 NFE 性能平均提升 9.11 和 10.46 个百分点，每前向传播仅增加 3.1% 的运行时开销。
Conclusion: 软注意力折扣重新排序是一种简单且模块化的方法，能够有效提升掩码扩散语言模型高度并行解码的质量。

summary_sections.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 上，将 ADAS 插入 Top-k、Fast-dLLM 和 EB-Sampler，在匹配去噪评估次数下，低 NFE 性能平均提升 9.11 和 10.46 个百分点，每前向传播仅增加 3.1% 的运行时开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 软注意力折扣重新排序是一种简单且模块化的方法，能够有效提升掩码扩散语言模型高度并行解码的质量。

papers.title: A Unified Siamese Learning Framework for Zero-Day Anomaly Detection and Classification in Optical Networks
papers.abstract_en: A multi-similarity Siamese neural network unifies zero-day anomaly detection and one-shot classification in optical networks, achieving over 99% accuracy and instant adaptability across lightpaths and unseen anomaly types without any retraining.
papers.comment: Authors' version of the manuscript accepted and published at the Optical Fiber Communication Conference (OFC) 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个多相似度孪生神经网络（multi-similarity Siamese neural network），统一处理光网络中的零日异常检测和一次性分类（one-shot classification），无需重训练即可适应不同光路和未见异常类型，在测试中达到超过99%的准确率。
Motivation: 现有光网络异常检测方法难以同时处理已知和未知异常类型，且依赖大量标注数据或频繁重训练。
Method: 提出多相似度孪生神经网络，通过计算样本对之间的多相似度度量，将零日异常检测和一次性分类统一在同一框架中。
Result: 在光网络测试中，该框架对零日异常检测和分类的准确率超过99%，且对不同光路和未见异常类型无需重训练即可即时适应。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需重训练的即时适应能力，适用于光网络中动态变化的异常检测需求。

papers.title: MODIP: Efficient Model-Based Optimization for Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies (DPs) have emerged as expressive policy representations for robot learning, often used with imitation learning methods such as behavioral cloning (BC). However, while their success has largely been confined to BC, direct reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning remains challenging because actions are generated through a multi-step denoising process. In this work, we propose MODIP, a framework for the offline-to-online fine-tuning of DPs. Rather than directly applying RL to the DPs, MODIP leverages a world model (WM) to guide policy adaptation and keeps the simplicity and stability of BC. We utilize model predictive control (MPC) to generate high-quality trajectories within the WM, and use them as supervised targets for fine-tuning the DP. To make MPC planning efficient, MODIP uses a terminal state value instead of a policy-dependent state-action value, reducing inference time. Additionally, MODIP trains critics with policy-independent TD targets, reducing training time. Experiments on D4RL (MuJoCo, Kitchen) and RoboMimic tasks show that MODIP improves diffusion policies beyond BC, and is competitive with or outperforms diffusion policy RL fine-tuning methods and strong model-based baselines such as TD-MPC2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）直接强化学习微调困难的问题，提出MODIP框架，利用世界模型（World Model）进行模型预测控制（MPC）生成高质量轨迹作为监督目标，避免直接应用RL，保持行为克隆的简单性和稳定性。在D4RL和RoboMimic任务上，MODIP提升了扩散策略的性能，与扩散策略RL微调方法和TD-MPC2等强基线竞争或超越。
Motivation: 扩散策略在机器人学习中通常与行为克隆结合使用，但直接强化学习微调因多步去噪过程而困难，需要一种兼具BC稳定性和RL性能提升的方法。
Method: MODIP利用世界模型通过MPC生成高质量轨迹，并以此作为监督目标微调扩散策略；使用终端状态值替代策略依赖的状态-动作值以减少推理时间，并采用策略无关的TD目标减少训练时间。
Result: 在D4RL（MuJoCo、Kitchen）和RoboMimic任务上，MODIP改善了扩散策略性能，与扩散策略RL微调方法和TD-MPC2等强基线相比具有竞争力或更优。
Conclusion: MODIP为扩散策略提供了一种有效的离线到在线微调框架，融合了BC的简单性和RL的性能优势，但实验限于仿真环境。

papers.title: Encoding the Euler Characteristic Transform
papers.abstract_en: The Euler Characteristic Curve (ECC) records the Euler characteristic of a linearly embedded cell complex as a function of filtration height in a given direction, and the Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT) is the injective shape descriptor obtained by collecting ECCs over many directions. How the ECT is encoded for a neural network is itself an inductive bias, conventionally fixed by discretizing each ECC. We introduce a continuous encoding: for each direction and each vertex it records the net Euler-characteristic change attributed to that vertex, producing a per-direction token sequence that a small transformer maps to a feature vector. We separate the resulting pipeline into two stages on orthogonal axes: an ECC encoder that acts within each direction, mapping its curve to a fixed-length vector, and an ECT representation that acts across directions, aggregating the per-direction vectors into one. We study six ECT representation architectures spanning a range of inductive biases, from a structure-agnostic feedforward baseline to convolutional and complex-valued models that preserve equivariance under planar rotations. Across six classification benchmarks covering point clouds, graphs, cubical complexes, and meshes, the continuous encoding improves accuracy on five of six datasets, and control experiments attribute the gain to the tokenization itself rather than to the added transformer capacity. The representation architecture matters less than the encoding, and the payoff from its inductive biases depends on the encoding: a feedforward network performs best under continuous encoding but is less robust under discretization than convolutional architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对欧拉特征变换（Euler Characteristic Transform, ECT）的连续编码方法。传统ECT通过离散化每个方向的欧拉特征曲线（ECC）来编码形状，本文则记录每个方向下每个顶点的净欧拉特征变化，形成序列，并用小型Transformer映射为特征向量。该方法将流程分为两个正交阶段：ECC编码器（每个方向内将曲线映射为定长向量）和ECT表示器（跨方向聚合向量）。在点云、图、立方体复形和网格等六种分类基准上，连续编码在五个数据集上提升了准确率，控制实验表明增益来自tokenization本身而非Transformer容量增加。表示架构的影响小于编码方式。
Motivation: 传统ECT编码通过离散化ECC引入归纳偏置，可能限制表示能力。本文旨在设计一种连续编码，更灵活地捕捉形状特征。
Method: 对于每个方向和每个顶点，记录由该顶点贡献的净欧拉特征变化，生成每方向的token序列；使用小型Transformer处理序列得到方向特征向量；再通过跨方向聚合架构（如前馈、卷积、复值模型）得到全局形状描述符。研究了六种表示架构，从结构无关的前馈基线到保持平面旋转等变性的卷积和复值模型。
Result: 在六个分类基准（涵盖点云、图、立方体复形和网格）上，连续编码在五个数据集上优于传统离散化基线。控制实验表明性能提升主要来自tokenization本身，而非Transformer容量。在前馈网络下连续编码表现最佳，而离散化下卷积架构更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 连续编码改善了ECT的形状描述能力，且编码方式比跨方向聚合架构更重要。这表明ECT的归纳偏置应更多放在编码阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Earth-OneVision: Extending Remote Sensing Multimodal Large Language Models to More Sensor Modalities and Tasks
papers.abstract_en: RS-MLLMs enable natural-language understanding and spatial reasoning over earth observation imagery. However, existing models support only a narrow range of sensor types and tasks, yielding a fragmented view of the earth and leaving cross-modal geoscientific knowledge largely unexploited. This work presents Earth-OneVision, a 2B RS-MLLM that unifies six sensor modalities (i.e., optical, SAR, infrared, multispectral, temporal, and video) and cross-sensor fusion across 9 task categories within a single autoregressive framework. Three dedicated mechanisms address three bottlenecks. Full-Granularity Vision-Language Alignment (FGVLA) aligns multi-level visual features with the multi-dimensional language space. Spatial-Linguistic Isomorphic Serialization (SLIS) unifies heterogeneous spatial outputs as autoregressive tokens. Progressive Cross-Modality Adaptation (PCMA) decomposes the compound domain gap into sequential stages, tackling the viewpoint and imaging physics gaps in turn. To support joint training, MMRS-OneVision is constructed with ~34M QA pairs spanning all six sensor modalities and cross-sensor fusion across 9 task categories, substantially exceeding existing RS multimodal instruction datasets. With only 2B parameters, Earth-OneVision achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results across extensive benchmarks, consistently matching or outperforming 4B-72B RS-MLLMs. It achieves 87.52% P@0.5 on the OPT-RSVG testset for optical visual grounding and 80.68% on the SAR VQA benchmark SARLANG-Bench, exceeding 7B models by over 7%. It further achieves 75.74% recall on the BigEarthNet-MS testset for multispectral classification, and 81.94% MCQ accuracy on EarthMind-Bench for cross-modality reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Earth-OneVision，一个 2B 参数的多模态遥感大模型，统一了 6 种传感器模态（光学、SAR、红外、多光谱、时间序列和视频）和跨传感器融合，覆盖 9 个任务类别。通过三个机制（全粒度视觉语言对齐、空间-语言同构序列化和渐进跨模态适应）解决瓶颈，并在多个基准上达到与 4B-72B 模型相当或更优的效果。
Motivation: 现有遥感多模态大模型仅支持少数传感器类型和任务，导致对地球的碎片化理解，跨模态地学知识未被充分利用。
Method: 提出三个专用机制：全粒度视觉-语言对齐（FGVLA）对齐多级视觉特征与多维度语言空间；空间-语言同构序列化（SLIS）将异构空间输出统一为自回归 token；渐进跨模态适应（PCMA）逐步解决视角和成像物理差异。并构建了包含约 3400 万 QA 对的多模态遥感指令数据集 MMRS-OneVision。
Result: 在光学视觉定位 OPT-RSVG 测试集上达到 87.52% P@0.5；在 SAR VQA 基准 SARLANG-Bench 上达到 80.68%，超过 7B 模型 7% 以上；在多光谱分类 BigEarthNet-MS 测试集上达到 75.74% 召回率；在跨模态推理 EarthMind-Bench 上达到 81.94% MCQ 准确率。
Conclusion: Earth-OneVision 证明了小参数模型通过统一多种模态和任务可以在遥感领域取得与更大模型竞争的性能，但论文未探讨降水、预报等任务，且规模限制了对极端天气等动态现象的建模能力。

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IMPACT框架，将机器人力控交互任务解耦为任务规划和基于内模型的预测控制，在仿真和真实实验中实现了更高的成功率、对未见物体重量的良好泛化，并改善了安全性和能效。
Motivation: 现有学习方法处理力交互任务时，隐式方法泛化性差，显式方法需要专用硬件且增加系统复杂度。
Method: 提出IMPACT框架，将任务规划与基于内模型的预测控制（internal-model predictive control）相结合，实现力交互任务的解耦。
Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，该方法在成功率、对未见物体重量的泛化性、安全性和能效方面均优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该解耦框架能够有效提升机器人力控任务的性能，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: Deep learning for echo sounder data
papers.abstract_en: There is no doubt that over the last decade, techniques from the field of machine learning have revolutionized how we process and interpret data, especially images and text. For underwater observations acoustics is a primary source of information, and naturally, deep learning methods have been applied to echograms and other acoustics data, but so far with rather modest results. Here, we argue that due to intrinsic properties of acoustic data, substantial advances will likely require research into deep learning methods beyond mere recycling of models and techniques from image processing. Currently, the potential for breakthroughs in method development is hindered by the lack of standard data formats and organization, and even more by the lack of readily available, high quality data sets with established performance goals. To advance the field, these shortcomings should be remedied
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论深度学习在水下回声测深数据（echogram）中的应用现状与挑战，指出当前方法大多直接套用图像处理模型，效果有限，并呼吁建立标准数据格式和高质量数据集以推动研究进展。
Motivation: 水下声学数据具有固有特性，直接套用图像处理领域的深度学习模型效果不佳，且缺乏标准数据格式和高质量数据集，阻碍了方法突破。
Method: 未提出具体新方法，而是从数据特性角度分析现有深度学习应用局限，并呼吁社区解决数据标准化和数据集缺乏问题。
Result: 未报告具体实验结果，仅指出当前深度学习在回声测深数据上应用效果有限。

papers.title: Moonshine: An Autonomous Mathematical Research Agent Centered on Conjecture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Moonshine is an autonomous agent whose central objective is to generate mathematical conjectures. Its core capability is to extract structure from classical problems, distill new concepts, and formulate conjectures of mathematical significance. Rather than treating the solution of a single proposition as its endpoint, Moonshine builds an extensible theoretical framework through conjecture generation, bridge building, and obstacle identification. This article uses Moonshine's exploration of the Jacobian conjecture as an example. It shows how the central logic of whether local nondegeneracy can force global injectivity is transferred to one-hidden-layer affine-ridge sigmoid networks. This leads to the formulation of the \emph{Neural Jacobian Conjecture} (NJC): if such a network has strictly positive Jacobian determinant on the whole space, then it must be globally injective. By invoking GPT-5.5-pro and DeepSeek-V4-pro separately, Moonshine obtained independent complete proofs for the case \(N=n+1\). In addition, with the assistance of ChatGPT through interactive use of its web interface with GPT-5.5-pro, a geometric-topological proof was developed. These results provide preliminary evidence for the plausibility of the conjecture. The general higher-width case \(N\ge n+2\), however, remains unresolved and is left for further investigation. This work illustrates Moonshine's ability to autonomously generate meaningful mathematical problems and make rigorous progress on them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Moonshine是一个自主数学研究代理，核心能力是生成数学猜想并构建理论框架。本文以雅可比猜想为例，将其转化为神经网络形式并提出神经雅可比猜想，在N=n+1情况下通过GPT-5.5-pro和DeepSeek-V4-pro独立获得证明，但更一般情况未解决。展示了代理自主生成有意义的数学问题并取得进展的能力。
Motivation: 现有AI在数学领域多集中于求解单个命题，缺乏自动生成有意义的猜想并构建理论框架的能力。本文旨在开发能够自主提取经典问题结构、提炼新概念并提出数学猜想的代理。
Method: 提出Moonshine代理，通过将经典问题（如雅可比猜想）的结构转移至神经网络（单隐藏层仿射-ridge sigmoid网络），形成新猜想（神经雅可比猜想），并利用大语言模型（GPT-5.5-pro、DeepSeek-V4-pro）进行证明验证。

papers.title: Beyond APIs: Probing the Limits of MLLMs in Physical Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at utilizing digital APIs and increasingly serve as the "brain" of embodied AI, instructing robots to interact with the physical world. In such embodied settings, a central capability is the use of physical tools, which underpins MLLMs' ability to assist humans in real-world tasks. Despite the importance, MLLMs' proficiency in physical tool use remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PhysTool-Bench, the first physical tool-use benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs' ability to comprehend real-world scenarios, identify physical tools, and plan their use. PhysTool-Bench comprises 2,510 queries over 2,678 real-world physical tools spanning diverse domains, including manufacturing, electrical work, agriculture, and healthcare. Concretely, models are evaluated along two primary dimensions: 1) recognizing all physical tools present in the scene, and 2) planning the tool selection and use sequence based on the instruction and visual context. Across 13 leading MLLMs, even the strongest model (Gemini-3.1-Pro) identifies only 58.7% of tools in a scene and completes merely 21.0% of queries end-to-end. Our analysis reveals a two-level deficit: MLLMs struggle to perceive tools in realistic scenes, and the much larger drop at the planning stage further indicates a lack of functional commonsense for mapping perceived tools onto task semantics, pinpointing a critical bottleneck for the development of practical embodied AI.

TL;DR: 本文提出物理工具使用基准 PhysTool-Bench，包含 2,510 个查询和 2,678 个真实物理工具，评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在真实场景中识别工具和规划使用序列的能力。实验表明，最强模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 仅正确识别 58.7% 的工具，且仅完成 21.0% 的端到端查询，揭示了模型在感知和功能常识上的双重不足。
Motivation: MLLMs 在数字 API 上表现出色，但作为具身 AI 的‘大脑’时，其物理工具使用能力尚未被系统评估。现有基准缺失对真实场景中工具识别与使用规划的评估。
Method: 构建 PhysTool-Bench，包含 2,678 个覆盖制造、电气、农业、医疗等领域的真实工具，定义两个评估维度：场景中所有工具的识别，以及基于指令和视觉上下文的工具选择与使用序列规划。
Result: 在 13 个顶级 MLLMs 上，最强模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 工具识别率 58.7%，端到端查询完成率 21.0%；规划阶段的性能下降比感知阶段更显著，表明功能常识缺失是瓶颈。
Conclusion: MLLMs 在物理工具使用上存在严重缺陷，尤其是将感知工具映射到任务语义的规划能力，这为开发实用的具身 AI 指明了关键挑战。

papers.title: Boosting ECG Classification Performance by Pre-training with Synthesized Data
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) typically require extensive datasets for effective training. In the medical domain, acquiring large-scale data is often challenging due to privacy concerns and the rarity of certain diseases. To address this data scarcity, we investigate the efficacy of training DNN models using synthetic data, generated based on domain-specific medical knowledge. Specifically, we develop a knowledge-driven Gaussian-composition synthesis algorithm for single-lead II ECGs, in which each heartbeat is represented by Gaussian-shaped P, Q, R, S, and T wave components. Using this simulator, we generate synthetic data for four abnormal electrocardiogram (ECG) classes: atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial flutter (AFLT), premature ventricular complex (PVC), and Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome (WPW). We evaluate the utility of this synthetic data by conducting abnormal ECG classification using ten different DNN architectures. Our results demonstrate that synthetic-to-real training improves classification performance for three of the four target abnormalities, with the largest architecture-averaged gain of $33.2\%$ observed for AFLT. Further analysis reveals that the performance enhancement from synthetic data is more pronounced with smaller real-world datasets. These findings suggest that domain-knowledge-based synthetic ECGs can serve as a useful pre-training resource, particularly in scenarios where real-world data are limited or difficult to obtain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于医学知识的高斯合成算法，生成单导联II心电图（ECG）的合成数据，用于预训练深度神经网络，以缓解医学领域数据稀缺问题。实验表明，合成数据预训练能提升房扑等三种异常心电图的分类性能，尤其在真实数据较少时效果更显著。
Motivation: 医学领域获取大规模标注数据困难，隐私和罕见病等问题导致数据稀缺，限制深度神经网络性能。
Method: 开发知识驱动的高斯组分合成算法，将每个心拍表示为高斯形状的P、Q、R、S、T波分量，生成心房颤动、房扑、室性早搏、预激综合征四类异常心电图的合成数据，并用十种不同的深度神经网络架构进行异常分类。
Result: 合成数据预训练对三种异常分类性能有提升，房扑的架构平均增益最大（33.2%），且真实数据集越小时增益越明显。
Conclusion: 基于领域知识的合成心电图可作为有效的预训练资源，特别适用于真实数据有限或难以获取的场景。

papers.title: Evaluating Research-Level Math Proofs via Strict Step-Level Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to rigorously verify complex mathematical proofs. Standard global evaluation approaches suffer from "context poisoning," in which superficially plausible statements mask subtle logical flaws, leading to hallucination or over-skepticism. To address this, we shift from global evaluation to strict step-level verification: our framework maintains detailed context for each deduction step and strictly constrains the sources of applied theorems. We evaluate on a carefully curated adversarial diagnostic suite of research-level proofs drawn from the FirstProof challenge. A systematic ablation study demonstrates that these deductive constraints are indispensable, as unconstrained global prompting consistently fails to localize subtle logical errors. Beyond outperforming global evaluation, our approach fundamentally alters the failure taxonomy. Error analysis reveals that, rather than exhibiting severe logical hallucinations, remaining rejections are primarily instances of "pedantic hyper-rigor" stemming from unstated domain conventions, effectively exposing implicit ambiguities within the expert benchmark itself. Our findings suggest that prompting agents to organize their verification notes in a cautious, human-mathematician-like manner can substantially improve their ability to distinguish rigorous proofs from flawed ones, with the potential to strengthen agentic reasoning on frontier mathematical concepts that the base model does not already know well, and to lay a theoretical foundation for future automated proof-review systems. Code and prompts are available at GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出严格步骤级验证框架，将全局评估分解为对每个推理步骤的独立验证，以解决LLM在复杂数学证明验证中的'上下文中毒'问题。在FirstProof挑战构建的对抗性诊断套件上，消融实验表明全局提示无法定位细微逻辑错误，而该方法不仅表现更优，还改变了失败模式——剩余拒绝主要源于'迂腐的过度严格'，暴露出专家基准本身的隐含歧义。
Motivation: 现有LLM全局评估方法在处理研究级数学证明时容易受到'上下文中毒'影响，即表面合理的陈述掩盖了微妙的逻辑缺陷，导致模型要么产生幻觉要么过度怀疑。
Method: 构建一个框架，为每个推理步骤维护详细上下文，并严格约束所应用定理的来源（即只允许从已知前提或先前步骤推导），通过逐步验证取代一次性全局判断。
Result: 在精心构建的对抗性诊断套件上，全局无约束提示始终无法定位细微逻辑错误，而逐步验证方法成功区分正确证明和有缺陷证明；失败案例主要转变为'迂腐的过度严格'，即因未声明的领域约定而拒绝正确步骤。
Conclusion: 以谨慎、类人数学家方式组织验证笔记可以显著提升LLM区分严谨证明与错误证明的能力，尤其能泛化到模型不太熟悉的前沿数学概念，为未来自动化审稿系统奠定理论基础。

papers.title: CITRAS-FM: Tiny Time Series Foundation Model for Covariate-Informed Zero-Shot Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) have enabled zero-shot forecasting on unseen target series. However, existing TSFMs often incur high computational cost and provide limited support for diverse variable types, often failing to account for covariates that exogenously influence target variability. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS-FM, a tiny 7M-parameter TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting with real-time CPU inference. Built on a patch-based, decoder-only Transformer, CITRAS-FM introduces Shifted Attention into the cross-variate module to effectively exploit known covariates accessible throughout the forecast horizon. Moreover, to enable covariate-aware pretraining despite the scarcity of covariate-rich corpora, we propose CovSynth, which synthesizes realistic covariates from decomposed components of target series. Experiments on fev-bench, spanning 100 tasks across various settings, demonstrate that CITRAS-FM achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among sub-10M TSFMs while delivering sub-0.1-second CPU inference, offering a strong balance between forecasting accuracy and real-time deployability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CITRAS-FM 是一个仅 7M 参数的小型时间序列基础模型，支持单变量、多变量和协变量感知的零样本预测，可在 CPU 上实现亚 0.1 秒实时推断。模型采用基于分块的解码器 Transformer，并通过 Shifted Attention 利用预测期间已知的协变量。为解决协变量数据稀缺问题，提出 CovSynth 方法从目标序列分解成分中合成真实协变量。在 fev-bench 的 100 个任务上，CITRAS-FM 在 10M 以下参数模型中达到最先进的零样本准确率。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型计算成本高，对多样化变量类型支持有限，且未能充分利用影响目标变量的外生协变量。
Method: 提出 CITRAS-FM，一个基于分块解码器 Transformer 的 7M 参数模型，在跨变量模块中引入 Shifted Attention 以有效利用预测期间已知的协变量；并设计 CovSynth 方法，从目标序列的分解成分中合成真实协变量用于预训练。
Result: 在 fev-bench 的 100 个任务上，CITRAS-FM 在子 10M 参数模型中取得最先进的零样本预测精度，且 CPU 推断时间小于 0.1 秒。
Conclusion: CITRAS-FM 在预测精度和实时部署能力之间取得了良好平衡，适合资源受限场景。

papers.title: Dep-LLM: Training-Free Depression Diagnosis via Evidence-Guided Structured Multi-factor with Reliable LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Depression Detection (ADD) from clinical interviews is a pivotal task in computational mental health, yet it remains challenging due to two critical obstacles: 1) difficulty in modeling complex but sparsely distributed depression clues within lengthy, multi-topic clinical interviews, leading to superficial and unreliable reasoning; 2) scarcity of labeled data due to clinical privacy, together with high cost of training and fine-tuning, limiting the deployment of supervised ADD systems. To jointly address these challenges, we propose Dep-LLM, a training-free framework that mirrors the step-by-step reasoning of clinical psychiatrists and operates entirely on frozen off-the-shelf foundation LLMs. Dep-LLM comprises three stages. First, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Depression Multi-factor Analysis module structurally decomposes the long dialogue into five clinically aligned themes and produces evidence-grounded rationales, effectively handling long-context dependencies. Second, we introduce Confidence Analysis and Modulation module that quantifies the epistemic reliability from token-level entropy of each rationale and applies an intra-label and inter-theme modulation that amplifies trustworthy signals while suppressing uncertain ones without extra training. Third, a Collaborative Multi-factor Prediction module dynamically integrates multi-factor signals weighted by confidence into the final diagnosis. Extensive experiments on the DAIC-WOZ and E-DAIC datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of Dep-LLM: it surpasses zero-shot baseline on nearly all 21 foundation LLMs across 9 metrics such as accuracy, macro F1 and weighted-average F1, and further outperforms state-of-the-art supervised domain-specific LLMs as well as the latest closed-source commercial LLMs, while requiring no extra training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Dep-LLM，一种无需训练的抑郁症自动检测框架，利用冻结的大型语言模型，通过结构化的多因素分析和置信度调节，在DAIC-WOZ和E-DAIC数据集上超越零样本基线及有监督模型。
Motivation: 现有抑郁症检测方法难以从长临床访谈中提取稀疏的抑郁线索，且标注数据稀缺，限制了监督方法的部署。
Method: Dep-LLM包含三个阶段：1) 链式思考抑郁多因素分析模块，将长对话分解为五个临床主题并生成基于证据的推理；2) 置信度分析与调节模块，通过令牌级熵量化可靠性，并应用内标签和跨主题调节；3) 协作多因素预测模块，按置信度加权整合信号得出最终诊断。
Result: 在21个基础LLM上，Dep-LLM在准确率、宏F1和加权平均F1等9个指标上超越零样本基线，并超过有监督领域特定LLM和最新闭源商业LLM。
Conclusion: Dep-LLM无需训练即可有效进行抑郁症检测，展示了冻结LLM在临床诊断中的潜力。

papers.title: A Multimodal RGB and Events Dataset for Hand Detection in First-Person View
authors: Yulia Sandamirskaya (1) ((1) Zurich University of Applied Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Existing hand detection algorithms work on images and the detection rate is restricted by the frame rate of the camera. In hand detection applications for moving robotic systems, conventional cameras cause motion blur, especially in darker lighting conditions. We can leverage the use of event-based cameras which possess a high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low power consumption. Recent work has shown that using a stereo setup of an event-based and a frame-based camera improves detection accuracy and the bandwidth-latency tradeoff. The main bottleneck in using event-based cameras in object detection and recognition tasks is a relatively low amount of training data. In this work, we propose a methodology and an exemplary synthetic event-based hand dataset from an egocentric, first-person view perspective. The data is synthesized from the existing RGB Egohands dataset with the v2e toolbox. Parameters of the v2e toolbox are varied to provide versions of the dataset with different lighting conditions and scales. Ground truth detections are generated with a fine-tuned YOLOv8 model which is applied to the RGB images in the Egohands dataset and interpolated on the high-temporal resolution events. We use the multi-modal dataset to perform hand detection with existing object detection algorithms which use a multi-modal setup of event and RGB cameras and demonstrate performance comparable to the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态RGB与事件数据的手部检测数据集，基于Egohands数据集使用v2e工具合成事件数据，并利用YOLOv8生成真值。实验表明，该数据集支持的事件+RGB多模态方法在检测性能上与现有最优方法相当。
Motivation: 事件相机具有高动态范围、高时间分辨率和低功耗，但缺乏训练数据。现有手部检测在运动模糊和低光照下受限，需要多模态数据集来提升检测性能。
Method: 使用v2e工具从Egohands RGB数据集合成事件数据，通过调整参数生成不同光照和尺度的版本，并用微调后的YOLOv8在RGB图像上检测并插值到高时间分辨率事件上得到真值。
Result: 摘要称该多模态数据集用于事件+RGB相机的手部检测，性能与当前最优方法相当。
Conclusion: 该数据集填补了事件相机手部检测训练数据的空白，为多模态检测提供了基准。

papers.title: Closing the Modality Gap in Zero-Shot HAR: Contrastive Training and Separability-Optimized Prototypes on IMU Data
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) for inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based human activity recognition (HAR) faces a central challenge: bridging the gap between sensor embeddings and semantic class representations. We systematically evaluate seven configurations combining three inference methods with two training pipelines on the PAMAP2 dataset, using 14 seen and 4 unseen activity classes with subjects 108 and 109 held out for testing. We find that the modality gap is a training-time phenomenon governed by the encoder objective. A temporal convolutional network (TCN) trained with cross-entropy over label-name Sentence- BERT prototypes yields sensor embeddings with a mean cosine similarity of 0.30 to the corresponding text prototypes, while replacing the label-name prototype targets with discriminative activity descriptions raises this to 0.69. This alignment improvement transfers consistently across all three inference methods. The strongest result combines contrastive training with inverted softmax correction, achieving 73.2% accuracy and 0.583 macro F1 on unseen classes, compared to 58.3% accuracy and 0.34 macro F1 for the label-name baseline. A secondary finding is that richer text descriptions reduce inter-prototype separability in Sentence-BERT space, because shared biomechanical vocabulary causes the language model to compress the prototype cloud. This effect does not negate the benefits of contrastive alignment provided prototype descriptions retain sufficient discriminative vocabulary. We also demonstrate that overall accuracy is a misleading primary metric when test-set class distributions are imbalanced, and recommend macro-averaged F1 as the standard reporting metric for ZSL-HAR benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了在IMU人体活动识别（HAR）中，通过对比训练和可分离性优化原型来缩小零样本学习（ZSL）中传感器嵌入与语义表示之间的模态间隙。在PAMAP2数据集上，使用14个可见类和4个不可见类，结合三种推理方法和两种训练流程，发现模态间隙是训练时间现象，由编码器目标决定。使用判别性活动描述替换标签名原型，将传感器嵌入与文本原型的余弦相似度从0.30提升至0.69。最佳结果结合对比训练和反向softmax校正，在不可见类上达到73.2%准确率和0.583宏F1，而基线为58.3%和0.34。还发现丰富文本描述会降低原型间可分离性，但对比对齐仍有效，并建议在类别不平衡时使用宏F1替代准确率作为主要指标。
Motivation: 零样本学习在基于IMU的人体活动识别中面临传感器嵌入与语义表示之间的模态间隙问题，现有方法未能系统评估训练和推理策略的影响。
Method: 系统评估七种配置，结合三种推理方法（如反向softmax校正）和两种训练流程（使用Sentence-BERT原型的交叉熵与对比训练），在PAMAP2数据集上比较标签名与判别性活动描述作为原型。
Result: 使用判别性活动描述将传感器-文本相似度从0.30提升至0.69；对比训练加反向softmax校正达到73.2%准确率和0.583宏F1，优于基线58.3%和0.34。
Conclusion: 模态间隙是训练时间现象，可通过对齐训练缩小；丰富文本描述虽降低原型可分离性但不影响对比对齐收益；推荐使用宏F1而非准确率作为ZSL-HAR不平衡数据的主要指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerating NeurASP with vectorization and caching
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic AI combines neural networks with symbolic programs to create robust and explainable predictions. One such framework is NeurASP, which trains a neural network to predict concepts and reasons over them using rules written in answer set programming (ASP) to solve downstream tasks. Crucially, labels are only provided for the downstream prediction produced by the symbolic rules, not for the latent concepts themselves.Backpropagation through the non-differentiable ASP component requires expensive probability and gradient calculations, which has hindered scalability to more sophisticated tasks.In this paper, we address the current limitations of NeurASP by improving its computational performance through vectorization, batch processing and caching of intermediate computations during training. We compare computation speeds between the original and our new implementation of NeurASP and report speedups of multiple orders of magnitude for larger tasks. To this end, we propose a new dataset of difficult tasks involving playing cards, which we use to test the capabilities of NeurASP's enhanced learning function.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, to be published in the Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP) journal for the 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming (ICLP) issue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经符号框架NeurASP中ASP组件不可微导致的反向传播效率低下的问题，提出通过向量化、批处理和缓存中间计算来加速训练。实验报告在较大规模任务上实现了多个数量级的加速，并引入了一个涉及扑克牌的困难任务新数据集。
Motivation: NeurASP框架中非可微分的ASP组件导致概率和梯度计算昂贵，限制了其扩展到更复杂任务的能力。
Method: 在训练过程中采用向量化、批处理以及缓存中间计算结果的方法来加速计算。
Result: 相比原始实现，新实现在较大任务上取得了多个数量级的速度提升。
Conclusion: 通过向量化和缓存策略可以显著提升NeurASP的计算效率，有助于其应用于更具挑战性的神经符号任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Bayesian Network Approach for Enhancing Security-Focused Decision Support Systems
papers.abstract_en: The adoption and integration of heterogeneous stacks in most of today's open-source based networks brings clear benefits like interoperability and availability of advanced features. Yet, on the other hand the increasing number of interconnecting components and moving parts requires maintaining an ever increasing base of interdisciplinary knowledge of different tools in different domains to ensure proper operation. To alleviate such efforts, this work proposes a Decision Support System (DSS) to guide infrastructure operators through the selection of security approaches (e.g. tools) to adopt in their environments. This framework easily captures the end-user high-level requirements on the security triad for different domains and runs inference on the designated models to provide the identified tools (security mechanisms) that better serve such needs. The presented DSS aims at delivering an understandable and extensible framework to accommodate varying requirements and Bayesian Network (BN) models. The architecture and modelling of the system are proposed, aligned with its theoretical framework. Its performance is evaluated in terms of time and prediction accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 2025 IEEE 50th Conference on Local Computer Networks (LCN), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于贝叶斯网络的决策支持系统（DSS），帮助基础设施运营商根据安全需求选择合适的安全工具。系统通过捕获用户对安全三元组（机密性、完整性、可用性）的高层需求，在贝叶斯网络模型上推理，输出推荐的安全机制。实验评估了系统的运行时间和预测准确性。
Motivation: 当前开源网络采用异构技术栈，组件间互联日益复杂，运维人员需要跨领域知识来维护系统安全，增加了人工负担。现有方法缺乏自动化决策支持。
Method: 构建一个决策支持系统框架，采用贝叶斯网络（BN）模型。用户输入安全需求，系统通过BN推理，输出匹配的安全工具（机制）列表。框架强调可理解性和可扩展性。
Result: 摘要报告了系统在时间和预测精度上的性能评估，但未给出具体数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: 系统旨在提供易理解、可扩展的框架，支持不同场景的安全决策需求，未来可适配更多BN模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Secure Aggregation with Top-K Sparsification in Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Secure aggregation is a vital component for mitigating gradient leakage in federated learning, but its communication cost conventionally scales with the gradient dimension. This becomes prohibitive for large models and even more pronounced in decentralized federated learning with limited bandwidth and unreliable nodes. Top-K gradient sparsification is an effective approach to reduce communication by transmitting only a few entries of the full gradient, while maintaining competitive model accuracy. Nevertheless, the top-K entries selected by each user are unpredictable and vary across users, which poses a challenge for efficient sparse secure aggregation. This paper studies information-theoretic secure aggregation with top-K sparsification in decentralized federated learning under user dropouts and user collusion. We propose a communication-efficient sparse secure aggregation scheme that offloads dimension-dependent overhead to an offline phase and protects private gradients using random masks and permutations. Experimental results demonstrate that our scheme preserves accuracy comparable to full-gradient aggregation even with only 1% gradient sparsification, while substantially reducing the communication cost.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, accepted to IEEE ISIT 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化联邦学习中的安全聚合与Top-K梯度稀疏化结合问题，提出一种通信高效的稀疏安全聚合方案。该方案将维度相关的通信开销转移到离线阶段，利用随机掩码和排列保护私有梯度，在有用户掉线和合谋的场景下实现信息论安全。实验表明，即使仅保留1%的梯度，精度仍可与全梯度聚合相当，同时通信成本大幅降低。
Motivation: 现有安全聚合的通信开销随梯度维度线性增长，在大型模型和去中心化联邦学习中带宽受限、节点不可靠，问题更为严重。Top-K稀疏化虽可降低通信，但各用户选择的Top-K条目不可预测且不同用户间存在差异，导致稀疏安全聚合难以高效实现。
Method: 提出一种通信高效的稀疏安全聚合方案，将维度依赖的开销转移到离线阶段，并在在线阶段使用随机掩码和排列保护私有梯度，同时支持用户掉线和合谋场景下的信息论安全。
Result: 实验表明，即使仅保留1%的梯度稀疏率，该方案的模型精度仍可媲美全梯度聚合，同时显著降低了通信成本。
Conclusion: 本文提出的方案有效解决了去中心化联邦学习中Top-K稀疏化与安全聚合的兼容性问题，在保持精度的前提下大幅降低通信开销。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有安全聚合的通信开销随梯度维度线性增长，在大型模型和去中心化联邦学习中带宽受限、节点不可靠，问题更为严重。Top-K稀疏化虽可降低通信，但各用户选择的Top-K条目不可预测且不同用户间存在差异，导致稀疏安全聚合难以高效实现。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种通信高效的稀疏安全聚合方案，将维度依赖的开销转移到离线阶段，并在在线阶段使用随机掩码和排列保护私有梯度，同时支持用户掉线和合谋场景下的信息论安全。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，即使仅保留1%的梯度稀疏率，该方案的模型精度仍可媲美全梯度聚合，同时显著降低了通信成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提出的方案有效解决了去中心化联邦学习中Top-K稀疏化与安全聚合的兼容性问题，在保持精度的前提下大幅降低通信开销。

papers.title: From Patches to Patients: A study of the tile-to-slide performance transferability in Digital Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Foundation Models (FMs) have recently redefined the state-of-the-art in histopathology by providing robust representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis. However, selecting the optimal foundation model (FM) for a specific clinical cohort currently requires multiple preprocessing steps, followed by computationally expensive feature extraction and the training of a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) aggregator for every model. In this work, we investigate whether efficient tile-level linear probing can serve as a reliable proxy for slide-level performance, reducing the need to run full slide-level pipelines for every candidate encoder. We benchmark 19 state-of-the-art FMs on 42 slide-level and 16 tile-level tasks, comparing tile probing metrics against slide-level outcomes using ABMIL and Mean Pooling aggregations. We observe a high correlation between tile and slide performance across varying task difficulties, indicating that encoder representation quality is the primary determinant of WSI success. Sensitivity analyses show that transferability is stable across models and is more influenced by cohort sizes and numbers of tiles per slide than by average task difficulty. We also measure the agreement in best performing models between tile and slide-level tasks, showing tile benchmarks reliably shortlist strong candidates. Overall, our study indicates that tile-level benchmarking provides an efficient and practical first step for narrowing down candidate models, while slide-level evaluation remains essential for final validation on clinical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在数字病理学中，是否可以通过高效的 tile 级线性探测（linear probing）来替代完整的 slide 级多实例学习（MIL）流程，以快速筛选候选基础模型（FM）。作者在 19 个 FM 上，对 42 个 slide 级和 16 个 tile 级任务进行基准测试，发现 tile 级与 slide 级性能之间存在高度相关性，表明编码器表示质量是 WSI 分析成功的主要决定因素。
Motivation: 现有方法在临床队列中筛选最优基础模型需要完整的 slide 级预处理、特征提取和 MIL 聚合器训练，计算成本高昂。作者希望探究 tile 级线性探测能否作为 slide 级性能的可靠代理，从而降低模型选择开销。
Method: 对 19 个 SOTA 基础模型进行系统基准测试，对比 tile 级线性探测指标与 slide 级（ABMIL 和 Mean Pooling）结果，分析相关性、跨模型稳定性、以及队列大小、每张 slide 的 tile 数等因素的影响。
Result: 摘要报告 tile 级与 slide 级性能高度相关；性能迁移性受队列规模和每张 slide 的 tile 数影响比平均任务难度更大；tile 级基准可可靠地筛选出候选模型。
Conclusion: tile 级基准测试可作为模型筛选的高效第一步，但最终的临床验证仍需 slide 级评估。

papers.title: Can we trust our models? Epistemic calibration in second-order classification
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimation is critical for deploying machine learning models in high-stakes settings. However, classical calibration only assesses the reliability of predicted probabilities and does not evaluate whether epistemic uncertainty estimates are themselves trustworthy. This limitation is particularly relevant for second-order classification models. We introduce epistemic calibration, a principled criterion that measures whether reported epistemic uncertainty faithfully reflects the dispersion of model predictions around the ground truth. We show that epistemic calibration is a strictly stronger notion than classical calibration and captures failure modes invisible to standard metrics. We relate this work to the existing literature through an impossibility theorem that holds under the epistemic calibration hypothesis. To operationalize this concept, we propose the Expected Epistemic Calibration Error (EECE), which we prove to be a consistent estimator of a True Epistemic Calibration Error (TECE). Experiments across a broad range of uncertainty quantification methods show that epistemic calibration is a coherent and meaningful criterion and reveal substantial differences across methods, despite similar predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认知校准（epistemic calibration）概念，用于评估二阶分类模型中认知不确定性估计的可信度。相比经典校准，认知校准是更强的条件，能捕获标准指标遗漏的失效模式。作者引入期望认知校准误差（EECE）作为TECE的一致估计量，实验表明不同不确定性量化方法在该准则下存在显著差异。
Motivation: 经典校准只衡量预测概率的可靠性，无法评估认知不确定性估计本身是否可信。这一缺陷在二阶分类模型（如贝叶斯神经网络）中尤为突出，可能导致高风险场景下的错误信任。
Method: 定义认知校准准则，要求模型报告的不确定性分布与真实预测分布一致。提出EECE指标，并证明其为TECE的一致估计量。
Result: 理论上证明认知校准严格强于经典校准；实验中多种不确定性方法在EECE上表现迥异，尽管预测性能相似。
Conclusion: 认知校准为不确定性评估提供了更严格的标准，揭示了现有方法在认知不确定性可靠性上的不足。

papers.title: Inverse Probability Weighting and Age-of-Information Aggregation for Decentralized Federated Learning under Partial Reception
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) over lossy wireless networks faces two key challenges: selection bias, where updates from poor-quality links are systematically underrepresented due to partial model reception, and update staleness, where asynchronous nodes contribute outdated information. We show that uniform gossip aggregation with local-fill reconstruction introduces persistent link-quality-induced bias, while completeness-based weighting further amplifies this effect. To address these challenges, we propose DFL-AA (Decentralized Federated Learning with Adaptive AoI-weighted Aggregation), which combines Inverse Probability Weighting with online EWMA-based channel estimation to correct selection bias and Age-of-Information-based weighting to mitigate staleness without requiring global synchronization. We theoretically show that DFL-AA removes link-quality distortion in expectation and experimentally demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across varying loss rates, network sizes, and heterogeneous wireless conditions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对去中心化联邦学习（DFL）在丢包无线网络中的选择偏差和更新过时问题，提出DFL-AA方法，结合逆概率加权和基于信息年龄（AoI）的聚合，以纠正链路质量偏差并缓解陈旧性。理论证明该方法能在期望上消除链路质量失真，实验表明在不同丢包率、网络规模和异构无线条件下均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习在无线网络中面临部分接收导致的选择偏差（低质量链路更新被系统性地低估）以及异步节点更新过时的问题，现有均匀聚合和基于完整性的加权会放大这些偏差。
Method: 提出DFL-AA框架，利用逆概率加权（IPW）结合在线EWMA信道估计纠正选择偏差，并采用信息年龄（AoI）加权来降低陈旧更新的影响，无需全局同步。
Result: 实验证明该方法在各种丢包率、网络规模和异构无线条件下，一致优于当前最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法在理论上能消除链路质量引起的期望偏差，适用于实际无线网络中的去中心化联邦学习。

papers.title: On-sky demonstration of reinforcement learning for adaptive optics control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based algorithms have recently emerged as a promising approach for adaptive optics (AO) control. In simulations and laboratory experiments, they have demonstrated robustness to real-world effects such as photon and detector noise, misregistration, vibrations, and rapid variations in seeing conditions. However, their performance has not yet been validated on sky. We report the first on-sky demonstration of a reinforcement learning controller for adaptive optics, named Policy Optimization for AO (PO4AO). We further analyze its on-sky behavior and identify directions for improving the algorithm and its implementation.PO4AO was implemented and deployed on the Papyrus adaptive optics system installed at the Coudé focus of the 1.52 m telescope (T152) at the OHP. A Python-based implementation was interfaced with the existing real-time controller (DAO RTC) via shared-memory buffers. The performance of PO4AO was compared to that of a standard integrator controller over several nights, covering a range of flux levels and atmospheric conditions. PO4AO consistently outperformed the standard integrator in all tested configurations. The controller successfully learned and compensated for vibration patterns and demonstrated strong robustness to measurement noise. Once tuned for Papyrus, PO4AO operated in a turnkey fashion, using a single set of hyperparameters across varying observing conditions and science targets. These performance gains were achieved despite a non-optimized Python implementation introducing approximately $750\,μ\text{s}$ of additional latency, along with control jitter and occasional frame drops. When properly implemented and optimized, PO4AO constitutes a robust and high-performance turnkey controller for single-conjugate adaptive optics systems, paving the way for broader adoption of reinforcement learning strategies in on-sky AO operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在真实天空条件下演示了基于强化学习的自适应光学控制器PO4AO，并在1.52米望远镜的Papyrus系统上验证其性能。与标准积分控制器相比，PO4AO在所有测试条件下均表现更优，成功学习并补偿振动模式，对测量噪声具有强鲁棒性，且在不同观测条件下使用单一超参数即可运行。尽管当前的Python实现引入了约750微秒的额外延迟，但该工作为强化学习在自适应光学中的实际应用铺平了道路。
Motivation: 强化学习在自适应光学控制仿真和实验中表现优异，但尚未在真实天空条件下进行验证，其实际性能未知。
Method: 在Papyrus自适应光学系统上部署基于强化学习的PO4AO控制器，通过共享内存缓冲区与现有实时控制器接口，并与标准积分控制器进行对比实验。
Result: PO4AO在所有测试条件下（不同通量和大气条件）持续优于标准积分控制器，成功学习振动模式并展示了对测量噪声的强鲁棒性，且作为即用型控制器运行。
Conclusion: 当实现和优化得当，PO4AO可成为单共轭自适应光学系统的鲁棒高性能即用型控制器，促进强化学习在自适应光学领域的广泛应用。

papers.title: Correcting Variable Importance Scored by Random Forests
papers.abstract_en: Variable importance produced by Random Forests (RF) is used widely in statistical data analysis, and has played an important role in a variety of tasks such as assisting model interpretation, model selection and diagnosis, and cost-bounded learning etc. However, the calculation of variable importance in RF does not take into account of the correlations among variables, and variables that are correlated to many other variables tend to receive a lower importance index or being completely masked (i.e., with an importance index near zero) by other strongly correlated variables. To prevent influence from unwanted correlated variables in calculating variable importance, we propose to group variables by their conditional correlations (conditional on the response variable). We explore two computationally efficient options, with one grouping variables individually, and then separates the variable of interest from all correlated variables, while the other uses clustering to group variables according to their pair-wise conditional correlations. Our experiments show that both lead to sensible corrections to the importance of variables.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 通过考虑条件相关性，可以改善随机森林变量重要性的计算。

papers.title: ZODS-RS -- Zero-training Oriented Detection & Segmentation for Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing and UAV applications need models that generalize across platforms and viewpoints without task-specific training. Yet training-free pipelines often falter on oriented geometry, scale/rotation variation, and crowded ports or airfields, and rarely unify detection and segmentation. We introduce ZODS-RS, a training-free, closed-form pipeline that outputs horizontal boxes (HBB) and instance masks. Built on DINOv3 dense features and SAM-style proposals, ZODS-RS chains: PP (prototype purification via Tyler covariance), R-SEM (rotation-scale equivariant matching with separable kernels and global Hungarian assignment), and UAM (uncertainty-aware pixelwise merging with adaptive priors and optional negative prototypes). A lightweight CWLA fuses multiple DINOv3 layers. On FAIR1M (HBB) we obtain $\mathrm{mAP}_{0.50:0.95}=\mathbf{13.06}$ and $\mathrm{AP}_S=\mathbf{2.93}$ \emph{(class-averaged over ship/airplane)}; on xView (HBB) we report $\mathrm{mAP}=\mathbf{16.69}$. On our UAV dataset, ZODS-RS achieves mask $\mathrm{mIoU}=\mathbf{31.10}$ and improves small-object AP by $\mathbf{+30.70}$ over Grounded-SAM on a single 5090. This work offers a unified, \emph{no-training} solution for horizontal-box detection plus instance segmentation in aerial imagery; provides explicit closed-form formulations for PP/R-SEM/UAM tightly coupled with DINOv3; and demonstrates \emph{consistent} gains on small and crowded targets and under cross-domain shifts while keeping deployment simple.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ZODS-RS，一种无需训练即可输出水平框和实例掩膜的闭环管道，用于遥感图像。该方法基于DINOv3密集特征和SAM提案，包含原型纯化、旋转-尺度等变匹配和不确定性感知像素合并等模块，在FAIR1M、xView和UAV数据集上取得具有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 现有无训练方法在遥感中难以处理旋转/尺度变化、拥挤场景，并且很少统一检测与分割任务。
