papers.title: N-GRPO: Embedding-Level Neighbor Mixing for Enhanced Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The success of Large Language Models in mathematical reasoning relies heavily on the generation of diverse and valid solution paths during the rollout phase. However, current rollout techniques face a fundamental trade-off: token-level sampling often yields redundant trajectories that differ only in rephrasing, while embedding-level methods utilizing random noise frequently disrupt semantic consistency. To resolve this, we introduce N-GRPO, a novel exploration strategy integrated into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework. Rather than relying on token-level sampling or native embedding-level noise, our approach leverages Semantic Neighbor Mixing. This mechanism dynamically constructs input representations by mixing the embeddings of an anchor token and its nearest semantic neighbors, thereby injecting diversity while strictly adhering to the local semantic manifold. Experimental evaluations on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models across different sizes show that N-GRPO not only achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on math reasoning benchmarks but also exhibits robust generalization capabilities on out-of-distribution tasks.
papers.comment: ACL 2026 Findings. 16 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/ZJUSCL/N-GRPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出N-GRPO，一种在GRPO框架中通过嵌入级邻居混合（Semantic Neighbor Mixing）增强探索的策略，旨在解决数学推理中rollout阶段多样性不足和语义不一致的问题。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen模型上的实验显示，该方法在数学推理基准上持续改进，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 当前rollout技术面临根本性权衡：token级采样产生冗余轨迹，而嵌入级随机噪声破坏语义一致性。需要一种既能注入多样性又保持语义一致性的方法。
Method: 提出Semantic Neighbor Mixing机制，通过混合锚点token及其最近语义邻居的嵌入来动态构造输入表示，在局部语义流形内注入多样性，并集成到GRPO框架中。
Result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen不同规模模型上，N-GRPO在数学推理基准上一致优于强基线，并在分布外任务上展现出鲁棒的泛化能力。
Conclusion: N-GRPO通过语义邻居混合有效提升了策略探索的质量，为基于GRPO的强化学习方法提供了可行的改进路径。

papers.title: DD-INR: Dynamics-Driven Implicit Neural Representation for Accelerated Whole-Brain Functional MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Accelerated acquisition of fMRI enables enhanced detection of neurovascular (BOLD) activity in the brain, but image reconstruction becomes challenging with high k-space undersampling: Task-evoked BOLD signals are small in magnitude, which traditional anatomical MRI reconstruction methods fail to recover, as they favor spatial accuracy over temporal fidelity. We present DD-INR, a Dynamics-Driven Implicit Neural Representation framework tailored for accelerated fMRI that benefits from incoherent time-varying sampling and a tailored spatiotemporal prior, outperforming traditional methods, demonstrated in simulation and in-vivo acquisition, both in terms of image quality and retrieval of activation patterns. DD-INR achieves this by splitting the fMRI data into a static background and a temporally varying dynamic component, representing only the dynamics with a dedicated INR, thereby focusing the model's capacity on activation-relevant changes while remaining compact. In general, DD-INR provides a promising framework for accelerated fMRI reconstruction, with the potential to improve the sensitivity and robustness of fMRI studies within practical scan time limits. The source code is available at https://github.com/JoosenLi/DD-INR.
papers.journal_ref: MICCAI 2026 - 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention, Sep 2026, Strasbourg, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DD-INR，一种动力学驱动的隐式神经表示框架，用于加速全脑功能MRI重建。通过将fMRI数据分解为静态背景和时变动态分量，仅对动态部分使用专用隐式神经表示（INR），在模拟和体内实验中均优于传统方法，提升了图像质量和激活模式检索能力。
Motivation: 加速fMRI采集能增强脑部神经血管（BOLD）活动检测，但高k空间欠采样导致重建困难，传统解剖MRI方法只注重空间精度而忽略时间保真度，难以恢复任务诱发的小幅度BOLD信号。
Method: DD-INR框架利用非相干时变采样和定制的时空先验，将fMRI数据分解为静态背景和时变动态分量，仅用专用INR表示动态部分，从而聚焦模型容量于激活相关变化。
Result: 在模拟和体内实验中，DD-INR在图像质量和激活模式检索方面均优于传统方法。
Conclusion: DD-INR为加速fMRI重建提供了一个有前景的框架，有望在实际扫描时间内提高fMRI研究的灵敏度和鲁棒性。

papers.title: AutoPDE: Reliable Agentic PDE Solving via Explicitly Represented Solver Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) are core computational tools in science and engineering. Building reliable PDE solvers requires not only executable code, but a numerical solver strategy, a set of decisions about discretization, stabilization, solver configuration, and resolution control, that matches the PDE structure. Recent LLM-based coding agents have begun to reduce the programming burden by generating and debugging solver implementations. However, they typically move directly from a PDE problem to solver code, leaving the solver strategy implicit in implementation details. Feedback from a failed solve is therefore routed back to code edits rather than to the underlying strategy, so numerical decisions remain hard to check before code is generated and hard to revise using numerical evidence when it fails. To address this limitation, we propose AutoPDE, a code agent that maintains the solver strategy as an explicitly represented object throughout the solving process: an independent, inspectable object that is built before any code is written and can be revised, using numerical evidence, whenever a solve fails. AutoPDE builds and maintains this object in three stages, all drawing from a library of reusable PDE-solving skills: PDE analysis identifies the equation type and algebraic structure; numerical method selection chooses a numerical method that matches the analysis result and commits to a discretization, stabilization, and linear solver accordingly; and adaptive tuning runs low-cost pilot solves to calibrate resolution and tolerances under the prescribed accuracy and runtime budget. We evaluate AutoPDE on the PDE Agent Bench, where experimental results show that AutoPDE achieves a pass rate of $54.5%$, improving over the strongest baseline by $14.2$ percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoPDE，一个基于LLM的代码智能体（code agent），它将偏微分方程（PDE）求解策略（solver strategy）显式表示为一个独立的、可检查的对象，在编写代码前构建，并可在求解失败时根据数值证据进行修订。AutoPDE通过三个阶段（PDE分析、数值方法选择、自适应调优）从可复用技能库中构建策略。在PDE Agent Bench上，AutoPDE达到54.5%的通过率，比最强基线提高14.2个百分点。
Motivation: 现有LLM编码智能体直接从PDE问题生成求解代码，策略隐含在实现细节中，失败时反馈用于修改代码而非底层策略，导致数值决策难以在代码生成前检查和失败时依据数值证据修订。
Method: AutoPDE维护显式的求解策略对象：先进行PDE分析（识别方程类型和代数结构），然后选择匹配的数值方法（离散化、稳定化、线性求解器），最后通过低开销试算校准分辨率和容差，所有阶段利用可复用技能库。
Result: 在PDE Agent Bench上，AutoPDE的通过率为54.5%，比最强基线提高14.2个百分点。
Conclusion: AutoPDE通过将求解策略显式表示和迭代修订，提升了PDE求解的可靠性和自动化水平，但摘要未提及在具体应用领域（如气象）的表现。

papers.title: Toward Secure LLM Agents: Threat Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly moving from conversational interfaces to software components that plan, invoke tools, maintain memory, and act on external environments. This transition changes the nature of security risk. In agentic settings, failures are no longer limited to unsafe text generation. Untrusted content may redirect control flow, misuse tool privileges, corrupt persistent state, leak sensitive information, or trigger harmful external actions. At the same time, research on LLM agent security is expanding quickly but remains fragmented across attack families, defense layers, application domains, and evaluation settings. This paper synthesizes 247 papers through a lifecycle-based, systems-oriented framework that models agent security around the interaction of information flow, delegated authority, and persistent state. We organize the literature around four questions: how LLM agent security should be modeled, which threat surfaces and attack families dominate, what defenses have been proposed and with what tradeoffs, and how security claims are evaluated. We find that prompt injection and tool-mediated control-flow hijacking still dominate the field, while persistent state corruption and multi-agent propagation are becoming central emerging concerns. We further find that current defenses provide useful building blocks but remain weakly compositional, and that existing benchmarks still underrepresent long-horizon, stateful, and deployment-sensitive risks. We argue that secure LLM agents require explicit trust boundaries, principled privilege control, provenance-aware state management, and evaluation practices aligned with realistic operational settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）智能体安全性的综合性综述，基于247篇论文，提出一个以生命周期为基础、系统为导向的框架，围绕信息流、委托权限和持久状态三个核心交互来建模智能体安全。文章组织文献回答四个问题：如何建模LLM智能体安全、主要威胁面和攻击家族、现有防御及其权衡、安全评估方式。发现提示注入和工具中介的控制流劫持仍占主导，而持久状态破坏和多智能体传播成为新兴关注点；现有防御缺乏组合性，基准测试低估长周期、有状态和部署敏感的风险。
Motivation: LLM智能体从对话界面快速演变为能够规划、调用工具、维护记忆和操作外部环境的软件组件，安全风险从不安全文本生成扩展到控制流劫持、工具滥用、状态破坏和有害外部动作。然而，相关研究虽然快速增长但碎片化严重，缺乏统一的建模和分析框架。
Method: 采用基于生命周期的系统化框架，围绕信息流、委托权限和持久状态三个维度建模LLM智能体安全，并据此对247篇文献进行系统分类和组织。
Result: 发现提示注入和工具中介的控制流劫持仍是主导攻击类型；持久状态破坏和多智能体传播成为新兴威胁；现有防御提供有用构建块但组合性弱；现有基准测试在长周期、有状态和部署敏感风险方面覆盖不足。
Conclusion: 安全的LLM智能体需要明确的信任边界、原则性的权限控制、来源感知的状态管理，以及与实际运行环境对齐的评估实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Arbiter Agent: Continually Monitoring Multi-Agent Conversations to Detect Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems built from multiple language-model agents become more common, they are increasingly used to make decisions together: discussing, negotiating, and acting on shared tasks. While individual agents may appear well-aligned when tested on their own, problems can arise from how they interact with one another. We introduce the Arbiter, an agent designed to monitor multi-agent conversations in real time and identify which participants may be behaving in misaligned ways. The Arbiter operates under a limited "inspection budget", meaning it must decide carefully how to use its resources. As it observes a conversation step by step, it can choose to wait, question a participant, examine internal information such as system prompts or reasoning traces, or log concerning behavior. At the end, it produces a report identifying the likely source of misalignment. We evaluate the Arbiter across five conversation conditions, ranging from risky financial advice model organisms to evaluation-aware and colluding agents, we test five tool configurations of increasing capability and two backbone models. We find that the Arbiter reliably detects misaligned agents well before the end of the conversation, with active inspection tools improving both detection accuracy and speed. Weight-induced misalignment proves hardest to detect, while instruction-induced misalignment is identified reliably even under passive observation. The logging tool exhibits a dual effect, improving recall at the cost of precision. These results suggest that continual, budget-aware monitoring can effectively catch misalignment, and that overseeing multi-agent systems may require treating the auditor as an active participant in the process. The code is available at https://github.com/aisilab/arbiter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Arbiter 智能体，用于实时监控多语言模型代理间的对话，检测可能出现的对齐失败 (misalignment)。Arbiter 在有限检查预算下通过等待、提问、检查系统提示或推理轨迹等动作，逐步观察并报告问题源头。在五种对话条件（包括风险金融建议、评估感知和共谋代理）下评估，发现 Arbiter 能在对话结束前可靠检测出对齐失败的代理，主动检查工具提高了检测准确率和速度；权重诱导的对齐失败最难检测，而指令诱导的即使被动观察也能可靠检测；日志工具在提高召回的同时降低了精度。
Motivation: 多智能体系统由多个语言模型代理组成，共同决策时可能从交互中产生对齐问题，而单个代理独立测试时可能表现良好，因此需要持续监控对话来检测这些涌现的对齐失败。
Method: Arbiter 是一个监控代理，在对话过程中逐步观察，拥有有限的“检查预算”，可选择等待、质疑参与者、检查内部信息（如系统提示或推理痕迹）或记录可疑行为，最终生成报告识别对齐失败的可能来源。
Result: 在五种对话条件下，Arbiter 在对话结束前可靠检测出对齐失败的代理，主动检查工具提升检测准确率和速度；权重诱导的对齐失败最难检测，而指令诱导的对齐失败即使在被动观察下也能可靠检测；日志工具在提高召回的同时降低了精度。
Conclusion: 持续且预算感知的监控可以有效捕获对齐失败，并且监督多智能体系统可能需要将审计者视为积极参与过程的一部分。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Arbiter 智能体，用于实时监控多语言模型代理间的对话，检测可能出现的对齐失败 (misalignment)。Arbiter 在有限检查预算下通过等待、提问、检查系统提示或推理轨迹等动作，逐步观察并报告问题源头。在五种对话条件（包括风险金融建议、评估感知和共谋代理）下评估，发现 Arbiter 能在对话结束前可靠检测出对齐失败的代理，主动检查工具提高了检测准确率和速度；权重诱导的对齐失败最难检测，而指令诱导的即使被动观察也能可靠检测；日志工具在提高召回的同时降低了精度。

summary_sections.method: Arbiter 是一个监控代理，在对话过程中逐步观察，拥有有限的“检查预算”，可选择等待、质疑参与者、检查内部信息（如系统提示或推理痕迹）或记录可疑行为，最终生成报告识别对齐失败的可能来源。

papers.title: MemVenom: Triggered Poisoning of Multimodal Memories in Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: External memory has become a core component of modern web agents, enabling long-horizon reasoning through the retrieval of past experiences. However, this paradigm introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious content injected into memory can be persistently recalled and repeatedly influence agent behavior. In this work, we identify and systematically study multimodal memory poisoning, an overlooked yet practical attack surface in web-agent systems. We propose MemVenom, a unified black-box attack framework that poisons graph-structured external memory with coordinated text-image evidence. Our method consists of a two-stage design: (1) a trigger-conditioned retrieval attack that ensures high-probability recall of malicious memory, and (2) a post-retrieval attack induction that leverages adversarial perturbations and stealthy OCR injection to override the original user objective. Unlike prior attacks that operate on prompts or text-only memory, our approach enables persistent, reusable, and goal-agnostic attacks without modifying model parameters or re-optimizing malicious tasks. Experiments across multiple web-agent frameworks and vision-language models demonstrate that MemVenom achieves strong end-to-end attack success with minimal impact on benign performance, reaching up to 99.15% on GPT-5-family web agents, while transferring effectively across architectures and model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemVenom，一个针对web代理系统中多模态记忆投毒的攻击框架。利用条件触发的检索攻击和后检索诱导，通过协调文本-图像证据污染图结构外部记忆，实现持久可复用的黑盒攻击。在多个web代理框架和视觉语言模型上，对GPT-5系列代理达到99.15%攻击成功率，且对良性性能影响极小。
Motivation: 外部记忆成为web代理核心组件但引入安全漏洞，恶意记忆可被持续召回并影响代理行为；现有攻击局限于提示或纯文本记忆，缺乏对多模态记忆投毒的系统研究。
Method: 提出统一黑盒攻击框架MemVenom：两阶段设计——(1) 触发条件检索攻击确保恶意记忆高概率召回；(2) 后检索攻击诱导，利用对抗扰动和隐蔽OCR注入覆盖用户原始目标。无需修改模型参数或重新优化恶意任务。
Result: 在多个web代理框架和视觉语言模型上，MemVenom实现强端到端攻击成功，对GPT-5系列代理达99.15%成功率，且跨架构和模型规模可迁移，对良性性能影响小。
Conclusion: 揭示了多模态记忆投毒是web代理中实际且被忽视的攻击面；MemVenom攻击持久、可复用、目标无关。

papers.title: When the Chain of Thought Knows Better: Failure Modes in Multi-Turn Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Failures in multi-turn reasoning models are largely invisible to terminal-score evaluation. A model can lock onto an unsafe stance early in a long dialogue, yet its final-turn refusal rate may appear indistinguishable from a robustly aligned baseline. To expose these hidden temporal dynamics, we propose a trace-level diagnostic - the CoT-Output 2x2 safety matrix. This framework labels every turn along two independent axes (internal reasoning and visible output), yielding four operationally defined failure cells: robust alignment, alignment faking, overt jailbreak, and a distinct failure mode we term context-injection failure (where the CoT maintains safe reasoning, but the visible output produces harm, highlighting a multi-turn manifestation of reasoning unfaithfulness). We evaluate three distilled reasoning targets against a fixed attacker across five oversight conditions, collecting 6750 turn-level observations on the Information-Hazard scenario. Our analysis reveals two reproducible vulnerabilities: an oversight paradox where explicit monitoring cues paradoxically increase alignment-faking rates rather than suppress them, and a context-injection failure where models lock onto unsafe external outputs despite safe internal states. We release the full dataset of multi-turn dialogues and CoT traces to support follow-up trace-diagnostic research.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 FAGEN Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多轮推理模型中的隐性失败模式，提出一种追踪级诊断框架——CoT-Output 2x2 安全矩阵，将每一轮推理沿着内部推理和可见输出两个独立轴标注，识别出四种失败单元：稳健对齐、对齐伪装、公然越狱以及一种新类型——上下文注入失败（内部推理安全但输出有害）。在信息-危险场景下对三个蒸馏推理模型进行5种监督条件的评估，收集6750轮次观察，发现两个可复现的漏洞：监督悖论（显式监控提示反而增加对齐伪装率）和上下文注入失败（模型锁定不安全的外部输出尽管内部状态安全）。论文发布了多轮对话和CoT追踪的完整数据集。
Motivation: 多轮推理模型的失败对终端分数评估几乎不可见；一个模型可能在长对话早期锁定不安全立场，但其最终轮拒绝率与稳健对齐基线无明显差异，需要暴露这些隐藏的时间动态。
Method: 提出CoT-Output 2x2安全矩阵，将每一轮推理沿内部推理（CoT）和可见输出两个独立轴分类，定义四种操作失败单元；并在信息-危险场景下对三个蒸馏推理模型进行5种监督条件的系统评估。
Result: 收集6750轮次观察，发现两个可复现漏洞：监督悖论（显式监控提示增加对齐伪装率而非抑制）和上下文注入失败（模型保持安全推理但输出有害，体现多轮推理不忠实）。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要追踪级诊断方法而非仅终端评分来评估多轮推理安全，并发布完整数据集以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatial-Omni: Spatial Audio Understanding Integration in Multimodal LLMs via FOA Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models mainly process audio as monaural signals, thereby discarding the spatial cues contained in spatial audio for sound localization, spatial relation reasoning, and spatial scene understanding. We propose Spatial-Omni, a lightweight method that implements SO-Encoder to inject First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) spatial audio into existing Omni LLMs as an independent modality, without modifying their original audio encoders. SO-Encoder provides spatial tokens with limited additional context cost and improves spatial audio understanding through efficient staged training. To support training and evaluation, we construct SO-Dataset, SO-QA, and SO-Bench from open-source data, real recordings, and simulations, containing 400K FOA spatial audio clips and 2.1M spatial question answering pairs. SO-Bench covers 16 spatial audio understanding subtasks, including basic detection and location estimation, spatial relation understanding, and complex spatial reasoning. Experiments show that Spatial-Omni outperforms existing open-source Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni LLM models on spatial audio understanding tasks while retaining a reasonable level of general audio understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/dieKarotte/Spatial-Omni.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial-Omni，一种轻量级方法，通过 SO-Encoder 将一阶环境立体声 (FOA) 空间音频注入现有全模态大语言模型 (Omni LLMs)，作为独立模态而不修改原始音频编码器。该方法利用有限附加上下文代价提供空间令牌，并通过高效分阶段训练提升空间音频理解。文章构建了包含 40 万条 FOA 空间音频片段和 210 万对空间问答数据的 SO-Dataset、SO-QA 和 SO-Bench 基准，覆盖 16 项空间音频理解子任务。实验表明，Spatial-Omni 在空间音频理解任务上优于现有开源大型音频语言模型和全模态大语言模型，同时保持合理的通用音频理解水平。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型主要将音频处理为单声道信号，丢弃了空间音频中包含的声源定位、空间关系推理和空间场景理解等空间线索，亟需一种方法将空间音频作为独立模态融入模型。
Method: 提出 SO-Encoder 从一阶环境立体声 (FOA) 中提取空间令牌，以轻量方式注入现有全模态大语言模型，不修改原始音频编码器；采用分阶段训练策略，逐步提升空间音频理解能力；并构建大规模空间音频数据集 SO-Dataset 和问答基准 SO-Bench。
Result: Spatial-Omni 在 16 项空间音频理解子任务（包括基本检测、定位估计、空间关系理解和复杂空间推理）上优于现有开源大型音频语言模型和全模态大语言模型，同时保持通用音频理解性能。
Conclusion: 空间音频可作为独立模态有效增强多模态大语言模型的空间理解能力，且 SO-Encoder 的轻量设计便于集成到现有系统中。代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Detecting Knowledge Gaps from Conversational AI Interactions Using Curriculum Prerequisite Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Large online courses generate thousands of student questions directed at conversational AI teaching assistants, yet these interaction logs remain largely untapped as diagnostic signals. We present a pipeline that maps student questions from a conversational AI teaching assistant to curriculum topics using a few-shot text classifier, grounded in a GPT-4-extracted prerequisite knowledge graph of course concepts. Evaluated on 1,340 question events from 164 students in a graduate-level AI course, our classifier achieves 80.0% accuracy across 43 labels (42 curriculum topics plus an "unknown" abstention class). Topic-level question volume correlates significantly with student self-reported difficulty from an independent mid-semester survey (rho = 0.491, p = 0.008, n = 28 topics), providing convergent evidence that the classified question stream reflects genuine topic difficulty. These results demonstrate that conversational AI interaction logs, mapped onto curriculum structure, carry actionable signals about topic-level knowledge gaps and provide instructors with a curriculum-grounded view of which topics warrant attention.
papers.comment: Accepted as a short paper at the 10th CSEDM Workshop, co-located with the 18th International Conference on Educational Data Mining (EDM 2026). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个流水线，将学生对对话AI助手的提问映射到课程主题，通过小样本文本分类器和GPT-4提取的课程先验知识图。在164名研究生的AI课程中，分类器在1340个问题事件上达到80.0%的准确率，且主题级问题数量与学生自报难度显著相关（rho=0.491, p=0.008），表明对话AI交互日志能有效检测知识缺口。
Motivation: 大型在线课程中，学生对对话AI助手的提问日志大量但未被有效利用为诊断信号，无法系统性识别学生知识缺口。
Method: 构建基于GPT-4提取的课程先验知识图，使用小样本文本分类器将学生问题映射到43个标签（42个课程主题+“未知”类）。
Result: 在1340个问题事件上分类器准确率达80.0%；主题级问题数量与独立中期末学生自报难度显著相关（Spearman ρ=0.491, p=0.008, n=28主题）。
Conclusion: 对话AI交互日志经课程结构映射后，能提供可操作的知识缺口信号，帮助教师定位需要关注的主题。

papers.title: Patient-Level Diagnosis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia via Deep Learning Analysis of Bone Marrow Smear
papers.abstract_en: Bone marrow smear review remains important for acute myeloid leukemia (AML) assessment, but manual single-cell interpretation is labor-intensive and patient-level diagnosis requires aggregation of many cellular observations. We present a cell-to-patient deep learning pipeline for AML-assisted diagnosis from bone marrow smear images. The study included 258 patients from six anonymized centers, including a main cohort of 169 patients from Centers 1-3 and an external validation cohort of 89 patients from Centers 4-6. A 16-category cell annotation vocabulary was used to describe the global cellular composition, including granulocytic, monocytic, erythroid, lymphoid, eosinophilic, and other cells. Rather than identifying strict AML blasts or leukemic blasts, the model targets an expert-defined composite category termed Composite Blast-like Cells (CBLC), comprising N, N1, M, M1, R, R1, J, and J1 according to the project-wide morphological standard. A fixed YOLO-based segmentation module detected cells, predicted contours were matched to expert polygon annotations by contour IoU, and standardized single-cell crops were generated. An EfficientNet-B0 classifier was trained through a two-stage GT-to-YOLO and YOLO-to-YOLO strategy with class-imbalance correction, center-border regularization, and morphology-assisted supervision. Cell-level predictions were aggregated into patient-level CBLC ratios for AML-oriented diagnostic support. The pipeline achieved stable internal validation and maintained external generalization, with ensemble weighted F1-scores of 0.9076, 0.8696, and 0.9124 on Centers 4, 5, and 6, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从骨髓涂片图像进行急性髓系白血病（AML）辅助诊断的深度学习流水线，将细胞级预测聚合为患者级诊断支持。研究纳入258名患者（来自六个中心），使用16类细胞注释词汇表，并定义复合母细胞样细胞（CBLC）作为诊断目标。基于YOLO的细胞检测和EfficientNet-B0分类器，通过两阶段训练策略和多种正则化方法，在外部验证集上集成加权F1分数达0.8696-0.9124。
Motivation: 骨髓涂片手工判读费时费力，且患者级诊断需要整合大量细胞观察结果；现有方法多聚焦单细胞识别，缺乏从细胞到患者的完整自动化流程。
Method: 采用固定YOLO分割模块检测细胞，通过轮廓IoU匹配专家多边形标注，生成标准化单细胞剪裁。使用EfficientNet-B0分类器，经两阶段GT-to-YOLO和YOLO-to-YOLO策略训练，结合类别不平衡校正、中心-边界正则化和形态学辅助监督。细胞级预测聚合为患者级CBLC比率以辅助AML诊断。
Result: 在外部验证中心4、5、6上，集成加权F1分数分别为0.9076、0.8696和0.9124，表明模型在内部验证和外部泛化方面表现稳定。
Conclusion: 该流水线通过细胞到患者级别的聚合，为AML诊断提供了有效的自动化辅助工具，但未提及与其他方法的比较或临床验证细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPACR: Single-Pass Adaptive Training of Uncertainty-Aware Conformal Regressors
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides robust uncertainty guarantees for predictive models, but is typically applied post hoc, which misaligns model training with the conformal goal of producing efficient (i.e, narrow) intervals. We propose SPACR (Single-Pass Adaptive Conformal Regressor), a novel method for directly training uncertainty-aware regressors within a differentiable loss. SPACR jointly optimizes efficiency and validity without batch-splitting or a predefined confidence levels during training. As a result, a single SPACR model yields valid prediction intervals at multiple confidence levels during inference, avoiding the costly retraining required by methods like DOICR. Experiments on diverse datasets show that SPACR consistently gives tighter intervals and better coverage-efficiency trade-offs compared to standard CP and DOICR, while significantly reducing computational costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPACR 是一种单次自适应共形回归方法，通过可微损失直接训练不确定性感知回归器，联合优化预测区间的效率（窄区间）和有效性（覆盖保证），无需预先设定置信水平或分批训练。实验表明，SPACR 在多个数据集上相比标准共形预测和 DOICR 方法得到了更紧的区间和更好的覆盖-效率权衡，并显著降低了计算成本。
Motivation: 标准共形预测通常作为事后步骤应用，导致模型训练与共形目标（产生高效区间）不匹配，且现有方法如 DOICR 需要针对不同置信水平重新训练，计算成本高。
Method: 提出 SPACR，一种在可微损失函数中直接训练不确定性感知回归器的单次自适应共形回归方法，无需分批或预设置信水平，训练单个模型即可在推理时生成多个置信水平的有效预测区间。
Result: 在多个数据集上，SPACR 始终生成更窄的预测区间，并实现更好的覆盖-效率权衡，同时显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: SPACR 提供了一种高效且有效的共形回归训练方式，避免了事后校准和多次训练的需求，适用于需要不确定性量化的场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Transformer Based Model for Spatiotemporal Feature Learning in EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely adopted technique for monitoring brain activity, offering valuable insights into neurological states due to its high temporal resolution and cost-effectiveness. To enhance the analysis of complex EEG data, we propose EEG-TransNet, an architecture designed to capture temporal, regional, and synchronous features of EEG signals. EEG-TransNet introduces three key modules: 1) a preprocessing and feature extraction module leveraging ResNet and wavelet-based denoising, 2) a Local Self-Attention Block for regional feature learning, and 3) a Fuzzy-Attention Synchronous Transformer (FAST) to model spatiotemporal dependencies. Through extensive experiments on three EEG datasets (BETA, SEED, and DepEEG), the proposed model consistently outperforms other methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness across varying signal lengths. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of the Local Self-Attention Block in improving performance, and the inclusion of depthwise separable convolutions in the decoder reduces computational complexity while maintaining high accuracy. EEG-TransNet's ability to generalize across subjects with minimal performance variation highlights its potential as a robust tool for EEG-based brain activity classification and emotion recognition tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EEG-TransNet，一种用于脑电图(EEG)情感识别的Transformer模型，包含局部自注意力模块和模糊注意力同步Transformer(FAST)以捕捉时空特征。在BETA、SEED和DepEEG三个数据集上，该模型在分类准确性和鲁棒性方面优于其他方法。
Motivation: EEG信号分析面临复杂时空依赖建模的挑战，现有方法难以同时捕捉时间、区域和同步特征。
Method: 提出EEG-TransNet，包含三个模块：1) 基于ResNet和小波去噪的预处理与特征提取；2) 局部自注意力块用于区域特征学习；3) 模糊注意力同步Transformer(FAST)用于时空依赖建模。解码器中引入深度可分离卷积降低计算复杂度。
Result: 在BETA、SEED和DepEEG数据集上，EEG-TransNet在不同信号长度下均取得优于对比方法的分类准确率和鲁棒性。消融实验验证了局部自注意力块的贡献。
Conclusion: EEG-TransNet在不同被试间表现稳定，是EEG脑活动分类和情感识别的鲁棒工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention Expansion: Enhancing Keyphrase Extraction from Long Documents with Attention-Augmented Contextualized Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have achieved strong performance in keyphrase extraction (KPE), largely due to their ability to generate rich contextualized representations. However, long-document KPE remains challenging because salient keyphrase evidence may be scattered across distant document sections that cannot be jointly captured within the limited context window of most PLMs. Although long-context large language models (LLMs) can process broader textual contexts, their computational cost limits their practicality for efficient and high-throughput KPE. To overcome this limitation, we propose an attention expansion mechanism that augments PLM token representations with information from surrounding out-of-context chunks using pre-trained word embeddings. The proposed mechanism expands the effective contextual scope of PLM-based KPE models without requiring full-document attention or expensive LLM-based inference. We evaluate our approach across five PLM backbones, including general-purpose, scientific, task-specific, and long-context encoders, using two training regimes and five benchmark corpora from scientific and news domains. Experimental results demonstrate that attention expansion consistently enhances KPE performance across all evaluation settings, outperforming state-of-the-art models and yielding notable improvements in F1 score. The improvements extend to domain-specific, task-specialized, and native long-context models, showing that the proposed mechanism provides complementary information rather than merely compensating for limited input length. These results establish attention expansion as an efficient and effective strategy for long-document KPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长文档关键短语提取（KPE）中预训练语言模型上下文窗口有限的问题，提出注意力扩展机制（Attention Expansion），通过预训练词嵌入将周围超出上下文的片段信息融入当前token表示，从而扩展有效上下文范围，无需全文档注意力或昂贵的大模型推理。在五种PLM骨干网络、两种训练设置和五个科学/新闻领域基准上，该方法一致提升F1分数，超越现有模型，并展现出对领域专用、任务专用和原生长上下文模型的互补性。
Motivation: 长文档关键短语提取中，PLM的有限上下文窗口无法同时捕捉分散在文档各处的关键证据，而长上下文LLM计算成本过高，限制了高效高吞吐的KPE。
Method: 提出注意力扩展机制，利用预训练词嵌入将周围非上下文块的信息以注意力方式注入PLM的token表示，从而在不增加全文档注意力开销的情况下扩展有效上下文范围。
Result: 实验涵盖五个PLM骨干（通用、科学、任务专用、长上下文编码器）、两种训练设置和五个科学/新闻基准，注意力扩展在所有设置下一致提升KPE性能，F1分数显著提高，并优于现有最优模型。
Conclusion: 注意力扩展是一种高效且有效的长文档KPE策略，能为现有PLM提供互补信息，不仅弥补输入长度限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ++nnU-Net: Scaling nnU-Net with Prefix-Based Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: The nnU-Net has demonstrated continuous success in medical segmentation tasks, which heavily rely on the availability and diversity of annotated biomedical data. However, assembling medical imaging cohorts remains challenging due to numerous factors such as privacy regulations and annotation costs. As a result, data augmentation plays a crucial role in increasing data availability while maintaining anatomical feasibility. Hence, we propose the ++nnU-Net, a novel data augmentation module based on image registration that operates prior to preprocessing and training take place. Our framework was evaluated across five different 2D datasets. In this workflow, image data go through a two-stage registration process, generating new warped images. The transformations are then applied to the respective segmentation. In addition, the pipeline computes available disk space, generates supplementary binary synthetic masks and generates checkpoints. We demonstrate that the ++nnU-Net outperforms the nnU-Net baseline, yielding improvements in Dice Similarity Coefficient scores. In the most prominent cases, we observe performance gains of approximately 22\%. These findings highlight the effectiveness of registration-based data augmentation, particularly for 2D medical imaging datasets and suggest that the ++nnU-Net provides a practical and scalable approach for enhancing segmentation performance in data-limited settings. The source code for the ++nnU-Net is available at: https://github.com/sofia-adelie/plusplusnnunet.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出++nnU-Net，一种基于图像配准的数据增强模块，在预处理前对医学图像进行两阶段配准生成新形变图像，并应用于分割掩码。在五个2D数据集上，该方法相比基线nnU-Net提升了Dice相似系数，最高提升约22%，代码已开源。
Motivation: 医学分割依赖大量标注数据，但数据收集受隐私、成本等限制，数据增强对提升数据多样性和解剖可行性至关重要。
Method: 提出基于图像配准的二阶段注册流程，在预处理前对原图进行形变，并将变换应用于对应的分割掩码；同时自动计算磁盘空间、生成二进制合成掩码和检查点。
Result: 在五个2D数据集上，++nnU-Net的Dice相似系数优于nnU-Net基线，最优情况下性能提升约22%。
Conclusion: 注册基数据增强在2D医学图像分割中有效，为数据有限场景提供了实用且可扩展的性能提升方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search by Recycling Zero-Variance Queries During Training
papers.abstract_en: The use of GRPO-style algorithms has become the standard strategy for training LLM search agents under outcome-only rewards. With these algorithms, a query contributes to parameter updates only when its rollout group mixes successes and failures; all-correct (too-easy) and all-incorrect (too-hard) groups are zero-variance and waste rollout cost. Existing approaches treat zero-variance as a static property and either discard or pre-filter such groups. We hypothesize and empirically validate that queries flip between zero-variance and signal-bearing states as the policy evolves during training. Building on this intuition, we propose query recycling, which returns zero-variance groups to a mutable pool for future resampling, so that the effective training distribution co-evolves with the policy. With the proposed technique, a 1.7B parameter model trained on synthetic data can reach 66.0 average Pass@1 accross seven multi-hop QA benchmarks, matching or surpassing systems with up to 7B parameters trained on benchmark-derived supervision. Analysis of recycling patterns shows that recycled queries supply roughly three quarters of the effective batch by the end of training, with contributions split between recovery from policy improvement and policy drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GRPO风格算法训练LLM搜索代理时零方差查询浪费计算资源的问题，提出查询回收（query recycling）方法，将全正确或全错误的rollout组返回可变池供未来重采样，使有效训练分布随策略共同演变。该方法在1.7B参数模型上使用合成数据训练，在七个多跳QA基准上达到平均66.0的Pass@1，匹配或超越使用基准监督训练的7B模型。
Motivation: 现有GRPO风格算法中，当rollout组全是正确或全错时方差为零，无法提供梯度信号，导致计算浪费；传统方法将这些组静态地丢弃或预过滤，忽略了查询状态在训练过程中可能从零方差变为有信号。
Method: 提出查询回收（query recycling），在训练过程中将零方差查询组放回可变池，允许后续epoch重新采样，使训练分布动态适应策略变化。
Result: 1.7B参数模型在七个多跳QA基准上平均Pass@1达66.0，匹配或超越使用基准监督训练的7B模型；回收查询在训练后期贡献约四分之三的有效batch。
Conclusion: 查询回收利用查询状态动态变化的特点，有效回收原本浪费的查询，显著提升样本效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 1.7B参数模型在七个多跳QA基准上平均Pass@1达66.0，匹配或超越使用基准监督训练的7B模型；回收查询在训练后期贡献约四分之三的有效batch。
summary_sections.conclusion: 查询回收利用查询状态动态变化的特点，有效回收原本浪费的查询，显著提升样本效率。

papers.title: Unifying Data, Memory, and Compute Efficiency in LLM training: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Resource constraints increasingly determine what can be trained, fine-tuned, and deployed in large language models (LLMs), yet efficiency is often studied through isolated techniques rather than as an interacting system of limits. This survey adopts a constraint-centric perspective and organizes recent progress around three coupled bottlenecks: data efficiency (what to train on), memory efficiency (how to fit training), and compute budget awareness (when and where to spend FLOPs). On the data axis, we review selection and pruning methods that maximize learning per token, ranging from scalable proxy signals based on learning dynamics to gradient- and influence-based scoring, as well as difficulty-aware and curriculum-style strategies. We highlight emerging evidence that different notions of good data dominate in different regimes, implying that optimal subsets depend on the task objective and resource budget rather than being universal. On the systems side, we show that GPU memory, not raw compute, is often the dominant bottleneck in fine-tuning, and that effective scaling requires jointly reducing weight storage, optimizer states, and activation memory rather than optimizing any single component in isolation. Beyond memory, we frame training and inference as compute-governed processes in which optimization, data selection, and decoding must explicitly account for finite FLOP budgets. We review evidence for compute-optimal allocation and stopping rules, where computation should be halted or reallocated once marginal performance gains fall below a budget-dependent threshold. Together, these results unify compute-aware data selection, scaling laws, and adaptive inference under a common principle of resource-conditioned decision-making.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以资源约束为核心视角，综述了大语言模型训练中数据效率、内存效率与计算预算感知三个耦合瓶颈的最新进展。在数据轴，回顾了基于学习动力学的代理信号、梯度和影响力评分、难度感知及课程策略等选择与剪枝方法；在系统轴，指出GPU内存通常是微调的主要瓶颈，需联合减少权重存储、优化器状态和激活内存；在计算轴，将训练和推理视为计算受限过程，回顾了计算最优分配和停止规则。
Motivation: 现有LLM效率研究多孤立地考虑单一技术，缺乏对数据、内存、计算三者相互作用的系统视角，本文旨在统一这些方面以提供资源条件化决策的框架。
Method: 采用约束中心的综述方法，组织研究进展围绕三个耦合瓶颈：数据效率（选择与剪枝）、内存效率（减少存储）、计算预算感知（FLOPs分配与停止规则）。
Result: 总结了不同数据选择方法在不同任务和预算下的统治性证据；指出GPU内存是微调的主要瓶颈；回顾了计算最优分配和停止规则。
Conclusion: 这些结果统一了计算感知数据选择、缩放法则和自适应推理，强调资源条件化决策是高效LLM训练的核心原则。

papers.title: Event-Driven Reinforcement Learning Enables Long-Horizon Control in Semiconductor Fabrication
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning promises to optimize sequential decisions in large-scale systems. Semiconductor manufacturing systems are stochastic and highly constrained environments where heterogeneous wafers traverse hundreds of processing steps across extensive equipment networks. These characteristics yield complex, high-dimensional decision problems with delayed feedback and long-horizon requirements, complicating production planning and control. We propose a deep reinforcement learning framework for multi-objective policy optimization at this scale. Specifically, we formulate control as a centralized-agent problem, where a core policy coordinates system-wide decisions, while system evolution is represented as an interconnected temporal process driven by discrete events. Accordingly, we develop a tailored event-driven temporal-difference formulation that remains general and can be integrated with various policy optimization methods under relevant training settings. We investigate several core model-free algorithms incorporated into this framework and evaluate their effectiveness using high-fidelity simulations of diverse, industry-real operating scenarios. Across extensive validation experiments, agents trained in both offline and online settings show significant and consistent gains in throughput and utilization. We further evaluate performance and generalization across training phases, clarifying the relative strengths of alternative reinforcement learning formulations and algorithms. Overall, the results support the scalability, generality, and transferability of the proposed framework for controlling event-driven complex adaptive systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半导体制造中异构晶圆经数百道工序的随机、高约束环境，提出一种事件驱动强化学习框架。通过将控制问题表述为集中式智能体决策，并设计事件驱动的时间差分公式，该框架可集成多种无模型策略优化算法。在高保真仿真实验中，离线与在线训练的智能体在吞吐量和设备利用率上取得显著且一致的提升，验证了框架的可扩展性、通用性和可迁移性。
Motivation: 半导体制造系统具有随机性、高约束、异构晶圆多步骤长时序决策等特点，传统规划与控制方法难以应对复杂高维决策问题，延迟反馈与长时域需求增加了难度。
Method: 提出深度强化学习框架，将控制视为集中式智能体问题，核心策略协调全局决策；系统演化建模为离散事件驱动的互联时序过程，并开发通用的事件驱动时间差分公式，可与多种策略优化方法（如无模型算法）集成。
Result: 在多种工业级运行场景的高保真仿真验证中，离线与在线训练的智能体在吞吐量和设备利用率上取得显著且一致的提升；实验还评估了不同训练阶段的性能与泛化能力，澄清了不同强化学习算法及公式的相对优势。
Conclusion: 该框架支持事件驱动复杂自适应系统的控制，展示了可扩展性、通用性和可迁移性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Observation to Intervention: A Causal Audit of Expert Importance in Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods routinely use population-level summary statistics over observed model behaviour to license claims about the effects of targeted interventions on specific computations; in Pearl's terms, they treat rung-1 associational evidence as if it supported rung-2 interventional conclusions, a move whose validity is rarely tested. We examine one concrete instance: the use of routing statistics in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pruning, where utilization rates, activation norms, and routing weight distributions are treated as predictors of which experts can be removed without functional cost. A token-level interventional audit across three high-redundancy MoE architectures (OLMoE-1B-7B-0924, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite) finds no observational metric predicts causal expert importance after multiple-comparison correction in any model, with effect sizes below Cohen's $d = 0.17$ across all 60 metric-layer combinations. A per-token routing weight control rules out insufficient power, recovering a single Bonferroni-significant signal at OLMoE's final MoE layer ($d = +0.231$, $p = 0.0013$). Existing pruning methods succeed in this regime not by identifying dispensable experts but because early-layer redundancy renders most selection criteria interchangeable. Our results provide an explicit counterexample to the common inferential step from population-level observational summaries to token-level interventional claims about expert importance, and illustrate how interventional audits can calibrate the evidential standards for interpretability claims.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Philosophy of Science Meets Machine Learning (PhilML). Non-archival
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对混合专家（MoE）模型的剪枝中常用的路由统计指标（利用率、激活范数、路由权重分布）能否预测专家因果重要性进行了因果审计。在三个高冗余MoE架构上的token级干预实验表明，经过多重比较校正后，没有任何观测指标能预测因果重要性，效应量均低于Cohen's d=0.17。作者认为现有剪枝方法的成功并非因为识别了可删除专家，而是由于早期层的冗余使得大多数选择标准可互换。
Motivation: 可解释性方法常将群体层面的观察性统计（rung-1关联证据）当作支持干预性结论（rung-2）的证据，但这种推断的有效性很少被检验。本文针对MoE剪枝中路由统计指标作为专家重要性预测因子的做法进行因果审计。
Method: 对三个高冗余MoE架构（OLMoE-1B-7B-0924, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite）进行token级干预审计，比较各种路由统计指标与专家因果重要性之间的关系，并进行多重比较校正和效应量计算。
Result: 经过多重比较校正后，所有60个指标-层组合中均未发现观测指标能预测因果重要性，效应量均小于Cohen's d=0.17。仅在OLMoE的最后一个MoE层通过token级路由权重控制恢复了一个Bonferroni显著信号（d=+0.231, p=0.0013）。
Conclusion: 现有MoE剪枝方法的成功并非因为识别了可删除专家，而是由于早期层冗余使得大多数选择标准可互换。本文结果提供了一个从群体观察统计到token级干预推断的明确反例，并说明干预审计如何校准可解释性主张的证据标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vector Map as Language: Toward Unified Remote Sensing Vector Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing vector mapping aims to generate structured maps of geospatial entities, such as buildings, roads, and water bodies, from remote sensing imagery. In practice, vector maps usually contain multiple category layers and heterogeneous entity structures, requiring a unified model for diverse mapping needs. However, existing methods typically represent vector objects as polygons or graphs, making them suitable only for specific categories: polygons poorly capture topological relations, while graphs often blur instance boundaries. We observe that language, as a natural medium for human communication, offers a flexible and expressive representation that can accommodate heterogeneous map elements, including geometry, semantics, and topolog. Motivated by this insight, we propose Vector Map as Language (VecLang), a unified paradigm that reformulates multiclass vector mapping as structured text generation. VecLang encodes the common elements of different geospatial entities into a GeoJSON-like vector language, enabling cross-category modeling within a shared textual format. To generate this language reliably, we design a progressive vision-language mapping framework that first localizes vectorization units and then generates structured map elements. We further introduce Hierarchical Vector Language Optimization, which uses reinforcement learning to improve syntax validity, content fidelity, and map executability. We also build VecMap-Bench with 54K images and 800K instances, supporting training and evaluation across standard and generalization settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VecLang handles both single-class and multiclass vector mapping while achieving strong cross-dataset and open-vocabulary generalization. The model and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/yyyyll0ss/VecLang.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VecLang 范式，将多类遥感矢量制图重构为结构化文本生成任务，使用类似 GeoJSON 的矢量语言统一表示不同地理实体（如建筑、道路、水体），并设计渐进式视觉-语言映射框架与分层矢量语言优化（强化学习），构建包含 54K 图像和 800K 实例的 VecMap-Bench 数据集。实验表明该方法在单类、多类矢量制图以及跨数据集和开放词汇泛化上均表现优异。
Motivation: 现有矢量制图方法（如多边形、图表示）仅适用于特定类别，多边形难以捕捉拓扑关系，图则模糊实例边界，缺乏统一的、灵活的表示来应对多类图层和异构实体结构。
Method: 提出 VecLang 范式：将矢量地图编码为类似 GeoJSON 的结构化文本语言；设计渐进式视觉-语言映射框架，先定位矢量单元再生成结构化元素；引入分层矢量语言优化（强化学习）来提升语法有效性、内容保真度和地图可执行性。
Result: 在 VecMap-Bench 及跨数据集、开放词汇泛化设置下，VecLang 有效处理单类和多种类矢量制图，性能优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 语言作为一种灵活、富有表现力的表示，能够统一异构地图元素（几何、语义、拓扑），验证了将矢量制图转化为语言生成任务的可行性。

papers.title: Using the YOLOv12 Model for Verifying the Correct Color Sequence of Wires in Network Cables (Patch Cords) on the Production Line
papers.abstract_en: In the production process of network cables, ensuring the correct color sequence of wire pairs inside the standard connector plays a critical role in the final performance of the cable, as any misplacement or color-ordering error can lead to defective products and impose significant costs. Traditional inspection methods based on visual examination through digital microscopes are typically time-consuming, tedious, and prone to human error. In this study, an intelligent system based on the twelfth version of the YOLO1 object detection model was developed to identify the position and verify the correct color sequence of wires in patch cords. The dataset used consisted of 2,500 images captured from microscopic views of network connectors, which were divided into 70% for training, 15% for validation, and 15% for testing. The proposed model, leveraging a single-stage architecture and attention mechanisms during learning, achieved highly accurate wire detection with approximately 98% precision. Additionally, the overall mean accuracy, classification precision, and recall were around 95%, 99%, and 98%, respectively. The results demonstrate that this system can reliably and in real time verify the correctness of wire color sequencing on the production line without the need for human intervention, thereby reducing human error and enhancing efficiency in the manufacturing process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于YOLOv12的目标检测模型，用于在生产线上自动验证网络跳线中电线颜色顺序的正确性。使用2500张显微图像数据集，实现了约98%的精确度和99%的分类精度。
Motivation: 传统人工目检耗时且易出错，导致缺陷产品和高成本，需要自动化检测方案。
Method: 采用YOLOv12单阶段架构，结合注意力机制，对电线位置和颜色顺序进行实时检测与验证。
Result: 在测试集上达到约98%的精确度，整体平均准确率约95%，分类精度99%，召回率98%。
Conclusion: 该系统可实时可靠地验证电线颜色顺序，无需人工干预，减少错误并提高生产效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient AI-Inspired Reduction of Feynman Integrals via Tube Seeding
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we use machine learning to discover a new seeding strategy for integration-by-parts reduction of Feynman integrals, which is a frequent bottleneck in state-of-the-art calculations in theoretical particle and gravitational-wave physics. Our strategy allows us to reduce multi-loop integrals with large numerator powers via essentially the standard Laporta algorithm but with a sparse selection of seed integrals that grows only linearly with the numerator power, whereas existing strategies lead to growth with a polynomial power that increases with the complexity of the integral being reduced. The seeds are restricted to a thin tube-like region that connects the target integral to the master integrals along a zigzag path. We demonstrate the power of our approach by reducing non-planar 2-loop 5-point integrals of rank 20 with numerical kinematics over a finite field, which is prohibitively difficult for the Laporta algorithm with conventional seeding. Going beyond individual integrals, we further demonstrate the reduction of a complete set of top-level rank-10 integrals by dividing the target integrals into several chunks, each of which can be solved by our sparse seeding strategy with considerably less time and a significantly lower memory footprint than other state-of-the-art strategies, making the approach well-suited for phenomenological applications. We provide a proof-of-principle implementation on GitHub at https://github.com/andreslunagodoy/tube_seeding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习发现了一种新的种子积分选择策略，用于费曼积分的分部约化。该策略通过将种子限制在连接目标积分和主积分的管状区域，使种子数量随分子幂次线性增长，而非多项式增长。作者展示了该方法在约化非平面双圈5点积分（秩20）以及完整顶层秩10积分集合上的有效性，显著降低了时间和内存开销。
Motivation: 费曼积分的分部约化是高能物理和引力波计算中的常见瓶颈，传统Laporta算法中种子数量随分子幂次多项式增长，限制了复杂积分的处理能力。
Method: 提出基于机器学习的管状种子选择（tube seeding）策略，通过将种子限制在连接目标积分与主积分的窄管状区域（沿之字形路径），仅需线性增长的种子数量即可完成约化。
Result: 在数值运动学下成功约化非平面双圈5点积分（秩20），而传统Laporta算法无法处理；并完成完整顶层秩10积分集合的约化，时间和内存开销显著低于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该稀疏种子策略使Laporta算法能高效处理高阶分子幂次积分，对唯象应用具有潜力，代码已开源。

papers.title: Don't waste SAM
papers.abstract_en: Meta AI has recently released the Segment Anything Model (SAM), which demonstrates exceptional zero-shot image segmentation performance across various tasks with remarkable accuracy. Despite its inability to provide accurate segmentation across multiple research fields, SAM still serves as a valuable starting point for supporting the segmentation pipeline process, particularly for tasks that require extensive and senior skills annotations. This study aims to evaluate the generalization of SAM and fine-tuning SAM models using three waste segmentation datasets. Although they are captured from real scenes as SAM was pretrained on, these datasets present several challenges, including occlusions, deformable objects, transparency, and objects easily confused with backgrounds. In our findings, the fine-tuned SAM-ViT-H model outperforms the state-ofthe-art Zerowaste, and TACO datasets with a significant increase of +30 in IoU, and it closely approaches performance levels of TrashCan 1.0, with only a -1.44 difference. After evaluating these popular waste datasets, it became evident that fine-tuning SAM as a foundational model is a crucial step for providing better generalization for downstream waste segmentation tasks. Therefore, SAM should not be disregarded or wasted.
papers.comment: Published at European Symposium on Artificial Neural Networks (ESANN2023), Computational Intelligence and Machine Learning. Bruges (Belgium)

papers.title: Do LLMsMakeNeural Distinguishers Wise?
papers.abstract_en: Neural distinguishers are a cryptanalysis method for symmetric-key cryptography that trains machine learning models on pairs of plaintexts and ciphertexts with specific differences in order to recover a secret key. To the best of our knowledge, no existing work has explored the use of large language models (LLMs) for neural distinguishers. In this paper, we propose LLM-based neural distinguishers through a prompt design and conduct extensive experiments with them on SPECK-32/64 to investigate whether LLMs can strengthen neural distinguishers. We then found three key insights. First, by comparing the results of LLM-based neural distinguishers with ResNet in the existing work, we demonstrate that LLMs provide no observable improvement in the performance of neural distinguishers. Second, we confirm that, at high rounds, the choice of differences is no longer effective for LLM-based neural distinguishers as well as ResNet. Third, we show that the performance of LLM-based neural distinguishers can be significantly improved by incorporating only the XOR operation results as a prompt design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次探索将大语言模型（LLM）用于对称密码学中的神经区分器（neural distinguishers），通过提示设计在SPECK-32/64上实验。结果表明LLM并未带来性能提升，但仅加入XOR操作结果作为提示可显著改善性能。
Motivation: 现有神经区分器未使用LLM，本文旨在探究LLM能否增强神经区分器性能。
Method: 通过提示设计构建LLM-based神经区分器，并在SPECK-32/64上进行大量实验，与ResNet基线对比。
Result: 1) LLM相比ResNet无性能提升；2) 高轮次时差异选择对LLM亦失效；3) 仅包含XOR操作结果的提示设计可显著提升性能。
Conclusion: LLM本身不提升神经区分器，但特定提示设计（如XOR结果）可有效改进。

papers.title: An adaptive framework for the axisymmetric pulsar magnetosphere using physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.abstract_en: The pulsar magnetosphere has only recently been addressed using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), by deploying a domain-decomposition approach and treating the separatrix and equatorial current sheet as infinitesimally thin discontinuities. However, this baseline requires extensive manual hyperparameter tuning, achieves limited final accuracy and demands several hours of training. We refine this framework by introducing domain-specific neural architectures based on Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, an automated adaptive training pipeline and a physics-based convergence criterion that eliminate the need for manual calibration. The proposed methodology delivers self-consistent axisymmetric magnetosphere solutions with mean squared errors of the PDE residuals at O(1e-6) in double precision - an improvement of two orders of magnitude over the baseline - while achieving convergence in under 20 minutes in single precision. Importantly, the method reliably resolves stellar radii reduced by up to 80% compared to the baseline, overcoming the severe spatial scale disparities that also challenge traditional solvers. Furthermore, by varying the flux that opens to infinity, we provide a correction to the equation that connects it to the equatorial T-point's position. The complete framework is released as the open-source library PulsarX.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Journal of Computational Physics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脉冲星磁球体问题，提出基于物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的自适应框架，替代了传统基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的领域分解方法。新方法无需手动超参数调优，在双精度下将PDE残差均方误差降至O(1e-6)，比基线提升两个数量级，并在单精度下20分钟内收敛。该方法还能解析比基线小80%的恒星半径，并通过改变开路磁通修正了磁球T点位置方程。开源库PulsarX已发布。
Motivation: 现有基于PINN的脉冲星磁球求解器需要大量手动超参数调整，最终精度有限且训练耗时数小时，亟需更高效、自适应的求解方案。
Method: 引入KAN作为领域特定神经网络架构，结合自动化自适应训练管道和基于物理的收敛准则，彻底消除手动校准需求；通过改变开路磁通量修正T点位置方程。
Result: 双精度下PDE残差均方误差达O(1e-6)，比基线提高两个数量级；单精度下训练时间小于20分钟；恒星半径可缩小80%而不失精度。
Conclusion: 本文展示了KAN在轴对秤脉冲星磁球求解中的有效性，显著提升精度和效率，并提供了对传统求解器难以处理的尺度差异问题的解决方案。

papers.title: Divide and Cooperate: Role-Decomposed Multi-Agent LLM Training with Cross-Agent Learning Signals
papers.abstract_en: Modern language agents which perform multi-step reasoning have shown strong performance in knowledge-intensive question answering. However, existing approaches typically couple evidence acquisition and answer generation within a single policy. This forces a single model to play multiple potentially conflicting roles, inducing a combinatorial explosion in the policy space and hindering efficient exploration. It also introduces a credit assignment problem during training: a search action that retrieves sufficient evidence may still be penalized when generation fails, and vice versa. We propose DAC (Divide and Cooperate), a role-decomposed multi-agent training framework that divides agentic search into two cooperative subtasks, each handled by a dedicated agent trained with role-specific learning signals. The generator serves a dual role as both an answer producer and an evidence sufficiency verifier, abstaining when retrieved evidence is insufficient. This abstention signal is incorporated into the search agent's reward, providing structured cross-agent learning signals that improve credit assignment. Conversely, the searcher exposes the generator to diverse and challenging evidence environments by hard-positive evidence augmentation, improving its robustness. Experiments on general and multi-hop QA benchmarks show that DAC, implemented via parameter-efficient LoRA modules over a shared backbone, achieves strong performance against prior baselines that rely on full fine-tuning of monolithic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 DAC（Divide and Cooperate）框架，将多步推理中的证据获取与答案生成分解为两个独立智能体，分别由专用角色特定学习信号训练。生成器同时担任答案生成与证据充分性验证者，在证据不足时弃权，该弃权信号作为搜索智能体的奖励，改善信用分配。搜索智能体通过硬正例证据增强提升生成器鲁棒性。实验表明，基于共享骨干的参数高效 LoRA 实现，在通用与多跳问答基准上优于全微调的单体模型。
Motivation: 现有方法将证据获取与答案生成耦合在单个策略中，导致模型需扮演多重冲突角色，引发策略空间组合爆炸并阻碍高效探索，同时引入信用分配问题：即使检索到充分证据，若生成失败仍可能被惩罚。
Method: 提出角色分解的多智能体训练框架 DAC，将智能体搜索分为两个合作子任务：搜索智能体负责证据获取，生成智能体负责答案生成及证据充分性验证。生成器在证据不足时弃权，该弃权信号被纳入搜索智能体奖励；搜索智能体通过硬正例证据增强向生成器提供多样化挑战证据环境。
Result: 在通用与多跳问答基准上，DAC 采用基于共享骨干的参数高效 LoRA 模块实现，性能优于先前依赖全微调单体模型的基线方法。
Conclusion: DAC 通过角色分解与跨智能体学习信号有效改进多步推理中的信用分配，并证明了参数高效微调在此类框架中的可行性。

papers.title: UniDexTok: A Unified Dexterous Hand Tokenizer from Real Data
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous hands are essential for fine-grained manipulation, but their hardware designs vary substantially across embodiments. Differences in kinematics, joint definitions, and degrees of freedom make it difficult to define a shared state representation compared with parallel grippers. As a result, dexterous-hand data remains fragmented and difficult to use for joint training. In this work, we propose the Unified Dexterous Hand Model (UDHM), which maps human and robot hand states into a shared 22-DoF semantic interface. Based on UDHM, we introduce UniDexTok, a retargeting-free state tokenizer that learns embodiment-conditioned discrete tokens from standardized real joint states. UniDexTok provides a unified representation for heterogeneous dexterous hands without relying on retargeting or simulation data. Compared with the recent baseline UniHM, UniDexTok reduces MPJAE from 15.63 degrees to 0.16 degrees and MPJPE from 18.51 mm to 0.18 mm, corresponding to error reductions of 98.98% and 99.03%, respectively. These results improve reconstruction from centimeter-scale to sub-millimeter accuracy. Experiments further show that data from other embodiments improves target-embodiment reconstruction accuracy, demonstrating the benefit of cross-embodiment tokenization. UniDexTok also shows strong zero-shot and few-shot reconstruction ability when new dexterous hands are introduced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniDexTok，一种基于真实关节状态学习的统一灵巧手分词器（tokenizer），无需重新定向（retargeting）或仿真数据。通过统一灵巧手模型（UDHM）将人手和机器人手状态映射到共享的22自由度语义接口，从而解决不同灵巧手因硬件差异导致的状态表示碎片化问题。实验表明，UniDexTok 在重构精度上比基线 UniHM 显著提升，误差降低 98% 以上。
Motivation: 灵巧手硬件设计差异大（运动学、关节定义、自由度），缺乏类似平行夹爪的共享状态表示，导致灵巧手数据碎片化，难以用于联合训练。
Method: 提出 Unified Dexterous Hand Model (UDHM)，将人手和机器人手状态映射到 22 自由度语义接口；基于此提出 UniDexTok，一种免重新定向的状态分词器，学习基于具体实体（embodiment-conditioned）的离散 Token，仅使用标准化真实关节状态，不依赖仿真数据。
Result: 与基线 UniHM 相比，UniDexTok 将 MPJAE 从 15.63° 降至 0.16°（误差降低 98.98%），MPJPE 从 18.51 mm 降至 0.18 mm（误差降低 99.03%），重构精度从厘米级提升到亚毫米级。跨实体数据可提高目标实体重构精度，并展现出零样本和少样本重构能力。
Conclusion: UniDexTok 为异构灵巧手提供了一种无需重新定向或仿真数据的统一表示，并能利用跨实体数据提升重构精度，具有良好的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 UniDexTok，一种基于真实关节状态学习的统一灵巧手分词器（tokenizer），无需重新定向（retargeting）或仿真数据。通过统一灵巧手模型（UDHM）将人手和机器人手状态映射到共享的22自由度语义接口，从而解决不同灵巧手因硬件差异导致的状态表示碎片化问题。实验表明，UniDexTok 在重构精度上比基线 UniHM 显著提升，误差降低 98% 以上。
summary_sections.motivation: 灵巧手硬件设计差异大（运动学、关节定义、自由度），缺乏类似平行夹爪的共享状态表示，导致灵巧手数据碎片化，难以用于联合训练。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Unified Dexterous Hand Model (UDHM)，将人手和机器人手状态映射到 22 自由度语义接口；基于此提出 UniDexTok，一种免重新定向的状态分词器，学习基于具体实体（embodiment-conditioned）的离散 Token，仅使用标准化真实关节状态，不依赖仿真数据。
summary_sections.result: 与基线 UniHM 相比，UniDexTok 将 MPJAE 从 15.63° 降至 0.16°（误差降低 98.98%），MPJPE 从 18.51 mm 降至 0.18 mm（误差降低 99.03%），重构精度从厘米级提升到亚毫米级。跨实体数据可提高目标实体重构精度，并展现出零样本和少样本重构能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: UniDexTok 为异构灵巧手提供了一种无需重新定向或仿真数据的统一表示，并能利用跨实体数据提升重构精度，具有良好的泛化能力。

papers.title: PL-KKT-hPINN: Enforcing Nonlinear Equality Constraints on Neural Networks via Piecewise-Linear Projection
papers.abstract_en: While physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown strong potential for process modeling, physical equations are only enforced as soft constraints during training, and thus, they do not guarantee constraint satisfaction at inference. We propose a framework, called piecewise-linear Karush--Kuhn--Tucker hard-constrained PINNs (PL-KKT-hPINNs), that strictly enforces nonlinear equality constraints through piecewise-linear projection. This extends the KKT-hPINN framewor, which exactly enforces linear equalities through the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions associated with orthogonally projecting neural network outputs onto the constraint feasible region. The method is demonstrated on a continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) case study for both one and two inputs. Results show that PL-KKT-hPINN preserves predictive accuracy comparable to that of a standard neural network while achieving substantially lower constraint violations. In addition, the proposed model shows improved robustness in low-data regimes, yielding lower RMSE than the unconstrained neural network for limited training sample sizes. These results demonstrate that PL-KKT-hPINN provides a computationally efficient and physically consistent framework for surrogate modeling of nonlinear chemical engineering systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PL-KKT-hPINN框架，通过分段线性投影将神经网络输出投影到可行域，严格强制非线性等式约束，扩展了原有针对线性约束的KKT-hPINN方法。在CSTR案例上，该方法在保持精度同时显著降低约束违反，且在低数据场景下更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有物理信息神经网络(PINNs)仅在训练时以软约束方式加入物理方程，无法保证推理时满足约束。
Method: 利用Karush–Kuhn–Tucker条件对非线性等式约束进行分段线性投影，将网络输出精确投影到约束可行域。
Result: 在连续搅拌釜反应器(CSTR)案例中，PL-KKT-hPINN的预测精度与标准神经网络相当，但约束违反大幅降低；在有限训练样本下，RMSE低于无约束神经网络。
Conclusion: 该框架为非线性化工系统提供了一种高效且物理一致的替代建模方法，兼具计算效率和约束满足保证。

papers.title: One Step Closer to Ground Truth: A Multi-Scale Residual-Aware Representation Learning Pipeline for Predicting Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models have emerged as leading paradigms in time-series forecasting in recent years, employing self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies. Despite their success, these single-stage forecasting architectures exhibit persistent systematic residual biases arising from structural discrepancies, unmodeled stochastic components, or inadequate multi-scale temporal representations. This limitation persists when residuals are treated as irreducible noise, precluding adaptive correction of structured error patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that explicitly decouples forecasting and residual learning into distinct stages of representation learning. A base transformer first generates the initial predictions. Subsequently, a dedicated meta-corrector dynamically models structured error patterns across multivariate channels, preserves cross-variable dependencies, and iteratively refines the residual bias of the base transformer. By formalizing this pipeline as a hypothesis space expansion, our framework addresses approximation limitations inherent in single-stage architectures, removes reliance on restrictive assumptions, and enables end-to-end learning of complex error dynamics. Evaluated on eight popular benchmark datasets using established protocols, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in standard metrics (MSE, MAE). The results demonstrate the framework's ability to mitigate systematic biases and enhance robustness to complex temporal dynamics, advancing the practical applicability of transformer-based forecasting models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种两阶段、模型无关的框架，将时间序列预测分解为基预测器与元校正器，显式学习残差模式，在8个基准数据集上取得最先进结果。
Motivation: 单阶段Transformer预测器存在系统性残差偏差，源于对多尺度时序表示建模不充分或忽略随机成分，传统方法将残差视为不可约噪声从而无法自适应校正。
Method: 两阶段流水线：基Transformer生成初始预测，专用元校正器（meta-corrector）对多元通道的结构化误差模式进行动态建模，保留跨变量依赖，迭代修正残差偏差，作为假设空间扩展。
Result: 在8个公开基准上使用标准协议评估，MSE和MAE指标显著提升，达到当前最优。
Conclusion: 该方法能够缓解系统偏差、增强对复杂时序动态的鲁棒性，推进Transformer预测模型的实际应用。

papers.title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term LLM agents need persistent memory that can track changing facts and provide relevant evidence across sessions. Existing memory systems often store observations as isolated records, summaries, or indexed fragments, which makes evidence aggregation, fact revision, and memory maintenance difficult. We propose Infini Memory, a maintainable text-based persistent memory architecture that treats agent memory as topic-structured documents. Each topic document serves as a semantic unit for collecting related evidence, preserving metadata, and revising facts over time. New observations are first staged in a buffer and periodically consolidated into coherent textual contexts. At inference time, an agentic retrieval procedure lets the LLM read memory through iterative tool calls rather than a single retrieval step. On MemoryAgentBench, Infini Memory achieves 64.7% overall score. Ablations show that topic-structured maintenance and iterative evidence inspection improve complementary aspects of long-term memory use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Infini Memory，一种基于主题文档的可维护持久记忆架构，用于长周期LLM代理。它通过缓存-合并机制将观察整理成主题文档，并在推理时通过迭代工具调用让LLM读取记忆。在MemoryAgentBench上达到64.7%的整体分数。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统以孤立记录或片段存储信息，导致证据聚合、事实修订和记忆维护困难，无法支持长期代理对动态事实的跟踪。
Method: 构建以主题文档为语义单元的记忆架构，新观察先存入缓冲区，定期合并为连贯文本；推理时采用代理式检索，通过多次工具调用而非单次检索获取记忆。
Result: 在MemoryAgentBench上取得64.7%的整体分数；消融实验表明主题结构维护和迭代证据审查分别改善了长期记忆使用的互补方面。
Conclusion: 主题文档结构和迭代检索机制能有效提升LLM代理的长期记忆可维护性和事实跟踪能力。

papers.title: ClusBench: The Clustering Benchmark Data Resource You've All Been Waiting For (?)
papers.abstract_en: Although some very common test beds exist for assessing the performance of clustering methods, large scale benchmarking is typically limited to relatively simplistic simulation set-ups. Here we describe the production and curation of close to 3000 synthetic data sets, derived from more than 200 publicly available data sets; the majority of which arose from real-world applications. By fitting a flexible non-parametric distribution to each base data set we are able to retain much of the nuance in real-world data which is difficult to reproduce in standard simulations, while also producing data sets whose sizes are sometimes substantially greater than the data sets from which they are derived. The synthetic data sets, plus an accompanying R package, are available for download from https://github.com/DavidHofmeyr/ClusBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了ClusBench，一个包含近3000个合成数据集的聚类基准测试资源，这些数据集衍生自200多个公开的真实世界数据集。通过拟合灵活的非参数分布，保留了真实数据的细微特征，并提供了R包供下载。
Motivation: 现有聚类方法基准测试通常局限于简单的模拟设置，缺乏能反映真实数据复杂性的标准化测试床。
Method: 从200多个公开数据集出发，通过拟合非参数分布生成大量合成数据集，保留了原始数据的细微特征。
Result: 生成了近3000个合成数据集，数据规模有时远超原始数据集。
Conclusion: ClusBench为聚类方法提供了更贴近真实应用的基准资源，有助于更全面的性能评估。

papers.title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos by generating successive temporal segments, but their historical KV cache grows with video length. Existing bounded-cache methods reduce this cost with local windows, sink tokens, or compressed memory states, yet they usually assign fixed roles to different parts of the history. We propose FadeMem, a distance-aware KV memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed cache budget. This design is motivated by frequency-dependent temporal decay: fine details decorrelate quickly, while coarse scene structure and identity remain useful over longer horizons. During generation, new history is inserted as fine-grained entries, while older adjacent entries are progressively merged under a power-law temporal allocation schedule, yielding a dense-near, sparse-far memory within one cache. Without architectural changes, FadeMem preserves recent context for short-term dynamics and compact long-range anchors for identity and scene coherence. Experiments show improved subject consistency, background stability, and temporal coherence over existing bounded-cache strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FadeMem提出一种距离感知的KV缓存内存整合机制，用于自回归视频扩散模型。该机制在固定缓存预算下将历史KV块组织成时间层次结构，新历史作为细粒度条目插入，旧条目按幂律时间调度逐步合并，形成近密远疏的缓存，无需架构改变即可改进长视频生成的主题一致性、背景稳定性和时间连贯性。
Motivation: 现有有界缓存方法（如局部窗口、汇点令牌、压缩记忆）对历史不同部分赋予固定角色，未能自适应时间衰减特性，导致长视频生成中缓存管理效率不足。
Method: 提出FadeMem，基于频域时间衰减的动机，将历史KV块按功率律时间分配调度进行渐进合并，形成距离感知的层级缓存，新历史保持细粒度，旧历史压缩为长距离锚点。
Result: 实验表明FadeMem在主题一致性、背景稳定性和时间连贯性上优于现有有界缓存策略。
Conclusion: FadeMem在不引入架构变化的情况下，通过合理组织缓存层次实现了长视频生成中更高效的记忆管理，主要限制可能在于对特定衰减调度的依赖。

papers.title: In Defense of Information Leakage in Concept-based Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based models (CMs), deep neural networks that ground their predictions on representations aligned with human-understandable concepts (e.g., "round", "stripes", etc.), have been shown to learn representations that leak concept-irrelevant information. As the traditional narrative goes, this leakage is undesirable and should be eradicated as it leads to uninterpretable models. In this paper, we posit that this conventional view of leakage in CMs is not only ill-posed, as the evidence of how leakage makes a model less interpretable is often inconclusive, but also bound to lead to impractical CMs under common real-world constraints. Specifically, we argue that in real-world settings where concept incompleteness is the norm, some leakage is often necessary for constructing accurate and intervenable CMs. To this end, we propose that there is such a thing as benign leakage and show that, by optimizing a reframing of the typical CM training objective, CMs can encourage and exploit this form of leakage without sacrificing accuracy or intervenability.
papers.comment: Accepted as a position paper at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了概念模型（CMs）中信息泄漏的传统观点，认为泄漏并非总是有害，在某些情况下（如概念不完整）甚至是有益的。作者提出良性泄漏的概念，并通过重新优化CM训练目标来利用这种泄漏，而不牺牲准确性或可干预性。
Motivation: 传统观点认为CM中的信息泄漏会导致模型不可解释，应被消除。但作者认为这一观点假设不当，且在实际应用中概念不完整是常态，完全消除泄漏会限制模型的实用性和准确性。
Method: 作者重新定义CM训练目标，以鼓励和利用良性泄漏，即在保留概念相关信息的同时允许部分概念无关但有用的信息流动。
Result: 摘要声称通过优化重定义的目标，CM能够在不牺牲准确性或可干预性的情况下利用这种良性泄漏。
Conclusion: 作者主张对CM中的泄漏采取更细致的视角，区分恶性泄漏和良性泄漏，并展示了设计合理的泄漏可以提升模型在现实场景下的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analyzing Training-Free Corruption Detection for Object Detection Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Annotation errors are widespread in computer vision datasets and can significantly degrade the performance of systems trained on them, particularly in complex tasks such as object detection. Several approaches exist to identify annotation errors, including training-free feature-space methods which provide a fast and interpretable way to analyze annotations. However, the behavior on object detection annotations, which include semantic and spatial information, remains largely unexplored. In this work we analyze the applicability of feature-space-based approaches for detecting annotation errors in object detection datasets. By adapting an existing feature-space method, we show that such approaches reliably expose semantic mislabel, while positional errors remain difficult to detect. We evaluate this behavior across multiple pretrained embedding models, synthetic noise types (symmetric, asymmetric, and positional), and real-world annotation errors using VOC2012 and KITTI. All code and real-world corruptions are publicly available at the following repository: https://github.com/ ChristianSieberichs/BoundingBox\_corruption\_detection

TL;DR: 本文分析基于特征空间的免训练方法在目标检测数据集上检测标注错误（包括语义和位置错误）的适用性。通过在VOC2012和KITTI上使用多种预训练嵌入模型和合成噪声类型，发现该方法能可靠地暴露语义错误，但位置错误难以检测。
Motivation: 目标检测数据集中的标注错误会严重影响模型性能，但现有的免训练特征空间方法主要针对分类任务，在包含语义和空间信息的目标检测标注上的行为尚不清楚。
Method: 调整现有特征空间方法，利用预训练嵌入模型对目标检测数据集的标注进行腐败检测，评估不同噪声类型（对称、非对称、位置）和真实标注错误。
Result: 实验表明该方法能有效识别语义错误，但对位置错误检测困难，行为在多个嵌入模型上一致。
Conclusion: 免训练特征空间方法适用于目标检测数据集的语义错误检测，但需要额外技术来处理位置错误；代码和真实腐败数据已公开。

papers.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Shared Context
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can scale large language model reasoning at test time by decomposing complex problems into parallel subtasks. However, most existing MAS rely on centralized orchestration, where a main agent assigns work, collects outputs, and merges results. As the number of subtasks grows, this controller becomes a communication and integration bottleneck. We propose Decentralized Language Models (DeLM), a MAS framework that decentralizes coordination through parallel agents, a shared verified context, and a task queue. Agents asynchronously claim subtasks, read accumulated progress, perform local reasoning, and write back compact verified updates. The shared context acts as a common communication substrate, enabling agents to build on one another's verified progress without routing every update through a central controller. Empirically, DeLM improves both software-engineering test-time scaling and long-context reasoning. On SWE-bench Verified, DeLM achieves the best performance across Avg.@1, Pass@2, and Pass@4, with gains of up to 10.5 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while reducing cost per task by roughly 50%. On LongBench-v2 Multi-Doc QA, DeLM achieves the highest average accuracy across four frontier model families, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 5.7 percentage points. The code is available on our project website at https://yuzhenmao.github.io/DeLM/.

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化多智能体框架 DeLM，通过并行智能体、共享验证上下文和任务队列来协调大语言模型推理，避免了集中式控制器的瓶颈。在软件工程和长上下文推理基准上，DeLM 提升了性能并降低了成本。

Conclusion: 去中心化协调可以有效扩展多智能体系统的测试时推理能力。

papers.title: Accounting for AI Inference in Corporate GHG Inventories: A Four-Tier Methodology for Scope 3 Category 1 Reporting
papers.abstract_en: AI inference services -- API subscriptions, enterprise chat tools, and SaaS products with embedded AI features -- fall unambiguously within Scope 3 Category 1 under the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), which requires disclosure for fiscal years starting January 2024. Yet no standardised methodology exists for including them in corporate GHG inventories. Current practice either omits the category entirely or applies a generic economic input-output (EEIO) factor calibrated to the ICT sector as a whole, overestimating AI inference emissions by 10-40x relative to physically derived alternatives. We propose a four-tier framework that matches estimation precision to the data organisations can realistically obtain, progressing from direct token-based physical estimation -- using GPU energy benchmarks and regional grid carbon intensities -- down to a spend-based EEIO fallback for services where no usage data exists. Emission factors are derived from peer-reviewed GPU energy benchmarks (ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3), confirmed grid carbon intensities (EPA eGRID 2023; Ember 2023), and published water use effectiveness data (Li et al., 2025). Applied to a 200-person European firm, the framework yields a total below 1 tCO2e, illustrating that the compliance challenge is methodological rather than magnitude-driven. We further document a water-carbon trade-off that current ESG tools do not surface: Sweden's hydro-dominated grid delivers the lowest carbon intensity in our dataset but the highest water footprint, with direct implications for data centre location strategy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI推理服务在企业温室气体清单（Scope 3 Category 1）中缺乏标准化核算方法的问题，提出四层方法论框架，从物理基准估算到支出基础回退。应用于一家200人欧洲公司，总排放低于1 tCO2e，并揭示了水碳权衡现象。
Motivation: 现有企业温室气体报告忽略AI推理服务或使用过于粗略的行业平均排放因子，导致高估10-40倍，亟需标准化方法论。
Method: 四层框架：第1层基于token数、GPU能耗基准和区域电网碳强度进行物理估算；第2层使用供应商排放数据；第3层应用行业平均因子；第4层采用支出基础EEIO回退。
Result: 案例企业总排放低于1 tCO2e；瑞典的水电主导电网碳强度最低但水足迹最高，形成水碳权衡。
Conclusion: AI推理排放的合规挑战是方法论而非规模驱动；当前ESG工具未体现水碳权衡，影响数据中心选址策略。

papers.title: Post-Quantum Secure Federated DeFi for Inclusive Banking
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in error-corrected qubits have accelerated the timeline for practical quantum computing. It poses a threat to cryptographic primitives used to secure financial systems, government infrastructure, communication networks, and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) ecosystems. This paper introduces a post-quantum secure federated DeFi framework that enables inter-bank collaboration to improve the inclusivity of individuals underserved by local lenders due to limited financial histories. Multiple banks contribute encrypted information batches to a virtual server, where lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables end-to-end homomorphic computation. The server fuses local data-driven probabilistic assessments, expert beliefs, and verifiable evidence generated by the NASA-IBM Prithvi Geospatial Foundation Model (GFM), in encrypted format. Decentralized technologies are employed to ensure tamper-proof evidence and auditable accountability for all encrypted data exchanges between institutions and the server. The framework is tested on agricultural lending decisions for rural borrowers in Virginia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个抗量子安全的联邦DeFi框架，使银行能够在不暴露原始数据的情况下协作评估贷款申请，特别针对缺乏金融记录的农村借款人。框架利用格基全同态加密（FHE）在加密状态下融合本地数据驱动评估、专家意见和NASA-IBM Prithvi地理空间基础模型的证据，并通过去中心化技术确保数据交换的可审计性。在弗吉尼亚州农业贷款场景中进行了测试。
Motivation: 量子计算的进展威胁现有金融系统密码学基础；同时，传统银行因缺乏信用记录难以服务农村借款人，需要安全且包容的跨机构协作方案。
Method: 提出联邦DeFi框架：多家银行将加密信息批次提交至虚拟服务器，服务器使用格基全同态加密进行端到端同态计算，融合本地概率评估、专家信念及NASA-IBM Prithvi地理空间基础模型生成的加密证据，并采用去中心化技术确保防篡改和可审计性。
Result: 在弗吉尼亚州农业贷款决策场景中进行了测试，但摘要未报告具体量化结果。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了在量子威胁下通过联邦DeFi提升金融服务包容性的可行性，但实际部署需进一步评估性能和扩展性。

papers.title: Envision4D: Envisioning Visual Futures via Feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting the future evolution of dynamic scenes is crucial in autonomous driving. However, existing feed-forward paradigms are primarily designed for interpolation. When extended to future extrapolation, they suffer from ghosting artifacts under large displacements and are constrained by simplified motion assumptions or strict future priors. To overcome these challenges, we propose Envision4D, a fully self-supervised feed-forward framework for pose-free future extrapolation. Specifically, we introduce a Future Pose Prediction module that infers future camera parameters via an iterative denoising process. Furthermore, to capture non-linear dynamics, we propose In-layer Temporal Attention and employ Conditioned Motion Lifting, which transforms the highly uncertain extrapolation process into robust relational mappings. Finally, a Progressive Training Strategy is utilized to stabilize unsupervised motion learning against error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Envision4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods in future view synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Envision4D 是一个完全自监督的前馈框架，用于自动驾驶中无位姿的未来场景外推。它通过未来姿态预测模块（迭代去噪）、层内时间注意力与条件运动提升将不确定的外推转化为稳健的关系映射，并采用渐进式训练策略稳定无监督运动学习。实验表明，该方法在未来的视图合成任务上显著超越现有方法，达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有前馈方法主要针对插值设计，扩展到未来外推时在大位移下产生鬼影，且受限于简化运动假设或严格的未来先验。
Method: 提出 Envision4D，包括未来姿态预测模块（通过迭代去噪推断未来相机参数）、层内时间注意力与条件运动提升（将不确定的外推转化为关系映射），以及渐进式训练策略。
Result: 摘要报告 Envision4D 在未来的视图合成上显著优于现有方法，达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法是一个完全自监督、无需位姿的前馈框架，能够有效解决自动驾驶中的未来外推挑战。

papers.title: STEDiff: Strengthening Text Embedding for Text-to-Image Alignment in Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Although pretrained text-to-image (T2I) generation models can produce high-quality images, they often fail to faithfully reflect the semantic intent of complex prompts due to stochastic noise and inherent model limitations. This issue frequently manifests as the model overlooking specific objects or failing to correctly bind attributes to their corresponding entities, a challenge referred to as semantic alignment. Unlike existing approaches that rely on computationally expensive fine-tuning or labor-intensive layout priors, we propose STEDiff, a training-free method designed to enhance semantic representations directly within the text-embedding space. Specifically, we introduce a method that primarily leverages the [EOT] token to strengthen the relevant semantics of sub-sentences and then replaces the corresponding tokens in the original prompt. Furthermore, a novel semantic enhancement loss is incorporated to enforce spatial constraints, ensuring that the semantics of each entity are precisely mapped to their respective image regions. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on the T2I-CompBench demonstrate that our method notably improves semantic consistency and generation integrity in complex scenarios.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STEDiff，一种无需训练的文本到图像生成语义对齐方法，通过在文本嵌入空间中利用[EOT] token增强子句语义并引入语义增强损失施加空间约束，显著提升复杂提示下的语义一致性。在T2I-CompBench上的定量和定性评估验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法无需训练即可有效改善语义对齐，为文本到图像生成提供了轻量级解决方案。

papers.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed to advance long-video understanding and agentic intelligence. To address the challenges of ultra-long contexts, information redundancy, and prohibitive computational costs inherent in hour-level videos, Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, enabling lossless 256K context processing while capturing critical frames and long-range temporal dependencies. This architecture is underpinned by a highly optimized training and inference infrastructure, including scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels that significantly maximize throughput and minimize computational overhead. Furthermore, to overcome the algorithmic dilemma of catastrophic forgetting during multi-task alignment, we introduce Cross-Modal Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) paired with Context-RL and Video-RL. By distilling dense token-level teacher feedback from on-policy rollouts back into the MoE backbone, which activates only 3B parameters, Keye-VL-2.0 natively empowers advanced agent collaboration across Code, Tool, and Search scenarios with multimodal self-correction. Extensive evaluations across video understanding, temporal grounding, reasoning, STEM, and agent benchmarks demonstrate that Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of similar scale, particularly excelling in fine-grained temporal localization on TimeLens and long-video comprehension on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench. We release our model checkpoints to accelerate community progress toward scalable and robust multimodal agentic applications.
