papers.title: Dynamic Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: The scalability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to long contexts is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic complexity of standard attention, motivating the adoption of linear attention mechanisms with sub-quadratic cost. To improve representation capacity under long contexts, recent approaches organize memory in a multi-state manner. However, existing multi-state linear attention methods rely on fixed state merging policies that cannot adapt to dynamically varying token importance, irreversibly obscuring critical tokens and causing severe error accumulation over long sequences. To address this limitation, we propose DLA, a dynamic memory modeling framework for multi-state linear attention. DLA introduces (i) Information-Aware Dynamic State Merging, which adaptively determines state boundaries based on token-level information variation, preserving high-resolution representations around semantic transitions while aggressively summarizing stable regions, and (ii) Capacity-Bounded Memory Modeling, which maintains a fixed-size, chronologically ordered state cache by selectively merging adjacent low-information states to control memory growth with minimal information loss. We pre-train DLA on two different linear attention models and evaluate on 16 datasets across three categories. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of DLA over state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态线性注意力（DLA）框架，用于多状态线性注意力的动态内存建模。DLA包含信息感知的动态状态合并和容量受限的内存建模，以解决现有方法因固定状态合并策略导致的错误累积问题。在16个数据集上的实验表明DLA优于现有最优方法。
Motivation: 现有线性注意力方法在处理长上下文时，固定状态合并策略无法适应动态变化的token重要性，导致关键token被掩盖和错误累积。
Method: 提出DLA框架，包括信息感知的动态状态合并（根据token信息变化自适应调整状态边界）和容量受限的内存建模（通过选择性合并相邻低信息状态控制内存增长）。
Result: 在两种不同的线性注意力模型上预训练，并在16个数据集上评估，实验结果显示DLA优于现有最优方法。
Conclusion: DLA通过动态内存建模有效缓解了长序列中的错误累积问题，提升了线性注意力在长上下文任务中的表现。

papers.title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Token-level credit assignment remains a key obstacle for reinforcement learning (RL) in large language models (LLMs), where RL recipes typically treat all tokens equally, failing to distinguish decisive reasoning steps from routine formatting or fluent filler. Recent attempts leverage model-internal signals to assign finer-grained credit, but these are often point-wise heuristics that ignore the global structure of information propagation. We propose FlowTracer, an RL framework that traces answer-targeted reasoning flow on an attention-induced directed acyclic graph in which nodes correspond to tokens and edge capacities come from aggregated attention weights and derives token credit from this global structure. The edge capacities are reweighted to retain only the influence that can reach the answer region, while enforcing local flow conservation so intermediate tokens neither lose nor gain effective mass due to path length or irrelevant branches. On this graph, FlowTracer extracts an information-flow backbone connecting the question to the answer and scores tokens by flow throughput, revealing high-impact hubs and aggregation checkpoints that mediate long-range dependencies. These derived importances are used to shape token-level rewards, enabling learning signals to focus precisely on the tokens that route information toward (or away from) correct answers and delivering consistent performance gains across a range of reasoning tasks.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowTracer 框架，通过注意力诱导的有向无环图追踪答案导向的推理信息流，为 LLM 中的强化学习提供细粒度 token 级信用分配。该方法重加权注意力边容量以保留能到达答案区域的流量，并局部守恒约束，从而提取从问题到答案的信息流骨干，计算 token 的流量吞吐量作为重要性分数，用于塑造 token 级奖励。
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法在 LLM 中常对所有 token 一视同仁，未能区分关键推理步骤与格式化填充词，导致信用分配粗糙。
Method: 构建注意力诱导的有向无环图，节点为 token，边容量为聚合注意力权重；重加权边容量仅保留能到达答案区域的影响，并施加局部流守恒；提取信息流骨干，计算 token 的流吞吐量作为重要性。
Result: 在多种推理任务上，使用 FlowTracer 引导的 token 级奖励持续提升了性能。
Conclusion: 通过追踪信息流结构并基于流吞吐量分配信用，可以实现更精确的 token 级强化学习信号，提升推理能力。

papers.title: ManiSplat: Manipulation Trajectory Synthesis from Monocular Video via Decoupled 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic and interactive 3D scenes from real-world observations remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. While recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled high-fidelity static reconstruction, extending it to interactive environments with articulated robots and manipulable objects remains difficult due to complex contact interactions and abrupt pose changes. To address these challenges, we introduce ManiSplat, a unified framework that reconstructs controllable and decoupled Gaussian digital twins directly from monocular ego-view robotic videos. Our method introduces a Graph-Structured Disentangled Representation that separates the robot, objects, and background into independently optimizable Gaussian subfields organized within a scene graph. To ensure stability, we propose a Task-Oriented Spatio-Temporal Alignment module that leverages the inherent logic of manipulation tasks-alternating between Motion and Skill phases-to construct accurate pseudo-ground-truth trajectories. Finally, a joint photometric-geometric optimization ensures the reconstructed scenes are temporally coherent, physically consistent, and simulation-ready. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach reconstructs interaction-driven dynamic scenes with high fidelity and controllability, effectively supporting downstream robotic tasks and policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ManiSplat，一种从单目第一人称机器人视频重建可控且解耦的高斯数字孪生的统一框架。该方法通过图结构解耦表示将机器人、物体和背景分离为独立优化的高斯子场，并利用任务导向时空对齐模块构建伪真值轨迹，再通过联合光度几何优化保证时间一致性和物理一致性。实验表明，该方法能高保真、可控制地重建交互驱动动态场景，并有效支持下游机器人任务和策略学习。
Motivation: 从真实观测重建动态交互3D场景是计算机视觉和机器人学的基本挑战。现有3D高斯泼溅在静态重建上表现良好，但扩展到含铰接机器人和可操纵物体的交互环境时，由于复杂接触交互和姿态突变而困难。
Method: 提出 ManiSplat 框架，包括：图结构解耦表示将场景分解为独立优化的高斯子场；任务导向时空对齐模块利用操纵任务中运动和技能阶段的交替逻辑构建伪真值轨迹；以及联合光度几何优化保证时空一致性和物理一致性。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法重建的交互驱动动态场景具有高保真度和可控性，有效支持下游机器人任务和策略学习。
Conclusion: ManiSplat 使重建场景达到模拟就绪状态，可直接用于策略学习，为从真实视频到可交互数字孪生提供了一种新范式。

papers.title: PhysMetrics.Weather: An Evaluation Framework for Physical Consistency in ML Weather Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning weather prediction (MLWP) models have achieved impressive forecasting performance at a small fraction of the computational costs required for traditional physics-based methods. However, they are primarily (1) data-driven and (2) evaluated using pixel-wide error metrics (e.g., RMSE), so there are no guarantees that their forecasts are consistent with known physical laws. We introduce PhysMetrics.Weather, an evaluation framework that assesses the physical realism of MLWP models across three types of metrics: conservation, spectral, and dynamical. By quantifying physical realism, this tool guides the development of physics-informed architectures and helps evaluate whether MLWP models are reliable for operational use. Our framework is available on Github at https://github.com/Emmakast/PhysMetrics.Weather.

papers.title: ChartLens: A Dual-Branch Framework for Chart Data Correction and Factual Summary Refinement
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we present our champion solution for the DataMFM Challenge Track 2: Chart Understanding. This track requires models to recover structured chart data and generate faithful natural-language summaries from chart images. To address the complementary requirements of accurate data extraction and factual narration, we propose ChartLens, a dual-branch framework for chart data correction and summary refinement. ChartLens consists of two key modules: Structure-Aware CSV Verification and Correction (SAVC) and Text-Retention-Guided Summary Refinement (TRSR). SAVC improves the reliability of structured data extraction through verification and correction, while TRSR enhances summary generation by preserving critical textual and numerical evidence from charts. By combining model adaptation, correction-based generation, and OCR-assisted evidence grounding, ChartLens improves both structured data recovery and summary factuality. On the test set, our final system achieves an overall score of 69.10 and ranks first in Track 2, demonstrating its effectiveness for accurate chart understanding. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/CVPRW26-ChartLens.

papers.title: Is Fairness Truly Fair? Towards Reliable Lipschitz Fairness in Multi-Task Learning via Fixed-\texorpdfstring{$δ$}{delta} Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Lipschitz-style individual fairness formalizes the idea that semantically similar examples should receive similar predictions, but its evaluation in multi-task learning (MTL) can be confounded by method-induced representation scales. This paper identifies threshold confounding: when the auditing tolerance is derived from each model's own representation distances, different algorithms are compared under different semantic thresholds. A threshold-drift analysis further shows how Bias rankings can change and identifies sufficient conditions for ranking preservation. We propose \textbf{ReLiF}, a reliability-aware framework that separates evaluation-time fixed-$δ$ auditing from training-time controlled regularization. ReLiF uses a shared reference tolerance for comparable auditing and a violation-rate feedback controller to keep the Lipschitz surrogate active without letting it dominate stochastic training. This work also develops supporting analysis for threshold drift, reference-tolerance selection, and the relationship between the huberized training surrogate and its unsmoothed positive-margin counterpart. Experiments on clinical time-series benchmarks and NYUv2 (NYU Depth V2) dense prediction show that fixed-$δ$ auditing exposes utility--fairness trade-offs that method-dependent thresholds can obscure. On NYUv2 with a ResNet50 backbone, ReLiF achieves competitive utility while substantially reducing aligned bias under shared fixed thresholds. On clinical benchmarks, ReLiF yields controlled fairness-regularized trade-offs, while fixed-$δ$ auditing reveals that task-balancing baselines can sometimes achieve lower bias and that genuine utility--fairness trade-offs persist. These results support fixed-$δ$ auditing as a semantically consistent protocol for evaluating Lipschitz fairness in MTL.

TL;DR: 本文提出ReliF框架，解决多任务学习中Lipschitz个体公平性评估的阈值混淆问题，采用固定δ审计与可控正则化分离的方法，在临床时间序列和NYUv2基准上展示了更可靠的公平性-效用权衡。
Motivation: 多任务学习中，Lipschitz公平性评估因方法依赖的代表性尺度导致阈值漂移，不同算法在同一语义阈值下无法公平比较。
Method: 提出ReliF框架：在评估时使用固定参考阈值进行固定δ审计，训练时通过违规率反馈控制器控制Lipschitz代理正则化强度，避免主导随机训练。
Result: 在NYUv2（ResNet50骨干）上，ReliF在保持竞争效用的同时显著降低固定阈值下的对齐偏差；在临床基准上，固定δ审计揭示了任务平衡基线有时可实现更低偏差。
Conclusion: 固定δ审计可作为多任务学习中评估Lipschitz公平性的语义一致协议，暴露方法依赖阈值可能掩盖的真实权衡。

papers.title: Leveraging Metric Depth for Relative Depth Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We present our solution to the 2025 SoccerNet Monocular Depth Estimation Competition Challenge. Predicting the relative depth in football scenarios is challenging, especially with only thousands of training samples available. To address this issue, our method leverages the powerful zero-shot capabilities of models pretrained on large-scale datasets to learn metric depth for effective relative depth prediction, achieving a score of $2.68 \times 10^{-3}$ on the challenge set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用预训练模型零样本学习度量深度（metric depth）的方法，用于足球场景的相对深度预测，以应对训练样本稀少的问题。在SoccerNet Monocular Depth Estimation竞赛的挑战集上取得2.68×10^{-3}的得分。
Motivation: 足球场景中相对深度预测任务因仅有数千训练样本而面临挑战，现有方法难以泛化。
Method: 借助大规模数据集预训练模型的零样本能力，先学习度量深度，再将其转化为相对深度预测。
Result: 在SoccerNet竞赛挑战集上取得2.68×10^{-3}的得分。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确总结，但该方法在有限训练数据下有效。

papers.title: Profy: Interpretable Visualization of Expertise-Dependent Motor Skills Toward Supporting Piano Practice
papers.abstract_en: The quality of piano performance depends on nuanced timing, articulation, and dynamic control, but practice feedback is often summary-based and hard to act on. We introduce Profy, a weakly supervised system that learns from take-level labels derived from aggregated listener ratings (expert-labeled vs. amateur-labeled) to produce time-aligned highlights for review during piano practice. We collected synchronized 1 kHz key-motion and audio from 73 pianists and used 1,083 valid takes for modeling and evaluation. The model outputs clip-level predictions together with evidence scores on a shared resampled model time base for visualization. On 20 amateur clips from short technique studies annotated by 21 expert pianists, the displayed highlight score aligns with passages that expert pianists marked for review despite training without localized labels (Pearson r=0.61, ROC-AUC 0.75). Rather than summarizing a take with a single global score, Profy helps learners decide where to inspect next by supporting scrubbing, looping, and focused replay of time-localized passages associated with expert-amateur differences.
papers.comment: Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS '26), June 13-17, 2026, Singapore, Singapore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Profy 系统，一种弱监督学习方法，利用从听众评分聚合得到的“取次”级别标签（专家标记 vs 业余标记），在钢琴练习中生成时间对齐的高亮片段供学习者回顾。系统收集了73位钢琴家的同步1kHz键运动与音频数据，使用1083个有效取次进行建模与评估。在21个由专家钢琴家标注的短技巧练习业余片段上，高亮分数与专家标记的需复习段落一致（Pearson r=0.61，ROC-AUC 0.75）。Profy 帮助学习者通过时间定位片段（支持快进、循环、聚焦回放）决定下一步检查位置。
Motivation: 钢琴练习反馈常基于整体总结，难以指导具体改进；缺乏时间定位的直观可视化方法以区分专家与业余差异。
Method: 使用弱监督学习，从听众评分聚合得到的取次级别标签（专家 vs 业余）训练模型，输出片段级别预测及证据分数，在共享重采样模型时间基上可视化。
Result: 在21个业余片段上，高亮分数与专家标注的需复习段落相关性为 Pearson r=0.61，ROC-AUC 0.75。
Conclusion: Profy 通过时间局部化的高亮显示帮助钢琴学习者定位需要加强练习的段落，而非单一全局评分。

papers.title: STORM: Stepwise Token Optimization with Reward-Guided Beam Search
papers.abstract_en: Modern retrieval increasingly relies on dense and learned-sparse neural models that are effective but require encoding the entire corpus into a specialized index, rebuilt whenever the model changes. Lexical retrievers like BM25 stay efficient and transparent on a standard inverted index that need not change as models evolve, but suffer from vocabulary mismatch. LLM query rewriting can help, yet prompted rewriters emit well-formed but retrieval-ineffective or harmful-terms, and training against a retrieval reward gives only delayed, sequence-level supervision that obscures which terms helped. We introduce STORM (Stepwise Token Optimization with Reward-guided beaM search), a self-supervised framework for lexical query expansion. STORM trains the rewriter through generation guided by retrieval metrics: at each step, candidate expansions are scored against the BM25 index and low-reward continuations pruned, turning the retrieval reward into a token-level signal that concentrates exploration on retrieval-effective vocabulary. Across TREC DL and BEIR, STORM lets 0.6B-8B backbones match or surpass competitive LLM rewriters while retrieving as fast as plain BM25; at 8B it rivals far larger proprietary rewriters. It further transfers zero-shot to 18 languages (MIRACL), beating dedicated multilingual dense retrievers on average, making STORM a competitive, infrastructure-light alternative to dense neural retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STORM框架，一种基于检索奖励引导的束搜索（beam search）的自监督词法查询扩展方法。STORM在每一步利用BM25检索指标对候选扩展进行评分，剪枝低奖励的后续生成，从而将检索奖励转化为token级别的信号，引导生成检索有效的词汇。实验表明，在TREC DL和BEIR基准上，STORM使得0.6B-8B的骨干模型匹配或超越竞争性的LLM重写器，且检索速度与纯BM25相当；8B模型可与更大的专有重写器竞争。此外，STORM零样本迁移到18种语言（MIRACL），平均超越专用多语言稠密检索器。
Motivation: 现有LLM查询重写器虽然能生成格式良好的查询，但可能包含检索低效或有害词；且端到端训练使用检索奖励仅提供延迟的序列级监督，难以识别哪些词起到了关键作用。词法检索器如BM25有词汇不匹配问题，需要一种能生成检索有效词汇的自我监督方法。
Method: 提出STORM，一种基于检索奖励引导的束搜索的逐步令牌优化框架。在生成每个步骤时，使用BM25检索指标评估当前候选扩展，并剪枝低奖励的后续生成，从而在token级别提供监督信号，引导模型探索检索有效的词汇空间。
Result: 在TREC DL和BEIR基准上，STORM使得0.6B-8B的模型匹配或超越竞争性LLM重写器，检索速度与纯BM25相同；8B模型可与更大专有重写器竞争。零样本迁移到18种语言（MIRACL），平均超越专用多语言稠密检索器。
Conclusion: STORM是一种无需密集神经检索基础设施的高竞争力替代方案，使得轻量级模型通过词法检索获得优于稠密检索的性能。

papers.title: Can Image Models Imagine Time? ImageTime: A Novel Benchmark for Probing Visual World Modeling Through Spatiotemporal Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Image generation models now produce high-quality static images, yet their ability to represent how a visual world changes over time remains poorly understood. Practical workflows such as storyboarding, step-by-step illustration, reference-guided editing, and video previsualization require models to preserve identities, objects, spatial relations, and causal order across multiple visual states. Existing evaluations largely measure single-image correctness, compositional alignment, or video quality, leaving open whether an image model can coherently imagine a temporally ordered process. We introduce ImageTime, a diagnostic benchmark that uses spatiotemporal consistency as a behavioral probe of visual world modeling in image generation. Given an action instruction, and optionally a reference image specifying the initial state, a model must generate one image containing four ordered key states: initial state, action onset, transition state, and final state. This four-keyframe protocol is more temporally demanding than single-image generation while avoiding the confounds of dense video dynamics. ImageTime organizes tasks with a progressive capability hierarchy and decomposes each scenario into stage-wise state predicates, cross-frame temporal constraints, and forbidden causal violations. GPT-5.5 scores all generated images under a structured VLM-as-judge protocol, producing interpretable capability scores, diagnostic subscores, and failure labels. Through multi-family benchmarking, ImageTime reveals where current image generation systems succeed, fail, and drift when asked to maintain coherent visual world states over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ImageTime基准，用于评估图像生成模型在时间维度上保持视觉世界一致性的能力。基准通过四关键帧协议（初始状态、动作起始、过渡状态、最终状态）测试模型能否在多个时间步中保持身份、物体、空间关系和因果顺序。实验使用GPT-5.5作为评判，揭示当前模型的优势和失败模式。
Motivation: 现有图像生成评估主要集中在单图像正确性或视频质量，缺乏对模型能否连贯地模拟时间有序过程的诊断工具。
Method: 设计ImageTime基准，包含动作指令和可选参考图像，要求生成四帧关键状态；采用分阶段状态谓词、跨帧时序约束和因果违规禁止；使用GPT-5.5作为结构化VLM评判生成能力分数和失败标签。
Result: 通过多家族模型基准测试，揭示了当前图像生成系统在维护跨时间视觉世界状态时的成功、失败和漂移模式。
Conclusion: 该基准为评估图像模型的时空一致性提供了系统化工具，有助于理解生成模型在时间建模上的局限性。

papers.title: SSR-Merge: Subspace Signal Routing for Training-Free LoRA Merging in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) merging can efficiently combine diverse generative capabilities from multiple trained LoRAs for a diffusion model. However, existing LoRA merging techniques often suffer from severe parameter interference, causing destructive collisions in the shared parameter space. To address this, we propose Subspace Signal Routing (SSR), which resolves interference by routing internal signals instead of performing parameter-space merge. Specifically, SSR first constructs a unified subspace by concatenating candidate LoRAs along the rank dimension. Next, SSR employs an inverse correlation matrix to decorrelate mixed signals within this space. Finally, a directional guide matrix steers these purified signals into their respective task-specific subspaces. We provide a rigorous theoretical analysis proving that SSR aligns with the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) solution, thereby ensuring mathematical optimality. We utilize the additivity of sufficient statistics to design a streaming algorithm. This enables on-the-fly updates that significantly reduce memory overhead and computation time. Extensive experiments validate that SSR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/nagara214/SSR-Merge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出子空间信号路由（SSR）方法，用于解决扩散模型中多个LoRA合并时的参数干扰问题。SSR通过沿秩维度拼接候选LoRA构建统一子空间，利用逆相关矩阵解耦混合信号，并借助方向引导矩阵将净化后的信号路由到各自任务子空间。理论分析证明SSR等价于普通最小二乘解，并利用充分统计量的可加性设计流式算法以降低内存和计算开销。实验表明SSR显著优于现有方法且效率相当。
Motivation: 现有LoRA合并技术常因参数空间共享而导致严重干扰，造成破坏性冲突，影响多能力融合效果。
Method: 提出SSR方法：首先沿秩维度拼接候选LoRA构建统一子空间；然后使用逆相关矩阵解耦混合信号；最后通过方向引导矩阵将信号路由到任务特定子空间。基于充分统计量的可加性设计流式算法实现实时更新。
Result: 实验验证SSR在扩散模型多LoRA合并任务上显著优于现有方法，同时保持可比的效率。
Conclusion: SSR通过路由内部信号而非参数空间合并，从根本上解决了参数干扰，其数学最优性由OLS等价性保证，且流式算法提升了实际可用性。

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents accumulate observations, reasoning traces, and retrieved facts that exceed their finite context windows, making memory retention a fundamental resource-allocation problem. Existing memory systems improve management through heuristic scoring, retrieval optimization, or learned compression, but largely treat retention as a local decision problem and do not explicitly model its long-term consequences under realistic observability constraints. To fill this gap, we formulate memory retention as a constrained stochastic optimization problem with explicit budget feasibility, evidence utility, and delayed costs including miss penalties, reacquisition delays, and stale-information risk. We then propose OSL-MR (Observability-Safe Learning for Memory Retention), a novel framework that enforces a strict separation between online-observable features and offline-available supervision (OAS). OSL-MR combines an evidence learner trained from realized evidence supervision with a Mixed-Score heuristic that serves both as a deployable online-safe baseline and as a structured inductive prior for learning. The resulting policy learns query-conditioned evidence value directly from interaction data while remaining deployable under the same observability constraints. Experiments on LOCOMO and LongMemEval show that OSL-MR consistently outperforms recency-based methods, Generative Agents-style scoring, and other heuristic baselines, particularly under tight memory budgets. The Mixed-Score prior further improves precision while preserving recall, and sensitivity analysis demonstrates robustness across a wide range of cost configurations.

Motivation: 现有记忆系统多将保留视为局部决策问题，未显式建模有限可观测性下的长期后果，导致资源分配低效。
Method: 将记忆保留建模为约束随机优化问题，引入预算可行性、证据效用、延迟成本等要素；提出OSL-MR框架，包含基于在线特征训练的evidence learner和混合分数启发式（兼作在线安全基线和归纳先验）。
Result: 在LOCOMO和LongMemEval上，OSL-MR在紧预算下持续优于基于新近度的方法、Generative Agents风格评分及其他启发式基线；混合分数先验提高了精度同时保持召回率，且对成本配置具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: OSL-MR通过可观测安全的约束优化有效改进了长时程代理的记忆保留，混合分数先验提供结构性归纳偏置，适用于有限观测场景。

papers.title: Dexterous Point Policy: Learning Point-based Dexterous Hand Policies from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Robotic foundation models pre-trained on human demonstration videos have shown promise, but a significant embodiment gap remains when the resulting policies are deployed on real robots. A common remedy is to fine-tune these models on robot-specific demonstrations. However, robot data collection can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, which is particularly acute in dexterous manipulation, e.g., teleoperating a multi-fingered hand for even a single atomic task can take days. To address this, we introduce Dexterous Point Policy, a framework that learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos and requires no robot demonstrations. Our core insight is that a unified 3D keypoint representation can bridge human and robot embodiments when used for both observations and actions. Specifically, we extract 3D keypoints of task-relevant objects and human hands from raw videos, and train an autoregressive transformer over these keypoints. We observe that at the keypoint level, specifically the wrist and fingertips, human and robot behaviors closely align, enabling direct policy transfer. On a suite of real-robot tasks spanning pick-and-place and tool use, Dexterous Point Policy attains 75.0% success, whereas a state-of-the-art VLA baseline reaches only 1.0%. Furthermore, our method generalizes strongly to unseen scenarios, including multi-object environments and novel object categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dexterous Point Policy，一种直接从人类视频学习灵巧操作策略的框架，无需机器人演示。通过提取任务相关物体和人手的 3D 关键点，训练自回归 Transformer，利用关键点级别（手腕和指尖）上人类与机器人行为的对齐实现策略迁移。在真实机器人拾放和工具使用任务上达到 75.0% 成功率，远超 SOTA VLA 基线（1.0%），并泛化到多物体和未见物体类别。
Motivation: 机器人基础模型预训练后存在具身差距，常见微调方法依赖昂贵的机器人数据收集，尤其在灵巧操作中遥操作多指手耗时数天。
Method: 从人类视频中提取任务相关物体和人手的 3D 关键点，训练一个自回归 Transformer 模型，将关键点序列作为观测和动作表示，利用手腕和指尖关键点对齐人类与机器人行为。
Result: 在真实机器人任务套件上达到 75.0% 成功率，而 SOTA VLA 基线仅 1.0%；在未见的多物体环境和新型物体类别上表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 统一的 3D 关键点表示能有效桥接人类与机器人具身，实现无需机器人演示的灵巧操作策略学习。

papers.title: Fast and Highly Expressive Policy Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning via Bootstrapped Flow Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based Q-learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but its reliance on multi-step denoising makes both training and inference computationally expensive and brittle. Recent efforts to accelerate diffusion Q-learning toward single-step action generation typically introduce auxiliary networks, policy distillation, or multi-phase training, which frequently compromise simplicity, stability, or performance. To address these limitations, we introduce Bootstrapped Flow Q-Learning (BFQ), a novel framework that enables accurate single-step action generation during both training and inference, without auxiliary networks or distillation procedures. BFQ adopts a divide-and-conquer view of the displacement vector along the flow path: it begins by learning short-range displacements that can be accurately estimated from the Flow Matching marginal velocity, and bootstraps these components to directly learn a noise-to-action mapping in a single step. This formulation eliminates multi-step denoising, resulting in a learning procedure that is substantially faster, simpler, and more robust. Extensive D4RL evaluations show that BFQ improves performance while significantly reducing computational cost compared to multi-step diffusion baselines, demonstrating that single-step action generation suffices for high-performance offline Reinforcement Learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bootstrapped Flow Q-Learning (BFQ)，一种用于离线强化学习的单步动作生成框架。BFQ 采用分治策略，先学习流路径上的短程位移，再自举学习噪声到动作的直接映射，避免了多步去噪。在 D4RL 基准上，BFQ 提升了性能并显著降低了计算成本。
Motivation: 扩散 Q-learning 依赖多步去噪，导致训练和推理计算昂贵且不稳定；现有加速方法引入辅助网络或蒸馏，牺牲了简单性、稳定性或性能。
Method: 采用分治思想，将位移向量分解为短程分量，利用 Flow Matching 边际速度学习这些分量，然后通过自举直接学习单步噪声到动作映射，无需多步去噪。
Result: 在 D4RL 基准上，BFQ 在提升性能的同时显著减少计算成本，表明单步动作生成足以实现高性能离线强化学习。
Conclusion: 单步动作生成对于高性能离线强化学习是足够的，BFQ 提供了一种更快、更简单、更鲁棒的学习过程。

papers.title: GaussTrace: Provenance Analysis of 3D Gaussian Splatting Models with Evidence-based LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a powerful technique for creating high-fidelity 3D assets. However, the widespread sharing and iterative modification of 3DGS models across digital platforms create pressing challenges for intellectual property protection and forensic traceability. To address this, we propose GaussTrace, a novel framework for constructing directed provenance graphs for 3DGS models. GaussTrace formulates provenance analysis as an evidence-based reasoning problem. It builds upon attribute-wise statistical profiling of 3DGS parameters to capture intrinsic properties. Moreover, we introduce hypothesis-driven editing simulations of common operations to provide auxiliary evidence for plausible transformation pathways. These statistical and simulated cues jointly enable a Large Language Model (LLM) to perform structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, yielding directional provenance inferences and explainable edge reasons. Experimental results demonstrate that GaussTrace effectively constructs evolutionary relationships among diverse 3DGS models, delivering accurate, interpretable, and robust provenance graphs without requiring model training or access to editing histories. Project page: https://haolianghan.github.io/GaussTrace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussTrace 框架，用于 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 模型的溯源分析，通过属性统计分布和假设驱动的编辑模拟生成证据，并利用大语言模型 (LLM) 进行链式推理以构建有向溯源图，在无训练和无编辑历史条件下实现准确、可解释且鲁棒的溯源。
Motivation: 3DGS 模型在数字平台上的广泛共享和迭代修改带来了知识产权保护和取证溯源的挑战，现有方法缺乏有效的溯源分析手段。
Method: 将溯源分析形式化为基于证据的推理问题，包括对 3DGS 参数进行属性级统计刻画，以及引入假设驱动的常见操作编辑模拟以提供辅助证据，最后通过 LLM 进行结构化链式推理输出有向溯源边和可解释理由。
Result: 实验表明 GaussTrace 能有效构建多种 3DGS 模型间的演化关系，生成准确、可解释且鲁棒的溯源图，无需模型训练或编辑历史。
Conclusion: GaussTrace 为 3DGS 模型的溯源提供了一种无需训练、可解释的解决方案，但尚未涉及大规模或真实复杂编辑场景的评估。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for 2D Irregular Nesting
papers.abstract_en: Traditional heuristic solvers for the 2D irregular nesting problem share a fundamental limitation: they are blind to polygon geometry, relying on guided brute-force to navigate the continuous placement space with minimal geometrical guidance. In this paper, we argue that Reinforcement Learning is uniquely positioned to overcome this bottleneck. By pairing an optimization policy with a geometry-aware neural encoder, an agent can automatically discover rich geometric priors directly from data, utilizing these learned intuitions to strategically guide exploration. To realize this, we introduce the Polygons Transformer (PoT), a novel architecture that encodes 2D continuous vector geometries while allowing cross-polygons attention. We couple this novel architecture with a Combinatorial Optimization Reinforcement Learning (CORL) training framework to find optimal solutions. To support this paradigm, we release an open-source training dataset derived from complex geographic contours alongside a dedicated evaluation benchmark. Our empirical validation demonstrates that our trained agent achieves area utilization performance highly competitive with Sparrow, the state-of-the-art heuristic solver, proving that reinforcement learning can successfully discover and exploit geometric awareness for precise spatial tasks.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Under review at the European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL)

papers.title: Causal Ensemble Agent: Hierarchical Causal Discovery with LLM-guided Expert Reweighting
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery aims to uncover causal structures from observational data, which is crucial for real-world decision-making. However, different causal discovery algorithms can produce divergent results that conflict with each other, complicating the identification of accurate causal graphs. Traditional approaches rely on numerical values and statistical assumptions, often ignoring rich domain-specific information, such as feature descriptions, which could also help structure learning. While recent works explore using Large Language Models (LLMs) to infer causal relations via direct queries, such methods can be unreliable due to a lack of alignment with the actual data. To address these limitations, we propose Causal Ensemble Agent (CEA), a novel framework that aggregates structural insights from statistical discovery experts across different graph levels via linear opinion pooling, and uses an LLM as a meta-referee to dynamically reweight experts when the aggregated confidence is close to the decision boundary, thereby composing an improved and more complete causal graph. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that CEA achieves the strongest overall performance across a wide range of causal discovery methods, highlighting the effectiveness of using LLMs for meta-analysis in causal discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Causal Ensemble Agent (CEA)，一种聚合多个因果发现算法（统计发现专家）的框架，通过线性意见池合并不同图层面的结构信息，并利用大语言模型 (LLM) 作为元裁判，在聚合置信度接近决策边界时动态重加权专家，从而构建更完整、更优的因果图。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，CEA 在多种因果发现方法中取得了最强的整体性能，验证了 LLM 在因果发现元分析中的有效性。
Motivation: 不同因果发现算法可能产生相互冲突的结果，传统方法依赖数值和统计假设，忽略了特征描述等丰富的领域特定信息；而直接使用 LLM 查询因果关系的做法因缺乏与真实数据对齐而不可靠。
Method: CEA 框架采用线性意见池 (linear opinion pooling) 聚合来自统计发现专家在不同图层级的结构见解，并引入一个 LLM 作为元裁判，在聚合置信度接近决策边界时动态重加权专家，从而组合出改进的因果图。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验显示，CEA 在多种因果发现方法中取得了最强的整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，使用 LLM 进行元分析能够有效改进因果发现的质量，CEA 框架为融合统计方法和领域知识提供了新思路。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，使用 LLM 进行元分析能够有效改进因果发现的质量，CEA 框架为融合统计方法和领域知识提供了新思路。

papers.title: Globally Localizing Lunar Rover in Pixels via Graph Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Precise rover localization is a prerequisite for autonomous lunar exploration, yet the absence of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals and the cumulative drift of local localization methods severely constrain long-range missions. Cross-view localization provides a promising drift-free global solution by matching rover-view and satellite-view imagery. However, the lunar environment poses unique challenges for correspondence alignment, including inter-entity entanglement, inter-viewpoint divergence, and simulation-to-real domain shift. To address these challenges, we propose Warped Alignment of Reprojected Graphs (WARG), a framework that leverages unified graph learning and reprojected graph matching for robust cross-view alignment. Pretrained on the synthetic LuSNAR dataset, WARG achieves an average test error of 0.32 m and demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization to the synthetic lunar south pole region with an error of 3.63 m. More importantly, when validated on real-world data from the YuTu-2 rover, WARG achieves a localization error of 1.68 m within a 100 m x 100 m search area, corresponding to nearly one-pixel precision in low-resolution satellite imagery with a spatial resolution of 1.40 m/pixel. Beyond accuracy, WARG is computationally efficient, containing only 1.56M parameters, corresponding to 16.12% of previous lightweight models, and operating at 5.49 Hz on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU, approaching GNSS-level update frequency. Finally, we observe that WARG naturally develops low-level spatial awareness, including semantic segmentation and structural reasoning, through cross-view localization learning, highlighting its potential as a promising paradigm for spatial intelligence with minimal annotation cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/maochen-casia/warg.

TL;DR: 本文提出 WARG 框架，通过统一图学习和重投影图匹配，实现月球车与卫星图像的跨视角全局定位，在合成数据集上达到 0.32 m 平均误差，在真实玉兔二号数据上达 1.68 m 定位精度，且模型仅 1.56M 参数，运行速度 5.49 Hz。
Motivation: 月球探测中缺乏 GNSS 信号，现有局部定位方法存在累积漂移，而跨视角定位面临实体纠缠、视角差异和仿真到真实域迁移等挑战。
Method: 提出 WARG (Warped Alignment of Reprojected Graphs)，利用统一图学习和重投影图匹配实现鲁棒的跨视图对齐。

papers.title: Dmsh: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for All-Quad Mesh Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality meshes for arbitrary geometries remains a fundamental bottleneck in computational engineering, often demanding heuristic tuning and semi-manual workflows. In this paper, we introduce Dmsh, a first fully automated reinforcement learning pipeline that unifies geometric decomposition and quadrilateral mesh generation within a single learning-based framework. Dmsh decomposes the problem through three coordinated agents handling topology simplification, geometric regularization, and mesh generation. The meshing process is formulated as a Markov Decision Process and solved using a parametric Soft Actor-Critic architecture with decoupled critics, enabling efficient exploration of a hybrid discrete-continuous action space. A curriculum learning strategy ensures scalability from simple domains to highly complex geometries, suppressing seed variance. By design, the recursive decomposition enables parallel meshing of subregions, yielding globally conforming all-quadrilateral meshes without post hoc correction. Across a wide range of benchmarks, Dmsh consistently outperforms existing methods in automation, robustness, and mesh quality, establishing a new paradigm for learning-based mesh generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dmsh，首个完全自动化的强化学习框架，将几何分解与四边形网格生成统一在单一学习框架中。通过三个协调智能体（拓扑简化、几何正则化、网格生成）将问题分解为马尔可夫决策过程，并采用参数化 Soft Actor-Critic 架构与解耦评论家进行求解。在多种基准测试上，Dmsh 在自动化、鲁棒性和网格质量方面持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有网格生成方法依赖启发式调参和半人工流程，缺乏自动化，成为计算工程中的瓶颈。
Method: 将网格生成过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用三个协调智能体分别处理拓扑简化、几何正则化和网格生成，采用参数化 Soft Actor-Critic 架构与解耦评论家，结合课程学习策略处理简单到复杂几何。
Result: 在多种基准测试上，Dmsh 在自动化、鲁棒性和网格质量方面持续优于现有方法，能生成全局一致的四边形网格。
Conclusion: Dmsh 建立了学习型网格生成的新范式，递归分解支持子区域并行网格化，无需后处理校正。

papers.title: Toward Proactive RF Charging Scheduling: Generative AI for Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency wireless power transfer (RF-WPT) is an enabling technology for supporting uninterrupted communications in future Internet of Things systems by reducing the need for battery replacement and mitigating battery-waste-related issues. For large-scale RF-WPT deployment, one of the main challenges is the scheduler-level resource allocation. Specifically, the transmitter must decide how much energy to deliver, when, and to whom, under limited charging resources, incomplete receiver-side information, and uncertain near-future charging conditions. This article positions generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) as a promising tool for this setting because it can foresee multiple plausible charging scenarios conditioned on coarse operational context and receiver-side information. We propose GenAI to act as an uncertainty-aware support layer for the RF-WPT scheduler rather than as a standalone forecasting or decision-making tool. To this end, we first revisit the main challenges of RF-WPT scheduling, and discuss how major GenAI families can support uncertainty-aware charging decisions by generating scenario-based inputs for downstream tasks. We then present a warehouse-style case study showing that preserving uncertainty through the sampling capability of generative models can improve robust charging decisions compared with deterministic prediction and simple non-learning baselines, especially under risk-sensitive objectives. Finally, we identify key open challenges and present some directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨射频无线能量传输（RF-WPT）调度中的资源分配问题，提出利用生成式人工智能（GenAI）作为不确定性感知的决策支持层，通过生成多种可能的充电场景来辅助调度器。在仓库场景的案例研究中，该方法相比确定性预测和简单基线在风险敏感目标下提升了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 大规模RF-WPT部署面临调度级资源分配挑战：有限充电资源、接收端信息不完整以及近未来充电条件不确定。现有方法难以有效应对这些不确定性。
Method: 将生成式AI作为辅助层，不直接做决策，而是基于粗略运行环境和接收端信息生成多个可能的充电场景，供调度器用于下游任务。
Result: 仓库案例研究显示，通过生成模型的采样能力保留不确定性，可提升充电决策的鲁棒性，尤其在风险敏感目标下优于确定性预测和简单非学习基线。
Conclusion: GenAI有潜力作为RF-WPT调度的支持工具，但仍有开放问题需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embedding Hybrid Systems into Continuous Latent Vector Fields
papers.abstract_en: This work proves that an $n$-dimensional hybrid system can be embedded into an $m$-dimensional Euclidean space equipped with a continuous vector field on its embedded image whenever $m>2n$. This result suggests that an intrinsically discontinuous hybrid system generically admits a continuous extrinsic representation that is well-posed for differentiable optimization. Building on this existence theorem, we show that a latent Neural ODE with consistency loss in both the latent and state space can accurately recover the flow of hybrid systems. Extensive experiments suggest the proposed method outperforms the existing method in learning hybrid systems with varying geometries from only time series data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，任意n维混合系统可在m>2n维欧氏空间中找到连续向量场嵌入，从而为不连续系统提供可微优化框架。基于存在性定理，提出带潜在空间和状态空间一致性损失的潜在神经常微分方程（Neural ODE），仅从时间序列数据即可恢复混合系统流。实验表明该方法在多种几何结构的混合系统学习上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 混合系统的本质不连续性导致其难以直接应用于基于梯度的可微优化，亟需一种连续的显式表示以兼容现代机器学习工具。
Method: 证明嵌入定理（m>2n时混合系统可嵌入连续向量场），并构建潜在Neural ODE框架，通过潜在空间与状态空间的双重一致性损失训练，从观测时间序列中学习混合系统的连续表示。
Result: 在多种几何结构的混合系统（如弹跳球、双模式系统）上，该方法仅凭时间序列数据即可准确恢复系统流，并显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该工作为混合系统提供了一种理论上保证的连续可微表示，扩展了神经ODE在非连续动力学中的应用范围。

papers.title: From Data Heterogeneity to Convergence: A Data-Centric Review of Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising solution for data hunger in centralized learning. This paradigm enables privacy with multiple clients to train a shared-task model collaboratively without exposing their local data. While being a key component in any learning system, data is also a primary source of vulnerabilities and challenges, and a major determinant of a stable and well-converged training. Existing FL reviews describe general foundations, security practices, opportunities, challenges, and applications, without delving into diverse aspects of data and considering problems from the data perspective. They rarely provide a data-lens synthesis that links concrete data properties, split protocols, and defenses to convergence speed and stability. This survey fills that gap with three advances. First, we analyze non-IID into measurable traits and rank their influence on convergence as strong, medium, or light, explaining the mechanisms behind each and reconciling evidence across images, texts, and graphs. Second, we connect experimental splitting practices to the real phenomena they emulate, expose the artifacts they introduce, and show how those artifacts affect target accuracy. Third, we analyze how data-related vulnerabilities and their proposed defenses affect convergence, reporting performance under clean and adversarial conditions to make the convergence-robustness trade-off explicit. To our knowledge, this is the first survey to provide a complete understanding of data-related challenges that govern FL. With clear takeaways distilled for each concern, our work serves as actionable guidance, helping practitioners design their system with predictable convergence and stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数据视角全面综述联邦学习中的挑战，重点分析数据异质性（non-IID）对收敛的影响。研究将non-IID分解为可测量特征并排序其影响强度，连接实验拆分实践与真实现象，并分析数据相关漏洞及防御对收敛的影响。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习综述缺乏从数据角度深入分析异质性、拆分协议和防御对收敛影响的研究，填补这一空白有助于设计更稳定的联邦学习系统。
Method: 通过文献分析，将non-IID分解为可测量特征并排序其对收敛的影响（强、中、弱），连接实验拆分实践与真实现象并揭示伪影，分析数据漏洞及防御对收敛和鲁棒性权衡的影响。
Result: 首次提供对联邦学习中数据相关挑战的完整理解，给出每个问题的明确结论，帮助从业者设计可预测收敛和稳定性的系统。
Conclusion: 本文为联邦学习从业者提供基于数据视角的行动指南，强调收敛-鲁棒性权衡。

papers.title: Segment and Select: Vision-Language Segmentation in 3D Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: 3D vision-language segmentation aims to segment target objects in 3D scenarios according to the linguistic instructions and visual observations. Prior art heavily relies on the coarse superpoint representation to reduce the computation complexity, which suffers from poor segmentation quality and messy object boundaries. In this paper, we propose the SEGment-And-select (SEGA3D) paradigm for 3D visionlanguage segmentation that directly operates on the fine-grained visual information and is free from the superpoint dependency. Specifically, we first leverage a mask candidate generator to provide fine-grained categorical mask candidates, substantially improving the quality of candidate masks over the superpoint counterparts. Then, a Large Language Model (LLM) is utilized to generate the semantic and spatial information based on the linguistic description and visual features. The LLM output and visual features are fed to the Semantic-Spatial Selector (SSS) to produce the top-ranking mask candidates. Eventually, the Loopback Verification Module (LVM) is designed to yield the segmentation mask from the selected candidate masks. Our SEGA3D attains competitive performance on ScanRefer, ScanNet and Matterport3D benchmarks. Notably, our SEGA3D surpasses the top-performing counterpart by 8.3 mIoU and 5.3 mIoU on ScanNet and Matterport3D, respectively. Codes will be available upon publication.
papers.comment: The core idea is to reformulate 3D vision-language segmentation as the segment-and-select paradigm (free from the superpoint dependency)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEGA3D范式，用于3D视觉语言分割，直接在细粒度视觉信息上操作，摆脱了超点依赖。通过掩码候选生成器、大语言模型和语义-空间选择器，结合回环验证模块，在ScanRefer、ScanNet和Matterport3D上取得竞争性能，在ScanNet和Matterport3D上分别超过最佳方法8.3和5.3 mIoU。
Motivation: 现有3D视觉语言分割依赖粗粒度超点表示，导致分割质量差和边界混乱，亟需一种无需超点、直接操作细粒度信息的方法。
Method: 提出SEGA3D范式：先用掩码候选生成器提供细粒度类别掩码候选；再用大语言模型解析语言和视觉特征并生成语义和空间信息；再通过语义-空间选择器选出排名最高的候选；最后用回环验证模块产生最终分割掩码。
Result: 在ScanNet和Matterport3D上分别超越最佳方法8.3和5.3 mIoU，在ScanRefer上也取得竞争性能。
Conclusion: SEGA3D通过摆脱超点依赖，显著提升了3D视觉语言分割的质量，且方法通用有效。

summary_sections.method: 提出SEGA3D范式：先用掩码候选生成器提供细粒度类别掩码候选；再用大语言模型解析语言和视觉特征并生成语义和空间信息；再通过语义-空间选择器选出排名最高的候选；最后用回环验证模块产生最终分割掩码。
summary_sections.result: 在ScanNet和Matterport3D上分别超越最佳方法8.3和5.3 mIoU，在ScanRefer上也取得竞争性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: SEGA3D通过摆脱超点依赖，显著提升了3D视觉语言分割的质量，且方法通用有效。

papers.title: Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting for Alleviating Over-smoothing in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting often suffers from over-smoothing, especially when future dynamics are multi-modal. Forecasts may follow the coarse trend of the observed future, but fail to preserve sharp changes, oscillations, turning points, and regime transitions that define plausible dynamic evolution. In this work, we revisit over-smoothing from the perspective of latent dynamical mode compression: under partial observation and single-realization supervision, multiple plausible future modes can be weakened, merged, or averaged during forecasting. Based on this view, we propose Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting (DGF), a mode-preserving forecasting framework that explicitly models multiple mode-conditioned predictive distributions and uncertainty over their selection probabilities. DGF uses a Dirichlet-guided hierarchical sampling mechanism and reward-based optimization to encourage forecasts that are accurate, dynamically consistent, and mode-distinct. Extensive experiments on real-world forecasting benchmarks show that DGF reduces over-smoothing while improving forecasting accuracy, diversity, and dynamical consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中的过平滑问题，从潜在动态模式压缩的角度重新审视，提出Dirichlet引导的组预测（DGF）框架，显式建模多个模式的预测分布和选择概率不确定性，通过Dirichlet引导的分层采样和奖励优化来鼓励准确、动态一致且模式区分度的预测。实验表明DGF能减少过平滑并提升准确性、多样性和动态一致性。
Motivation: 时间序列预测中过平滑问题严重，尤其当未来动态是多模态时，预测往往只捕捉粗略趋势，丢失尖锐变化、振荡、转折点和状态转换。现有方法未能有效保留多种可能的动态模式。
Method: 提出Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting (DGF)，一种保留模式预测框架：显式建模多个模式条件下的预测分布，并通过Dirichlet引导的分层采样机制和基于奖励的优化，鼓励预测既准确又在动态上一致且模式间区分度高。
Result: 在真实世界时间序列预测基准上，DGF减少了过平滑，同时提升了预测准确性、多样性和动态一致性。
Conclusion: 从潜在动态模式压缩视角解释过平滑，并证明通过显式多模态预测和Dirichlet引导可以缓解该问题。

papers.title: Towards Diverse Scientific Hypothesis Search with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are on the rise for accelerating scientific discovery, most recently in advanced tasks such as generating valid scientific hypotheses. Yet in many discovery settings, the goal is not to identify a single best hypothesis since validation can be noisy and expensive, and scientists benefit from a set of high-quality alternative hypotheses that hedge against downstream uncertainty for the best solutions. Nevertheless, commonly used evolutionary search recipes tend to prioritize optimization over exploration in hypothesis generation, and the resulting selection pressure during the search process leads to diversity collapse. Motivated by these limitations, we formulate hypothesis search as a sampling problem, where the objective is to efficiently produce diverse, high-quality hypotheses under a fixed validation budget. Building on this perspective, we propose \ours, an evolutionary framework inspired by the classical parallel tempering algorithm that searches hypotheses at multiple temperature levels and enables principled information exchange across temperatures to improve exploration without disrupting convergence. Across domains including molecular discovery, equation discovery, and algorithm discovery, our approach consistently improves both hypothesis quality and diversity under the same validation budget, and produces candidates that remain robust under more expensive downstream computational validations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于并行回火（parallel tempering）的演化框架，用于生成多样且高质量的科学假设。该方法将假设搜索形式化为采样问题，通过多温度层级搜索和信息交换来平衡探索与收敛，避免传统演化搜索中因选择压力导致的多样性崩溃。在分子发现、方程发现和算法发现三个领域，该方法在固定验证预算下同时提升了假设的质量和多样性，且生成的候选在下游昂贵计算验证中仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有用于科学假设生成的演化搜索方法往往优先优化而非探索，导致多样性丧失，而科学家需要一组高质量替代假设以对冲下游不确定性。
Method: 提出并行回火演化框架，在多温度层级上并行搜索假设，并通过层级间原则性信息交换改善探索，同时不破坏收敛性。
Result: 在分子发现、方程发现和算法发现任务上，该方法在固定验证预算下同时提升了假设质量和多样性，且候选假设在更昂贵的下游计算验证中保持稳健。
Conclusion: 将假设搜索视为采样问题，并采用并行回火策略，可以在不牺牲质量的前提下有效提高假设多样性，适用于多个科学发现领域。

papers.title: NOVA: Symbolic Regression Discovery of Interpretable Car-Following and Lane-Change Models with Driver Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: We present NOVA, an autonomous symbolic regression framework that identifies interpretable car-following and lane-change structures from raw trajectory data with minimal behavioral priors. Applied to 4,765,788 active driving observations from the NGSIM I-80 and US-101 datasets, NOVA's deterministic Rust-powered search engine evaluates over 10,000 candidate algebraic structures and identifies a compact two-term acceleration model under a forward-shifted rolling-mean prediction target. Evaluated under two complementary preprocessing pipelines, NOVA achieves $RMSE = 1.376 m/s^2$ ($R^2 = 15.57\%$) on the intent-forecasting benchmark, outperforming the best recalibrated symbolic-regression baseline (SR-LLM, PNAS~2025) by 0.135 m/s$^2$ in RMSE under an identical evaluation protocol. Across eight independent experiments, a single dominant nonlinear term emerges as a robust backbone of human car-following; a residual-guided extension further links the selected structure to an established psychophysical theory of collision avoidance. The discovered feature operators transfer zero-shot between freeway sites with under 3 pp $R^2$ loss. Extended to lane-change modelling within a multinomial logit framework, NOVA achieves 67.4\% balanced accuracy under strict vehicle-ID holdout on 502 unseen drivers, surpassing existing lane-changing baselines by +29.8 percentage points on a three-class problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NOVA，一个自主符号回归框架，用于从原始轨迹数据中识别可解释的跟车和换道模型，仅需最少的驾驶行为先验。在NGSIM数据集上，NOVA通过对超过10,000个候选代数结构进行确定性搜索，识别出一个紧凑的两项加速度模型，在意图预测基准上RMSE为1.376 m/s^2（R^2=15.57%），优于最先进的符号回归基线。换道建模中，在跨司机严格留出法下达到67.4%的平衡准确率。
Motivation: 传统跟车和换道模型依赖手工设计的行为先验，缺乏从数据自动发现可解释结构的能力，难以捕捉驾驶员的异质性。
Method: 提出NOVA框架，使用Rust实现的高效确定性搜索，在前向平移滚动均值预测目标下评估候选代数结构，并结合残差引导扩展至心理物理学理论。
Result: 在NGSIM数据集的4,765,788个观测上，NOVA在意图预测任务中RMSE为1.376 m/s^2，R^2为15.57%，比SR-LLM基线低0.135 m/s^2；换道任务中平衡准确率67.4%，超过现有基线+29.8个百分点。
Conclusion: 发现的单一非线性项是跟车行为的鲁棒骨干，且特征算子可在不同高速公路站点间零样本迁移，损失低于3个百分点R^2。

papers.title: Drawing with Strangers: Population Scaling Drives Zero-Shot Mutual Intelligibility in Emergent Sketching
papers.abstract_en: Generalization in emergent communication has largely focused on novel inputs or linguistic structures, yet the capacity for agents to communicate with strangers from strictly disjoint communities remains relatively unexplored. In this work, we formalize this capability as \textit{zero-shot mutual intelligibility (ZMI)}: successful communication between independently trained populations without prior exposure. Leveraging emergent sketching -- in which agents communicate through sets of drawn strokes -- as a visually grounded modality, we find that scaling the training population substantially improves ZMI across independent groups. Crucially, as we scale the population size, in-group communicative variation increases, preventing co-adaptation into homogeneity. Simultaneously, cross-group variation decreases, indicating a structural convergence toward a certain type of universality. Further analysis reveals that this universality is achieved through perceptual grounding: scaled populations increasingly anchor their emergent sketches on the objective visual resemblance of the target images. Together, these results position ZMI as a distinct axis of generalization in emergent communication and suggest a route toward socially interoperable artificial agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨涌现通信中的零样本互理解性（ZMI），即在独立训练群体之间无需先验接触即可成功通信的能力。在涌现素描（emergent sketching）任务中，扩大训练人口规模可显著提升ZMI。大规模群体导致组内沟通变异增加，防止过度适应同质化，同时组间变异减少，表明结构趋向某种普遍性。这种普遍性通过视觉锚定实现：规模扩大后的群体越来越将其涌现素描锚定于目标图像的客观视觉相似性。
Motivation: 现有涌现通信泛化研究多聚焦于新输入或新语言结构，而不同独立群体间的通信能力（零样本互理解性）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 采用涌现素描（emergent sketching）作为视觉基础模态，通过扩大训练人口规模来观察零样本互理解性的变化，并分析群体内和群体间的变异。
Result: 扩大人口规模显著提升零样本互理解性；组内沟通变异增加，组间变异减少，表明结构收敛；大规模群体更依赖目标图像的视觉相似性进行素描。
Conclusion: 零样本互理解性应被视为涌现通信泛化的独立维度，为零样本互理解性的研究为构建社会可互操作的人工智能提供了途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence of Monte Carlo Optimistic Policy Iteration: Beyond Uniform State-Action Updates
papers.abstract_en: The asymptotic behaviour of Monte Carlo optimistic policy iteration (MC-O-PI) is a long-standing open question. When the model of the environment is unknown, as is common in practice, the only known condition that guarantees convergence to optimality is impractical. In its canonical form, this condition requires that the episodes used for policy evaluation be initialised uniformly over the entire state-action space. This paper strictly relaxes that requirement. Specifically, we prove that initial-visit MC-O-PI converges to optimality even when updates are uniform only over the actions within each state. This allows episodes to start in different states at arbitrary frequencies; a realistic implementation when the state space is large or unknown but the action space in each state is manageable. The proof departs from the classical analysis of Tsitsiklis whose central commutativity argument no longer applies when states are updated at different frequencies. Instead, we first show that the mean-field dynamics of MC-O-PI generate monotonically improving policies when updates are uniform over the actions in each state, and then prove that noise cannot consistently prevent this improvement by extending the lock-in argument of the combined stability-ODE method. This approach suggests a new way to study optimistic policy-iteration algorithms in general.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明蒙特卡洛乐观策略迭代（MC-O-PI）在状态更新频率非均匀时仍收敛到最优解，放宽了经典条件中要求整个状态-动作空间均匀初始化的限制。
Motivation: 经典收敛条件要求所有状态-动作对被均匀访问，这在大型或未知状态空间中不切实际。本文试图放松这一条件，使其更适用于实际强化学习场景。
Method: 采用平均场动态分析和扩展的稳定性-ODE组合方法的锁入论证，证明当动作更新在每个状态下均匀时，策略单调改进且噪声无法阻止收敛。
Result: 证明了初始访问MC-O-PI在仅需每个状态下动作更新均匀时即可收敛到最优，允许各状态以任意频率被访问。
Conclusion: 该结果为大规模或部分未知状态空间下的强化学习算法提供了更实用的收敛保证，并提出了一种分析乐观策略迭代算法的新思路。

papers.title: One Token per Multimodal Evidence: Latent Memory for Resource-Constrained QA
papers.abstract_en: External memory effectively grounds large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs)-based question answering (QA) in relevant multimodal evidence. However, existing memory paradigms represent each memory item in raw text and image forms, so retrieval-based systems must pass the retrieved text or images to the generation LLMs/VLMs, resulting in high token consumption and storage pressure, making it unaffordable for resource-constrained applications. We propose Latent Memory, a latent-space memory paradigm that replaces each raw text or image evidence item with a single high-dimensional latent token produced by a small compressor LLM/VLM. Rather than retrieving raw evidence for generation, Latent Memory operates in a unified latent representation space: the query is embedded into this space to retrieve relevant latent tokens, and the retrieved latent tokens are directly prompted to a pretrained LLM or VLM for answer generation. To make each latent token simultaneously informative for reconstruction, retrieval, and generation, we train the compressor with reconstruction, contrastive, and distillation objectives in a unified end-to-end manner. Latent Memory is evaluated on seven text-only QA benchmarks (e.g., HotpotQA) and multimodal QA benchmarks, where it achieves competitive QA performance compared to advanced RAG baselines while consuming 3x to 10x fewer generator tokens. It can also deliver the strongest image-grounded QA performance on WebQA. Code is available at https://github.com/zz1358m/Latent-Memory-Master.

TL;DR: 本文提出潜记忆（Latent Memory）范式，将每条多模态证据（文本或图像）压缩为单个高维潜变量token，替代原始证据的检索与传递。通过重建、对比和蒸馏损失联合训练一个小型压缩器LLM/VLM，使潜token同时支持检索和生成。在七个文本QA和多模态QA基准上，该方法以3-10倍更少的生成Token达到与先进RAG基线相当的精度，并在WebQA上取得最强图像问答性能。
Motivation: 现有外部记忆以原始文本或图像存储每条证据，检索后传递给生成模型，导致高Token消耗和存储压力，在资源受限场景下不可负担。
Method: 提出Latent Memory：使用一个小型压缩器LLM/VLM将每条文本或图像证据映射为单个高维潜token；查询同样嵌入该潜空间进行检索，检索到的潜token直接作为前缀输入预训练LLM/VLM生成答案。训练目标包括重建损失、对比损失（用于检索）和蒸馏损失（用于生成）。
Result: 在7个纯文本QA基准（如HotpotQA）和多模态QA基准上，Latent Memory取得与RAG基线竞争力相当的QA性能，同时生成Token消耗降低3-10倍；在WebQA数据集上获得最强的图像问答性能。
Conclusion: 潜记忆通过将证据压缩为单Token潜表示，显著降低了生成阶段的计算和存储开销，同时保持问答质量，适合资源受限的实际应用。

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Transferability on Vision-Language Pre-training Models via Surrogate-Specific Bias Correction
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial examples reveal vulnerabilities in Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) models and provide insights for improving robustness. A key property is cross-model transferability, which enables transfer-based black-box attacks. However, existing attacks often rely heavily on the surrogate model, causing cross-model performance drops. One reason is that adversarial optimization may follow surrogate model responses more than input semantics, making the update direction effective on the surrogate but less transferable to unseen targets. We refer to this dependency as surrogate-specific bias. Motivated by this observation, DeBias-Attack improves transferability by correcting surrogate-specific bias in adversarial optimization directions. It maintains two perturbation branches. The main branch optimizes a perturbation on the original image and obtains the adversarial gradient used to disrupt image-text alignment. The reference branch optimizes a perturbation on a weak-semantic image constructed from the dataset mean image with small Gaussian noise resampled at each iteration. Since this weak-semantic image contains little clear visual content, its optimization reflects surrogate responses more than image semantics, and its reference gradient estimates surrogate-specific bias. DeBias-Attack removes the aligned projection of the main gradient on the reference gradient before updating the adversarial image, then performs context-aware text substitution using the updated adversarial image. DeBias-Attack is the first transfer-based VLP attack that corrects surrogate-specific bias through gradient correction. Experiments show strong performance across VLP models, downstream tasks, and open-source and closed-source multimodal large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）模型中对抗样本跨模型迁移性差的问题，提出DeBias-Attack方法，通过校正替代模型特异性偏差（surrogate-specific bias）来提升迁移性。该方法维护主分支和参考分支：主分支在原始图像上优化扰动，破坏图像-文本对齐；参考分支在弱语义图像（由数据集均值图像添加小高斯噪声构成）上优化，其梯度近似替代模型偏差。通过从主梯度中去除参考梯度的对齐投影来更新对抗图像，并结合上下文感知文本替换。实验表明该方法在多种VLP模型、下游任务及开源/闭源多模态大模型上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击严重依赖替代模型，导致跨模型性能下降，原因在于对抗优化可能更多遵循替代模型响应而非输入语义，这种替代模型特异性偏差限制了迁移性。
Method: 提出双分支梯度校正框架：主分支在原始图像上优化对抗扰动，参考分支在弱语义图像（数据集均值加高斯噪声）上优化，用参考梯度估计替代模型偏差，然后从主梯度中减去其在参考梯度上的投影，再进行上下文感知文本替换。
Result: 在多个VLP模型、下游任务以及开源/闭源多模态大语言模型上，该攻击方法相比现有方法显著提升了对抗样本的跨模型迁移性。
Conclusion: 本文首次通过梯度校正直接校正替代模型特异性偏差来提升VLP攻击的迁移性，实验验证了该策略的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hidden Consensus:Preference-Validity Compression in Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Standard RLHF pipelines often reduce heterogeneous human judgments into a single scalar reward target. We argue that this reduction can mis-measure alignment in structurally plural societies, where disagreement may reflect culturally, historically, linguistically, regionally, or normatively grounded interpretations rather than annotation noise. We call this failure Preference-Validity Compression, the collapse of multiple plural-valid response options into a single optimization target. Using Malaysia as a diagnostic setting, we analyze RLHF-style feedback aggregation through preference events linking prompts, responses, and acceptability judgments across interpretive frames. Across 321 preference events from 20 participants and 107 trio-annotated prompts, 79% of prompts contain more than one majority-supported response that single-winner aggregation would discard, and apparent dominance gaps between top responses diminish when all majority-supported options are considered. Participants frequently select multiple acceptable responses, and discarded responses demonstrably reflect coherent local, practical, or cultural frames. These findings show that majority aggregation in this corpus measures argmax acceptability rather than plural alignment. We treat this as a measurement-validity issue and argue that future alignment methods should satisfy Validity-Preserving Consistency, remaining stable across plural-valid interpretive frames rather than collapsing them into a single reward target.
papers.comment: 28 pages. When AI learns from human feedback, it forces a single "correct" answer, but sometimes multiple answers are all genuinely valid, and that nuance gets thrown away
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示标准RLHF将多元人类判断压缩为单一标量奖励，导致在结构多元的社会中误测量对齐。以马来西亚为诊断场景，通过对321个偏好事件和107个三标注提示的分析，发现79%的提示有多个多数支持的回应被单赢聚合丢弃，且被丢弃的回应反映连贯的地方、实践或文化框架。作者将此视为测量有效性问题，主张未来的对齐方法应满足有效性保持一致性（Validity-Preserving Consistency），即在多元有效解释框架下保持稳定而非压缩为单一奖励目标。
Motivation: 标准RLHF将异质的人类判断简化为单一标量奖励，但在结构多元的社会中，分歧可能源于文化、历史、语言、区域或规范等多元解释，而非标注噪声。这种简化误测量对齐。
Method: 通过马来西亚的多参与者实验，收集321个偏好事件和107个三标注提示，分析偏好聚合中的多数投票结果，并与考虑所有多数支持回应的情况进行对比。
Result: 79%的提示中，多数投票丢弃了多个多数支持的回应；考虑所有多数支持选项时，候选回应间的优势差距缩小；参与者常选择多个可接受回应，被丢弃的回应反映连贯的框架。
Conclusion: 多数聚合测量的是argmax可接受性而非多元对齐；未来对齐方法应满足有效性保持一致性，即在多元有效解释框架下保持稳定。

papers.title: Accelerating SAV-based optimization via randomized low-rank Hessian approximation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new optimization method, the Nyström-enhanced relaxed scalar auxiliary variable method (N-RSAV), which incorporates curvature information into the RSAV framework to accelerate convergence while preserving an unconditional modified energy dissipation law. Existing RSAV-based methods rely solely on first-order information and often suffer from slow convergence, particularly for ill-conditioned problems such as those arising in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To address this limitation, we design the linear operator in the RSAV scheme using approximate Hessian information obtained from a randomized low-rank Nyström approximation. To preserve the dissipation structure, we enforce positive semidefiniteness through eigenvalue truncation. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive strategy that reuses the approximate Hessian based on the deviation between the original and modified energies, significantly reducing computational cost. We also provide a convergence analysis of the RSAV scheme with a general positive semidefinite operator under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition and establish corresponding convergence guarantees for N-RSAV under the PL condition and an additional convexity assumption. Numerical experiments on ill-conditioned problems with effectively low-rank structure, including convex quadratic problems and training of PINNs, demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve substantially faster convergence than conventional RSAV-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出N-RSAV方法，在松弛标量辅助变量（RSAV）框架中引入随机低秩Nyström近似的Hessian信息以加速收敛，同时保持无条件修正能量耗散律。该方法通过特征值截断确保半正定性，并基于能量偏差自适应重用近似Hessian以降低计算成本。在凸二次问题和物理信息神经网络（PINNs）等病态问题上的实验表明，N-RSAV比传统RSAV方法收敛更快。
Motivation: 现有RSAV方法仅依赖一阶信息，在PINNs等病态问题上收敛缓慢，亟需引入曲率信息加速。
Method: 在RSAV框架中将线性算子替换为随机低秩Nyström近似的Hessian，并施加特征值截断保证半正定性；同时设计自适应策略根据能量偏差重用Hessian。
Result: 在凸二次问题和PINN训练等病态问题上，N-RSAV比传统RSAV方法收敛速度显著提升。
Conclusion: N-RSAV能在不破坏能量耗散结构的前提下通过曲率信息加速优化，适用于具有有效低秩结构的病态问题。

papers.title: Deterministic Denominator Design for Localized Tamed Stochastic-Gradient Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Tamed stochastic-gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD) stabilizes large drifts by adding a denominator to the update. If this denominator uses the same stochastic-gradient sample as the update step, it can also change the conditional mean drift. We study deterministic denominators: the state-dependent envelope is fixed before the current oracle sample is drawn. The main question is how to design this envelope in practice. The design starts from an oracle score, builds a low-cost proxy score on pilot states, chooses activation thresholds by empirical quantiles, and then applies a small calibration layer. The analysis tracks three steps: proxy and threshold errors become envelope errors; envelope errors perturb one SGLD step; and the local residuals give stationary errors through a conditional perturbation bridge. Experiments show that the proxy-quantile denominators are close to oracle-score behavior, avoid the random-denominator mean-shift channel, and improve simple deterministic taming choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究tamed随机梯度Langevin动力学（SGLD）中确定性分母的设计方法。传统分母使用随机梯度样本可能导致条件均值漂移，作者提出基于oracle分数构建低成本代理分数，通过经验分位数选择激活阈值并添加校准层。理论分析将代理和阈值误差逐级传递到SGLD平稳误差。实验表明代理分位数分母接近oracle分数行为，避免随机分母的均值偏移通道，优于简单确定性选择。
Motivation: 现有tamed SGLD分母使用随机梯度样本会改变条件均值漂移，需要更稳健的确定性分母设计。
Method: 确定性分母设计：从oracle分数开始，在试点状态上构建低成本代理分数，通过经验分位数选择激活阈值，并应用小的校准层。分析包括三步：代理和阈值误差变为包络误差；包络误差扰动一个SGLD步骤；通过条件扰动桥得到局部残差的平稳误差。
Result: 实验表明代理分位数分母接近oracle分数行为，避免随机分母的均值偏移通道，并改进简单的确定性taming选择。
Conclusion: 本文提出的确定性分母设计方法能有效稳定SGLD，避免随机分母的均值漂移问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking Knowledge Editing using Logical Rules
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications that require access to up-to-date knowledge. However, retraining LLMs is computationally expensive. Therefore, knowledge editing techniques are crucial for maintaining current information and correcting erroneous assertions within pre-trained models. Current benchmarks for knowledge editing primarily focus on recalling edited facts, often neglecting their logical consequences. To address this limitation, we introduce a new benchmark designed to evaluate how knowledge editing methods handle the logical consequences of a single fact edit. Our benchmark extracts relevant logical rules from a knowledge graph for a given edit. Then, it generates multi-hop questions based on these rules to assess the impact on logical consequences. Our findings indicate that while existing knowledge editing approaches can accurately insert direct assertions into LLMs, they frequently fail to inject entailed knowledge. Specifically, experiments with popular methods like ROME and FT reveal a substantial performance gap, up to 24%, between evaluations on directly edited knowledge and on entailed knowledge. This highlights the critical need for semantics-aware evaluation frameworks in knowledge editing.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 24th International Semantic Web Conference 2025
papers.journal_ref: The Semantic Web. ISWC 2025. ISWC 2025. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16141. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个评估知识编辑方法能否处理编辑事实的逻辑后果的基准。该基准从知识图谱中提取逻辑规则，生成基于这些规则的多跳问题。实验发现现有方法（如ROME、FT）在直接编辑知识上表现良好，但在蕴含知识上性能下降高达24%，表明需要语义感知的评估框架。
Motivation: 现有知识编辑基准主要关注直接编辑事实的回忆，忽略了逻辑后果，导致无法评估编辑后模型是否能够正确推理出蕴含知识。
Method: 提出一个基准，对于给定的事实编辑，从知识图谱中提取相关逻辑规则，并基于这些规则生成多跳问题，以评估对逻辑后果的影响。

papers.title: PrismAvatar: Pseudo-Multiview Reconstruction and Subpixel Prism Rendering for Real-Time Stereoscopic Communication
papers.abstract_en: Real-time stereoscopic video communication has long been a goal of immersive telepresence, yet practical systems still require specialized capture rigs or reduce remote users to a single portrait view. We present PrismAvatar, a Gaussian head-avatar system that connects monocular avatar capture with subpixel-encoded glasses-free lenticular display for real-time autostereoscopic communication. From a monocular portrait video, PrismAvatar reconstructs a controllable head avatar and optimizes it for the lateral viewing zones induced by the display. The method uses natural head turns as pseudo-multiview (PMV) supervision to constrain regions that are otherwise weakly observed in monocular training, including hair, ears, jaw contours, and neck boundaries. Reliable side frames are yaw-binned, aligned to virtual cameras, and supervised within a strict head-and-hair domain; contour-aware losses and staged regularization further suppress ghosting, alpha leakage, and depth instability while preserving lateral detail. At runtime, PrismAvatar renders 32 virtual views and encodes them into a 4K lenticular raster with calibrated subpixel-routing masks. The live-tracker prototype sustains 10.65 FPS, and a subject-specific distilled driver raises the same display pipeline to 38.49 FPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PrismAvatar系统，利用单目视频重建可控头部高斯头像，并通过子像素棱镜渲染实现实时裸眼立体通信。摘要声称该方法在单目训练中利用伪多视角监督和轮廓感知损失，生成了可靠的侧视图，并在实时追踪原型上达到10.65 FPS，蒸馏后达到38.49 FPS。
Motivation: 现有实时立体视频通信要么需要专用采集设备，要么只能提供单一视图。本文旨在实现仅需单目摄像头的实时裸眼立体通信。
Method: 从单目肖像视频重建可控头部高斯头像，利用自然头部转动作为伪多视角监督，结合轮廓感知损失和分阶段正则化，生成32个虚拟视图并编码为4K光栅，使用子像素路由掩码进行裸眼立体显示。

papers.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Limited-Angle STEM-EDX Tomography -- Application to 3D Chemical Analysis of Phase-Change Memory Devices
papers.abstract_en: Energy Dispersive X-ray (EDX) tomography in Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) enables 3D compositional and elemental mapping at the nanoscale, but its use is limited by restricted tilt ranges and low-dose conditions required to avoid beam damage. Limited-angle acquisition introduces missing-wedge artefacts such as elongation and anisotropic resolution, while noisy low-dose data further degrade reconstruction quality and quantitative reliability. Here, we introduce an unsupervised deep learning framework based on Deep Image Prior with total variation regularization (DIP-TV) for limited-angle STEM-EDX tomography. We extend it to a multi-channel formulation (DIPm-TV) that jointly reconstructs multiple elemental maps by exploiting spatial correlations. Using a synthetic 3-channel phantom, we show that the method compensates for severe missing-wedge artefacts corresponding to approximately $100^\circ$ of missing angular range under moderate noise, outperforming simultaneous iterative reconstruction technique and compressed sensing approaches. We apply the method to 3D chemical analysis of Ge-Sb-Te (GST) memory devices in virgin (as-fabricated) and SET (crystalline) operational states. Samples were prepared as cross-sectional focused ion beam lamellae and acquired under a limited-angle tilt range from $-40^\circ$ to $+40^\circ$ with $5^\circ$ steps and a dose of $2.0\times10^5$ $e^-/Ang^2$. The multi-channel approach enables voxel-by-voxel elemental reconstruction using only EDX signals without external structural priors such as high-angle annular dark-field imaging. The reconstructed volumes show near-isotropic spatial resolution and reveal compositional heterogeneities associated with device operation. This approach enables 3D chemical characterization in experimentally accessible sample geometries where conventional methods fail due to severe angular limitations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度图像先验与全变分正则化（DIP-TV）的无监督深度学习框架，用于有限角度的STEM-EDX断层扫描，并扩展为多通道版本（DIPm-TV）以联合重建多个元素图。在合成数据上，该方法在约100°缺失角度范围和中等噪声下优于同时迭代重建技术和压缩感知方法。应用于Ge-Sb-Te（GST）相变存储器件（原始态和SET态）的3D化学分析，仅利用EDX信号实现了近乎各向同性的空间分辨率重建，并揭示了与器件操作相关的组分异质性。
Motivation: 有限角度采集引起的缺失楔伪影（如伸长和各向异性分辨率）以及低剂量噪声严重降低了STEM-EDX断层扫描的重建质量和定量可靠性，需要一种无需外部结构先验且能处理严重角度限制的无监督重建方法。
Method: 基于深度图像先验（Deep Image Prior）与全变分正则化（DIP-TV）的无监督学习框架，并扩展为多通道公式（DIPm-TV），通过利用空间相关性联合重建多个元素图，仅使用EDX信号，无需高角环形暗场像等外部结构先验。
Result: 在合成3通道体模上，该方法在约100°缺失角度和中等噪声下补偿了严重的缺失楔伪影，优于SIRT和压缩感知方法。在GST存储器件实验数据上，实现了近各向同性空间分辨率，并重建了原始态和SET态的3D元素分布，揭示了组分异质性。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在实验可访问的样品几何结构下实现3D化学表征，在传统方法因严重角度限制而失败的情况下有效，但其对噪声和角度缺失的鲁棒性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Flexible Flows for Biological Sequence Design
papers.abstract_en: Designing functional biological sequences requires navigating vast discrete spaces under strict evolutionary and biophysical constraints. Discrete Flow Matching (DFM) offers a generative framework over such spaces, but existing approaches rely on biologically uninformative couplings and offer limited flexibility for variable-length sequence generation and fine-grained control. We propose a structured coupling that encodes domain-specific preferences among sequence elements, biasing the source distribution toward plausible regions without modifying the flow objective or training procedure. Building on this, we introduce a latent edit-based rate parameterization that models variable-length generation via edit operations conditioned on a shared global latent, akin to a latent variable model, while remaining tractable. We further introduce a latent classifier-free guidance mechanism that steers generation coherently in continuous latent space, along with Dirichlet-prior temperature scaling for test-time control over edit operations. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse biological sequence tasks, including density estimation, unconditional and conditional DNA sequence generation, and peptide sequence generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物序列设计中的离散流匹配（DFM）方法提出改进，通过结构化耦合编码序列元素间的领域偏好、基于隐编辑的速率参数化实现变长生成，并引入隐分类器无引导机制和Dirichlet先验温度缩放。在DNA序列和肽序列生成等任务上取得最先进性能。

Method: 提出结构化耦合编码序列元素间的领域偏好，基于隐编辑的速率参数化进行变长生成，以及隐分类器无引导机制和Dirichlet先验温度缩放用于测试时控制。
Result: 在密度估计、无条件/条件DNA序列生成和肽序列生成等任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法在生物序列设计任务上表现优越，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或适用边界。

papers.title: GRAR: Glass-induced Reflection Artifact Removal in LiDAR Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) point clouds captured in urban environments frequently suffer from glass-induced reflection artifacts, severely degrading downstream applications. Existing reflection artifact removal methods generally rely on ideal reflection symmetry assumptions, yet their performance is limited by inaccurate glass estimation and insufficient geometric representations. To address these issues, we propose a novel unified framework aimed at robust reflection artifact removal: In the first stage, we leverage a multi-modal vision foundation model to produce initial glass masks, which are then refined using geometric cues to achieve high-precision glass regions, followed by glass completion to recover missing regions caused by no-return measurements on transparent surfaces; In the second stage, we propose a physics-driven descriptor, termed Reflection-aware Local-Global Geometric Similarity (RE-LGGS), which is grounded in actual laser reflection geometry and jointly encodes multi-scale geometric structures and orientation consistency using PCA-based local shape representations, thereby significantly improving robustness against imperfect observations. Extensive experiments on multiple public TLS datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reflection artifacts removal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地面激光扫描点云中玻璃反射伪影问题，提出一个两阶段统一框架。第一阶段利用多模态视觉基础模型生成玻璃掩膜，结合几何线索精化并补全缺失区域；第二阶段提出物理驱动的描述符RE-LGGS，编码多尺度几何结构与方向一致性。实验在多个公共TLS数据集上表明该方法在反射伪影去除方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有反射伪影去除方法依赖理想反射对称假设，性能受限于玻璃估计不准确和几何表示不足，需要更鲁棒的方案。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用多模态视觉基础模型生成初始玻璃掩膜，利用几何线索精化并补全无返回测量导致的缺失区域；第二阶段提出物理驱动的描述符RE-LGGS，基于PCA局部形状表示编码多尺度几何结构与方向一致性。
Result: 在多个公共TLS数据集上的实验表明，该方法在反射伪影去除任务上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要未讨论局限性，但实验证明了所提框架的有效性，尤其通过物理驱动的描述符提升了对不完美观测的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Audio-Visual Exchange-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Audio-Visual Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual captioning generates natural language descriptions from video and audio content. Multimodal LLMs have advanced this task, but both modalities contribute many tokens to the LLM input, where prefill self-attention scales quadratically. Existing token-pruning methods usually retain tokens by attention, saliency, or cross-entropy loss, yet the hard threshold selection makes it difficult to retain tokens that are truly valuable, especially for high-confusing tokens near the decision boundary. To this end, we propose a AVEX-Prune, an RL-based audio-visual dynamic token pruning method in this work. In our AVEX-Prune, an audio-visual token exchange strategy is proposed to select truly valuable tokens by replacing low-confidence retained tokens with high-confidence candidate tokens from the same or the other modality, and measuring the differences in caption generation from token swaps. AVEX-Prune preserves full-token quality at a 40% retention ratio on both VILA 1.5-8B (54.5 vs. 54.6) and VideoLLaMA 2 (57.0 vs. 56.8).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的音频-视觉动态token剪枝方法AVEX-Prune，通过token交换策略替换低置信度保留token以选择真正有价值的token，在40%保留率下保持全token质量，在VILA 1.5-8B和VideoLLaMA 2上性能几乎无损。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型的输入token数量大导致自注意力计算量呈二次增长，现有硬阈值剪枝方法难以保留决策边界附近真正有价值的token。
Method: 利用强化学习训练的音频-视觉token交换策略，通过替换低置信度保留token并测量caption生成差异来选取高价值token。
Result: 在40%保留率下，VILA 1.5-8B上CIDEr从54.6略降至54.5，VideoLLaMA 2上从56.8略升至57.0，几乎无性能损失。
Conclusion: AVEX-Prune通过token交换策略有效保留了关键token，在显著降低计算量的同时保持了caption质量。

papers.title: ActiveMem: Distributed Active Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Memory is essential for enabling large language model (LLM) agents to handle long-horizon reasoning tasks. Existing memory mechanisms are largely centralized, typically organizing retrieved information and interaction history within a single model context. This design imposes a fundamental trade-off: scaling reasoning trajectories risks context overload, whereas aggressive content pruning may result in irreversible information loss. Seeking a better trade-off, we draw inspiration from human cognitive systems, especially the functional complementarity between the prefrontal cortex (executive control) and the hippocampus (memory management), suggesting that such a trade-off need not be inherent, but may instead stem from centralized memory organization. To this end, we propose ActiveMem, a heterogeneous framework that decouples agent memory from the core reasoning process. Specifically, a high-level Planner utilizes distilled semantic gists to execute reasoning, while a lightweight, distributed memory system operates in parallel to actively accumulate and consolidate these gists throughout the task. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and GAIA show that ActiveMem achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly reduced overhead, demonstrating the effectiveness of distributed active memory for long-horizon reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ActiveMem，一种将智能体记忆与核心推理过程解耦的异构框架，灵感来自人脑前额叶皮层与海马体的功能互补。它利用高层规划器通过蒸馏的语义要点进行推理，同时轻量级分布式记忆系统并行主动积累和整合这些要点。在BrowseComp-Plus和GAIA基准上，ActiveMem以显著更低的开销实现了最先进的准确性。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆机制多为集中式，将检索信息和交互历史置于单一模型上下文中，导致扩展推理轨迹时存在上下文过载与信息丢失之间的权衡。
Method: 提出ActiveMem框架，包含一个高层规划器（负责推理）和一个分布式记忆系统（负责记忆管理）；规划器使用蒸馏的语义gist进行推理，记忆系统并行运行主动积累和整合gist。
Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus和GAIA基准上取得最先进准确率，同时显著降低计算开销。
Conclusion: 分布式主动记忆能够有效支持长时域推理，避免了集中式记忆的权衡问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LC-QAT: Data-Efficient 2-Bit QAT for LLMs via Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is essential for extremely low-bit large language models (LLMs). Current QAT methods are mainly based on scalar quantization (SQ), which enables efficient optimization but suffers from severe performance degradation at 2-bit precision. On the other hand, vector quantization (VQ) provides substantially higher representational capacity, but its discrete codebook lookup prevents end-to-end training. We propose LC-QAT, a 2-bit weight-only VQ-QAT framework that represents quantized weights via a learned affine mapping over discrete vectors, which yields a high-quality PTQ initialization and enables fully differentiable end-to-end optimization without explicit codebook lookup in the training forward pass. This strong post-training initialization makes LC-QAT highly data-efficient. Experiments across diverse LLMs demonstrate that LC-QAT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art QAT methods while using only 0.1%--10% of the training data. Our results establish LC-QAT as a practical and scalable solution for extreme low-bit model deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LC-QAT，一种用于大语言模型的 2 比特权重量化感知训练框架，通过线性约束向量量化实现全微分端到端优化，在极低比特部署中取得领先性能。
Motivation: 现有标量量化 QAT 在 2 比特精度下性能严重下降，而矢量量化虽表示能力强但离散码本阻碍端到端训练。
Method: 利用向量上的学习仿射映射表示量化权重，避免训练前向中的显式码本查找，并支持高质量 PTQ 初始化，使训练数据需求大幅降低。
Result: 在多种 LLM 上，LC-QAT 以仅 0.1%–10% 的训练数据持续超越最先进的 QAT 方法。
Conclusion: LC-QAT 被证明是极端低比特模型部署的实用且可扩展的解决方案。
Relevance: 0
