papers.title: Machine Learning Methods for Studying Latent Neural Activity Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in brain recording are driving a demand for machine learning tools capable of decoding the latent structure of large populations of neurons. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey that outlines the trajectory of Latent Variable Models (LVMs) from early state-space models to more recent deep generative models. We organize the literature into three closely related domains: (1) Single-Region Latent Dynamics, which includes models such as linear dynamical systems to more complex dynamics represented by Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs); (2) Multi-Region Communication, which employs probabilistic as well as subspace methods to study how information is transferred across different brain areas considering synaptic propagation delays and network connectivity; and (3) Behavior-Aligned Modeling, which seeks to disentangle neural activity related to task performance from other internal states via supervised or contrastive learning. This survey also includes large-scale neural foundation models, such as Transformers and diffusion models, that rely on large-scale pre-training for optimal performance across subjects. Finally, we conclude and discuss benchmarks, evaluation criteria, and open challenges, such as the ability to identify causal links or directionality of communication, to facilitate future research for bridging interpretable brain dynamics with reliable neural decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于机器学习方法研究潜在神经活动动力学的综述，涵盖从早期状态空间模型到深度生成模型的潜变量模型（LVMs）。文章将文献组织为三个相关领域：单区域潜动力学（包括线性动力系统、RNN、神经常微分方程）、多区域通信（概率和子空间方法）以及行为对齐建模（监督或对比学习）。还讨论了大规模神经基础模型（Transformer、扩散模型）以及基准、评估标准和开放挑战。
Motivation: 脑记录技术的进展需要能够解码大规模神经元群体潜在结构的机器学习工具，现有方法缺乏系统性的综述整理。
Method: 按三个领域组织综述：单区域潜动力学、多区域通信、行为对齐建模，并涵盖大规模神经基础模型；最后讨论基准和挑战。
Result: 论文未提供定量结果，而是系统性地梳理了各子领域的方法谱系。
Conclusion: 指出开放挑战包括识别因果关系或通信方向性，以桥接可解释的脑动力学与可靠的神经解码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation-Aware Advantage Estimation: Your Reward Model Provides More Than A Scalar Output
papers.abstract_en: Current reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) methods primarily rely on scalar rewards from a trained reward model (RM). While effective, scalar rewards are often noisy and fail to capture fine-grained preference differences, whereas RM hidden states encode richer semantic and preference information. We introduce the representation-aware advantage estimation, which leverages RM hidden states and models them as auxiliary signals for better advantage estimation. Specifically, we propose the Graph-based Advantage Estimation (GraphAE), treat each sampled group as a graph, where nodes correspond to responses and edges capture their similarity in the RM hidden space. Then advantages are computed via graph propagation, enabling each sample to incorporate contextual information from its neighbors. GraphAE is lightweight and can be seamlessly integrated into existing group-based RL algorithms. We apply GraphAE to GRPO, GSPO and RLOO, and conduct extensive experiments on different models and benchmarks. Empirical results show consistent improvements across three benchmarks, with gains of up to + 6.3 on Arena-Hard-v0.1, + 8.27 on AlpacaEval 2.0, and + 0.22 on MT-Bench. These results demonstrate that leveraging RM representations leads to more sample efficient and robust RLHF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表示感知优势估计（Representation-Aware Advantage Estimation），利用奖励模型（RM）的隐藏状态作为辅助信号改进优势估计。具体方法为图基优势估计（GraphAE），将每组样本构建为图，节点为回答，边为RM隐藏空间中的相似性，通过图传播计算优势。该方法可轻量集成到GRPO、GSPO、RLOO等组基RL算法中，在多个基准上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 当前RLHF方法依赖标量奖励，存在噪声且无法捕捉细粒度偏好差异，而RM隐藏状态蕴含更丰富的语义和偏好信息。
Method: 提出GraphAE：将每组样本视为图，节点对应回答，边基于RM隐藏空间相似性构建，通过图传播计算每个样本的优势值，从而融入邻域上下文信息。
Result: 在Arena-Hard-v0.1上提升+6.3，AlpacaEval 2.0上提升+8.27，MT-Bench上提升+0.22，表明利用RM表示能提升样本效率和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 利用RM隐藏状态进行优势估计能有效提升RLHF性能，且GraphAE方法轻量、易集成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assessing Automated Prompt Injection Attacks in Agentic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection poses a critical threat to LLM agents that interact with untrusted external data, yet automated attack methods--proven effective for jailbreaking--remain underexplored in realistic agentic settings. We present a comprehensive empirical evaluation of automated prompt injection attacks against LLM agents, adapting both white-box (GCG) and black-box (TAP) methods to the agentic setting within the AgentDojo framework. We evaluate across 80 task pairs spanning four domains and multiple models, and find that black-box optimization substantially outperforms gradient-based methods, a gap we attribute to GCG's optimization instability under reasonable compute budgets. We also find that TAP's effectiveness depends on the attacker model, as both general capability and safety tuning affect attack success--stronger models produce more effective injections, while safety-tuned attackers can refuse to generate adversarial prompts. Task-universal attacks transfer effectively to unseen tasks and out-of-distribution domains, but attacks optimized on smaller open-source models do not transfer to frontier models like GPT-5. These findings highlight automated prompt injection as a credible but model-dependent threat, with significant barriers remaining for model-agnostic exploitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了针对LLM agent的自动提示注入攻击，在AgentDojo框架中适配了白盒GCG和黑盒TAP方法，跨越80个任务对和多个模型。结果显示黑盒优化优于梯度方法，且攻击效果依赖于攻击者模型的能力和安全微调。
Motivation: 间接提示注入对LLM agent构成严重威胁，但自动化攻击方法在真实agent场景中尚未被充分探索。
Method: 在AgentDojo框架中适配了白盒GCG和黑盒TAP方法，评估了跨域任务对和多个模型。
Result: 黑盒优化显著优于基于梯度的方法；攻击有效性依赖于攻击者模型的能力和安全微调；任务通用攻击可迁移到未见任务和域外域，但小模型优化攻击无法迁移到GPT-5等前沿模型。
Conclusion: 自动提示注入是一种可信但模型依赖的威胁，实现模型无关的利用仍存在显著障碍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GUI-AC: Enhancing Continual Learning in GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) serve as the dominant medium for human-computer interaction, yet building GUI agents that generalize across the vast diversity of real-world interface environments, with the same flexibility and robustness that humans naturally exhibit, remains unsolved. Notably, GUI data are inherently non-stationary: the continual emergence of previously unseen interface instances (e.g., novel domains and resolutions) induces persistent distribution shifts, significantly impeding the continual learning of existing GUI agents. Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) has attracted considerable attention as a promising approach. Nevertheless, RFT exhibits pronounced instability in its grounding capability, manifested as sharp reward discontinuities and high-variance oscillations. The imbalanced distribution of rollout outcomes introduces substantial noise into advantage estimation, leading to policy overconfidence. The fixed clipping bound suppresses the increase in policy probabilities needed to adapt to new distributions, leading to a collapse in exploration capacity. To address these challenges, we propose GUI-AC, a method that enhances the continual learning capability of GUI agents. GUI-AC introduces grounding certainty to support two core mechanisms: (i) Adaptive Advantage, which down-weights noisy advantage estimates to prevent policy overconfidence; and (ii) Dynamic Clipping, which relaxes the clipping bound to encourage exploration range. Extensive experiments show that these mechanisms jointly improve performance, enabling our method to surpass state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GUI-AC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GUI代理在非平稳界面环境中的持续学习问题，提出GUI-AC方法。该方法引入接地确定性（grounding certainty）来支持两个核心机制：自适应优势（Adaptive Advantage）降低噪声优势估计，动态裁剪（Dynamic Clipping）放宽裁剪边界以鼓励探索。实验表明该方法在多个基准上超越现有基线。
Motivation: GUI数据本质非平稳，新界面实例持续出现导致分布偏移，阻碍现有GUI代理的持续学习。强化微调（RFT）存在接地能力不稳定、奖励突变、高方差振荡等问题，且固定裁剪边界抑制探索能力。
Method: 提出GUI-AC方法，引入接地确定性（grounding certainty）来支持：1) 自适应优势（Adaptive Advantage）降低噪声优势估计以防止策略过自信；2) 动态裁剪（Dynamic Clipping）放宽裁剪边界以扩大探索范围。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个基准上超越现有最先进基线，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 自适应优势和动态裁剪机制联合提升了GUI代理的持续学习性能，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAFP: Preserving Latent Action Structure in Latent Policy Learning via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Learning high-quality latent actions from large-scale unlabeled videos, coupled with limited real-world interaction data for training an action decoder, has emerged as a promising paradigm for scalable latent policy learning. However, existing approaches typically rely on behavior cloning, which tends to collapse inherently multimodal action distributions into unimodal ones, thereby degrading the pretrained latent action structure. While flow matching provides a potential alternative, directly applying it leads to a misalignment between latent actions and physical actions during action decoder training, due to the stochastic nature of the learned policy. To address these, we propose Latent Action Flow Policy (LAFP), which leverages flow matching for latent policy learning and introduces an inference-time interpolation mechanism to mitigate stochasticity-induced misalignment. Experimental results demonstrate that LAFP consistently outperforms prior methods on downstream imitation learning tasks, achieving up to 10-15% improvement in success rate while incurring less than 1x additional inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Action Flow Policy (LAFP)，利用流匹配 (flow matching) 进行潜在策略学习，并引入推理时插值机制来缓解随机性导致的潜在动作与物理动作之间的错位。实验表明，该方法在下游模仿学习任务上持续优于先前方法，成功率提升10-15%，且额外推理开销不到1倍。
Motivation: 现有潜在动作学习方法通常依赖行为克隆，容易将多峰动作分布退化为单峰，损害预训练的潜在动作结构；直接应用流匹配则因策略的随机性导致动作错位。
Method: 提出 LAFP，核心是使用流匹配进行潜在策略学习，并设计推理时插值机制来抑制随机性引起的错位，从而保留潜在动作结构。
Result: 在多个下游模仿学习任务上，LAFP的成功率相比之前方法提升10-15%，且额外推理开销小于1倍。
Conclusion: 流匹配结合推理时插值能有效保持潜在动作结构，实现更优的模仿学习性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 LAFP，核心是使用流匹配进行潜在策略学习，并设计推理时插值机制来抑制随机性引起的错位，从而保留潜在动作结构。
summary_sections.result: 在多个下游模仿学习任务上，LAFP的成功率相比之前方法提升10-15%，且额外推理开销小于1倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 流匹配结合推理时插值能有效保持潜在动作结构，实现更优的模仿学习性能。

papers.title: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities as autonomous agents across a wide range of tasks, their performance often degrades in multi-turn long-horizon agentic tasks. Existing methods have made progress through fine-grained credit assignment to alleviate long-horizon sparse rewards and hierarchical reinforcement learning to decompose tasks and reduce long-term dependency. However, these methods still do not directly address long-context interference, in which continuously growing histories weaken the agent's ability to track the global task state and impair subsequent reasoning and decision-making. Inspired by the way humans handle complex tasks through subgoal decomposition and completed progress summarization, we propose Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding (HIPIF) for long-horizon LLM agent learning. HIPIF trains the agent end-to-end to organize long-horizon execution around explicit subgoals while folding completed subgoal histories to reduce long-context interference. Furthermore, to stabilize subgoal-based planning and execution, HIPIF combines hierarchical reflection and subgoal-oriented process rewards to guide subgoal generation, transition, and execution, without relying on costly auxiliary models or task-specific expert trajectories. Extensive experiments on three publicly available agentic benchmarks demonstrate the validity of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIPIF 框架，通过分层规划与信息折叠解决 LLM 智能体在长期任务中的长上下文干扰问题。方法将长期执行组织为显式子目标，折叠已完成的子目标历史以减少上下文干扰，并结合分层反思与子目标过程奖励进行稳定规划。在三个公开智能体基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: LLM 在多轮长期任务中性能下降，现有方法虽通过细粒度信用分配和分层强化学习缓解稀疏奖励与长期依赖，但未直接解决长上下文干扰问题，即持续增长的历史削弱了全局状态追踪能力。
Method: 提出 HIPIF，端到端训练 LLM 智能体：以显式子目标组织长期执行，折叠已完成子目标历史；结合分层反思与子目标导向的过程奖励指导子目标生成、转换与执行，无需昂贵辅助模型或任务特定专家轨迹。
Result: 在三个公开智能体基准上，HIPIF 方法有效提升了长期任务性能，具体指标见原文。
Conclusion: HIPIF 通过子目标分解与信息折叠减轻长上下文干扰，为长期 LLM 智能体学习提供了一种无需额外模型或专家数据的解决方案。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation without Paired Data: Theoretical Foundation and Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal knowledge distillation (CMKD) studies how a (large) teacher model trained on one type of data (e.g., images) can guide a (smaller) student model building on another type of data (e.g., text/audio). Existing CMKD methods often require paired multi-modal data with aligned semantics, but obtaining such paired data are often costly and impractical. To mitigate this limitation, we develop a new CMKD framework for the more challenging setting where paired data are unavailable. In particular, we establish a cross-modal distributional relationship between teacher and student models, which reveals two fundamental quantities governing effective distillation: feature alignment and label alignment. These quantities characterize semantic discrepancy between modalities at the levels of representation and prediction distributions, respectively. Motivated by this insight, we propose a principled framework, with theoretical guarantees, that enables effective cross-modal knowledge distillation by aligning distributions rather than individual samples. Extensive experiments across a wide range of multimodal benchmarks show that our framework is highly effective in both unpaired and paired data settings, improving significantly over prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无配对数据下的跨模态知识蒸馏，建立教师和学生模型之间的跨模态分布关系，揭示特征对齐和标签对齐两个关键量，并提出基于分布对齐而非样本对齐的理论框架。实验表明该方法在无配对和有配对设置下均有效，显著优于先前工作。
Motivation: 现有跨模态知识蒸馏方法通常需要配对的多模态数据，但获取此类数据成本高且不现实。本文旨在解决无配对数据设置下的高效蒸馏问题。
Method: 建立跨模态分布关系，提出通过分布对齐而非样本对齐的知识蒸馏框架，具有理论保证。
Result: 在多种多模态基准上，该方法在无配对和有配对数据设置下均显著优于先前工作。
Conclusion: 分布对齐可以替代样本对齐实现有效的跨模态知识蒸馏，扩展了知识蒸馏的适用场景。

papers.title: A Reliable Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Belief Rule Base Consider Robustness Analysis
papers.abstract_en: In equipment operation, the implementation of fault diagnosis is essential to ensure the continuity and safety of production equipment, improve operational efficiency and reduce maintenance costs. Since sensor readings are widely used for fault diagnosis, their reliability directly affects the results of fault diagnosis. A new fault diagnosis method is proposed to address the two problems of robustness assessment and robustness optimization of fault diagnosis models. For this purpose, a reliable fault diagnosis method based on a belief rule base (BRB) considering robustness analysis is proposed. Firstly, the robustness analysis of the BRB model is carried out systematically. Secondly, three robustness constraint strategies are proposed to optimize the robustness of the BRB fault diagnosis model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by taking the fault diagnosis of WD615 diesel engine and Case Western Reserve University bearings as an example, and the experiments show that the proposed model improves both accuracy and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对设备故障诊断中传感器可靠性影响结果的问题，提出一种基于置信规则库（BRB）的可靠故障诊断方法，系统性地进行鲁棒性分析，并提出三种鲁棒性约束策略优化模型。在WD615柴油机和CWRU轴承故障诊断实验中，该方法同时提高了诊断准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有故障诊断模型缺乏对鲁棒性的系统评估与优化，传感器可靠性直接影响诊断结果，亟需一种同时考虑鲁棒性分析和优化的方法。
Method: 首先对BRB模型进行系统的鲁棒性分析；然后提出三种鲁棒性约束策略（如不确定性传播边界、参数扰动范围等）来优化模型鲁棒性；最后在柴油机和轴承数据集上验证。
Result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在WD615柴油机和CWRU轴承故障诊断中，相比传统BRB方法，在准确性和鲁棒性上均有提升。
Conclusion: 该方法能够有效提升故障诊断模型对传感器噪声和不确定性的鲁棒性，但未讨论计算复杂度或对其他类型故障的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MoE Enhanced Federated Learning for Spatiotemporal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Traffic prediction is fundamental to intelligent transportation systems and urban computing, yet many cities continue to suffer from traffic data scarcity due to limited sensor deployment and uneven urban development. Cross-city knowledge transfer has thus attracted increasing attention, enabling data-rich cities to assist data-scarce ones. However, centralized approaches raise privacy concerns, while existing federated methods struggle with pronounced spatiotemporal heterogeneity across cities. To address these challenges, we propose MoE-FedTP, a personalized federated cross-city spatiotemporal prediction framework based on lightweight Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) networks. MoE-FedTP first employs spatiotemporal neural networks to extract features from both source and target cities, then introduces a set of expert networks derived from different source cities through partial parameter sharing. A gating mechanism dynamically fuses the experts to capture diverse traffic dynamics, achieving fine-grained modeling of urban heterogeneity while preserving privacy. Experiments on four real-world traffic datasets show that MoE-FedTP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cross-city and federated learning baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing prediction accuracy for data-scarce cities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoE-FedTP，一种基于轻量级混合专家网络（MoE）的个性化联邦跨城市时空预测框架。通过将不同源城市的专家网络进行部分参数共享，并利用门控机制动态融合，MoE-FedTP在保护隐私的同时实现了对城市间异质性的细粒度建模。在四个真实交通数据集上，该方法优于现有的跨城市和联邦学习基线。
Motivation: 交通预测中数据稀缺问题普遍，跨城市知识转移面临隐私顾虑和时空异质性的挑战，现有联邦学习方法难以应对城市间的显著异质性。
Method: 采用时空神经网络提取源城市和目标城市的特征，引入从不同源城市派生的专家网络并通过部分参数共享实现，门控机制动态融合专家以捕捉多样的交通动态。
Result: 在四个真实交通数据集上，MoE-FedTP持续优于最先进的跨城市和联邦学习基线，证明了其在提升数据稀缺城市预测准确性方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法通过个性化联邦学习和MoE网络实现了隐私保护下的跨城市知识转移，并有效建模了城市异质性。

papers.title: Achieving Cloud-Grade SLOs for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference through CPU-GPU Hybrid Design
papers.abstract_en: Local deployment of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models falls short of the service quality achieved in cloud-scale environments, even under low-concurrency workloads. We identify four key gaps in local MoE inference: reliance on capacity-reduced models (quantized, distilled, rerouted), inability to meet 30-second TTFT for long prefills (more than 12K), sub-baseline decode throughput (under 20 tokens/s), and poor concurrency under mixed prefill-decode and batched decode workloads. We present a CPU-GPU hybrid system that achieves cloud-level SLOs on dual-socket commodity CPUs and consumer GPUs by (1) stream-loading prefill (SLP), boosting prefill throughput to 1,200 tokens/s and enabling 32K prompts within 30 seconds; (2) distributed SLP (DSLP) with SmallEP expert parallelism, reaching 1,800 tokens/s and 45K prompts in 30 seconds on two RTX 5090s; (3) intra-node prefill-decode disaggregation with zero-copy shared weights and a dual-batch attention-MoE overlap scheme, sustaining concurrency with under 15 percent latency increase and 50 percent throughput gains; (4) an AVX-512-optimized FP8 GEMV kernel, enabling native CPU FP8 inference while delivering 4-5x lower CPU latency; and (5) fine-grained CPU parallelism that attains 28 tokens/s on INT4 DeepSeek-V3 and 21.5 tokens/s on intact FP8 V3. Evaluations show our system delivers cloud-level QoS for flagship MoE models on consumer CPU-GPU platforms, reshaping local deployment with intact, original-precision inference and enabling high-quality, cost-effective access without datacenter infrastructure.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 20th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation (OSDI '26). The official version will appear in the OSDI '26 proceedings published by USENIX
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对本地部署的混合专家（MoE）模型在低并发下服务质量低于云环境的问题，提出CPU-GPU混合推理系统。通过流加载预填充（SLP）、分布式SLP（DSLP）结合SmallEP专家并行、节点内预填充-解码分离、AVX-512优化的FP8 GEMV内核和细粒度CPU并行等五项技术，在双插槽消费级CPU和RTX 5090 GPU上实现了云级SLO：预填充吞吐量达1,200 tokens/s（单GPU）和1,800 tokens/s（双GPU），32K/45K长度提示在30秒内完成；解码吞吐量在INT4 DeepSeek-V3上达28 tokens/s，FP8原版达21.5 tokens/s。评估表明该系统可在无数据中心基础设施的条件下提供高质量、低成本的本土MoE推理服务。
Motivation: 本地部署的大型MoE模型在低并发下仍远达不到云环境服务质量，存在四个关键缺口：依赖容量缩减模型、无法在30秒内处理超过12K长的预填充、解码吞吐量低于20 tokens/s、混合预填充-解码和批量解码工作负载下的并发性差。
Method: 提出CPU-GPU混合推理系统，包含五项核心技术：(1) 流加载预填充（SLP），提升预填充吞吐量至1,200 tokens/s；(2) 分布式SLP（DSLP）结合SmallEP专家并行，在双RTX 5090上达1,800 tokens/s；(3) 节点内预填充-解码分离，通过零拷贝共享权重和双批次注意力-MoE重叠方案，实现低于15%延迟增长和50%吞吐提升；(4) AVX-512优化的FP8 GEMV内核，实现原生CPU FP8推理，降低4-5倍延迟；(5) 细粒度CPU并行，在INT4 DeepSeek-V3和FP8原版上分别达28和21.5 tokens/s解码吞吐。
Result: 系统在消费级CPU-GPU平台上达成云级QoS：单GPU预填充吞吐量1,200 tokens/s，双GPU达1,800 tokens/s，支持30秒内处理32K/45K长度提示；预填充-解码分离仅增加不到15%延迟并提升50%吞吐；CPU FP8推理延迟降低4-5倍；解码吞吐量在INT4和FP8模型上分别达到28和21.5 tokens/s。
Conclusion: 该系统实现了云级服务质量，以原始精度完整模型在消费级CPU-GPU平台上重塑本地部署，无需数据中心基础设施即可获得高质量、低成本的MoE推理。

summary_sections.result: 系统在消费级CPU-GPU平台上达成云级QoS：单GPU预填充吞吐量1,200 tokens/s，双GPU达1,800 tokens/s，支持30秒内处理32K/45K长度提示；预填充-解码分离仅增加不到15%延迟并提升50%吞吐；CPU FP8推理延迟降低4-5倍；解码吞吐量在INT4和FP8模型上分别达到28和21.5 tokens/s。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该系统实现了云级服务质量，以原始精度完整模型在消费级CPU-GPU平台上重塑本地部署，无需数据中心基础设施即可获得高质量、低成本的MoE推理。

papers.title: PathRelax: Parallel-Path Relaxed Speculative Jacobi Decoding for Accelerating Auto-Regressive Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: The growing need for high-resolution image generation in autoregressive text-to-image models has resulted in extended token sequences, significantly increasing computational costs and inference times. However, existing state-of-the-art methods for accelerating autoregressive text-to-image models rely on chain-structured draft token sequences, leading to inefficient draft token search and limited acceptance lengths. To address this, we propose parallel-path cross-relaxed speculative Jacobi decoding (\textbf{PathSpec}), a novel framework that enhances efficiency through a multi-sequence draft tree structure. Our parallel-path speculative Jacobi decoding (\textbf{PathExplore}) expands the token search space, achieving a higher speedup ratio without sacrificing image quality. Additionally, we introduce cross-path relaxed verification (\textbf{PathRelax}) that exploits semantic similarities across sequences to further boost token acceptance rates. Evaluated on the Parti-Prompts, MSCOCO2017, and T2ICompBench datasets, our method achieves a speedup ratio of 4.14 $\times$, 3.95$\times$, and 4.18$\times$, respectively. Remarkably, PathExplore, without any relaxed sampling, outperforms relaxed sampling methods in the speedup ratio, such as GSD and LANTERN. Moreover, PathRelax's relaxation mechanism can be seamlessly integrated with other relaxation techniques, enabling further acceleration and providing an efficient solution for real-time text-to-image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Haodong-Lei-Ray/PathSpec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归文本到图像生成中长序列导致的高计算成本，提出并行路径交叉松弛推测雅可比解码（PathSpec），通过多序列候选树结构扩展搜索空间，并引入跨路径松弛验证提高接受率。在Parti-Prompts、MSCOCO2017和T2ICompBench上分别实现4.14×、3.95×和4.18×的加速比，且PathExplore本身无需松弛采样即可超越现有松弛方法。
Motivation: 现有加速方法依赖链式草稿序列，导致搜索效率低、接受长度有限，难以满足高分辨率图像生成的实时需求。
Method: 提出PathExplore并行路径推测雅可比解码，通过多序列树状结构扩展搜索空间；以及PathRelax跨路径松弛验证，利用序列间语义相似性提升接受率。
Result: 在Parti-Prompts、MSCOCO2017和T2ICompBench上分别获得4.14×、3.95×和4.18×加速比，PathExplore本身在加速比上优于GSD和LANTERN等松弛采样方法。
Conclusion: 该方法可与其他松弛技术无缝集成，进一步加速实时文本到图像生成，代码已开源。

papers.title: A complementary study on PlanGPT: Evaluation with defined Performance Metrics and comparison with a planner
papers.abstract_en: Automated Planning is a subfield of Artificial Intelligence (AI) where the main objective is generating a sequence of actions, known as a plan, that helps us reach a goal state from an initial state. A planning problem is defined by a set of objects, an initial state and a desired goal state. The objective is to compute a plan that'll lead us from the inital state to the goal state. Programs that generate plans are called planners. In this paper, we did a complementary study to the state-of-the-art LLM called PlanGPT which was released last year. We redid some experiments to verify whether planning with LLMs is \textbf{pertinent} and \textbf{worthwhile}. We also check whether the results obtained in the official PlanGPT paper for plan coverage were correct, and we also performed a more comprehensive study on PlanGPT's performance: in our paper PlanGPT's performance was evaluated using two metrics: Plan Cost and Plan Generation Time. The results of planGPT were compared to those produced by a traditional planner for the same plans and same metrics. We discovered that PlanGPT is no better than a Greedy search strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对去年发布的PlanGPT（基于LLM的规划器）的补充研究。作者重新进行了实验，验证了使用LLM进行规划的合理性和价值，并检查了原论文中规划覆盖率的正确性。通过计划成本和计划生成时间两个指标，将PlanGPT与传统规划器进行比较，发现PlanGPT并不优于贪婪搜索策略。
Motivation: 由于LLM在自动规划领域的应用尚不明确，作者希望验证PlanGPT的宣称性能是否可靠，并评估其相对于传统规划器的实际价值。
Method: 重复PlanGPT原论文的实验，使用计划成本（Plan Cost）和计划生成时间（Plan Generation Time）两个指标，将PlanGPT的结果与一个传统规划器进行比较。
Result: PlanGPT在计划覆盖率和其它指标上并不优于贪婪搜索策略。
Conclusion: 该研究表明，目前LLM（以PlanGPT为例）在自动规划任务上与传统方法相比没有优势，甚至不如简单的贪婪搜索。

papers.title: 5% > 100%: Flatness Preference is All You Need for Multimodal Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods provide a streamlined and efficient tool for adapting large models to domain-specific multimodal downstream tasks. Although these methods proved their tangible effects in practice, their principal aspects remain under-explored. Therefore we remain curious about the underlying generalization mechanisms in various PEFT methods and how they can be further enhanced. In this paper, we reveal the flatness preference widely present in various PEFTs, where a small fraction of sharp dimensions dominates the generalization of PEFT. This finding suggests an appealing possibility: we may be satisfied with a better generalization by merely attending to this small fraction of sharp dimensions instead of all of them. Furthermore, we propose Flatness Preference Optimization (FlatPO) to flatten these key sharpness dimensions, leading various PEFTs toward better generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our findings and the proposed method. Code is available at https://github.com/Can-Lin/FlatPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示参数高效微调（PEFT）方法中广泛存在的平坦性偏好，即少数尖锐维度主导泛化；提出Flatness Preference Optimization (FlatPO) 展平这些关键维度，显著提升PEFT泛化性能。
Motivation: PEFT方法在实践中有效，但其底层泛化机制尚不明确。本文旨在探索PEFT的泛化原理，并寻找进一步提升的方法。
Method: 通过分析发现PEFT中普遍存在的平坦性偏好，即少数尖锐维度对泛化起决定性作用；据此提出FlatPO，专门优化这些关键尖锐维度。
Result: 大量实验验证了平坦性偏好的存在以及FlatPO的有效性，表明针对尖锐维度优化可引导PEFT实现更好泛化。
Conclusion: 平坦性偏好是PEFT泛化的关键机制，FlatPO通过聚焦尖锐维度优化，为提升PEFT性能提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stop Early, Spend Less: Hidden-State Probes as a Practical Recipe for Streaming Moderation of LLM Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models in user-facing systems requires efficient output safety filtering. Existing approaches typically rely on a separate moderation model applied after generation, which doubles inference cost and only detects violations after generation completes. We observe that the signal needed for moderation is already present in the model hidden states. Based on this, we train lightweight token-level probes that operate directly on internal activations, producing per-token safety scores that can be aggregated for both offline evaluation and online intervention. The probe reuses activations from the generator and requires no additional forward pass, enabling sub millisecond per-token safety checks inside the decoding loop. A probe applied to a single mid layer recovers most decisions of a strong guard model, acting as a low cost surrogate optimized for latency rather than accuracy. In streaming settings, it can halt or modify unsafe outputs before they are fully generated, replacing end of sequence moderation with continuous token level monitoring. Compared to post hoc and streaming guard models, our method achieves orders of magnitude lower compute overhead with minimal latency cost. We also provide a practical deployment recipe, including layer selection, aggregation strategy, probing frequency, and triggering thresholds. Finally, we show that the probe linear component corresponds to a direction in residual space, enabling both detection and activation steering at negligible cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型内部隐藏状态的轻量级探针（probe）进行流式输出安全审核，在解码循环中以亚毫秒级速度生成每令牌安全分数，可提前中断或修改不安全输出，比后处理模型降低数个数量级的计算开销。
Motivation: 现有输出安全过滤方法通常在生成完成后额外运行一个审核模型，导致推理成本翻倍且无法在生成过程中干预。
Method: 训练轻量级令牌级线性探针，直接复用生成模型的内部激活（无需额外前向传播），在解码循环中实时输出安全分数，并支持通过聚合策略进行离线评估或在线干预。
Result: 在单个中间层上训练的探针即可恢复强守卫模型的大部分决策，计算开销比后处理或流式守卫模型低数个数量级，延迟极小。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种低延迟、低成本的流式审核方案，包括层选择、聚合策略、探测频率和触发阈值等实用部署建议，并揭示探针线性分量对应残差空间中的方向，可用于检测和激活操控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Advancing the State-of-the-Art in Empirical Privacy Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) can exhibit problematic memorization of individual training examples. Empirical privacy auditing (EPA) quantifies this risk by measuring realistic data leakage on membership inference (MI) or reconstruction attacks. A key challenge in EPA is designing ``canary'' examples that are mixed with the privacy-sensitive training data. We propose generating synthetic canaries via high-temperature sampling ($T \geq 0.8$) from LLMs, using prompts tailored to the privacy-sensitive training data. These canaries act as high-influence outliers, ensuring high identifiability and hence strong audits. Further, since the canaries are themselves non-private, they are inspectable and can be inserted with repetition without jeopardizing the privacy of the real data. An important use of models fine-tuned on privacy-sensitive data is the generation of synthetic data. This also comes with privacy risk. We introduce a powerful synthetic data audit based on fine-tuning an auxiliary model on the synthetic data. Auditing the auxiliary model for the original canaries then provides a strong estimate of the privacy leakage through the synthetic data. Finally, leveraging our strong auditing methodologies, we perform a systematic investigation into the interacting effects of model capacity and canary entropy on memorization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型参数高效微调中的记忆泄露问题，提出使用高温采样（T≥0.8）生成合成canary以进行经验隐私审计，并可审计通过微调辅助模型生成的合成数据的隐私泄露。摘要表明该方法提供强大的审计能力，并系统研究了模型容量和canary熵对记忆化的交互影响。
Motivation: 现有经验隐私审计面临设计能有效混合隐私敏感训练数据的canary的挑战，难以准确量化数据泄露风险。
Method: 提出从LLM中高温采样生成合成canary作为高影响力异常值，用于成员推断和重建攻击审计；并引入一种基于在合成数据上微调辅助模型的新审计方法，以评估合成数据本身的隐私泄露。
Result: 摘要称该方法实现了强大的隐私审计效果，并通过系统实验揭示了模型容量与canary熵对记忆化的交互作用。
Conclusion: 合成canary本身非私有、可检查且可重复插入，不损害真实数据隐私；该审计框架也适用于评估合成数据的隐私风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ComBench: A Benchmark for Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization in Olympiad-Level Combinatorics
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorics is central to Olympiad-level mathematical problem solving, requiring deep discrete reasoning, creative constructions, and rigorous structural insight. Recent evidence suggests that even today's strongest frontier models remain uneven on Olympiad combinatorics, revealing a gap in creative mathematical reasoning. We introduce ComBench, an Olympiad-level combinatorics benchmark for evaluating and diagnosing the combinatorial reasoning capabilities of large language models. ComBench contains 100 human-annotated competition-level problems organized around two complementary settings: analysis-centric problems, which primarily require rigorous mathematical arguments, and construction-centric problems, which require explicit constructions in addition to correctness justifications. The evaluation protocol combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic construction verification, exposing cases where proof quality and construction validity diverge. Experiments on frontier open- and closed-source models show that ComBench is far from saturated: the strongest model reaches 65.4% overall Avg. and 75.3% overall Best@4. We further find that Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization are distinct capabilities: Kimi-K2.6 trails GPT-5.5 on analysis-centric proof grading but surpasses it on construction-centric Best@4, while Existence and Construction problems remain consistently hardest across representative frontier models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ComBench 是一个面向奥林匹克级组合数学的基准，包含100道人工标注的竞赛题，分为分析型（需要严格数学论证）和构造型（需要显式构造和正确性证明）。实验表明，最强模型（如GPT-5.5）整体平均准确率仅65.4%，Best@4为75.3%，且证明推理与构造实现是两种分离的能力。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在奥林匹克组合数学上表现不均，缺乏创造性数学推理能力，亟需专门的基准来系统评估和诊断。
Method: 构建包含100道人工标注竞赛题的基准ComBench，区分分析型（rigorous proof reasoning）与构造型（constructive realization）问题；采用基于评分标准的证明评分与确定性构造验证相结合的评估协议。
Result: 最强模型整体平均65.4%，Best@4达75.3%；Kimi-K2.6在分析型证明评分上落后GPT-5.5，但在构造型Best@4上超越；存在性问题与构造问题对各类前沿模型始终最难。
Conclusion: ComBench远未饱和，证明推理与构造实现是两种不同能力，现有模型在这两方面存在显著不平衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有大语言模型在奥林匹克组合数学上表现不均，缺乏创造性数学推理能力，亟需专门的基准来系统评估和诊断。
summary_sections.method: 构建包含100道人工标注竞赛题的基准ComBench，区分分析型（rigorous proof reasoning）与构造型（constructive realization）问题；采用基于评分标准的证明评分与确定性构造验证相结合的评估协议。
summary_sections.result: 最强模型整体平均65.4%，Best@4达75.3%；Kimi-K2.6在分析型证明评分上落后GPT-5.5，但在构造型Best@4上超越；存在性问题与构造问题对各类前沿模型始终最难。
summary_sections.conclusion: ComBench远未饱和，证明推理与构造实现是两种不同能力，现有模型在这两方面存在显著不平衡。

papers.title: 3D-CoS: A New 3D Reconstruction Paradigm Based on VLM Code Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Most recent 3D reconstruction and editing systems operate on implicit and explicit representations such as NeRF, point clouds, or meshes. While these representations enable high-fidelity rendering, they are fundamentally low-level and hard to control programmatically. In contrast, we propose and systematically evaluate a new 3D reconstruction paradigm, 3D Code Synthesis (3D-CoS), where 3D assets are constructed as executable Blender code, a programmatic and interpretable medium. To assess how well current VLMs can use code to represent 3D objects, we evaluate representative open-source and closed-source VLMs in code-based reconstruction under a unified protocol. We further introduce a suite of structured code-synthesis workflows, including blueprint-based planning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over Blender API documentation, few-shot geometric demonstrations, and a component-level Agent workflow for part-wise code generation. To demonstrate the unique advantages of this representation, we further evaluate localized text-driven modifications and compare our code-based edits with a point-cloud-based 3D editing baseline. Our study shows that code as a 3D representation offers strong controllability and locality, yielding stronger edit fidelity and better preservation of unedited regions in our targeted editing evaluation. Our work also analyzes the potential of this paradigm, delineates the current capability frontier of VLMs for programmatic 3D modeling, and highlights code synthesis as a promising direction for editable 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3D-CoS（3D Code Synthesis）新范式，将3D物体重建为可执行的Blender代码，而非传统的隐式或显式表示（如NeRF、点云）。系统性地评估了多种视觉语言模型（VLM）在代码化3D重建上的能力，并引入蓝图规划、RAG、少样本几何演示和组件级Agent工作流等结构化代码合成方法。实验表明，代码表示在局部文本驱动编辑任务中具有更强的可控性和区域保真度。
Motivation: 现有3D重建系统基于NeRF、点云等底层表示，难以程序化控制和编辑。本文旨在探索将3D资产表示为可解释、可编程的代码（Blender代码）是否可行，并评估当前VLM在此范式下的能力。
Method: 提出3D-CoS，即基于VLM的代码合成重建3D对象。设计了统一评估协议，并引入蓝图规划、RAG（基于Blender API文档）、少样本几何演示和组件级Agent工作流等多种结构化工作流。
Result: 在代码化3D重建任务上评估了多个开源和闭源VLM。编辑实验表明，代码表示相比点云基线在局部编辑上具有更高的编辑保真度和更优的未编辑区域保持能力。
Conclusion: 代码作为3D表示具有强可控性和局部性，是值得进一步探索的可编辑3D重建方向。本文也勾勒了当前VLM在程序化3D建模方面的能力边界。

papers.title: Decoupling Thought from Speech: Knowledge-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Resilient Multi-Agent Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate frameworks have been shown to improve large language model performance in convergent tasks, but they are currently optimized in a way that heavily favors final output accuracy rather than stability of the process. During long-horizon exchanges reactive systems under sustained perturbations often experience logic degradation, argument repetition, and role drift. To structurally prevent the identity loss and maintain the process fidelity, we introduce Knowledge-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning (KG-CFR), a dual-stage architecture that enforces a strict separation of concerns between a private, retrieval-augmented planning buffer, and a public execution layer. We assess this system in Dynamic Resource Allocation under Uncertainty (DRAU), a dedicated 1v1v1 environment, introducing diversity as distinct from standard debate settings. Over 270 completely factorial crisis simulation trajectories with stochastic environmental shocks, KG-CFR prevents judge-detected critical post-shock degradation (defined as a quality shift, $Δ\le -0.20$) in more than 95% of perturbed runs, increasing the overall argument quality from 0.694 to 0.822. Our primary contribution is the demonstration of architectural decoupling being an important factor of systemic resilience enhancement under sustained pressure without quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce custom vector metrics for discourse divergence and plan-execution alignment that provide strong, directionally consistent evidence of operational stability. Our ablation experiments suggest that the proper doctrinal grounding can be an equally important factor for argument quality, as the prospective planning. KG-CFR, according to our initial metric evaluations, reduces semantic looping, by preserving the agent's consistency with the original plan.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems (KES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识接地反事实推理（KG-CFR）架构，用于多智能体辩论系统，通过分离私有规划缓冲区和公共执行层来增强系统在扰动下的稳定性。在动态资源分配不确定性环境（DRAU）中，KG-CFR在95%以上受扰动运行中防止了质量下降（Δ≤-0.20），并将整体论证质量从0.694提升到0.822。主要贡献是展示架构解耦对系统韧性的重要性。
Motivation: 现有多智能体辩论框架优化最终输出准确性但过程稳定性不足，长期交互中易出现逻辑退化、论点重复和角色漂移。需要结构性方法防止身份丢失并保持过程保真度。
Method: 提出双阶段架构KG-CFR，强制执行私有、检索增强的规划缓冲区与公共执行层的严格分离，并利用反事实推理。
Result: 在DRAU环境中，超过270次完全因子危机模拟轨迹中，KG-CFR在95%以上受扰动运行中防止了关键质量下降，整体论证质量从0.694提升到0.822。引入自定义向量指标用于话语发散和计划-执行对齐。
Conclusion: 架构解耦是增强系统韧性的重要因素，且正确的教义基础与前瞻规划同等重要。初始评估表明KG-CFR通过保持代理与原始计划的一致性减少了语义循环。

papers.title: Trading Utility for Dynamic Fairness in Multiple Resource Division with Sequential Demand
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic multi-resource allocation is a central problem in shared computing environments, where users' demands arrive sequentially and resources must be distributed fairly without knowledge of future demands. Existing methods emphasize fairness guarantees such as Sharing Incentive, Envy Freeness, and Dynamic Pareto Optimality, but often overlook system utility. Moreover, these fairness criteria are mutually incompatible, preventing strict enforcement of them at the same time. We propose a neural allocation mechanism that reconciles fairness with utility through multi-objective optimization during sequential rollout. We first formalize fairness in the dynamic setting via stepwise loss functions for Sharing Incentive, Envy Freeness, and Dynamic Pareto Optimality, enabling differentiable training. Leveraging non-wastefulness, we parameterized the solutions by constraining allocations to the subspace of demand while allowing elastic over-allocation when resources remain available. Empirical results demonstrate that our learned allocator achieves substantially higher utility at comparable levels of fairness, uncovering clear Pareto-frontier-like tradeoffs across metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经分配机制，通过多目标优化在序列需求到达时权衡多资源分配的公平性与系统效用。公平性指标（共享激励、无嫉妒、动态帕累托最优）被形式化为可微损失函数，并利用非浪费性约束参数化解空间。实验表明，学习到的分配器在相同公平性水平下实现了显著更高的效用，并展示了清晰的帕累托前沿权衡。
Motivation: 现有动态多资源分配方法强调公平性但常忽视系统效用，且公平性准则相互不兼容，难以同时严格满足。
Method: 提出基于神经网络的分配机制，通过将公平性指标转化为可微损失函数，结合非浪费性约束（允许弹性超额分配），在序列展开中执行多目标优化。
Result: 实验表明，学习到的分配器在可比公平性水平上实现了显著更高的系统效用，并揭示了不同指标间的帕累托前沿权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了通过可微优化在动态资源分配中平衡公平与效用的可行性，但未讨论具体算例或实际系统部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting Speculative Language in Biomedical Texts using Recurrent Neural Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this investigation, we delve into the automated detection of speculative language within biomedical articles by utilizing distributed sentence representations and advanced deep learning techniques. The implications of such identification extend to information retrieval, multi-document summarization, and the exploration of new knowledge. Our exploration encompasses two distinct approaches for acquiring distributed sentence representations: the Paragraph Vector model and the Recursive Neural Tensor Network. These methodologies are then rigorously compared against three foundational baseline algorithms: Support Vector Machines, Naive Bayes, and pattern matching. Our findings reveal that the Recursive Neural Tensor Network (RNTN) demonstrates a slight performance edge (F1 = 0.885) over the top-performing baseline, the linear bigram SVM (F1 = 0.881). Meanwhile, the Paragraph Vector model proves less effective (F1 = 0.368), even after extensive training using an expansive, unlabeled dataset. We engage in a comprehensive discourse on the factors influencing these performance disparities and provide insightful recommendations for future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生物医学文献中推测性语言的自动检测，利用分布式句子表示和深度学习技术。比较了Paragraph Vector模型和递归神经张量网络（RNTN）两种方法，并与SVM、朴素贝叶斯和模式匹配等基线对比。结果表明RNTN（F1=0.885）略优于线性双元SVM（F1=0.881），而Paragraph Vector模型效果较差（F1=0.368）。
Motivation: 生物医学文本中推测性语言的自动检测有助于信息检索、多文档摘要和新知识探索，但目前方法性能有限。
Method: 采用两种分布式句子表示方法：Paragraph Vector模型和递归神经张量网络（RNTN），并与SVM、朴素贝叶斯和模式匹配三种基线算法进行对比。
Result: RNTN取得最高F1分数0.885，略优于线性双元SVM的0.881；Paragraph Vector模型仅0.368。
Conclusion: RNTN在推测性语言检测任务上表现略优，但差异不大；未来需进一步研究性能差异的原因和改进方向。

papers.title: A Mean-Field Analysis of Multi-Head Self-Attention under Cross-Entropy Training
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a mean-field theory for a simplified single-layer causal multi-head self-attention model trained by cross-entropy minimization. Each attention head is treated as a particle in parameter space, and the empirical law of the heads is used as the large-head state variable. In the infinite-head limit, the averaged attention logits define a risk functional on probability measures, whose first variation generates a nonlinear Wasserstein gradient-flow equation. Unlike classical mean-field analyses of shallow networks that often focus on square-loss regression, the present model contains the softmax residual from the cross-entropy objective and the query-key-value structure of masked self-attention. We prove a static finite-head approximation bound for the optimal risk, characterize global minimizers through a variational support condition, and establish a quantitative finite-time propagation-of-chaos estimate comparing finite-head stochastic gradient descent with the limiting PDE. We then study the long-time behavior of the PDE: energy dissipation, convergence to the stationary set under compactness, convergence to a single stationary measure under topological or Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz assumptions, and explicit convergence rates under gradient-domination conditions. Finally, we prove local exponential stability under a Wasserstein strong-monotonicity condition and give verifiable stability and instability criteria for Dirac stationary measures. The results provide a rigorous baseline mean-field framework for attention-head training and clarify the additional compactness, landscape, and curvature assumptions needed to pass from stationarity to convergence and stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对简化单层因果多头自注意力模型（由交叉熵训练）的均值场理论。通过将每个注意力头视为参数空间中的粒子，在头数无穷大极限下，平均注意力logits定义了概率测度上的风险泛函，其一阶变分生成非线性Wasserstein梯度流方程。论文证明了有限头近似最优风险的静态界，刻画了全局最小化子的变分支撑条件，并建立了有限头随机梯度下降与极限PDE之间的定量有限时间混沌传播估计。进一步分析了PDE的长时间行为：能量耗散、紧性下收敛到稳态集、Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz假设下的收敛到单一稳态测度、梯度主导条件下的显式收敛速率，以及Wasserstein强单调性下的局部指数稳定性。
Motivation: 多头自注意力是Transformer的核心，但对其训练动态的理论理解有限，尤其是交叉熵目标下的机制。现有均值场分析多聚焦于平方损失回归的浅层网络，缺乏对掩码自注意力中的softmax残差和查询-键-值结构的研究。
Method: 将每个注意力头视为参数空间中的粒子，使用经验分布作为大数状态变量。在头数无穷大极限下，推导平均注意力logits的风险泛函及其一阶变分对应的Wasserstein梯度流方程。通过概率测度上的变分分析和PDE方法建立理论。
Result: 证明了有限头近似最优风险的静态界；刻画了全局最小化子的支撑条件；建立了随机梯度下降与极限PDE的定量有限时间混沌传播估计；推导了PDE的长时间行为（能量耗散、收敛性、显式速率）以及局部指数稳定性/不稳定性判据。
Conclusion: 该框架为注意力头训练提供了严格的均值场理论基础，阐明了从平稳性到收敛与稳定性所需的额外紧性、景观和曲率假设。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 证明了有限头近似最优风险的静态界；刻画了全局最小化子的支撑条件；建立了随机梯度下降与极限PDE的定量有限时间混沌传播估计；推导了PDE的长时间行为（能量耗散、收敛性、显式速率）以及局部指数稳定性/不稳定性判据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为注意力头训练提供了严格的均值场理论基础，阐明了从平稳性到收敛与稳定性所需的额外紧性、景观和曲率假设。

papers.title: Geometric Coastline Localization using Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Coastline detection in remote sensing imagery is commonly formulated as a pixel-wise segmentation problem, where the final coastline is extracted from a predicted mask through post-processing. This formulation relegates coastline geometry, the primary representation used in coastal change analysis, to a secondary artifact rather than the learning objective. In practice, coastlines are defined by geomorphic proxies such as vegetation lines, dune toes, or cliff edges, rather than an instantaneous land-water boundary often used in pixel-based segmentation approaches. In this work, we revisit coastline extraction from a representation perspective and formulate the task as geometric boundary localization. We use the New Zealand Coastal Change Dataset (NZCCD) and high-resolution aerial imagery from Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) to develop CoastlineVLM-7B, a vision-language model (VLM) built on the GeoChat-7B/LLaVA-1.5 architecture that jointly performs coastline presence detection, proxy-type classification, and coastline grounding. The model directly predicts a coastline as a polyline rather than a dense segmentation mask. We evaluate CoastlineVLM-7B against segmentation baselines under strict one-pixel boundary supervision. Results show that geometry-based metrics are more suitable for assessing coastline localization quality than pixel-overlap metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU). CoastlineVLM-7B improves global geometric alignment with reference coastlines, reducing Hausdorff distance from 37.74 m to 31.84 m and Earth Mover's Distance from 21.12 m to 17.32 m. These results indicate that output representation is a critical design choice in coastline extraction, and that geometry-oriented learning, combined with the semantic reasoning capabilities of vision-language models, aligns well with how coastlines are defined and evaluated in operational coastal monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视遥感影像中的海岸线提取问题，将任务从像素级分割重构为几何边界定位。作者基于GeoChat-7B/LLaVA-1.5架构构建了CoastlineVLM-7B模型，直接预测折线形式的海岸线，并联合执行存在性检测、代理类型分类和接地。在新西兰海岸变化数据集和高分辨率航拍图像上，该模型相比于分割基线方法，在几何指标（Hausdorff距离从37.74m降至31.84m，Earth Mover's Distance从21.12m降至17.32m）上表现更优，表明输出表示形式是海岸线提取的关键设计选择。
Motivation: 传统海岸线检测通常建模为像素级分割，再通过后处理提取海岸线，这使海岸线几何（变化分析的主要表示）沦为次要产物。作者认为应直接将几何边界定位作为学习目标。
Method: 基于GeoChat-7B/LLaVA-1.5架构构建CoastlineVLM-7B视觉语言模型，直接预测折线（polyline）而非分割掩码。模型联合执行海岸线存在性检测、代理类型分类和海岸线接地。
Result: 在严格单像素边界监督下，CoastlineVLM-7B相比于分割基线，将Hausdorff距离从37.74m降至31.84m，Earth Mover's Distance从21.12m降至17.32m，表明几何导向的学习更优。
Conclusion: 输出表示形式是海岸线提取的关键设计选择；结合视觉语言模型的语义推理能力，几何导向的学习与海岸线定义及评估方式更一致。

papers.title: UPLOTS: A Unified Pretrained Language Model for Constrained Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: In time-series generation, existing approaches typically handcraft ortrain a separate model for each dataset, which hinders their scalability and fails to leverage shared temporal structures across domains. To address this fragmentation, we propose UPLOTS, a Unified, Prompt-guided Language model framework fOr constrained Time-Series Generation across diverse domains. Instead of building task-specific models, UPLOTS leverages a single pre-trained transformer backbone guided by learned constraint prompts, enabling on-demand generation with precise pattern control. One key innovation is our dynamic multi-dataset loss re-weighting and prompt-to-pattern mapping, which allows UPLOTS to internalize diverse temporal structures during training and conditionally generate them at inference. We evaluate UPLOTS on four real-world benchmarks and multiple constraint settings, including peak-period, calendar, load-level, and volatility patterns. Additional held-out constraint-combination and downstream forecasting experiments further demonstrate that UPLOTS generalizes beyond the original peak-pattern setting and improves data augmentation under scarce real-data regimes. Our code and baselines are available at anonymous github repo: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UPLOTS-6C36.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UPLOTS 提出一个统一的预训练语言模型框架，通过可学习的约束提示 (constraint prompts) 实现跨领域的有约束时间序列生成。该模型使用单一 Transformer 骨干网络，结合动态多数据集损失重加权和提示-模式映射，能够内化多种时间结构并在推理时按需生成。在四个真实基准和多种约束设置（如峰值时段、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上评估，并展示了在约束组合和下游预测任务上的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法通常为每个数据集单独训练模型，无法跨领域共享时序结构，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 提出 UPLOTS 框架，采用预训练 Transformer 作为骨干，通过可学习的约束提示引导生成。创新点包括动态多数据集损失重加权和提示-模式映射，使模型学习多种时间序列模式并在推理时条件生成。
Result: 在四个真实基准和多种约束设置（峰值时段、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上验证有效性，额外在约束组合和下游预测任务上展示泛化能力，表明在真实数据稀缺时能改善数据增强。
Conclusion: UPLOTS 通过统一的预训练语言模型和约束提示，实现了跨领域的有约束时间序列生成，有望简化现有碎片化的建模流程。

papers.title: ERAlign: Energy-based Representation Alignment of GNNs and LLMs on Text-attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Text-attributed Graphs (TAGs) incorporate textual node attributes with graph structures to describe rich relational semantics. Recent efforts to integrate Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for learning on TAGs, yet achieving well-aligned representations remains challenging. Prior studies largely rely on heuristics that perform coarse-grained matching. They lack sufficient constraints and ignore distributional alignment, leading to representation drift and limited generalization. Building on Energy-based Models (EBMs), we propose an Energy-based Representation Alignment (ERAlign) framework that projects GNN-encoded graph structure and LLM-derived text embeddings in a shared latent space to achieve distribution consistency. Concretely, layer-wise alignment is quantified by a distance metric and optimized via an EBM objective. By decreasing energy values, our framework yields well-aligned representations for downstream tasks. During training, we introduce Energy Discrepancy (ED) to avoid high sampling costs associated with intractable normalization. ED also carries theoretical guarantees of higher training efficiency and reduced energy landscape distortion. Empirical evaluations on eight TAG datasets demonstrate that ERAlign obtains state-of-the-art performance across varying levels of supervision and cross-task transfer scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERAlign框架，基于能量模型（EBM）对齐图神经网络（GNN）和大语言模型（LLM）在文本属性图（TAG）上的表示，通过层间距离度量和能量差异（ED）优化分布一致性，在八个TAG数据集上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有GNN与LLM集成方法依赖启发式粗粒度匹配，缺乏分布对齐约束，导致表示漂移和泛化受限。
Method: 提出能量表示对齐（ERAlign）框架，利用EBM目标优化GNN图结构与LLM文本嵌入在共享隐空间中的分布一致性，并引入能量差异（ED）避免高采样成本，具有理论上的训练效率保证。
Result: 在八个TAG数据集上，ERAlign在不同监督程度和跨任务迁移场景下均取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 基于能量的分布对齐可以有效增强GNN与LLM的表示一致性，提高下游任务性能，且ED降低了训练复杂度。

papers.title: LakeQA: An Exploratory QA Benchmark over a Million-Scale Data Lake
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown rapid progress in reading-based question answering (QA), where evidence is explicitly provided or can be trivially retrieved. In contrast, real-world questions are often not paired with accurate evidence documents. The useful evidence resides in massive data lakes, making search a prerequisite for answering. However, there is a lack of comprehensive benchmarks that require both searching and reasoning over large data lakes. To this end, we introduce LakeQA, a comprehensive benchmark for search-centric question answering over data lakes that jointly emphasizes searching and reasoning capabilities. LakeQA is built on a heterogeneous collection of approximately 9.5 TB of text resources from Wikipedia and open-source government data, spanning structured and unstructured data. To ensure task quality, each sample is annotated by at least one Ph.D.-level expert. Each task requires long-horizon multi-hop reasoning with implicit intermediate steps: agents need to discover the correct documents and then compose evidence across sources to produce the answer. Experimental results on seven frontier LLMs demonstrate that LakeQA is challenging. For instance, GPT-5.2 achieves only an exact-match score of 18.37% on LakeQA. Overall, LakeQA provides a realistic testbed for developing LLM agents that can both find and analyze data in modern data lakes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LakeQA 是一个面向大规模数据湖（约 9.5 TB 文本资源）的搜索型问答基准，强调同时进行搜索与多跳推理。每个样本由至少一位博士级专家标注，要求智能体先发现正确文档再跨源组合证据。实验表明，GPT-5.2 在该基准上的精确匹配得分仅为 18.37%。
Motivation: 现有问答基准常预设证据已提供或可简单检索，缺乏同时要求搜索和推理的大规模数据湖场景。
Method: 构建基于 Wikipedia 和政府开放数据的异构数据湖（9.5 TB），由专家标注需要长程多跳推理的问答对，智能体需先搜索文档再推理答案。
Result: 七个前沿 LLM 的测试显示 LakeQA 极具挑战性，GPT-5.2 的精确匹配得分仅为 18.37%。
Conclusion: LakeQA 为开发能同时查找和分析数据湖数据的 LLM 智能体提供了现实测试场景。

papers.title: Minimum Distortion Quantization with Specified Output Distribution
papers.abstract_en: We derive the optimal quantizer of a real-valued random variable $W$ with distribution $P_W$ such that 1) the distribution of the quantization output $X$ that can take $k$ values follows any specified distribution $P_X$ over $\{1,\ldots,k\}$, and 2) the minimum mean squared error (MMSE) of estimating $W$ from $X$ is minimized. It is shown that the optimal quantizer takes the form $X=σ\big(F_{σ^{-1}(X)}^{-1}(F_W(W))\big)$, where $σ$ is the optimal permutation of $\{1,\ldots,k\}$ among all permutations to minimize the MMSE, and $F$ is the cumulative distribution function. When $P_W$ is uniform over an interval or $P_X$ is uniform over $\{1,\ldots,k\}$, the quantizer takes a simple form $X=F_{X}^{-1}(F_W(W))$. The concept of majorization plays a key role in the optimality proof. Specifying the output distribution is useful for designing quantizers with explicitly controlled output entropy, maximized mutual information between input and output, tailored output distribution to match channel input requirements for communication, and data anonymization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了实数随机变量 W 在指定输出分布 P_X 下的最小均方误差量化器，推导出最优量化器形式为 X=σ(F_{σ^{-1}(X)}^{-1}(F_W(W)))，并展示了当输入或输出为均匀分布时的简化形式。主要化概念在最优化证明中起关键作用。指定输出分布对于控制熵、最大化互信息、匹配通信信道输入要求以及数据匿名化有用。
Motivation: 现有量化器设计通常未指定输出分布，而实际应用中可能需要输出分布满足特定约束（如熵控制、信道匹配、匿名化），因此需要理论最优解。
Method: 利用主要化理论证明最优量化器由累积分布函数的复合变换和输出标签的排列优化构成。
Result: 推导出最优量化器的闭式表达式；在均匀输入或均匀输出情况下，量化器简化为 X=F_X^{-1}(F_W(W))。
Conclusion: 指定输出分布可用于设计具有明确熵控制、最大化互信息、匹配信道输入要求及数据匿名化的量化器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trace2Policy: From Expert Behavior Traces to Self-Evolving Decision Agents
papers.abstract_en: Decision rules that enterprise experts apply tacitly -- in auditing, compliance, and contract review -- can be systematically recovered and improved through iterative error analysis. We present \textbf{Trace2Policy}, whose core mechanism -- \textbf{EISR} (\textbf{E}rror-driven \textbf{I}terative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{R}efinement) -- maintains a human-readable rule document as its optimization target: each round executes the rules on a validation set, clusters errors by root cause into MISSING, WRONG, or CONFLICT types, applies targeted patches, and commits only those that pass a regression gate. \textbf{For this class of compliance-sensitive, skewed-base-rate decision tasks, we identify rule quality -- not model capability -- as the dominant performance lever}: across five LLMs, one-shot distillation plateaus near $\sim$70\% on the deployed pool, while eight EISR rounds lift the same rules to 79.6\% when compiled into deterministic Python -- zero LLM calls at inference. \textbf{Execution form compounds the gain: in production, the same EISR-refined content runs 9.8~pp higher as compiled Python than as an LLM prompt, a form-and-engineering bundle the 22-day deployment matured together.} Deployed for 22 days at a major logistics carrier (3,349 audit cases), the compiled pipeline outperforms the pure-LLM baseline it replaced (72.7\%); on these calibrated, skewed-base-rate workloads, re-enabling LLM fallback monotonically degrades accuracy. An LLM-driven variant, \textbf{Auto-EISR}, reproduces this refinement at \$5--\$10 per cycle versus $\sim$70 expert-hours, and transfers to four public benchmarks spanning legal reasoning (LegalBench) and process-mining decisions (BPIC 2012) without re-engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Trace2Policy框架，通过EISR（错误驱动迭代技能精炼）机制从专家行为轨迹中提取可读决策规则，并自动改进。在合规敏感、偏基准率的决策任务中，规则质量比模型能力更重要。经过8轮EISR迭代，编译为确定性Python的规则比直接用LLM提示高9.8个百分点，部署22天后表现优于纯LLM基线。Auto-EISR变体以低成本将改进迁移到多个基准。
Motivation: 企业专家隐式应用的决策规则（如审计、合规、合同审查）难以系统化提取和改进，现有方法依赖LLM推理成本高且效果有限。
Method: 提出EISR机制，维护人类可读规则文档作为优化目标：每轮在验证集上执行规则，按根因将错误聚类为MISSING、WRONG或CONFLICT三类，应用针对性补丁，并通过回归门筛选通过者。
Result: 在部署的审计池上，一次蒸馏准确率约70%，8轮EISR后提升至79.6%且推理零LLM调用。编译为Python比LLM提示高9.8个百分点；Auto-EISR每周期成本仅5-10美元（对比约70专家小时），并成功迁移至LegalBench和BPIC 2012等基准。
Conclusion: 在合规敏感、偏基准率的决策任务中，规则质量是主要性能杠杆，迭代错误驱动的规则精炼优于直接使用LLM；执行形式（编译Python vs. LLM提示）显著影响性能，且LLM回退会单调降低准确率。

papers.title: The Distributed Detectability Band Against Marginal-Preserving Attacks
papers.abstract_en: AI-control monitors score individual agent actions to detect misbehavior, but real harm can be distributed across many benign-looking steps, each individually below any per-step alarm. We construct a marginal-preserving, correlation-encoded distributed-sabotage attack using a Gaussian-copula AR(1) construction: the per-step monitor-score marginal is held exactly equal to benign, so mean, max, top-k tail, and threshold monitors (Monitor A) are defeated by construction, while harm is encoded in the temporal correlation structure. We sequence the paper around three reviewer-mandated gates. (1) Realizability gate: the stealthy attack achieves KS-distance to benign of 0.013 (effectively zero) at all tested harm levels up to 3.0, confirming that harm is fully decoupled from the per-step marginal and realizability is not harm-limited. (2) Monitor-A-vs-B reconciliation: we show formally that the attack, built against Monitor A's score marginal, remains marginal-preserving under a different-score Monitor B (the correlation/sequence family: CUSUM, SPRT, HMM-LR, runs test, autocorrelation, windowed logistic), and scope worst-case claims to score functions that admit a temporal signature. (3) Non-empty detectability band: Monitor A achieves AUC 0.52 (chance); Monitor B spans AUC 0.79-0.97 at the same 1% FPR target, and as harm is amortized over more steps Monitor A collapses to chance while Monitor B holds at AUC ~0.95. These results demonstrate a non-empty detectability band and characterize the sub-threshold sabotage frontier: distribution-shape monitors fail by construction; temporal-correlation monitors can detect but are not trivially optimal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构造了一种边缘保持、相关性编码的分布式破坏攻击，使用高斯copula AR(1)模型，使得每步监控器得分边缘分布与良性行为完全相同，从而击败基于均值、最大值、top-k尾部等阈值监控器（Monitor A），但危害编码在时间相关性结构中。通过三个评审要求的门控实验证明，该攻击可实现KS距离仅0.013，Monitor A的AUC为0.52（随机猜测），而Monitor B（相关性/序列监控器）的AUC在0.79-0.97之间。
Motivation: 现有AI控制监控器基于单步行为检测异常，但真实危害可能分布在多个看似无害的步骤中，每个步骤均低于报警阈值。
Method: 提出一种边缘保持的分布式破坏攻击，采用高斯copula AR(1)模型，保持每步监控器得分边缘分布与良性一致，同时通过时间相关性编码危害。
Result: 攻击在危害水平高达3.0时仍保持与良性行为的KS距离为0.013；Monitor A的AUC为0.52（随机），Monitor B的AUC范围为0.79-0.97；当危害分摊到更多步骤时，Monitor A降至随机水平，Monitor B保持约0.95的AUC。
Conclusion: 存在非空的可探测性带，分布形状监控器被构造性地击败，时间相关性监控器可检测但并非平凡最优。

papers.title: Few-step Generative Models as Lossy Compression
papers.abstract_en: DiffC provides a principled way to reuse pre-trained diffusion models for lossy compression, but its encoding and decoding procedures remain slow because they require many discretized forward and reverse steps. We study whether few-step generative models -- Rectified Flow, Consistency Trajectory Models (CTM), and MeanFlow -- can be cast as codecs within the same reverse channel coding (RCC) framework. The main challenge is that RCC requires posterior and shared distribution parameters, whereas these models do not explicitly parameterize intermediate conditional distributions. For Rectified Flow and MeanFlow, we use the equivalence between velocity parameterization and diffusion-style denoising parameterization to derive the quantities required by RCC. For CTM, which is distilled from EDM, we adopt the EDM noise parameterization together with local Gaussian approximations of the sender and shared distributions at intermediate states. This yields a proof-of-concept probabilistic formulation that enables compression with pre-trained few-step generative models without retraining. On low-resolution benchmarks, the resulting codecs reduce encoding and decoding time and improve realism in the low-bit-rate regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将少步生成模型（Rectified Flow、Consistency Trajectory Models、MeanFlow）纳入反向信道编码（RCC）框架用于有损压缩。主要挑战在于这些模型不显式参数化中间条件分布，作者通过速度与去噪参数化的等价性以及局部高斯近似来推导所需量，从而无需重新训练即可实现压缩。在低分辨率基准上，该方法减少了编解码时间，并在低比特率下提升了真实性。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的压缩方法（如DiffC）编解码速度慢，需要大量离散化步骤。本文旨在利用少步生成模型加速编解码过程，同时保持压缩质量。
Method: 对于Rectified Flow和MeanFlow，利用速度参数化与扩散式去噪参数化的等价性推导RCC所需的后验和共享分布参数；对于从EDM蒸馏的CTM，采用EDM噪声参数化结合中间状态的高斯近似，形成概率公式，支持使用预训练少步生成模型进行压缩。
Result: 在低分辨率基准上，所提编解码器减少了编码和解码时间，并在低比特率条件下提升了生成图像的真实感。
Conclusion: 本文展示了少步生成模型在反向信道编码框架下用于有损压缩的可行性，无需重新训练，且能加速编解码过程。

papers.title: Mitigating Bias in Low-SNR Financial Reinforcement Learning via Quantum Representations
papers.abstract_en: The financial market is a typical low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) setting, which often destabilizes off-policy maximum-entropy methods like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Specifically, noisy state representations may produce unreliable Q-value estimates, and bootstrapping amplifies these errors, forming a failure mode we call the "Financial Entropy Trap". In this paper, we propose FPQC-SAC, an efficient and plug-and-play SAC variant that places a compact and bounded Parameterized Quantum Circuit (PQC) before the actor and critic networks to constrain feature propagation at the representation level, rather than filtering raw inputs or regularizing Q-values after bootstrapping. Notably, FPQC-SAC reduces the impact of extreme market fluctuations on Bellman target estimation, while trainable quantum entanglement preserves flexible cross-asset interactions. Empirical evaluations on real-world portfolio management tasks demonstrate that FPQC-SAC substantially enhances out-of-sample stability and cumulative returns by achieving a 66.89% relative gain in cumulative return over standard unconstrained SAC and outperforms the best continuous-control deep reinforcement learning baseline by approximately 27%. Open-source code is available at https://github.com/ZeyuLIU-UST/FPQC-SAC-main.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融市场的低信噪比（SNR）环境导致软演员-评论家（SAC）算法不稳定（称为“金融熵陷阱”）的问题，提出FPQC-SAC方法。该方法在演员和评论家网络前插入一个紧凑且有界的参数化量子电路（PQC），在表示层面约束特征传播，而非过滤原始输入或引导后正则化。实验表明，在真实投资组合管理任务中，FPQC-SAC相比标准SAC获得了66.89%的累计收益相对提升，并优于最佳连续控制深度强化学习基线约27%。
Motivation: 在低信噪比的金融市场中，离线最大熵方法如SAC可能因噪声状态表示导致不可靠的Q值估计，自举放大误差形成“金融熵陷阱”，影响策略稳定性和收益。
Method: 提出FPQC-SAC，一种即插即用的SAC变体，通过在演员和评论家网络前放置紧凑有界的参数化量子电路（PQC）来约束表示层面的特征传播，而非直接处理原始输入或后置正则化，利用可训练的量子纠缠保留跨资产交互。
Result: 在真实投资组合管理任务中，FPQC-SAC累计收益相对标准SAC提升66.89%，并超越最佳连续控制深度强化学习基线约27%，增强了样本外稳定性。
Conclusion: FPQC-SAC通过量子表示在低SNR金融强化学习中有效缓解偏差，提升稳定性和收益，且代码开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SpenseGPT: Practical One-shot Pruning Enabling Sparse and Dense GEMMs for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured 2:4 sparsity is widely supported by modern accelerators, providing up to a 2x theoretical speedup. However, its strict 50% sparsity constraint often causes non-negligible accuracy degradation under post-training pruning. Meanwhile, existing relaxed sparsity formats either require specialized compiler support or introduce runtime overheads that limit end-to-end speedup. We propose Spense, a practical hybrid sparse-dense format that splits each weight matrix into a 2:4 sparse region and a dense region. This design relaxes the effective sparsity constraint while remaining compatible with existing high-performance sparse and dense GEMM libraries, avoiding both custom compiler support and input activation expansion. Building on this format, we introduce SpenseGPT, a one-shot post-training pruning method that produces sparse and dense regions. Notably, we show that selecting the right dense regions is important, and we devise two different strategies to choose them. Experiments on Qwen3-32B and Seed-OSS-36B demonstrate that our method achieves up to 1.2x end-to-end decoding speedup on B200 GPUs with FP8 precision, while preserving accuracy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first one-shot pruning demonstration of real-world end-to-end LLM decoding speedup from semi-structured sparse tensor cores on recent GPUs such as B200s, while maintaining model quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpenseGPT，一种混合稀疏-稠密格式，将权重矩阵分为2:4稀疏区域和稠密区域，实现无需自定义编译器的一步剪枝，在B200 GPU上使用FP8精度获得最高1.2倍端到端加速，同时保持精度。
Motivation: 现有半结构化2:4稀疏性在训练后剪枝中常导致精度下降，而其他稀疏格式需要特殊编译器支持或引入运行时开销。
Method: 提出Spense混合稀疏-稠密格式，将权重矩阵分为2:4稀疏区域和稠密区域，兼容现有高性能GEMM库；在此基础上提出SpenseGPT，一种一步训练后剪枝方法，并设计了两种选择稠密区域的策略。
Result: 在Qwen3-32B和Seed-OSS-36B模型上，在B200 GPU上使用FP8精度获得最高1.2倍端到端解码加速，同时保持模型质量。
Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在B200等现代GPU上利用半结构化稀疏张量核心实现真实世界LLM端到端解码加速的一步剪枝演示，同时保持模型质量。

papers.title: ASTRA-sim 3.0: Next-Level Distributed Machine Learning Simulations via High-Fidelity GPU and Infrastructure Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Distributed machine learning (ML) is a key paradigm for today's large-scale artificial intelligence applications. As model inference arises as an important use case, faithful modeling of latency-sensitive collective communication has never been more important. Capturing the device architecture and modeling control and data paths at high fidelity is therefore a necessity today. Having a common, detailed representation for distributed ML infrastructure is also crucial. We revisit the promising open-source, community-driven simulator: ASTRA-sim. In this work, we identify limitations of the current ASTRA-sim simulator and augment it with new features. To this end, we enable fine-grained, high-fidelity simulation with a standardized infrastructure representation, opening new design space exploration opportunities. We propose the simulation at cache-line-sized load-store granularity, with a detailed graphics processing unit (GPU) execution model, to balance simulation scalability and fidelity. We also introduce InfraGraph, a standardized representation to capture distributed ML network infrastructure in detail. Using the updated ASTRA-sim 3.0 simulator, we showcase interesting design space explorations for designing optimized collective algorithms, network requirements, and GPU architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASTRA-sim 3.0 是一个开源的分布式机器学习模拟器，通过细粒度、高保真的GPU执行模型和标准化基础设施表示（InfraGraph），实现了缓存行级别的负载-存储粒度模拟，用于探索优化集合通信算法、网络需求及GPU架构的设计空间。
Motivation: 现有分布式ML模拟器在捕获延迟敏感的集合通信和精确建模GPU控制/数据路径方面存在不足，缺乏统一的详细基础设施表示。
Method: 提出 InfraGraph 标准化表示以详细描述分布式ML网络基础设施，并实现缓存行粒度的负载-存储模拟，结合GPU执行模型以平衡模拟可扩展性和保真度。
Result: 通过ASTRA-sim 3.0展示了设计空间探索的示例，包括优化集合算法、网络需求和GPU架构。

papers.title: Parallel Causal Associative Fields: Gated Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Transformers achieve strong language modeling performance by providing direct token-to-token communication paths, but causal self-attention scales quadratically with context length. Recurrent and state-space models reduce this cost, yet compress history into sequentially updated fixed-size states. This paper studies a third primitive: a parallel content-addressed memory over causal successor records. The proposed Parallel Causal Associative Field (PCAF) writes local records from a context window into hash buckets, retrieves a bounded candidate set for the current query, forms a sparse cache distribution over successor tokens, and mixes that cache with a parametric local language model through a learned gate. The resulting model maintains sparse long-context access while avoiding a single fixed recurrent state bottleneck. We evaluate PCAF under full autoregressive pretraining on WikiText-103 and PG-19 using a distributed Google Cloud TPU v4-32 pod. At 303M parameters and context length T = 2048, PCAF-semantic reaches 36.31 perplexity on WikiText-103 and 52.45 perplexity on PG-19, compared with 47.49 and 53.84 for a matched dense Transformer. PCAF-semantic simultaneously processes 0.61-0.62M tokens/s across the TPU pod, versus 0.43M tokens/s for dense and local attention baselines. Supporting 41M-parameter multi-seed sweeps and single-GPU component ablations show that the associative cache, retrieval capacity, and learned gate materially affect the speed-quality trade-off.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, and 6 tables. Experiments on WikiText-103, PG-19, and WikiText-2 using TPU v4-32 and NVIDIA RTX 3060 hardware. Code: https://github.com/ahmed123hds/PCAF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并行因果关联场（PCAF），一种用于长上下文语言建模的稀疏记忆机制，通过并行内容寻址存储和检索避免二次复杂度。在WikiText-103和PG-19上，303M参数的PCAF达到36.31和52.45的困惑度，优于匹配的密集Transformer，同时吞吐量更高。
Motivation: 因果自注意力随上下文长度二次增长，循环和状态空间模型则压缩历史为固定大小状态，导致瓶颈。本文探索第三种原型：基于因果后继记录的并行内容寻址存储，以实现稀疏长上下文访问。
Method: 提出PCAF结构：从上下文窗口写入局部记录到哈希桶，为当前查询检索有界候选集，形成后继token的稀疏缓存分布，并通过学习门控将该缓存与参数化局部语言模型混合。
Result: 在303M参数、上下文长度2048时，PCAF-semantic在WikiText-103和PG-19上的困惑度分别为36.31和52.45，优于密集Transformer的47.49和53.84；同时训练吞吐量0.61-0.62M tokens/s，高于密集和局部注意力基线的0.43M tokens/s。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明关联缓存、检索能力和学习门控显著影响速度-质量权衡。

papers.title: Vision-Assisted Foundation Model for Solving Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Problems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task vehicle routing problems play a critical role in enhancing efficiency across various industries and service sectors. These problems consist of multiple variants that optimize routing costs while meeting diverse customer constraints. Existing multi-task VRP solvers solely utilize a graph-based modality, limiting their ability to address variants with multiple constraints. As a format to represent complex semantics, vision modality shows great potential for encoding diverse VRP constraints. This motivates us to learn patch-level semantics from the vision images, and then integrate them into a graph-based model to solve various VRP variants simultaneously. However, directly applying this approach to multi-task VRPs presents three challenges: 1) existing VRP images lack constraint representations, which are essential for multi-task VRPs, 2) the fixed receptive field of individual patches cannot effectively accommodate varying requirements across tasks, and 3) imbalanced pixel distribution among constraints may cause the model to overlook constraints with fewer pixels. In this paper, we propose a vision-assisted foundation model (VaFM) to address these challenges. In the vision modality, input images tailored to all constraints are encoded by a convolutional neural network. The obtained patch embeddings are fused with graph-based nodes to generate solutions, with an auxiliary task designed to address the pixel-imbalanced issue. The performance of VaFM is evaluated across 16 different VRP variants. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of VaFM over state-of-the-art methods, especially for variants with complex constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉辅助基础模型VaFM，用于解决多任务车辆路径问题。通过将视觉模态（卷积神经网络编码的约束图像）与图模态融合，能够同时处理多种VRP变体。模型设计了针对约束像素不平衡的辅助任务，在16种VRP变体上超越现有方法，尤其在复杂约束场景下表现突出。
Motivation: 现有多任务VRP方法仅使用图模态，难以应对多种约束。视觉模态可编码复杂语义，但直接应用存在三个挑战：VRP图像缺少约束表示、固定感受野不适用多任务、约束像素分布不平衡导致模型忽视少数约束。
Method: 提出VaFM，包含视觉模态（输入全约束定制的图像，用CNN编码）和图模态融合。通过卷积神经网络获取图像块嵌入，与图节点嵌入融合生成解，并设计辅助任务缓解像素不平衡问题。
Result: 在16种不同VRP变体上的实验表明，VaFM优于现有最先进方法，尤其在处理复杂约束的变体上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视觉模态辅助图模型能有效处理多任务VRP中的多约束问题，VaFM通过解决约束表示、感受野和像素不平衡三个挑战实现了改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Soul Computing: A Theoretical Framework and Technical Architecture for Intelligent Agents with Independent Consciousness
papers.abstract_en: Breakthroughs in large language models and multimodal generation technologies have propelled the digital reconstruction of human mental traits, emotional patterns, and long-term memory from science fiction toward engineering practice. Yet current research and industry practices at the intersection of AI and digital humans remain hampered by fundamental conceptual ambiguities: the essential differences between next-generation intelligent agents and traditional virtual humans, the construction pathways for digital entities possessing self-identity, and the core technical and ethical challenges confronting this domain all demand urgent clarification. This paper systematically examines the transformative logic underlying the transition from traditional virtual humans to the ``Soul Computing'' paradigm, driven by frontier AI technologies. We first analyze the evolutionary patterns of human consciousness and memory mechanisms, reassessing the core value of massive multimodal digital fragments in the reverse reconstruction of individual mental worlds. On this basis, we formally delineate the academic connotations of narrow and broad Soul Computing for the first time, clarifying its academic boundaries and essential distinctions from Affective Computing, Historical Reconstruction, and Mortal Computation. We argue that Soul Computing systems must architecturally construct an ``Intensional'' core rather than serving as purely ``Extensional'' functional carriers, thereby enabling the fundamental transition of AI from toolhood to living agency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“灵魂计算”（Soul Computing）概念，旨在通过前沿AI技术（如大语言模型和多模态生成）实现具有独立意识的智能体。作者区分了狭义与广义灵魂计算，并强调系统应构建“内涵性”（Intensional）核心而非“外延性”（Extensional）功能载体，以实现AI从工具到生命体的根本转变。
Motivation: 当前AI与数字人类领域存在概念模糊：下一代智能体与传统虚拟人的本质区别、数字实体自我身份的构建路径、以及相关技术与伦理挑战尚未澄清。
Method: 系统分析了人类意识与记忆机制的演化模式，重新评估多模态数字碎片在个体心智重建中的价值，并首次正式界定狭义与广义灵魂计算的学术内涵及其与情感计算、历史重建、凡人计算等的边界。
Result: 论文提出灵魂计算系统必须在架构上构建内涵性核心，而非作为纯粹外延性功能载体，从而推动AI从工具转向生命体。
Conclusion: 本文倡导一种新的计算范式，强调通过内涵性架构实现AI的独立意识，并指出该方向的核心技术挑战与伦理问题。

papers.title: A Unified Multi-Modal Framework for Intelligent Financial Systems: Integrating Reinforcement Learning, High-Frequency Trading, and Game-Theoretic Approaches with Cross-Modal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of financial technology demands sophisticated artificial intelligence systems capable of handling diverse challenges across multiple domains simultaneously. This paper presents a groundbreaking unified framework that seamlessly integrates Proximal Policy Optimization for robo-advisory systems, advanced time-series prediction models for high-frequency trading, in-context learning mechanisms for dynamic investment advisory, game-theoretic approaches for competitive banking scenarios, and unified embeddings for cross-modal financial sentiment analysis. Our comprehensive framework addresses the critical gap in existing literature where these technologies have been developed in isolation, failing to leverage their synergistic potential. Through extensive experimentation across multiple financial datasets and real-world scenarios, we demonstrate that our integrated approach achieves superior performance compared to specialized single-domain systems. Specifically, our framework shows a 23.7% improvement in portfolio optimization metrics, reduces prediction error in high-frequency trading by 31.2%, enhances investment recommendation accuracy by 18.9%, optimizes competitive banking strategies with a 27.4% increase in Nash equilibrium convergence speed, and improves sentiment analysis accuracy by 15.6% through cross-modal fusion. The theoretical foundation of our work establishes convergence guarantees for the integrated optimization problem, while our empirical results validate the practical applicability across diverse financial institutions. This research not only advances the state-of-the-art in financial AI but also provides a blueprint for developing comprehensive intelligent systems that can adapt to the complex, interconnected nature of modern financial markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的金融智能框架，整合了强化学习、高频交易时间序列预测、上下文学习、博弈论和跨模态情感分析，用于解决金融领域的多种任务。实验表明，该框架在投资组合优化、高频交易预测、投资推荐、银行竞争策略和情感分析等多个指标上优于单领域系统。
Motivation: 现有金融AI方法通常在各自领域独立开发，未能利用不同技术之间的协同潜力，缺乏能够同时处理多种金融挑战的统一系统。
Method: 提出一个统一的框架，结合Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）用于机器人投顾、高级时间序列模型用于高频交易、上下文学习用于动态投资建议、博弈论用于银行竞争、统一嵌入用于跨模态情感分析，并理论上证明了集成优化问题的收敛性。
Result: 摘要报告：投资优化指标提升23.7%，高频交易预测误差降低31.2%，投资推荐准确率提升18.9%，银行竞争策略中纳什均衡收敛速度提高27.4%，跨模态情感分析准确率提升15.6%。
Conclusion: 该工作为构建适应现代金融市场复杂互联本质的综合智能系统提供了蓝图，并在实际金融机构中验证了其实用性。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Inference-Time Augmentation Framework in Physiological Signals: Application to PPG-Based AF Detection
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Accurate classification of physiological signals in real-world deployments is challenged by sensor noise, motion artifacts, and distribution shifts between training and deployment data. Inference-time augmentation (ITA), which applies augmentations during inference rather than retraining, offers a simple, model-agnostic mechanism to improve robustness. However, ITA application to physiological signals has remained narrow in scope, relying on limited augmentation methods with fixed, unoptimized parameters. This work proposes a unified ITA framework to address that gap. Approach: The framework incorporates 13 augmentation methods spanning time-domain, amplitude-domain, frequency-domain, and artifact-injection transformations, with hyperparameters optimized via Bayesian optimization. We evaluate on atrial fibrillation (AF) detection from 30-second PPG signals using GPT-PPG and ResNet across five datasets comprising more than 400 patients and ${\sim}$9,800 hours of recording. Main results: Standard ITA consistently improved AUROC (up to 8.5% for GPT-PPG and 0.7% for ResNet) and AUPRC (up to 10.6% for GPT-PPG and 0.8% for ResNet). Selective ITA further reduced average FPR by up to 4.4% (GPT-PPG) and 1.3% (ResNet) on non-AF datasets. Significance: These findings establish ITA as a practical, model-agnostic approach for improving PPG-based AF classification reliability in deployment settings where retraining is not feasible, with broader applicability to physiological signal analysis.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Under review at Physiological Measurement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的推理时增强（ITA）框架，包含13种增强方法，通过贝叶斯优化超参数，应用于PPG信号的心房颤动（AF）检测。在5个数据集、400多名患者和约9800小时记录上，标准ITA将GPT-PPG的AUROC提升8.5%、AUPRC提升10.6%，ResNet的AUROC提升0.7%、AUPRC提升0.8%；选择性ITA进一步降低非AF数据集上的平均FPR。
Motivation: 真实环境中的生理信号分类面临传感器噪声、运动伪影和分布偏移，推理时增强（ITA）提供了一种无需重训练的模型无关鲁棒性提升手段，但现有ITA在生理信号中的应用范围窄、参数固定且未优化。
Method: 提出统一ITA框架，集成13种增强方法（涵盖时域、幅域、频域和伪影注入变换），通过贝叶斯优化自动搜索超参数，评估GPT-PPG和ResNet在PPG房颤检测上的表现。
Result: 标准ITA在GPT-PPG上AUROC提升8.5%、AUPRC提升10.6%；在ResNet上AUROC提升0.7%、AUPRC提升0.8%。选择性ITA进一步将非AF数据集上的平均FPR降低4.4%（GPT-PPG）和1.3%（ResNet）。
Conclusion: ITA是一种实用、模型无关的方法，可提升PPG房颤检测在部署环境中的可靠性，尤其适用于无法重训练的场景，且可推广到更广泛的生理信号分析。
