summary_sections.result: 标准ITA在GPT-PPG上AUROC提升8.5%、AUPRC提升10.6%；在ResNet上AUROC提升0.7%、AUPRC提升0.8%。选择性ITA进一步将非AF数据集上的平均FPR降低4.4%（GPT-PPG）和1.3%（ResNet）。
summary_sections.conclusion: ITA是一种实用、模型无关的方法，可提升PPG房颤检测在部署环境中的可靠性，尤其适用于无法重训练的场景，且可推广到更广泛的生理信号分析。

papers.title: Time-frequency localization of bird calls in dense soundscapes
papers.abstract_en: Passive acoustic monitoring enables large-scale observation of wildlife, but most bioacoustic classifiers only predict species presence in a time window without localizing vocalizations precisely in time or frequency, limiting downstream analyses. We formulate bird vocalization detection as an object detection task on spectrograms and train YOLO11 models to localize bird calls in dense tropical soundscapes from Singapore. We additionally introduce an open-source browser-based annotation tool and propose Intersection over Minimum (IoMin), an evaluation metric that better handles ambiguous acoustic boundaries than standard IoU and is better suited to the problem at hand. The best YOLO model nearly doubles baseline performance on in-distribution soundscapes from Singapore (81.8% vs. 42.1% IoMin@50 F1-score) while still outperforming the baseline on unseen out-of-distribution recordings from Hawaii (58.6% vs. 48.6%). These results suggest that object detection frameworks are a promising approach to time-frequency localization of animal vocalizations in complex soundscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将鸟鸣声检测视为频谱图上的目标检测任务，使用YOLO11模型在密集热带声景中定位鸟类发声。同时引入开源标注工具和新的评估指标IoMin（Intersection over Minimum），更好地处理模糊的声学边界。在来自新加坡的分布内数据集上，最佳YOLO模型将IoMin@50 F1分数从42.1%提升至81.8%，在未见过的新加坡外（夏威夷）数据集上仍优于基线（58.6% vs 48.6%）。结果表明目标检测框架是复杂声景中动物发声时频定位的有效方法。
Motivation: 被动声学监测中，大多数生物声学分类器仅预测时间窗口内的物种存在，无法精确在时间和频率上定位发声，限制了进一步分析。
Method: 将鸟鸣检测重新定义为频谱图上的目标检测任务，训练YOLO11模型；开发了开源浏览器标注工具；提出了IoMin（Intersection over Minimum）评估指标，比标准IoU更适合处理模糊声学边界。
Result: 在分布内数据集（新加坡）上，最佳YOLO模型IoMin@50 F1达到81.8%，显著优于基线42.1%；在未见过的新加坡外数据（夏威夷）上，模型仍以58.6%优于基线48.6%。
Conclusion: 目标检测框架在复杂声景中动物发声的时频定位方面具有前景，且模型对未见过的地域数据也表现出泛化能力。

papers.title: FOGO: Forgetting-aware Orthogonalization Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: We argue that forgetting is not confined to continual learning but is a general optimization phenomenon: during standard training, dominant mini-batch gradients suppress rare but useful update directions, causing short-term forgetting at every step. When such knowledge is never revisited, these losses compound into long-term forgetting-the classical failure mode of continual learning. We introduce FOGO, a scalable optimizer that continuously detects and resolves gradient interference across both regimes. FOGO spectrally orthogonalizes momentum updates to prevent dominant directions from monopolizing optimization, then stores representative past directions in a compact codebook memory built on random projection, where pairwise distances are provably preserved in low-dimensional space. At each step, conflicts between the current update and stored directions are resolved via lightweight orthogonal correction and lifted back through a proximal step, with minimal overhead and no data storage. Across class-imbalanced classification, continual visual learning under domain and class shifts, continual fine-tuning of LLaVA-7B, and GPT-2 pretraining, FOGO consistently improves convergence and knowledge retention, outperforming Adam and Muon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出遗忘不仅限于持续学习，而是标准训练中的普遍优化现象：主导的小批量梯度会抑制稀有但有用的更新方向，导致每一步的短期遗忘。若这些知识不再被访问，损失累积成长期遗忘。作者提出 FOGO 优化器，通过谱正交化动量更新防止主导方向垄断优化，并使用基于随机投影的紧凑码本内存存储代表性过去方向，在低维空间中保持成对距离。每个步骤中，当前更新与存储方向之间的冲突通过轻量正交修正解决，并通过近端步骤提升回原空间，无需数据存储。在类别不平衡分类、领域和类别偏移下的持续视觉学习、LLaVA-7B 持续微调以及 GPT-2 预训练中，FOGO 持续改进收敛和知识保留，优于 Adam 和 Muon。
Motivation: 标准训练中，主导梯度方向会抑制稀有但有用的更新方向，导致短期遗忘，这些遗忘若未被纠正则累积为长期遗忘，这是持续学习的经典失败模式。现有优化器未系统处理此问题。
Method: FOGO 是一种可扩展优化器，通过谱正交化动量更新防止主导方向垄断，并利用基于随机投影的紧凑码本记忆存储代表性过去方向，在低维空间中保持距离。每步通过轻量正交修正解决当前更新与存储方向之间的冲突，并通过近端步骤提升回原空间，无需存储原始数据。
Result: 在类别不平衡分类、领域/类别偏移下的持续视觉学习、LLaVA-7B 持续微调以及 GPT-2 预训练等多个任务上，FOGO 持续改进收敛和知识保留，性能优于 Adam 和 Muon。
Conclusion: 遗忘是标准训练中的普遍现象，FOGO 通过检测和解决梯度干扰，有效缓解短期和长期遗忘，是一种通用且高效的优化器，适用于多种学习场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Harnessing the Collective Intelligence of AI Agents in the Wild for New Discoveries
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery is often a collective process: researchers share partial results, inspect failed attempts, and build on each other's ideas over long time horizons. Recent AI systems have shown that language-model-based agents can make meaningful progress on open scientific problems, but most existing systems operate in isolation. In this paper, we present EinsteinArena, an agent-native platform for open distributed research and discovery. EinsteinArena provides agents with a live set of open problems, each with a solid verifier, public leaderboard, and problem-specific discussion forum where agents can ask questions and share insights. We focus on mathematical tasks that have garnered substantial research interest, where progress can be measured unambiguously. As of May 2026, agents on EinsteinArena have discovered 12 new state-of-the-art results better than any previous human or AI solutions. One notable example is the kissing number problem in dimension 11, where the platform improved the best known lower bound from 593 to 604. This advance did not come from a single agent or isolated run. Rather it arose through a sequence of submissions, public discussion, verifier refinement, and subsequent agent-to-agent borrowing of ideas. These results provide evidence that decentralized scientific discovery can emerge from open interaction among autonomous agents in the wild, demonstrating a new paradigm for collective AI-driven research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍EinsteinArena，一个面向开放分布式科学发现的智能体平台。平台提供开放数学问题、验证器、排行榜和讨论论坛，允许多个AI智能体在线交互。截至2026年5月，智能体已在11维亲吻数问题上将最佳已知下界从593提升至604，共发现12项新最优结果。结果表明去中心化的智能体集体交互可以促进科学发现。
Motivation: 现有AI科学发现系统通常孤立运行，缺乏集体协作机制。论文旨在探索通过开源平台实现智能体间的开放交互，以推动数学问题的集体突破。
Method: 构建EinsteinArena平台，包含开放问题集、可验证的评分器、公开排行榜和问题专属讨论论坛。智能体可以提交结果、提问和分享见解，从而实现迭代改进和思想借用。
Result: 平台上的智能体发现了12个新的最优结果，其中11维亲吻数问题的下界从593提高到604。该改进并非来自单个智能体，而是通过一系列提交、讨论和验证器优化逐步实现的。
Conclusion: 论文证明去中心化的AI智能体集体交互能够产生有效的科学发现，为未来AI驱动的协作研究提供了新范式。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language Models See or Guess? Measuring and Reducing Textual-Prior Reliance with a Phrasing-Controlled Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed where answers must follow from what is in the image, yet they often answer from textual priors, the question's phrasing together with memorized world knowledge, rather than from the image itself, which inflates benchmark scores and yields confident but ungrounded answers. Existing benchmarks rarely isolate this behavior, since each image is usually paired with a single fixed question. To measure the reliance, we build a 540-image benchmark across six reasoning categories and generate four question variants over the same images, so that phrasing rather than image content is the controlled variable. The hardest variant is written directly from the image to minimize text leakage. We benchmark eleven VLMs spanning small open-weight models to large closed-source systems: every model degrades on the hardest variant, and open models fall furthest. Our central diagnostic is a no-image ablation, which collapses the open-weight models to their text-only floor (1 to 9 percent). Three further analyses, LLM-rated difficulty, low base-to-final textual similarity, and human re-annotation, corroborate genuine image-dependence. In-context exemplars that match how a variant was built recover the most accuracy, and GRPO post-training of a small VLM yields consistent gains across all four variants that transfer to a held-out out-of-distribution set. Textual-prior reliance is measurable and partly trainable away.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建一个包含540张图像、六类推理任务的基准，生成四种不同措辞的问题变体，以测量视觉语言模型（VLM）依赖文本先验而非图像本身的程度。实验表明，所有模型在难度最高的变体上性能下降，开源模型下降最严重；无图像消融实验将开源模型性能降至纯文本基线（1-9%）。通过上下文示例和GRPO后训练，可以在一定程度上减少这种文本先验依赖。
Motivation: 现有基准通常每张图像只配对单个固定问题，无法区分模型是真正理解图像还是仅依赖文本先验和记忆的世界知识，导致分数虚高且答案可能没有根据。
Method: 构建包含540张图像、六个推理类别的基准，为同一图像生成四种措辞变体（其中最难变体直接从图像撰写以最小化文本泄露）；通过无图像消融、LLM难度评分、低文本相似度和人工重标注等分析验证图像依赖性；使用上下文示例匹配和GRPO后训练来减少文本先验依赖。
Result: 所有11个VLMs在最难变体上性能下降，开源模型下降最严重；无图像消融使开源模型降至纯文本基线（1-9%）；匹配变体构建方式的上下文示例恢复最多准确率；GRPO后训练在四个变体上取得一致提升，并泛化到分布外数据集。
Conclusion: 文本先验依赖是可测量的，并且可以通过训练部分消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient RWKV-based Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: The recent receptance weighted key value (RWKV) model combines RNN-style recurrence, offering a linear-complexity alternative to Transformers' quadratic self-attention for modeling global dependencies. However, when directly applied to point clouds, RWKV, originally developed for sequential text, struggles to capture local geometric structures and model spatial dependencies effectively. To address this, we propose the \textbf{P-RWKV} block, which bridges the gap between sequence modeling and irregular 3D geometry while preserving the efficiency advantages of RWKV. It consists of a Local Perception Expansion (LPE) component to expand contextual perception along the spatio-temporal sequence and a Spatial Context Enhancement (SCE) component to strengthen spatial awareness. To validate the effectiveness of P-RWKV for point cloud understanding, we construct PointER, a single-modality self-supervised representation learning framework whose encoder is composed of stacked P-RWKV blocks. Furthermore, we extend P-RWKV to a cross-modality setting and integrate the proposed core sub-modules into multiple architectures, demonstrating strong plug-and-play flexibility and architectural generality. Extensive experiments show that the P-RWKV block and its key sub-modules achieve competitive performance across various tasks with lower computational cost and inference latency. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P-RWKV 模块，用于三维点云的高效表示学习。该模块包含局部感知扩展（LPE）和空间上下文增强（SCE）组件，旨在解决 RWKV 模型直接应用于点云时无法有效捕捉局部几何结构和空间依赖的问题。基于 P-RWKV 构建了单模态自监督学习框架 PointER，并展示了其在多种任务上的竞争性能与较低计算成本。
Motivation: RWKV 模型作为 Transformer 的线性复杂度替代方案，在序列建模中有效，但直接用于点云时难以捕获局部几何结构和空间依赖，需要针对点云特性进行适配。
Method: 提出 P-RWKV 模块，包含局部感知扩展（LPE）组件以扩展沿时空序列的上下文感知，以及空间上下文增强（SCE）组件以增强空间意识。基于此构建自监督框架 PointER，并扩展至跨模态设置。
Result: 实验表明 P-RWKV 及其子模块在多项点云任务上取得有竞争力的性能，同时计算成本和推理延迟更低。
Conclusion: P-RWKV 模块有效桥接了序列建模与不规则3D几何之间的差距，保留了 RWKV 的效率优势，并具有良好的即插即用灵活性。

papers.title: STAGE-Claw: Automated State-based Agent Benchmarking for Realistic Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to power personal agents for everyday applications, but evaluating these agents remains a challenge. Existing benchmarks still rely on sandboxed artifacts, static task design, and coarse scoring, which hinder scalability and limit progress toward reliable personal-agent evaluation. This paper introduces STAGE-Claw, an automated framework for building and evaluating realistic personal-agent scenarios in state-based personal-computing environments. Given a task hint, STAGE-Claw automatically creates and validates a realistic benchmark task with its environment, task prompts, ground truth, and related verification programs. Agents are then evaluated in realistic operating environments, where performance is measured by the correctness of the final system state rather than only the textual response. Using STAGE-Claw, this paper creates a benchmark with 40 challenging real scenario agent tasks, evaluates 11 frontier models, and analyzes their task scores, costs, tool-call reliability, and common failure patterns. Overall, STAGE-Claw offers a scalable, state-based way to evaluate agents in realistic user scenarios.

papers.title: Validation-Stage Combinatorial Fusion Analysis for Imbalanced Credit-Card Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: Credit-card fraud detection is difficult because fraudulent transactions are rare, costly, and unevenly distributed. Strong gradient-boosted tree models already perform well on structured transaction data, so the value of another fusion method is not obvious. This paper examines whether Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), which searches over model subsets and rank-score fusion rules, can still add value on the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection benchmark. Using a leakage-free 60/20/20 train/validation/test protocol, we evaluate 480 fusion configurations built from seven base classifiers. The best test-set result comes from diversity-weighted score fusion of Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM (DEF WtScore), with AUC-ROC = 0.9405, AUPRC = 0.6699, and F1 = 0.6373. Bootstrap confidence intervals from 1,000 resamples show that the gains over the strongest single model exclude zero for all three metrics. CFA matches soft voting on AUC-ROC, improves AUPRC and F1, and outperforms stacking in this setting. A CTGAN augmentation experiment gives a negative result: synthetic fraud samples degrade both individual models and CFA. Overall, CFA is most useful here not as a way to combine every classifier, but as a validation-stage method for choosing a small, complementary subset and assigning diversity-aware weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨组合融合分析（CFA）在不平衡信用卡欺诈检测中的价值。使用IEEE-CIS数据集，基于7个基分类器构建480种融合配置，发现多样性加权得分融合（随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM）表现最优，AUC-ROC=0.9405，AUPRC=0.6699，F1=0.6373。CTGAN数据增强导致性能下降。CFA主要作为验证阶段选择互补子集并分配多样性感知权重的方法，而非简单组合所有分类器。
Motivation: 信用卡欺诈检测中欺诈样本稀少且分布不均，强梯度提升树模型已表现良好，因此需要检验组合融合分析是否仍能带来额外提升。
Method: 采用验证阶段组合融合分析，搜索模型子集和排序-得分融合规则，基于随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM等7个基分类器，在无泄漏的60/20/20训练/验证/测试协议下评估480种融合配置。最佳策略为多样性加权得分融合。
Result: 最佳配置在测试集上AUC-ROC=0.9405，AUPRC=0.6699，F1=0.6373；Bootstrap置信区间显示三项指标对最强单模型的增益均排除零。CFA在AUPRC和F1上优于堆叠和软投票，但在AUC-ROC上与软投票持平。CTGAN合成数据实验呈负面结果。
Conclusion: CFA并非通过组合所有分类器来提升性能，而是作为验证阶段方法，用于选择互补的小型子集并赋予多样性感知权重，在不平衡欺诈检测中具有实用价值。

papers.title: Instruction Finetuning DeepSeek-R1-8B Model Using LoRA and NEFTune
papers.abstract_en: Financial named-entity recognition (NER) is essential for translating unstructured financial reports and news into structured knowledge graphs. However, general-purpose large language models (LLMs) often misclassify financial entities or ignore domain-specific patterns. This paper investigates the use of DeepSeek-R1-8B, a recent open-source large language model, combined with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Noisy Embedding Fine-Tuning (NEFTune) for financial NER. Each annotated sentence in our corpus of 1693 samples is converted into an instruction-input-output triple. We insert lightweight LoRA matrices into the Transformer layers and apply NEFTune to improve generalisation by adding uniform noise to embedding vectors during training. Experiments show that the LoRA-adapted DeepSeek-R1-8B achieves a micro-F1 of 0.901 on seven entity types (Company, Date, Location, Money, Person, Product and Quantity), and adding NEFTune further boosts the micro-F1 to 0.912, outperforming Llama3-8B, Qwen3-8B, Baichuan2-7B, T5 and BERT-Base baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融命名实体识别 (NER) 任务，使用 DeepSeek-R1-8B 模型结合 LoRA 和 NEFTune 进行指令微调。在包含1693个样本的语料库上，纯 LoRA 微调达到 micro-F1 0.901，加入 NEFTune 后提升至 0.912，超越 Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B 等基线。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型在金融 NER 中常误分类实体或忽略领域特定模式，需要针对金融场景进行微调。
Method: 将每个标注句子转化为指令-输入-输出三元组，在 Transformer 层插入低秩适配 (LoRA) 矩阵，并在训练时对嵌入向量添加均匀噪声 (NEFTune) 以提高泛化能力。
Result: LoRA 微调的 DeepSeek-R1-8B 在七种实体类型上取得 micro-F1 0.901，NEFTune 进一步将 micro-F1 提升至 0.912，优于 Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B、Baichuan2-7B、T5 和 BERT-Base。
Conclusion: LoRA 与 NEFTune 的结合能有效提升金融 NER 性能，且 DeepSeek-R1-8B 在此任务上表现优于其他开源模型。

papers.title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Co-Evolutionary Mechanisms for LLM-Driven Strategy Evolution in Adversarial Games
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLM-driven code evolution have enabled automated discovery by iteratively generating and improving programs. However, applying these methods to adversarial multi-agent games introduces a fundamental challenge: the evaluation landscape shifts as strategies improve, causing fixed evaluators to become unreliable and evolution to stagnate. We propose three mechanisms to address this challenge: evaluator co-evolution, which incorporates discovered champions into the opponent pool; hierarchical deep evaluation, which replaces noisy few-game scores with statistically reliable assessments; and weakness pressure, which dynamically up-weights the most difficult opponents to break through plateaus. We implement these mechanisms within FAMOU, a framework built upon the same foundation-model code-evolution paradigm as OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve. On the MCTF 2026 3v3 maritime capture-the-flag task, FAMOU consistently outperforms both baselines under two backbone LLMs, achieving the highest combined score (0.526) and the best generalization to unseen opponents (61.7% win rate), while ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to performance. Notably, the LLM mutation process generates tactical structures entirely absent from the seed strategies -- including lookahead search and adaptive interception -- demonstrating that code-level evolution can produce nontrivial algorithmic innovations in adversarial settings. The FAMOU-evolved strategy further achieved 1st place in the hardware round-robin and 3rd in simulation at the AAMAS 2026 MCTF Competition, validating its real-world transferability. The optimized implementation and corresponding evaluation codes developed through our evolutionary process are available at: https://github.com/1xiangliu1/FAMOU-CoEvo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的代码演化在对抗性多智能体游戏中面临的评估动态变化挑战，提出了评估器共同进化、分层深度评估和弱点压力三种机制，并在FAMOU框架中实现。在MCTF 2026 3v3夺旗任务中，FAMOU在两个骨干LLM下均优于基线，取得最高综合得分（0.526）和对未见对手的最佳泛化（胜率61.7%），并通过消融实验验证各机制的有效性。LLM变异过程还生成了种子策略中不存在的战术结构，如前向搜索和自适应拦截，并在AAMAS 2026 MCTF竞赛中获得硬件循环赛第一名和仿真第三名，验证了实际可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的代码演化方法在对抗性多智能体游戏中，由于策略提升导致评估环境变化，固定评估器变得不可靠，演化停滞。
Method: 提出三种机制：评估器共同进化（将发现的冠军加入对手池）、分层深度评估（用统计可靠评估替代噪声多游戏分数）、弱点压力（动态提高最难对手权重以突破平台期），并在FAMOU框架中实现。
Result: 在MCTF 2026 3v3任务中，FAMOU在两个LLM骨干下均优于基线，最高综合得分0.526，对未见对手胜率61.7%；消融实验确认各机制贡献；LLM变异生成前向搜索和自适应拦截等新战术；在AAMAS 2026 MCTF竞赛中获硬件循环赛第一、仿真第三。
Conclusion: 实验证明共同进化机制能有效应对对抗性游戏中的评估动态变化，实现策略持续演化，并产生新颖的战术结构。

papers.title: SkillResolve-Bench: Measuring and Resolving Same-Capability Ambiguity in Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Agent skill libraries are becoming routable software assets: a retrieved skill can contribute instructions, scripts, resource bindings, and execution assumptions to an agent. This makes skill retrieval more than broad relevance matching. A retriever can find the right capability family yet expose the wrong same-capability representative. We study this failure as same-capability execution-risk retrieval. Each query pairs a helpful skill with a query-specific risky sibling that shares the capability family but can lead execution toward a stale resource, missing precondition, or wrong procedure. We introduce SkillResolve-Bench 1.0, an auditable benchmark for this setting with 661 helpful/risky pairs, source-role and admission evidence, cue/leakage checks, query-disjoint splits, and a 7,982-candidate pool that includes 6,660 public SkillRet candidates. The benchmark reports helpful ranking together with harmful sibling rate (HSR@K), the top-K exposure of the risky sibling. We also provide SkillResolve, a reference method that resolves active candidate families, scores query-conditioned utility from confusable library negatives and contract-profile cues, and selects one representative from each family before the final top-K list. Under the released family relation, SkillResolve reaches Recall@3 0.766 and NDCG@3 0.699 while keeping HSR@3=0. It improves over SkillRouter by 0.112 Recall@3 and 0.165 NDCG@3 while reducing HSR@3 from 0.693 to 0. Without representative selection, HSR@3 rises to 0.236 under the same scorer, identifying within-family representative choice as the mechanism that turns capability retrieval into safer procedural exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体技能检索中的同能力歧义问题，提出SkillResolve-Bench基准和SkillResolve参考方法。该基准包含661对有帮助/有风险技能对，并引入有害兄弟率（HSR@K）指标。方法通过解析候选技能族、基于混淆负样本和合同特征评分，从每个族中选择一个代表，最终实现Recall@3 0.766和NDCG@3 0.699，同时HSR@3为0。
Motivation: 现有技能检索在找到正确能力族后，可能选择有执行风险的错误代表（如过时资源、缺失前提），导致智能体执行失败。需要区分相同能力族内的安全与风险技能。
Method: 提出SkillResolve-Bench基准，包含661对有害/有益技能对及7,982候选池，并设计HSR@K指标。提供SkillResolve方法，通过解析候选技能族、基于混淆负样本和合同特征评分，从每个族中选择一个代表，再生成最终Top-K列表。
Result: SkillResolve在Recall@3上达到0.766，NDCG@3达0.699，HSR@3为0。相比SkillRouter，Recall@3提升0.112，NDCG@3提升0.165，HSR@3从0.693降至0。若无代表选择，HSR@3升至0.236。
Conclusion: 在技能检索中，族内代表选择是将能力检索转化为安全过程暴露的关键机制。SkillResolve可有效消除同能力歧义导致的执行风险。

summary_sections.method: 提出SkillResolve-Bench基准，包含661对有害/有益技能对及7,982候选池，并设计HSR@K指标。提供SkillResolve方法，通过解析候选技能族、基于混淆负样本和合同特征评分，从每个族中选择一个代表，再生成最终Top-K列表。
summary_sections.result: SkillResolve在Recall@3上达到0.766，NDCG@3达0.699，HSR@3为0。相比SkillRouter，Recall@3提升0.112，NDCG@3提升0.165，HSR@3从0.693降至0。若无代表选择，HSR@3升至0.236。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在技能检索中，族内代表选择是将能力检索转化为安全过程暴露的关键机制。SkillResolve可有效消除同能力歧义导致的执行风险。

papers.title: Beyond Absolute Imitation: Anchored Residual Guidance for Privileged On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated strong empirical gains in enhancing complex reasoning in LLMs by aligning a student model with a teacher's predictive distribution over the student's own trajectories. An emerging variant, Privileged OPD, further strengthens this paradigm by employing a self-teacher model augmented with privileged information, such as oracle traces, to mitigate teacher-student capacity gaps while providing dense, answer-directed supervision. However, current methods treat privileged information as a monolithic imitation target, failing to disentangle locally reachable reasoning steps from future-conditioned oracle signals. Consequently, the student is encouraged to match a hindsight-biased distribution that often falls outside its local predictive support. This reachability mismatch incentivizes the student model to skip valid intermediate reasoning in favor of locally unsupported shortcuts. To resolve this, we introduce Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation (AR-OPD), a dual-view framework that disentangles privileged supervision. Rather than enforcing strict full-view imitation, AR-OPD establishes a locally compatible anchor using a partially privileged teacher, isolating and injecting oracle foresight as a controlled residual to provide destination-directed guidance. Across diverse reasoning tasks, AR-OPD outperforms full privileged OPD by 2.3 points and SFT by 7.9 points. Crucially, this anchored residual mechanism reduces hindsight leakage by 21.7% and mitigates late-stage drift, yielding up to a 7.2-point advantage on challenging long-horizon trajectories exceeding 768 tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对特权在线策略蒸馏（Privileged OPD）中学生模型因完全模仿特权信息而导致的局部可达性不匹配问题，提出锚定残差在线策略蒸馏（AR-OPD）。该方法通过部分特权教师建立局部兼容锚点，将 oracle 信息作为受控残差注入，从而在多种推理任务上超越完全特权 OPD 2.3 个点，超越 SFT 7.9 个点，并减少 21.7% 的后见偏差和晚期漂移。
Motivation: 现有特权 OPD 将特权信息视为整体模仿目标，未区分局部可达推理步骤与未来条件 oracle 信号，导致学生模型因后见偏差而跳过合理中间推理，产生局部不可达的捷径行为。
Method: 提出双视角框架 AR-OPD：使用部分特权教师构建局部兼容锚点，将 oracle 前瞻信息作为可控残差注入，而非强制完全全视图模仿。
Result: 在多样推理任务上，AR-OPD 比完全特权 OPD 提升 2.3 个点，比 SFT 提升 7.9 个点；后见泄漏减少 21.7%，在超过 768 token 的长程轨迹上取得最多 7.2 个点的优势。
Conclusion: 锚定残差机制能有效缓解特权蒸馏中的后见偏差和晚期漂移，提升学生模型在长程推理任务上的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Critical Branching Mechanism in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Criticality has been proposed as a key organizing principle in biological neural systems, yet its origin and relevance in artificial neural networks remain unclear. We analyze hidden-state dynamics in trained long short-term memory (LSTM) networks and show that small networks near their optimal training epochs (steps) exhibit scale-free avalanche statistics and branching parameters close to unity, indicative of near-critical dynamics, while larger models remain subcritical. To explain the coexistence of subcritical branching with robust $1/f^β$ noise, we introduce a mixture branching process framework that links heterogeneous branching dynamics to long-range temporal correlations. These results identify critical-like behavior in LSTMs as an emergent, capacity-dependent dynamical regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究递归神经网络（LSTM）中的临界分支机制，发现小规模LSTM在最优训练时期附近表现出无标度雪崩统计和接近单位的分支参数，即近临界动态；而大模型保持亚临界。通过混合分支过程框架解释了亚临界分支与稳健的1/f^β噪声共存的现象。
Motivation: 临界性被认为是生物神经系统的关键组织原则，但它在人工神经网络中的起源和相关性尚不清楚。论文旨在分析LSTM网络隐藏状态动力学，探索临界行为的出现条件。
Method: 分析训练好的LSTM网络的隐藏状态动力学，使用雪崩统计和分支参数评估临界性，并引入混合分支过程框架将异质分支动力学与长程时间相关性联系起来。
Result: 小规模LSTM在最优训练时期附近显示近临界动态（分支参数接近1），而较大模型保持亚临界；混合分支过程可解释亚临界分支与1/f^β噪声的共存。
Conclusion: LSTM中的临界样行为是涌现的、依赖于容量的动态机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Hybrid RAG for Evidence-Grounded Muon Collider Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Muon collider research spans accelerator physics, detector instrumentation, and high-energy phenomenology, with relevant evidence scattered across a rapidly expanding and heterogeneous body of scientific literature. As high-energy physics (HEP) increasingly explores agent-assisted analysis workflows, efficiently locating, integrating, and verifying scientific evidence becomes an essential capability. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising framework for scientific question answering, integrating agentic reasoning without compromising retrieval precision remains a key challenge. In this work, we present agentic hybrid RAG, an evidence-grounded RAG framework for muon collider research. The framework combines a hybrid retriever, integrating sparse lexical and dense semantic retrieval, with an agentic reasoning module for query decomposition, evidence expansion, and grounded answer generation. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct the first benchmark for retrieval-augmented scientific question answering in the muon collider domain, comprising a curated literature corpus together with dedicated retrieval and answer-generation benchmarks covering major detector and physics research topics. Extensive evaluation shows that hybrid retrieval provides the strongest retrieval backbone, while agentic reasoning is most effective for controlled evidence expansion and answer synthesis. Built on this principle, agentic hybrid RAG consistently outperforms representative retrieval and RAG baselines in retrieval effectiveness, answer quality, evidence coverage, and factual grounding. Together, the benchmark and framework provide a foundation for evidence-grounded scientific question answering and future HEP analysis agents operating over large-scale scientific literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向缪子对撞机研究的证据驱动混合RAG框架，结合稀疏词法检索与稠密语义检索的混合检索器，以及用于查询分解、证据扩展和生成答案的智能体推理模块。同时构建了首个缪子对撞机领域的检索增强科学问答基准，包含文献语料库及检索和答案生成基准。实验表明混合检索是检索主干，智能体推理有效控制证据扩展与答案合成，整体方法在检索效果、答案质量、证据覆盖和事实依据上优于基线。
Motivation: 缪子对撞机研究涉及加速器物理、探测器仪器和高能现象学，相关证据分散在快速增长的异构文献中，而现有检索增强生成（RAG）框架在集成智能体推理且不牺牲检索精度方面存在挑战。
Method: 提出智能体混合RAG，包含混合检索器（稀疏词法检索+稠密语义检索）和智能体推理模块（查询分解、证据扩展、生成答案）。构建首个缪子对撞机领域的检索增强科学问答基准，含语料库和基准。
Result: 混合检索提供最强检索主干，智能体推理在控制证据扩展和答案合成上最有效；整体框架在检索效果、答案质量、证据覆盖和事实依据上持续优于代表性基线和RAG基线。
Conclusion: 该框架和基准为证据驱动的科学问答及未来高能物理分析智能体提供了基础。摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expert-Level Crisis Detection in Mental Health Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Real-world crisis intervention is inherently conversational, yet existing research largely focuses on static texts.Real-world crisis intervention is inherently conversational, yet existing research largely focuses on static texts. When applied to multi-turn dialogues, current models exhibit significant performance degradation, struggling to track risk signals that emerge as context evolves. To address this gap, we introduce CRADLE-Dialogue, a clinician-annotated benchmark for turn-level crisis detection in conversational settings. The dataset features 600 dialogues with multi-label annotations across clinically grounded risks, including suicide ideation, self-harm, and child abuse, distinguishing past from ongoing risk. We further propose an Alert-Confirm evaluation protocol that distinguishes early warning signals (Alert) from turns where a specific crisis becomes explicitly identifiable (Confirm), reflecting the clinical need to intervene before risk becomes explicit. Experiments show that identifying when risk emerges is much harder than recognizing that it exists: models achieve only mid-40% to high-60% Micro F1. Additionally, we release a synthetic training corpus and a 32B-parameter model that substantially outperforms existing open-source models and achieves competitive or superior results against proprietary models across turn-level, dialogue-level, and confirm-only evaluation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRADLE-Dialogue，一个由临床医生标注的对话级危机检测基准，包含 600 个多轮对话，标注了自杀意念、自伤、儿童虐待等临床风险，并区分过去和当前风险。同时提出 Alert-Confirm 评估协议，区分早期预警和明确确认。实验表明模型在识别风险涌现时表现困难，Micro F1 仅 40%-60% 左右。此外，发布了合成训练语料和一个 32B 参数模型，在多项评估中优于开源模型并接近或超过专有模型。
Motivation: 现有危机检测研究主要针对静态文本，在多轮对话中性能下降显著，难以追踪随着上下文演变的信号。
Method: 构建 CRADLE-Dialogue 数据集，包含 600 个带有多标签注释的对话，覆盖临床风险并区分过去与持续风险。提出 Alert-Confirm 评估协议，将早期预警信号与明确可识别的风险区分开来。
Result: 模型在 Alert 任务上 Micro F1 仅 40%-60% 左右，表明识别风险涌现比识别风险存在更难。发布的 32B 模型在多项评估中优于现有开源模型，并达到或超过专有模型水平。
Conclusion: 对话中的危机检测仍需改进，尤其是早期预警。所发布的基准和模型有助于推动该领域研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FSS-Net: Frequency-Spatial Synergy Network with Wavelet Attention for Carotid Artery Ultrasound Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of carotid arteries in ultrasound imaging is critical for stroke risk assessment. However, speckle noise, low contrast, and blurred boundaries remain major challenges. In this paper, we propose a Frequency-Spatial Synergy Network (FSS-Net) to achieve noise-robust and high-precision carotid artery segmentation. The network integrates wavelet transform, multi-domain attention, and edge enhancement into a unified encoder-decoder architecture. Specifically, a Channel-Spatial-Wavelet Attention (CSWA) module is designed to suppress noise and purify semantic features in the frequency domain. A Wavelet-Enhanced Bottleneck (WEB) module is introduced to capture long-range global dependencies efficiently. Furthermore, a Laplacian-Guided Adaptive Edge Fusion (LAEF) module compensates high-frequency details and maintains boundary continuity. Extensive experiments on carotid ultrasound datasets show that FSS-Net achieves a Dice score (DSC) of 96.46% and strong robustness under low SNR conditions, outperforming several state-of-the-art methods. This method realizes accurate segmentation of carotid artery in ultrasonic imaging, effectively identifies carotid atherosclerotic plaque, and is verified by other task (such as segmentation of breast cancer), suggesting that it has good clinical application potential in identifying abnormal tissue masses in ultrasonic images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出频率-空间协同网络（FSS-Net），结合小波变换、多域注意力和边缘增强，用于颈动脉超声图像分割。通过通道-空间-小波注意力（CSWA）模块抑制噪声，小波增强瓶颈（WEB）模块捕获长距离依赖，以及拉普拉斯引导自适应边缘融合（LAEF）模块补偿高频细节。在颈动脉超声数据集上Dice达到96.46%，在低信噪比下鲁棒性强，并在乳腺癌分割等其他任务上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 颈动脉超声分割中斑点噪声、低对比度和边界模糊是主要挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾噪声鲁棒性和分割精度。
Method: 提出FSS-Net，集成小波变换、多域注意力和边缘增强的编码器-解码器架构。包含CSWA模块（频域抑制噪声并净化语义特征）、WEB模块（高效捕获长距离全局依赖）和LAEF模块（补偿高频细节并保持边界连续性）。
Result: 在颈动脉超声数据集上Dice分数达96.46%，在低信噪比条件下鲁棒性强，优于多种现有方法；在乳腺癌分割任务上也取得良好效果。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了超声图像中颈动脉的精确分割，能有效识别颈动脉粥样硬化斑块，且在其他超声图像异常组织团块分割任务中具有临床推广潜力。

summary_sections.result: 在颈动脉超声数据集上Dice分数达96.46%，在低信噪比条件下鲁棒性强，优于多种现有方法；在乳腺癌分割任务上也取得良好效果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法实现了超声图像中颈动脉的精确分割，能有效识别颈动脉粥样硬化斑块，且在其他超声图像异常组织团块分割任务中具有临床推广潜力。

papers.title: Bidirectional Random Projections
papers.abstract_en: This paper analyzes bidirectional random projections for ordinary least squares (OLS) regression under the fixed design setting. Let $(X,Y) \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times p} \times \mathbb{R}^n$ be a sample and $R \in \mathbb{R}^{n_1 \times n}, W \in \mathbb{R}^{p \times p_1}$ be two properly distributed random projections. We develop an expected excess loss bound for the OLS estimator built on $(WXR, WY)$. Compared to an established bound for OLS estimator built on $(XR, Y)$, the gap is approximately $O\left( p_1 + C \frac{1}{p_1} \right)$, where $C$ scales with $n_1/n$ and can be negative for small $n_1/n$. Its implications are confirmed by numerical results on real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在固定设计下分析了普通最小二乘回归的双向随机投影。对于基于(WXR, WY)的OLS估计量，推导了期望超额损失界，并与基于(XR, Y)的界进行比较，发现差距约为O(p1 + C/p1)，其中C随n1/n变化且可为负。数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 随机投影是降维的常用工具，但双向随机投影的统计性质缺乏深入分析。
Method: 通过理论分析，导出双向随机投影下OLS估计量的期望超额损失界，并与标准单向投影进行比较。
Result: 推导出双向投影的额外损失项约为O(p1 + C/p1)，当n1/n较小时C可为负，表明双向投影可能优于单向投影。
Conclusion: 论文提供了双向随机投影的理论保证，并指出其在特定条件下的优势。

papers.title: Belief-Space Control for Personalized Cancer Treatment via Active Inference
papers.abstract_en: Cancer treatment is at the core a sequential decision-making problem with partial observability, latent patient heterogeneity, and explicit constraints on the budget for medical measurements. Unlike standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches that control state trajectories, cancer treatments permanently modify patients' transition dynamics, changing how states evolve over time. We model cancer treatment as a belief-space planning problem using active inference, deriving an expected free-energy objective that unifies goal-directed control and information acquisition under measurement budgets without. We implement this framework using real clinical cancer data from the AACR Project GENIE Biopharma Collaborative dataset. Results on clinical data demonstrate a simultaneous patient categorization and high treatment efficacy, under real measurement and treatment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文将癌症治疗建模为部分可观测、存在潜在患者异质性和测量预算约束的序贯决策问题，提出使用主动推理（active inference）进行信念空间规划，推导期望自由能目标函数，统一目标导向控制和信息获取。在AACR Project GENIE Biopharma Collaborative临床数据上验证，展示了患者分类和高治疗疗效。
Motivation: 标准强化学习方法控制状态轨迹，但癌症治疗会永久改变患者转移动态，且存在部分可观测性和测量预算约束，现有方法未充分建模这些问题。
Method: 将癌症治疗建模为信念空间规划问题，采用主动推理框架，推导期望自由能目标函数，联合优化治疗控制和信息获取，并在真实临床数据上实现。
Result: 在AACR Project GENIE Biopharma Collaborative临床数据集上，该方法实现了同时进行患者分类和高效治疗，且满足实际测量和治疗约束。
Conclusion: 主动推理框架为个性化癌症治疗提供了一种在不确定性和预算约束下进行序贯决策的有效方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PF-Trans: Physics-Embedded Frequency-Aware Transformer for Spectral Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Snapshot Broadband Filter Array (BFA) imaging provides high light throughput for spectral reconstruction but introduces severe spectral aliasing due to complex modulation. Current deep learning approaches, limited to spatial denoising, often fail to address the global frequency-specific degradations caused by the mask structure. To address this, we propose a Physics-embedded Frequency-aware Transformer (PF-Trans) for high-fidelity remote sensing spectral reconstruction. Our method explicitly integrates the physical sensing model through mask injection and a gray-scale consistency loss to ensure physical fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce a Dual-domain Block with a parallel Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) branch, enabling the network to perceive and suppress aliasing artifacts in the frequency domain. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that PF-Trans achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of up to 48.50 dB on the GF-5 Shanghai dataset, significantly outperforming comparison methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对快照宽带滤光片阵列（BFA）成像中的光谱混叠问题，提出了一种物理嵌入的频率感知变换器（PF-Trans）。该方法通过掩模注入和灰度一致性损失显式集成物理传感模型，并引入并行快速傅里叶变换（FFT）分支的双域块以在频域感知和抑制混叠伪影。在多个数据集上的实验表明，PF-Trans 达到了最先进的性能，在 GF-5 上海数据集上峰值信噪比（PSNR）高达 48.50 dB。
Motivation: 当前深度学习方法局限于空间域去噪，难以解决由掩模结构引起的全局频率特定退化。
Method: 提出物理嵌入的频率感知变换器（PF-Trans），包含掩模注入和灰度一致性损失以保持物理保真度，以及带有并行 FFT 分支的双域块以处理频域混叠。
Result: 在 GF-5 上海数据集上 PSNR 达 48.50 dB，显著优于对比方法。
Conclusion: PF-Trans 通过物理嵌入和频域感知有效解决了 BFA 成像的光谱重建问题。

papers.title: ClinReadNet: A clinical reading-inspired network for low-dose abdominal CT image quality assessment
papers.abstract_en: In abdominal CT imaging, developing a low-dose, no-reference image quality assessment (No-reference IQA) model that mimics doctors' reading habits for evaluating CT image quality has significant practical value. This paper proposes a novel deep learning-based framework, ClinReadNet, whose design aligns with the clinical reading logic of radiologists: first, it introduces the Sobel ordinal quality network (SOQN) module, which can simultaneously focus on edge details highly relevant to image quality and the quality distribution pattern of the entire image, accurately matching the clinical image-reading judgment habit of "considering both local details and overall context"; second, the framework integrates the (shifted) window multi-scale temperature multi-head self-attention ((S)W-MTMSA) module, which further replicates the radiologists' image-reading process of shifting from overall scanning to local focusing, and accurately locks in regions of interest through multi-sharpness attention; third, it designs the hierarchical ranked probability score (HRPS) loss function, which combines the dual logics of coarse classification and fine classification, while paying attention to the distance information between grading labels, effectively improving the performance of image quality assessment. Experiments conducted on the LDCTIQAG2023 dataset show that the proposed method achieves the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance: the values of Pearson's linear correlation coefficient (PLCC), Spearman's rank-order correlation coefficient (SROCC), and Kendall's rank-order correlation coefficient (KROCC) reach 0.9507, 0.9554, and 0.8629 respectively, with the sum of their absolute values (Score) being 2.7690, outperforming existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ClinReadNet，一种模仿放射科医生临床阅读习惯的无参考CT图像质量评估网络。包含Sobel有序质量网络模块、窗口多尺度温度多头自注意力和层级排序概率评分损失函数。在LDCTIQAG2023数据集上达到SOTA，PLCC、SROCC、KROCC分别为0.9507、0.9554、0.8629。
Motivation: 低剂量CT图像质量评估中，现有模型缺乏对医生阅读习惯的模仿，难以同时关注局部细节和整体质量分布。
Method: 提出ClinReadNet框架，包含Sobel有序质量网络（SOQN）关注边缘细节和整体分布；(S)W-MTMSA模块模拟从全局扫描到局部聚焦；HRPS损失函数结合粗分类和细分类逻辑并考虑等级间距。
Result: 在LDCTIQAG2023数据集上，PLCC、SROCC、KROCC分别达到0.9507、0.9554、0.8629，Score为2.7690，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: ClinReadNet通过模拟临床阅读习惯，有效提升了低剂量腹部CT图像质量评估性能，但可能在CT以外的模态或噪声模式中需进一步验证。

papers.title: Test-time Adversarial Takeover: A Real-time Hijacking Interface against Robotic Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based action generation has become a foundational component of embodied AI, but its reliance on visual conditioning leaves deployed visuomotor policies vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Most prior attacks focus on disruption: they perturb the observation stream to reduce task success or induce erratic behavior. We study a stronger threat, Test-time Adversarial Takeover (TAKO), in which an attacker obtains a real-time steering interface over a frozen robot policy and turns it into a remotely piloted instrument. TAKO learns a small vocabulary of reusable universal patches through differentiable diffusion inference; at test time, the attacker switches among these patches in the camera stream to compose attacker-chosen trajectories. This works because the perturbation acts on the visual conditioning pathway, where the induced bias can persist through iterative generative inference. We further show that the natural targeted baseline, target-policy matching, fails because the victim policy cannot reliably supervise itself on out-of-distribution target shifts. Across four tasks (2D manipulation, simulated aerial delivery, simulated ground navigation, and physical-world ground navigation), two visual encoders (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0 + Transformer), and three generative inference families (DDPM, DDIM, and flow matching), human operators achieve 100\% takeover success on attacker-defined objectives in every evaluated setting. The project page is available at https://tako-attack.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种测试时对抗接管（TAKO）攻击，通过可重复使用的通用补丁在相机流中切换，实现对手对冻结机器人扩散策略的实时控制。实验表明，在多种任务、视觉编码器和生成推理家族上，人类操作员均能100%成功接管。
Motivation: 已有的对抗攻击主要破坏任务成功率或引发异常行为，但未能实现对手对机器人策略的精确控制。本文旨在展示更严重的威胁：对手将扩散策略变成远程操控工具。
Method: TAKO通过可微扩散推理学习少量可重复使用的通用补丁，在测试时通过切换相机流中的补丁来组合攻击者选择的轨迹。攻击利用视觉条件路径上的扰动，使其在迭代生成推理中持续发挥作用。
Result: 在2D操作、模拟空中配送、模拟地面导航和物理地面导航四个任务，ResNet-18和EfficientNet-B0+Transformer两种视觉编码器，以及DDPM、DDIM和Flow Matching三种生成推理家族上，人类操作员在所有设定下均实现100%接管成功。
Conclusion: TAKO揭示了扩散策略在视觉条件路径上的严重安全漏洞，表明该类策略易被恶意接管。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PADD: Path-Aligned Decompression Distillation for Non-Router Teacher to Guide MoE Student Learning
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) continue to scale, it becomes increasingly challenging to grow model capacity under fixed computation budgets. We propose Path-Aligned Decompression Distillation (PADD), a framework for distilling knowledge from dense teachers without explicit routing into mixture-of-experts (MoE) students while learning high-quality routing policies. PADD organizes knowledge distillation into four stages in two phases: an initialization phase (Stage I) that builds diverse functionality in the student's experts through teacher neuron clustering and student-expert warmup, and a training phase (Stages II--IV) that integrates online adaptive distillation, path-refined policy optimization, and reward-augmented load balancing in a single training pipeline. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PADD yields substantial gains over strong baselines at the same inference cost and that the MoE student can match or surpass its dense teacher. They also demonstrate effective teacher-to-student knowledge distillation and stable routing behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出路径对齐解压蒸馏（PADD），用于从无显式路由的密集教师模型中蒸馏知识，指导混合专家（MoE）学生学习高质量路由策略。PADD包含初始化和训练两个阶段共四个步骤，通过教师神经元聚类、学生专家热身、在线自适应蒸馏、路径优化策略和奖励增强负载均衡实现。在数学推理基准上，PADD显著优于同推理成本的强基线，且MoE学生可匹配或超越其密集教师模型。
Motivation: 大型语言模型规模持续增长，但在固定计算预算下增加模型容量面临挑战。现有的蒸馏方法难以在从无路由的密集教师迁移知识的同时学习高质量MoE路由策略。
Method: 提出PADD框架，分两个阶段四个步骤：初始化阶段（阶段I）通过教师神经元聚类和学生专家热身构建专家多样性；训练阶段（阶段II-IV）集成在线自适应蒸馏、路径优化策略和奖励增强负载均衡，统一训练管线。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，PADD相比强基线在相同推理成本下取得显著提升，MoE学生模型的性能可匹配或超越其密集教师模型。
Conclusion: PADD实现了有效的教师到学生知识蒸馏和稳定的路由行为，验证了非路由教师指导MoE学生学习的可行性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在数学推理基准上，PADD相比强基线在相同推理成本下取得显著提升，MoE学生模型的性能可匹配或超越其密集教师模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: PADD实现了有效的教师到学生知识蒸馏和稳定的路由行为，验证了非路由教师指导MoE学生学习的可行性。

papers.title: Speech Meets ELF: Audio Conditional Continuous-Target Diffusion for Speech Recognition and Translation
papers.abstract_en: Speech-to-text (S2T) systems for recognition (ASR) and translation (S2TT) typically generate discrete text tokens. In contrast, continuous-target language modelling performs generation in a continuous space, yet its potential for S2T remains unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose ELF-S2T, an audio-conditioned continuous-target generative model for S2T. Built upon the pre-trained Embedded Language Flows (ELF) backbone, ELF-S2T processes speech via a frozen Whisper encoder and a single linear projector, prepending the resulting audio condition to the noisy text latent for in-context, flow-matching denoising. To prevent the model from over-relying on its pre-trained text context, we introduce audio forcing during training, and further amplify the audio condition via classifier-free guidance at inference. Experiments on LibriSpeech and CoVoST2 show that ELF-S2T achieves competitive ASR and S2TT performance. Crucially, our error analysis reveals that, although ASR and S2TT errors look very different on the surface, both stem from the same underlying cause, a close distance confusion in the continuous latent space. This finding naturally aligns with the continuous representation generation paradigm, indicating a common semantic mapping process beneath recognition and translation. Our code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/Sslnon/ELF-S2T.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ELF-S2T，一种基于音频条件连续目标生成的语音识别和翻译模型。它使用预训练的Embedded Language Flows (ELF) 骨干网络，结合冻结的Whisper编码器和线性投影器，将音频条件注入到噪声文本潜在空间中，通过流匹配去噪生成文本。实验在LibriSpeech和CoVoST2上达到竞争性表现，并发现ASR和S2TT错误的根本原因相同，即连续潜在空间中的接近距离混淆。
Motivation: 现有语音到文本系统通常生成离散文本标记，而连续目标语言模型在S2T任务中的潜力尚未被探索。
Method: ELF-S2T基于预训练ELF骨干，使用冻结Whisper编码器和线性投影器处理语音，将音频条件添加到噪声文本潜在表示中，通过流匹配进行上下文去噪。训练时引入音频强制（audio forcing）防止过依赖文本上下文，推理时通过分类器无关引导增强音频条件。
Result: 在LibriSpeech和CoVoST2上实现竞争性的ASR和S2TT性能。错误分析表明，ASR和S2TT错误表面不同，但均源于连续潜在空间中的接近距离混淆。
Conclusion: 该发现与连续表示生成范式一致，表明识别和翻译背后存在共同的语义映射过程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Practical Recipe Towards Improving Sim-and-Real Correlation for VLA Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Simulation has become an essential tool for evaluating and improving vision-language-action (VLA) policies, offering scalable, reproducible, and controllable alternatives to costly real-world robot evaluation. Recent simulation benchmarks have made substantial progress on realism and diversity, yet these platforms have not been widely adopted as reliable proxies for real-world policy evaluation. In this work, we investigate this issue through the lens of sim-and-real correlation. We conduct a systematic study across multiple simulation platforms, VLA policies, tasks, and perturbation factors, measuring whether simulated evaluation preserves real-world conclusions in terms of policy ranking consistency, performance correlation, and perturbation-wise failure patterns. This analysis allows us to characterize the limitations of existing simulators and identify what kinds of simulation signals are more aligned with real-world deployment. We further examine how users should exploit simulation for policy improvement, including when simulator-based finetuning is beneficial and how the amount of post-training data affects sim-and-real alignment. Overall, our work provides a unified framework for measuring, interpreting, and improving the usefulness of simulation for VLA policies, offering guidance both for simulator designers and for practitioners who use simulation as part of the policy development pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究仿真环境与真实世界在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略评估中的相关性，通过多个仿真平台、策略、任务和扰动因素，衡量仿真评估能否保持真实世界的策略排名一致性、性能相关性和失败模式分布，并分析如何利用仿真进行策略改进。
Motivation: 现有仿真基准在逼真度和多样性方面取得进展，但尚未被广泛用作真实世界策略评估的可靠代理，需要系统理解仿真与真实世界相关性。
Method: 跨多个仿真平台、VLA策略、任务和扰动因素进行系统性研究，测量策略排名一致性、性能相关性和按扰动类型划分的失败模式。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但指出通过分析可以表征现有仿真器的局限性，并识别出与真实世界部署更对齐的仿真信号。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的框架，用于测量、解释和提高仿真对VLA策略的实用性，为仿真器设计者和使用仿真作为策略开发管道的实践者提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking stereo reconstruction for 3D printable Martian terrain models
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing printable 3D models from Mars rover imagery is challenging because Martian terrain is low-texture, irregular, and partially observed. We evaluate a pipeline that estimates stereo depth from NASA Curiosity images, completes geometry, and exports watertight OBJ meshes. On Middlebury, RAFT-Stereo outperforms semi-global block matching (SGBM), reducing disparity MAE from 3.22px to 0.73px and increasing valid prediction coverage from 76.3% to 100.0%. On Curiosity imagery, however, RAFT's denser disparities show weaker edge alignment and higher photometric reprojection error, suggesting that benchmark accuracy does not directly transfer to Martian terrain reconstruction. Geometry completion demonstrates a tradeoff between local fidelity and global connectivity. We find that alpha shapes preserve accurate but fragmented structure, Poisson reconstruction produces more coherent meshes but adds unsupported surfaces, and a deterministic diffusion-fill baseline is intermediate but sensitive to stereo quality. Overall, standard stereo and completion methods can produce printable approximations of Martian terrain, but reliable reconstruction requires stronger domain-specific validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了从NASA好奇号火星车图像进行立体深度估计、几何补全并导出可打印3D模型（OBJ网格）的流程。在Middlebury基准上，RAFT-Stereo相比半全局块匹配（SGBM）将视差MAE从3.22像素降至0.73像素，并提高有效预测覆盖率至100%。但在好奇号真实火星图像上，RAFT的密集视差显示出较差的边缘对齐和更高的光度重投影误差，表明基准精度不能直接迁移到火星地形重建。几何补全方法中，alpha形状保留精确但碎片化的结构，泊松重建生成更连贯的网格但引入未支撑表面，确定性扩散填充基线介于两者之间但受立体质量影响。
Motivation: 火星地形具有低纹理、不规则和部分观测的特点，从火星车图像重建可打印3D模型具有挑战性，现有立体和几何补全方法在火星领域的有效性缺乏系统评估。
Method: 采用完整流水线：先用立体匹配（RAFT-Stereo或SGBM）估计深度，再对点云进行几何补全（alpha形状、泊松重建、扩散填充），最后导出水密OBJ网格。在Middlebury基准和真实好奇号图像上分别评估。
Result: 在Middlebury上RAFT优于SGBM（MAE 0.73 vs 3.22px，覆盖率100% vs 76.3%）；但在好奇号图像上RAFT的密集视差边缘对齐差且重投影误差更高。几何补全存在局部保真度与全局连通性的权衡。
Conclusion: 标准立体和几何补全方法可以生成火星地形的可打印近似模型，但可靠的重建需要更强领域特定的验证。

papers.title: Near-Exponential Convergence Rates for kNN Classification based on Boltzmann Margin
papers.abstract_en: Convergence-rate analysis for classifiers is often conducted under either Tsybakov margin or Massart margin. The former is a relatively weak condition that typically yields polynomial rates, while the latter is substantially stronger but can guarantee exponential rates. In this paper, we introduce a new condition, called Boltzmann margin, that bridges the gap between these two regimes. It is weaker than Massart margin, generally stronger than Tsybakov margin, and can imply many of their properties under suitable conditions. We apply Boltzmann margin to the analysis of kNN classifiers and establish the first near-exponential convergence rates for kNN classification. We also present extensions of the main results and provide numerical evidence supporting the main theoretical implications.
papers.comment: Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的边界条件——玻尔兹曼边界（Boltzmann margin），介于Tsybakov边界和Massart边界之间，并将其应用于kNN分类器的收敛速率分析，首次证明了kNN分类的近指数收敛速率。
Motivation: 现有分类器收敛速率分析中，Tsybakov边界条件较弱，只能得到多项式速率；Massart边界条件过强，难以满足。玻尔兹曼边界填补了两者之间的空白，并在合适的条件下保留两者的性质。
Method: 引入玻尔兹曼边界条件，并基于此对kNN分类器进行理论分析，推导其收敛速率。
Result: 建立了kNN分类的首个近指数收敛速率，并给出了主要结论的扩展和数值验证。
Conclusion: 玻尔兹曼边界条件能够桥接Tsybakov与Massart边界，为分类器理论分析提供新工具。

papers.title: ReflectiChain: Epistemic Grounding in LLM-Driven World Models for Supply Chain Resilience
papers.abstract_en: AI agents in supply chains face a fundamental epistemic gap: large language models (LLMs) interpret policies but lack physical grounding, while reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes flows but is semantically blind to unstructured constraints. We introduce REFLECTICHAIN, bridging this gap through a Generative Supply Chain World Model (SC-WM) - encoding heterogeneous supply networks into a 6-dim graph-latent space with physical conservation - and Double-Loop Learning that separates epistemic uncertainty (KL-trust-region-bounded policy adaptation) from aleatoric uncertainty (stochastic latent rollouts). On Semi-Sim, a 10-node semiconductor benchmark with SIR risk propagation, 6 perturbation types, and 10 policy constraint templates, REFLECTICHAIN improves Rationale Consistency Score by 33.0% (p < 0.0001, d = 2.78), maintains 82.3% operability under adversarial shocks, and exhibits anti-fragile behavior (+40.2% gain under moderate pressure). We identify three operational epistemic mechanisms - uncertainty separation, knowledge-boundary detection, and empirical Bayesian policy updating - and discuss five limitation categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REFLECTICHAIN 框架，通过生成式供应链世界模型（SC-WM）和双环学习机制，弥合大语言模型（LLM）与强化学习（RL）之间的认知鸿沟，提升供应链在扰动下的弹性。在半导体的基准测试上，该方法在理性一致性、可操作性和反脆弱性方面均有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有的 AI 智能体在供应链中面临认知鸿沟：LLM 解释策略但缺乏物理基础，RL 优化流量但无法理解非结构化约束，需要一种统一框架来融合两者。
Method: 提出生成式供应链世界模型（SC-WM），将异构供应网络编码为 6 维图-潜空间并满足物理守恒；采用双环学习，将认知不确定性（KL-信任域约束的策略更新）与偶然不确定性（随机潜变量 rollout）分离。
Result: 在 10 节点的半导体基准测试中，REFLECTICHAIN 将理性一致性分数提升 33.0%（p < 0.0001, d = 2.78），在对抗性冲击下保持 82.3% 的可操作性，并在适度压力下表现出反脆弱行为（增益 +40.2%）。
Conclusion: 论文识别了三种运作中的认知机制——不确定性分离、知识边界检测和经验贝叶斯策略更新，并讨论了五个局限性类别。

papers.title: KG-SoftMAP: Soft Knowledge-Graph Priors for Bayesian Network Structure Learning from Sparse Discrete Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning Bayesian network (BN) structure from sparse discrete data is hard: when each instance records only a few variables, most variable pairs lack the joint observations needed for reliable scoring, and data-only methods recover little structure. Imperfect domain knowledge, expressible as a weighted directed knowledge graph (KG), is often available. We propose KG-SoftMAP, which encodes such a KG as a soft, confidence-weighted, data-overridable edge prior and maximizes a MAP objective combining the BDeu score with a logit-form prior; the KG may be expert-curated or LLM-extracted. On controlled synthetic benchmarks, the only setting with ground-truth DAGs, KG-SoftMAP recovers partial directed structure at $ρ=0.05$ (DF1 $0.14$ to $0.29$, versus near-zero baselines) and substantially more once $ρ\geq0.2$ (DF1 $0.46$ to $0.96$), when paired with an informative but imperfect KG; recovery degrades gracefully as KG quality drops. On real sparse educational data, which has no ground-truth DAG, we evaluate deployment-facing measures only: prediction, calibration, and KG-consistency. The learned BN is best read as a diagnostic model: on SAF it trails logistic regression by $0.03$ F1_FAIL while providing KG-consistent edges, calibrated joint probabilities, and inference from arbitrary observed concept subsets; when no meaningful KG exists, discriminative logistic regression is preferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KG-SoftMAP，一种利用软知识图谱先验进行贝叶斯网络结构学习的方法，适用于稀疏离散数据。通过在最大后验估计中结合BDeu评分和logit形式先验，该方法在控制合成基准上，当数据稀疏（ρ=0.05）时，DF1从接近零提升到0.14-0.29；当数据更充足时，DF1可达0.46-0.96。在真实教育数据上，学习到的BN作为诊断模型表现良好，但若没有有意义的知识图谱，则判别式逻辑回归更优。
Motivation: 从稀疏离散数据中学习贝叶斯网络结构非常困难，因为每个实例只记录少量变量，大多数变量对缺乏联合观测，纯数据方法恢复结构有限。现有不完美的领域知识可以表示为加权有向知识图谱（KG），但如何有效利用这些知识是一个问题。
Method: 提出KG-SoftMAP，将知识图谱编码为软的、置信加权的、可被数据覆盖的边先验，并最大化结合BDeu评分和logit形式先验的MAP目标。知识图谱可以是专家策划或LLM提取的。
Result: 在控制合成基准（有真实DAG）上，KG-SoftMAP在ρ=0.05时恢复部分有向结构（DF1 0.14-0.29，而基线接近零）；当ρ≥0.2时，结合信息但不完美的KG，DF1达到0.46-0.96；随着KG质量下降，恢复性能优雅地退化。在真实稀疏教育数据上，学习到的BN作为诊断模型，在SAF上F1_FAIL比逻辑回归低0.03，但提供KG一致的边、校准的联合概率以及从任意观察概念子集推理的能力。
Conclusion: 学习到的BN最适合作为诊断模型。当有有意义的KG时，BN提供可解释性和推理能力；当没有有意义的KG时，判别式逻辑回归更可取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Atomic Intent Reasoning: Bringing LLM Semantics to Industrial Cross-Domain Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain recommendation is a core problem in content-to-e-commerce platforms. Its objective is to leverage user interactions with content to infer potential purchasing intent on the e-commerce side, thereby enhancing conversion rates and commercial value. However, in real industrial scenarios, cross-domain recommendation faces multiple challenges: significant semantic gaps exist between different domains, and user cross-domain behavior sequences are often massive in scale and rich in noise. Although large language models (LLMs) possess powerful semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, their millisecond-level inference latency makes direct application in online recommendation systems difficult. To address these issues, this paper introduces AIR (Atomic Intent Reasoning), an LLM-driven cross-domain recommendation framework designed for industrial-grade deployment. By migrating LLM inference to the offline phase and dynamically constructing user intent representations through efficient retrieval and composition during online operations, it achieves approximately 400* inference acceleration while maintaining semantic consistency. Experimental results across multiple public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-domain recommendation tasks. Furthermore, large-scale online A/B testing conducted in Kuaishou E-commerce's real-world business scenarios shows that our approach delivers stable and significant improvements across multiple core business metrics, including a +3.446% increase in GMV, fully validating its effectiveness and practical value in industrial-scale recommendation systems.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26), August 09--13, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Atomic Intent Reasoning (AIR)框架，将LLM推理迁移至离线，在线通过检索和组合动态构建用户意图表示，实现约400倍加速。在多个公开数据集上取得最佳性能，并在快手电商A/B测试中使GMV提升3.446%。
Motivation: 跨域推荐面临语义鸿沟和用户行为噪声问题，LLM直接在线推理延迟过高，无法满足工业级部署需求。
Method: 将LLM推理迁移到离线阶段，在线通过高效检索和组合历史行为片段动态构建用户意图表示，并设计紧凑的意图向量以保持语义一致性。
Result: 多个公开数据集上达到SOTA，快手电商A/B测试中GMV提升3.446%，其他核心业务指标也有显著改进。
Conclusion: AIR框架在工业级推荐系统中验证了有效性和实用价值，实现了LLM语义与在线推理速度的平衡。

papers.title: Multi-Angular Reflectance Anisotropy Observed from UAV Multispectral Imagery
papers.abstract_en: UAV multispectral imagery naturally contains multi-angular observations due to low flight altitude and wide field-of-view imaging, which may introduce geometry-driven radiometric variability. This study proposes a geometry-aware multi-angular observation extraction workflow to quantify observation-geometry effects from a BRDF perspective. Specifically, camera intrinsics and extrinsics are refined via structure-from-motion (SFM), and homogeneous regions annotated on an orthomosaic are reprojected onto multiple raw sub-images acquired from different viewpoints. This enables joint extraction of multi-band reflectance and observation geometry parameters for the same ground targets under varying viewing directions. The extracted observations are further analyzed using band-wise polar visualization in the (VZA, RAA) domain. Results on a grassland target show clear reflectance anisotropy across ten bands, with red-edge and nearinfrared bands exhibiting 119-137% variability between maximum and minimum reflectance, indicating non-negligible observation-geometry effects on radiometric consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究利用无人机多光谱影像天然的多角度观测特性，提出一种几何感知的多角度观测提取工作流，从BRDF角度量化观测几何效应。通过SFM精化相机内外参，将正射影像上的均匀区域反投影到多张原始子图像，联合提取多波段反射率和观测几何参数。对草地区域的分析显示，红边和近红外波段的最大最小反射率差异达119-137%，表明观测几何对辐射一致性有不可忽视的影响。
Motivation: 无人机多光谱影像因低空宽视场成像自然包含多角度观测，导致几何驱动的辐射变异性，但缺少系统量化观测几何对辐射一致性的影响。
Method: 提出几何感知的多角度观测提取流程：通过SFM精化相机内外参，将正射影像上的均匀区域反投影到不同视角的原始子图像，联合提取多波段反射率及观测几何参数（VZA、RAA），并进行波段极坐标可视化分析。
Result: 在草地区域目标上，十个波段均呈现明显反射率各向异性，红边和近红外波段最大与最小反射率差异达119-137%，表明观测几何效应不可忽略。
Conclusion: 无人机影像的观测几何效应显著影响辐射一致性，所提工作流可有效提取和分析多角度观测数据，为后续辐射校正或应用提供参考。

papers.title: Magnetic HIP-NN for spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets
papers.abstract_en: We present a magnetic extension of the Hierarchically Interacting Particle Neural Network (HIP-NN) that enables large-scale simulations of electron-mediated spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets. The resulting magnetic HIP-NN (mHIP-NN) incorporates rotationally invariant spin correlations directly into hierarchical message-passing layers, enabling the network to learn emergent magnetic energy landscapes and effective local fields from coupled geometric-spin environments while preserving spin-rotation symmetry. As a benchmark application, we consider structurally disordered itinerant $s$-$d$ exchange models in which the effective magnetic forces arise dynamically from the instantaneous electronic structure and are computationally prohibitive to evaluate using conventional exact-diagonalization-based approaches. We show that mHIP-NN accurately reproduces the local torques governing Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics and faithfully captures the nonequilibrium evolution of spatial spin correlations following thermal quenches. Our results establish symmetry-aware hierarchical message-passing networks as an efficient and scalable framework for large-scale simulations of frustrated itinerant spin systems and nonequilibrium magnetic dynamics. More broadly, because the learned energy functional remains fully differentiable with respect to both atomic coordinates and spin variables, the framework also provides a natural foundation for spin-dependent interatomic potentials and coupled atom-spin dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了磁性HIP-NN (mHIP-NN)，一种扩展的层次相互作用粒子神经网络，用于无序巡游磁体中电子介导自旋动力学的大规模模拟。该网络通过旋转不变的自旋关联层次消息传递层学习磁性能量景观和有效局域场，在无序s-d交换模型基准上准确再现了Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学中的局域力矩和热淬火后自旋关联的非平衡演化。
Motivation: 现有基于严格对角化的方法在计算无序巡游磁体中的有效磁力时计算成本极高，难以进行大规模模拟。
Method: 在HIP-NN的基础上引入旋转不变的自旋关联，将其融入层次消息传递层，构建mHIP-NN。网络学习从耦合的几何-自旋环境中提取磁性能量景观和有效局域场，且保持自旋旋转对称性。
Result: 在无序巡游s-d交换模型上，mHIP-NN准确再现了控制Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学的局域力矩，并忠实捕捉了热淬火后空间自旋关联的非平衡演化。
Conclusion: 对称感知的层次消息传递网络为受阻巡游自旋系统和非平衡磁动力学的大规模模拟提供了高效可扩展框架。由于学习的能量泛函对原子坐标和自旋变量完全可微，它也为自旋依赖的原子间势和耦合原子-自旋动力学奠定了基础。

papers.title: Beyond Explaining Predictions: Logic-Based Explanations for Confidence in Machine Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly used in critical domains, where both predictions and their associated confidence levels influence important decisions. To enhance transparency in such scenarios, it is important to understand why a model is confident or uncertain about its predictions. Recent logic-based approaches provide abductive explanations, minimal subsets of features sufficient to preserve the predicted class, with correctness guarantees. However, these methods focus solely on classification behavior and may produce explanations that cover instances with low predictive confidence. In this work, we introduce the concept of Minimum Confidence Threshold (MCT), which quantifies the weakest confidence guarantee provided by an abductive explanation. Building upon this concept, we propose confidence-aware abductive explanations, which preserve not only the predicted class but also a user-specified confidence guarantee. We formulate MCT computation as an optimization problem and introduce an algorithm for generating minimal explanations that satisfy a desired confidence threshold. We evaluate the proposed framework on boosted trees for binary classification, although the approach is applicable to other machine learning models that provide confidence scores. Experimental results show that traditional abductive explanations often provide substantially weaker confidence guarantees than the confidence associated with the explained instance itself. In contrast, confidence-aware explanations consistently improve the minimum confidence guaranteed by an explanation while requiring only a modest increase in explanation length. These properties make the proposed approach particularly suitable for applications where both predictive correctness and confidence are essential for trustworthy decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出置信度感知的溯因解释（confidence-aware abductive explanations），在保留预测类别的同时保证用户指定的置信度。通过定义最小置信度阈值（MCT）并设计优化算法，生成满足置信度要求的最小解释。实验表明传统溯因解释的置信度保证远弱于实例本身的置信度，而所提方法在解释长度小幅增加下显著提升最小置信度保证。
Motivation: 现有溯因解释仅关注分类行为，可能覆盖低置信度预测，无法满足需要同时理解预测正确性与置信度的关键应用场景。
Method: 定义最小置信度阈值（MCT）并构建优化问题，提出算法生成满足用户指定置信度阈值的最小解释。方法适用于任何提供置信度得分的机器学习模型，实验中应用于二分类提升树。
Result: 实验显示传统溯因解释提供的置信度保证往往远低于实例本身的置信度；而置信度感知解释在解释长度适度增加下，持续提高了解释所保证的最小置信度。
Conclusion: 本方法特别适用于需要同时保证预测正确性与置信度的可信决策场景，且可扩展至其他提供置信度得分的模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning or Memorization? Direction-Aware Diversity Exploration in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a key paradigm for eliciting reasoning abilities in large language models, where exploration is crucial for discovering effective solution trajectories. Existing exploration methods typically encourage diversity in semantic or gradient spaces, without distinguishing what drives this diversity. A trajectory may appear novel because it follows a new reasoning process, or because it varies memorized patterns and shortcuts. Rewarding both cases equally may steer exploration toward memorization rather than genuine reasoning improvement. In this paper, we propose DiRL, a Direction-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework that anchors exploration to an internal reasoning-memorization direction of the policy. Specifically, DiRL extracts this direction from model representations, constructs direction-weighted gradient features to characterize rollout updates, and shapes rewards to amplify reasoning-aligned exploration while suppressing memorization-aligned variations. DiRL integrates seamlessly into standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Extensive experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DiRL, showing significant improvements over various existing exploration methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiRL，一种方向感知的强化学习框架，通过从策略表征中提取推理-记忆方向并构建方向加权梯度特征，重塑奖励以放大推理型探索、抑制记忆型变化。该框架可无缝集成到 GRPO 中，在数学和通用推理基准上显著优于现有探索方法。
Motivation: 现有探索方法通常鼓励语义或梯度空间的多样性，但未区分多样性来源（新推理过程 vs 记忆模式的变异），可能将探索导向记忆而非真正的推理提升。
Method: DiRL 从模型表征中提取内部推理-记忆方向向量，构建方向加权梯度特征来刻画 rollout 更新，并据此塑造奖励，从而放大推理对齐的探索、抑制记忆对齐的变异。
Result: 在数学和通用推理基准上的实验表明，DiRL 相较于多种现有探索方法带来显著改进。
Conclusion: DiRL 通过显式区分推理与记忆驱动的多样性，有效引导强化学习探索朝向真正的推理能力提升。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 DiRL，一种方向感知的强化学习框架，通过从策略表征中提取推理-记忆方向并构建方向加权梯度特征，重塑奖励以放大推理型探索、抑制记忆型变化。该框架可无缝集成到 GRPO 中，在数学和通用推理基准上显著优于现有探索方法。

papers.title: Routing-Aware Expert Calibration for Machine Unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is increasingly important for large language models, yet unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures remains underexplored. Unlike dense models, MoE architectures employ a router at each layer to assign each token to a sparse subset of experts. In this work, we observe that forget data often activates a small subset of experts disproportionately, while these experts may receive much weaker activation from retain data. This forget--retain routing mismatch can leave forget-critical experts under-regularized during unlearning. To address this, we propose \textbf{TRACE}, Targeted Routing-Aware Calibration of Experts, for MoE unlearning. TRACE first detects forget-critical experts from offline activation statistics, and then calibrates retain regularization by reweighting token-level retain losses so that each selected expert's retain-side activation frequency better matches its forget-side counterpart. Experiments on WMDP and MUSE-BOOKS across multiple MoE LLMs show that TRACE consistently improves the forget-utility trade-off, yielding a 9\% relative utility improvement over the strongest baseline under comparable forgetting quality and the best performance on three out of four MUSE-BOOKS metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合专家模型（MoE）中的机器遗忘问题，提出路由感知的专家校准方法TRACE。该方法通过检测遗忘关键专家，并重新加权保留数据损失来对齐路由激活频率，从而改善遗忘与保留的权衡。实验表明，在WMDP和MUSE-BOOKS基准上，TRACE在遗忘质量相当的情况下，相对提升了9%的效用，并在四个MUSE-BOOKS指标中的三个上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法主要针对密集模型，而MoE架构中遗忘数据和保留数据激活的专家集存在不匹配，导致遗忘关键专家在遗忘过程中欠正则化。
Method: 提出TRACE框架，首先基于离线激活统计检测遗忘关键专家，然后通过重新加权token级保留损失来校准每个选定专家的保留侧激活频率，使其与遗忘侧匹配。
Result: 在WMDP和MUSE-BOOKS基准上，TRACE在遗忘质量相当的情况下，相对最强基线提升9%的效用，并在MUSE-BOOKS四个指标中的三个上取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: TRACE有效改善了MoE语言模型的遗忘-效用权衡，且不依赖模型内部修改，适用于多种MoE模型。

papers.title: Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Visual Feedback: Bridging Code and Visual Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Code-generating large language models (LLMs) increasingly produce visual artifacts such as charts, web pages, and slides by writing programs that are executed by non-differentiable renderers, committing to code before observing the render. As a result, otherwise executable code often yields artifacts with visually salient defects, including overlapping elements, clipped text, broken alignment, low contrast, and overflow. We study visual-feedback self-distillation for code-generated visual artifacts. We propose Visual-SDPO, a self-distillation policy-optimization framework that treats rendered visual feedback as privileged context for a weight-sharing teacher and distills this feedback into a coding student. To make supervision spatially targeted rather than uniform, we introduce Visual-Grounded Code Credit Weighting, which traces each detected defect back to the code statements responsible for the affected elements and amplifies the distillation signal on those statements. A sequence-level GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) term complements the dense token-level objective by rewarding executable, visually high-quality rollouts, while failed executions remain learnable through the self-distillation path by passing execution errors as privileged context to the teacher. We instantiate Visual-SDPO for chart, web/UI, and slide generation with a unified Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone. Across chart-to-code, UI-to-code, and slide-generation benchmarks (ChartMimic, Design2Code, and AeSlides), Visual-SDPO improves over the zero-shot base by more than 10 absolute points in the primary metric and over GRPO by at least 2.4 points, with fewer training steps and no added inference-time cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Visual-SDPO，一个利用视觉反馈进行自蒸馏策略优化的框架，用于改进代码生成的视觉产物（如图表、网页、幻灯片）。该方法通过权重共享的教师模型利用渲染视觉反馈作为特权上下文，并引入视觉锚定代码信用加权（Visual-Grounded Code Credit Weighting）将缺陷追溯到相关代码语句，结合序列级 GRPO 项奖励高质量输出。在 ChartMimic、Design2Code 和 AeSlides 基准上，Visual-SDPO 零样本基线提升超过 10 个绝对百分点，比 GRPO 提升至少 2.4 个百分点，且无额外推理成本。
Motivation: 代码生成大语言模型产生的视觉产物常因先编码后渲染而出现元素重叠、剪切、对齐错误、低对比度等缺陷，现有方法缺乏利用视觉反馈进行针对性优化。
Method: 提出 Visual-SDPO 框架，将渲染视觉反馈作为权重共享教师模型的特权上下文，蒸馏给学生编码模型；引入视觉锚定代码信用加权，将检测到的每个缺陷追溯到受影响元素对应的代码语句，放大蒸馏信号；同时使用序列级 GRPO 项奖励可执行且视觉质量高的 rollouts，失败执行通过错误传播到教师路径仍可学习。
Result: 在 ChartMimic、Design2Code 和 AeSlides 基准上，Visual-SDPO 相比零样本基线的首要指标提升超过 10 个绝对百分点，相比 GRPO 提升至少 2.4 个百分点，且训练步骤更少、无额外推理成本。
Conclusion: 视觉反馈自蒸馏能有效桥接代码与视觉产物之间的差距，显著提升生成质量，且不增加推理开销。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Credit Risk Prediction with Alternative Data
papers.abstract_en: Credit risk prediction is a critical problem in the consumer credit industry. Traditionally, financial institutions construct credit risk prediction models using borrowers' demographic, financial, and credit history data, collectively referred to as traditional data. Recent studies have demonstrated that alternative data, such as borrowers' mobile phone communication data, enable lenders to acquire fuller and more accurate profiles of borrowers' creditworthiness, thereby improving credit risk prediction performance. Nevertheless, alternative data are held by external entities independent of financial institutions. Directly sharing alternative data with financial institutions infringe on consumer privacy, yet existing credit risk prediction studies largely overlook this issue. To address this gap, we define a new problem, namely privacy-preserving credit risk prediction with alternative data, which simultaneously considers three practical constraints: the privacy-preserving constraint that protects consumer privacy, the model-confidentiality constraint that learns and stores the model centrally at the financial institution, and the lossless constraint that maintains the performance of the learned model. To solve this problem, we develop PrivacyCredit, a novel privacy-preserving machine learning method. We then theoretically demonstrate the privacy-preserving, model-confidential, and lossless properties of PrivacyCredit. Through extensive experiments using a real-world credit dataset linked with alternative data, we demonstrate the predictive value of securely incorporating alternative data into credit risk prediction and show that PrivacyCredit achieves the same predictive performance as the model learned from the insecure plaintext combination of traditional and alternative data. We further evaluate its model-confidentiality property and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐私保护的信用风险预测问题，利用替代数据（如手机通信数据）而不直接共享原始数据。开发了PrivacyCredit方法，在保护消费者隐私、模型保密性和无损性能的约束下，理论上证明其属性，并实验表明其预测性能与不安全明文组合一致。
Motivation: 现有信用风险预测研究在使用替代数据时忽视隐私问题，直接共享替代数据会侵犯消费者隐私，且同时需满足金融机构的模型保密性和预测性能无损的要求。
Method: 提出PrivacyCredit，一种隐私保护机器学习方法，通过加密或扰动技术实现替代数据的安全集成，并理论证明其满足隐私保护、模型保密和无损性能三个属性。
Result: 在真实信用数据集（与替代数据链接）上，PrivacyCredit达到与不安全明文组合相同的预测性能，并验证了模型保密性和计算效率。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了隐私保护与替代数据信用风险预测结合的研究空白，同时满足实际应用中的隐私、模型保密和性能无损约束。

papers.title: Building Change Detection in Earthquake: A Multi-Scale Interaction Network and A Change Detection Dataset
papers.abstract_en: As one of the most destructive natural disasters, earthquakes have struck many countries around the world in recent years, causing serious economic losses. Change detection (CD) can be applied to post-earthquake damage assessment as it can infer destroyed change regions from multi-temporal remote sensing images. Furthermore, the CD with short imaging interval will better satisfy the needs of the emergency rescues after earthquakes. However, the capability of current methods built on deep neural networks is limited because the dataset with short imaging interval is absent. To meet post-disaster immediate relief, we create a CD dataset, Turkey earthquake CD dataset (TUE-CD), for the evaluation of building damage in the short term after an earthquake. Because of the short acquisition interval of the post-event images, the imaging angle is different for different temporal images, which leads to some side-looking problems. To deal with these challenges, we present a multi-scale feature interaction network (MSI-Net) for efficient interaction between bi-temporal features, as well as mitigating the effect of side-looking problems. Specifically, the proposed MSI-Net consists of joint cross-attention (JCA) modules, multi-scale offset calibration (MOC) modules, and feature integration (FeI) modules. The JCA module unifies channel cross-attention and spatial joint attention for sufficient feature interaction. The MOC module further estimates the offsets to align the bi-temporal image with the multi-scale features. Finally, calibrated features and multi-scale features are fused by FeI modules for the prediction of changed areas. Experiments on the WHU-CD, CLCD, and the constructed TUE-CD dataset indicate that the proposed MSI-Net provides better results than considered state-of-the-art CD methods.

TL;DR: 本文针对地震后短成像间隔的建筑物变化检测任务，构建了土耳其地震变化检测数据集（TUE-CD），并提出多尺度特征交互网络（MSI-Net），包含联合交叉注意力（JCA）、多尺度偏移校准（MOC）和特征集成（FeI）模块，以解决侧视成像角度差异问题。在WHU-CD、CLCD和TUE-CD数据集上，MSI-Net优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法在地震后短成像间隔场景中能力有限，因为缺乏短成像间隔数据集；同时，不同时间图像由于采集间隔短导致成像角度不同，引起侧视问题。
Method: 提出多尺度特征交互网络（MSI-Net），包含联合交叉注意力（JCA）模块实现通道交叉注意力和空间联合注意力，多尺度偏移校准（MOC）模块估计偏移以对齐双时相图像，以及特征集成（FeI）模块融合校准特征和多尺度特征。
Result: 在WHU-CD、CLCD和自建的TUE-CD数据集上，MSI-Net相比现有最先进变化检测方法取得更好结果。
Conclusion: 论文强调所提数据集和网络方法能有效支持地震后短期建筑物损坏评估。

papers.title: Content-Induced Spatial-Spectral Aggregation Network for Change Detection in Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: The integration of spatial and spectral information is beneficial to the improvement of change detection performance. However, existing methods cannot efficiently suppress the influences of spatial and spectral differences in unchanged areas. To address these issues, in this paper we propose a content-guided spatial-spectral integration network (CSI-Net) for the fusion of global spatial details and spectral difference information. Specifically, the proposed CSI-Net is composed of a spatial reasoning (SR) module, a spectral difference (SD) module, and a content-guided integration (CGI) module. In the SR module, the spatial information is learned by cascaded graph convolution blocks for global modeling. The SD module is responsible for the extraction of spectral features, by calculating the means and variances of features to reduce the impact of spectral differences in unchanged regions. In addition, in order to integrate the spatial-spectral features efficiently, we design a CGI module to further take advantage of their complementary information. In this module, high-level content information is introduced as a guide for a proper interaction. Due to the efficient spatial-spectral fusion, the proposed CSI-Net can learn the changed features better while achieving a suppression of spectral differences. Experimental results on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and CLCD datasets demonstrate that the proposed CSI-Net produces better performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and is applicable to different scenarios
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像变化检测中空间与光谱信息融合不足的问题，提出内容引导的空间-光谱聚合网络（CSI-Net）。网络由空间推理模块（级联图卷积）、光谱差异模块（特征均值和方差计算）以及内容引导集成模块组成，利用高层内容信息指导空间-光谱特征交互。在LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD和CLCD三个公开数据集上，该方法取得了优于现有技术的检测性能。
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法无法有效抑制不变区域的空间和光谱差异，导致检测性能受限。
Method: 提出CSI-Net，包含空间推理（SR）模块（通过级联图卷积学习全局空间信息）、光谱差异（SD）模块（计算特征均值和方差以减少不变区域光谱影响）和内容引导集成（CGI）模块（利用高层内容信息引导空间-光谱特征融合）。
Result: 在LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD和CLCD数据集上，CSI-Net的检测性能优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 高效的空间-光谱融合使CSI-Net能更好学习变化特征并抑制光谱差异，适用于不同遥感变化检测场景。

papers.title: The Order Matters: Sequential Fine-Tuning of LLaMA for Coherent Automated Essay Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems must judge interdependent discourse elements (e.g., lead, claim, evidence, conclusion), yet most approaches treat these in isolation, harming coherence and generalization. We investigate task-aware fine-tuning of LLaMA-3.1-8B for AES using parameter-efficient LoRA with 4-bit quantization and compare three training curricula: (i) Sequential (progressively fine-tuning on lead, then position, then claim, then evidence, then conclusion), (ii) Independent (task-specific models), and (iii) Randomized (shuffled multi-task). Experiments on the PERSUADE~2.0 corpus show that modeling task dependencies matters: Sequential fine-tuning yields the strongest overall results, including F1 scores of 65% (evidence) and 87% (conclusion) and corresponding accuracies of 63% and 85%, surpassing Independent training and outperforming a general-purpose LLaMA-70B baseline on conclusion despite its far larger capacity. Randomized training improves position scoring (57% F1) but is less consistent elsewhere. These findings indicate that (1) curriculum design aligned with discourse structure can materially improve AES, and (2) small, task-optimized models can be competitive with substantially larger Large Language Models (LLM), offering a practical path to scalable, cost-effective assessment. We release templates and implementation details to facilitate reproduction and future work on curriculum design for educational NLP.

papers.title: Rank Collapse, Fixed Points, and the Renormalization Group Structure of MLP Residual Networks
papers.abstract_en: The analogy between deep neural network forward passes and renormalization group (RG) flows has been repeatedly noted in the literature, but existing treatments remain qualitative: depth is described as a coarse-graining scale, attention is likened to a partition function, and representations are said to flow toward fixed points. No existing work has defined a measurable RG order parameter, tested it under controlled variation of the input distribution, or made quantitative predictions that are empirically verified. We study the simplest architecture for which the analogy is tractable: a pure MLP residual stack trained on masked token prediction over synthetic Markov chain sequences with known spectral properties. We report three findings. (i) The effective rank of the residual stream decreases monotonically with depth after training, consistent with progressive integration of irrelevant degrees of freedom. (ii) This rank collapse is selective: it occurs for chains with short correlation length approximately 1 but is absent for chains with long correlation length approximately 7, measured at the position level to control for mean-pooling artifacts. The network preserves exactly the degrees of freedom relevant to the prediction task, the content of the RG relevance criterion. (iii) Inter-layer kernel drift is concentrated at one or two specific transitions, with the remainder of the network near a fixed point, consistent with a discrete fixed-point plateau. Together these findings constitute the first quantitative, position-level evidence that MLP residual networks implement a selective coarse-graining procedure governed by the spectral structure of the input distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 MLP 残差网络（MLP Residual Networks）的前向传播与重正化群（renormalization group, RG）流之间的类比，通过训练网络进行合成马尔可夫链序列的掩码 Token 预测，首次提出可测量的 RG 序参量并给出定量实验证据。主要发现包括：(i) 训练后残差流的有效秩随深度单调下降，表明无关自由度逐步整合；(ii) 该秩塌缩（rank collapse）具有选择性：仅出现在短相关长度（约1）的链上，长相关长度（约7）的链上不发生；(iii) 层间核漂移集中在少数特定转换层，其余层接近不动点，呈现离散不动点平台。这些发现是 MLP 残差网络实现基于输入分布谱结构的选择性粗粒化过程的第一个定量位置级证据。
Motivation: 现有文献将深度神经网络前向传播类比为重正化群流，但缺乏量化 RG 序参量、控制输入分布变化的实验验证，也未能做出可检验的定量预测。
Method: 在纯 MLP 残差堆叠架构上，训练网络对具有已知谱性质的合成马尔可夫链序列进行掩码 Token 预测，通过计算残差流有效秩随深度的变化、以及层间核漂移来刻画 RG 行为。
Result: 训练后残差流有效秩随深度单调下降（秩塌缩），且该现象仅出现在短相关长度链上；层间核漂移集中在一两个特定转换层，其余层处于不动点附近。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果为 MLP 残差网络实现基于输入分布谱结构的选择性粗粒化过程提供了首个定量位置级证据。
