papers.title: Baseline-Free Policy Optimization for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) trains autoregressive policies to solve routing problems. The standard training algorithm, REINFORCE with a rollout baseline, requires maintaining and periodically updating a frozen copy of the policy for variance reduction. This baseline introduces a structural vulnerability: on harder instances, a poor baseline produces noisy gradient estimates that can destabilize training. We evaluate Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an algorithm from large language model alignment that eliminates the baseline entirely by normalizing advantages within groups of sampled trajectories. In a controlled comparison of five RL algorithms on TSP and CVRP benchmarks within the RL4CO framework, we find that: (i) GRPO avoids the training collapse observed with REINFORCE on TSP-100, where performance degrades from cost 9.8 to 52.1 immediately after the warmup phase and does not recover under extended training; (ii) at matched gradient updates, GRPO achieves solution quality within 2% of POMO, a strong AM-based multi-start baseline, while requiring no external baseline; and (iii) P3O, a pairwise preference algorithm also from the alignment literature, is competitive on TSP but shows higher variability on CVRP. These results identify GRPO as a promising baseline-free alternative for NCO, particularly in settings where baseline-dependent training becomes fragile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了来自大语言模型对齐领域的GRPO算法在神经组合优化（NCO）中的表现。GRPO通过组内归一化优势替代了REINFORCE的rollout基线，避免基线依赖导致的训练不稳定。在TSP和CVRP基准上的实验表明，GRPO避免了REINFORCE在TSP-100上的训练崩溃（cost从9.8跃升至52.1），且性能与多起点基线POMO相差在2%以内。
Motivation: 标准REINFORCE算法依赖rollout基线进行方差缩减，但在困难实例上基线质量差会导致梯度估计噪声大，进而引发训练崩溃。
Method: 采用组相对策略优化（GRPO），通过组内轨迹的归一化优势完全消除外部基线，并与REINFORCE、POMO、P3O等算法在RL4CO框架下进行受控比较。
Result: 在TSP-100上，REINFORCE在预热后性能从cost 9.8恶化至52.1且无法恢复；GRPO无此类崩溃，且解质量在POMO的2%以内。P3O在TSP上有竞争力，但在CVRP上变异性更高。
Conclusion: GRPO被识别为NCO中一种有前景的无基线替代方案，尤其适用于基线依赖训练脆弱的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Catching One in Five: LLM-as-Judge Blind Spots in Production Multi-Turn Transaction Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge is the default instrument for evaluating conversational agents, yet its reliability is almost always reported as agreement with human ratings, not recall of real defects. We study a deployed multi-turn food-and-beverage ordering agent and measure how many genuine quality problems its built-in LLM judge catches, using exhaustive human transcript review as ground truth. Across three batches the judge surfaces well under a quarter of human-confirmed systematic problems -- 2 of 9 patterns (22%) in one batch, and its operational gate flagged zero of 100 rounds in a batch where humans confirmed 23 distinct defects and 7 new cross-cutting patterns. Our blind-spot taxonomy shows the failure is structured, not random: the judge catches turn-local issues (a fabricated statistic, a wrong language) but misses cross-turn state issues (confirm-gate lockout, cart hallucination, escalation lockout, stale referents). The mechanism: the scoring rubric exposes only three coarse axes (intent, brand-voice, personalization) and has no category for the behavioural dimensions -- state-tracking, guardrails, recovery -- where most defects cluster. The failure is routing, not perception: 113 of 114 rounds whose raw judge note describes a confirm-gate or cart-state defect are scored "brand voice", and none reach an operational failure -- the gate is wired to hangs and hard assertions, not the rubric -- so the 0% is a routing-and-wiring failure, not blindness. The consequence for prevalence estimation is sharp: when the apparent defect rate is zero the Rogan-Gladen correction degenerates -- no signal can recover the true rate -- while where the gate reports a nonzero rate the same estimator implies a 3-6x undercount under our measured sensitivity. For production multi-turn agents, automated judging is a regression floor, not a substitute for human review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生产环境中部署的多轮食品饮料订购代理中，内置 LLM 裁判（LLM-as-judge）的实际缺陷召回率，以详尽人工审查为基准。结果表明裁判仅捕获不到四分之一的人类确认系统性问题（一个批次中 9 个模式仅发现 2 个，召回率 22%），另一个批次中操作门控标记了 0 个缺陷而人类确认了 23 个。盲点分类显示失败是结构化的：裁判擅长捕获轮次局部问题（如虚构统计、错误语言），但遗漏跨轮状态问题（确认门锁死、购物车幻觉、升级锁死、过时引用）。根本原因是评分标准仅包含意图、品牌语气、个性化三个粗粒度轴，缺乏状态跟踪、护栏、恢复等行为维度；且失败在于路由而非感知——113/114 轮裁判原始笔记描述了确认门或购物车状态缺陷，却被评分为“品牌语气”，且门控仅挂钩崩溃和硬断言而非评分标准。结论是自动评判仅能作为回归基线，不能替代人工审查。
Motivation: LLM-as-judge 的可靠性通常仅通过与人评分的一致性来报告，而非对真实缺陷的召回率；本文旨在评估实际部署中 LLM 裁判发现系统性问题（而非仅一致同意）的能力。
Method: 以详尽人工转录审查为 ground truth，对生产环境中的多轮食品饮料订购代理进行三批次评估，测量内置 LLM 裁判捕获的缺陷比例，并构建盲点分类法分析失败模式。
Result: 裁判仅捕获 22% 的人类确认系统性问题模式（2/9）；另一个批次中操作门控标记 0 个缺陷，而人类确认 23 个不同缺陷和 7 个新跨轮模式。113/114 轮裁判原始笔记描述确认门或购物车缺陷却被评为“品牌语气”，未触发门控，导致零召回。
Conclusion: 对于生产环境中的多轮对话代理，自动评判（LLM-as-judge）仅是一个回归地板，不能替代人工审查；即使表面缺陷率为零，实际缺陷可能被显著低估（Rogan-Gladen 校正退化）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mobility Anomaly Generation using LLM-Driven Behavior with Kinematic Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Although the study of human trajectory anomalies is critical for advancing spatial data mining, empirical research remains severely hindered by a pervasive lack of ground-truth datasets. Despite the availability of several real-world and simulated human trajectory collections, these datasets exclusively capture normal mobility patterns and lack annotated anomalies. This specific scarcity is fundamentally driven by the inherent statistical rarity of anomalous events, precluding the feasibility of conventional observational methods. Compounding this challenge, the systematic acquisition of large-scale mobility data is strictly bottlenecked by prohibitive costs and stringent privacy regulations. To overcome these fundamental limitations and establish a reliable human trajectory anomalies dataset with annotated ground truth, we introduce a novel, end-to-end generative framework designed to synthesize realistic trajectory anomalies at scale. Our architecture bridges the gap between purely synthetic mobility data and complex real-world physical constraints by operating directly on baseline simulated trajectories. We employ Large Language Model (LLM) agents to systematically inject semantically meaningful behavioral anomalies such as irregular out-of-distribution check-ins and skipped routine visits. To ensure rigorous spatial validity, the system leverages map-constrained routing reconstruction to recalculate the physical transitions between these LLM agent-modified staypoints. Moreover, to narrow the simulation-to-reality gap, we augment the resulting trajectories with a context-aware spatial noise model, parameterized by environmental and location-specific variables, to accurately emulate heterogeneous GPS sensor degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人类轨迹异常数据集缺乏的问题，提出一个端到端的生成框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）代理在模拟轨迹中注入语义行为异常（如异常签到、跳过常规活动），并通过地图约束路径重建和上下文感知噪声模型生成逼真的轨迹异常数据。
Motivation: 现有轨迹数据集只包含正常模式，缺乏带标注的异常数据，而异常事件在统计上稀有且采集成本高、隐私受限，阻碍了空间数据挖掘研究。
Method: 框架在基线模拟轨迹上使用LLM代理注入行为异常，然后通过地图约束路由重建物理转移，并添加环境参数化的空间噪声模型以模拟GPS传感器退化。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称能生成大规模、逼真且带标注的轨迹异常数据集。

papers.title: Dissect and Prune: Enhancing Robustness in AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: While existing AI-generated image detectors report high performance, we identify that this is largely driven by a critical prediction asymmetry: a bias toward the real class that severely limits sensitivity to generated content, especially under standard post-processing operations such as compression and resizing. We hypothesize that this stems from the model's reliance on spurious features, distracting signals that obscure true generative artifacts. To address this, we propose DEAR (Dissect and Prune), which leverages inpainted images to identify and prune these interfering components. Specifically, we find that features strongly aligned to either inpainted or non-inpainted regions are less robust to post-processing. By measuring the alignment between channel activations and inpaint masks, DEAR removes features at both extremes, retaining only those that capture genuine generative artifacts. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances robustness against unseen generators and post-processing, effectively mitigating the prediction asymmetry. Our code is available at https://github.com/dahyedahye/dear.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables, Accepted to ICML 2026; includes appendix

TL;DR: 本文针对现有AI生成图像检测器存在的预测不对称性（对真实类别的偏见导致对生成内容的敏感性降低）问题，提出DEAR（Dissect and Prune）方法。该方法利用修补图像（inpainted images）识别并剪除与生成伪影无关的干扰特征，通过衡量通道激活与修补掩码的对齐程度，移除极端对齐的特征，仅保留捕捉真实生成伪影的特征。实验表明，该方法显著增强了模型对未见生成器和后处理的鲁棒性，有效缓解了预测不对称性。

papers.title: What Spatial Memory Must Store: Occlusion as the Test for Language-Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Language-agent "memory palace" systems anchor each memory to a world coordinate, on the intuition that geometry adds something text cannot. We make that intuition testable and report three results. First, the memory-palace default of folding spatial proximity into a linear blend beside recency and importance does not help and can hurt: in a pre-registered recall experiment the shipped blend fails its own frozen test (mean Delta-Hit@5 -0.0375, Wilcoxon p=0.306), sitting at a position-blind baseline, while a geometry-led weighting wins decisively (+0.3208, p<10^-15): geometry must lead recall when the query regime is spatial. Second, memory recall and visibility must be separated: recall is occlusion-blind by design (you correctly remember the next room behind a wall), while visibility is a perception predicate over stored geometry that the live system never computed. A one-line ray-versus-voxel digital differential analyzer (DDA), re-pointed from the gaze ray the agent already casts, supplies it: text and the live FoV cone both score 0.000 on 849 behind-wall targets while cone-plus-DDA reaches 0.982 (exact McNemar p<10^-6); coordinate recall separately resolves near-duplicate locations a cosine null cannot (1.000 vs 0.533, n=150). Third, the visibility predicate is confirmed live under a git-committed pre-registration (SPMEM-OCC-LIVE-v1: eight scripted worlds, automated oracle scoring, 96 behind-wall targets, false-visible 1.000->0.000, pooled exact McNemar p=2.5x10^-29), a run that surfaced and fixed a real relay anchor defect. We concede that occlusion-needs-geometry is near-tautological; the contribution is the measurement and isolation, separating what spatial memory must store from how it is read. These pilots power a frozen confirmatory study (SPMEM-ZERO-REAL-PREREG-v1); the full human-authored multi-world study with blind raters remains future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言代理记忆系统中空间记忆的存储和读取问题。通过预注册的召回实验，发现几何引导的权重策略显著优于位置无关的基线（Delta-Hit@5 +0.3208）。进一步提出将记忆召回与可见性分离，利用射线-体素数字微分分析器（DDA）提供可见性谓词，在遮挡目标上准确率达0.982。实时预注册实验（SPMEM-OCC-LIVE-v1）确认了可见性谓词的有效性，并发现并修复了中继锚点缺陷。
Motivation: 现有语言代理记忆宫殿系统将记忆锚定于世界坐标，但默认的线性混合权重（融合空间邻近性、时效性和重要性）未经严格测试，且可见性作为感知谓词未被显式建模。
Method: 通过预注册的召回实验，比较位置无关基线、默认线性混合和几何引导权重；引入射线-体素DDA从代理的视线射线计算可见性谓词，并在实时环境中进行预注册验证。
Result: 几何引导权重在Hit@5上优于位置无关基线0.3208（p<10^-15），默认混合无效（-0.0375, p=0.306）。可见性谓词在849个遮挡目标上准确率达0.982（对比纯文本和视锥均为0.000），实时实验将假可见率从1.000降至0.000（p=2.5e-29）。
Conclusion: 贡献在于定量测量并分离空间记忆的存储（几何坐标）与读取（可见性计算），表明几何信息必须主导空间召回，且可见性是独立于记忆的感知谓词。完整的人类多世界盲评研究尚待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Context-Aware to Conflict-Aware: Generalizing Contrastive Decoding for Knowledge Conflict in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: When large language models generate from retrieved or augmented contexts, conflicts between external context and parametric priors remain a central reliability bottleneck. Existing contrastive decoding methods follow a \emph{context-aware} paradigm that unilaterally amplifies context over parametric priors, overwriting correct priors when the context is erroneous. We generalize this to the \textbf{conflict-aware} paradigm that dynamically allocates authority between prior and context based on conflict signals, rather than presupposing context trustworthiness. We show that the affine combination of prior and context logits yields a \textbf{power family} with an inherent \textbf{regime asymmetry}: extrapolation amplifies errors unboundedly when the prior is correct, interpolation under-corrects when the context is correct, and no static regime covers both. Existing contrastive decoding methods are instances of this family, mostly extrapolative. To evaluate both conflict directions, we propose TriState-Bench, a model-aware evaluation protocol that calibrates per-model prior knowledge to measure three conflict states: correction, resistance, and agreement. To resolve the asymmetry, we propose Adaptive Regime Routing (ARR), which routes between regimes at each step, lifting resistance EM from below 6 to 16--33 without sacrificing correction or agreement. Our code is available at https://github.com/keith-Jiang/conflict-aware-decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将对比解码从上下文感知(context-aware)推广到冲突感知(conflict-aware)范式，通过动态分配外部上下文与参数先验的权重来解决LLM生成中的知识冲突问题。作者揭示了先验与上下文logits仿射组合形成的幂族(power family)中存在固有不对称性，并提出自适应路由方法ARR来平衡不同冲突状态。
Motivation: 现有对比解码方法假设上下文可信，单向放大上下文而忽略参数先验，在上下文错误时会覆盖正确先验，导致可靠性问题。
Method: 将对比解码推广为冲突感知范式，提出自适应区间路由(Adaptive Regime Routing, ARR)，在每一步根据冲突信号动态在插值和外推区间之间切换，而非预设上下文可信。
Result: 在提出的TriState-Bench评估协议上，ARR将抵抗性(resistance)的精确匹配(EM)从不到6提升到16-33，同时不牺牲修正(correction)或一致(agreement)性能。
Conclusion: 冲突感知范式相比上下文感知范式能更鲁棒地处理外部知识与参数先验之间的冲突，ARR通过动态路由解决了单一区间无法同时覆盖两种冲突方向的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Confident Liar: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Debate with Log-Probabilities and LLM-as-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate systems are typically evaluated only on whether the final answer is correct, overlooking the quality of the intermediate reasoning that debate is designed to produce. This paper studies the relationship between three signals in multi-agent debate: token-level log-probability distributions over reasoning tokens, LLM-as-judge rubric scores assigned to those tokens, and final task accuracy. We examine whether internal confidence signals predict externally evaluated reasoning quality, and whether either signal aligns with task correctness, across three domains: rubric-based scoring, mathematical reasoning, and factual question answering. Our framework pairs a two-agent debate architecture -- a Constructor and an Auditor -- with an LLM-as-judge that scores each agent's reasoning along instruction following, justification quality, and evidence grounding, together with a critical-failure flag. Experiments in the rubric-scoring domain reveal a consistent four-phase confidence trajectory and a substantial role asymmetry: confidence aligns with judged reasoning quality roughly twice as strongly for the Constructor as for the Auditor, and confidence-based detection of critical reasoning failures is markedly more reliable for the Constructor (AUROC 0.804) than for the Auditor (0.634). These findings motivate the broader cross-domain investigation proposed in this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体辩论系统中推理质量的评估，提出结合 token 级对数概率分布、LLM-as-judge 评分和最终任务准确率的诊断框架。实验发现，Constructor 智能体的信心与推理质量的一致性约为 Auditor 的两倍，且信心检测推理失败在 Constructor 上更可靠（AUROC 0.804 vs 0.634）。
Motivation: 现有多智能体辩论系统仅以最终答案正确性评估，忽视了中间推理质量，而推理质量正是辩论设计的目标。
Method: 采用两智能体辩论架构（Constructor 和 Auditor），结合 LLM-as-judge 对每个智能体的推理按指令遵循、理由质量和证据基础评分，并记录 token 级对数概率作为内部信心信号。
Result: 在规则评分领域发现一致的四阶段信心轨迹和显著角色不对称：Constructor 的信心与推理质量一致性约是 Auditor 的两倍，信心检测推理失败的 AUROC 在 Constructor 上为 0.804，Auditor 上为 0.634。
Conclusion: 研究结果提示，内部信心信号与外部推理质量评估之间存在关联，但角色不对称性需在跨领域调查中进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $k$-Nearest Neighbors in Gromov--Wasserstein Space
papers.abstract_en: The Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) distance provides a framework for comparing metric measure spaces, regardless of their underlying structure or geometry. For network-based data, it enables direct comparisons of graphs with different numbers of nodes, without requiring an embedding or other abstraction. Furthermore, through a variant of GW known as fused Gromov--Wasserstein (fGW), it is also possible to incorporate node features in addition to graph structure. In this work, we implement $k$-nearest neighbors ($k$-NN) classification using the GW and fGW distances. We prove the universal consistency of the GW-$k$-NN classifier on the space of equivalence classes of metric measure spaces with finite support and uniform probability measure. By viewing graphs as finitely supported metric measure spaces equipped with the pairwise distance metric and a uniform probability measure on the nodes, we obtain universal consistency of GW-$k$-NN for the space of graphs. Likewise for fGW-$k$-NN, we prove universal consistency on the space of weak isomorphism classes of structured objects consisting of metric measure spaces with finite support and uniform probability measure and feature maps into Euclidean space, thus establishing universal consistency on the space of node-attributed graphs. Our numerical experiments show that GW-$k$-NN and fGW-$k$-NN consistently perform well across multiple graph datasets, suggesting that metric classifiers such as $k$-NN work well in the GW framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 和融合Gromov-Wasserstein (fGW) 距离框架下实现k-最近邻分类，证明了GW-k-NN和fGW-k-NN在有限支撑度量测度空间（包括图空间）上的通用一致性，并在多个图数据集上验证了分类性能。
Motivation: GW距离可直接比较不同节点数量的图，无需嵌入，但缺乏基于GW距离的k-NN分类器的理论保证。本文旨在填补这一空白，并扩展至带节点特征的图。
Method: 将图视为具有均匀概率测度的有限支撑度量测度空间，定义GW-k-NN和fGW-k-NN分类器，并证明其通用一致性（基于弱同构类空间和带特征映射的结构化对象空间）。
Result: 理论证明了GW-k-NN和fGW-k-NN分类器的通用一致性；数值实验表明，这些分类器在多个图数据集上表现良好。
Conclusion: 基于GW距离的度量分类器（如k-NN）在图分类中有效且具有理论保证，适用于不同节点数的图以及带节点特征的图。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Neural Architecture Search for Robust Co-Design of Physical Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deploying neural networks on unconventional hardware demands architectures that co-optimize task accuracy and platform-specific constraints such as energy cost, physical non-idealities, and numerical precision. Existing neural architecture search (NAS) methods are typically tailored to a single hardware family, limiting cross-platform comparison and generalization. We introduce Unconventional Hardware Neural Architecture Search (UH-NAS), a hardware-agnostic, LLM-guided NAS framework that integrates language models as evolutionary operators to co-optimize accuracy and inference energy. By exposing hardware as a swappable backend with per-platform energy models, physical constraints, and non-ideality simulators, UH-NAS enables fair system-level comparisons across various backends without modifying the search algorithm. Tested on optical MZI hardware, UH-NAS discovers more diverse, robust architectures than conventional baselines while outperforming existing LLM-to-NAS approaches. Additional ablations on architecture robustness under non-idealities and the role of system prompts highlight the importance of architecture-hardware co-design for emerging computing platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UH-NAS，一种硬件无关、LLM引导的神经架构搜索框架，用于物理神经网络（如光学MZI硬件）的鲁棒协同设计。该框架将硬件作为可交换后端，集成能耗模型、物理约束和非理想性模拟器，无需修改搜索算法即可实现跨平台公平比较。实验表明，UH-NAS能发现比传统基线更多样且鲁棒的架构，并优于现有LLM-to-NAS方法。
Motivation: 现有NAS方法通常针对单一硬件家族设计，限制了跨平台比较和泛化能力，难以协同优化任务精度和特定平台约束（如能耗、物理非理想性、数值精度）。
Method: 提出UH-NAS，一个硬件无关的NAS框架，使用LLM作为进化算子，将硬件暴露为可交换后端（含每平台能耗模型、物理约束和非理想性模拟器），实现系统级公平比较。
Result: 在光学MZI硬件上测试，UH-NAS发现的架构比传统基线更多样且鲁棒，并优于现有LLM-to-NAS方法；消融实验表明架构-硬件协同设计对新兴计算平台的重要性。
Conclusion: 架构与硬件的协同设计对于在非常规硬件上部署神经网络至关重要，UH-NAS提供了一个可推广的框架。

papers.title: When Metrics Disagree: A Meta-Analysis of Knowledge-Graph-Completion Model Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) models remains challenging because standard assessment relies on isolated rank-based metrics such as MRR, Hits$@$k, and Mean Rank, which often produce conflicting model orderings across datasets. A model that leads on MRR may trail on Hits@1, and strong performance on one dataset may not generalize to another. This fragmentation hinders comparison, enables selective reporting, and obscures real progress. We reframe KGC evaluation as a Multi-Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) problem and present a meta-analysis of seven aggregators across five tests: consistency, cross-dataset stability, metric independence, robustness under noise, and generalizability. Each test is averaged over leave-one-model-out (LOMO) and leave-one-group-out (LOGO) removals so that reliability reflects aggregator behavior across diverse model subsets. Across tail $(h,r,?)$ and relation $(h,?,t)$ prediction, Pareto-optimal analysis identifies Z-score as the most balanced aggregator, which ranks DualE highest for tail prediction and FMS (Flow-Modulated Scoring) highest for relation prediction. A test-sensitivity analysis using the same removals shows that consistency and stability are largely removal-invariant, while generalizability and independence are the most sensitive. The framework resolves evaluation inconsistencies and offers evidence-based guidance for aggregator selection and model benchmarking in KGC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识图谱补全（KGC）模型评估中不同排名指标（如MRR、Hits@k、Mean Rank）产生不一致模型排序的问题，将其重新定义为多准则决策（MCDM）问题，并对七种聚合器进行了元分析。通过一致性、跨数据集稳定性、指标独立性、噪声鲁棒性和泛化性五项测试，结合留一模型（LOMO）和留一组（LOGO）移除，发现Z-score是最平衡的聚合器，对尾预测和关系预测分别推荐DualE和FMS模型。该框架解决了评估不一致性，为KGC中的聚合器选择和模型基准测试提供了基于证据的指导。
Motivation: 标准KGC评估依赖孤立的排名指标，这些指标常产生冲突的模型排序，且跨数据集表现不一致，阻碍了公平比较和真实进展的识别。
Method: 将KGC评估视作MCDM问题，对七种聚合器（如Z-score、TOPSIS等）进行五项测试的元分析，并使用LOMO和LOGO移除来评估聚合器的可靠性。
Result: Pareto最优分析表明Z-score是最平衡的聚合器；尾预测中DualE排名最高，关系预测中FMS排名最高。一致性和稳定性对移除不敏感，而泛化性和独立性最敏感。
Conclusion: 该框架解决了KGC评估中的不一致性，为聚合器选择和模型基准测试提供了基于证据的建议，但需注意其适用范围仅限于所分析的聚合器和测试。

papers.title: Sim2Schedule: A Simulator-Guided LLM Framework for Autonomous Open-Pit Mine Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Open-pit mine scheduling is a critical process for maximizing economic return under complex geotechnical and operational constraints. While Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) provides mathematically optimal baselines, its exponential computational complexity and inability to adapt in real time limit its practical deployment in dynamic industrial environments. This work introduces a simulator-driven Large Language Model (LLM) scheduling framework in which the LLM acts as an autonomous decision-making agent, guided at each step by a custom simulator that encodes geotechnical precedence, extraction-processing coupling, and dynamic capacity constraints directly into the action generation mechanism. Operating entirely zero-shot within a closed, data-secure environment, the framework produces complete, interpretable extraction and processing schedules without cloud-based inference, domain-specific fine-tuning, or retraining. To provide a trustworthy performance benchmark, a novel MILP formulation is developed that incorporates realistic operational and geotechnical constraints. Evaluated across mining instances of varying scale and time periods, the LLM-based framework recovers between 94\% and 99\% of the MILP optimal NPV while scaling linearly in computation time. These results position simulator-constrained LLM agents as a practical and scalable alternative to classical optimization for long-horizon industrial scheduling under complex operational constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模拟器引导的大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于露天矿调度。LLM作为自主决策代理，由自定义模拟器编码地质优先级、采掘-加工耦合和动态容量约束，以零样本方式生成可解释的采掘和加工计划。使用改进的MILP公式作为基准，LLM框架恢复了MILP最优NPV的94%-99%，且计算时间线性增长。
Motivation: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）虽能提供数学最优解，但指数级计算复杂度和无法实时更新限制了其在动态工业环境中的实际部署。需要一种可扩展、实时且无需云端推理的调度方法。
Method: 开发一个模拟器驱动的LLM调度框架：LLM作为自主决策代理，每一步由定制模拟器指导，该模拟器将地质优先关系、采掘-加工耦合和动态容量约束直接编码到动作生成机制中。框架在封闭、数据安全的环境中零样本运行，无需云端推理、领域微调或重新训练。同时设计了一个包含现实操作和地质约束的新型MILP公式作为性能基准。
Result: 在多种规模和时间段的采矿实例上，基于LLM的框架恢复了MILP最优NPV的94%-99%，且计算时间线性增长。
Conclusion: 模拟器约束的LLM代理可作为复杂操作约束下长期工业调度的实用且可扩展的替代方案，无需云计算或微调。

papers.title: Revisiting Positive Samples in Graph Contrastive Learning: From the Perspective of Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL), which trains graph encoders by maximizing similarity between positive samples and minimizing it between negative ones, has emerged as a mainstream graph pre-training paradigm. It is widely recognized that positive samples are essential in GCLs. Ideally, maximizing the similarity of positive samples enables graph encoders to capture intrinsic semantic and patterns of graph data. However, we discover an interesting phenomenon: GCLs can achieve competitive performance even without positive samples. This motivates us to revisit the fundamental mechanism of positive samples in GCLs. From the perspective of Dirichlet energy, we theoretically finds that message passing, a key mechanism in graph encoders, trivializes the maximization of positive samples, preventing GCLs from effectively learning from positive samples. To address this, we propose SPGCL to mitigate the trivialization caused by message passing and restore the learning efficacy of positive samples. Specifically, we find that high Dirichlet energy features help positive samples provide effective learning signals while low Dirichlet energy features contribute little to positive learning signal but is useful for positive sampling. Based on this, SPGCL propagates only high Dirichlet energy features and uses low energy features to construct a probability matrix for reliable positive sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of SPGCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视图对比学习（GCL）中正样本的作用，发现即使没有正样本也能取得竞争性能。从Dirichlet能量角度理论解释，消息传递机制会削弱正样本最大化效果。提出SPGCL，通过分别处理高能量和低能量特征恢复正样本的学习信号，实验验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有GCL普遍认为正样本至关重要，但作者发现无正样本也能竞争，这促使重新审视正样本的根本机制。
Method: 从Dirichlet能量角度理论分析发现消息传递导致正样本最大化被平凡化；提出SPGCL：仅传播高Dirichlet能量特征用于学习信号，低能量特征用于构建概率矩阵进行可靠正采样。
Result: 大量实验证明SPGCL的有效性（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 揭示了消息传递对正样本学习的抑制作用，并提出了恢复正样本学习信号的方法。

papers.title: Overlapped Wavelet Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we propose an overlapped wavelet diffusion framework for Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE), which incorporates two complementary components to achieve blocking artifact-free and detail-preserving enhancement. Although recent diffusion-based LLIE methods have demonstrated remarkable performance compared with traditional approaches, DiffLL still suffers from blocking artifacts caused by the Haar Wavelet Transform (WT) and blurred edges or over-smoothed textures due to the limitations of its High-Frequency Restoration Module (HFRM). To overcome these issues, we introduce an Overlapped WT (OWT) that incorporates correlations across neighboring regions, thereby structurally preventing blocking artifacts. Furthermore, we integrate a low-frequency-guided High-Frequency Enhance Block (HFEBlock) to strengthen detail recovery, yielding sharper edges and more reliable textures. Extensive experiments on the LOLv1 and LOLv2-real datasets demonstrate that our framework, termed OWDiff, consistently outperforms existing LLIE methods both qualitatively and quantitatively, achieving superior visual quality while maintaining computational efficiency. OWDiff effectively addresses the structural limitations of the Haar WT and the HFRM, achieving an average PSNR gain of 0.58 dB, along with a 1.64% relative improvement in SSIM and a 5.9% relative reduction in LPIPS, compared to DiffLL across both the LOLv1 and LOLv2-real datasets.

TL;DR: 本文提出重叠小波扩散框架（OWDiff）用于低光图像增强，通过重叠小波变换（OWT）消除传统Haar小波变换导致的块效应，并引入低频引导的高频增强块（HFEBlock）改善细节恢复。在LOLv1和LOLv2-real数据集上，相比DiffLL平均PSNR提升0.58 dB，SSIM相对提升1.64%，LPIPS相对降低5.9%。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法DiffLL因Haar小波变换产生块伪影，且高频恢复模块（HFRM）导致边缘模糊或纹理过度平滑，需要结构性的改进。
Method: 提出重叠小波变换（OWT）以引入相邻区域相关性消除块伪影，并设计低频引导的高频增强块（HFEBlock）强化细节恢复。
Result: 在LOLv1和LOLv2-real数据集上，OWDiff相比DiffLL平均PSNR提高0.58 dB，SSIM相对提升1.64%，LPIPS相对降低5.9%。
Conclusion: OWDiff有效解决了Haar WT和HFRM的结构局限，在低光图像增强任务中取得更优的视觉质量和计算效率。

papers.title: Supervised Fine-tuning with Synthetic Rationale Data Hurts Real-World Disease Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning with synthetic rationale data is widely assumed to improve language model performance on clinical prediction tasks by teaching models not just what to predict but why. We test this assumption on five-year Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) prediction from longitudinal health histories. Across a large-scale controlled experiment of 504 configurations, we find that rationale-based SFT consistently and substantially hurts prediction performance relative to label-only fine-tuning. The degradation persists across model families and data scales, and is not resolved by using a reasoning-oriented base model. Crucially, the failure is not explained by poor rationale quality: human expert annotation confirms that the generated rationales are medically accurate and faithfully grounded in patient-specific evidence, and few-shot experiments show that the same rationales improve performance when used as inference-time demonstrations rather than training targets. We identify the root cause as a structural conflict between narrative plausibility and discriminative optimization. We hope our work paves the path toward a more precise understanding of when and how rationale-based supervision helps and when it does not, guiding the responsible development of language models for high-stakes clinical prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在临床预测任务中使用合成理由数据进行监督微调的效果。发现尽管生成的理由在医学上准确，但基于理由的微调总是损害预测性能，根源在于叙事合理性与判别优化之间的结构冲突。
Motivation: 普遍假设使用合成理由数据进行监督微调能通过教导模型“为什么”预测来提升性能，本文在五年期阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症预测任务上检验该假设。
Method: 在504种配置的大规模受控实验中，比较基于理由的监督微调与仅标签微调的性能。
Result: 基于理由的微调一致且显著地损害预测性能，这种下降在不同模型家族和数据规模下持续存在，且不能被理由质量低劣所解释——专家确认理由在医学上准确且基于患者证据。少量实验显示相同的理由作为推理时演示可提升性能。
Conclusion: 失败的根本原因是叙事合理性与判别优化之间的结构冲突。希望这项工作能引导对理由监督何时有用、何时无用的更精确理解。

papers.title: Towards Robust Arabic Speech Emotion Recognition with Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) aims to identify a speaker's emotional state from audio signals. While recent advances in deep learning have significantly improved SER performance in Indo-European languages, Arabic SER remains underexplored and challenging due to dialectal diversity, limited annotated datasets, and the difficulty of modeling both local spectral cues and long-range temporal dependencies. To address these limitations, this study investigates whether hybrid architectures that jointly model spatial and contextual information can improve emotion recognition in Arabic speech. We propose and evaluate a comparative framework involving three architectures: a CNN-LSTM model, a CNN-Transformer model, and a fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 model. The first two models leverage MFCC and spectrogram-based representations, while wav2vec 2.0 operates directly on raw audio through self-supervised representations. Experiments conducted on the EYASE and BAVED datasets demonstrate that the proposed CNN-Transformer architecture significantly outperforms the other models, achieving an accuracy of 98.1 percent. This result highlights the effectiveness of combining convolutional feature extraction with Transformer-based global context modeling. The main contribution of this work lies in providing a systematic comparison of hybrid and self-supervised approaches for Arabic SER, and in demonstrating that CNN-Transformer architectures offer a robust solution for capturing both spectral and long-range dependencies in low-resource and dialectally diverse settings.

TL;DR: 本文研究阿拉伯语语音情感识别（SER），提出CNN-LSTM、CNN-Transformer和微调wav2vec 2.0三种架构的比较框架。在EYASE和BAVED数据集上，CNN-Transformer架构取得98.1%准确率，优于其他模型，表明混合卷积与Transformer的方法能有效捕获局部谱特征和长程时序依赖。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语SER因方言多样性、标注数据有限及难以同时建模局部谱特征和长程依赖而挑战重重，而针对印欧语系的深度学习方法在阿拉伯语上表现不佳。
Method: 构建三种混合架构的对比框架：CNN-LSTM、CNN-Transformer（基于MFCC和语谱图）以及微调wav2vec 2.0（直接处理原始音频）。
Result: CNN-Transformer在EYASE和BAVED数据集上达到98.1%准确率，显著优于另外两个模型。
Conclusion: CNN-Transformer架构为低资源和方言多样的阿拉伯语SER提供了鲁棒解决方案，同时系统比较了混合与自监督方法的优劣。

papers.title: A Unified Adaptive Feature Composition Framework for Multi-Task Generalization in Wireless Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Though wireless foundation models (WFMs) have shown strong potential in learning universal channel representations, their adaptation to various downstream tasks remains constrained by existing paradigms. Fine-tuning strategies introduces substantial computational and storage overhead, while frozen feature extraction leads to sub-optimal performance across diverse downstream tasks. To address this issue, we propose a unified adaptive feature composition framework for multitask generalization in WFMs, where the key component is the Routing Adapter for Feature Composition (RAFC). Instead of extracting only the final-layer output, this router treats the hidden states from different Transformer depths as a reusable pool of multi-level hidden features, and employs a lightweight task-driven feature composition network to generate layer-wise aggregation weights, then adaptively combine hierarchical representations through weighted summation. This design enables each downstream task to access suitable mixture of low-, mid-, and high-level wireless features without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on four representative wireless tasks demonstrate that RAFC consistently outperforms conventional adaptation baselines while introducing fewer than 50K additional parameters. Moreover, the learned routing weights provide interpretable evidence of task-specific layer preferences, making the proposed framework a low-complexity, scalable, and explainable interface for adapting WFMs to diverse downstream scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无线基础模型（WFM）在下游任务泛化中的局限性，提出统一的自适应特征组合框架，核心组件为路由适配器RAFC。RAFC将不同Transformer层的隐藏状态作为多级特征池，通过轻量任务驱动网络生成逐层聚合权重，自适应组合层次化表示。在四个无线任务上，RAFC以少于50K额外参数一致超越传统微调基线，且路由权重提供可解释的任务偏好证据。
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型微调策略计算与存储开销大，冻结特征提取方法在多下游任务上性能次优。
Method: 提出RAFC路由适配器，将不同Transformer深度的隐藏状态视为可复用多级特征池，通过轻量任务驱动特征组合网络生成逐层聚合权重，加权求和自适应组合层次化表示，不修改预训练骨干网络。
Result: 在四个代表性无线任务上，RAFC一致优于传统适应基线，额外参数少于50K。
Conclusion: RAFC提供了低复杂度、可扩展且可解释的无线基础模型下游适配接口，路由权重揭示了任务特定的层偏好。

papers.title: Hierarchical Policies from Verbal and Egocentric Human Signals for Natural Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: For natural human-robot interaction, a robot must understand human intent expressed not only through language but also through nonverbal signals such as gestures and gaze. However, current robot policies rely on language instructions as the sole interface for conveying intent, leaving nonverbal signals unused and placing the full burden of communication. In this work, we present EDITH, a robot framework that captures the human's nonverbal signals through continuous streams of first-person view and gaze from smart glasses, and uses them alongside language instructions as inputs to the robot policy. Our hardware system streams the human's first-person view, gaze, and speech to the robot in real time, transcribing the speech into language instructions. To handle these rich but noisy signals, we design a hierarchical policy in which a high-level policy infers the human's intent and produces a sequence of subtasks, where each subtask is represented as a fine-grained instruction paired with a keyframe that grounds the intent in the scene (e.g., the frame where the human points at the target object). A low-level policy then executes these subtasks. In our experiments on human-robot interactive tasks, EDITH enables the robot to act on the human's nonverbal signals even when intent is expressed only briefly, and significantly reduces user effort to convey intent compared to using language instructions alone. Visit our project page for source code and real-robot demo videos.
papers.comment: We provide video demos and code in: https://project-edith.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EDITH框架，通过智能眼镜捕捉人类第一人称视角、注视和语音，结合语言指令作为机器人策略输入。设计层次化策略，高层推断意图并生成子任务（细粒度指令+关键帧），低层执行子任务。实验表明，即使意图仅短暂表达，机器人也能响应非语言信号，显著减少用户传达意图的努力。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略仅依赖语言指令传达意图，忽视了手势、注视等非语言信号，增加了用户沟通负担。
Method: 提出EDITH框架，硬件系统实时传输人类第一人称视图、注视和语音，语音转文字。设计层次化策略：高层从视觉、注视和语言中推断意图，生成子任务序列（细粒度指令+关键帧）；低层执行子任务。
Result: 在人机交互任务实验中，EDITH使机器人能够理解短暂表达的非语言信号，并显著减少了用户传达意图的努力。
Conclusion: 通过整合非语言信号与语言指令，层次化策略有效提升了自然人机交互效率。

papers.title: FoA-SR: Faithful or Aesthetic? Profile-Aware Preference Optimization for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image super-resolution (SR) is often designed with a single restoration objective, despite the current capacity of generative models to produce multiple high-quality reconstructions for the same input. In this paper, we argue that the best restoration strategy is subject to the specific restoration profile: a Faithful restoration prioritizes reference consistency, structure preservation, and hallucination suppression, whereas an Aesthetic restoration prioritizes visually pleasing and natural-looking details. We propose FoA-SR, a novel preference optimization approach to real-world SR based on profiles. To achieve this goal, FoA-SR starts with our supervised FLUX.2-based SR adapter (Flux2SR) trained with LR latent conditioning, flow matching, and image-space reconstruction losses for paired LR-to-HR image super-resolution. Following the development of the shared supervised super-resolution adapter, FoA-SR generates a shared stochastic candidate pool for each input image and ranks the same candidates using profile-specific Faithful and Aesthetic rewards to mine winner-loser pairs. These pairs are used to fine-tune separate LoRA adapters while keeping the base model frozen. Experiments on RealSR and DIV2K show that FoA-SR can steer the same SR adapter towards distinct restoration objectives: a Faithful adapter improves reference-consistent metrics while an Aesthetic adapter boosts metrics that measure perceptual quality without reference. Our candidate-pool analysis shows that Faithful and Aesthetic rewards frequently select different winners, and a Hybrid-LoRA ablation shows that collapsing both profiles into one reward yields an implicit compromise rather than explicit profile control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FoA-SR，一种基于偏好的图像超分辨率优化方法，通过分别训练忠实（Faithful）和美学（Aesthetic）两个 LoRA 适配器来满足不同的恢复目标。基于 FLUX.2 的 SR 适配器先进行监督训练，然后利用候选池和偏好奖励对进行微调。实验表明 FoA-SR 能根据偏好调整恢复策略。
Motivation: 现有真实世界图像超分辨率通常只追求单一恢复目标，但不同应用场景对忠实度或美学质量的需求不同，缺乏显式偏好控制。
Method: 首先训练基于 FLUX.2 的监督 SR 适配器（Flux2SR），然后为每个输入生成候选池，使用偏好奖励（忠实或美学）对候选排序，得到胜者-败者对，分别微调两个 LoRA 适配器（基模型冻结）。
Result: 在 RealSR 和 DIVK 数据集上，忠实适配器提升参考一致性指标，美学适配器提升无参考感知质量指标。候选池分析显示两种奖励经常选出不同胜者，混合 LoRA 消融实验表明合并目标会导致隐式妥协。
Conclusion: FoA-SR 通过显式分离忠实和美学偏好，实现了对 SR 恢复策略的灵活控制，避免了单一目标带来的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. Applying these principles yields a substantially stronger system than either flat VLA control or a naively designed hierarchy, across experiments both in simulation and on a real ALOHA robot. Overall, our results provide a foundation for building more capable, robust, and principled hierarchical VLA agents. More information and video at jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对层级视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）系统在机器人操作中的设计进行了系统研究，将代表性方法统一在选项式控制框架下，并在短程、长程和推理密集型任务上基准测试核心设计选择。实验表明，遵循提炼出的实用原则可以构建出比扁平VLA控制或朴素层级设计更强的系统，在仿真和真实ALOHA机器人上均有效。
Motivation: 现有Hi-VLA系统在设计原则上缺乏统一性，不同工作在规划器、控制器、切换机制以及观察和记忆表示等方面存在差异，阻碍了系统的性能提升和泛化能力。
Method: 将典型Hi-VLA系统统一在选项式控制框架下，系统性地对比分析规划器与控制器选择、两者之间的切换机制以及观察和记忆表示等核心设计选择，并在多类任务上评估。
Result: 应用所得原则构建的系统在短程、长程和推理密集型任务上均显著优于扁平VLA控制器或朴素层级设计的系统，在仿真和真实ALOHA机器人实验中得到验证。
Conclusion: 研究提供了构建更强大、更鲁棒且更有原则的层级VLA代理的基础设计原则，对未来机器人操作系统的开发具有指导意义。

papers.title: Explaining Unsupervised Disease Staging in Huntington's Disease: Insights into Model Representations and Clusters
papers.abstract_en: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor, cognitive, and behavioral functions, where accurate characterization of disease progression remains essential to improve patient outcome and quality of life. Unsupervised machine learning (ML) approaches have demonstrated the ability to uncover disease progression trajectories and meaningful latent stages from longitudinal data; however, their limited interpretability restricts clinical trust and translation. We extend a previously proposed ML-based disease staging framework by applying an explainability analysis to the extracted feature representations and discovered disease stages. Applied to the Enroll-HD dataset, we first project the learned representations into a lower-dimensional space to intuitively assess whether the resulting clusters align with the progression of established clinical measures. We then use saliency maps to identify the clinical features that most strongly contribute to the learned embeddings over time. Finally, we train a surrogate classifier and apply SHAP to quantify feature importance for cluster assignments and to analyze which clinical variables drive transitions between disease stages. The explainability analysis indicates that the learned embeddings capture clinically meaningful disease structure, aligning with established motor and functional severity scores and exhibiting progressive deterioration across clusters. Within this analysis, SHAP reveals a stratification of disease stages, ranging from early cognitive-motor impairment to severe functional dependency, consistent with known clinical progression patterns, while also highlighting intra-stage variability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对亨廷顿病（HD）的无监督疾病分期模型进行可解释性分析，通过低维投影、显著性图和SHAP方法揭示模型表示与临床指标的对齐。在Enroll-HD数据集上的实验表明，学习到的嵌入捕捉了从早期认知-运动障碍到重度功能依赖的进展轨迹，且SHAP量化了各临床特征对分期的贡献。
Motivation: 无监督机器学习可发现疾病进展轨迹，但其可解释性不足限制了临床信任和应用；本文旨在通过可解释性分析增强模型透明性，促进向临床转化。
Method: 在已有ML疾病分期框架基础上，应用三种可解释性技术：将学习到的表示投影到低维空间评估聚类与临床测量的一致性；利用显著性图识别随时间变化的贡献特征；训练代理分类器并用SHAP量化特征重要性及阶段转变驱动因素。
Result: 嵌入表示与运动功能严重程度评分等临床指标高度一致，SHAP揭示了从早期认知-运动障碍到重度功能依赖的疾病分期，并捕捉到各阶段内部的变异性。
Conclusion: 可解释性分析表明无监督分期模型能提取临床有意义的疾病结构，增强了模型的可信度，但未讨论方法的局限性或推广性。

papers.title: Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning for Stochastic Constrained Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic constrained decision-making requires optimizing performance objectives while enforcing statistical requirements such as safety or fairness. However, standard primal--dual methods struggle to update multipliers robustly under stochastic mini-batch feedback, as the noise of mini-batch gradients and constraint estimates can be directly accumulated into the multiplier memory. To address this issue, we propose Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning (RCML), which reformulates multiplier updating as projected-pressure feedback. The central idea is to decompose the projected multiplier into an effective pressure signal for primal descent and a pressure-memory residual for finite-gain multiplier tracking. To handle heterogeneous and noisy observations, we further augment this residual-integral backbone with modular stochastic stabilization components. For the convex-affine backbone, we establish finite-gain convergence, derive a stochastic residual bound under mini-batch feedback, and show that the residual feedback law admits a local KKT-residual interpretation near regular KKT points of nonconvex problems. Experiments across optimization, allocation, and fair-ranking tasks show that RCML improves feasibility control and multiplier stability while maintaining competitive objective performance. Code is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RCML-3114/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML），一种用于随机约束决策问题的投影压力反馈框架。该方法将投影乘子分解为有效压力信号和压力记忆残差，并通过模块化随机稳定组件处理异质噪声观测。在凸-仿射骨干下证明有限增益收敛，并在非凸问题的正则KKT点附近展示局部KKT残差解释。实验涵盖优化、分配和公平排序任务，表明RCML在保持竞争力目标性能的同时改善了可行性控制和乘子稳定性。
Motivation: 标准原-对偶方法在随机小批量反馈下难以稳健更新乘子，因为小批量梯度和约束估计的噪声会直接累积到乘子记忆中。需要一种更鲁棒的乘子更新机制。
Method: 提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML），将乘子更新重构为投影压力反馈。核心思想是将投影乘子分解为用于原下降的有效压力信号和用于有限增益乘子追踪的压力记忆残差，并引入模块化随机稳定组件处理异质噪声。
Result: 在凸-仿射骨干下建立了有限增益收敛，推导了小批量反馈下的随机残差界，并表明残差反馈律在非凸问题的正则KKT点附近具有局部KKT残差解释。实验在优化、分配和公平排序任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: RCML通过残差控制改进了可行性控制和乘子稳定性，同时保持竞争性的目标性能。方法的模块化设计允许针对不同应用进行定制。

papers.title: Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining: Improved Regularization and Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Classical scaling laws for language model pretraining balance model size against training dataset size under a fixed compute budget, assuming abundant data and a single pass over the corpus. As training compute grows faster than the supply of natural language data, pretraining is likely to enter a data-constrained, compute-rich regime where models train for multiple epochs over a finite dataset. We study data-constrained pretraining along two axes, regularization and scaling. For regularization, we study masked-input regularization (MIR), an auxiliary next-token prediction loss on randomly masked inputs. MIR tests whether the random masking central to diffusion language models can benefit autoregressive pretraining without architectural changes or inference overhead. Across 72M to 1.4B parameter models, we find that MIR added on top of strong weight decay improves validation loss over autoregressive strong-weight-decay-only models, with downstream gains at 1.4B. For scaling, we propose SoftQ, a scaling law that couples model size and data size to capture their interaction under repeated data. Classical alternatives such as the Chinchilla law use an additive form that decouples these terms, making them misspecified in the data-constrained regime. We find that SoftQ fits data-constrained experiments substantially better than these alternatives, and estimates MIR's gains as equivalent to roughly 1.3 times as much unique training data. We release our code at https://github.com/yixinw-lab/dc_pretrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据受限场景下的语言模型预训练，提出掩码输入正则化（MIR）和SoftQ缩放定律。MIR在1.4B参数模型上改善验证损失并带来下游收益，SoftQ比经典Chinchilla定律更准确拟合重复数据实验，等价于约1.3倍独特数据的效果。
Motivation: 预训练计算增长超过自然语言数据供给，导致多epoch训练成为常态，现有缩放定律和正则化方法在数据受限下不再适用。
Method: 提出MIR（掩码输入正则化），在自回归训练中增加随机掩码输入的辅助下一词预测损失；提出SoftQ缩放定律，耦合模型规模和数据集大小以描述重复数据下的交互。
Result: MIR在72M至1.4B参数模型上优于仅强权重衰减的自回归模型，1.4B模型显示下游任务改进；SoftQ拟合数据受限实验显著优于Chinchilla等加性定律，并量化MIR收益相当于1.3倍独特数据。
Conclusion: 数据受限预训练需要专门设计的正则化和缩放定律，MIR是一种有效且无需架构变更的正则化方法，SoftQ能更准确预测重复数据下的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TorchKM: A GPU-Oriented Library for Kernel Learning and Model Selection
papers.abstract_en: TorchKM is an open-source library for kernel machines, including support vector machines, kernel logistic regression, and kernel quantile regression, with GPU acceleration. The library features a scikit-learn-style API and is designed to exploit GPU-friendly linear algebra, accelerating the full training and model-selection pipeline through intelligent reuse of matrix operations. Benchmarks show competitive predictive performance with substantial speedups over standard baselines. The efficiency and programmable design also make TorchKM a kernel-learning component for AI-driven workflows. Code and documentation are available at https://github.com/YikaiZhang95/torchkm, and the package can be easily installed via PyPI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TorchKM 是一个基于 PyTorch 的开源核机器库，支持支持向量机、核逻辑回归和核分位数回归，并通过 GPU 友好的线性代数运算和智能矩阵复用加速训练与模型选择。基准测试显示其在保持预测性能的同时实现了显著的加速。该库提供 scikit-learn 风格的 API，易于安装和使用。
Motivation: 现有核机器实现通常缺乏高效的 GPU 加速和便捷的 API，难以集成到现代 AI 工作流中。
Method: 设计 GPU 友好的线性代数运算，并通过智能复用矩阵操作来加速整个训练和模型选择流程。
Result: 基准测试表明 TorchKM 在预测性能上与标准基线相当，同时实现了显著的加速。
Conclusion: TorchKM 作为一个易于使用的 GPU 加速核学习库，可嵌入 AI 驱动的数据处理工作流。

papers.title: RECAP: Regression Evaluation for Continual Adaptation of Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Production agentic systems routinely face evolving constraints and must comply from the very next interaction. Scenarios like a tool-call notification changing a compliance threshold or a policy update adding disclosure requirements fit this criteria, having close to no room for errors in production. This proactive adaptation setting is common in deployment, but absent from current benchmarks, which assume either static constraint sets or reactive protocols with evaluation feedback. We introduce RECAP, a benchmark that measures continual-learning phenomena (forgetting, regression, forward transfer) at the constraint level under a strictly proactive adapt-then-test protocol: prompt optimization methods receive only the constraint specification and must generalize before seeing any test data. Evaluating six methods across four LLMs and three schedules with evolving constraints, we find that these methods show no significant improvement in performance, even after incurring a higher latency. These methods, designed for offline or reactive settings, are inadequate for the proactive paradigm. Our work emphasizes the growing need for designing proactive prompt adaptation methods, where the models must remain robust to evolving needs in deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RECAP基准，用于评估在严格主动适应协议下提示优化方法的持续学习能力。该协议要求模型仅基于约束规范泛化，而无需测试数据反馈。在四个LLM和三种调度上评估六种方法，发现现有方法在性能上无显著提升，且延迟更高，表明它们不适合生产中的主动适应场景。
Motivation: 生产中的代理系统常面临动态约束，需主动适应新要求，但现有基准仅考虑静态或反应性设置，缺乏对主动适应能力的评估。
Method: 提出RECAP基准，采用主动适应-然后-测试协议：提示优化方法仅接收约束规范，在未见测试数据前必须泛化。评估六种方法（未具体命名）在四个LLM和三种约束演变调度上的表现。
Result: 六种方法在性能上无显著提升，且推理延迟更高，说明它们无法有效应对主动适应需求。
Conclusion: 需要设计新的主动提示适应方法，使模型在部署中能鲁棒地应对不断变化的约束。

papers.title: PSEBench: A Controllable and Verifiable Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs in Patient Safety Event Triage
papers.abstract_en: Patient safety event triage, determining whether a clinical event is reportable under jurisdiction-specific policy, is a high-stakes task typically performed manually by patient safety experts. Although LLMs may support this workflow, reliable evaluation is limited by the lack of benchmarks to capture evidence-grounded policy reasoning, proactive information seeking for incomplete reports, and principled abstention in irreducibly ambiguous cases. We address this gap with a policy-grounded construction methodology centered on the clause card, a structured representation that factorizes regulatory text into auditable decision specifications. Combining clause cards with anchor-driven instantiation and closed-loop verification, our scalable pipeline produces narratives with by-construction ground truth and naturally supports generating missing information and uncertain variants. We instantiate this method on Minnesota's 29 Reportable Adverse Health Events, producing PSEBench, a 5,074-case benchmark with an agentic evaluation environment. Evaluation on 15 representative LLMs reveals consistent capability trends, demonstrates the benchmark's utility, and identifies actionable gaps toward reliable LLM-based patient safety event triage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PSEBench，一个基于政策约束的患者安全事件分诊基准，通过条款卡片（clause card）结构化表示监管文本，结合锚点驱动实例化和闭环验证，生成具有确定性真实标签的叙事文本，并支持缺失信息和不确定变体。在明尼苏达州29种可报告不良健康事件上构建了5,074个案例的基准，并在15个LLM上评估，揭示了能力趋势和可改进的差距。
Motivation: 患者安全事件分诊（确定临床事件是否需按政策报告）是高风险任务，通常由专家手动完成。缺乏能够捕获基于证据的政策推理、主动信息寻求和原则性弃权的基准，限制了LLM在此任务上的可靠评估。
Method: 提出基于条款卡片的政策导向构建方法：将监管文本分解为可审计的决策规范，结合锚点驱动实例化生成叙事，并通过闭环验证确保ground truth的正确性，同时支持生成缺失信息和不确定变体。
Result: 在明尼苏达州29种可报告不良健康事件上构建了5,074个案例的基准（PSEBench）和代理评估环境，对15个代表性LLM的评估显示一致的能力趋势，并识别了实现可靠LLM分诊的可操作差距。
Conclusion: PSEBench提供了可验证的基准，揭示了当前LLM在患者安全事件分诊中的能力与不足，为改进提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在明尼苏达州29种可报告不良健康事件上构建了5,074个案例的基准（PSEBench）和代理评估环境，对15个代表性LLM的评估显示一致的能力趋势，并识别了实现可靠LLM分诊的可操作差距。
summary_sections.conclusion: PSEBench提供了可验证的基准，揭示了当前LLM在患者安全事件分诊中的能力与不足，为改进提供了方向。

papers.title: UniPixie: Unified and Probabilistic 3D Physics Learning via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Existing feed-forward networks excel at predicting a single set of physical properties from visual appearance, but this point-estimate paradigm fundamentally fails to capture the real world's inherent physical ambiguity. We address this by reframing physics prediction as a task of learning a controllable, continuous distribution of material properties. We introduce UNIPIXIE, a framework trained to predict a continuous and parameterized path of physically plausible material properties from a single visual input. By learning a direct mapping along an object's softest-to-stiffest spectrum on our PIXIEMULTIVERSE dataset, UNIPIXIE allows for controllable generation of diverse, physically valid material fields via a single intuitive parameter. Crucially, UNIPIXIE introduces a novel unified architecture to produce simulation-ready parameters for diverse physics solvers, including continuum-based Material Point Method (MPM), reduced-order deformation based on Linear Blend Skinning (LBS), and anchor-based Spring-Mass systems, addressing a key portability issue in prior work. Experiments show our approach not only generates a rich variety of plausible dynamics but also reduces Young's Modulus prediction error by over 50% against the strongest deterministic baseline, bridging the gap between static point estimates and the continuous nature of physical reality. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
papers.comment: Published at CVPR 2026 as a Highlight. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniPixie 提出将物理属性预测重新定义为学习可控连续分布的任务，利用流匹配从单张视觉输入生成材料属性的连续参数化路径，并支持多种物理求解器（MPM、LBS、弹簧质点系统）。实验表明该方法不仅能生成多样化的合理动力学，还将杨氏模量预测误差相比最强确定性基线降低超过50%。
Motivation: 现有前馈网络只能从视觉外观预测单一物理属性，无法捕捉真实世界中固有的物理歧义性（例如不同材料可能产生相似外观）。
Method: 提出 UniPixie 框架，通过流匹配学习从最软到最硬的材料属性连续路径，利用单一直观参数控制生成；构建 PIXIEMULTIVERSE 数据集，并设计统一架构支持多种物理求解器。
Result: 在多个物理仿真基准上，UniPixie 生成的动力学多样性显著提升，且杨氏模量预测误差相比最强确定性基线降低超过50%。
Conclusion: 将物理预测从点估计扩展到连续概率分布，改善了物理仿真的真实性和灵活性，并解决了不同求解器之间的可移植性问题。

papers.title: CoRe-MoE: Contrastive Reweighted Mixture of Experts for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Locomotion with Gait Adaptation
authors: Haohui Huang (3) ((1) Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract_en: Humans primarily rely on walking and running to traverse complex terrains. Similarly, humanoid robots should be able to smoothly transition between walking and running while maintaining natural and stable locomotion. However, unifying gait transition and multi-terrain adaptation within a single policy remains challenging due to gradient interference between tasks and the distribution shift caused by terrain variations. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can mitigate multi-skill interference, direct joint training often fails to achieve clear expert specialization. To address these challenges, we propose CoRe-MoE, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that decouples gait generation from terrain adaptation. In the first stage, a stable locomotion policy is learned to produce natural walking and running behaviors with smooth transitions. In the second stage, a terrain-aware MoE branch is introduced, and the gating network is trained with a contrastive objective to learn structured terrain representations and promote expert specialization. The final action is obtained through weighted fusion of the base gait policy and the terrain-aware branch, enabling the policy to preserve stable locomotion while adapting to complex terrains. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline approaches in terms of success rate, locomotion stability, and multi-terrain adaptability. Furthermore, zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validates the effectiveness of our framework, achieving robust walking and running across stairs, slopes, steps, obstacles, and unstructured outdoor terrains while maintaining accurate foothold control and dynamic stability.
papers.comment: Kailun Huang, Zikang Xie, Yanzhe Xie and Panpan Liao contributed equally to this work. Corresponding authors: Renjing Xu and Haohui Huang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoRe-MoE，一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于人形机器人的多地形步态适应。第一阶段学习稳定的步态策略（行走和跑步及平滑切换），第二阶段引入地形感知的混合专家（MoE）分支，通过对比学习训练门控网络以结构化地形表示并促进专家专门化。最终动作通过基础步态策略和地形感知分支的加权融合得到。在仿真和实际Unitree G1机器人上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 统一步态切换和多地形适应于单一策略面临梯度干扰和地形分布偏移的挑战，直接联合训练MoE难以实现清晰的专家专门化。
Method: 两阶段RL框架：1）基策略学习稳定行走和跑步及平滑切换；2）引入地形感知MoE分支，门控网络通过对比目标学习结构化地形表示，促进专家专门化；最终通过加权融合结合基策略和地形分支。
Result: 仿真中比基线方法在成功率、运动稳定性和多地形适应性上更优；零样本部署在Unitree G1上验证了跨楼梯、斜坡、台阶、障碍物和非结构化地形的稳健行走和跑步，保持精确落脚控制和动态稳定性。
Conclusion: 框架有效地解耦步态生成和地形适应，实现了多地形人形机器人稳健运动，且无需微调直接迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: Parthenon Law: A Self-Evolving Legal-Agent Framework
papers.abstract_en: As agents grow more capable, legal-domain LLM agents promise to turn document-heavy matters into reviewable work products -- yet reliable deployment faces three obstacles: no large-scale evidence on how today's strongest model-and-harness combinations behave on end-to-end legal matters; no agent architecture adapted to the legal vertical, only general-purpose harnesses; and, in a setting that keeps shifting with new facts, authorities, and deadlines, no mechanism for systems to learn from their own outcomes. We address each. A large-scale empirical study on Harvey LAB -- $12{,}510$ agent trajectories -- shows that even frontier agents remain far from completing matters in a single pass: per-criterion accuracy climbs with stronger models while strict matter completion stalls. We then introduce \textsc{Parthenon}, a self-evolving legal-agent framework that factors Model, Harness, Agent roles, legal Knowledge, deterministic Tools, and procedural Skills into auditable surfaces for source traceability, date and number grounding, deliverable compliance, and issue closure. Finally, an anti-leakage learning loop converts scored failures into task-agnostic edits to skills, tools, and knowledge, letting the system improve with experience -- as a firm refines its checklists and playbooks after each matter -- without touching model weights. Across our large-scale empirical analysis, \textsc{Parthenon} substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art models and harnesses on legal-matter tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对法律领域LLM代理部署面临的三大障碍——缺乏大规模端到端法律事务的实证、缺乏适应法律垂直领域的代理架构、缺乏从自身结果中学习的机制——提出Parthenon，一个自演化法律代理框架。通过对Harvey LAB上的12,510条代理轨迹进行大规模实证，发现即使是最前沿的模型也难以一次性完成法律事务。Parthenon将模型、框架、代理角色、法律知识、确定性工具和程序技能分解为可审计的表面，并通过反泄漏学习循环将评分失败转化为任务无关的技能、工具和知识编辑，使系统在不修改模型权重的情况下从经验中改进。实验表明Parthenon显著提升了最先进模型和框架在法律事务任务上的性能。
Motivation: 法律领域LLM代理的可靠部署面临三个障碍：缺乏大规模端到端法律事务的实证、没有针对法律垂直领域的代理架构、缺乏从自身结果中学习的机制。
Method: 提出Parthenon框架，将模型、框架、代理角色、法律知识、确定性工具和程序技能分解为可审计的表面，并通过反泄漏学习循环将评分失败转化为任务无关的技能、工具和知识编辑，使系统在不修改模型权重的情况下从经验中改进。
Result: 大规模实证表明即使前沿模型也难以一次性完成法律事务，Parthenon显著提升了最先进模型和框架在法律事务任务上的性能。
Conclusion: Parthenon框架通过自演化学习机制让法律代理系统从经验中改进，无需修改模型权重，同时提供可审计的组件分解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticRL，一个基于GPT智能体的强化学习框架，用于无人机视觉导航任务。该框架利用多模态GPT代理自动设计奖励函数、训练PPO策略并通过闭环反馈自改进，最终在多个导航任务上提升策略性能71%，并实现91%的真实世界成功率与94%的仿真到现实迁移准确率。
Motivation: 深度强化学习在自主导航中依赖人工设计的奖励函数和反复调参，耗时且难以保证任务成功率。
Method: 提出AgenticRL，使用多模态GPT代理解释任务和视觉观察，生成奖励函数，通过PPO训练策略，再作为评论员生成诊断反馈，闭环改进奖励函数；推理时根据图像和语言自动选择策略。
Result: 闭环改进使策略性能提升71%，真实世界成功率达91%，仿真到现实迁移准确率94%。
Conclusion: AgenticRL通过GPT代理实现奖励函数自动设计与闭环自改进，显著提升无人机导航的性能和迁移能力。

papers.title: LiveBand: Live Accompaniment Generation in the Audio Domain
papers.abstract_en: We present LiveBand, a real-time system that generates high-fidelity music accompaniments to live audio input, respecting strict causal constraints. Our method trains a causal transformer generator in the continuous latent space of a pre-trained causal audio autoencoder, using adversarial sequence-level supervision from a discriminator. At each timestep, the generator receives only the causally available mix context and Gaussian noise, and predicts accompaniment latents without access to future mix frames or ground-truth target latents. Training is performed in a single parallel forward pass under causal masking, while streaming inference proceeds autoregressively with a rolling attention state. The model's training and inference computations are matched by design, eliminating teacher forcing and the associated exposure bias. On a multi-instrument music accompaniment benchmark, LiveBand improves over prior work on objective measures of audio quality, beat alignment, and mix adherence, while enabling real-time streaming generation without lookahead into the future on consumer hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveBand是一个实时音乐伴奏生成系统，它使用因果Transformer在预训练因果音频自编码器的连续潜在空间中生成高保真伴奏。系统在训练时采用因果掩码的并行前向传播，推理时使用自回归滚动注意力，消除了教师强制和暴露偏差。实验表明，LiveBand在多乐器伴奏基准上优于先前方法，在音频质量、节拍对齐和混合一致性方面均有提升，并能在消费级硬件上实现无前瞻的实时流式生成。
Motivation: 现有的音乐伴奏生成方法通常需要未来的上下文（非因果）或存在教师强制导致的暴露偏差，难以实现严格因果约束下的实时高质量生成。
Method: 提出一个因果Transformer生成器，在预训练的因果音频自编码器的连续潜在空间上运作，使用对抗性序列级鉴别器进行训练。训练时通过因果掩码在单次前向传播中并行完成，推理时以自回归方式利用滚动注意力状态生成，确保训练与推理的计算模式一致。
Result: 在多乐器音乐伴奏基准上，LiveBand在客观音频质量、节拍对齐和混合一致性指标上均优于先前工作，并能在消费级硬件上实现无未来信息访问的实时流式生成。
Conclusion: 通过设计匹配的训练和推理计算模式，LiveBand消除了教师强制和暴露偏差，证明了严格因果约束下实时高保真伴奏生成的可行性。该系统适用于现场音乐交互等低延迟场景。

summary_sections.method: 提出一个因果Transformer生成器，在预训练的因果音频自编码器的连续潜在空间上运作，使用对抗性序列级鉴别器进行训练。训练时通过因果掩码在单次前向传播中并行完成，推理时以自回归方式利用滚动注意力状态生成，确保训练与推理的计算模式一致。
summary_sections.result: 在多乐器音乐伴奏基准上，LiveBand在客观音频质量、节拍对齐和混合一致性指标上均优于先前工作，并能在消费级硬件上实现无未来信息访问的实时流式生成。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过设计匹配的训练和推理计算模式，LiveBand消除了教师强制和暴露偏差，证明了严格因果约束下实时高保真伴奏生成的可行性。该系统适用于现场音乐交互等低延迟场景。

papers.title: Optimizing Explicit Unit-Distance Lower-Bound Certificates
papers.abstract_en: The 2026 disproof of Erdős's unit-distance conjecture and Sawin's quantitative refinement show that the maximum number $u(n)$ of unit distances among $n$ planar points can exceed $n^{1+\varepsilon}$ for a fixed positive $\varepsilon$. Sawin's explicit bound gives more than $n^{1.014}$ unit distances for arbitrarily large $n$ and exposes integer parameters whose choice is not fully optimized. This report treats Sawin's parameter selection as a nonlinear integer optimization problem and develops an open-source Python optimization and verification pipeline for certificates involving prime sets $T$ and $S_Q$, integer multiplicities $k(p)$, and a rationally encoded real parameter $R$. After reproducing Sawin's certificate with $δ=0.014114\ldots$, the pipeline yields improved certificates with the same $T$. We develop a tailored integer evolution strategy achieving a certificate with $δ=0.015263\ldots$ and supporting the cautious statement $u(n)>n^{1.0152}$ for arbitrarily large $n$. For extended ramified prime ranges, the Emmerich--Cordella certificate obtained with the same framework reports $u(n)>n^{1.031}$ for $\#T=67$, illustrating the importance of enlarging $T$. Very recent MathOverflow discussions, brought to the author's attention as of version~4, report further improvements, including certificates above $δ>0.035$ and beyond $δ>0.036$. Some of these improvements may rely not only on larger prime ranges but also on modified constraint systems and additional degrees of freedom that deviate from Sawin's original formulation. Beyond this application, the work illustrates how randomized optimization heuristics can improve, verify, and refine explicit certificates for combinatorial geometry through nonlinear integer optimization.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 9 figures. Added a declaration on the use of AI. Added references to further contributions discussed on MathOverflow, including a reference to the independently developed verification pipeline and certificate package by Tseng (2026), published on Zenodo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Erdős 单位距离猜想的反证中 Sawin 的显式下界证书参数选择进行非线性整数优化。通过开发开源 Python 优化与验证流水线，在相同素数集 T 下将证书参数 δ 从 0.014114 提升至 0.015263，支持 u(n) > n^{1.0152}。对于扩展的素数范围，Emmerich-Cordella 证书报告 δ > 0.031。最新 MathOverflow 讨论提及 δ 已超过 0.036。
Motivation: Sawin 的显式下界证书中整数参数的选择未完全优化，存在进一步提升的空间，从而获得更紧的单位距离下界。
Method: 将参数选择视为非线性整数优化问题，开发基于 Python 的流水线，采用定制的整数进化策略 (integer evolution strategy) 进行优化。
Result: 在相同素数集 T 下，将 δ 从 0.014114 提升至 0.015263，支持 u(n) > n^{1.0152}；扩大的素数集 T=67 下，δ 超过 0.031；最新未包含的讨论中 δ 超过 0.036。
Conclusion: 随机优化启发式算法能有效改进、验证和精炼组合几何中的显式证书，但改进依赖素数集扩展和约束系统修改，不限于原方法。

papers.title: AgentPLM: Agentic Protein Language Models with Reasoning-Augmented Decoding for Protein Sequence Design
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models (PLMs) are passive oracles: they generate sequences in a single forward pass with no mechanism to consult external biophysical feedback or redirect generation when a candidate violates thermodynamic or structural constraints. We introduce AgentPLM, which addresses this by equipping a pre-trained PLM with i) Reasoning-Augmented Decoding (RAD), which interleaves autoregressive generation with tool calls (ESMFold, FoldX, AutoDock Vina), and ii) Contrastive Agent Policy Optimisation (CAPO), a trajectory-level extension of direct preference optimisation that trains the policy end-to-end to learn when oracle feedback is informative rather than merely imitating high-fitness sequences. We evaluate AgentPLM on benchmark tasks spanning de novo enzyme design, antibody optimisation, thermostability, PPI interface design, and zero-shot fitness prediction with standardised oracle APIs and controlled sequence-identity splits. AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.
papers.journal_ref: Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology, 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentPLM，一种将预训练蛋白质语言模型与推理增强解码（RAD）和对比代理策略优化（CAPO）相结合的方法，用于蛋白质序列设计。RAD 在自回归生成过程中穿插调用 ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina 等工具，CAPO 通过轨迹级扩展直接偏好优化来训练策略何时利用 Oracle 反馈。在从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面设计和零样本适应性预测等基准上，AgentPLM 达到了最先进水平，尤其在抗体 top-10% 命中率上超过最强被动基线，提供了在线纠错的机制证据而无需显式回溯。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型是被动的预言机，单次前向生成序列，无法在生成过程中咨询外部生物物理反馈或纠正违反热力学/结构约束的候选序列。
Method: 提出推理增强解码（RAD），在自回归生成中穿插工具调用（ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina）；以及对比代理策略优化（CAPO），一种轨迹级扩展的直接偏好优化，使策略端到端学习何时 Oracle 反馈具有信息性，而非仅仅模仿高适应性序列。
Result: 在标准化的 Oracle API 和控制序列同一性分割的基准任务上（包括从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、PPI 界面设计、零样本适应性预测），AgentPLM 达到最先进结果，在抗体 top-10% 命中率上较最强被动基线有显著提升。
Conclusion: 提供了在线错误修正的机制证据，无需显式回溯。

papers.title: When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-ClassArchitectures
papers.abstract_en: We track the developmental trajectory of attention-head circuit formation across three 1B-class language models spanning two architecture families (dense transformer, mixture-of-experts) and two pretraining corpora (The Pile, DCLM): Pythia 1B, OLMo 1B-0724-hf, and OLMoE 1B-7B-0924. At each of 10 log-spaced revisions per model -- 30 mechanistic-interpretability runs in total -- we apply a participation-ratio (PR) spectral signal and an all-head capability-specific selectivity screen to track induction, previous-token, and BOS-attractor heads as they emerge. Five findings. (F1) Layers 0 and 1 produce zero BOS-classified heads at every revision in every model: the L0/L1 zero-BOS floor is an architectural property, not a learned outcome. (F2) The whole-model BOS-attractor fraction follows three distinct emergence shapes -- a gradual ramp in Pythia 1B, a sharp phase transition in OLMo 1B (7% to 70% between adjacent checkpoints), and a gradual ramp in OLMoE 1B-7B. (F3) In DCLM models, induction-circuit formation precedes BOS-attractor formation by 10-20x in tokens; capability-circuit formation and attention-sink formation are two transitions, not one. (F4) The capability-specific screen converges to the final induction circuit within 0.3-2% of total training tokens -- circuit identification does not require the final model. (F5) For every final-checkpoint induction head sampled across all three models, per-head PR is elevated at or before the first revision at which that head crosses its capability-selectivity threshold. The results refine the induction-phase-transition framing: in 1B-class models trained on DCLM, the induction transition and the attention-sink transition are separated by an order of magnitude in tokens and have qualitatively different shapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文追踪了三个1B类语言模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B）中注意力头电路形成的发育轨迹。通过30次机制可解释性运行，测量了归纳头、前一个token头和BOS吸引头的出现情况。主要发现包括：L0/L1层从不产生BOS分类头；BOS吸引头的形成形状因模型而异；在DCLM模型上，归纳电路形成比BOS吸引头早10-20倍（以token计）；能力特定筛选在训练初期即可收敛；每个归纳头在达到选择性阈值之前或之时，其参与比已升高。
Motivation: 现有研究对注意力电路（如归纳头、BOS吸引头）的出现时机和发育轨迹缺乏系统理解，尤其是不同架构和训练数据下的差异。
Method: 对三个1B类模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B）的10个对数间隔检查点进行机制可解释性分析，使用参与比（PR）频谱信号和全头能力特定选择性筛选来识别归纳头、前一个token头和BOS吸引头。
Result: 五个主要发现：(1) L0/L1层在所有检查点均无BOS头，是架构属性；(2) BOS吸引头的形成形状有渐进型（Pythia）、剧变型（OLMo）和渐进型（OLMoE）；(3) 在DCLM模型上，归纳电路形成比BOS头早10-20倍；(4) 能力特定筛选在训练早期即可确定最终归纳电路；(5) 每个归纳头的参与比在其跨过选择性阈值之前或之时已经升高。
Conclusion: 在1B类DCLM模型上，归纳转变与注意力汇（attention-sink）转变在token量级上相差一个数量级，且形状不同。

papers.title: Chroma Clues: Leveraging Color Statistics to Detect Synthetic Images
papers.abstract_en: The evolution and dissemination of AI-synthesized images is occurring at an unprecedented rate. Image generators are making rapid progress in their goal of perfectly imitating natural images, which also challenges image forensics. In this work, we exploit an underexplored cue in current generative models, namely their weakness to imitate color statistics of natural images. We first show that the LPIPS loss used for training image generators is less sensitive to chrominance than to luminance, which may lead to statistical discrepancies in the colors of synthetic images. Building on this observation, we then introduce six hand-crafted color transformations and a method to learn a task-optimized color transform to statistically expose generated images. These transformations can be used in various ways. First, we define color-sensitive features at pixel-level or patch-level. A simple, interpretable classifier achieves with these features an average generalization accuracy of 93.27% and strong robustness against six types of post-processing. Second, we demonstrate that the transformations exhibit characteristic visual noise patterns in natural and synthetic image areas, which enables an intuitive visual image evaluation. Third, we demonstrate that the transforms can enhance color patterns in generated images for improved multiclass attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现AI生成图像在颜色统计上存在缺陷，因为训练生成模型的LPIPS损失对色度不敏感。作者提出六种手工设计的颜色变换以及一种学习任务优化的颜色变换，用于统计暴露合成图像。使用这些变换提取像素级或补丁级特征，一个简单的可解释分类器达到93.27%的平均泛化精度，并对六种后处理具有强鲁棒性。此外，这些变换在自然和合成图像区域表现出特征性的视觉噪声模式，有助于直观评估，并可用于多类归属。
Motivation: 现有图像生成器在完美模仿自然图像方面进展迅速，但颜色统计是一个未充分探索的弱点。LPIPS损失对色度不敏感，导致合成图像与自然图像在颜色上存在统计差异。
Method: 提出六种手工颜色变换和一个学习任务优化的颜色变换。这些变换可用于提取像素级或补丁级的颜色敏感特征，并使用简单可解释的分类器进行检测。
Result: 基于这些特征，简单分类器在合成图像检测上平均泛化精度达93.27%，对六种后处理（如JPEG压缩、模糊等）具有强鲁棒性。变换还产生特征性视觉噪声模式，并增强了生成图像中的颜色模式，有助于多类归属。
Conclusion: 颜色统计是检测合成图像的有效线索，所提方法简单、可解释且鲁棒，为图像取证提供了新方向。

papers.title: VET: A Framework for Analyzing AI Discourse
papers.abstract_en: Public discourse on AI has become polarized; exaggerated positions on AI in traditional and social media threaten the development of AI Literacy among the general public. In this article, I introduce the VET Framework, a method for categorizing AI discourse along the dimensions of valence, effectiveness, and trajectory. I show how this framework can be used to identify, compare, and critique prevalent narratives of AI Hype, AI Doom, AI Denial, and AI Normalcy. Using VET, I analyze how each of these four stances exaggerates some aspects of the current state and/or likely evolution of AI, and illustrate how the VET framework can serve as an AI Literacy tool by supporting the ``vetting'' of polarized AI discourse.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the Paris Institute for Advanced Study (Vol. 21) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 VET 框架，用于按效价、有效性和轨迹三个维度对 AI 话语进行分类。该框架帮助识别和比较 AI 炒作、AI 末日、AI 否认和 AI 正常化四种常见叙事，并可作为 AI 素养工具。
Motivation: 公共媒体中关于 AI 的讨论两极分化且夸大，威胁公众 AI 素养；缺乏系统化的分类工具来分析这些话语。
Method: 提出 VET 框架，从效价、有效性、轨迹三个维度对 AI 话语进行分类。
Result: 展示了该框架如何识别和对比四种 AI 叙事（AI 炒作、AI 末日、AI 否认、AI 正常化），并作为 AI 素养工具支持对话语的“审查”。
Conclusion: VET 框架有助于批判性分析 AI 话语，促进公众 AI 素养。

papers.title: EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors
papers.abstract_en: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVA-Net，一个两阶段框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验进行跨被试EEG运动解码。第一阶段通过对比学习对齐EEG和视频特征；第二阶段通过视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验转移到仅EEG分类器。在公共数据集上，LOSO精度提升8.66%。
Motivation: 跨被试EEG运动解码受个体差异和信号非平稳性影响，现有文本作为语义锚点的方法难以捕捉动态运动过程。
Method: 提出EVA-Net：第一阶段使用跨模态和监督对比学习对齐EEG与视频特征；第二阶段利用视频类别原型和知识蒸馏，在不增加推理开销的情况下将视频先验转移到EEG分类器。
Result: 在EEGMMI数据集上，EVA-Net在留一被试（LOSO）评估中实现8.66%的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 视频作为语义先验比文本更有效，能够提升跨被试EEG运动解码性能，且不增加推理负担。

papers.title: Leave a Window Out: Modifying the Jackknife for Predictive Inference in Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction methods enjoy strong theoretical and empirical predictive inference performance, provided the data is exchangeable and is treated symmetrically during training. However, these assumptions are impractical in many settings, such as time series, where temporal dependence violates exchangeability and it is preferable to use predictors that leverage dependence by treating data asymmetrically. Recent work shows that split conformal prediction is robust to these issues, but sample splitting can reduce accuracy, motivating the study of methods that do not rely on data splitting in the time series setting. In this work, we show that the vanilla leave-one-out jackknife can suffer arbitrary loss of coverage even in canonical time series models with mild temporal dependence. As a remedy, we propose a modification tailored to such settings, which we term the leave-a-window-out (LWO) method, and show that it can achieve valid coverage provided that the model-fitting procedure satisfies mild stability properties. Our proofs are based on quantifying the degree to which the data departs from cyclic exchangeability, which we introduce new coefficients to measure. Experiments on time series demonstrate that our method often enjoys valid coverage when the vanilla jackknife fails to cover, while producing much narrower intervals than split conformal prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列预测中保形预测的覆盖有效性，指出标准留一法jackknife在时间序列中会失去覆盖，提出留窗口法（LWO）并证明其在弱稳定性条件下可实现有效覆盖，实验表明LWO比split conformal区间更窄。
Motivation: 时间序列中可交换性假设不成立，标准split conformal因数据分割降低精度，而留一法jackknife也可能失效，需要改进方法。
Method: 提出leave-a-window-out (LWO)方法，通过移除一个窗口而非单个点来打破时间依赖性，并引入循环可交换性偏离系数来证明覆盖有效性。
Result: 实验表明LWO在标准jackknife失效时仍保持有效覆盖，且区间宽度窄于split conformal。
Conclusion: LWO是时间序列中预测推断的有效工具，在合理稳定性条件下实现有效覆盖，但需要验证稳定性条件的具体适用范围。

papers.title: PromptEmbedder: Efficient and Transferable Text Embedding via Dual-LLM Soft Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable efficacy in text embedding, yet current adaptation methods like LoRA face significant bottlenecks in computational efficiency and cross-architecture transferability. Whenever a new backbone emerges, existing approaches require costly retraining from scratch. To address this, we propose PromptEmbedder, a novel dual-LLM framework that decouples embedding knowledge from specific backbone weights. PromptEmbedder utilizes a Prompting LLM to generate instruction-aware soft prompts for a frozen Embedding LLM via a differentiable generation process with continuous relaxation, ensuring full gradient flow during contrastive training. By localizing task-specific knowledge within the Prompting LLM, adapting to new architectures requires only retraining a lightweight linear alignment matrix. Evaluations on the MTEB benchmark show that PromptEmbedder achieves comparable performance with LoRA finetuning while reducing GPU memory by 40% and accelerating training by 3.7x. Our approach establishes a scalable, architecture-agnostic paradigm for efficient LLM-based representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PromptEmbedder，一种双LLM框架，通过可微分的软提示生成实现高效且可迁移的文本嵌入。它利用Prompting LLM为冻结的Embedding LLM生成指令感知的软提示，将嵌入知识与骨干权重解耦。在MTEB基准上，它与LoRA微调性能相当，但GPU内存减少40%，训练速度提升3.7倍。
Motivation: 现有方法如LoRA在文本嵌入任务中面临计算效率低和跨架构迁移性差的问题，每当新骨干出现时需要重新训练。
Method: 提出双LLM框架PromptEmbedder，包含Prompting LLM和冻结的Embedding LLM，通过连续松弛的可微分生成过程生成软提示，确保对比训练中的梯度流动。适应新架构只需训练轻量线性对齐矩阵。
Result: 在MTEB基准上，PromptEmbedder达到与LoRA微调可比的性能，GPU内存减少40%，训练加速3.7倍。
Conclusion: 该方法建立了一种可扩展的、与架构无关的高效LLM表示学习范式。
