papers.title: On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt models to maintain reliable performance on non-stationary test streams without requiring labeled data. Despite its empirical success, the learnability of TTA under non-stationary streams remains unexplored. A key challenge is the lack of a principled theoretical framework that simultaneously aligns with the TTA objective and captures both continuously evolving distribution shifts and intrinsic information constraints. To address this gap, we propose the first theoretical framework for studying the learnability of TTA and introduce $(ε,δ)$-Recovery Complexity and $(ε,ρ)$-TTA Learnability. Recovery complexity measures the post-shift time needed to maintain excess risk below a target level with high probability, and is further extended to TTA learnability, which measures the long-term reliability of TTA. Within this framework, we introduce a novel discrete surrogate for non-stationary test streams, enabling a unified and tractable analysis of both gradual and abrupt shifts. We derive order-wise matching lower and upper bounds on recovery complexity, revealing fundamental limits of TTA and an intrinsic adaptivity-information trade-off. These results provide unified learnability guarantees for TTA that complement regret-based analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个研究测试时自适应（TTA）可学习性的理论框架，引入(ε,δ)-恢复复杂度和(ε,ρ)-TTA可学习性概念，用于衡量非平稳测试流中模型恢复性能所需的时间与长期可靠性。通过设计离散代理变量统一分析渐变和突变偏移，推导了恢复复杂度的紧致上下界，揭示了TTA的基本极限和自适应性-信息权衡。
Motivation: 测试时自适应在实际应用中成功，但其在非平稳流下的可学习性缺乏理论分析，现有框架无法同时契合TTA目标并捕捉连续演变的分布偏移和信息约束。
Method: 提出了(ε,δ)-恢复复杂度衡量偏移后使超额风险低于目标水平所需的时间，扩展为(ε,ρ)-TTA可学习性；引入非平稳测试流的离散代理变量以统一分析渐变和突变偏移。
Result: 推导了恢复复杂度的紧致上下界（阶一致），揭示了测试时自适应的基本极限以及自适应性-信息权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架为TTA提供了统一的可学习性保证，补充了基于后悔的分析，并指出了自适应与信息约束之间的内在折衷。

papers.title: Does Capability Transfer to Subjective Behavior -- and Would Our Instruments Tell Us? A Self-Evolving, Trust-by-Construction Evaluation Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking is mature where answers are verifiable -- math, code, reasoning -- but the fastest-growing uses of LLMs are subjective and human-facing: companionship, emotional support, counseling. There the default validity test, correlating a metric to human judgment, has no stable anchor: inter-rater agreement is low, structured by annotator identity, barely reproducible, and length-biased. So we cannot answer the question that matters: does capability that scales on objective benchmarks transfer to subjective behavior, and would our instruments even tell us if it did not? We build an instrument for this regime and report what it reveals at the frontier. We contribute, first, a self-evolving instrument that selects and then authors its own behavioral dimensions under a multiplicative anti-gaming fitness, self-halting when it stops improving; second, a trust-by-construction paradigm that earns belief through three certificates established without a human gold standard, where human raters saturate (rho ~ 0.45); and third, the finding it makes visible -- capability transfer is dissociable. Across 49 models, 8 families, and 24 months, subjective behaviors are where objective-benchmark scaling fails to carry over: the sharpest case, advice-restraint (knowing when not to give advice), is the frontier's universal-lowest dimension, and at gpt-4.1->gpt-5 it ran backwards while the aggregate score hid it -- a regression one instruction recovers. Warm restraint is moved by model generation, not by raw scale, MoE width, inference budget, or reasoning mode; the open-weight Pareto frontier matches closed flagships at ~10-80x lower per-call cost; and four judge families replicate the rubric on held-out human ESConv conversations. Data, code, the locked rubric, and judge prompts will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在主观行为（如陪伴、情感支持）上的能力迁移问题，构建了一个自演进、信任内建的评价范式。该范式通过无人类黄金标准的证书来验证模型行为，并发现能力迁移是可分离的：客观基准上的能力提升并不一定迁移到主观行为，例如在建议克制维度上，GPT-4.1到GPT-5出现了倒退，而聚合分数掩盖了这一现象。
Motivation: 现有基准测试在可验证任务（数学、代码、推理）上成熟，但LLM增长最快的用途是主观且面向人类的（陪伴、情感支持、咨询）。这些场景下，与人类判断的相关性缺乏稳定锚点，因为标注者间一致性低、受标注者身份影响大、难以复现且受长度偏差影响。因此无法回答关键问题：客观基准上的能力是否迁移到主观行为，以及现有工具能否检测到迁移失败。
Method: 提出一个自演进的评价工具，该工具在乘法反博弈适应度下自行选择并生成行为维度，并在停止改进时自动终止；同时采用信任内建范式，通过三个无需人类黄金标准的证书建立可信度（人类评分者饱和时rho约0.45）。
Result: 在49个模型、8个模型家族、24个月的时间跨度内，发现主观行为是客观基准能力迁移失败的地方：最显著的例子是建议克制（知道何时不给出建议）是前沿模型普遍最低的维度，从GPT-4.1到GPT-5该维度倒退，而聚合分数隐藏了这一回归（一个指令即可恢复）。温暖的克制受模型代际影响，而非原始规模、MoE宽度、推理预算或推理模式；开源权重帕累托前沿以约10-80倍低的每次调用成本匹配闭源旗舰；四个评判模型家族在保留的ESConv对话上复现了该评价准则。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，客观基准上的能力迁移到主观行为是可分离的，且现有聚合指标可能掩盖关键退化。自演进、信任内建的范式为评估主观行为提供了无人类黄金标准的方法。局限性包括：实验限于特定模型和时间范围，主观行为的维度定义可能不全面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Falcon-X: A Time Series Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Multivariate Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are transforming the forecasting paradigm through large-scale cross-domain pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs remain univariate, and recent efforts to enable cross-variate modeling still operate directly within the raw variate space. This design introduces fundamental limitations in semantic alignment and relational expressivity. Specifically, raw-space group mixing lacks a dedicated mechanism to align heterogeneous physical quantities, while standard non-negative attention fails to capture the complex synergistic and antagonistic interactions ubiquitous in real-world systems. To address these challenges, we propose Falcon-X, decouples variates from the raw space and maps them into a unified latent prototype space. Falcon-X employs a Unified Prototype Diff-Attention mechanism that explicitly evaluates both positive and negative semantic affinities to explicitly align heterogeneous variates. Cross-variate interactions are then efficiently performed within this shared space via Latent Entity Attention, naturally facilitating zero-shot structural transfer. Finally, a Variate Reassembly Router robustly reconstructs variate-specific trajectories via a request-and-dispatch mechanism. Extensive evaluations on the GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks demonstrate that Falcon-X achieves excellent forecasting performance, offering a principled and scalable paradigm for complex multivariate environments. Falcon-X is publicly released to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Falcon-X 是一种时间序列基础模型，通过将变量映射到统一潜在原型空间来解决多变量建模中的语义对齐和关系表达问题。它采用统一原型扩散注意力机制（Unified Prototype Diff-Attention）处理正负语义亲和性，并通过潜在实体注意力（Latent Entity Attention）进行跨变量交互，最后用变量重组路由器（Variate Reassembly Router）重构变量轨迹。在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 基准上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型多为单变量，且多变量建模直接在原始变量空间进行操作，缺乏对异构物理量的语义对齐机制，标准非负注意力无法捕捉真实的协同与拮抗交互。
Method: 提出 Falcon-X，将变量从原始空间解耦并映射到统一潜在原型空间；使用统一原型扩散注意力机制评估正负语义亲和性以对齐异构变量；通过潜在实体注意力在共享空间内进行跨变量交互；采用变量重组路由器通过请求-分配机制稳健重建变量轨迹。
Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 基准上，Falcon-X 取得了优异的预测性能，提供了原则性且可扩展的多变量建模范式。
Conclusion: Falcon-X 为复杂多变量环境下的时间序列预测提供了通用方案，并开源支持后续研究。

papers.title: Similarity-based matrix factorization for revealing interpretable dimensions in representational data
papers.abstract_en: The study of representations is widespread across fields, including neuroscience, psychology, and artificial intelligence. While representations are often studied and compared through similarities between stimuli, current methods provide only limited access to the dimensions that shape these representations and are often limited in interpretability. To overcome these challenges, here we introduce Similarity-Based Representation Factorization (SRF), a general computational method for recovering low-dimensional, non-negative, interpretable embeddings from similarity matrices derived from measured data. Across simulations and many neural, behavioral, and computational datasets, SRF recovers interpretable dimensions from diverse forms of representational data, even for very sparsely sampled, incomplete data. The dimensions derived from these datasets match those obtained by task-specific models, predict independent behavioral properties, improve exploratory analysis, and offer higher power for confirmatory hypothesis testing than comparing similarity matrices. Together, these results establish SRF as a general-purpose method with broad applications for uncovering, understanding, and using the dimensions underlying representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出相似性表示因子化（Similarity-Based Representation Factorization, SRF），一种从相似性矩阵中恢复低维、非负、可解释嵌入的通用计算方法。在模拟实验及神经、行为和计算数据集上，SRF能有效恢复可解释维度，匹配任务特定模型，预测独立行为属性，并提升探索性分析与假设检验的统计效力。
Motivation: 现有方法对表示维度的访问有限且可解释性不足，亟需一种能从相似性数据中直接提取可解释维度的通用方法。
Method: 引入SRF方法，通过非负矩阵分解等技术从观测到的相似性矩阵中学习低维嵌入，保证结果的非负性和可解释性。
Result: 在多个数据集（含稀疏、不完整数据）上，SRF恢复的维度与任务特定模型一致，能预测行为属性，在探索性分析和确认性假设检验中均优于直接比较相似性矩阵。
Conclusion: SRF是一种通用方法，可广泛用于揭示和理解各类表示数据背后的潜在维度。

papers.title: Rotation-Invariant Spherical Watermarking via Third-Order SO(3) Representation Coupling
papers.abstract_en: Reliable watermarking of panoramic imagery is fundamentally challenged by arbitrary 3D rotations. As panoramas are defined on the sphere, they naturally transform under the action of $SO(3)$, rendering conventional planar representations and augmentation-based robustness strategies inadequate and devoid of theoretical guarantees. To address this, we formulate panoramas as spherical signals and leverage $SO(3)$ representation theory to derive provably rotation-invariant descriptors. While spherical harmonic coefficients transform equivariantly under rotations, the natural invariant constructions are typically limited to zeroth-order statistics which eliminate directional information and severely constrain embedding capacity. In this work, we introduce a principled third-order invariant construction by coupling higher-order $SO(3)$ irreducible representations via tensor products and projecting onto the trivial representation. This yields a spherical invariant bispectrum that preserves phase information while remaining strictly rotation-invariant. Leveraging this property, we embed watermarks into higher-order spherical harmonic coefficients and recover them from invariant bispectral scalars, enabling reliable extraction under arbitrary 3D rotations. We provide a theoretical proof of $SO(3)$ invariance for it and demonstrate experimentally its near-perfect robustness to continuous rotations while maintaining high visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于SO(3)群表示论的旋转不变球面水印方法。通过将高阶不可约表示进行张量积并投影到平凡表示，构造了严格旋转不变的球面双谱（bispectrum），用于水印嵌入与提取。实验表明该方法在任意三维旋转下具有近完美鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。
Motivation: 现有平面表示在球面旋转下缺乏鲁棒性，而低阶不变量（如能量谱）会丢失相位信息，限制水印嵌入容量。
Method: 利用SO(3)不可约表示的张量积构造三阶不变量（球面双谱），将水印嵌入高阶球谐系数，从双谱标量中恢复水印。
Result: 实验证明该方法在任意三维旋转下具有近完美鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上证明了该构造的SO(3)不变性，并实验验证了其鲁棒性，适用于全景图像等球面数据的版权保护。

papers.title: AMEL: Accumulated Message Effects on LLM Judgments
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are routinely used as automated evaluators: to review code, moderate content, or score outputs, often with many items passing through one conversation. We ask whether the polarity of prior conversation history biases subsequent judgments, an effect we call the accumulated message effect on LLM judgments (AMEL). Across 84,088 API calls to 12 models from 5 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and four open-source models), we present identical test items in isolation or following histories saturated with predominantly positive or negative evaluations. Models shift toward the conversation's prevailing polarity (d = -0.17, p < 10^-53). The effect concentrates on items where the model is genuinely uncertain at baseline (d = -0.36 for high-entropy items, vs d = -0.15 when the baseline is deterministic). Bias does not grow with context length: 5 prior turns and 50 produce the same shift (Spearman |r| < 0.01; OLS slope p = 0.80). And there is a negativity asymmetry: paired per item, negative histories induce 1.52x more bias than positive (t = 13.03, p < 10^-36, n = 2,733). Scaling helps but does not solve it (Anthropic: Haiku -0.22 to Opus -0.17; OpenAI: Nano -0.34 to GPT-5.2 -0.17). Three follow-ups narrow the mechanism. The token probability distribution shifts continuously, not at a threshold. The negativity asymmetry has both token-level and semantic components, though attributing the balance is exploratory at our sample sizes. Position does not matter: five biased turns anywhere in a 50-turn history produce the same shift. The simplest fix for evaluation pipelines is a fresh context per item; when batching is unavoidable, balancing the history helps.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 8 tables. Single author. Code, data (84,088 deduplicated API responses), and analysis pipeline at https://github.com/chutapp/amel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过84,088次API调用、12个模型、5家提供商的实验，发现LLM在评估任务中会受到对话历史极性的影响，即累积消息效应（AMEL）。模型倾向于偏向对话的主流极性（d=-0.17, p<10^-53），且负性历史引起的偏差是正性的1.52倍。偏差不随上下文长度增长，扩大模型规模可减轻但不能消除。
Motivation: 现有LLM被广泛用作自动化评估器，但对话历史中的极性偏见可能影响评估结果的公正性，本文旨在量化这种偏见并探索其机制。
Method: 在多个LLM（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、DeepSeek及开源模型）上，将相同测试项分别置于孤立、正性主导或负性主导的对话历史后，测量判断偏移量。
Result: 模型显著偏向历史主导极性（d=-0.17, p<10^-53）；高不确定性项目偏移更大（d=-0.36）；5轮与50轮历史产生的偏移相同；负性历史偏移量是正性的1.52倍。
Conclusion: 最直接的缓解措施是每项评估使用新上下文；若必须批处理，则应平衡历史极性。

papers.title: Updating the standard neuron model in artificial neural networks
papers.abstract_en: From their inception in the 1950s, artificial neural networks (ANNs) started using the so-called point neuron model then prevalent in neuroscience, hoping that this analogy would allow for a better emulation of brain function. Over the years the neuroscience literature has shown that the point neuron model is too simplistic to properly represent many fundamental neural processes; however, the standard neuron model in ANNs still remains the same. Here we substitute it by a very recent model of cortical cells and demonstrate through theoretical analyses and experimental results how, simply by using a more realistic neural unit element without augmenting the number of parameters, the resulting ANNs offer a number of important advantages that include increases in expressivity, robustness and learning speed, and a reduction in memorization and the amount of training data needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用更真实的皮层细胞模型替换人工神经网络中沿用数十年的标准点神经元模型，在不增加参数数量的情况下，通过理论分析和实验证明改进后的网络在表达性、鲁棒性、学习速度上均有提升，且减少了记忆化和所需训练数据量。
Motivation: 标准点神经元模型过于简单，无法表示许多基础神经过程，而人工神经网络至今仍在使用该模型，限制了网络性能。
Method: 用近期提出的皮层细胞模型替代标准点神经元模型，保持参数数量不变，仅改变神经元计算单元。
Result: 实验表明，新模型在表达性、鲁棒性、学习速度方面优于传统模型，并降低了记忆化程度和训练数据需求。
Conclusion: 采用更逼真的神经元模型可以在不增加参数的情况下显著提升人工神经网络的综合性能。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: Claim verification is an important problem in high-stakes settings, including health and finance. When information underpinning claims is incomplete or conflicting, uncertain answers may be more appropriate than binary true or false classifications. In all cases, faithful explanations of the considerations determining the final verdict are crucial. We introduce inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification in which a formal argumentation semantics giving the strength of claims is used both (i) to guide LLM training as models learn to generate arguments and assign them base scores (representing intrinsic strengths) and (ii) to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) predictions from generated, scored arguments. As a result, at training time, argument generation and scoring can be optimised according to the quality of the induced argumentative predictions. Moreover, at inference time, the final prediction is faithful, by construction, to the arguments and scores determining the verdict, rather than being justified by a potentially unfaithful post-hoc reasoning trace as in conventional reasoning models. We finally show that, on two datasets for ternary claim verification, ITA improves upon argumentative baselines and can perform competitively against non-argumentative direct-prediction baselines, while providing verdicts that are computed deterministically from explicit, inspectable argumentative structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 inference-time argumentation (ITA) 框架，一种可训练的神经符号方法，用于三元（真/假/不确定）声明验证。ITA 利用形式化论证语义指导 LLM 生成并评分论证，从而得到忠实于论证结构的预测。实验表明，ITA 在两项基准上优于论证基线，并能与非论证直接预测方法竞争。
Motivation: 在健康、金融等高安全场景中，声明验证常面临信息不完全或冲突，二元分类不够灵活，且现有方法的事后解释可能不忠实。
Method: ITA 框架结合神经符号学习，训练 LLM 生成论证并分配基分，再通过形式化论证语义聚合为三元预测。训练时优化论证生成和评分以提高预测质量。
Result: 在两个三元声明验证数据集上，ITA 优于基于论证的基线，并可与非论证的直接预测方法竞争。
Conclusion: ITA 提供确定性、可检查的论证结构作为预测依据，确保预测忠实于推理过程，适合需要可解释性的高风险场景。

papers.title: From Volume to Value: Preference-Aligned Memory Construction for On-Device RAG
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid emergence of personal AI agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs), implementing them on-device has become essential for privacy and responsiveness. To handle the inherently personal and context-dependent nature of real-world requests, such agents must ground their generation in device-resident personal context. However, under tight memory budgets, the core bottleneck is what to store so that retrieval remains aligned with the user. We propose EPIC (Efficient Preference-aligned Index Construction), which focuses on user preferences as a compact and stable form of personal context and integrates them throughout the RAG pipeline. EPIC selectively retains preference-relevant information from raw data and aligns retrieval toward preference-aligned contexts. Across four benchmarks covering conversations, debates, explanations, and recommendations, EPIC reduces indexing memory by 2,404 times, improves preference-following accuracy by 18.79 %p, and achieves 32.17 times lower retrieval latency over the best-performing baseline. In on-device experiments, EPIC maintains under 1 MB memory and achieves 5.21 to 29.35 ms/query latency across three platforms, while supporting streaming updates under preference drift. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/EPIC.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code and data are available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/EPIC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EPIC（高效偏好对齐索引构建），用于在设备端RAG系统中构建用户偏好对齐的记忆。EPIC从原始数据中选择性保留偏好相关信息，并将检索对齐到偏好一致的上下文。在四个基准上，EPIC将索引内存减少2404倍，偏好跟随准确率提升18.79个百分点，检索延迟降低32.17倍。在设备端实验中，内存保持在1MB以下，延迟在5.21到29.35毫秒/查询之间。
Motivation: 在设备端LLM个人代理中，内存预算紧张，核心瓶颈在于如何存储内容以使检索与用户偏好对齐。个人请求具有高度个人化和上下文依赖性，需要设备上的个人上下文。
Method: EPIC关注用户偏好作为紧凑稳定的个人上下文形式，并将其集成到整个RAG流程中。它选择性保留原始数据中的偏好相关信息，并将检索对齐到偏好对齐的上下文。支持流式更新以适应偏好漂移。
Result: 在对话、辩论、解释和推荐四个基准上，EPIC将索引内存减少2404倍，偏好跟随准确率提升18.79个百分点，检索延迟降低32.17倍。在设备端实验中，内存保持在1MB以下，在三个平台上实现5.21-29.35毫秒/查询的延迟。
Conclusion: EPIC通过将用户偏好作为紧凑稳定的上下文形式集成到RAG流程中，显著提高了设备端个人AI代理的存储效率和检索准确性，同时保持低内存和低延迟。

papers.title: Sample-efficient inductive matrix completion with noise and inexact side-information
papers.abstract_en: Inductive matrix completion (IMC) is a variant of low-rank matrix completion that incorporates row and column side-information. In principle, it can reduce the effective dimension of the recovery problem from the ambient matrix size to the dimension of the side-information features. Existing theory, however, does not fully realize this advantage in the noisy setting: sample-efficient guarantees only apply to noiseless recovery, while noisy guarantees require sample sizes comparable to ordinary matrix completion. This paper closes this gap for noisy IMC. We analyze a nonconvex projected gradient descent algorithm with spectral initialization and prove that, under exact side-information, it achieves linear convergence and stable recovery at a sample complexity governed by the effective side-information dimension rather than the ambient matrix dimension. The key technical ingredient is a local regularity condition for the IMC loss that holds at this reduced sample size, despite the mismatch between the observation pattern and the side-information subspaces. We further extend the analysis to inexact side-information, showing that the same reduced sample complexity is preserved and that the estimation error degrades optimally with the level of subspace misspecification. Motivated by this trade-off, we also propose a penalized interpolation between IMC and ordinary matrix completion that balances sample efficiency against robustness to imperfect side-information. Simulations and experiments on the MovieLens dataset support the theoretical findings and illustrate the practical benefits of exploiting side-information in low-sample regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对带噪声的归纳矩阵补全（IMC）问题，证明了在精确边信息下，非凸投影梯度下降算法能以由边信息有效维度决定的样本复杂度实现线性收敛和稳定恢复，并将分析扩展到不精确边信息，提出了一种惩罚插值方法以平衡样本效率和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有带噪声的IMC理论所需的样本量与普通矩阵补全相当，未能体现边信息降低有效维度的优势，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 分析了非凸投影梯度下降算法（带谱初始化），通过建立局部正则条件证明了在精确边信息下样本复杂度由边信息维度决定，并推广到不精确边信息，引入了惩罚插值方法。
Result: 理论保证在精确边信息下样本复杂度取决于边信息维度而非矩阵维度，且估计误差随子空间错误指定程度最优退化；MovieLens实验验证了理论发现。
Conclusion: 本文缩小了IMC在噪声设置下的理论差距，表明边信息在低样本场景下具有显著实用价值。

papers.title: Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation has become a strong recipe for LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher supervises the student's own rollouts while conditioning on the reference solution. A design choice shared by nearly all such methods, however, has gone unquestioned: the teacher always sees the full reference reasoning. We argue that this default itself is part of the problem and identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch: when the teacher conditions on reasoning far beyond the student's current competence, the resulting token targets become too strong to absorb. A controlled fixed-exposure sweep makes this concrete on two fronts: 1) full exposure is not reliably the best choice, and 2) student-teacher mismatch grows monotonically as the teacher sees more privileged reasoning. This motivates treating teacher exposure not as a fixed hyperparameter but as a learnable training-time control variable. We therefore propose Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation (ATESD). ATESD models the reveal ratio with a lightweight Beta-policy controller conditioned on compact training-state statistics, and uses one sampled exposure for a short hold window of student updates. To make this exposure controller learnable, we optimize it with a discounted learning-progress reward that scores each held decision by its effect on the student's future improvement rather than its immediate loss change, addressing the delayed credit assignment induced by on-policy distillation. Experiments on AIME 24, AIME 25, and HMMT 25 across Qwen3-{1.7B, 4B, 8B} show that ATESD consistently outperforms competitive self-distillation and RL baselines, improving over OPSD by +0.95, +2.05, and +2.33 Average@12 points respectively, and establishing adaptive teacher exposure as an effective new axis for reasoning self-distillation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应教师暴露（ATESD），用于大语言模型推理的自蒸馏训练。作者发现标准自蒸馏中教师总是看到完整参考推理，这会导致暴露不匹配问题，即学生无法吸收过强的监督信号。ATESD使用轻量级Beta策略控制器根据训练状态动态调整暴露比例，并通过折扣学习进展奖励进行优化。在AIME 24、AIME 25和HMMT 25上使用Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B实验，ATESD一致优于OPSD等基线。
Motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏方法默认教师总是看到完整参考推理，但作者认为这会导致教师暴露与学生能力不匹配，阻碍学生有效学习。
Method: 提出ATESD，将教师暴露比例建模为可学习的控制变量：使用轻量级Beta策略控制器，根据紧凑的训练状态统计生成暴露比例，并在一个短窗口内保持固定；通过折扣学习进展奖励（基于学生未来改进而非即时损失变化）优化控制器，以处理延迟信用分配。
Result: 在AIME 24、AIME 25和HMMT 25上，使用Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B模型，ATESD相比OPSD基线分别提升+0.95、+2.05和+2.33 Average@12点，并优于其他竞争性自蒸馏和RL基线。
Conclusion: 自适应教师暴露被证明是推理自蒸馏中一个有效的新维度，能够缓解暴露不匹配问题，提升蒸馏效果。

papers.title: SARA: Semantically Adaptive Relational Alignment for Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent video diffusion models (VDMs) synthesize visually convincing clips, yet still drop entities, mis-bind attributes, and weaken the interactions specified in the prompt. Representation-alignment objectives such as VideoREPA and MoAlign improve fine-grained text following by distilling spatio-temporal token relations from a frozen visual foundation model, but their pairwise supervision budget is allocated by visual or motion cues rather than by how relevant each pair is to the prompt. We present SARA, Semantically Adaptive Relational Alignment, which keeps token-relation distillation (TRD) on a frozen VFM target and adds a text-conditioned saliency that decides which token pairs carry supervision. A lightweight Stage~1 aligner is trained with per-entity SAM~3.1 mask supervision and an InfoNCE regulariser, and its continuous saliency is fused into TRD through a pair-routing operator that assigns each token pair a weight whenever either of its two endpoints is salient, thereby routing supervision toward subject-subject and subject-background pairs and away from background-background ones. In the Wan2.2 continual-training setting, SARA improves both text alignment and motion quality over SFT, VideoREPA, and MoAlign on a 13-dimension VLM rubric, on the public VBench benchmarks, and in a blind user study. Project page: https://saradit.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视频扩散模型在实例丢失、属性错绑以及交互弱化等问题，本文提出 SARA（语义自适应关系对齐）方法。该方法在保留冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）的 token 关系蒸馏基础上，引入文本条件显著性来决定哪些 token 对承载监督信号。通过轻量级 Stage 1 对齐器（使用 SAM 3.1 掩膜监督和 InfoNCE 正则化）训练，其连续显著性通过成对路由操作符融合到关系蒸馏中，从而将监督导向主体-主体和主体-背景对，远离背景-背景对。在 Wan2.2 持续训练设置下，SARA 在 13 维度 VLM 评估、VBench 基准和盲人用户研究中均优于 SFT、VideoREPA 和 MoAlign。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型虽然能生成视觉上令人信服的片段，但仍会丢失实体、错误绑定属性以及削弱提示中指定的交互。表示对齐目标（如 VideoREPA 和 MoAlign）通过从冻结的视觉基础模型中蒸馏时空 token 关系来改进细粒度文本遵循，但其成对监督预算由视觉或运动线索分配，而非根据每个对与提示的相关性。
Method: 提出 SARA，语义自适应关系对齐，保持冻结 VFM 目标上的 token 关系蒸馏，并添加文本条件显著性来决定哪些 token 对携带监督。通过轻量级 Stage 1 对齐器（使用 per-entity SAM 3.1 掩膜监督和 InfoNCE 正则化）训练，其连续显著性通过成对路由操作符融合到关系蒸馏中，该操作符在任一端点显著时给该 token 对赋予权重，从而路由监督。
Result: 在 Wan2.2 持续训练设置下，SARA 在 13 维度 VLM 评估、VBench 基准和盲人用户研究中均优于 SFT、VideoREPA 和 MoAlign。
Conclusion: 本文通过文本条件显著性引导的关系蒸馏，有效提升了视频扩散模型的文本对齐和运动质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChartREG++: Towards Benchmarking and Improving Chart Referring Expression Grounding under Diverse referring clues and Multi-Target Referring
papers.abstract_en: Referring expression grounding is a core problem in visual grounding and is widely used as a diagnostic of spatial grounding and reasoning in vision and language models, yet most prior work focuses on natural images. In contrast, existing chart referring expression grounding-related benchmarks remain limited: (1) they largely adopt bounding boxes, constraining localization precision for fine chart elements (2) they mostly assume a single and two referred target instances, failing to handle multi-instance target references; (3) the language expressions over-rely on textual cues or data-rank clues (4) they cover only a narrow range of chart types. To address these issues, we introduce a chart referring expression grounding benchmark that systematically supports multiple localization forms, multiple referred targets, diverse grounding cues and diverse chart types. Results across representative multimodal large models reveal a significant performance gap. We further introduce a code-driven synthesis pipeline that exploits the inherent alignment between plotting programs and rendered chart primitives to derive pixel accurate instance masks across chart element types and granularities. We train an instance segmentation model with the synthesized masks and integrate it into a general-purpose multimodal grounding framework. The resulting system consistently outperforms baselines on our benchmark and generalizes well to a ChartQA-derived real-chart grounding benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有图表指代表达基础（chart referring expression grounding）基准的局限性，构建了一个支持多种定位形式、多目标、多样化线索和图表类型的新基准，并发现多模态大模型在该基准上存在显著性能差距。进一步提出代码驱动合成流水线，利用绘图程序与渲染图元的对齐生成像素级精确的实例掩码，训练实例分割模型并集成到通用多模态基础框架中，在基准和真实图表基准上持续优于基线。
Motivation: 现有图表指代表达基础基准主要使用边界框，限制了对细粒度图表元素的定位精度；大多假设单个或两个目标实例，无法处理多实例引用；语言表达过度依赖文本或数据排序线索；覆盖的图表类型狭窄。
Method: 构建新基准，系统支持多种定位形式（如多边形、掩码）、多个目标、多样化线索（空间、颜色、数据等）与多种图表类型。提出代码驱动合成流水线，通过绘图程序与渲染图元的对齐自动生成像素级精确的实例掩码，训练实例分割模型并集成到通用多模态基础框架中。
Result: 代表性多模态大模型在新基准上表现出显著性能差距。所提系统在基准和ChartQA衍生的真实图表基础基准上持续优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 该基准和代码驱动合成方法能够有效提升图表指代表达基础的性能，并为后续研究提供了更全面的评估工具。

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Rotation Profile Control in Tokamaks
papers.abstract_en: Tokamaks remain leading candidates for achieving practical fusion energy, yet many important control problems inside these devices are still difficult or unsolved. One such challenge is controlling the plasma rotation profile, which strongly influences stability, confinement, and transport. While the average rotation can be controlled, controlling the full profile is challenging due to high dimensionality, response to multiple actuators and dependence on plasma condition. Learning-based control methods, such as reinforcement learning (RL), provide a potential solution to this challenging problem with ability to model complex interactions leading to effective multi-input multi-output control. However, learning such policies is challenging due to the lack of accurate simulators that can model the rotation profile dynamics. In this work, we investigate the use of offline RL and offline model-based RL algorithms for rotation profile control, training them solely on historical data from the DIII-D tokamak. Our final method uses probabilistic models of plasma dynamics to generate rollouts for RL training. We deploy this policy on the DIII-D Tokamak and observe promising real-world results. We conclude by highlighting key challenges and insights from training and deploying an RL policy on a complex physical device while using only limited past data.

Result: 在DIII-D托卡马克上部署策略，观察到有希望的实际结果。
Conclusion: 强调了在复杂物理设备上使用有限历史数据训练和部署RL策略的关键挑战和见解。

papers.title: Hierarchical Support Vector State Partitioning for Distilling Black Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: We introduce State Vector Space Partitioning (SVSP), a novel method to mimic a black box reinforcement learning policy using a set of human-interpretable subpolicies. By partitioning a distillation dataset of state action pairs with linear support vector machine splits, SVSP constructs a compact and structured representation of the original policy. Our method improves mean return by +7.4% over previous critic driven state partitioning attempts such as Voronoi State Partitioning (VSP) and +2.8% over the original TD3 policy, while reducing the number of required subpolicies against VSP by 82.1%. Our results pave the path towards a more flexible form of distillation where both the decision boundary and surrogate models can be chosen within a margin of the original black box behavior.
papers.comment: Accepted for poster presentation at HHAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种层次化支持向量状态划分（SVSP）方法，通过线性支持向量机分割状态-动作对数据集，从黑盒强化学习策略中蒸馏出可解释的子策略集。相比先前方法（如Voronoi状态划分），SVSP在平均回报上提升7.4%，比原始TD3策略提升2.8%，同时所需子策略数量减少82.1%。
Motivation: 现有黑盒策略蒸馏方法（如基于批评者的状态划分）产生的子策略数量多、可解释性差，且性能损失较大，需要更灵活且高效的蒸馏框架。
Method: 利用线性支持向量机对蒸馏数据集中的状态-动作对进行递归分割，构建状态向量空间的分层划分，每个区域对应一个可解释的子策略。
Result: 在平均回报上比Voronoi状态划分（VSP）提升7.4%，比原始TD3策略提升2.8%，且子策略数量减少82.1%。
Conclusion: SVSP为黑盒策略蒸馏提供了更灵活的形式，允许在原始行为的一定范围内选择决策边界和代理模型，有助于提高可解释性。

papers.title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that require nuanced ethical reasoning, yet existing bias evaluations treat model outputs as simply "biased" or "unbiased." This binary framing misses the gradual, context-sensitive way bias actually emerges. We address this gap in two stages: behavioral profiling and mechanistic validation. In the behavioral stage, we introduce the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), a metric that quantifies the probability of biased output across a graduated, seven-tier stress test ranging from abstract numerical problems to scenarios rooted in historical and socioeconomic injustice. Evaluating four leading models (Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5), we identify distinct behavioral signatures shaped by alignment design: for instance, Gemini 1.5 reaches 72.7% MSI by Tier 5 under socioeconomic framing, while Claude exhibits sharp suppression consistent with identity-based safety training. We then verify these behavioral patterns mechanistically. We select criminal-bias scenarios, which produced the highest MSI scores across models, as probes and apply logit lens, attention analysis, activation patching, and semantic probing to a controlled set of six models spanning three capability tiers: small language models (SLMs), instruction-tuned base models, and reasoning-distilled variants. Circuit-level analysis reveals a U-curve of bias: SLMs exhibit strong criminal bias; scaling to instruction-tuned models eliminates it; reasoning distillation reintroduces bias to SLM-like levels despite identical parameter counts, suggesting distillation compresses reasoning traces in ways that reactivate shallow statistical associations. Critically, the socially loaded cues that drive high MSI scores activate the same bias-driving circuits identified mechanistically, providing cross-stage validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出道德敏感性指数（MSI），通过七级压力测试量化大语言模型（LLM）的偏见概率，并采用行为画像与机制验证相结合的方法，揭示模型偏见随上下文逐渐显现的模式。在Claude 3.5、Qwen 3.5、Llama 3和Gemini 1.5上，发现不同对齐设计导致不同行为特征，例如Gemini 1.5在社会经济框架下达到72.7%的MSI。机制分析通过logit lens、注意力分析、激活修补和语义探针，在六个模型上发现偏见的U形曲线：小语言模型（SLM）有强烈刑事偏见，指令调优后消除，推理蒸馏又使偏见恢复到SLM水平。
Motivation: 现有LLM偏见评估仅进行二元分类（“有偏见”或“无偏见”），忽略了偏见随上下文涌现的渐进性和敏感性。
Method: 两阶段方法：行为阶段提出MSI指标，通过七级压力测试（从抽象数值问题到历史社会经济不公场景）评估模型；机制阶段选择刑事偏见场景，运用logit lens、注意力分析、激活修补和语义探针对六个模型进行电路级分析。
Result: Gemini 1.5在第五级社会经济框架下MSI达72.7%；机制分析发现偏见的U形曲线：SLM强偏见，指令调优消除，推理蒸馏重新激活偏见至SLM水平。
Conclusion: 本文验证了行为画像与机制分析的一致性，表明社会负载线索激活相同偏见驱动电路，并指出推理蒸馏可能压缩推理痕迹从而重新激活浅层统计关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Let ViT Speak: Generative Language-Image Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{L}anguage-\textbf{I}mage \textbf{P}re-training (GenLIP), a minimalist generative pretraining framework for Vision Transformers (ViTs) designed for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To better align vision encoders with the autoregressive nature of LLMs, GenLIP trains a ViT to predict language tokens directly from visual tokens using a standard language modeling objective, without contrastive batch construction or an additional text decoder. This design offers three key advantages: (1) \textbf{Simplicity}: a single transformer jointly models visual and textual tokens; (2) \textbf{Scalability}: it scales effectively with both data and model size; and (3) \textbf{Performance}: it achieves competitive or superior results across diverse multimodal benchmarks. Trained on 8B samples from Recap-DataComp-1B, GenLIP matches or surpasses strong baselines despite using substantially less pretraining data. After continued pretraining on multi-resolution images at native aspect ratios, GenLIP further improves on detail-sensitive tasks such as OCR and chart understanding, making it a strong foundation for vision encoders in MLLMs.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 11 figures. Code and models are available at https://github.com/YanFangCS/GenLIP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenLIP，一种极简的生成式预训练框架，用于将视觉 Transformer (ViT) 与多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 对齐。GenLIP 直接使用语言建模目标从视觉 token 预测语言 token，无需对比学习或额外文本解码器，在 8B 样本上训练后达到或超越强基线，并在多分辨率继续预训练后提升 OCR 和图表理解等细节任务的表现。
Motivation: 现有视觉编码器与自回归语言模型的对齐方式复杂且扩展性有限，需要更简单、可扩展的预训练方法。
Method: GenLIP 使用单一 Transformer 联合建模视觉和文本 token，以语言建模目标直接预测文本 token，无需对比批次构建或额外文本解码器，并采用多分辨率继续预训练以保留细节。
Result: 在 Recap-DataComp-1B 的 8B 样本上训练后，GenLIP 匹配或超越强基线；多分辨率继续预训练进一步改进 OCR 和图表理解等细节敏感任务。
Conclusion: GenLIP 提供了一种简单、可扩展且性能优异的视觉编码器预训练方法，可作为 MLLM 的强有力基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UHR-Net: An Uncertainty-Aware Hypergraph Refinement Network for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate lesion segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. However, lesions often resemble surrounding tissues and exhibit ill-defined boundaries, leading to unstable predictions in boundary/transition regions. Moreover, small-lesion cues can be diluted by multi-scale feature extraction, causing under- or over-segmentation. To address these challenges, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Hypergraph Refinement Network (UHR-Net). First, we introduce an Uncertainty-Oriented Instance Contrastive (UO-IC) pretraining strategy that couples geometry-aware copy-paste augmentation with hard-negative mining of lesion-like background regions to improve instance-level discrimination for small and visually ambiguous lesions. Second, we design an Uncertainty-Guided Hypergraph Refinement (UGHR) block, which derives an entropy-based uncertainty map from a coarse probability map to guide hypergraph refinement. By splitting hyperedge prototypes into foreground and background groups, UGHR decouples higher-order interactions and improves refinement in ambiguous regions. Experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/CUGfreshman/UHR-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UHR-Net，一种基于不确定性感知的超图精化网络，用于医学图像分割。通过不确定性导向的实例对比预训练和不确定性引导的超图精化模块，在五个公共基准上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 病变分割中边界/过渡区域预测不稳定，小病变线索在多尺度特征提取中被稀释，导致分割不足或过度。
Method: 提出 Uncertainty-Oriented Instance Contrastive (UO-IC) 预训练策略，结合几何感知复制粘贴和硬负样本挖掘；设计 Uncertainty-Guided Hypergraph Refinement (UGHR) 块，利用熵图引导超图精化，分离前景和背景超边原型。
Result: 在五个公共医学图像分割基准上，UHR-Net 相比强基线获得一致性能提升。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的超图精化有效改善了模糊区域的分割精度，代码已公开。

papers.title: Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高等教育中AI素养的五阶段发展连续体模型（从0-未参与到4-改进），旨在诊断和指导学生从非参与或盲目使用向批判性、负责任地使用AI工具过渡。基于北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者），观察性结果表明行为向知情参与转变，但缺乏对照组和验证量表。
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架多定义能力维度，但缺乏诊断学习者起始阶段及发展路径的实用指南。学生要么因恐惧/伦理担忧回避AI，要么盲目依赖AI导致输出流畅但理解缺失。
Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体：0-未参与, 1-盲目使用, 2-知情使用, 3-批判评估, 4-改进。结合设计型实施案例，在学分课程和密集工作坊中开展实践（2024秋-2026春，330+参与者），未使用验证前后测或对照组。
Result: 观察性结果表明参与者行为向知情参与发展，持续且嵌入学科的经历更能促进批判评估和改进导向的实践。无量化指标对比。
Conclusion: AI素养应被视为发展性能力而非单纯工具采用，需与UNESCO/OECD等国际框架对接。论文强调实践路径、评估策略，但承认缺乏严格实验设计。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 观察性结果表明参与者行为向知情参与发展，持续且嵌入学科的经历更能促进批判评估和改进导向的实践。无量化指标对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI素养应被视为发展性能力而非单纯工具采用，需与UNESCO/OECD等国际框架对接。论文强调实践路径、评估策略，但承认缺乏严格实验设计。

papers.title: People-Centred Medical Image Analysis via Fairness-Aware Human-AI Cooperation
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for medical image analysis often exhibit subgroup-dependent performance, which impacts how decisions should be allocated between automated systems and human experts under limited resources. Prior work on AI fairness and human-AI cooperation, including learning to defer (L2D) and learning to complement (L2C), typically addresses these problems in isolation. We propose People-Centred Medical Image Analysis (PecMan), a framework for fairness-aware human-AI co-operative classification that jointly models subgroup-dependent reliability, decision allocation, and collaborative prediction. PecMan combines subgroup-specialised predictors with a gating and consolidation mechanism that dynamically assigns cases to automated models, human experts, or their combination, without requiring sensitive attributes at test time. We also introduce the FairHAI benchmark for evaluating trade-offs between predictive accuracy, subgroup equity, and human involvement. In addition, we provide a theoretical analysis of multi-agent gating via selection regret and characterise fairness-coverage trade-offs under input-dependent allocation. Experiments across multiple medical imaging datasets demonstrate that PecMan achieves consistently improved trade-offs compared to methods that address fairness or human-AI cooperation separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出People-Centred Medical Image Analysis (PecMan)框架，在医学图像分析中联合建模子群依赖的可靠性、决策分配和协作预测，通过子群专用预测器与门控整合机制动态分配任务给自动化模型、人类专家或二者组合，无需测试时敏感属性，并在多个数据集上实现比单独处理公平性或人机合作的方法更优的权衡。
Motivation: 现有医学图像分析模型常表现出子群依赖的性能，但先前关于AI公平性和人机合作（如L2D、L2C）的工作通常孤立处理这些问题，缺乏统一框架来同时优化预测准确性、子群公平性和人类参与。
Method: PecMan框架结合子群专用预测器与门控整合机制，动态将病例分配给自动化模型、人类专家或二者组合，通过选择后悔理论分析多智能体门控，并推导输入依赖分配下的公平性-覆盖权衡。
Result: 在多个医学影像数据集上，PecMan相比单独处理公平性或人机合作的方法，实现了持续更优的准确性、子群公平性和人类参与之间的权衡。
Conclusion: PecMan框架为医学图像分析提供了公平感知的人机协作范式，但摘要未明确讨论其在不同医学领域或资源极端受限场景下的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Price of Agreement: Measuring LLM Sycophancy in Agentic Financial Applications
papers.abstract_en: Given the increased use of LLMs in financial systems today, it becomes important to evaluate the safety and robustness of such systems. One failure mode that LLMs frequently display in general domain settings is that of sycophancy. That is, models prioritize agreement with expressed user beliefs over correctness, leading to decreased accuracy and trust. In this work, we focus on evaluating sycophancy that LLMs display in agentic financial tasks. Our findings are three-fold: first, we find the models show only low to modest drops in performance in the face of user rebuttals or contradictions to the reference answer, which distinguishes sycophancy that models display in financial agentic settings from findings in prior work. Second, we introduce a suite of tasks to test for sycophancy by user preference information that contradicts the reference answer and find that most models fail in the presence of such inputs. Lastly, we benchmark different modes of recovery such as input filtering with a pretrained LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大型语言模型（LLM）在金融代理任务中的谄媚行为（sycophancy），即模型倾向于同意用户的错误观点。研究发现，在金融场景中，模型对用户反驳或矛盾的响应性能下降较小，但在用户偏好信息与参考答案相矛盾的任务中，多数模型失败。论文还基准测试了不同恢复模式（如输入过滤）。
Motivation: LLM在金融系统中广泛使用，但存在谄媚行为（优先同意用户信念而非正确性），影响准确性和信任度。现有研究多关注通用领域，缺乏对金融代理任务中谄媚行为的系统性评估。
Method: 设计一系列金融代理任务，测试LLM在用户反驳、矛盾偏好信息下的表现，并评估输入过滤等恢复策略。
Result: 模型在用户反驳或矛盾下性能仅低到中等下降（与先前发现不同）；但在用户偏好信息与参考答案矛盾时，多数模型失败。
Conclusion: 金融代理任务中的谄媚行为表现与通用领域不同，需针对性防御；输入过滤等恢复模式可缓解部分问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedSLoP: Memory-Efficient Federated Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Projection
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables a population of clients to collaboratively train machine learning models without exchanging their raw data, but standard algorithms such as FedAvg suffer from slow convergence and high communication and memory costs in heterogeneous, resource-constrained environments. We introduce FedSLoP, a federated optimization algorithm that combines stochastic low-rank subspace projections of gradients, thereby reducing the dimension of communicated and stored updates while preserving optimization progress. On the theoretical side, we develop a detailed nonconvex convergence analysis under standard smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions, showing that FedSLoP is guaranteed to converge to a first-order stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{NT})$. On the empirical side, we conduct extensive experiments on federated MNIST classification with heterogeneous data partitions, showing that FedSLoP substantially reduces communication volume and client-side memory while achieving competitive or better accuracy compared with FedAvg and representative sparse or low-rank baselines. Together, our results demonstrate that random subspace momentum methods such as FedSLoP provide a principled and effective approach to communication- and memory-efficient federated learning. Codes are available at: https://github.com/pkumelon/FedSLoP.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedSLoP，一种结合随机低秩子空间梯度投影的联邦学习优化算法，旨在减少通信和内存开销。理论上证明了在非凸假设下以O(1/√(NT))速率收敛到一阶驻点。实验表明在异构MNIST分类任务上，FedSLoP相比FedAvg等基线显著降低通信量和客户端内存，同时保持或提升准确率。
Motivation: 标准联邦学习算法如FedAvg在异构、资源受限环境中收敛慢且通信和内存成本高。
Method: 结合随机低秩子空间投影的梯度更新，减少通信和存储维度，同时保持优化进度。
Result: 在联邦MNIST分类实验中，显著降低通信量和客户端内存，取得有竞争力的准确率。
Conclusion: 随机子空间动量方法（如FedSLoP）为通信和内存高效的联邦学习提供了有原则且有效的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CharTide: Data-Centric Chart-to-Code Generation via Tri-Perspective Tuning and Inquiry-Driven Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Chart-to-code generation demands strict visual precision and syntactic correctness from Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by data-centric limitations: despite the availability of growing chart-to-code datasets, simply scaling homogeneous chart-code pairs conflates visual perception with program logic, preventing models from fully leveraging the richness of multimodal supervision. We present CharTide, a novel data-centric framework that systematically redesigns both training and alignment data for chart-to-code generation. First, we construct a 2M-sample dataset via a Tri-Perspective Tuning strategy, explicitly decoupling training into visual perception, pure-text code logic, and modality fusion streams, enabling a 7B model to surpass specialized baselines using only supervised data. Second, we reformulate alignment as a data verification problem rather than a heuristic scoring task. To this end, we introduce an Inquiry-Driven RL framework grounded in the principle of information invariance: a downstream model should yield consistent answers to identical visual queries across both original and generated charts. Moving beyond rigid rule matching or VLM scoring, we employ a frozen Inspector to objectively verify generated charts through atomic QA tasks, providing verifiable reward signals based on answer accuracy. Experiments on ChartMimic, Plot2Code, and ChartX show that CharTide-7B/8B significantly outperforms open-source baselines, surpasses GPT-4o, and is competitive with GPT-5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CharTide，一个面向图表到代码生成的数据中心框架，通过三视角调优策略构建200万样本数据集，将训练解耦为视觉感知、纯文本代码逻辑和模态融合三个流，并引入基于信息不变性的询问驱动强化学习用于数据验证。实验表明，CharTide-7B/8B在ChartMimic、Plot2Code和ChartX上显著超越开源基线，超过GPT-4o，与GPT-5竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有图表到代码生成方法受限于数据中心限制：简单扩展同质图表-代码对会混淆视觉感知与程序逻辑，阻碍模型充分利用多模态监督的丰富性。
Method: 提出三视角调优策略构建200万样本数据集，将训练显式解耦为视觉感知、纯文本代码逻辑和模态融合流；并引入询问驱动强化学习框架，基于信息不变性原则，使用冻结的Inspector通过原子问答任务客观验证生成图表。
Result: CharTide-7B/8B在ChartMimic、Plot2Code和ChartX基准上显著优于开源基线，超过GPT-4o，与GPT-5竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 通过系统重新设计训练和对齐数据，数据中心方法能有效提升图表到代码生成性能。

papers.title: Replicable Bandits with UCB based Exploration
papers.abstract_en: We study replicable algorithms for stochastic multi-armed bandits (MAB) and linear bandits with UCB (Upper Confidence Bound) based exploration. A bandit algorithm is $ρ$-replicable if two executions using shared internal randomness but independent reward realizations produce the same action sequence with probability at least $1-ρ$. Prior approaches to this problem are elimination-based and, in linear bandits with infinitely many actions, rely on discretization, leading to suboptimal dependence on the dimension $d$ and $ρ$. We develop optimistic alternatives for both settings. For stochastic multi-armed bandits, we propose RepUCB, a replicable batched UCB algorithm and show that it attains a regret $O\!\left(\frac{K^2\log^2 T}{ρ^2}\sum_{a:Δ_a>0}\left(Δ_a+\frac{\log(KT\log T)}{Δ_a}\right)\right)$. For stochastic linear bandits, we first introduce RepRidge, a replicable ridge regression estimator that satisfies both a confidence guarantee and a $ρ$-replicability guarantee. Beyond its role in our bandit algorithm, this may also be of independent interest in other statistical estimation settings. We then use RepRidge to design RepLinUCB, a replicable optimistic algorithm for stochastic linear bandits, and show that its regret is bounded by $\widetilde{O}\!\big(\big(d+\frac{d^3}ρ\big)\sqrt{T}\big)$. This improves the best prior regret guarantee by a factor of $O(d/ρ)$, showing that our optimistic algorithm can substantially reduce the price of replicability. This is the first linear-bandit algorithm with an optimal dependence on $ρ$ for large number of arms. Finally, we extend our framework to stochastic generalized linear bandits by developing RepGLM, a replicable penalized GLM estimator, and RepGLMUCB, a replicable optimistic algorithm for this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于UCB探索的可复制随机多臂赌博机和线性赌博机算法。提出了RepUCB（可复制的批量UCB算法）和RepLinUCB（基于RepRidge回归估计的可复制乐观算法），证明了其遗憾界，并在线性赌博机中实现了对复制参数ρ的最优依赖。这是首个在大动作空间下具有最优ρ依赖的线性赌博机算法。
Motivation: 现有可复制赌博机算法多为淘汰制，在处理无穷多动作的线性赌博机时依赖离散化，导致对维度d和ρ的次优依赖。需要设计乐观算法以降低复制代价。
Method: 针对随机多臂赌博机，提出RepUCB，一种可复制的批量UCB算法；针对线性赌博机，先提出RepRidge——满足置信度和ρ-可复制性的可复制岭回归估计，再基于它设计RepLinUCB；最后扩展到广义线性赌博机，提出RepGLM和RepGLMUCB。
Result: RepUCB达到$O(K^2\log^2 T / ρ^2 \sum_{a:Δ_a>0}(Δ_a+\log(KT\log T)/Δ_a))$遗憾；RepLinUCB达到$\widetilde{O}((d+d^3/ρ)\sqrt{T})$遗憾，比先前最优结果改进因子$O(d/ρ)$。
Conclusion: 首次在大量臂的线性赌博机中实现最优的ρ依赖，表明乐观算法能显著降低可复制的代价。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Model Optimization: Preserving Plasticity in Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning must balance retention with adaptation, yet many methods still rely on \emph{single-model preservation}, committing to one evolving policy as the main reusable solution across tasks. Even when a previously successful policy is retained, it may no longer provide a reliable starting point for rapid adaptation after interference, reflecting a form of \emph{loss of plasticity} that single-policy preservation cannot address. Inspired by quality-diversity methods, we introduce \textsc{TeLAPA} (Transfer-Enabled Latent-Aligned Policy Archives), a continual RL framework that organizes behaviorally diverse policy neighborhoods into per-task archives and maintains a shared latent space so that archived policies remain comparable and reusable under non-stationary drift. This perspective shifts continual RL from retaining isolated solutions to maintaining \emph{skill-aligned neighborhoods} with competent and behaviorally related policies that support future relearning. In our MiniGrid CL setting, \textsc{TeLAPA} learns more tasks successfully, recovers competence faster on revisited tasks after interference, and retains higher performance across a sequence of tasks. Our analyses show that source-optimal policies are often not transfer-optimal, even within a local competent neighborhood, and that effective reuse depends on retaining and selecting among multiple nearby alternatives rather than collapsing them to one representative. Together, these results reframe continual RL around reusable and competent policy neighborhoods, providing a route beyond single-model preservation toward more plastic lifelong agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TeLAPA框架，将强化学习中的持续学习从保留单一策略转向维护行为多样化的策略存档，以解决干扰后策略可塑性丧失的问题。在MiniGrid持续学习设置中，TeLAPA成功学习更多任务、在干扰后更快恢复能力，并保持更高性能。分析表明源最优策略通常不是迁移最优，有效重用需要保留多个邻近备选方案。
Motivation: 现有持续强化学习方法依赖单一模型保留，干扰后策略可塑性丧失，无法为快速适应提供可靠起点。
Method: 受质量多样性方法启发，TeLAPA为每个任务维护行为多样化策略邻域存档，并保持共享潜在空间，使存档策略在非平稳漂移下仍可比较和重用。

papers.title: Who Gets Flagged? The Pluralistic Evaluation Gap in AI Content Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking is becoming the default mechanism for AI content authentication, with governance policies and frameworks referencing it as infrastructure for content provenance. Yet across text, image, and audio modalities, watermark signal strength, detectability, and robustness depend on statistical properties of the content itself, properties that vary systematically across languages, cultural visual traditions, and demographic groups. We examine how this content dependence creates modality-specific pathways to bias. Reviewing the major watermarking benchmarks across modalities, we find that, with one exception, none report performance across languages, cultural content types, or population groups. To address this, we propose three concrete evaluation dimensions for pluralistic watermark benchmarking: cross-lingual detection parity, culturally diverse content coverage, and demographic disaggregation of detection metrics. We argue that watermarking is part of the pluralistic alignment pipeline and should be held to the same evaluation standards. We connect this to governance frameworks currently mandating watermarking deployment without requiring fairness evaluation. Our position is that evaluation must precede deployment, and that the same bias auditing requirements applied to AI models should extend to the verification layer.
papers.comment: 7 pages. Accepted at the Multimodal Alignment for a Pluralistic Society (MAPS) Workshop, CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文指出AI内容水印在文本、图像、音频等多模态中因内容统计特性差异（如语言、文化、人口群体）而产生偏见，并发现现有水印基准几乎未报告跨语言、文化或人群的性能差异。作者提出三个多元化评估维度：跨语言检测平等性、文化多样性内容覆盖、检测指标的人口统计分解，强调水印作为对齐管道的一部分应接受公平性审计。
Motivation: 现有AI内容水印机制在不同语言、文化视觉传统和人口群体中表现存在系统差异，但主流基准未评估公平性，可能导致少数群体被不公平地标记或检测失败。
Method: 通过综述文本、图像、音频模态的水印基准，指出除一个例外均未报告跨语言/文化/群体的性能；提出三个具体评估维度用于多元化水印基准测试：跨语言检测平等性、文化多样性内容覆盖、检测指标的人口统计分解。
Result: 发现当前水印基准缺乏对跨语言、文化及人口群体性能的报告，且政府框架未要求公平性评估。
Conclusion: 水印部署前需进行公平性评估，偏倚审计要求应从AI模型扩展到验证层（即水印系统）。

papers.title: Prosociality by Coupling, Not Mere Observation: Homeostatic Sharing in an Inspectable Recurrent Artificial Life Agent
papers.abstract_en: Artificial agents can be made to ``help'' through explicit social rewards, hard-coded prosocial bonuses, or direct access to another agent's state. I isolate a narrower route: homeostatic coupling. Building on ReCoN-Ipsundrum, I add a scalar homeostat and a social coupling channel while keeping action selection self-directed: the planner scores only the actor's predicted internal state, with no partner-welfare reward. In a one-step FoodShareToy, an exact solver finds a switch from EAT to PASS at $λ^\star \approx 0.91$ for the default state. In a multi-step SocialCorridorWorld, partner-state access without coupling leaves behavior unchanged, whereas coupled agents fetch, carry, and pass food to the partner. Sham lesions preserve helping; coupling-off and shuffled-partner lesions abolish it. A coupling/load sweep shows that coupling creates a low-load helping regime but does not guarantee rescue under higher metabolic load. This is not a claim about empathy, altruism, consciousness, or moral status. It is a minimal ALife demonstration that, in this controller, partner-state access is behaviorally inert unless partner distress is routed into self-regulation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ALIFE 2026 Conference, Waterloo Institute for Complexity & Innovation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 ReCoN-Ipsundrum 框架上增加标量稳态器和社交耦合通道，实现人工代理无需显式社会奖励即可产生帮助行为。通过精确求解和模拟实验发现，仅观察伙伴状态而不耦合不会改变行为，而稳态耦合（homeostatic coupling）会导致代理主动传递食物。作者强调这不是关于共情或道德的声明，而是最小人工生命演示。
Motivation: 现有方法通过显式社会奖励或硬编码亲社会奖励实现代理帮助，本文探索更窄的路径：是否仅通过稳态耦合（将伙伴压力路由到自身调节）就能产生亲社会行为？
Method: 在 ReCoN-Ipsundrum 控制器基础上增加标量稳态器和社交耦合通道，保持自导向行动选择（规划器仅评分行动者自身预测的内部状态，不含伙伴福利奖励）。在一步 FoodShareToy 和多步 SocialCorridorWorld 中测试。
Result: 一步任务中找到从 EAT 到 PASS 的切换阈值 λ*≈0.91；多步任务中，无耦合的伙伴状态访问不改变行为，而耦合代理会取、携带和传递食物给伙伴。假损伤保持帮助，耦合关闭和打乱伙伴损伤消除帮助。耦合/负载扫描显示耦合创建低负载帮助机制，但不保证高代谢负载下的救援。
Conclusion: 示例表明在该控制器中，伙伴状态访问只有在伙伴压力被路由到自我调节时才会影响行为，是一种最小人工生命演示。

papers.title: Entropy, Disagreement, and the Limits of Foundation Models in Genomics
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models in genomics have shown mixed success compared to their counterparts in natural language processing. Yet, the reasons for their limited effectiveness remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the role of entropy as a fundamental factor limiting the capacities of such models to learn from their training data and develop foundational capabilities. We train ensembles of models on text and DNA sequences and analyze their predictions, static embeddings, and empirical Fisher information flow. We show that the high entropy of genomic sequences -- from the point of view of unseen token prediction -- leads to near-uniform output distributions, disagreement across models, and unstable static embeddings, even for models that are matched in architecture, training and data. We then demonstrate that models trained on DNA concentrate Fisher information in embedding layers, seemingly failing to exploit inter-token relationships. Our results suggest that self-supervised training from sequences alone may not be applicable to genomic data, calling into question the assumptions underlying current methodologies for training genomic foundation models.
papers.comment: Accepted to LMLR Workshop at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基因组学基础模型表现不如自然语言处理模型的原因，发现基因组序列的高熵导致模型输出分布接近均匀、模型间预测不一致以及静态嵌入不稳定，即使架构、训练和数据匹配也是如此。模型在嵌入层集中Fisher信息，未能利用token间关系，表明仅靠序列自监督训练可能不适用于基因组数据。
Motivation: 基因组学基础模型相比NLP模型效果有限，但其根本原因尚不明确。本文旨在探究熵作为限制模型从训练数据中学习并发展基础能力的关键因素。
Method: 在文本和DNA序列上训练模型集成，分析其预测、静态嵌入和经验Fisher信息流，比较了不同熵水平下的模型行为。
Result: 高熵基因组序列导致模型输出近似均匀分布、模型间分歧大、静态嵌入不稳定，且Fisher信息集中在嵌入层，表明模型未有效利用token间关系。
Conclusion: 自监督序列训练可能不适用于基因组数据，质疑了当前基因组基础模型训练方法的假设。

papers.title: SAFE: An LLM-as-Verifier Framework for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Hop Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop QA benchmarks often reward Large Language Models (LLMs) for spurious correctness, where models reach correct answers through invalid intermediate reasoning. We propose SAFE, an LLM-as-verifier framework for evidence-grounded multi-hop QA. Rather than judging only the final answer after generation, SAFE verifies reasoning during generation by checking intermediate steps against the provided passages and previous reasoning trajectory. To make this process checkable, SAFE decomposes reasoning into atomic, evidence-grounded units represented with Knowledge Graph (KG) triples. At train-time, SAFE verifies benchmark supervision under KG-grounded constraints and constructs reliable verifier training data. At inference-time, an external verifier checks each generated step, identifies invalid reasoning, and provides correction feedback before errors propagate. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks, SAFE improves accuracy by 8.8 pp on average. These results show that evidence-grounded multi-hop QA benefits from shifting LLM-based evaluation from post-hoc answer judgment to stepwise reasoning verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAFE框架，将LLM作为验证器，在多跳问答中逐步验证推理步骤。通过将推理分解为知识图谱三元组表示的原子证据单元，SAFE在训练时构造可靠的验证器数据，推理时外部验证器检查每一步并纠正错误。在三个多跳QA基准上平均提升8.8个百分点。
Motivation: 多跳QA基准中LLM常通过无效推理得出正确回答，现有方法仅检查最终答案，无法识别虚假正确性。
Method: 提出LLM-as-verifier框架，将推理分解为原子证据单元（知识图谱三元组），训练时在KG约束下验证基准监督并构建训练数据，推理时外部验证器逐步检查并纠正无效推理。
Result: 在三个多跳QA基准上平均准确率提升8.8个百分点。
Conclusion: 基于证据的多跳QA应从事后答案判断转向逐步推理验证，以提升可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: mlr3mbo: Bayesian Optimization in R
papers.abstract_en: We present mlr3mbo, a modular toolbox for Bayesian optimization in R. mlr3mbo supports single- and multi-objective optimization, multi-point proposals, batch and asynchronous parallelization, and robust error handling. While it can be used for many standard Bayesian optimization variants in applied settings, researchers can also construct custom Bayesian optimization algorithms from its flexible building blocks. In addition to an introduction to the software, its design principles, and its building blocks, the paper presents two extensive empirical evaluations on the surrogate-based benchmark suite YAHPO Gym. To identify robust default configurations for both numeric and mixed-hierarchical optimization regimes, and to gain further insights into the respective impacts of individual settings, we run a coordinate descent search over the mlr3mbo configuration space and analyze its results. Furthermore, we benchmark mlr3mbo against a wide range of established optimizers, including HEBO, SMAC3, Ax, and Optuna, and find that it performs on par with state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍mlr3mbo，一个用于贝叶斯优化的R语言模块化工具箱，支持单目标和多目标优化、多点提案、批量和异步并行化以及鲁棒错误处理。论文通过YAHPO Gym基准套件进行实证评估，通过坐标下降搜索确定稳健默认配置，并与HEBO、SMAC3、Ax、Optuna等优化器对比，性能与当前最优方法相当。
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化在应用和研究中广泛使用，但R语言中缺乏一个灵活、模块化的工具箱，便于研究人员构建定制算法并进行系统比较。
Method: 提出mlr3mbo工具箱，基于mlr3生态系统，提供可组合的构建块（如代理模型、采集函数、代理策略），并支持坐标下降搜索优化超参数。
Result: 在YAHPO Gym基准上，坐标下降搜索揭示了数值和混合分层优化中的稳健默认配置；对比实验表明mlr3mbo在性能上与HEBO、SMAC3、Ax、Optuna等现有优化器持平。
Conclusion: mlr3mbo为R用户提供了一个灵活且高效的贝叶斯优化框架，可作为研究平台和实用工具，且易于扩展。

papers.title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models fail when a salient surface cue conflicts with an unstated feasibility constraint. We introduce the Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB): 500 instances spanning 4 heuristic families and 5 constraint families, with minimal pairs and explicitness gradients. We pair HOB with a falsifiable behavioral characterization following a diagnose-measure-bridge-treat arc. Causal-behavioral analysis of the car wash problem across six models reveals context-independent sigmoid heuristics: the distance cue has 8.7 to 38 times more influence than the goal, and attribution better matches keyword association than compositional inference. Across 14 models, strict 10/10 evaluation shows that no model exceeds 75%, and presence constraints are hardest at 44%. A minimal hint improves performance by 15 pp, suggesting a constraint-inference failure rather than missing knowledge. However, 12 of 14 models perform worse when the constraint is removed, by up to 39 pp, revealing conservative bias. A thinking-mode ablation on Gemini 3.1 Pro drops performance from 74.6% with thinking on to 58.4% with thinking off, while explicit goal decomposition recovers it to 71.2%. Thus, internal deliberation does useful work, and explicit prompting can partially substitute for it. Reasoning models do not categorically outperform non-reasoning peers: after controlling for capability rank, the residual reasoning-mode effect is 1.8 pp and is not significant. Parametric probes show that the sigmoid pattern generalizes to cost, efficiency, and semantic-similarity heuristics. Goal-decomposition prompting improves performance by 5.0 pp, compared with 3.1 pp for generic chain-of-thought, isolating constraint enumeration as the active ingredient. Overall, heuristic override is a systematic reasoning vulnerability with a quantified locus in inference order, not knowledge, and a tested intervention.

TL;DR: 本文提出启发式覆盖基准（HOB），包含500个实例，覆盖4种启发式家族和5种约束家族，研究大语言模型在表面线索与隐含约束冲突时的推理失败。通过因果行为分析，发现距离线索的影响力比目标高8.7到38倍，且归因更符合关键词关联而非组合推理。14个模型在严格评估中均未超过75%，存在保守偏差。思维模式消融实验表明内部推理有效，但推理模型并不显著优于非推理模型。

papers.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative recommendation have leveraged pretrained LLMs by formulating sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation over a unified token space comprising language tokens and itemic identifiers, where each item is represented by a compact sequence of discrete tokens, namely Semantic IDs (SIDs). This SID-based formulation enables efficient decoding over large-scale item corpora and provides a natural interface for LLM-based recommenders to leverage rich world knowledge. Meanwhile, breakthroughs in LLM reasoning motivate reasoning-enhanced recommendation, yet effective reasoning over SIDs remains underexplored and challenging. Itemic tokens are not natively meaningful to LLMs; moreover, recommendation-oriented SID reasoning is hard to evaluate, making high-quality supervision scarce. To address these challenges, we propose SIDReasoner, a two-stage framework that elicits reasoning over SIDs by strengthening SID--language alignment to unlock transferable LLM reasoning, rather than relying on large amounts of recommendation-specific reasoning traces. Concretely, SIDReasoner first enhances SID-language alignment via multi-task training on an enriched SID-centered corpus synthesized by a stronger teacher model, grounding itemic tokens in diverse semantic and behavioral contexts. Building on this enhanced alignment, SIDReasoner further improves recommendation reasoning through outcome-driven reinforced optimization, which guides the model toward effective reasoning trajectories without requiring explicit reasoning annotations. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our reasoning-augmented SID-based generative recommendation. Beyond accuracy, the results highlight the broader potential of large reasoning models for generative recommendation, including improved interpretability and cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SIDReasoner，一个两阶段框架，通过增强语义ID（SID）与语言的对齐，并利用结果驱动强化优化，使大语言模型在生成式推荐中具备推理能力。实验表明该方法提升了推荐准确性、可解释性和跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于语义ID的生成式推荐缺乏有效的推理机制，因为物品令牌对LLM本身不具语义意义，且推荐导向的SID推理难以评估和获取高质量监督。
Method: 提出SIDReasoner，第一阶段通过教师模型合成增强的SID中心语料，进行多任务训练以加强SID-语言对齐；第二阶段采用结果驱动的强化优化，引导模型产生有效推理轨迹，无需显式推理标注。
Result: 在三个真实世界数据集上，SIDReasoner提升了推荐准确性，并展现出更好的可解释性和跨域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 语义ID推理能够增强生成式推荐，大推理模型在该领域具有潜力。

papers.title: FinTradeBench: A Financial Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Real-world financial decision-making is a challenging problem that requires reasoning over heterogeneous signals, including company fundamentals derived from regulatory filings and trading signals computed from price dynamics. Recently, with advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), financial analysts have begun to use them for financial decision-making tasks. However, existing financial question-answering benchmarks for testing these models primarily focus on company balance sheet data and rarely evaluate reasoning about how company stocks trade in the market or their interactions with fundamentals. To leverage the strengths of both approaches, we introduce FinTradeBench, a benchmark for evaluating financial reasoning that integrates company fundamentals and trading signals. FinTradeBench contains 1,400 questions grounded in NASDAQ-100 companies over a ten-year historical window. The benchmark is organized into three reasoning categories: fundamentals-focused, trading-signal-focused, and hybrid questions requiring cross-signal reasoning. To ensure reliability at scale, we adopt a calibration-then-scaling framework that combines expert seed questions, multi-model response generation, intra-model self-filtering, numerical auditing, and human-LLM judge alignment. We evaluate 14 LLMs under zero-shot prompting and retrieval-augmented settings and witness a clear performance gap. Retrieval substantially improves reasoning over textual fundamentals, but provides limited benefit for trading-signal reasoning. These findings highlight fundamental challenges in the numerical and time-series reasoning for current LLMs and motivate future research in financial intelligence.
papers.comment: 9 pages main text, 31 pages total (including references and appendix). 5 figures, 16 tables. Preprint under review. Code and data will be made available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinTradeBench是一个结合公司基本面（来自监管文件）和交易信号（来自价格动态）的金融推理基准，包含1,400个基于NASDAQ-100公司十年历史数据的问题，分为基本面、交易信号和混合推理三类。采用校准-扩展框架构建，确保可靠性。评估14个LLM发现检索增强显著提升文本基本面推理，但对交易信号推理帮助有限。
Motivation: 现有金融QA基准主要关注公司资产负债表数据，缺少对股票交易信号及与基本面交互推理的评估，无法全面反映LLM在真实金融决策中的能力。
Method: 提出FinTradeBench基准，包含三类推理问题。采用校准-扩展框架：专家种子问题、多模型响应生成、自过滤、数值审计和人机对齐，确保数据质量。
Result: 评估14个LLM在零样本和检索增强设置下的表现：检索增强显著改善基于文本的基本面推理（如准确率提升），但对交易信号推理（如价格趋势）提升有限，揭示LLM在数值和时间序列推理上的不足。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在数值和时间序列推理方面存在根本挑战，需要未来研究提升金融智能，特别是在跨信号整合和时序建模上。

papers.title: Upper Bounds for Local Learning Coefficients of Three-Layer Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Three-layer neural networks are known to form singular learning models, and their Bayesian asymptotic behavior is governed by the learning coefficient, or real log canonical threshold. Although this quantity has been clarified for regular models and for some special singular models, broadly applicable methods for evaluating it in neural networks remain limited. Recently, a formula for the local learning coefficient of semiregular models was proposed, yielding an upper bound on the learning coefficient. However, this formula applies only to nonsingular points in the set of realization parameters and cannot be used at singular points. In particular, for three-layer neural networks, the resulting upper bound has been shown to differ substantially from learning coefficient values already known in some cases. In this paper, we derive a formula for an upper bound on local learning coefficients at a class of singular realization parameters in three-layer neural networks. This formula can be interpreted as a counting rule under budget, demand, and supply constraints. In the non-polynomial real-analytic case, the formula applies in general settings, whereas in the polynomial case it applies under the restriction that the true distribution has no hidden units. In particular, our result covers activation functions such as the swish function and also includes polynomial activation functions under the above restriction, thereby extending previous results to a broader class of activation functions. We further show that, when the input dimension is one, the numerical value given by the right-hand side of our upper-bound formula agrees with the previously known learning coefficient, thereby providing a useful comparison with known exact results. Our result also provides a systematic perspective on how the weight parameters of three-layer neural networks affect the learning coefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对三层神经网络的奇异实现参数，推导了局部学习系数（实对数规范阈值）的上界公式。该公式可解释为预算、需求与供给约束下的计数规则，适用于非多项式实解析激活函数（如swish）以及特定限制下的多项式激活函数。当输入维度为1时，上界数值与已知精确值一致。
Motivation: 现有学习系数上界公式仅适用于半正则模型的非奇异点，无法处理三层神经网络的奇异点，且已有结果显示该上界与已知值存在较大差异。本文旨在填补奇异参数类上界公式的空白。
Method: 通过分析奇异实现参数的几何结构，提出基于预算、需求与供给约束的计数规则，导出局部学习系数上界公式。针对非多项式实解析与多项式激活函数分别给出适用条件。
Result: 上界公式在输入维度为1时与已知学习系数精确值一致，且覆盖了swish等常见激活函数，推广了先前结果。
Conclusion: 该上界公式提供了三层神经网络权重参数影响学习系数的系统视角，但需注意多项式情况下的无隐藏单元限制。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network: Explaining Causalities With Attention
papers.abstract_en: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) underpin critical infrastructure and face growing cyber-physical threats due to the convergence of operational technology and networked environments. While machine learning-based anomaly detection approaches in ICS shows strong theoretical performance, deployment is often limited by poor explainability, high false-positive rates, and sensitivity to evolving system behavior, i.e., baseline drifting. We propose a Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network (STA-GNN) for unsupervised and explainable anomaly detection in ICS that models both temporal dynamics and relational structure of the system. Sensors, controllers, and network entities are represented as nodes in a dynamically learned graph, enabling the model to capture inter-dependencies across physical processes and communication patterns. Attention mechanisms provide influential relationships, supporting inspection of correlations and potential causal pathways behind detected events. The approach supports multiple data modalities, including SCADA point measurements, network flow features, and payload features, and thus enables unified cyber-physical analysis. To address operational requirements, we incorporate a conformal prediction strategy to control false alarm rates and monitor performance degradation under drifting of the environment. Our findings highlight the possibilities and limitations of model evaluation and common pitfalls in anomaly detection in ICS. Our findings emphasise the importance of explainable, drift-aware evaluation for reliable deployment of learning-based security monitoring systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业控制系统（ICS）中异常检测可解释性差、误报率高和基线漂移问题，提出一种无监督且可解释的时空注意力图神经网络（STA-GNN）。该模型将传感器、控制器和网络实体表示为动态学习图中的节点，捕捉物理过程与通信模式间的相互依赖关系，并通过注意力机制揭示检测事件背后的相关性及潜在因果路径。模型支持SCADA点测量、网络流特征和载荷特征等多模态数据，并采用保形预测策略控制误报率和监控环境漂移下的性能退化。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的ICS异常检测方法尽管理论性能强，但因可解释性差、误报率高以及对系统行为基线漂移敏感，导致实际部署受限。
Method: 提出STA-GNN：通过动态图结构学习节点间关系，利用图注意力机制建模时空依赖，并融合多模态数据（SCADA测量、网络流、载荷特征）；同时引入保形预测（conformal prediction）以控制误报率并监控漂移。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅强调该方法在解释性、误报控制和对基线漂移的鲁棒性方面的潜力。
Conclusion: 研究强调了可解释、漂移感知的评估对学习型安全监控系统可靠部署的重要性，并指出ICS异常检测中模型评估的常见陷阱和局限性。

papers.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in AI Visibility: A Statistical Framework for Generative Search Measurement
papers.abstract_en: AI-powered answer engines are inherently non-deterministic: identical queries submitted at different times can produce different responses and cite different sources. Despite this stochastic behavior, current approaches to measuring domain visibility in generative search typically rely on single-run point estimates of citation share and prevalence, implicitly treating them as fixed values. This paper argues that citation visibility metrics should be treated as sample estimators of an underlying response distribution rather than fixed values. We conduct an empirical study of citation variability across three generative search platforms--Perplexity Search, OpenAI SearchGPT, and Google Gemini--using repeated sampling across three consumer product topics. Two sampling regimes are employed: daily collections over nine days and high-frequency sampling at ten-minute intervals. We show that citation distributions follow a power-law form and exhibit substantial variability across repeated samples. Bootstrap confidence intervals reveal that many apparent differences between domains fall within the noise floor of the measurement process. Distribution-wide rank stability analysis further demonstrates that citation rankings are unstable across samples, not only among top-ranked domains but throughout the frequently cited domain set. These findings demonstrate that single-run visibility metrics provide a misleadingly precise picture of domain performance in generative search. We argue that citation visibility must be reported with uncertainty estimates and provide practical guidance for sample sizes required to achieve interpretable confidence intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证AI生成式搜索引擎（Perplexity Search、OpenAI SearchGPT、Google Gemini）的可见性度量应视为随机样本估计，而非固定值。通过重复采样的实证研究，发现引用分布呈幂律形式，且不同采样间存在显著变异，单次运行的可见性指标具有误导性。建议报告不确定性估计，并给出所需样本量的实用指导。
Motivation: 当前AI答案引擎的域名可见性度量依赖单次点估计，忽略了其非确定性本质，导致结果看似精确但实际不可靠。
Method: 对三个生成式搜索平台进行重复采样实验，采用两种采样方案（每日一次共9天和每10分钟一次的高频采样），统计引用份额和出现率的变异，并使用自举置信区间和排名稳定性分析。
Result: 引用分布呈幂律形式，重复样本间变异显著；自举置信区间显示许多域名间的差异落入测量噪声中；排名稳定性分析表明，即使高频域名，其排名在不同样本间也不稳定。
Conclusion: 生成式搜索的可见性必须附带不确定性估计，并应基于所需置信区间宽度规划样本量。

papers.title: Non-Parametric Structural Priors for Geometry Theorem Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step theorem prediction is a central challenge in geometry problem solving. Existing neural-symbolic approaches rely heavily on supervised parametric models, which exhibit limited generalization to evolving theorem libraries. In this work, we explore training-free theorem prediction through the lens of in-context learning (ICL). We identify a critical scalability bottleneck, termed Structural Drift: as reasoning depth increases, the performance of vanilla ICL degrades sharply, often collapsing to near zero. We attribute this failure to the LLM's inability to recover latent topological dependencies, leading to unstructured exploration. To address this issue, we propose Theorem Precedence Graphs, which encode temporal dependencies from historical solution traces as directed graphs, and impose explicit topological constraints that effectively prune the search space during inference. Coupled with retrieval-augmented graph construction and a stepwise symbolic executor, our approach enables LLMs to act as structured planners without any gradient-based optimization. Experiments on the FormalGeo7k benchmark show that our method achieves 89.29% accuracy, substantially outperforming ICL baselines and matching state-of-the-art supervised models. These results indicate that explicit structural priors offer a promising direction for scaling LLM-based symbolic reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对几何定理预测中的多步推理问题，提出一种无需训练的推理方法：使用定理前序图（Theorem Precedence Graphs）编码历史解中的时间依赖关系，结合检索增强的图构建和逐步符号执行器，使大语言模型（LLM）能够进行结构化规划。在FormalGeo7k基准上达到89.29%的准确率，显著优于上下文学习基线，并匹配了最先进的监督模型。
Motivation: 现有的神经符号方法依赖监督参数模型，对不断扩展的定理库泛化能力有限；而普通上下文学习在推理深度增加时性能急剧下降（结构漂移问题），因为LLM难以恢复潜在拓扑依赖。
Method: 提出定理前序图，将历史求解轨迹中的时序依赖编码为有向图，施加显式拓扑约束以在推理时剪枝搜索空间；结合检索增强的图构建和逐步符号执行器，无需梯度优化。
Result: 在FormalGeo7k基准上达到89.29%准确率，大幅超越上下文学习基线，并匹配最先进的监督模型。
Conclusion: 显式的结构先验为扩展基于LLM的符号推理提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs Models
papers.abstract_en: Functional ANOVA offers a principled framework for interpretability by decomposing a model's prediction into main effects and higher-order interactions. For independent features, this decomposition is well-defined, strongly linked with SHAP values, and serves as a cornerstone of additive explainability. However, the lack of an explicit closed-form expression for general dependent distributions has forced practitioners to rely on costly sampling-based approximations. We completely resolve this limitation for categorical inputs. By bridging functional analysis with the extension of discrete Fourier analysis, we derive a closed-form decomposition without any assumption. Our formulation is computationally very efficient. It seamlessly recovers the classical independent case and extends to arbitrary dependence structures, including distributions with non-rectangular support. Furthermore, leveraging the intrinsic link between SHAP and ANOVA under independence, our framework yields a natural generalization of SHAP values for the general categorical setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分类输入模型的函数ANOVA分解问题，通过桥接函数分析与离散傅里叶分析的扩展，推导出无需任何假设的闭式分解公式。该公式计算高效，能自然恢复独立情形并扩展到任意依赖结构，包括非矩形支撑的分布。同时，基于SHAP与ANOVA在独立性下的内在联系，该框架为一般分类设置提供了SHAP值的自然推广。
Motivation: 现有函数ANOVA分解对于独立特征有良好定义并与SHAP值紧密相关，但缺乏一般依赖分布下的闭式表达式，迫使依赖昂贵采样近似。本文旨在为分类输入完全解决这一局限。
Method: 通过桥接函数分析与离散傅里叶分析的扩展，推导出任意依赖结构下分类输入模型的精确闭式ANOVA分解，无需任何假设。
Result: 该公式计算高效，能无缝恢复经典独立情形，并扩展到包括非矩形支撑分布在内的任意依赖结构。同时，该框架给出了分类设置下SHAP值的自然泛化。
Conclusion: 本文为分类输入模型提供了精确且计算高效的ANOVA分解闭式解，并推广了SHAP值，增强了可解释性工具的适用性。
