papers.title: TaCarla: A comprehensive benchmarking dataset for end-to-end autonomous driving
papers.abstract_en: Collecting a high-quality dataset is a critical task that demands meticulous attention to detail, as overlooking certain aspects can render the entire dataset unusable. Autonomous driving challenges remain a prominent area of research, requiring further exploration to enhance the perception and planning performance of vehicles. However, existing datasets are often incomplete. For instance, datasets that include perception information generally lack planning data, while planning datasets typically consist of extensive driving sequences where the ego vehicle predominantly drives forward, offering limited behavioral diversity. In addition, many real datasets struggle to evaluate their models, especially for planning tasks, since they lack a proper closed-loop evaluation setup. The CARLA Leaderboard 2.0 challenge, which provides a diverse set of scenarios to address the long-tail problem in autonomous driving, has emerged as a valuable alternative platform for developing perception and planning models in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation setups. Nevertheless, existing datasets collected on this platform present certain limitations. Some datasets appear to be tailored primarily for limited sensor configuration, with particular sensor configurations. To support end-to-end autonomous driving research, we have collected a new dataset comprising over 2.85 million frames using the CARLA simulation environment for the diverse Leaderboard 2.0 challenge scenarios. Our dataset is designed not only for planning tasks but also supports dynamic object detection, lane divider detection, centerline detection, traffic light recognition, prediction tasks and visual language action models . Furthermore, we demonstrate its versatility by training various models using our dataset. Moreover, we also provide numerical rarity scores to understand how rarely the current state occurs in the dataset.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Simulation for Autonomous Driving (SAD), CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于CARLA仿真环境的端到端自动驾驶基准数据集TaCarla，包含超过285万帧，涵盖Leaderboard 2.0挑战中的多样化场景，支持规划、动态目标检测、车道线检测、中心线检测、交通灯识别、预测和视觉语言动作模型等任务，并提供数值稀有度评分。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集往往不完整，例如感知数据集缺乏规划数据，规划数据集行为多样性有限，且缺乏闭环评估设置，而CARLA Leaderboard 2.0平台虽提供多样场景但现有数据集存在传感器配置限制等问题。
Method: 使用CARLA仿真环境收集超过285万帧数据，覆盖Leaderboard 2.0挑战的多样化场景，设计支持多种感知和规划任务，并提供数值稀有度评分。
Result: 数据集包含超过285万帧，支持动态目标检测、车道线检测、中心线检测、交通灯识别、预测和视觉语言动作模型等任务，并通过训练多种模型展示了其通用性。
Conclusion: TaCarla数据集旨在为端到端自动驾驶研究提供更全面的基准，支持开放循环和封闭循环评估，并引入稀有度指标以帮助理解数据分布。

papers.title: GRAU: Generic Reconfigurable Activation Unit Design for Neural Network Hardware Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: With the continuous growth of neural network scales, low-precision quantization is widely used in edge accelerators. Classic multi-threshold activation hardware requires 2^n thresholds for $n$-bit outputs, causing a rapid increase in hardware cost as precision increases. We propose a reconfigurable activation hardware, GRAU, based on piecewise linear fitting, where the segment slopes are approximated by powers of two. Our design requires only basic comparators and 1-bit right shifters, supporting mixed-precision quantization and nonlinear functions such as SiLU. Compared with multi-threshold activators, GRAU reduces LUT consumption by over 90%, achieving higher hardware efficiency, flexibility, and scalability. The best trade-off is usually achieved with 6-8 segments, while complex nonlinearities under aggressive low-cost settings may suffer larger accuracy degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为GRAU的可重构激活硬件单元，基于分段线性拟合，其分段斜率通过2的幂次近似。该设计仅需基本比较器和1位右移器，支持混合精度量化和非线性函数（如SiLU）。相比多阈值激活器，GRAU减少超过90%的LUT消耗，实现更高的硬件效率、灵活性和可扩展性。在6-8个分段时通常取得最佳权衡，但在激进低开销设置下复杂非线性可能面临较大精度损失。
Motivation: 现有神经网络硬件加速器中，经典多阈值激活硬件需要2^n个阈值来实现n位输出，导致硬件成本随精度增加而急剧上升。
Method: 提出基于分段线性拟合的可重构激活硬件GRAU，将分段斜率近似为2的幂次，仅使用基本比较器和1位右移器实现，支持混合精度和多种非线性函数。
Result: 与多阈值激活器相比，GRAU减少超过90%的LUT消耗，通常在6-8个分段时取得最佳权衡，但在低开销设置下复杂非线性可能精度下降更大。
Conclusion: GRAU在硬件效率、灵活性和可扩展性上显著优于传统多阈值方法，适用于边缘加速器中的低精度量化与混合精度场景。

papers.title: In Defense of Cosine Similarity: Normalization Eliminates the Gauge Freedom
papers.abstract_en: Steck, Ekanadham, and Kallus [arXiv:2403.05440] demonstrate that cosine similarity of learned embeddings from matrix factorization models can be rendered arbitrary by a diagonal ``gauge'' matrix $D$. Their result is correct and important for practitioners who compute cosine similarity on embeddings trained with dot-product objectives. However, we argue that their conclusion, cautioning against cosine similarity in general, conflates the pathology of an incompatible training objective with the geometric validity of cosine distance on the unit sphere. We prove that when embeddings are constrained to the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ (either during or after training with an appropriate objective), the $D$-matrix ambiguity vanishes identically, and cosine distance reduces to exactly half the squared Euclidean distance. This monotonic equivalence implies that cosine-based and Euclidean-based neighbor rankings are identical on normalized embeddings. The ``problem'' with cosine similarity is not cosine similarity, it is the failure to normalize.
papers.comment: This was a blog post companion draft, it needs to be updated to fit as a preprint, will do later
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文反驳Steck等人的观点，他们指出矩阵分解模型的余弦相似度可被对角规范矩阵任意改变。作者证明，当嵌入被约束到单位球面（训练中或训练后通过适当目标）时，该歧义完全消失，且余弦距离恰好等于欧氏距离的一半。这意味着在归一化嵌入上，基于余弦和基于欧氏距离的近邻排序完全相同。作者认为问题不在于余弦相似度，而在于未进行归一化。
Motivation: Steck等人警告一般性地使用余弦相似度，但作者认为该警告混淆了训练目标不兼容与余弦距离在单位球面上的几何有效性。
Method: 通过理论推导证明：若嵌入被约束在单位球面上，规范矩阵的歧义自动消失，余弦距离与平方欧氏距离单调等价。
Result: 归一化嵌入消除了D矩阵的自由度，使得余弦相似度不再任意；余弦距离与欧氏距离在排序上完全一致。
Conclusion: 余弦相似度本身并无问题，问题在于未对嵌入进行归一化。

papers.title: Seal-Robust KCR: A Robust Kuzushiji Character Recognition Framework under Seal Interference
papers.abstract_en: Kuzushiji was one of the most widely used cursive writing systems in pre-modern Japan. Due to its highly cursive forms and extensive glyph variations, most modern Japanese readers are unable to read Kuzushiji characters. Consequently, recent studies have focused on developing automated Kuzushiji character recognition (KCR) methods, which have achieved strong performance on relatively clean Japanese historical document images. Although seals frequently appear in Japanese historical documents, existing methods often fail to maintain recognition accuracy under seal interference, particularly when seals overlap with characters. To address this challenge, we propose a seal-robust KCR framework. Based on character detection, classification, and ordering, the proposed framework additionally incorporates document restoration to mitigate seal interference, thereby improving overall recognition performance. In addition, we introduce a novel synthetic data augmentation strategy to enhance the performance of character detection models. We further correct annotation errors, reconstruct the dataset, and create a synthetic test set to simulate severe seal interference. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in mitigating the impact of seal interference on KCR. Compared with a conventional baseline and NDLkotenOCR, it achieves relative character error rate (CER) reductions of 39.7% and 5.9%, respectively, on the real test set, and 50.1% and 41.7%, respectively, on the synthetic test set.

papers.title: AnomaMind: Agentic Time Series Anomaly Detection with Tool-Augmented Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection is critical in many real-world applications, where effective solutions must localize anomalous regions and support reliable decision-making under complex settings. However, most existing methods frame anomaly detection as a purely discriminative prediction task with fixed feature representations, rather than an evidence-driven diagnostic process. As a result, they often struggle when anomalies exhibit strong context dependence, diverse patterns, or domain shifts across datasets. To address these challenges, we propose AnomaMind, an agentic time series anomaly detection framework that reformulates anomaly detection as a sequential decision-making process. AnomaMind operates through a coarse-to-fine workflow that first localizes suspicious intervals, then constructs diagnostic evidence through tool interaction, and finally refines anomaly decisions through self-reflection. The workflow is supported by a toolkit box that combines knowledge memory and numerical diagnostics: visual anomaly patterns mined from training data and domain knowledge provide contextual guidance, while statistical, value-based, change-based, and region-level operators provide measurable evidence for verification. AnomaMind further adopts a hybrid inference mechanism in which general-purpose models handle flexible reasoning, tool invocation, and refinement, while a detection-specific policy is optimized with rule-based rewards for parsable outputs, F1-score alignment, and false-positive control. Extensive experiments under both in-domain and cross-domain settings demonstrate that AnomaMind consistently improves anomaly detection performance and enhances generalization across heterogeneous anomaly patterns, validating the effectiveness of tool-augmented reasoning for anomaly detection. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/AnomaMind-TS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnomaMind 将时间序列异常检测重新建模为基于工具增强推理的智能体决策过程，采用粗到细的工作流：先定位可疑区间，再通过工具交互构建诊断证据，最后通过自我反思细化异常判断。该方法结合知识记忆与数值诊断算子，并利用混合推理机制（通用模型负责推理和工具调用，检测专用策略通过规则奖励优化）。实验表明在域内和跨域场景下均提升异常检测性能和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法将异常检测视为纯判别预测任务，依赖固定特征表示，难以处理上下文依赖强、模式多样或领域偏移的复杂异常场景。
Method: 提出智能体框架 AnomaMind，包含三段式工作流（定位、诊断、反思）、工具箱（知识记忆和数值诊断算子，如统计、值变化、区域级算子）以及混合推理机制（通用模型做灵活推理与工具调用，检测策略用规则奖励优化 F1 和假阳性控制）。
Result: 在域内和跨域实验中，AnomaMind 持续提升异常检测性能，并增强对异构异常模式的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 工具增强推理可有效提升时间序列异常检测的决策质量与泛化性。

papers.title: RankLLM: Weighted Ranking of LLMs by Quantifying Question Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks establish a standardized evaluation framework to systematically assess the performance of large language models (LLMs), facilitating objective comparisons and driving advancements in the field. However, existing benchmarks fail to differentiate question difficulty, limiting their ability to effectively distinguish models' capabilities. To address this limitation, we propose RankLLM, a novel framework designed to quantify both question difficulty and model competency. RankLLM introduces difficulty as the primary criterion for differentiation, enabling a more fine-grained evaluation of LLM capabilities. RankLLM's core mechanism facilitates bidirectional score propagation between models and questions. The core intuition of RankLLM is that a model earns a competency score when it correctly answers a question, while a question's difficulty score increases when it challenges a model. Using this framework, we evaluate 30 models on 35,550 questions across multiple domains. RankLLM achieves 90% agreement with human judgments and consistently outperforms strong baselines such as IRT. It also exhibits strong stability, fast convergence, and high computational efficiency, making it a practical solution for large-scale, difficulty-aware LLM evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RankLLM框架，通过量化问题难度和模型能力实现更细粒度的LLM评估。核心机制是问题与模型间的双向分数传播：模型答对问题获得能力分，问题难住模型获得难度分。在35550个问题上评估30个模型，达到90%的人类判断一致性，优于IRT等基线，且具有稳定、快速收敛和高计算效率的特点。
Motivation: 现有基准无法区分问题难度，限制了区分模型能力的效果。
Method: RankLLM框架，通过双向传播机制同时量化问题难度和模型能力分，利用难度作为主要区分标准。
Result: 在30个模型和35550个问题上，RankLLM取得90%的人类判断一致性，优于IRT等强基线，并表现出强稳定性、快速收敛和高计算效率。
Conclusion: RankLLM是一种实用的、感知难度的大规模LLM评估框架。

papers.title: PRISM: Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model
papers.abstract_en: Generative sequence modeling faces a fundamental tension between the expressivity of Transformers and the efficiency of linear sequence models. Existing efficient architectures are theoretically bounded by shallow, single-step linear updates, while powerful iterative methods like Test-Time Training (TTT) break hardware parallelism due to two dimensions of serial dependency: token-level state reliance and step-level iteration loops. We propose PRISM (Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model) to resolve this tension. PRISM explicitly reconstructs the expressive gate x residual x direction iteration pattern of TTT in a parallelizable form. We employ a Write-Forget Decoupling strategy that isolates non-linearity within the injection operator. To bypass the serial dependency of explicit solvers, PRISM utilizes a two-stage proxy architecture: a short-convolution anchors the initial residual using local history energy, while a learned predictor estimates the refinement updates directly from the input. This design distills structural patterns associated with iterative correction into a parallelizable feedforward operator. Theoretically, we prove that this formulation achieves Rank-$L$ accumulation, structurally expanding the update manifold beyond the single-step Rank-$1$ bottleneck. Empirically, it achieves comparable performance to explicit optimization methods while achieving \textbf{174x higher throughput}. Codes are available in https://github.com/gpr-prism/prism/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM（Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model），通过显式重构测试时训练（TTT）的迭代模式并使其可并行化，解决了生成式序列建模中 Transformer 强表达性与线性模型高效率之间的矛盾。PRISM 采用 Write-Forget 解耦策略将非线性隔离到注入算子中，并利用两阶段代理架构（短卷积锚定初始残差、学习预测器直接估计更新）将迭代校正结构蒸馏为可并行的前馈算子。理论上证明该公式可实现 Rank-L 累加，突破单步 Rank-1 瓶颈；实验表明在达到与显式优化方法相当性能的同时，吞吐量提升 174 倍。
Motivation: 现有高效架构（如线性模型）在理论上受限于浅层单步线性更新，而强大的迭代方法（如 TTT）因 token 级状态依赖和步骤级迭代循环这两维串行依赖而无法实现硬件并行，急需一种兼具表达性与并行效率的序列模型。
Method: 提出 Write-Forget 解耦策略，将非线性限制在注入算子中，绕过显式求解器的串行依赖；采用两阶段代理架构：短卷积利用局部历史能量锚定初始残差，学习预测器直接根据输入估计精炼更新，从而将迭代校正的结构模式蒸馏为可并行的前馈算子。
Result: 理论证明该公式可实现 Rank-L 累加，扩展更新流形超出单步 Rank-1 瓶颈；实验在多个序列建模任务上达到与显式优化方法（如 TTT）相当的性能，同时实现 174 倍更高的吞吐量。
Conclusion: PRISM 成功将迭代序列模型并行化，在保持表达能力的同时大幅提升效率，为高效生成式序列建模提供了新的架构方向。

papers.title: Capture Timing-Attention of Events in Clinical Time Series
papers.abstract_en: The contemporary paradigm of trajectory learning operates fundamentally at the level of group dynamics, systematically reducing individual-level complexity to fit group-level models, thus rendering effective patient subtyping difficult and individual-level modeling largely out of reach. We propose a data-driven paradigm that introduces a dedicated individual-level temporal variable to capture \emph{Timing Attention} (i.e., the degree of concentration of an event's timing distribution across the patient cohort), thereby rendering timing a \emph{computable dimension} that enables individualized temporal features in trajectory learning. Instantiated as the Level-of-Individual Time Transformation (LITT) and applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, the proposed paradigm demonstrates, for the first time to our knowledge: (1) automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories, and (2) counterfactual timing deduction, that is, a \emph{What-If Machine}. Both results are purely data-driven, requiring no prior domain knowledge. LITT further achieves strong performance on timing prediction and survival analysis tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的个体级时间变量LITT（Level-of-Individual Time Transformation），用于捕获临床时间序列中事件的时间注意力（Timing Attention），使得时间成为可计算的维度，从而实现个体化的轨迹学习。在3276名乳腺癌患者的纵向EHR数据上，LITT自动发现了临床有意义的患者轨迹，并实现了反事实时间推演（What-If Machine），同时时序预测和生存分析表现良好。
Motivation: 当前轨迹学习范式的分组动态会降低个体复杂性，导致难以进行有效的患者亚型分类和个体化建模。需要一种方法将时间作为可计算维度来捕获个体事件的时间分布集中程度。
Method: 提出一个个体级时间变量LITT（Level-of-Individual Time Transformation），通过计算事件时间分布在患者群体中的集中程度（Timing Attention），将时间转化为可计算的个体化时间特征，用于轨迹学习。
Result: 在3276名乳腺癌患者的纵向EHR数据上，LITT首次实现了自动发现临床有意义的患者轨迹，以及反事实时间推演（What-If Machine），并且在时序预测和生存分析任务上取得了强性能。
Conclusion: 该数据驱动范式无需先验领域知识，能够实现个体级的轨迹学习与反事实推演，为临床时间序列分析提供了新方向。

papers.title: MedFeat: Model-Aware and Explainability-Driven Feature Engineering with LLMs for Clinical Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In clinical tabular prediction, classical machine learning models with feature engineering often outperform neural methods. LLMs are increasingly used to automate this process, acting as domain experts that propose diverse feature transformations to boost downstream performance. However, existing LLM-based methods decouple feature generation from the downstream model: the LLM receives no signal about which features currently drive predictions or where the model's representational capacity falls short, so proposals are neither targeted to promising regions of the feature space nor tailored to the learner's inductive bias. This shortcoming is amplified in healthcare data, which simultaneously exhibits class imbalance, heterogeneous feature spaces, and strict interpretability requirements. In this paper, we propose MedFeat, the first feature engineering framework inspired by the workflow of machine learning practitioners, leveraging model-awareness and feature importance signals to iteratively guide feature discovery for clinical tabular learning. We evaluate MedFeat on a broad range of challenging real-world clinical tasks and show that it statistically significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with an average improvement of more than 10% over the baseline across models with distinct inductive biases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedFeat，一种面向临床表格预测的模型感知与可解释性驱动的特征工程框架。该框架利用LLM作为领域专家，通过迭代地考虑下游模型的特征重要性信号来生成有针对性的特征变换。在多个真实临床任务上，MedFeat显著优于现有基线，平均性能提升超过10%。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的特征工程方法将特征生成与下游模型解耦，LLM无法获知当前模型依赖哪些特征或模型表示能力不足之处，导致特征提案缺乏针对性。这一问题在医疗数据（类别不平衡、异构特征空间、严格可解释性要求）中尤为突出。
Method: MedFeat受机器学习实践者工作流启发，首次将模型意识（model-awareness）和特征重要性信号引入LLM驱动的特征工程，通过迭代生成和选择特征来提升下游模型性能。
Result: 在多个具有不同归纳偏好的模型（如逻辑回归、树模型等）上，MedFeat相比基线方法取得统计显著的提升，平均改进超过10%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明MedFeat能有效利用模型反馈进行有导向的特征发现，在临床表格预测中展现出优于现有方法的潜力。

summary_sections.result: 在多个具有不同归纳偏好的模型（如逻辑回归、树模型等）上，MedFeat相比基线方法取得统计显著的提升，平均改进超过10%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明MedFeat能有效利用模型反馈进行有导向的特征发现，在临床表格预测中展现出优于现有方法的潜力。

papers.title: Blind denoising diffusion models and the blessings of dimensionality
papers.abstract_en: Denoising diffusion models (DDMs) are state-of-the-art methods for learning densities from data across numerous domains, yet many aspects of the training and sampling pipeline remain poorly understood. In particular, noise conditioning requires practitioners to incorporate contrived unprincipled noise embeddings into neural network architectures and to use ad hoc noise schedules for sampling. To address these drawbacks, we provide a complete theory for \emph{blind denoising diffusion models} (BDDMs): a variant of DDMs where the noise amplitude is not passed into the neural network during training or sampling, obviating the need for the aforementioned design choices. We justify the correctness of BDDMs as a sampling algorithm under an assumption of low intrinsic dimensionality of the underlying data distribution relative to the ambient dimension. This assumption arises through the introduction of the Bayesian problem of estimating noise levels from a single noisy sample, which might be of independent interest. We empirically compare the performance of BDDMs to standard DDMs, showcasing the benefits of an \emph{adaptive} scheme which is rigorously justified by our analysis.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 13 figures; Accepted to ICML 2025 FoGen workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出盲去噪扩散模型（BDDMs），一种无需将噪声幅度输入神经网络的扩散模型变体。作者在数据分布相对于环境维度具有低内在维度的假设下，证明了BDDM作为采样算法的正确性，并引入了一个贝叶斯问题用于从单个噪声样本中估计噪声水平。实证比较表明，BDDM的自适应方案优于标准DDM。
Motivation: 标准去噪扩散模型（DDMs）在训练和采样时需要将噪声幅度作为输入，这要求设计复杂的噪声嵌入和启发式噪声调度，缺乏理论依据。本文旨在消除这些人为设计选择，提出更简洁的变体。
Method: 提出盲去噪扩散模型（BDDM），在训练和采样过程中不将噪声幅度传入神经网络，而是通过一个贝叶斯问题从单个噪声样本中估计噪声水平。该方法在数据低内在维度的假设下得到理论支持。
Result: 理论上证明了BDDM在低内在维度假设下的正确性；实证上展示了BDDM自适应方案相比标准DDM的优势。
Conclusion: BDDM消除了DDM中人为噪声嵌入和调度的需要，提供了一种更简洁且理论严谨的替代方案。其有效性依赖于数据分布的低内在维度属性。

papers.title: Prompt Reinjection: Alleviating Prompt Forgetting in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiTs) for text-to-image generation maintain separate text and image branches, with bidirectional information flow between text tokens and visual latents throughout denoising. In this setting, we observe a prompt forgetting phenomenon: the semantics of the prompt representation in the text branch is progressively forgotten as depth increases. We further verify this effect on three representative MMDiTs--SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1 by probing linguistic attributes of the representations over the layers in the text branch. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a training-free approach, prompt reinjection, which reinjects prompt representations from early layers into later layers to alleviate this forgetting. Experiments on GenEval, DPG, and T2I-CompBench++ show consistent gains in instruction-following capability, along with improvements on metrics capturing preference, aesthetics, and overall text--image generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）在文本到图像生成中，文本分支的提示语义随深度增加逐渐遗忘，称为提示遗忘现象。作者提出一种无需训练的方法——提示重注入（prompt reinjection），将早期层的提示表示注入后期层以缓解遗忘。在SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.1上通过GenEval、DPG、T2I-CompBench++等基准测试，指令跟随能力及偏好、美学、整体质量指标均持续提升。
Motivation: 文本到图像生成的MMDiT中，文本提示语义在深层被遗忘，导致生成结果偏离指令，需缓解此遗忘现象。
Method: 提出训练免费的提示重注入方法，在推理时直接将早期特定层的文本表示复制到对应深层位置，不涉及额外参数或微调。
Result: 在GenEval、DPG、T2I-CompBench++等基准上，指令跟随能力一致提升，并改善偏好（HPSv2）、美学（LAION Aesthetic）和整体质量（FID、CLIP Score）指标。
Conclusion: 提示重注入能有效缓解MMDiT中的提示遗忘，显著提升文本-图像生成质量，且无需额外训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DAH-Net: A Dual-Attention Hybrid Network for Interpretable and Robust EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: EEG-based emotion recognition supports affective brain-computer interfaces and mental health monitoring yet remains challenged by signal complexity, subject variability, and limited interpretability. We propose DAH-Net, a dual-attention hybrid network integrating 1D-CNN, BiLSTM, and dual multi-head attention (16+8 heads) for three-class EEG emotion classification. Evaluated on 2,479 samples with 988 EEG features, DAH-Net achieves 99.19% held-out test accuracy with a 0.81% train-test gap, outperforming RF (96.17%), SVM (96.77%), MLP (97.18%), and Transformer (98.19%) baselines. Friedman testing (\c{hi}2 = 28.54, p < 0.001) and post-hoc Wilcoxon comparisons confirm statistical significance. Feature-level analysis using Random Forest importance, SHAP attribution, and feature category isolation shows that covariance features achieve near-baseline standalone accuracy (94.96%), while eigenvalue features show limited standalone performance (84.07%) but provide compact complementary information. The compact architecture (3.33M parameters, approximately 13.3MB using 32-bit weights) suggests potential for future lightweight EEG-based affective computing, pending subject-independent and external validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAH-Net 是一种结合 1D-CNN、BiLSTM 和双多头注意力（16+8 头）的双注意力混合网络，用于三分类 EEG 情绪识别。在包含 2479 个样本、988 个 EEG 特征的数据集上，其留出测试准确率达到 99.19%，训练测试差距仅 0.81%，优于随机森林、SVM、MLP 和 Transformer 等基线。
Motivation: EEG 情绪识别面临信号复杂性、受试者差异性和可解释性不足等挑战，现有方法性能有限且解释性差。
Method: 提出 DAH-Net 架构，集成 1D-CNN、BiLSTM 和双多头注意力机制（16 头与 8 头），并利用随机森林重要性、SHAP 归因和特征类别隔离进行特征级分析。
Result: 留出测试准确率 99.19%，训练测试差距 0.81%；RF、SVM、MLP、Transformer 的准确率分别为 96.17%、96.77%、97.18%、98.19%。Friedman 检验（χ²=28.54, p<0.001）及事后 Wilcoxon 比较证实统计显著性。协方差特征独立准确率 94.96%，特征值特征仅 84.07% 但提供紧凑互补信息。
Conclusion: DAH-Net 以紧凑架构（3.33M 参数，约 13.3MB）实现高精度和可解释性，但仍需受试者无关和外部验证以确认泛化能力。

papers.title: ASA: Backbone-Training-Free Representation Engineering for Tool-Calling Agents
papers.abstract_en: Adapting LLM agents to domain-specific tool calling remains notably brittle under evolving interfaces. Prompt and schema engineering is easy to deploy but often fragile under distribution shift and strict parsers, while continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning improves reliability at the cost of training, maintenance, and potential forgetting. We identify a critical Lazy Agent failure mode where tool necessity is nearly perfectly decodable from mid-layer activations, yet the model remains conservative in entering tool mode, revealing a representation-behavior gap. We propose Activation Steering Adapter (ASA), a training-free, inference-time controller that performs a single-shot mid-layer intervention and targets tool domains via a router-conditioned mixture of steering vectors with a probe-guided signed gate to amplify true intent while suppressing spurious triggers. On MTU-Bench with Qwen2.5-1.5B, ASA improves strict tool-use F1 from 0.18 to 0.50 while reducing the false positive rate from 0.15 to 0.05, using only about 20KB of portable assets and no weight updates.
papers.comment: The manuscript consists of 24 pages formatted in the ACL style. Youjin Wang, Run Zhou, and Yingjie Ma contributed equally to this work. Tao Fang and Liangming Pan are the co-corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理在领域特定工具调用中的脆弱性问题，提出一种无需训练、推理时干预的激活导向适配器（ASA）。该方法通过单次中间层激活干预，利用路由器混合导向向量和探针引导的符号门来放大真实意图、抑制虚假触发。在MTU-Bench上使用Qwen2.5-1.5B，ASA将严格工具使用F1分数从0.18提升至0.50，假阳性率从0.15降至0.05，且仅需约20KB的便携资产，无需权重更新。
Motivation: 现有方法如提示工程和模式工程在分布偏移下易失效，而持续参数高效微调尽管提升可靠性，但代价高昂且可能遗忘。作者识别出“懒惰代理”失败模式：工具必要性可从中间层激活近乎完美解码，但模型在进入工具模式时仍保守，存在表征-行为差距。
Method: 提出ASA（Activation Steering Adapter），一种免训练、推理时控制器，执行单次中间层干预，通过路由器条件混合导向向量，并使用探针引导的符号门来放大真实意图、抑制虚假触发。
Result: 在MTU-Bench上使用Qwen2.5-1.5B，ASA将严格工具使用F1从0.18提升至0.50，假阳性率从0.15降至0.05，仅需约20KB便携资产，无权重更新。
Conclusion: ASA提供了一种轻量、有效的工具调用适配方法，无需训练即可显著提升可靠性和降低虚假触发。

papers.title: MemCast: Memory-Driven Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Conditioned Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays a critical role in decision-making for many real-world applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)- based forecasters have made promising advancements. Despite their effectiveness, existing methods often lack explicit experience accumulation and continual evolution. In this work, we propose MemCast, a learning-to-memory framework that reformulates TSF as an experience-conditioned reasoning task. Specifically, we learn experience from the training set and organize it into a hierarchical memory. This is achieved by summarizing prediction results into historical patterns, distilling inference trajectories into reasoning wisdom, and inducing extracted temporal features into general laws. Furthermore, during inference, we leverage historical patterns to guide the reasoning process and utilize reasoning wisdom to select better trajectories, while general laws serve as criteria for reflective iteration. Additionally, to enable continual evolution, we design a dynamic confidence adaptation strategy that updates the confidence of individual entries without leaking the test set distribution. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MemCast consistently outperforms previous methods, validating the effectiveness of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/MemCast-TS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemCast，一个基于记忆框架的时间序列预测方法，将预测任务重构为经验条件推理。通过从训练集中学习经验并组织为层次记忆（历史模式、推理智慧、一般规律），在推理时利用这些经验引导推理和选择轨迹，并设计动态置信度适应策略实现持续演化。多个数据集上的实验表明方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的时间序列预测方法缺乏显式的经验积累和持续演化能力，限制了预测性能的提升。
Method: 提出 MemCast 学习-记忆框架：从训练集中学习经验，组织为包含历史模式、推理智慧和一般规律的分层记忆；推理时利用历史模式引导推理、推理智慧选择轨迹、一般规律进行反思迭代；并设计动态置信度适应策略实现持续演化，避免泄露测试集分布。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上 MemCast 持续优于先前方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: MemCast 通过显式的经验积累和层级记忆机制提升了时间序列预测效果，代码已开源。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Enabling Progressive Whole-slide Image Analysis with Multi-scale Pyramidal Network
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-instance Learning (MIL) is commonly used for computational pathology (CPath), where multi-scale features are essential for capturing both fine cellular details and broad tissue architecture. However, existing multi-scale MIL approaches typically rely on the inflexible multi-magnification inputs or the computationally expensive architectures. As pre-trained foundation models (FMs) become the trend for feature extraction and boost lightweight models, we rethink and explore a more efficient multi-scale MIL method. In this paper, we propose the Multi-scale Pyramidal Network (MSPN), a plug-and-play module for attention-based MIL. MSPN introduces progressive multi-scale whole-slide image analysis using only a single high-magnification input. It consists of (1) grid-based remapping that aggregates high-magnification features to derive spatially-aware coarse feature maps, and (2) the Coarse Guidance Network (CGN) that learns coarse contexts. We benchmark MSPN as an add-on module to 4 attention-based frameworks on 5 clinically relevant tasks with 2 foundation models, and a pre-trained MIL framework. Our results demonstrate that MSPN consistently improves MIL across the compared configurations and tasks, while being lightweight and easy-to-use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的即插即用模块MSPN，用于基于注意力的多实例学习（MIL），实现渐进式多尺度全切片图像分析，仅需单个高倍输入。MSPN通过网格重映射和粗引导网络（CGN）学习粗尺度上下文，在5个临床任务、4个注意力框架和2个基础模型上持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有多尺度MIL方法依赖不灵活的多倍率输入或高计算量架构，预训练基础模型虽然高效但缺乏多尺度能力。
Method: 提出Multi-scale Pyramidal Network（MSPN）模块，包含网格重映射（从高倍特征聚合空间感知粗特征图）和Coarse Guidance Network（CGN）学习粗上下文。
Result: 在4个注意力MIL框架、2个基础模型和预训练MIL框架上，横跨5个临床任务，MSPN持续提升性能。
Conclusion: MSPN是一个轻量且易于使用的即插即用模块，能有效改进基于注意力的MIL。

papers.title: Rethinking the Flow-Based Gradual Domain Adaptation: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Gradual domain adaptation (GDA) aims to mitigate domain shift by progressively adapting models from the source domain to the target domain via intermediate domains. However, real intermediate domains are often unavailable or ineffective, necessitating the synthesis of intermediate samples. Flow-based models have recently been used for this purpose by interpolating between source and target distributions. Notably, their training typically relies on sample-based log-likelihood estimation, which can discard useful information and thus degrade GDA performance. The key to addressing this limitation is constructing the intermediate domains via samples directly. To this end, we propose an Entropy-regularized Semi-dual Unbalanced Optimal Transport (E-SUOT) framework to construct intermediate domains. Specifically, we reformulate flow-based GDA as a Lagrangian dual problem and derive an equivalent semi-dual objective that circumvents the need for likelihood estimation. However, the dual problem leads to an unstable min-max training procedure. To alleviate this issue, we further introduce the entropy regularization to convert it into a more stable sequential optimization procedure. Based on this, we propose a novel GDA training framework and provide theoretical analysis in terms of stability and generalization. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of the E-SUOT framework.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted for presentation as a regular paper at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对渐进领域适应（GDA）中真实中间域不可用的问题，提出熵正则化半对偶非平衡最优传输（E-SUOT）框架。该框架通过将基于流的GDA重新表述为拉格朗日对偶问题，推导出无需似然估计的半对偶目标，并引入熵正则化将不稳定的min-max训练转化为稳定的序列优化。实验证明E-SUOT在多个GDA基准上有效。
Motivation: 渐进领域适应中的中间域常不可用或无效，现有流模型方法依赖样本对数似然估计导致信息丢失，亟需一种直接通过样本构建中间域的方法。
Method: 将流式GDA重新表述为拉格朗日对偶问题，得到等价的半对偶目标；引入熵正则化将对偶问题转化为稳定的序列优化过程，提出E-SUOT训练框架。
Result: 在多个GDA基准数据集上的实验表明，E-SUOT框架比基于似然估计的流方法取得更好的领域适应性能。
Conclusion: E-SUOT框架通过避免似然估计和稳定训练过程，为渐进领域适应提供了一种有效的替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Your Autoregressive Model Already Reveals the Causal Graph
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive models trained via next-token prediction implicitly learn the conditional independence structure of their data-generating process. We exploit this observation to perform scalable causal discovery from a single observed sequence of discrete events -- without any task-specific retraining. Such single-stream settings arise naturally in vehicle diagnostics, manufacturing systems, and patient trajectories, yet they remain largely unsolved: the absence of repeated samples, massive event vocabularies, and long-range temporal dependencies render existing methods either inaccurate or computationally intractable. We introduce TRACE, a framework that repurposes any pretrained autoregressive model as a density estimator for conditional mutual information, the fundamental primitive for conditional independence testing. By constructing parallelized CI tests on GPUs, TRACE recovers both the sample-level time causal graph and its summary projection, scaling linearly with the vocabulary size while naturally handling delayed causal effects. Crucially, we prove that minimizing the standard cross-entropy pretraining loss directly minimizes an upper bound on the causal identification error, establishing a duality between sequence prediction and causal discovery. On nonlinear SCMs (|X| = 8000) and real-world vehicle diagnostic logs (|X| = 29100), TRACE is the first applicable method at this scale, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 20 F1 points.
papers.journal_ref: Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling workshop ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明预训练的自回归模型（如Transformer）在下一个token预测中隐式编码了数据生成过程的条件独立结构，并提出TRACE框架，利用该模型作为条件互信息估计器进行可扩展的因果发现。在单序列离散事件场景（如车辆诊断日志）中，TRACE线性扩展于词汇量大小，且证明交叉熵损失最小化直接上界因果识别误差。在非线性SCM（|X|=8000）和真实车辆诊断日志（|X|=29100）上，TRACE是首个在此规模适用的方法，F1分数比最强基线高20多点。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在单序列、大规模词汇和长程依赖的场景下不准确或计算不可行，而车辆诊断、制造系统和患者轨迹等实际应用需要此类能力。
Method: 提出TRACE框架，将任何预训练的自回归模型重新用作条件互信息（条件独立性检验的基本原语）的密度估计器，通过在GPU上并行化CI检验来恢复样本级时间因果图及其摘要投影。
Result: 在非线性SCM（|X|=8000）和真实车辆诊断日志（|X|=29100）上，TRACE是首个在此规模适用的方法，F1分数比最强基线高20多点。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了序列预测与因果发现之间的对偶性，并证明TRACE能在不重新训练的情况下进行大规模因果发现，但主要验证于离散事件序列，未涉及连续变量或干预数据。

papers.title: Is Task-Specific Training Necessary for Anomaly Detection?
papers.abstract_en: Current state-of-the-art multi-class unsupervised anomaly detection (MUAD) methods rely on training encoder--decoder models to reconstruct anomaly-free features. However, we argue that such task-specific training is costly under distribution shifts, and that reconstruction-based residual scoring further faces a fidelity--stability dilemma. Existing training-free alternatives, in turn, remain prone to cross-category and cross-region mismatches in MUAD. Motivated by these limitations, we propose Retrieval-based Anomaly Detection (RAD), a task-specific training-free framework that stores anomaly-free features in a memory and detects anomalies through multi-level retrieval, matching test patches against the memory. Experiments demonstrate that RAD achieves state-of-the-art performance across four established benchmarks (MVTec-AD, VisA, Real-IAD, 3D-ADAM) under both standard and few-shot settings. On MVTec-AD, RAD reaches 96.7% Pixel AUROC with just a single anomaly-free image compared to 98.5% of RAD's full-data performance. Collectively, these findings overturn the assumption that MUAD requires task-specific training, showing that state-of-the-art anomaly detection is feasible with training-free memory-based retrieval. Our code is available at https://github.com/longkukuhi/RAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrieval-based Anomaly Detection (RAD)，一种无需任务特定训练的无监督异常检测框架，通过存储正常特征并利用多级检索匹配测试补丁来检测异常。在 MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD、3D-ADAM 四个基准上，RAD 达到或超越了现有训练方法的性能，例如 MVTec-AD 上单样本情况下 Pixel AUROC 达 96.7%，全数据时达 98.5%。结果表明，多类无监督异常检测可以不依赖任务特定训练而达到最高水平。
Motivation: 现有基于重建的异常检测方法在分布偏移下训练成本高，且重建残差评分面临保真度-稳定性权衡；而现有无训练替代方法在多类异常检测中存在跨类别和跨区域不匹配问题。
Method: 提出 RAD 框架，构建一个存储无异常特征的内存库，通过多层次检索将测试图像块与内存中最相似的特征进行匹配，根据匹配差异检测异常，无需任何任务特定训练。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD、3D-ADAM 四个基准上，RAD 在标准设置和少样本设置下均达到最先进性能。例如，MVTec-AD 上仅用一张正常图像即可达到 96.7% Pixel AUROC，全数据时达 98.5%。
Conclusion: 本文颠覆了多类无监督异常检测需要任务特定训练的假设，证明基于内存检索的无训练方法可以实现最先进的异常检测性能。

papers.title: Contrastive Spectral Rectification: Test-Time Defense towards Zero-shot Adversarial Robustness of CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to adversarial examples (AEs). While test-time defenses are promising, existing methods fail to provide sufficient robustness against strong attacks and are often hampered by high inference latency and task-specific applicability. To address these limitations, we start by investigating the intrinsic properties of AEs, which reveals that AEs exhibit severe feature inconsistency under progressive frequency attenuation. We further attribute this to the model's inherent spectral bias. Leveraging this insight, we propose an efficient test-time defense named Contrastive Spectral Rectification (CSR). CSR optimizes a rectification perturbation to realign the input with the natural manifold under a spectral-guided contrastive objective, which is applied input-adaptively. Extensive experiments across 16 classification benchmarks demonstrate that CSR outperforms the SOTA by an average of 18.1% against strong APGD with modest inference overhead. Furthermore, CSR exhibits broad applicability across diverse visual tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Summu77/CSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对CLIP等视觉语言模型在零样本场景下对抗鲁棒性不足的问题，提出一种测试时防御方法Contrastive Spectral Rectification (CSR)。该方法利用对抗样本在渐进频率衰减下特征不一致的观察，通过谱引导对比目标优化矫正扰动，将输入与自然流形对齐。在16个分类基准上，CSR对强APGD攻击平均提升18.1%，且推理开销适中。
Motivation: 现有测试时防御方法对强攻击鲁棒性不足，且存在推理延迟高和任务适用性差的问题。
Method: 提出CSR，通过分析对抗样本在频率衰减下的特征不一致性，归因于模型的谱偏差，然后设计谱引导的对比目标，优化输入自适应的矫正扰动。
Result: 在16个分类基准上，CSR对强APGD攻击平均提升18.1%，且推理开销适中。
Conclusion: CSR是一种高效的测试时防御，能提升CLIP的零样本对抗鲁棒性，并具有跨视觉任务的广泛适用性。

papers.title: Adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence in the German Software Engineering Industry: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools have seen rapid adoption among software developers. While adoption rates in the industry are rising, the underlying factors influencing the effective use of these tools, including the depth of interaction, organizational constraints, and experience-related considerations, have not been thoroughly investigated. This issue is particularly relevant in environments with stringent regulatory requirements, such as Germany, where practitioners must address the GDPR and the EU AI Act while balancing productivity gains with intellectual property considerations. Despite the significant impact of GenAI on software engineering, to the best of our knowledge, no empirical study has systematically examined the adoption dynamics of GenAI tools within the German context. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive mixed-methods study on GenAI adoption among German software engineers. Specifically, we conducted 18 exploratory interviews with practitioners, followed by a developer survey with 109 participants. We analyze patterns of tool adoption, prompting strategies, and organizational factors that influence effectiveness. Our results indicate that experience level moderates the perceived benefits of GenAI tools, and productivity gains are not evenly distributed among developers. Further, organizational size affects both tool selection and the intensity of tool use. Limited awareness of the project context is identified as the most significant barrier. We summarize a set of actionable implications for developers, organizations, and tool vendors seeking to advance artificial intelligence (AI) assisted software development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法（18次探索性访谈和109份开发者调查）实证研究德国软件工程行业对生成式AI（GenAI）的采用情况。结果显示，经验水平调节感知收益，生产力提升不均衡；组织规模影响工具选择和强度；项目上下文意识不足是最大障碍。研究为开发者、组织和工具供应商提出了可操作的建议。
Motivation: 现有研究未深入探讨德国严格监管环境（如GDPR和EU AI Act）下GenAI工具采用的动态因素，缺乏系统性实证研究。
Method: 采用混合方法：先进行18次半结构化访谈，随后开展109名参与者的开发者调查，分析工具采用模式、提示策略和组织因素。
Result: 经验水平调节感知收益，生产力提升不均衡；组织规模影响工具选择和强度；项目上下文意识不足是最显著障碍。
Conclusion: 总结了对开发者、组织和工具供应商的可操作建议，以推动AI辅助软件开发的进展。

papers.title: Efficient Imputation for Patch-based Missing Single-cell Data via Cluster-regularized Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Missing data in single-cell sequencing datasets poses significant challenges for extracting meaningful biological insights. However, existing imputation approaches, which often assume uniformity and data completeness, struggle to address cases with large patches of missing data. In this paper, we present CROT (Cluster-Regularized Optimal Transport), an optimal transport-based imputation algorithm designed to handle patch-based missing data in tabular formats. Our approach effectively captures the underlying data structure in the presence of significant missingness. Notably, it achieves superior imputation accuracy while significantly reducing runtime, demonstrating its scalability and efficiency for large-scale datasets. This work introduces a robust solution for imputation in heterogeneous, high-dimensional datasets with structured data absence, addressing critical challenges in both biological and clinical data analysis. Our code is available on GitHub, https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/CROT.

papers.title: MMD Guidance: Training-Free Distribution Adaptation for Diffusion Models via Maximum Mean Discrepancy Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative priors for both unconditional and conditional sample generation, yet their outputs often deviate from the characteristics of user-specific target data. Such mismatches are especially problematic in domain adaptation tasks, where only a few reference examples are available and retraining the diffusion model is infeasible. Existing inference-time guidance methods can adjust sampling trajectories, but they typically optimize surrogate objectives such as classifier likelihoods rather than directly aligning with the target distribution. We propose \emph{MMD Guidance}, a training-free mechanism that augments the reverse diffusion process with gradients of the \textit{Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)} between generated samples and a reference dataset. MMD provides reliable distributional estimates from limited data, exhibits low variance in practice, and is efficiently differentiable, which makes it particularly well-suited for the guidance task. Our framework naturally extends to prompt-aware adaptation in conditional generation models via product kernels. Also, it can be applied with computational efficiency in latent diffusion models (LDMs), since guidance is applied in the latent space of the LDM. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MMD Guidance can achieve distributional alignment while preserving sample fidelity. The project code is available at github.com/matinamehdizadeh/MMD-Guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMD Guidance，一种无需训练的推理时分布适应方法，在扩散模型的反向扩散过程中使用最大均值差异（MMD）梯度来对齐生成样本与参考数据集。该方法适用于条件生成和潜在扩散模型，实验表明能实现分布对齐同时保持样本保真度。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型在生成样本时可能偏离用户特定目标数据分布，尤其在域适应任务中只有少量参考样本且无法重训练模型的情况下。现有推理时指导方法通常优化替代目标（如分类器似然），而非直接对齐目标分布。
Method: 提出MMD Guidance，在反向扩散过程中加入生成样本与参考数据集之间的MMD梯度。MMD能从有限数据中提供可靠的分布估计，方差低且可高效求导。通过乘积核自然扩展到条件生成中的提示适应，并在潜在扩散模型中由于在潜在空间应用指导而保持计算效率。
Result: 在合成和真实基准实验上，MMD Guidance实现了分布对齐并保持了样本保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法是训练免费的分布适应机制，适用于多种扩散模型，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ObjSplat: Geometry-Aware Gaussian Surfels for Active Object Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous high-fidelity object reconstruction is fundamental for creating digital assets and bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in robotics. We present ObjSplat, an active reconstruction framework that leverages Gaussian surfels as a unified representation to progressively reconstruct unknown objects with both photorealistic appearance and accurate geometry. Addressing the limitations of conventional opacity or depth-based cues, we introduce a geometry-aware viewpoint evaluation pipeline that explicitly models back-face visibility and occlusion-aware multi-view covisibility, reliably identifying under-reconstructed regions even on geometrically complex objects. Furthermore, to overcome the limitations of greedy planning strategies, ObjSplat employs a next-best-path (NBP) planner that performs multi-step lookahead on a dynamically constructed spatial graph. By jointly optimizing information gain and movement cost, this planner generates globally efficient trajectories. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world cultural artifacts demonstrate that ObjSplat produces physically consistent models within minutes, achieving superior reconstruction fidelity and surface completeness while significantly reducing scan time and path length compared to state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://li-yuetao.github.io/ObjSplat-page/ .
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE T-ASE. Code: https://github.com/Li-Yuetao/ObjSplat , Project Page: https://li-yuetao.github.io/ObjSplat-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ObjSplat，一个主动物体重建框架，使用高斯 surfels 作为统一表示，逐步重建未知物体，同时实现逼真外观和精确几何。引入几何感知的视点评估管线，显式建模背面可见性和遮挡感知的多视图共视性，并采用 next-best-path (NBP) 规划器进行多步前瞻，生成全局高效轨迹。仿真和真实文物实验表明，ObjSplat 能在数分钟内生成物理一致的模型，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有的主动重建方法在复杂几何物体上重建不完整，且贪婪规划策略效率低，全局轨迹质量差。
Method: 使用高斯 surfels 表示，提出几何感知的视点评估（建模背面可见性和遮挡感知多视图共视性），并采用基于动态空间图的 NBP 规划器，联合优化信息增益和移动代价。
Result: 在仿真和真实文物实验中，ObjSplat 产生物理一致的模型，重建保真度和表面完整性优于现有方法，同时显著减少扫描时间和路径长度。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了高效、高保真的主动物体重建，适用于文化遗产等场景。

papers.title: AI Application Gives Users Real-Time Feedback on the Level of Peace in the Social Media Videos They Watch
papers.abstract_en: Most people now get their news from videos on social media, such as YouTube and Facebook, rather than through curated journalism. "We become what we behold." The content and tone of language plays an essential role in starting or ending conflicts. "Hate Speech" can enhance conflict, "Peace Speech" can enhance peace. We developed an application that measures, in real time, these aspects of speech from YouTube videos, which can give users helpful feedback on their own media diet. We used two approaches: 1) supervised machine learning. Language in the text of online news media text was tagged by surveys that measure the level of peace in those countries. One fully connected feedforward and 2 convolutional neural networks trained on that data were $\sim 97\%$ accurate in predicting levels of peace in the test set and $\sim 70\%$ accurate in another distinct news text data set, but did not generalize to YouTube videos, suggesting that written text is different than transcribed spoken language. 2) social science dimensions. There is no similar external data to tag the text in the YouTube video transcripts. We therefore used 2 word-level sentiment analysis (SA) and 6 context-level large language models (LLMs) to measure 5 social dimensions in peace identified by 59 social science studies: compassion-contempt, news-opinion, promotion-prevention, creativity-order, nuance-simplification. LLMs more closely matched the values by 3 human coders on 52 videos, $r^2\sim0.60$ than SA, at $r^2\sim0.03$. Results: LLMs successfully measured social dimensions important in peace in YouTube videos, compared to human coders. These results serve as the basis of an analysis engine that can give users and content creators feedback on their own media diet and creations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个应用程序，实时测量社交媒体视频（如YouTube）中的语言内容，以提供关于视频“和平”程度的反馈。研究采用两种方法：监督机器学习基于新闻文本预测国家和平水平（准确率约97%），但未能泛化到YouTube视频；社会科学维度使用大语言模型（LLM）测量五个社会维度（如怜悯-蔑视等），LLM与人类编码者的一致性（r²≈0.60）远优于词级情感分析（r²≈0.03）。结果表明LLM能有效评估视频中的和平相关维度。
Motivation: 人们主要通过社交媒体视频获取新闻，视频中的语言（仇恨言论或和平言论）影响冲突起止，需要工具帮助用户了解所观看视频的“和平”程度。
Method: 1) 监督学习：使用全连接前馈和卷积神经网络，基于在线新闻文本训练预测国家和平水平。2) 社会科学维度：采用词级情感分析和六个上下文级LLM，测量来自59项社会科学研究的五个和平维度（怜悯-蔑视、新闻-观点等）。
Result: 监督学习在测试集准确率约97%，但在另一新闻数据集约70%，且未泛化到YouTube视频。LLM与人类编码者一致性r²≈0.60，情感分析仅r²≈0.03。
Conclusion: LLM成功测量YouTube视频中与和平相关的社会维度，可作为分析引擎基础，为用户和内容创作者提供反馈。

papers.title: Segmentation-Driven Monocular Shape from Polarization based on Physical Model
papers.abstract_en: Monocular shape-from-polarization (SfP) leverages the intrinsic relationship between light polarization properties and surface geometry to recover surface normals from single-view polarized images, providing a compact and robust approach for three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction. Despite its potential, existing monocular SfP methods suffer from azimuth angle ambiguity, an inherent limitation of polarization analysis, that severely compromises reconstruction accuracy and stability. This paper introduces a novel segmentation-driven monocular SfP (SMSfP) framework that reformulates global shape recovery into a set of local reconstructions over adaptively segmented convex sub-regions. Specifically, a polarization-aided adaptive region growing (PARG) segmentation strategy is proposed to decompose the global convexity assumption into locally convex regions, effectively suppressing azimuth ambiguities and preserving surface continuity. Furthermore, a multi-scale fusion convexity prior (MFCP) constraint is developed to ensure local surface consistency and enhance the recovery of fine textural and structural details. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets validate the proposed approach, showing significant improvements in disambiguation accuracy and geometric fidelity compared with existing physics-based monocular SfP techniques.

papers.title: Pushing the limits of one-dimensional NMR spectroscopy for automated structure elucidation using artificial intelligence
papers.abstract_en: One-dimensional NMR spectroscopy is one of the most widely used techniques for the characterization of organic compounds and natural products. For molecules with up to 36 non-hydrogen atoms, the number of possible structures has been estimated to range from $10^{20} - 10^{60}$. The task of determining the structure (formula and connectivity) of a molecule of this size using only its one-dimensional $^1$H and/or $^{13}$C NMR spectrum, i.e. de novo structure generation, thus appears completely intractable. Here we show how it is possible to achieve this task for systems with up to 40 non-hydrogen atoms across the full elemental coverage typically encountered in organic chemistry (C, N, O, H, P, S, Si, B, and the halogens) using a deep learning framework, thus covering a vast portion of the drug-like chemical space. Leveraging insights from natural language processing, we show that our transformer-based architecture predicts the correct molecule with 60.4% accuracy within the first 15 predictions using only the $^1$H and $^{13}$C NMR spectra, thus overcoming the combinatorial growth of the chemical space while also being extensible to experimental data via fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的深度学习框架，仅利用一维1H和13C NMR谱即可自动解析含最多40个非氢原子的有机分子结构，覆盖有机化学中常见元素（C、N、O、H、P、S、Si、B及卤素）。在测试中，前15个预测的正确率达到60.4%，展示了克服化学空间组合爆炸的潜力，并可通过微调扩展到实验数据。
Motivation: 一维NMR光谱广泛用于有机化合物表征，但分子结构数量巨大（含36个非氢原子时可达10^20-10^60），从头结构解析看似不可行。现有方法难以直接利用一维谱图高效确定结构。
Method: 借鉴自然语言处理（NLP）的思想，采用Transformer架构，以1H和13C NMR谱为输入，预测分子结构。通过微调可适应实验数据。
Result: 该方法在前15个预测中正确率为60.4%，适用于含最多40个非氢原子的分子，覆盖有机化学常见元素。
Conclusion: 表明利用深度学习可从一维NMR谱实现自动结构解析，显著拓展了化学空间覆盖范围，有望成为药物化学等领域的实用工具。

papers.title: SCOPE: Sequential Causal Optimization of Process Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Prescriptive Process Monitoring (PresPM) recommends interventions during running business processes to optimize key performance indicators (KPIs). In realistic settings, interventions are rarely isolated: organizations need to align sequences of interventions to jointly steer the outcome of a case. Existing PresPM approaches only partially address this challenge. Many focus on a single intervention decision, while others treat multiple interventions independently, ignoring how they interact over time. Methods that do address these dependencies depend either on simulation or data augmentation to approximate the process to train a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent, which may create a reality gap and introduce bias. We introduce SCOPE (Sequential Causal Optimization of Process Interventions), a PresPM approach that learns aligned sequential intervention recommendations. SCOPE employs backward induction to estimate the effect of each candidate intervention action, propagating its impact from the final decision point back to the first. By leveraging causal learners, our method can utilize observational data directly, unlike methods that require constructing process approximations for RL. Experiments on both an existing synthetic dataset and a new semi-synthetic dataset show that SCOPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PresPM techniques in optimizing the KPI. The novel semi-synthetic setup, based on a real-life event log, is provided as a reusable benchmark for future work on sequential PresPM.

papers.title: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents WorldPlay, a streaming video diffusion model that enables real-time, interactive world modeling with long-term geometric consistency, resolving the trade-off between speed and memory that limits current methods. WorldPlay draws power from three key ingredients. 1) We use a Dual Action Representation to enable robust action control in response to the user's keyboard and mouse inputs. 2) To enforce long-term consistency, our Reconstituted Context Memory dynamically rebuilds context from past frames and uses temporal reframing to keep geometrically important but long-past frames accessible, effectively alleviating memory attenuation. 3) We also propose Context Forcing, a novel distillation method designed for memory-aware model. Aligning memory context between the teacher and student preserves the student's capacity to use long-range information, enabling real-time speeds while preventing error drift. Taken together, WorldPlay generates long-horizon streaming 720p video at 24 FPS with superior consistency, comparing favorably with existing techniques and showing strong generalization across diverse scenes. Project page and online demo can be found: https://3d-models.hunyuan.tencent.com/world/ and https://3d.hunyuan.tencent.com/sceneTo3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WorldPlay，一个流视频扩散模型，用于实时交互式世界建模，具有长期几何一致性。通过双重动作表示、重构上下文记忆和上下文强制蒸馏方法，实现了24 FPS的720p视频流，并保持了长期一致性。
Motivation: 现有方法在速度与内存之间存在权衡，限制了实时交互式世界建模的长期几何一致性。
Method: 提出了三个关键组件：1) 双重动作表示实现鲁棒的动作控制；2) 重构上下文记忆动态重建过去帧的上下文，使用时间重构让几何重要的远帧可访问；3) 上下文强制蒸馏方法，对齐教师和学生模型的内存上下文，防止误差漂移。
Result: WorldPlay生成长时间720p视频流，24 FPS，一致性优于现有技术，并在多种场景中表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调WorldPlay解决了实时交互式世界建模中的长期几何一致性问题，通过记忆机制和蒸馏方法实现实时速度。

papers.title: Scone: Bridging Composition and Distinction in Subject-Driven Image Generation via Unified Understanding-Generation Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Subject-driven image generation has advanced from single- to multi-subject composition, while neglecting distinction, the ability to distinguish and generate the correct subject when inputs contain multiple candidates. This limitation restricts effectiveness in complex, realistic visual settings. We propose Scone, a unified understanding-generation method that integrates composition and distinction. Scone enables the understanding expert to act as a semantic bridge, conveying semantic information and guiding the generation expert to preserve subject identity while minimizing interference. A two-stage training scheme first learns composition, then enhances distinction through semantic alignment and attention-based masking. We also introduce SconeEval, a benchmark for evaluating both composition and distinction across diverse scenarios. Experiments demonstrate that Scone outperforms existing open-source models in composition and distinction tasks on two benchmarks. Our model, benchmark, and training data are available at: https://github.com/Ryann-Ran/Scone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scone，一种统一理解与生成的方法，旨在同时实现主题驱动图像生成中的组合（composition）与区分（distinction）能力。Scone 利用理解专家作为语义桥梁，引导生成专家保留主体身份并减少干扰，通过两阶段训练先后学习组合与区分。实验在作者提出的 SconeEval 基准及现有基准上，Scone 在组合和区分任务中均优于现有开源模型。
Motivation: 现有主题驱动图像生成专注于多主体组合，忽视了区分能力——即输入包含多个候选主体时正确生成指定主体的能力，这限制了在复杂真实场景中的有效性。
Method: 提出统一理解-生成框架 Scone：让理解专家充当语义桥梁，将语义信息传递给生成专家，通过语义对齐和基于注意力的掩码机制增强区分能力；训练采用两阶段方案，先学习组合，再学习区分。
Result: 在 SconeEval 和另一基准上，Scone 在组合与区分任务中均优于现有开源模型。
Conclusion: Scone 通过统一理解与生成建模，有效桥接了主题驱动图像生成中的组合与区分能力，为处理复杂多主体场景提供了新思路。

papers.title: V-REX: Benchmarking Exploratory Visual Reasoning via Chain-of-Questions
papers.abstract_en: While many vision-language models (VLMs) are developed to answer well-defined, straightforward questions with highly specified targets, as in most benchmarks, they often struggle in practice with complex open-ended tasks, which usually require multiple rounds of exploration and reasoning in the visual space. Such visual thinking paths not only provide step-by-step exploration and verification as an AI detective but also produce better interpretations of the final answers. However, these paths are challenging to evaluate due to the large exploration space of intermediate steps. To bridge the gap, we develop an evaluation suite, ``Visual Reasoning with multi-step EXploration (V-REX)'', which is composed of a benchmark of challenging visual reasoning tasks requiring native multi-step exploration and an evaluation protocol. V-REX covers rich application scenarios across diverse domains. V-REX casts the multi-step exploratory reasoning into a Chain-of-Questions (CoQ) and disentangles VLMs' capability to (1) Planning: breaking down an open-ended task by selecting a chain of exploratory questions; and (2) Following: answering curated CoQ sequentially to collect information for deriving the final answer. By curating finite options of questions and answers per step, V-REX achieves a reliable quantitative and fine-grained analysis of the intermediate steps. By assessing SOTA proprietary and open-sourced VLMs, we reveal consistent scaling trends, significant differences between planning and following abilities, and substantial room for improvement in multi-step exploratory reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-REX是一个针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的多步骤探索推理评估套件，包含基准和评估协议。它将开放式的视觉推理任务转化为链式问题（Chain-of-Questions, CoQ），并分别评估模型的规划（选择探索问题链）和跟随（顺序回答问题）能力。通过对多种闭源和开源VLM的评估，揭示了规划与跟随能力之间的显著差异，以及当前模型在多步探索推理上的改进空间。
Motivation: 现有VLM基准多针对定义明确的问题，但在复杂开放式任务中表现不佳，这类任务需要多轮视觉探索和推理。缺乏对中间步骤的可靠评估方法。
Method: 构建V-REX评估套件，包含多领域挑战性视觉推理任务的基准，并设计链式问题（CoQ）框架，通过限定每步的问题和答案选项，实现中间步骤的定量细粒度分析，将能力分解为规划（选择问题链）和跟随（顺序回答问题）。
Result: 对当前SOTA的闭源和开源VLM评估显示，存在一致的扩展趋势，规划与跟随能力之间有显著差异，且多步探索推理仍有大量改进空间。
Conclusion: V-REX为多步探索性视觉推理提供了可靠的定量评估方法，揭示了当前VLM在该任务上的不足，并指出了未来研究方向。

papers.title: Model-Based Diffusion Sampling for Predictive Control in Offline Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Offline decision-making via diffusion models often produces trajectories that are misaligned with system dynamics, limiting their reliability for control. We propose Model Predictive Diffuser (MPDiffuser), a compositional diffusion framework that combines a diffusion planner with a dynamics diffusion model to generate task-aligned and dynamically plausible trajectories. MPDiffuser interleaves planner and dynamics updates during sampling, progressively correcting feasibility while preserving task intent. A lightweight ranking module then selects trajectories that best satisfy task objectives. The compositional design improves sample efficiency and adaptability by enabling the dynamics model to leverage diverse and previously unseen data independently of the planner. Empirically, we demonstrate consistent improvements over prior diffusion-based methods on unconstrained (D4RL) and constrained (DSRL) benchmarks, and validate practicality through deployment on a real quadrupedal robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出模型预测扩散器 (MPDiffuser)，一种组合扩散框架，通过将扩散规划器与动力学扩散模型交错采样，生成既符合任务目标又符合系统动力学的轨迹，并在离线决策基准和真实四足机器人上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有离线决策的扩散模型生成的轨迹常与系统动力学不对齐，限制了控制可靠性。
Method: MPDiffuser 组合扩散规划器与动力学扩散模型，在采样过程中交错更新规划器输出和动力学可行性，并利用轻量级排序模块选择最佳轨迹。
Result: 在无约束 (D4RL) 和约束 (DSRL) 基准上一致优于先前扩散方法，并在真实四足机器人上验证了实用性。
Conclusion: 组合设计使动力学模型独立于规划器利用多样数据，提升了样本效率和适应性。

papers.title: GeoLoom: High-quality Geometric Diagram Generation from Textual Input
papers.abstract_en: High-quality geometric diagram generation presents both a challenge and an opportunity: it demands strict spatial accuracy while offering well-defined constraints to guide generation. Inspired by recent advances in geometry problem solving that employ formal languages and symbolic solvers for enhanced correctness and interpretability, we propose GeoLoom, a novel framework for text-to-diagram generation in geometric domains. GeoLoom comprises two core components: an autoformalization module that translates natural language into a specifically designed generation-oriented formal language GeoLingua, and a coordinate solver that maps formal constraints to precise coordinates using the efficient Monte Carlo optimization. To support this framework, we introduce GeoNF, a dataset aligning natural language geometric descriptions with formal GeoLingua descriptions. We further propose a constraint-based evaluation metric that quantifies structural deviation, offering mathematically grounded supervision for iterative refinement. Empirical results demonstrate that GeoLoom significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in structural fidelity, providing a principled foundation for interpretable and scalable diagram generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoLoom框架，用于从文本描述生成高质量几何图形。框架包含自动形式化模块（将自然语言转为形式语言GeoLingua）和坐标求解器（通过蒙特卡洛优化将形式约束映射为精确坐标）。还构建了GeoNF数据集和对齐的约束评估指标。实验表明GeoLoom在结构保真度上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有文本到图形生成方法在高精度几何领域缺乏严格空间准确性，而形式语言与符号求解器在几何问题求解中已展现优势，但尚未用于图形生成。
Method: GeoLoom由两个核心组件构成：自动形式化模块将自然语言描述转换为专门设计的面向生成的形式语言GeoLingua；坐标求解器利用高效蒙特卡洛优化将形式约束映射为精确坐标。同时提出约束驱动的评估指标度量结构偏差。
Result: 在结构保真度上，GeoLoom显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: GeoLoom为可解释、可扩展的几何图形生成提供了原则性基础。

papers.title: MIND-V: Hierarchical World Model for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with RL-based Physical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Scalable embodied intelligence is constrained by the scarcity of diverse, long-horizon robotic manipulation data. Existing video world models in this domain are limited to synthesizing short clips of simple actions and often rely on manually defined trajectories. To this end, we introduce MIND-V, a cognitive hierarchical world model designed to synthesize physically plausible and logically coherent videos of long-horizon robotic manipulation. Inspired by cognitive science, MIND-V bridges high-level reasoning with pixel-level synthesis through three core components: a Semantic Reasoning Hub (SRH) that leverages a pre-trained vision-language model for task planning; a Behavioral Semantic Bridge (BSB) that translates abstract instructions into domain-invariant representations; and a Motor Video Generator (MVG) for conditional video rendering. MIND-V employs Staged Visual Future Rollouts, a test-time optimization strategy to enhance long-horizon robustness. To enforce adherence to physical laws, we introduce a GRPO reinforcement learning post-training phase guided by a novel Physical Foresight Coherence (PFC) reward. PFC leverages the V-JEPA2 world model as a physics referee to penalize implausible dynamics in the latent feature space. Experiments confirm MIND-V's SOTA performance in long-horizon simulation and its significant value for policy learning, introducing a scalable and fully autonomous framework for embodied data synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND-V 提出一种分层次的世界模型，用于生成长时间跨度机器人操作任务的物理合理且逻辑连贯的视频。模型包含语义推理中枢、行为语义桥和运动视频生成器三个核心组件，并采用阶段性视觉未来展开和基于 GRPO 的强化学习后训练来确保物理一致性。实验表明该方法在长时程模拟和策略学习方面达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作视频世界模型仅能合成短片段简单动作，且依赖人工定义轨迹，缺乏多样性和长时程能力。
Method: 设计认知分层世界模型 MIND-V，包括：语义推理中枢（SRH）利用预训练视觉语言模型进行任务规划；行为语义桥（BSB）将抽象指令转化为域不变表示；运动视频生成器（MVG）用于条件视频渲染。采用阶段性视觉未来展开作为测试时优化策略，并通过 GRPO 强化学习后训练结合物理前瞻一致性（PFC）奖励来惩罚不符合物理规律的动力学。
Result: 摘要称实验验证了 MIND-V 在长时程模拟中的最优性能，并对策略学习有显著价值，为具身数据合成提供了可扩展的全自动框架。
Conclusion: MIND-V 通过认知层次结构实现了长时程机器人操作的物理合理视频生成，并展示了其作为合成数据源用于策略学习的潜力。

papers.title: On the Condition Number Dependency in Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization minimizes an objective function, defined by an upper-level problem whose feasible region is the solution of a lower-level problem. We study the oracle complexity of finding an $ε$-stationary point with first-order methods when the upper-level problem is nonconvex, and the lower-level problem is strongly convex. Recent works (Ji et al., ICML 2021; Arbel and Mairal, ICLR 2022; Chen et al., JMLR 2025) achieve a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\bar κ_y^4 ε^{-2})$ upper bound that is near-optimal in $ε$, which can be reduced to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\bar κ_y^{7/2} ε^{-2})$ by a naive application of Nesterov acceleration in the inner loop, where $\bar κ_y$ is the global condition number. However, the optimal dependency on the condition number is unknown. In this work, we establish a new $Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2})$ lower bound, where $κ_y < \bar κ_y$ is the lower-level condition number that is of the same order as $\bar κ_y$ when the smoothness constants are $\mathcal{O}(1)$. Our lower bound establishes the first provable gap in terms of condition number dependency between bilevel problems and minimax problems in this setup. Our lower bounds can be extended to various settings, including high-order smooth functions, stochastic oracles, and convex hyper-objectives: (1) For second-order and arbitrarily smooth problems, we show lower bounds of $Ω({κ_y^{31/14}} ε^{-12/7})$ and $Ω(κ_y^{21/10} ε^{-8/5})$, respectively. (2) For convex-strongly-convex problems, we improve the previously best lower bound (Ji and Liang, JMLR 2022) from $Ω(κ_y /\sqrtε)$ to $Ω(κ_y^{3/2} / \sqrtε)$. (3) For smooth stochastic problems, we also show a lower bound of $Ω(κ_y^4 ε^{-4})$.
papers.comment: This new version improves deterministic lower bounds in v1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了双层优化中寻找ε-稳定点的一阶方法复杂度，重点关注对条件数的依赖。针对上层非凸、下层强凸的问题，现有方法达到了接近最优的ε依赖性，但条件数的最优依赖未知。本文建立了新的下界Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2})，并扩展到高阶光滑、随机和凸设置，揭示了双层优化与极小极大问题在条件数依赖上的差距。
Motivation: 双层优化问题中，现有的上界对条件数的依赖尚未达到最优，且与极小极大问题相比存在未知差距。明确最优依赖有助于指导算法设计。
Method: 通过构造具有特定条件数的实例，利用信息论和优化理论推导一阶方法的下界。
Result: 建立了Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2})的下界；对于二阶光滑问题得到Ω(κ_y^{31/14} ε^{-12/7})；对于凸-强凸问题将下界从Ω(κ_y/√ε)改进为Ω(κ_y^{3/2}/√ε)；对于随机问题得到Ω(κ_y^4 ε^{-4})。
Conclusion: 该下界首次证明了双层优化与极小极大问题在条件数依赖上的差异，并适用于多种设置。

papers.title: Selective Disk Bispectrum: A Complete and Rotation Invariant Image Descriptor
papers.abstract_en: Rotation invariance is a fundamental requirement across many computer vision tasks. Historically, this inductive bias has been encoded through hand-crafted rotation-invariant representations. These are compact, interpretable, and fast to compute, but they come at the cost of descriptive power. More recently, architectures achieve inductive bias through learned representations. These are highly descriptive and achieve strong empirical performance, at the cost of efficiency and interpretability. In this work, we propose an alternative at the intersection of both paradigms. We introduce the selective disk bispectrum (SDB), a complex-valued rotation-invariant vector that preserves all information about the image except its orientation. Our key theoretical contributions are the selective disk bispectrum, its inversion, its (reduced) spatial and computational complexities (compared to the full disk bispectrum), and its expectation and variance under noise. Furthermore, we propose a numerical SDB approximation and provide theoretical guarantees for its accuracy and rotation invariance. Empirically, we validate SDB's invariance and robustness to noise classification tasks. We test our reconstruction algorithm on multi-reference alignment of rotated images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性圆盘双谱（SDB），一种复数值的旋转不变图像描述子，理论上能保留除方向外的全部图像信息，并具有更低的时空复杂度（相比全圆盘双谱）。摘要给出了其逆变换、噪声下的期望与方差，以及数值近似的准确性保证，并在分类和多参考对齐任务上验证了不变性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有旋转不变表示要么是手工设计的紧凑但欠描述，要么是学习得到的高描述但低效，本文旨在结合两者优点，提出一种既紧凑、可解释又高描述力的旋转不变描述子。
Method: 提出选择性圆盘双谱（SDB），通过频域选择只保留圆盘内非冗余的频率分量，构造复数值旋转不变向量，并给出其逆变换、数值近似及理论保证。
Result: 在分类任务中验证了SDB的旋转不变性和对噪声的鲁棒性，并在旋转图像的多参考对齐任务上测试了重建算法，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: SDB是一种完整的旋转不变图像描述子，在保持信息完整性的同时降低了时空复杂度，并具有理论保障，适用于需要旋转不变性的视觉任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lost in Serialization: Invariance and Generalization of LLM Graph Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: While promising, graph reasoners based on Large Language Models (LLMs) lack built-in invariance to symmetries in graph representations. Operating on sequential graph serializations, LLMs can produce different outputs under node reindexing, edge reordering, or formatting changes, raising robustness concerns. We systematically analyze these effects, studying how fine-tuning impacts encoding sensitivity as well generalization on unseen tasks. We propose a principled decomposition of graph serializations into node labeling, edge encoding, and syntax, and evaluate LLM robustness to variations of each of these factors on a comprehensive benchmarking suite. We also contribute a novel set of spectral tasks to further assess generalization abilities of fine-tuned reasoners. Results show that larger (non-fine-tuned) models are more robust. Fine-tuning reduces sensitivity to node relabeling but may increase it to variations in structure and format, while it does not consistently improve performance on unseen tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了大语言模型（LLM）作为图推理器时，对图表示对称性缺乏不变性的问题。研究发现，LLM 在节点重索引、边重排序或格式变化下会输出不同结果，影响鲁棒性。作者提出图序列化的因素分解（节点标记、边编码、语法），并评估微调对编码敏感性和泛化能力的影响。结果表明，更大的（未微调）模型更鲁棒；微调降低了节点重标记的敏感性，但可能增加对结构和格式变化的敏感性，且未一致提升在未见任务上的表现。
Motivation: LLM 图推理器缺乏对图表示对称性的内置不变性，导致在节点重索引、边重排序或格式变化下输出不一致，引发鲁棒性担忧。
Method: 提出图序列化的原则性分解为节点标记、边编码和语法三个因素，并在综合基准套件上评估 LLM 对每种因素变化的鲁棒性；同时引入一套新的谱任务集来评估微调推理器的泛化能力。
Result: 更大的（未微调）模型更鲁棒；微调降低了节点重标记的敏感性，但可能增加对结构和格式变化的敏感性，且未一致提升在未见任务上的表现。
Conclusion: 微调 LLM 图推理器需要在编码敏感性与泛化能力之间权衡，当前方法在未见任务上改进有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning-Guided Integration Contours Construction for Fast Large-Scale Generalized Eigensolvers
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale Generalized Eigenvalue Problems (GEPs) is a fundamental yet computationally prohibitive task in science and engineering. As a promising direction, contour integral (CI) methods offer an efficient and parallelizable framework. However, their performance is critically dependent on the selection of integration contours -- improper selection without reliable prior knowledge of eigenvalue distribution can incur significant computational overhead and compromise numerical accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose Deepcontour, a novel hybrid framework that integrates a deep learning-based spectral predictor with Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) for principled contour design. Specifically, Deepcontour utilizes its specialized Eigen-Neural-Operator (ENO) to provide rapid spectral distribution priors, driving a KDE module to automatically construct the optimized integration contours, which guide the CI solver to efficiently find the desired eigenvalues. Deepcontour achieves up to a 5.63x speedup across diverse scientific datasets while maintaining strict numerical rigor. By merging the predictive power of deep learning with the numerical rigor of classical solvers, this work establishes an efficient and robust paradigm for solving large-scale GEPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Deepcontour混合框架，结合深度学习谱预测器（Eigen-Neural-Operator）与核密度估计（KDE）自动构建积分轮廓，用于加速大规模广义特征值问题求解。摘要显示在多个科学数据集上实现最高5.63倍加速，同时保持数值精度。
Motivation: 轮廓积分法（CI）性能依赖积分轮廓的选择，缺乏可靠的谱分布先验时不当选择会导致计算开销大和精度下降。
Method: 利用Eigen-Neural-Operator（ENO）快速提供谱分布先验，驱动KDE模块自动构建优化积分轮廓，引导CI求解器高效计算特征值。
Result: 在多个科学数据集上实现最高5.63倍加速，同时保持严格数值精度。
Conclusion: 融合深度学习预测能力与经典求解器数值严谨性，为大规模GEPs提供高效鲁棒的求解范式。

papers.title: QDepth-VLA: Quantized Depth Prediction as Auxiliary Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial perception and reasoning are crucial for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to accomplish fine-grained manipulation tasks. However, existing approaches often lack the ability to understand and reason over the essential 3D structures necessary for precise control. To address this limitation, we propose QDepth-VLA, a general framework that augments VLA models with an auxiliary depth prediction task. A dedicated depth expert is designed to predict quantized latent tokens of depth maps obtained from a VQ-VAE encoder, enabling the model to learn depth-aware representations that capture critical geometric cues. Experimental results on the simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks demonstrate that QDepth-VLA yields strong spatial reasoning and competitive performance on manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QDepth-VLA框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中引入辅助的深度预测任务，利用VQ-VAE编码器预测深度图的量化潜在令牌，从而增强模型的空间感知和几何推理能力。在仿真和真实世界的精细操作任务上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在精细操作任务中缺乏对3D结构的理解和推理能力，导致空间感知不足。
Method: 设计一个专门的深度专家模块，使用VQ-VAE编码器将深度图编码为量化潜在令牌，并作为辅助任务与主任务联合训练。
Result: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上，QDepth-VLA展现出强大的空间推理能力，并取得了有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 辅助深度预测任务能够有效提升VLA模型在操作任务中的空间感知和推理能力。

papers.title: RoboGPT-R1: Enhancing Robot Task Planning with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Improving the reasoning capabilities of embodied agents is crucial for robots to complete complex human instructions in long-view manipulation tasks successfully. Despite the success of large language models and vision language models based on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in planning tasks, they continue facing challenges in performing long-horizon manipulation tasks in complex real-world environments, owing to their restricted common sense and reasoning capabilities. Considering that aligning general-purpose vision language models to robotic planning tasks via supervised fine-tuning suffers from poor generalization and insufficient physical understanding, we propose RoboGPT-R1, a two-stage fine-tuning framework for embodied planning. In this framework, supervised training acquires foundational knowledge through expert sequences, followed by RL to address the model's shortcomings in visual-spatial understanding and reasoning. To achieve physical understanding and action sequence consistency in multi-step reasoning tasks, we design a rule-based reward function that simultaneously considers long-horizon performance and action constraint in the environment. The reasoning model, trained on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, significantly outperforms the larger-scale model, GPT-4o-mini, by 21.33% and surpasses other work trained on Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 20.33% on the EmbodiedBench benchmark.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026), pp. 2827-2837, IFAAMAS, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身智能体在长序列操作任务中推理能力不足的问题，提出两阶段微调框架 RoboGPT-R1，先通过监督微调（SFT）获取基础知识，再使用强化学习（RL）提升视觉空间理解与推理能力。在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 模型上训练后，在 EmbodiedBench 基准上超过 GPT-4o-mini 21.33%，并超越其他基于 7B 模型的工作 20.33%。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型/视觉语言模型的监督微调方法在复杂真实环境的长时段操作任务中泛化能力差、物理理解不足，需要更有效的方法来对齐模型与机器人规划任务。
Method: 提出两阶段微调框架：第一阶段使用专家序列进行监督微调，使模型获得基础规划知识；第二阶段设计基于规则奖励函数的强化学习，奖励函数同时考虑长时段任务表现和动作约束，以改善视觉-空间理解与推理一致性。
Result: 在 EmbodiedBench 基准上，基于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 的模型准确率比 GPT-4o-mini 高 21.33%，比基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的其他工作高 20.33%。

papers.title: Influence Dynamics and Stagewise Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Current training data attribution (TDA) methods treat the influence one sample has on another as static, but neural networks learn in distinct stages that exhibit changing patterns of influence. In this work, we introduce a framework for stagewise data attribution grounded in singular learning theory. We predict that influence can change non-monotonically, including sign flips and sharp peaks at developmental transitions. We first validate these predictions analytically and empirically in a toy model, showing that dynamic shifts in influence directly map to the model's progressive learning of a semantic hierarchy. Finally, we demonstrate these phenomena at scale in language models, where token-level influence changes align with known developmental stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前训练数据归因方法将样本间影响视为静态的问题，基于奇异学习理论提出阶段式数据归因框架。预测影响可以非单调变化（包括符号翻转和尖峰），并在玩具模型和语言模型中验证了这些现象，与模型学习语义层次结构的进展阶段一致。
Motivation: 现有训练数据归因方法忽略了神经网络在训练过程中影响模式的动态变化，而实际学习呈现阶段性特征。
Method: 基于奇异学习理论构建阶段式数据归因框架，通过分析模型学习过程中的影响动态，捕捉非单调变化和符号翻转。
Result: 在玩具模型中分析并经验验证了影响动态与语义层次结构学习的直接映射；在大规模语言模型中也观察到词元级影响变化与已知发展阶段对齐。
Conclusion: 该框架揭示了数据影响在训练过程中的动态演化，为理解神经网络学习阶段提供了新视角。

papers.title: How can we assess human-agent interactions? Case studies in software agent design
papers.abstract_en: While benchmarks measure the accuracy of LLM-powered agents, they mostly assume full automation, failing to represent the collaborative nature of real-world use cases. In this paper, we make two major steps towards the rigorous assessment of human-agent interactions. First, we propose PULSE, a framework for more efficient human-centric evaluation of agent designs, which comprises collecting user feedback, training an ML model to predict user satisfaction, and computing results by combining human satisfaction ratings with model-generated pseudo-labels. Second, we deploy PULSE in software engineering -- one of the highest-impact, real-world domains for LLM agents -- via a large-scale web platform built around the open-source agent OpenHands. Across 15k users, we evaluate how three agent design decisions impact developer satisfaction rates. We also show how PULSE can lead to more robust conclusions about agent design, reducing confidence intervals by 40\% compared to a standard A/B test. Finally, we find substantial discrepancies between in-the-wild results with benchmark performance (e.g., the anti-correlation between claude-sonnet-4 and gpt-5), underscoring the limitations of benchmark-driven evaluation. Our framework PULSE provides guidance for future evaluations, and our findings identify opportunities for better software agent designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体评估中缺乏人机交互视角的问题，提出PULSE框架，通过收集用户反馈、训练满意度预测模型并结合伪标签来高效评估智能体设计。在软件工程领域基于OpenHands平台对15k用户进行实验，评估三种设计决策对开发者满意度的影响，并发现基准测试分数与真实用户满意度之间存在显著不一致。
Motivation: 现有基准测试主要衡量完全自动化场景下的准确性，无法反映实际人机协作的复杂需求，导致评估结果与真实效用脱节。
Method: 提出PULSE框架，包含三阶段：收集用户反馈、训练机器学习模型预测用户满意度、结合人类评分与模型生成伪标签计算评估结果，并在软件工程领域通过大规模Web平台部署OpenHands智能体进行实验。
Result: 在15k用户实验中，PULSE将置信区间缩小40%，并揭示了claude-sonnet-4与gpt-5在基准表现与实际满意度之间的反相关等显著差异。
Conclusion: PULSE框架为未来人机交互评估提供指导，并指出基准测试驱动的评估存在局限性，需要更关注真实用户反馈。
