papers.title: Gradient-Guided Furthest Point Sampling for Robust Training Set Selection
papers.abstract_en: Training set sampling methods are used to improve model performance and lower data costs in machine learning problems relevant to chemistry. We introduce Gradient Guided Furthest Point Sampling (GGFPS), a simple extension of Furthest Point Sampling (FPS) that leverages molecular force norms to guide efficient sampling of configurational spaces of molecules. Numerical evidence is presented for a toy system (the Styblinski-Tang function) as well as for molecular dynamics trajectories from the MD17 dataset. Our numerical results indicate superior data efficiency and model robustness when using GGFPS compared to FPS and uniform random sampling (URS), as well as established supervised FPS-style selectors, PCov-FPS and PCov-CUR. Distribution analysis of the MD17 data suggests that FPS systematically under-samples equilibrium geometries, resulting in large test errors for relaxed structures. GGFPS cures this artifact and (i) enables up to twofold reductions in training cost without sacrificing predictive accuracy compared to FPS in the 2-dimensional Styblinski-Tang system, (ii) systematically lowers prediction errors for equilibrium as well as strained structures in MD17, and (iii) systematically decreases prediction error variances across all of the MD17 configuration spaces. These results suggest that gradient-aware sampling methods hold great promise as effective training set selection tools, and that naive use of FPS may result in imbalanced training and inconsistent prediction outcomes.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 43 figures, 2 algorithms; journal article with supplementary information appended
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度引导最远点采样（GGFPS），通过分子力范数指导高效采样，用于化学机器学习中的训练集选择。在MD17分子动力学轨迹上测试，结果显示GGFPS比FPS和均匀随机采样具有更高的数据效率和模型鲁棒性，能纠正FPS对平衡几何结构欠采样的问题。
Motivation: 现有FPS方法会系统性地欠采样平衡几何结构，导致对松弛结构的预测误差大，而训练集采样方法可提升模型性能并降低数据成本。
Method: GGFPS是FPS的简单扩展，利用分子力范数（force norms）来指导对分子构型空间的采样。
Result: 在MD17上，GGFPS相比FPS和URS显著降低预测误差，并减小预测方差；在二维Styblinski-Tang系统中，训练成本降低至两倍而不牺牲精度。
Conclusion: 梯度感知采样方法有望成为有效的训练集选择工具，而FPS的朴素使用会导致训练不平衡和不一致的预测。

papers.title: Orthogonal Procrustes problem preserves correlations in synthetic data
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data generation is increasingly used in applications involving privacy preservation, data sharing, and data scarcity. In many situations, preserving the dependence structure of the original data is of central interest. In this work, we propose a lightweight postprocessing methodology for synthetic tabular data based on the Orthogonal Procrustes problem. Starting from an already generated synthetic dataset, our approach constructs the closest dataset that restores the Pearson correlation structure of the original data. On the theoretical side, we show that preserving Pearson correlation is equivalent to the action of linear orthogonal maps in the centered-data subspace, and then deploy the Orthogonal Procrustes problem. However, in order for this to hold, we first establish a result ensuring that applying the Orthogonal Procrustes step remains in the aforementioned subspace under suitable assumptions. Applications to several datasets and synthetic data generators illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. In particular, the numerical experiments indicate that the correlation structure can be restored while largely preserving the individual feature distributions, the geometry of the data, and the performance of downstream classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对合成表格数据中保持原始数据依赖结构的需求，提出一种基于正交Procrustes问题的轻量级后处理方法，通过构造最接近原始Pearson相关结构的合成数据来恢复相关性。理论上证明了保持Pearson相关等价于中心数据子空间上的线性正交映射，并在多个数据集和生成器上验证了有效性，表明该方法能够恢复相关结构，同时保留个体特征分布、数据几何和下游分类性能。
Motivation: 合成数据生成中保持原始数据的依赖结构（尤其是相关结构）至关重要，但现有方法可能破坏该结构。本文旨在提供一种轻量级后处理方法来恢复相关结构。
Method: 基于正交Procrustes问题，在中心数据子空间上求解线性正交映射，将已有合成数据变换为最接近原始Pearson相关结构的合成数据。
Result: 在多个数据集和不同合成数据生成器上的数值实验表明，该方法能有效恢复相关结构，同时较好地保留个体特征分布、数据几何和下游分类任务性能。
Conclusion: 所提出的正交Procrustes后处理是一种有效的轻量级方法，用于恢复合成数据中的Pearson相关结构，且对数据分布和下游任务影响较小。

papers.title: Informed Asymmetric Actor-Critic: Leveraging Privileged Signals Beyond Full-State Access
papers.abstract_en: Asymmetric reinforcement learning leverages privileged information available during training to improve learning under partial observability. Existing asymmetric actor-critic methods typically assume access to the full environment state to condition the critic during training, which is often unrealistic in practice. We introduce the informed asymmetric actor-critic framework that allows the critic to be conditioned on arbitrary state-dependent privileged signals, and show that any such signal yields unbiased policy gradient estimates. This substantially expands the set of admissible privileged information and raises the problem of selecting the most informative signals for learning. To this end, we propose two novel informativeness criteria: a dependence-based test that can be applied prior to training, and a test based on improvements in value prediction that can be applied post hoc. Experiments on partially observable benchmarks and synthetic environments demonstrate that carefully selected privileged signals can match or outperform full-state asymmetric baselines while relying on strictly less state information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知情非对称Actor-Critic框架，允许评论家基于任意状态依赖的特权信号进行条件化，并证明任何此类信号都能产生无偏策略梯度估计。实验表明，精心选择的特权信号可以匹配或超越全状态非对称基线，同时依赖更少的状态信息。
Motivation: 现有非对称Actor-Critic方法通常假设训练时能访问完整环境状态，这在实践中不现实。本文旨在放宽这一假设，允许使用更广泛的特权信号，并解决如何选择最有效信号的问题。
Method: 提出知情非对称Actor-Critic框架，允许评论家以任意状态依赖的特权信号为条件。引入两种信息性标准：基于依赖的预训练测试和基于价值预测改进的后验测试。
Result: 在部分可观测基准和合成环境上，精心选择的特权信号可以匹配或超越全状态非对称基线，同时使用更少的状态信息。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架扩展了可用的特权信息范围，并提供了选择最具信息性信号的方法，在部分可观测设置下取得有效结果。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning for Wildfire Danger Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Wildfires are among the most severe natural hazards, posing a significant threat to both humans and natural ecosystems. The growing risk of wildfires increases the demand for forecasting models that are not only accurate but also reliable. Deep Learning (DL) has shown promise in predicting wildfire danger; however, its adoption is hindered by concerns over the reliability of its predictions, some of which stem from the lack of uncertainty quantification. To address this challenge, we present an uncertainty-aware DL framework that jointly captures epistemic (model) and aleatoric (data) uncertainty to enhance short-term wildfire danger forecasting. In the next-day forecasting, our best-performing model improves the F1 Score by 2.3% and reduces the Expected Calibration Error by 2.1% compared to a deterministic baseline, enhancing both predictive skill and calibration. Our experiments confirm the reliability of the uncertainty estimates and illustrate their practical utility for decision support, including the identification of uncertainty thresholds for rejecting low-confidence predictions and the generation of well-calibrated wildfire danger maps with accompanying uncertainty layers. Extending the forecast horizon up to ten days, we observe that aleatoric uncertainty increases with time, showing greater variability in environmental conditions, while epistemic uncertainty remains stable. Finally, we show that although the two uncertainty types may be redundant in low-uncertainty cases, they provide complementary insights under more challenging conditions, underscoring the value of their joint modeling for robust wildfire danger prediction. In summary, our approach significantly improves the accuracy and reliability of wildfire danger forecasting, advancing the development of trustworthy wildfire DL systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定感知的深度学习框架，联合捕获认知不确定性（模型）和偶然不确定性（数据），用于短期的野火危险预报。最佳模型在次日预报中相较于确定性基线将F1分数提升2.3%，期望校准误差降低2.1%，并验证了不确定性估计的可靠性及其在决策支持中的实用价值。将预报时效延长至十天时，偶然不确定性随时间增加，而认知不确定性保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有深度学习野火预测模型缺乏不确定性量化，导致预测可靠性不足，阻碍实际部署。

papers.title: MAD: Manifold Attracted Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models are a highly effective method for generating samples from a distribution of images. We consider scenarios where the training data comes from a noisy version of the target distribution, and present an efficiently implementable modification of the inference procedure to generate noiseless samples. Our approach is motivated by the manifold hypothesis, according to which meaningful data is concentrated around some low-dimensional manifold of a high-dimensional ambient space. The central idea is that noise manifests as low magnitude variation in off-manifold directions in contrast to the relevant variation of the desired distribution which is mostly confined to on-manifold directions. We introduce the notion of an extended score and show that, in a simplified setting, it can be used to reduce small variations to zero, while leaving large variations mostly unchanged. We describe how its approximation can be computed efficiently from an approximation to the standard score and demonstrate its efficacy on toy problems, synthetic data, and real data.

papers.title: CapStARE: Capsule-based Sequential Architecture for Robust and Efficient Gaze Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Human gaze estimation is essential for applications such as human-computer interaction, social robotics, and assistive systems. However, achieving accurate, interpretable, and real-time performance in unconstrained environments remains challenging. Existing appearance-based methods often face trade-offs between spatial robustness, computational efficiency, and effective use of contextual information. To address this, we introduce CapStARE, a capsule-based architecture that combines a frozen ConvNeXt backbone for efficient feature extraction, capsule formation with attention-based routing for structured facial reasoning, and dual GRU decoders for lightweight sequential modeling over short-horizon observation windows. This design preserves interpretable part-whole facial relationships while improving prediction stability through local contextual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance on ETH-XGaze (3.36) and MPIIFaceGaze (2.65), while also generalizing competitively on Gaze360 (9.06), all with real-time inference (<10 ms). These findings suggest that the proposed method provides a practical and robust framework for appearance-based gaze estimation in real-world interactive environments. The related code and experimental results are publicly available at: https://github.com/toukapy/capsStare

Result: 在ETH-XGaze、MPIIFaceGaze和Gaze360数据集上分别达到3.36、2.65和9.06的误差，推理延迟低于10毫秒。

papers.title: Risk Comparisons in Linear Regression: Implicit Regularization Dominates Explicit Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Existing theory suggests that for linear regression problems categorized by capacity and source conditions, gradient descent (GD) is always minimax optimal, while both ridge regression and online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) are polynomially suboptimal for certain categories of such problems. Moving beyond minimax theory, this work provides instance-wise comparisons of the finite-sample risks for these algorithms on any well-specified linear regression problem. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, GD dominates ridge regression: with comparable regularization, the excess risk of GD is always within a constant factor of that of ridge, but ridge can be polynomially worse even when tuned optimally. Second, GD is incomparable with SGD. While it is known that for certain problems GD can be polynomially better than SGD, the reverse is also true: we construct problems, inspired by benign overfitting theory, where optimally stopped GD is polynomially worse. Finally, GD dominates SGD for a significant subclass of problems -- those with fast and continuously decaying covariance spectra -- which includes all problems satisfying the standard capacity condition.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在线性回归问题中对梯度下降（GD）、岭回归（ridge regression）和随机梯度下降（SGD）进行实例级（instance-wise）风险比较。主要发现：GD始终优于ridge（即使ridge最优调参，仍可能多项式级更差）；GD与SGD互有胜负，存在两者分别最优的问题；但对于协方差谱快速且连续衰减的问题（包括满足标准容量条件的所有问题），GD优于SGD。
Motivation: 现有理论基于极小极大最优性表明GD总是最优，而ridge和SGD在某些问题上多项式次优。本文超越极小极大理论，提供实例级比较以揭示算法间的精确风险关系。
Method: 理论分析，基于任意良设定线性回归问题，推导GD、ridge和SGD的有限样本风险上界并进行比较。
Result: 得出三个关键发现：（1）GD优于ridge：相同正则化下GD风险始终在常数因子内，但ridge即使最优调参也可能多项式级更差；（2）GD与SGD不可比较：两者各自存在优于对方的问题；（3）对于协方差谱快速且连续衰减的问题（满足标准容量条件的子类），GD优于SGD。
Conclusion: 在线性回归中，隐式正则化（GD）在风险上主导显式正则化（ridge），但与SGD无绝对优劣；对于快速衰减谱问题，GD更优。

papers.title: A fine-grained attention and geometric correspondence model for musculoskeletal risk classification in athletes using multimodal visual and skeletal features
papers.abstract_en: Musculoskeletal disorders pose significant risks to athletes, and early risk assessment is essential for prevention. However, most existing methods are designed for controlled settings and fail to reliably assess risk in complex environments due to their reliance on a single type of data. This research introduces ViSK-GAT (Visual-Skeletal Geometric Attention Transformer), a novel multimodal deep learning framework that classifies musculoskeletal risk using both visual and skeletal coordinate-based features. A custom multimodal dataset (MusDis-Sports) was created by combining images and skeletal coordinates, with each sample labeled into eight risk categories based on the Rapid Entire Body Assessment (REBA) system. ViSK-GAT integrates two innovative modules: the Fine-Grained Attention Module (FGAM), which refines intra-modal features through self-attention before fusion, and the Multimodal Geometric Correspondence Module (MGCM), which enhances cross-modal alignment between image features and coordinates. The model achieved robust performance, with all key metrics exceeding 93%. Probability distribution error metrics also showed a low Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.1205 and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0156. ViSK-GAT consistently outperformed state-of-the-art (SOTA) deep learning backbones and showed its potential to advance artificial intelligence-driven musculoskeletal risk assessment and enable timely interventions in sports.

papers.title: Why Does Reasoning Length Converge? Unveiling the Underfitting-Overfitting Trade-off in Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling, primarily manifested through multi-step Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning via Reinforcement Learning (RL), has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, a significant theoretical gap persists: traditional token-level analysis fails to capture the macroscopic dynamics of reasoning-level scaling. To address this, we introduce CoT-Space, a novel theoretical framework that recasts the reasoning process from a discrete token-prediction task to an optimization process within a continuous, reasoning-level semantic space. By modeling the reasoning trajectory from both noise and risk perspectives and revitalizing foundational principles from classical learning theory, we demonstrate that the observed convergence to an optimal CoT length is a natural consequence of the fundamental trade-off between underfitting and overfitting. We further utilize RL as a tool to elicit and verify these results in our experiments. Our findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the internal test-time scaling via RL, offering a principled theoretical foundation to optimize reasoning trajectories in modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoT-Space理论框架，将链式思维推理从离散token预测重铸为连续语义空间中的优化过程，从噪声和风险角度建模推理轨迹，证明推理长度收敛是欠拟合与过拟合之间权衡的自然结果，并通过强化学习实验验证。
Motivation: 现有token级分析无法捕捉推理级缩放的宏观动力学，缺乏对推理长度收敛现象的理论解释。
Method: 引入CoT-Space框架，将推理过程建模为连续语义空间中的优化，结合经典学习理论中的欠拟合-过拟合权衡，并利用强化学习作为工具进行实验验证。
Result: 理论分析表明最优CoT长度存在且收敛，实验通过RL验证了该权衡机制。
Conclusion: 为推理时间缩放提供了机理性的理论基础，可用于优化LLM的推理轨迹。

papers.title: Parity Cross-Resonance: A Multiqubit Gate
papers.abstract_en: We present a native three-qubit entangling gate that exploits engineered interactions to realize control-control-target and control-target-target operations in a single coherent step. Unlike conventional decompositions into multiple two-qubit gates, our hybrid optimization approach selectively amplifies desired interactions while suppressing unwanted couplings, yielding robust performance across the computational subspace and beyond. The new gate can be classified as a cross-resonance gate. We show it can be utilized in several ways, for example, in GHZ triplet state preparation, Toffoli-class logic demonstrations with many-body interactions, and in implementing a controlled-ZZ gate. The latter maps the parity of two data qubits directly onto a measurement qubit, enabling faster and higher-fidelity stabilizer measurements in surface-code quantum error correction. In all these examples, we show that the three-qubit gate performance remains robust across Hilbert space sizes, as confirmed by testing under increasing total excitation numbers. This work lays the foundation for co-designing circuit architectures and control protocols that leverage native multiqubit interactions as core elements of next-generation superconducting quantum processors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种原生三量子比特纠缠门，利用工程化相互作用在单个相干步骤中实现控制-控制-目标和控制-目标-目标操作。通过混合优化方法，选择性放大所需相互作用并抑制不需要的耦合，在计算子空间及之外均表现鲁棒。该门可用于GHZ三重态制备、Toffoli类逻辑门以及实现受控-ZZ门，其中受控-ZZ门将两个数据量子比特的奇偶性直接映射到测量量子比特，从而在表面码量子纠错中实现更快、更高保真度的稳定子测量。
Motivation: 传统多量子比特操作需分解为多个两量子比特门，导致延迟增加和保真度下降。本文旨在开发一种原生多量子比特门，以简化量子电路并提高性能。
Method: 提出混合优化方法，通过工程化相互作用同时实现控制和目标量子比特间的多种相互作用，并抑制不需要的耦合。该门归类为交叉共振门。

summary_sections.method: 提出混合优化方法，通过工程化相互作用同时实现控制和目标量子比特间的多种相互作用，并抑制不需要的耦合。该门归类为交叉共振门。
summary_sections.result: 在GHZ态制备、Toffoli类逻辑门和受控-ZZ门中展示性能，且在不同希尔伯特空间尺寸下保持鲁棒性，特别是在受控-ZZ门中，将数据量子比特奇偶性直接映射到测量量子比特，加速表面码稳定子测量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为下一代超导量子处理器中利用原生多量子比特相互作用进行电路架构和控制协议协同设计奠定基础。

papers.title: Whisfusion: Parallel ASR Decoding with Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) encoder-decoder models dominate high-quality multilingual ASR, but their left-to-right decoders make inference latency scale with transcript length. A natural alternative, CTC-style non-autoregressive (NAR) systems avoid this bottleneck but their conditional independence assumption sacrifices transcript-level generative modeling. Masked diffusion language models (e.g., LLaDA, MDLM) offer a competitive NAR text-generation approach. We ask whether such models can bring NAR ASR into the accuracy regime of strong AR ASR systems while removing the left-to-right bottleneck. We propose Whisfusion, which trains a dedicated masked diffusion decoder from scratch on top of frozen Whisper-large-v3 audio embeddings, denoising masked transcripts in just a few steps. We train on ~68k hours of 11-language speech with high-mask specialization to align training with the fully masked starting point of inference, and decode via Parallel Diffusion Decoding. Whisfusion surpasses Whisper-large-v3 on group-average accuracy across English, European, and CJK benchmarks, while running 4-5x faster, additionally surpassing Whisper-turbo in both accuracy and throughput. It reaches accuracy competitive with Canary and Qwen3-ASR while running 3-7x faster. These results establish masked diffusion as a Pareto-competitive non-autoregressive paradigm for high-throughput multilingual transcription. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/taeyoun811/Whisfusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Whisfusion，在冻结的Whisper-large-v3音频嵌入上从头训练一个掩码扩散解码器，实现并行非自回归ASR解码。在约68k小时多语言语音上训练，采用高掩码专业化，解码仅需少量步骤。Whisfusion在英文、欧洲和CJK基准上组平均准确率超过Whisper-large-v3，速度快4-5倍，同时准确率和吞吐量均优于Whisper-turbo，与Canary和Qwen3-ASR准确率相当但快3-7倍。掩码扩散被证明是高吞吐量多语言转录的Pareto最优非自回归范式。
Motivation: 自回归ASR解码延迟随转录长度线性增长，而CTC式非自回归系统牺牲了生成建模能力。论文探索掩码扩散语言模型是否能在消除自回归瓶颈的同时达到强自回归ASR的准确率。
Method: 在冻结的Whisper-large-v3音频嵌入上，从零开始训练一个专用的掩码扩散解码器，采用高掩码专业化训练（使训练与推理时的全掩码起始点对齐），并通过并行扩散解码进行推理。
Result: 在英文、欧洲和CJK基准上，Whisfusion组平均准确率超过Whisper-large-v3，速度快4-5倍；准确率和吞吐量均超越Whisper-turbo；与Canary和Qwen3-ASR准确率相当但快3-7倍。
Conclusion: 掩码扩散被建立为高吞吐量多语言转录的一个Pareto竞争性非自回归范式，在准确率和速度之间取得了更好的权衡。

papers.title: Assessment of Personality Dimensions Across Situations in Dyadic Role-Play Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Prior research indicates that users prefer assistive technologies whose personalities align with their own. This has sparked interest in automatic personality perception (APP), which aims to predict an individual's perceived personality traits. Previous studies in APP have treated personalities as static traits, independent of context. However, perceived personalities can vary by context and situation as shown in psychological research. In this study, we investigate the relationship between conversational speech and perceived personality for participants engaged in two work situations (a neutral interview and a stressful client interaction). Our key findings are: 1) perceived personalities differ significantly across interactions, 2) loudness, sound level, and spectral flux features are indicative of perceived extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness in neutral interactions, while neuroticism correlates with these features in stressful contexts, 3) handcrafted acoustic features and non-verbal features outperform speaker embeddings in inference of perceived personality, and 4) stressful interactions are more predictive of neuroticism, aligning with existing psychological research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对话语音与情境化个性感知的关系，在两种工作场景（中立面试和高压客户互动）中分析语音特征与个性特质的相关性。发现感知个性在情境间显著不同，声学特征与不同情境下的个性特质存在关联，且非语言特征比说话人嵌入更有效。
Motivation: 先前自动个性感知研究将个性视为静态特质，忽视情境变化。心理学表明个性感知因情境而异，因此需要研究情境对语音个性感知的影响。
Method: 在两种工作情境（中立面试与高压客户互动）中收集参与者对话语音，提取手工声学特征（响度、声级、谱通量）与非语言特征，与感知个性进行关联分析。
Result: 关键发现包括：(1)感知个性在不同互动中显著不同；(2)响度、声级、谱通量在中立互动中与外向性、宜人性、尽责性、开放性相关，而在高压情境中与神经质相关；(3)手工声学特征和非语言特征优于说话人嵌入；(4)高压互动对神经质的预测更强。
Conclusion: 研究表明情境对语音个性感知有重要影响，未来APP系统应考虑情境因素，尤其在神经质预测上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Aided Joint Secrecy Precoding and Trajectory for RSMA-Based Heterogeneous UAV Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates secure communications in rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) enabled heterogeneous UAV networks, where multiple UAVs collaboratively serve ground terminals in the presence of eavesdroppers. By jointly considering secrecy rate maximization and propulsion energy consumption minimization, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem involving UAV trajectory design, service association, power allocation, and secrecy precoding under mobility, collision-avoidance, service-capacity, and communication constraints. The formulated problem is highly non-convex due to the coupling among UAV trajectories, RSMA transmission variables, and secrecy constraints.To address the resulting non-convex and highly coupled optimization problem, we propose a hierarchical optimization framework. The inner layer uses a semidefinite relaxation (SDR)-based S2DC algorithm combining penalty functions and difference-of-convex (D.C.) programming to solve the secrecy precoding problem with fixed UAV positions. The outer layer introduces a Large Language Model (LLM)-guided heuristic multi-agent reinforcement learning approach (LLM-HeMARL) for trajectory optimization. LLM-HeMARL efficiently incorporates LLM-generated expert heuristic policy, enabling UAVs to learn energy-aware, security-driven trajectories without the inference overhead of real-time LLM calls. The simulation results show that our method outperforms existing baselines in secrecy rate and energy efficiency, with consistent robustness across varying UAV swarm sizes and random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了RSMA异构无人机网络中的安全通信问题，联合优化保密速率与推进能耗，提出分层优化框架：内层采用基于半定松弛（SDR）的S2DC算法处理保密预编码，外层引入大语言模型（LLM）引导的多智能体强化学习方法（LLM-HeMARL）优化轨迹。仿真结果显示，该方法在保密速率和能效上超过现有基线，且对无人机数量和随机种子具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有无人机网络在存在窃听者时难以同时最大化保密速率和最小化能耗，且轨迹、资源分配与保密约束高度耦合导致问题非凸。
Method: 提出双层优化框架：内层利用SDR结合罚函数与差凸规划（D.C. programming）求解固定位置下的保密预编码；外层采用LLM生成的专家启发式策略引导多智能体强化学习优化轨迹，避免实时调用LLM的推理开销。
Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法在保密速率和能效上均优于现有基线，并在不同无人机规模与随机种子下保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了LLM引导的启发式策略可有效解决UAV轨迹优化中的非凸耦合问题，兼顾安全与能效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GRID: Scaling Task-Agnostic Inference in Continual Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-based continual learning (CL) offers a parameter-efficient way to adapt large language models (LLMs) across task sequences. However, existing methods often rely on task-aware inference and maintain an expanding set of task-specific prompts, leading to (1) severe performance degradation on earlier tasks when task identifiers are unavailable for prompt selection at inference time, and (2) limited scalability as task sequence grows. We propose GRID, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. GRID incorporates an output-space-aware decoding mechanism that enhances backward transfer by leveraging representative inputs and automatic label semantic normalization, alongside a gradient-guided prompt selection strategy that compresses less informative prompts into a single aggregated representation for scalable, memory-efficient continual learning. Extensive experiments on long-sequence and negative-transfer benchmarks show that GRID improves backward transfer, achieves competitive forward transfer, and substantially reduces prompt memory across encoder-decoder and decoder-only architectures, including T5, Qwen, and LLaMA. Source code is available at https://github.com/AnushkaTi/GRID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRID框架，解决连续提示调整中任务无关推理时的性能下降和可扩展性问题。通过输出空间感知解码机制和梯度引导提示选择策略，GRID在长序列和负迁移基准上改善了后向迁移，减少了提示内存。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的连续学习方法在推理时依赖任务标识符，导致早期任务性能严重下降，且随着任务序列增长可扩展性受限。
Method: GRID包含输出空间感知解码机制和梯度引导提示选择策略，压缩信息量少的提示为单一聚合表示，实现可扩展、内存高效的连续学习。
Result: 在T5、Qwen、LLaMA等模型上，GRID改善了后向迁移，保持了竞争力的前向迁移，并显著减少了提示内存。
Conclusion: GRID为连续提示调整提供了一种任务无关的推理方案，在长序列基准上有效平衡了迁移性能和内存开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NoiseSDF2NoiseSDF: Learning Clean Neural Fields from Noisy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing accurate implicit surface representations from point clouds remains a challenging task, particularly when data is captured using low-quality scanning devices. These point clouds often contain substantial noise, leading to inaccurate surface reconstructions. Inspired by the Noise2Noise paradigm for 2D images, we introduce NoiseSDF2NoiseSDF, a novel method designed to extend this concept to 3D neural fields. Our approach enables learning clean neural SDFs from noisy point clouds through noisy supervision by minimizing the MSE loss between noisy SDF representations, allowing the network to implicitly denoise and refine surface estimations. We evaluate the effectiveness of NoiseSDF2NoiseSDF on benchmarks, including the ShapeNet, ABC, Famous, and Real datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves surface reconstruction quality from noisy inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NoiseSDF2NoiseSDF，受Noise2Noise范式启发，将去噪概念扩展到3D神经场。通过最小化带噪SDF表示之间的MSE损失，从含噪点云中学习清洁的神经符号距离函数（SDF），实现隐式去噪和表面精化。在ShapeNet、ABC、Famous和Real数据集上，该方法显著提升了含噪输入下的表面重建质量。
Motivation: 低质量扫描设备获取的点云常含有大量噪声，导致隐式表面重建不准确，需要从带噪监督中学习清洁的神经场。
Method: 提出NoiseSDF2NoiseSDF框架，输入为成对或单样本的带噪点云，通过最小化两个带噪SDF表示之间的MSE损失，使网络隐式地学习去噪后的清洁SDF，无需干净真值。
Result: 在ShapeNet、ABC、Famous和Real数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了从含噪点云重建的表面质量，优于传统去噪加重建的流水线。
Conclusion: 证明了Noise2Noise理念可有效扩展至3D神经隐式表示，为从低质量扫描数据中获取高精度表面提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TinyTroupe: An LLM-powered Multiagent Persona Simulation Toolkit
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLM) have led to a new class of autonomous agents, renewing and expanding interest in the area. LLM-powered Multiagent Systems (MAS) have thus emerged, both for assistive and simulation purposes, yet tools for realistic human behavior simulation -- with its distinctive challenges and opportunities -- remain underdeveloped. Existing MAS libraries and tools lack fine-grained persona specifications, population sampling facilities, experimentation support, and integrated validation, among other key capabilities, limiting their utility for behavioral studies, social simulation, and related applications. To address these deficiencies, in this work we introduce TinyTroupe, a simulation toolkit enabling detailed persona definitions (e.g., nationality, age, occupation, personality, beliefs, behaviors) and programmatic control via numerous LLM-driven mechanisms. This allows for the concise formulation of behavioral problems of practical interest, either at the individual or group level, and provides effective means for their solution. TinyTroupe's components are presented using representative working examples, such as brainstorming and market research sessions, thereby simultaneously clarifying their purpose and demonstrating their usefulness. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations of selected aspects are also provided, including preliminary experiments with real human behavior as control. Results highlight possibilities, limitations, and trade-offs. The approach, though realized as a specific Python implementation, is meant as a novel conceptual contribution, which can be partially or fully incorporated in other contexts. The library is available as open source at https://github.com/microsoft/tinytroupe.

papers.title: Automatic Labelling for Low-Light Pedestrian Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian detection in RGB images is a key task in pedestrian safety, as the most common sensor in autonomous vehicles and advanced driver assistance systems is the RGB camera. Low-light pedestrian detection lacks large public datasets and autolabelling pipelines. This research proposes a solution in the form of an automated infrared-RGB pipeline. The pipeline consists of 1) Infrared detection, where a fine-tuned model for infrared pedestrian detection is used 2) Label transfer process from the infrared detections to their RGB counterparts 3) Training object detection models using the generated labels for low-light RGB pedestrian detection. The research was performed using the KAIST dataset. For evaluation, three object detection models, DETR, YOLO, and RCNN, were trained on generated and ground truth labels. When compared on previously unseen images, the results showed that the models trained on generated labels out-performed the ones trained on ground-truth in 5 out of 6 cases for the mAP@50 and LAMR metrics, and outperformed ground-truth on mAP@50-95 in all cases. Acquired results indicate that the proposed auto-labelling pipeline could be used for scalable annotation of low-light datasets for pedestrian detection. The source code for this research is available on GitHub: https://github.com/BouzoulasDimitrios/IR-RGB-autoamed-low-light-pedestrian-labelling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对低光照环境下RGB行人检测缺乏大规模标注数据集和自动标注管线的问题，提出一种自动红外-RGB标注管线。该管线先用微调的红外检测模型检测行人，再将标签传递到对应RGB图像，最后用生成标签训练目标检测模型。在KAIST数据集上评估DETR、YOLO和RCNN三种检测器，结果表明在mAP@50和LAMR指标上，生成标签训练的模型在6个情形中的5个上优于基于真实标签训练的模型，并且在mAP@50-95上全部胜出。
Motivation: 低光照RGB图像行人检测缺乏大规模公开数据集和自动标注流程，限制了该场景下行人检测技术的实际应用。
Method: 提出自动红外-RGB标注管线：1)使用微调的红外行人检测模型检测红外图像中的行人；2)将红外检测的标签通过坐标变换传递到对齐的RGB图像；3)利用生成的RGB标签训练目标检测模型（DETR、YOLO、RCNN）。
Result: 在KAIST数据集上，基于生成标签训练的模型在mAP@50和LAMR指标上6个情形中5个优于基于真实标签的模型，且mAP@50-95上全部领先。
Conclusion: 自动标注管线有望为低光照行人检测提供可扩展的标注方案，但研究仅基于KAIST单一数据集，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Quantifying Perception-Based Student Success with Generative AI: An Exploratory Monte Carlo Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT have attracted growing attention in higher education, particularly in relation to how students perceive their usefulness, usability, and educational value. This study develops an exploratory Monte Carlo simulation framework for quantifying perception-based student success in the context of GenAI use. A PRISMA-informed structured literature search in Scopus identified nineteen empirical studies published between 2023 and 2025, of which six reported item-level means and standard deviations suitable for probabilistic modelling. One coherent 10-item, 5-point Likert-scale usability-oriented instrument was selected as a canonical proof-of-concept dataset and used to parameterise an inverse-variance-weighted Monte Carlo simulation generating 10,000 synthetic observations. The results show that the weighting structure substantially influences the simulated outcome, with System Efficiency and Learning Burden receiving the largest inverse-variance weight and therefore the strongest influence on the composite score. The study offers a transparent, reproducible, and privacy-preserving proof-of-concept framework linking structured literature search, item-level summary statistics, and probabilistic modelling.

This article is an extended and substantially revised version of a conference paper presented at the Melbourne Institute of Technology ICETE Conference, Sydney, NSW, Australia, 9-10 February 2026. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个探索性蒙特卡洛模拟框架，用于量化基于感知的学生成功在使用生成式人工智能（如ChatGPT）背景下的表现。研究者通过PRISMA文献检索从Scopus中筛选出19篇实证研究，其中6篇报告了项目级均值和标准差，最终选取一个10项5点李克特量表作为基准数据集，参数化逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟生成10,000个合成观测值。结果表明权重结构显著影响模拟结果，系统效率和学习负担的权重最大。该框架提供了一种透明、可重复、保护隐私的概念验证方法，将结构化文献检索、项目级汇总统计和概率建模联系起来。
Motivation: 生成式人工智能工具在高等教育中日益普及，但如何量化学生对工具感知（有用性、可用性、教育价值）与学生成功之间的关系仍缺乏系统的方法。
Method: 采用PRISMA文献检索策略从Scopus中识别相关实证研究，基于六篇报告项目级均值和标准差的研究，选取一个10项5点李克特量表参数化逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟，生成10,000个合成观测值。
Result: 模拟结果显示逆方差加权结构显著影响结果，系统效率和学习负担获得最大逆方差权重，从而对综合得分影响最强。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个透明、可重复、保护隐私的概念验证框架，将结构化文献检索、项目级汇总统计和概率建模相结合，可用于量化感知型学生成功。

papers.title: Fact-Augmented Lookahead Planning for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, but LLM agents still struggle to plan effectively in interactive, partially observable, long-horizon environments when search is unguided or recent history is insufficient. We introduce LWM-Planner, a fact-augmented lookahead planning framework that improves agent behavior purely through in-context learning. After each episode, the agent extracts task-critical atomic facts from its trajectories, validates candidates with a lightweight predictive-consistency filter (and optionally compresses them), and uses the resulting fact set to condition action proposal, single-step latent world-model simulation, and state-value estimation. Planning then proceeds via recursive, depth-limited lookahead over candidate trajectories conditioned on the accumulated facts and recent history, enabling online improvement without parameter updates. We provide abstraction-style motivation: treating facts as reducing state aliasing (proxy $ε_{\mathrm{sim}}$) and fact-conditioned simulation as lowering one-step error (proxy $δ_{\mathrm{model}}$), without claiming formal guarantees. Empirically, on text FrozenLake variants, CrafterMini, and ALFWorld, the approach improves cumulative return over ReAct/Reflexion and search-only baselines, suggesting that additional test-time search is most useful when grounded by compact, experience-derived facts.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2026). Camera-ready version. 9-page main text plus appendices (63 pages total), 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LWM-Planner，一种基于事实增强的向前规划框架，用于提升LLM agent在部分可观测、长期交互环境中的规划能力。该方法通过从历史轨迹中提取并验证原子事实，利用这些事实条件化动作提议、单步潜在世界模型模拟和状态值估计，实现无需参数更新的在线规划。在text FrozenLake、CrafterMini和ALFWorld等基准上，累积回报优于ReAct/Reflexion及纯搜索基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent在部分可观测、长期交互环境中，当搜索缺乏引导或历史信息不足时，难以有效规划，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出LWM-Planner：1) 每轮后从轨迹中提取候选原子事实，经轻量级预测一致性过滤（可选压缩）；2) 用事实集条件化动作提议、单步潜在世界模型模拟和状态值估计；3) 基于累积事实和历史进行递归、深度限制的向前搜索规划。
Result: 在text FrozenLake变体、CrafterMini和ALFWorld任务上，累积回报显著优于ReAct/Reflexion及纯搜索基线。
Conclusion: 实验表明，当测试时搜索以紧凑、经验推导的事实为基础时，额外搜索带来的收益最大，说明事实增强是提升规划效率的关键。

papers.title: Position: The ML Community Must Build an AI-Augmented Peer-Review Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: Peer review, the bedrock of scientific advancement in machine learning (ML), is strained by a crisis of scale. Exponential growth in manuscript submissions to premier ML venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR is outpacing the finite capacity of qualified reviewers, leading to concerns about review quality, consistency, and reviewer fatigue. This position paper argues that AI-assisted peer review must become an urgent research and infrastructure priority. We advocate for a comprehensive AI-augmented ecosystem, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) not as replacements for human judgment, but as sophisticated collaborators for authors, reviewers, and Area Chairs (ACs). We propose specific roles for AI in enhancing factual verification, guiding reviewer performance, assisting authors in quality improvement, and supporting ACs in decision-making. Crucially, we contend that the development of such systems hinges on access to more granular, structured, and ethically-sourced peer review process data. We outline a research agenda, including illustrative experiments, to develop and validate these AI assistants, and discuss significant technical and ethical challenges. We call upon the ML community to proactively build this AI-assisted future, ensuring the continued integrity and scalability of scientific validation, while maintaining high standards of peer review.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. Accepted (Oral) at the ICML 2026 Position Paper Track

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为机器学习社区必须将AI辅助同行评审作为研究和基础设施优先级。作者主张利用大语言模型（LLMs）作为作者、审稿人和领域主席的协作者，而非替代人类判断，并提出AI在事实核查、指导审稿、质量改进和决策支持中的具体角色。论文强调此类系统的开发依赖于更细粒度、结构化且合乎伦理的评审过程数据，并讨论了技术和伦理挑战。
Motivation: 顶级ML会议（如NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR）的手稿提交量指数增长，但合格审稿人有限，导致评审质量、一致性和审稿人疲劳问题。现有系统无法应对规模危机，亟需AI辅助。
Method: 提出一个综合的AI增强生态系统，明确LLM在事实核查、指导审稿人表现、帮助作者改进质量以及支持领域主席决策中的具体角色。论文概述了研究议程，包括示例实验，并讨论了相关伦理挑战。

Conclusion: ML社区应主动构建AI辅助的未来，确保科学验证的持续完整性和可扩展性，同时维护同行评审的高标准。

papers.title: Latent Guided Sampling for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial Optimization problems are widespread in domains such as logistics, manufacturing, and drug discovery, yet their NP-hard nature makes them computationally challenging. Recent Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) methods leverage deep learning to learn policies for constructing solutions, trained via Supervised or Reinforcement Learning. While promising, these approaches often rely on task-specific augmentations, perform poorly on out-of-distribution instances, and lack robust inference mechanisms. Moreover, existing latent space models either require labeled data or use an instance-independent latent distribution. In this work, we propose LGS-Net, a novel latent space model that conditions on problem instances, and introduce an efficient inference method, Latent Guided Sampling (LGS), based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo and Stochastic Approximation. We show that the iterations of our method form a time-inhomogeneous Markov Chain and provide rigorous theoretical convergence guarantees. Empirical results on benchmark routing tasks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among NCO baselines.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Machine Learning, Jul 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LGS-Net，一种以问题实例为条件的潜空间模型，并引入基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和随机近似的潜引导采样 (LGS) 推理方法。在基准路由任务上，该方法达到神经组合优化 (NCO) 基线中的最优性能，并提供了严格的收敛性理论保证。
Motivation: 现有神经组合优化方法依赖任务特定增强、对分布外实例性能差且缺乏鲁棒推理机制；潜空间模型要么需要标签要么与实例无关。
Method: 提出 LGS-Net，一个以问题实例为条件的潜空间模型，以及基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和随机近似的潜引导采样 (LGS) 推理方法，其迭代形成时间非齐次马尔可夫链并给出收敛性证明。
Result: 在基准路由任务上，LGS-Net 达到神经组合优化基线中的最先进性能。
Conclusion: 方法提供了严谨的理论收敛保证，并通过实验验证了在组合优化中的有效性。

papers.title: A Machine Learning Theory Perspective on Strategic Litigation
papers.abstract_en: Strategic litigation involves bringing a case to court with the goal of having an impact beyond resolving the particular dispute at hand. In a common law system, one way a case may have far-reaching impact is by establishing new legal precedent that later courts must follow. In this paper, we explore strategic litigation from the perspective of machine learning theory. We consider an abstract model of a common law legal system where a lower court decides new cases by applying a decision rule learned from a higher court's past rulings. In this model, we explore the power of a strategic litigator, who strategically brings cases to the higher court to influence the decision rule applied by the lower court in future cases. We explore questions including: What impact can a strategic litigator have? Which cases should a strategic litigator bring to court? Does it ever make sense for a strategic litigator to bring a case when they are sure the court will rule against them? We show that this strategic case selection problem has interesting structure, with even simple settings exhibiting counterintuitive phenomena. When cases are represented by points in one dimension and the lower court's learning algorithm is nearest neighbor, or as points in d dimensions and the lower court's learning algorithm is a support vector machine, we characterize the set of inducible decision rules and develop algorithms for selecting an optimal set of cases to bring to the higher court given the strategic litigator's objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机器学习理论视角研究战略诉讼，即通过案例选择影响法院先例。作者建立了一个普通法系统的抽象模型，其中下级法院通过学习上级法院的过往裁决来决策。分析了战略诉讼者如何选择案例以影响下级法院未来的决策规则，并在一维最近邻和多维支持向量机设置下刻画了可诱导决策规则集，设计了最优案例选择算法。
Motivation: 现有法律研究多从定性角度分析战略诉讼，缺乏对案例选择策略的定量建模和最优性理解。本文旨在通过机器学习理论工具，形式化分析普通法系统中战略诉讼者的影响力和案例选择问题。
Method: 构建一个抽象模型：下级法院使用从上级法院历史裁决中学习到的决策规则裁决新案件。战略诉讼者选择案例提交给上级法院，以塑造该决策规则。在一维空间采用最近邻算法，在多维空间采用支持向量机作为学习算法，分析可诱导决策规则集，并开发最优案例选择算法。
Result: 即使简单的设置（如一维最近邻）也展现出反直觉现象。论文刻画了可诱导决策规则集的特征，并针对诉讼者的目标提出了最优案例选择算法。
Conclusion: 战略案例选择问题具有有趣的结构，机器学习理论视角能为法律战略提供新的定量洞见。

papers.title: Dual-stream attention-guided learning for weakly supervised whole slide image classification
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide images (WSIs) play a crucial role in cancer diagnosis due to their ultra-high resolution and rich morphological information, and multiple instance learning (MIL) has become a prevalent paradigm to solve the massive size of WSIs and the scarcity of fine-grained annotations of instance. However, most existing MIL methods struggle to accurately identify diagnostically critical local regions (instance) using only slide-level labels, and suffer from modelling the relationship of instances efficiently. To address these defects, we propose a Dual-Stream Attention-Guided Learning (DSAGL) framework. DSAGL bridges slide-level supervision and instance-level learning through a teacher-student dual-stream architecture, and mitigates instance ambiguity by generating attention-guided pseudo labels. The framework employs a shared lightweight encoder to efficiently model long-range dependencies and an attention-based fusion mechanism to enhance sensitivity to sparse, informative regions. Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world pathological WSI datasets demonstrate that DSAGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art MIL methods, achieving superior discriminative performance and robustness under weak supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全切片图像（WSI）分类中弱监督多实例学习（MIL）难以准确识别诊断关键局部区域和建模实例关系的问题，提出双流注意力引导学习（DSAGL）框架。该框架采用教师-学生双流架构，通过注意力引导生成伪标签，并结合共享轻量编码器建模长距离依赖以及基于注意力的融合机制。在合成基准和真实病理WSI数据集上，DSAGL一致优于现有MIL方法，在弱监督下展现出优越的判别性能和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有MIL方法仅使用切片级标签时，难以准确定位诊断关键的局部区域（实例），且实例间关系建模效率低下。
Method: 提出DSAGL框架，包含教师-学生双流架构，通过注意力引导生成伪标签来缓解实例模糊性；使用共享轻量编码器高效建模长距离依赖，并基于注意力的融合机制增强对稀疏信息区域的敏感性。
Result: 在合成基准和真实病理WSI数据集上，DSAGL一致优于最先进的MIL方法，在弱监督下实现了更优的判别性能和鲁棒性。

papers.title: FreshRetailNet-LT: A Stockout-Annotated Censored Demand Dataset for Latent Demand Recovery and Forecasting in Fresh Retail
papers.abstract_en: Accurate demand estimation is critical for the retail business in guiding the inventory and pricing policies of perishable products. However, it faces fundamental challenges from censored sales data during stockouts, where unobserved demand creates systemic policy biases. Existing datasets lack the temporal resolution and annotations needed to address this censoring effect. To fill this gap, we present FreshRetailNet-50K, the first large-scale benchmark for censored demand estimation. It comprises 50,000 store-product time series of detailed hourly sales data from 898 stores in 18 major cities, encompassing 863 perishable SKUs meticulously annotated for stockout events. The hourly stock status records unique to this dataset, combined with rich contextual covariates, including promotional discounts, precipitation, and temporal features, enable innovative research beyond existing solutions. We demonstrate one such use case of two-stage demand modeling: first, we reconstruct the latent demand during stockouts using precise hourly annotations. We then leverage the recovered demand to train robust demand forecasting models in the second stage. Experimental results show that this approach achieves a 2.73% improvement in prediction accuracy while reducing the systematic demand underestimation from 7.37% to near-zero bias. With unprecedented temporal granularity and comprehensive real-world information, FreshRetailNet-50K opens new research directions in demand imputation, perishable inventory optimization, and causal retail analytics. The unique annotation quality and scale of the dataset address long-standing limitations in retail AI, providing immediate solutions and a platform for future methodological innovation. The data (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dingdong-Inc/FreshRetailNet-50K) and code (https://github.com/Dingdong-Inc/frn-50k-baseline}) are openly released.
papers.comment: FreshRetailNet-LT is a new version of FreshRetailNet-50K, spanning dataset over two years
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了FreshRetailNet-50K，这是首个大规模缺货标注的截断需求数据集，包含50,000条小时级销售时间序列、863种易腐品、898家门店，并详细标注缺货事件。作者演示了两阶段需求建模方法：先利用小时级缺货标注重建潜在需求，再训练预测模型，实现预测准确率提升2.73%，并将需求低估偏差从7.37%降至近零。
Motivation: 现有零售需求估计受缺货期间销售数据截断影响，缺乏高时间分辨率和缺货标注的大规模数据集，导致系统性政策偏差。
Method: 构建FreshRetailNet-50K数据集，包含50,000条店铺-产品小时级销售序列、863种易腐品、898家门店，并精确标注缺货事件。提出两阶段需求建模：第一阶段利用小时级标注重建缺货期间的潜在需求；第二阶段使用恢复后的需求训练预测模型。
Result: 两阶段方法在预测准确率上提升2.73%，并将需求低估系统偏差从7.37%降至接近零。
Conclusion: 该数据集以空前的时序粒度和真实世界信息，为需求插补、易腐库存优化和因果零售分析提供了平台，解决了零售AI中长期存在的局限。

papers.title: CleanPatrick: A Benchmark for Image Data Cleaning
papers.abstract_en: Robust machine learning depends on clean data, yet current image data cleaning benchmarks rely on synthetic noise or narrow human studies, limiting comparison and real-world relevance. We introduce CleanPatrick, the first large-scale benchmark for data cleaning in the image domain, built upon the publicly available Fitzpatrick17k dermatology dataset. We collect 496,377 binary annotations from 933 medical crowd workers, identify off-topic samples (4%), near-duplicates (21%), and label errors (32%), and employ an aggregation model inspired by item-response theory followed by expert review to derive high-quality ground truth. CleanPatrick formalizes issue detection as a ranking task and employs standard ranking metrics that mirror real audit workflows. We benchmark classical anomaly detectors, perceptual hashing, SSIM, Confident Learning, NoiseRank, FINE, BHN, and SelfClean. On CleanPatrick, self-supervised representations excel at near-duplicate detection, classical methods achieve competitive off-topic detection under constrained review budgets, and detecting implausible labels under conservative human judgment remains challenging for fine-grained medical classification. By releasing both the dataset and the evaluation framework, CleanPatrick enables a systematic comparison of image-cleaning strategies.
papers.comment: Accepted at Journal of Data-centric Machine Learning Research (DMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CleanPatrick，首个面向图像数据清洗的大规模基准，基于Fitzpatrick17k皮肤病数据集构建。通过收集933名医学众包工作者的496,377个二元标注，识别出离题样本(4%)、近重复(21%)和标签错误(32%)，并采用项目反应理论聚合模型及专家审查获得高质量真值。基准将问题检测形式化为排序任务，评测了经典异常检测器、自监督方法等多种清洗策略，发现自监督表示在近重复检测上表现优异，而细粒度医学分类中标签错误检测仍具挑战。
Motivation: 现有图像数据清洗基准依赖合成噪声或小规模人工研究，缺乏现实性和可比性，亟需大规模、真实标注的基准以系统评估清洗方法。
Method: 基于Fitzpatrick17k数据集，收集众包二元标注，通过项目反应理论聚合模型与专家审查构建高质量真值，将问题检测（离题、近重复、标签错误）定义为排序任务，采用标准排序指标进行评估。
Result: 自监督表示在近重复检测中表现最佳，经典方法在受限审查预算下离题检测具有竞争力；在细粒度医学分类中，检测不可靠标签仍是一个开放挑战。
Conclusion: CleanPatrick为图像数据清洗提供了大规模真实标注基准和评估框架，揭示了不同清洗策略的优势与局限，尤其指出医学图像细粒度标签错误检测的困难。

papers.title: A Survey of Robotic Navigation and Manipulation with Physics Simulators in the Era of Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Navigation and manipulation are core capabilities in Embodied AI, but training agents to perform them directly in the real world is costly, time-consuming, and unsafe. Therefore, sim-to-real transfer has emerged as a key approach, yet the sim-to-real gap persists. This survey examines how physics simulators address this gap by analyzing properties that have received limited attention in prior surveys. We also analyze their features for navigation and manipulation tasks, as well as their hardware requirements. Additionally, we offer a resource with benchmark datasets, metrics, simulation platforms, and methods to help researchers select suitable tools while accounting for hardware constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了物理仿真器在具身AI中实现机器人导航与操作任务的现状，重点分析了仿真到现实迁移中的差距问题，并比较了不同仿真器在任务支持、硬件需求等方面的特性，提供了基准数据集、指标和平台资源。
Motivation: 具身AI中直接在实际环境训练智能体成本高、耗时且不安全，而仿真到现实迁移方法面临sim-to-real gap，现有综述对物理仿真器特性的分析不足。
Method: 系统分析物理仿真器的关键属性（如物理精度、传感器模拟、交互能力），评估其在导航和操作任务中的适用性，并整理硬件需求与基准资源。
Result: 提供了仿真平台、基准数据集和指标的综合性资源，帮助研究者根据硬件限制选择合适工具，但未给出定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 强调物理仿真器在缩小sim-to-real gap中的重要性，并指出未来需提升仿真真实度与硬件兼容性。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.result: 提供了仿真平台、基准数据集和指标的综合性资源，帮助研究者根据硬件限制选择合适工具，但未给出定量实验结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调物理仿真器在缩小sim-to-real gap中的重要性，并指出未来需提升仿真真实度与硬件兼容性。

papers.title: LaRI: Layered Ray Intersections for Single-view 3D Geometric Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present Layered Ray Intersections (LaRI), a fully supervised method for occluded geometry reasoning from a single image. Unlike conventional depth estimation, which is limited to visible surfaces, LaRI predicts multiple surfaces intersected by the camera rays using layered point maps. Compared to the existing approaches that leverage neural implicit representations or iterative refinement, LaRI achieves complete scene reconstruction in one feed-forward pass, enabling efficient and view-aligned geometric reasoning to underpin both object-level and scene-level tasks. We further propose to predict the ray stopping index, which identifies valid intersecting pixels and layers from LaRI's output. To better underpin and evaluate this task, we build an annotation pipeline using rendering engines, construct annotations for five public datasets, including synthetic and real-world data covering 3D objects and scenes. As a generic method, LaRI's performance is validated in object-level and scene-level reconstruction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaRI（Layered Ray Intersections），一种从单张图像进行遮挡几何推理的全监督方法。与传统深度估计不同，LaRI 使用分层点图（layered point maps）预测相机射线穿过的多个表面，并通过单次前馈实现完整的场景重建。此外，提出射线停止索引（ray stopping index）来识别有效像素和层。方法在物体级和场景级重建任务上得到验证。
Motivation: 传统深度估计仅限于可见表面，无法处理遮挡几何；现有方法依赖神经隐式表示或迭代优化，效率较低。
Method: 提出分层射线相交（LaRI），预测沿相机射线的多个表面点图，并引入射线停止索引来筛选有效层。使用渲染引擎构建注释管道，在五个公开数据集（合成和真实数据）上训练。
Result: 在物体级和场景级重建任务上验证了方法的有效性，能够从单张图像高效重建完整场景。
Conclusion: LaRI 作为通用方法，通过单次前馈实现与视图对齐的几何推理，支撑下游任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NuWa: Deriving Lightweight Class-Specific Vision Transformers for Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) often need to be compressed for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices like drones and smart vehicles. However, existing model compression methods ignore that many edge devices only require the knowledge of specific classes for their applications. As a result, the derived all-class ViTs retain redundant knowledge and perform suboptimally on these classes. We discovered that simply replacing the calibration dataset with class-specific data does not suffice to address this issue, as these methods face two fundamental limitations. First, they overlook the existence of class-detrimental weights, which interfere with specialization, while removing them can improve class-specific performance. Second, the diversity of target classes and resource constraints on edge devices demand numerous customized models. Existing methods are time-consuming and computationally expensive, thus unscalable. In this work, we present NuWa, a cost-efficient method that addresses these challenges by deriving small ViTs from base ViTs for edge devices with specific class requirements. NuWa performs self-knowledge purification to prune class-detrimental weights and efficiently derives compact ViTs through closed-form optimization. Without post-pruning retraining, the derived edge ViTs surpass the base ViT in class-specific accuracy and accelerate inference. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that NuWa outperforms state-of-the-art training-free pruning methods on class-specific tasks by up to 29.00\% in accuracy. Compared with the best-performing training-dependent pruning method, NuWa achieves a 33.69x pruning speedup and reduces pruning cost by up to 99.83\%, with only a 0.61\% average accuracy loss. Project Page: https://github.com/CGCL-codes/NuWa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NuWa方法，用于从基础ViT中派生轻量级类特定ViT，以部署在资源受限的边缘设备（如无人机、智能车辆）上。NuWa通过自我知识提纯（self-knowledge purification）修剪类有害权重，并利用闭式优化（closed-form optimization）高效导出紧凑模型，无需后剪枝重训练。实验表明，在类特定任务上，NuWa在准确率上比最先进的免训练剪枝方法提升高达29.00%，与最佳训练依赖剪枝方法相比，剪枝速度提升33.69倍，成本降低99.83%，平均精度损失仅0.61%。
Motivation: 现有模型压缩方法为所有类别保留冗余知识，忽略了边缘设备只需特定类别知识的需求，导致类特定性能次优。直接替换校准数据集不足以解决该问题，因为存在类有害权重（class-detrimental weights）且定制化模型生成成本高昂。
Method: NuWa包含两个关键步骤：首先通过自我知识提纯移除类有害权重；然后利用闭式优化从基础ViT中高效导出紧凑的类特定ViT，无需后剪枝重训练。
Result: 在类特定任务上，NuWa相比最先进的免训练剪枝方法准确率提升最高29.00%；相比最佳训练依赖剪枝方法，剪枝速度加快33.69倍，剪枝成本降低99.83%，平均精度损失仅0.61%。
Conclusion: NuWa为边缘设备上的类特定ViT部署提供了一种高效且经济的解决方案，在不牺牲类特定精度的前提下显著降低计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CITRAS: Covariate-Informed Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In time series forecasting, covariates represent external factors that influence target variables. Some covariates are observable only in the past (observed covariates, such as recorded weather data), while others are known in advance (known covariates, such as calendar events or discount schedules). Although covariates have the potential to enhance forecasting performance, most deep learning-based forecasting models struggle to address the length discrepancy between variables caused by the future portion of known covariates and fail to leverage them flexibly. Moreover, capturing dependencies between target variables and covariates is non-trivial, as models must accurately reflect the local impact of covariates while simultaneously modeling global cross-variate dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS, a decoder-only Transformer that flexibly integrates multiple target variables, observed covariates, and known covariates. While preserving strong autoregressive modeling capabilities, CITRAS introduces two novel mechanisms within patch-wise cross-variate attention: Key-Value (KV) Shift and Attention Score Smoothing. KV Shift seamlessly incorporates the future portion of known covariates into the forecasting process by aligning them with target variables based on their concurrent dependencies. Attention Score Smoothing refines locally accurate patch-wise cross-variate dependencies into global variate-level dependencies by smoothing the historical attention scores. Experimentally, CITRAS demonstrates strong performance across a wide range of real-world datasets in both covariate-informed and multivariate settings, showcasing its versatile ability to leverage cross-variate and cross-time dependencies for improved forecasting accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CITRAS是一种仅解码器Transformer，专为包含观测协变量和已知协变量的时间序列预测设计。它通过补丁级跨变量注意力中的KV移位和注意力分数平滑机制，灵活整合目标变量与不同类型协变量，在多个真实数据集上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有深度预测模型难以处理已知协变量未来部分与目标变量之间的长度不一致，且无法同时捕捉局部协变量影响和全局跨变量依赖。
Method: 提出CITRAS，一种仅解码器Transformer，在补丁级跨变量注意力中引入KV移位（将已知协变量未来部分与对应时间点目标变量对齐）和注意力分数平滑（将局部补丁级依赖转化为全局变量级依赖）。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上，CITRAS在协变量信息和多变量设置下均取得强性能，证实其利用跨变量和跨时间依赖提升预测精度的能力。
Conclusion: CITRAS通过灵活整合观测和已知协变量，有效提升时间序列预测精度，适用于多种协变量信息场景。

papers.title: An $(ε,δ)$-accurate level set estimation with a stopping criterion
papers.abstract_en: The level set estimation problem seeks to identify regions within a set of candidate points where an unknown and costly to evaluate function's value exceeds a specified threshold, providing an efficient alternative to exhaustive evaluations of function values. Traditional methods often use sequential optimization strategies to find $ε$-accurate solutions, which permit a margin around the threshold contour but frequently lack effective stopping criteria, leading to excessive exploration and inefficiencies. This paper introduces an acquisition strategy for level set estimation that incorporates a stopping criterion, ensuring the algorithm halts when further exploration is unlikely to yield improvements, thereby reducing unnecessary function evaluations. We theoretically prove that our method satisfies $ε$-accuracy with a confidence level of $1 - δ$, addressing a key gap in existing approaches. Furthermore, we show that this also leads to guarantees on the lower bounds of performance metrics such as F-score. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed acquisition function achieves comparable precision to existing methods while confirming that the stopping criterion effectively terminates the algorithm once adequate exploration is completed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种带有停止准则的水平集估计（level set estimation）采集策略，保证算法在进一步探索难以改进时自动终止，从而减少不必要的函数评估。理论证明该方法在置信水平1-δ下满足ε-精度，并给出了F-score等性能指标的下界保证。数值实验表明精度与现有方法相当，且停止准则有效。
Motivation: 传统水平集估计方法常因缺乏有效停止准则而过度探索，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出一种融入停止准则的采集策略，通过理论保证实现ε-精度和1-δ置信水平。
Result: 理论证明方法满足ε-精度和置信度保证，并推导出F-score等性能的下界。数值实验显示精度可比，且停止准则能适时终止算法。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了水平集估计中缺乏停止准则的空白，在保证精度的同时提高了效率。

papers.title: Integrating Biological-Informed Recurrent Neural Networks for Glucose-Insulin Dynamics Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) management is a complex task due to many variability factors. Artificial Pancreas (AP) systems have alleviated patient burden by automating insulin delivery through advanced control algorithms. However, the effectiveness of these systems depends on accurate modeling of glucose-insulin dynamics, which traditional mathematical models often fail to capture due to their inability to adapt to patient-specific variations. This study introduces a Biological-Informed Recurrent Neural Network (BIRNN) framework to address these limitations. The BIRNN leverages a Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) architecture augmented with physics-informed loss functions that embed physiological constraints, ensuring a balance between predictive accuracy and consistency with biological principles. The framework is validated using the commercial UVA/Padova simulator, outperforming traditional linear models in glucose prediction accuracy and reconstruction of unmeasured states, even under circadian variations in insulin sensitivity. The results demonstrate the potential of BIRNN for personalized glucose regulation and future adaptive control strategies in AP systems.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the Engineering Diabetes Technologies (EDT 2025). 7 pages, 2 figures and 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对1型糖尿病管理中人工胰腺系统对葡萄糖-胰岛素动力学建模的准确性需求，提出一种生物信息循环神经网络（BIRNN）。该网络基于门控循环单元（GRU），结合物理信息损失函数嵌入生理约束，在UVA/Padova商业模拟器上验证，优于传统线性模型，提高了血糖预测精度和未测量状态重建能力。

Method: 提出BIRNN框架，使用GRU架构，并采用物理信息损失函数将生理约束融入训练，平衡预测准确性与生物学一致性。
Result: 在UVA/Padova模拟器上验证，相比传统线性模型，在血糖预测精度和未测量状态重建上表现更优，即使存在昼夜胰岛素敏感性变化。
Conclusion: 结果表明BIRNN在个性化血糖调节和未来人工胰腺自适应控制策略中具有潜力。

papers.title: One-Step Residual Shifting Diffusion for Image Super-Resolution via Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models for super-resolution (SR) produce high-quality visual results but require expensive computational costs. Despite the development of several methods to accelerate diffusion-based SR models, some (e.g., SinSR) fail to produce realistic perceptual details, while others (e.g., OSEDiff) may hallucinate non-existent structures. To overcome these issues, we present RSD, a new distillation method for ResShift. Our method is based on training the student network to produce images such that a new fake ResShift model trained on them will coincide with the teacher model. RSD achieves single-step restoration and outperforms the teacher by a noticeable margin in various perceptual metrics (LPIPS, CLIPIQA, MUSIQ). We show that our distillation method can surpass SinSR, the other distillation-based method for ResShift, making it on par with state-of-the-art diffusion SR distillation methods with limited computational costs in terms of perceptual quality. Compared to SR methods based on pre-trained text-to-image models, RSD produces competitive perceptual quality and requires fewer parameters, GPU memory, and training cost. We provide experimental results on various real-world and synthetic datasets, including RealSR, RealSet65, DRealSR, ImageNet, and DIV2K. We provide the code at https://github.com/Daniil-Selikhanovych/RSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSD蒸馏方法，用于加速基于ResShift的扩散超分辨率模型。通过训练学生网络生成图像，使得基于这些图像训练的fake ResShift模型与教师模型一致，实现单步恢复。在LPIPS、CLIPIQA、MUSIQ等感知指标上，RSD显著优于教师模型和现有蒸馏方法SinSR，与最先进的扩散SR蒸馏方法性能相当，且参数更少、训练成本更低。在RealSR、RealSet65、DRealSR、ImageNet、DIV2K等数据集上验证。
Motivation: 现有加速扩散超分辨率方法（如SinSR）无法生成真实感知细节，或（如OSEDiff）可能产生虚构结构，需要更高效的蒸馏方法以平衡质量和计算成本。
Method: RSD蒸馏方法：训练学生网络输出图像，然后基于这些图像训练一个新的fake ResShift模型，使其分布与教师模型一致，从而实现单步超分辨率恢复。
Result: 在LPIPS、CLIPIQA、MUSIQ等感知指标上，RSD单步恢复效果明显优于教师模型和SinSR，与当前最先进的扩散SR蒸馏方法性能相当，且参数更少、GPU内存和训练成本更低。
Conclusion: RSD在感知质量上具有竞争力，计算成本有限，开源代码提供复现。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有加速扩散超分辨率方法（如SinSR）无法生成真实感知细节，或（如OSEDiff）可能产生虚构结构，需要更高效的蒸馏方法以平衡质量和计算成本。
summary_sections.method: RSD蒸馏方法：训练学生网络输出图像，然后基于这些图像训练一个新的fake ResShift模型，使其分布与教师模型一致，从而实现单步超分辨率恢复。
summary_sections.result: 在LPIPS、CLIPIQA、MUSIQ等感知指标上，RSD单步恢复效果明显优于教师模型和SinSR，与当前最先进的扩散SR蒸馏方法性能相当，且参数更少、GPU内存和训练成本更低。
summary_sections.conclusion: RSD在感知质量上具有竞争力，计算成本有限，开源代码提供复现。

papers.title: Infinity-norm-based Input-to-State-Stable Long Short-Term Memory networks: a thermal systems perspective
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) have shown remarkable performances in system identification, particularly in nonlinear dynamical systems such as thermal processes. However, stability remains a critical challenge in practical applications: although the underlying process may be intrinsically stable, there may be no guarantee that the resulting RNN model captures this behavior. This paper addresses the stability issue by deriving a sufficient condition for Input-to-State Stability based on the infinity-norm (ISS$_{\infty}$) for Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The obtained condition depends on fewer network parameters compared to prior works. A ISS$_{\infty}$-promoted training strategy is developed, incorporating a penalty term in the loss function that encourages stability and an ad hoc early stopping approach. The quality of LSTM models trained via the proposed approach is validated on a thermal system case study, where the ISS$_{\infty}$-promoted LSTM outperforms both a physics-based model and an ISS$_{\infty}$-promoted Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) network while also surpassing non-ISS$_{\infty}$-promoted LSTM and GRU RNNs.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the European Control Conference 2025 (ECC25). 8 pages, 3 figures and 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LSTM网络在系统辨识中的稳定性问题，提出一种基于无穷范数的输入-状态稳定（ISS∞）充分条件，该条件依赖的网络参数少于以往工作。开发了ISS∞促进的训练策略，通过在损失函数中加入惩罚项和早停方法，并在热系统案例中验证，所提方法在性能上优于物理模型、ISS∞促进的GRU网络以及未加ISS∞促进的LSTM和GRU。
Motivation: RNN在非线性动力系统（如热过程）中表现优异，但稳定性是实际应用中的关键挑战：尽管底层过程可能固有稳定，但RNN模型无法保证捕获该行为。
Method: 推导了基于无穷范数的LSTM网络输入-状态稳定（ISS∞）的充分条件，该条件依赖更少的网络参数；并开发了ISS∞促进的训练策略，包括在损失函数中加入惩罚项和专门的早停方法。
Result: 在热系统案例研究中，ISS∞促进的LSTM优于基于物理的模型、ISS∞促进的GRU网络以及非ISS∞促进的LSTM和GRU。
Conclusion: 所提ISS∞条件及训练策略能有效提升LSTM在热系统等非线性动力系统中的稳定性与性能。

papers.title: AdaGC: Enhancing LLM Pretraining Stability via Adaptive Gradient Clipping
papers.abstract_en: Loss spikes remain a persistent obstacle in large-scale language model pretraining. While previous research has attempted to identify the root cause of loss spikes by investigating individual factors, we observe that, in practice, such spikes are typically triggered by the confluence of heterogeneous factors. Empirically, loss spikes may arise from a combination of data outliers, hardware or transient computational faults, numerical precision issues, and hyperparameter settings. Regardless of the underlying cause, these spikes manifest as unstable optimizer updates, as abnormal gradients contaminate both first- and second-moment states. In this paper, we propose a principled gradient-centric remedy: AdaGC, an adaptive per-tensor gradient clipping scheme that mitigates such contamination by bounding gradient norms relative to a tensor-wise exponential moving average of their historical clipped values. AdaGC is optimizer-agnostic, introduces negligible memory overhead, and reduces communication costs compared to GlobalGC, particularly in hybrid-parallel distributed training. Experiments on Llama-2 7B, Mixtral 8x1B, and ERNIE 10B-A1.4B demonstrate that AdaGC robustly eliminates training instabilities, consistently reducing spike scores to zero for all models and improving downstream accuracy over GlobalGC by 1.32%, 1.27%, and 2.48%, respectively. Furthermore, AdaGC seamlessly integrates with optimizers such as Muon and Lion, consistently yielding higher average accuracy and zero spike scores. The code is available at https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleFleet (see Research/AdaGC).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型预训练中损失尖峰（loss spike）问题，提出一种自适应的逐张量梯度裁剪方法 AdaGC。该方法通过维护每个张量梯度历史裁剪值的指数移动平均，动态调整裁剪阈值，从而抑制异常梯度对优化器状态的污染。实验在 Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B 和 ERNIE 10B-A1.4B 模型上验证了 AdaGC 能完全消除训练不稳定性（spike 分数降为零），并在下游任务上比 GlobalGC 提升 1.32%-2.48% 的准确率。
Motivation: 现有研究通常单独分析损失尖峰的诱因（如数据异常、硬件故障、数值精度等），但实践中尖峰往往由多种因素共同触发。无论根源如何，尖峰都表现为异常梯度污染优化器的一阶和二阶矩状态，因此需要一种通用的梯度级解决方案。
Method: 提出 AdaGC，一种与优化器无关的自适应梯度裁剪方案。它对每个张量独立维护梯度范数的指数移动平均历史裁剪值，并将当前梯度范数相对于该历史值进行归一化后裁剪，从而自适应地抑制异常梯度。该方法额外内存开销可忽略，且在混合并行训练中相比 GlobalGC 减少了通信成本。
Result: 在 Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B 和 ERNIE 10B-A1.4B 模型上，AdaGC 将所有模型的 spike 分数降至零，并在下游评估中比 GlobalGC 分别提升 1.32%、1.27% 和 2.48% 的准确率。同时，AdaGC 可无缝集成 Muon、Lion 等优化器，均获得零 spike 分数和更高平均准确率。
Conclusion: AdaGC 是一种针对大规模语言模型预训练中损失尖峰问题的有效且通用的解决方案，能够稳健消除训练不稳定性，并提升下游性能。其代码已开源。

papers.title: Representational Alignment with Chemical Induced Fit for Molecular Relational Learning
papers.abstract_en: Molecular Relational Learning (MRL) is widely applied in natural sciences to predict relationships between molecular pairs by extracting structural features. The representational similarity between substructure pairs determines the functional compatibility of molecular binding sites. Nevertheless, aligning substructure representations by attention mechanisms lacks guidance from chemical knowledge, resulting in unstable model performance in chemical space (\textit{e.g.}, functional group, scaffold) shifted data. With theoretical justification, we propose the \textbf{Re}presentational \textbf{Align}ment with Chemical Induced \textbf{Fit} (ReAlignFit) to enhance the stability of MRL. ReAlignFit dynamically aligns substructure representation in MRL by introducing chemical Induced Fit-based inductive bias. In the induction process, we design the Bias Correction Function based on substructure edge reconstruction to align representations between substructure pairs by simulating chemical conformational changes (dynamic combination of substructures). ReAlignFit further integrates the Subgraph Information Bottleneck during fit process to refine and optimize substructure pairs exhibiting high chemical functional compatibility, leveraging them to generate molecular embeddings. Experimental results on nine datasets demonstrate that ReAlignFit outperforms state-of-the-art models in two tasks and significantly enhances model's stability in both rule-shifted and scaffold-shifted data distributions.
papers.comment: Accepted by SIGKDD2026 AI for Science Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分子关系学习（MRL）中注意力机制缺乏化学知识引导导致模型在化学空间偏移数据上性能不稳定的问题，提出了基于化学诱导契合的表示对齐方法（ReAlignFit）。该方法通过引入化学诱导契合的归纳偏置，设计偏差校正函数模拟化学构象变化来对齐子结构表示，并利用子图信息瓶颈优化高功能兼容性的子结构对。在九个数据集上的实验表明，ReAlignFit在两项任务中达到最优，并显著提升了模型在规则偏移和骨架偏移数据分布上的稳定性。
Motivation: 现有的分子关系学习模型通过注意力机制对齐子结构表示，但缺乏化学知识的引导，导致在化学空间（如官能团、骨架）偏移的数据上模型性能不稳定。
Method: 提出ReAlignFit方法，包含两个阶段：诱导（induction）过程中，基于子结构边重建设计偏差校正函数，模拟化学构象变化以动态对齐子结构表示；拟合（fit）过程中，集成子图信息瓶颈（Subgraph Information Bottleneck）来精炼高化学功能兼容性的子结构对，并用于生成分子嵌入。
Result: 在九个数据集上的实验结果表明，ReAlignFit在两个任务上优于现有最优模型，并显著增强了模型在规则偏移和骨架偏移数据分布上的稳定性。
Conclusion: 该工作通过引入化学诱导契合的归纳偏置，有效提升了分子关系学习在数据偏移场景下的稳定性和性能。

papers.title: Boosting Graph Robustness Against Backdoor Attacks: An Over-Similarity Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved notable success in tasks such as social and transportation networks. However, recent studies have highlighted the vulnerability of GNNs to backdoor attacks, raising significant concerns about their reliability in real-world applications. Despite initial efforts to defend against specific graph backdoor attacks, existing defense methods face two main challenges: either the inability to establish a clear distinction between triggers and clean nodes, resulting in the removal of many clean nodes, or the failure to eliminate the impact of triggers, making it challenging to restore the target nodes to their pre-attack state. Through empirical analysis of various existing graph backdoor attacks, we observe that the triggers generated by these methods exhibit over-similarity in both features and structure. Based on this observation, we propose a novel graph backdoor defense method SimGuard. We first utilizes a similarity-based metric to detect triggers and then employs contrastive learning to train a backdoor detector that generates embeddings capable of separating triggers from clean nodes, thereby improving detection efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on real-world datasets demonstrate that our proposed method effectively defends against various graph backdoor attacks while preserving performance on clean nodes. The code will be released upon acceptance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证发现现有图后门攻击生成的触发器在特征和结构上存在过相似性，据此提出图后门防御方法SimGuard，利用相似性度量检测触发器，并结合对比学习训练检测器以区分触发器与干净节点。在真实数据集上的实验表明该方法能有效防御多种图后门攻击，同时保持对干净节点的性能。
Motivation: 现有图后门防御方法要么无法清晰区分触发器与干净节点导致误删，要么无法消除触发器影响使目标节点恢复到攻击前状态。
Method: SimGuard先使用基于相似性的度量检测触发器，再通过对比学习训练一个后门检测器，生成能够分离触发器与干净节点的嵌入，从而提高检测效率。
Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效防御多种图后门攻击，同时保持对干净节点的性能。
Conclusion: 触发器在特征和结构上的过相似性是图后门攻击的一个共性特征，利用这一特性可以设计有效的防御方法。

papers.title: Interpretable deep convolutional model for nonlinear multivariate time series in complex systems
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Deep Convolutional Interpreter for Time Series (DCIts), a deep-learning architecture for nonlinear multivariate time series that provides sample-specific, locally interpretable descriptions of the underlying interaction structure. Unlike standard black-box forecasters, DCIts learns a time- and lag-dependent transition tensor explicitly factorized into two components: a Focuser, which selects relevant source series and time lags via a sparse masking mechanism, and a Modeler, which assigns signed coefficients to these selected interactions. This decomposition yields a local lag-adjacency structure and signed source-lag contributions for every forecast instance, enabling direct inspection of effective connectivity; when higher-order branches are activated, the same framework yields order-resolved elementwise polynomial contributions. Architecturally, DCIts uses a diverse bank of convolutional filters to capture temporal and cross-variable dependencies, which are mapped through a bottleneck network to the transition tensor. On controlled benchmark datasets with a known interaction structure, we demonstrate that DCIts achieves competitive forecasting error relative to a strong interpretable baseline while recovering stable, signed, lag-resolved interaction patterns. The framework thus prioritizes intrinsic interpretability, using forecasting accuracy as a faithfulness constraint rather than the sole objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCIts，一种用于非线性多变量时间序列的可解释深度卷积模型。它将时间与滞后依赖的过渡张量分解为Focuser（通过稀疏掩码选择相关序列和滞后）和Modeler（为选定交互分配符号系数），从而为每个预测实例提供局部可解释的交互结构。在已知交互结构的受控基准数据集上，DCIts实现了与强可解释基线竞争性的预测误差，并恢复了稳定、带符号、滞后分辨的交互模式。
Motivation: 标准黑箱预测模型缺乏可解释性，难以揭示复杂系统时间序列中的非线性交互结构，而DCIts旨在提供内在可解释的描述，同时保持预测准确性。
Method: DCIts使用多样化的卷积滤波器来捕获时间与跨变量依赖关系，并通过瓶颈网络映射到过渡张量。该张量被显式分解为Focuser（稀疏掩码机制选择相关源序列和滞后）和Modeler（为选中的交互分配符号系数），从而产生局部滞后邻接结构和带符号的源-滞后贡献。
Result: 在具有已知交互结构的受控基准数据集上，DCIts在预测误差上与强可解释基线相当，并且能够恢复稳定、带符号、滞后分辨的交互模式，表明其有效性和可解释性。
Conclusion: DCIts优先考虑内在可解释性，将预测准确性作为忠实性约束而非唯一目标，适用于需要理解交互结构的复杂系统时间序列分析。

summary_sections.motivation: 标准黑箱预测模型缺乏可解释性，难以揭示复杂系统时间序列中的非线性交互结构，而DCIts旨在提供内在可解释的描述，同时保持预测准确性。
summary_sections.method: DCIts使用多样化的卷积滤波器来捕获时间与跨变量依赖关系，并通过瓶颈网络映射到过渡张量。该张量被显式分解为Focuser（稀疏掩码机制选择相关源序列和滞后）和Modeler（为选中的交互分配符号系数），从而产生局部滞后邻接结构和带符号的源-滞后贡献。
summary_sections.result: 在具有已知交互结构的受控基准数据集上，DCIts在预测误差上与强可解释基线相当，并且能够恢复稳定、带符号、滞后分辨的交互模式，表明其有效性和可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: DCIts优先考虑内在可解释性，将预测准确性作为忠实性约束而非唯一目标，适用于需要理解交互结构的复杂系统时间序列分析。

papers.title: Unleashing Correlation and Continuity for Hyperspectral Reconstruction from RGB Images
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing Hyperspectral Images (HSI) from RGB images can yield high spatial resolution HSI at a lower cost, demonstrating significant application potential. This paper reveals that local correlation and global continuity of the spectral characteristics are crucial for HSI reconstruction tasks. Therefore, we fully explore these inter-spectral relationships and propose a Correlation and Continuity Network (CCNet) for HSI reconstruction from RGB images. For the correlation of local spectrum, we introduce the Group-wise Spectral Correlation Modeling (GrSCM) module, which efficiently establishes spectral band similarity within a localized range. For the continuity of global spectrum, we design the Neighborhood-wise Spectral Continuity Modeling (NeSCM) module, which employs memory units to recursively model the progressive variation characteristics at the global level. In order to explore the inherent complementarity of these two modules, we design the Patch-wise Adaptive Fusion (PAF) module to efficiently integrate global continuity features into the spectral features in a patch-wise adaptive manner. These innovations enhance the quality of reconstructed HSI. We perform comprehensive comparison and ablation experiments on the mainstream datasets NTIRE2022 and NTIRE2020 for the spectral reconstruction task. Compared to the current advanced spectral reconstruction algorithms, our designed algorithm achieves State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) performance.

papers.title: Dynamics of Adversarial Attacks on Large Language Model-Based Search Engines
papers.abstract_en: The increasing integration of Large Language Model (LLM) based search engines has transformed the landscape of information retrieval. However, these systems are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, especially ranking manipulation attacks, where attackers craft webpage content to manipulate the LLM's ranking and promote specific content, gaining an unfair advantage over competitors. In this paper, we study the dynamics of ranking manipulation attacks. We frame this problem as an Infinitely Repeated Prisoners' Dilemma, where multiple players strategically decide whether to cooperate or attack. We analyze the conditions under which cooperation can be sustained, identifying key factors such as attack costs, discount rates, attack success rates, and trigger strategies that influence player behavior. We identify tipping points in the system dynamics, demonstrating that cooperation is more likely to be sustained when players are forward-looking. However, from a defense perspective, we find that simply reducing attack success probabilities can, paradoxically, incentivize attacks under certain conditions. Furthermore, defensive measures to cap the upper bound of attack success rates may prove futile in some scenarios. These insights highlight the complexity of securing LLM-based systems. Our work provides a theoretical foundation and practical insights for understanding and mitigating their vulnerabilities, while emphasizing the importance of adaptive security strategies and thoughtful ecosystem design.

TL;DR: 本文将大语言模型搜索引擎中的排名操纵攻击建模为无限重复囚徒困境，分析玩家在合作与攻击之间的策略动态。研究发现攻击成本、折现率、攻击成功率等因素影响合作稳定性，且防御措施可能适得其反。
Motivation: 大语言模型搜索引擎易受排名操纵攻击，攻击者通过构造网页内容操纵LLM的排名以获取不公平优势，现有研究缺乏对这种攻击动态的理论分析。
Method: 将排名操纵攻击问题建模为无限重复囚徒困境，多玩家策略性地决定合作或攻击，利用博弈论分析合作维持的条件及触发策略的影响。
Result: 合作在有前瞻性的玩家中更易维持；降低攻击成功率反而可能激励攻击；限制攻击成功率上限在某些场景下无效。
Conclusion: 本文提供了理解大语言模型搜索引擎脆弱性的理论基础，强调需要自适应安全策略和深思熟虑的生态系统设计。

papers.title: Training Set Augmentation and Biology-Aware Harmonization Improve Radiomic Models for Lung Cancer Prediction in Indeterminate Nodules
papers.abstract_en: CT radiomics-based machine learning has potential to predict lung cancer in pulmonary nodules (PNs) earlier than standard-of-care methods. Low malignancy rates in early-development PNs and variable image acquisition hinder development of radiomic models for diagnosing these PNs. To address these challenges, we augmented training using later-development PNs and harmonized for acquisition effects. We examine early-development benign and malignant PNs (n=106) below the sensitivity of standard-of-care diagnosis. Classifiers predicting malignancy performed near chance when trained on ComBat-harmonized radiomic features from only early-development PNs. We then augmented training with later-development benign and malignant PNs (n=225). We evaluated whether harmonization must incorporate biology that impacts acquisition effects in added training data. To correct variability from four acquisition protocols, we compared: 1) biology-unaware harmonization, 2) harmonizing with a covariate distinguishing early-development, later-development benign, later-development malignant datasets, 3) harmonizing each dataset separately. Models trained using augmentation, but biology-unaware harmonization, failed to improve consistently. Augmented training data harmonized with a covariate (ROC-AUC 0.74 [0.69-0.79]) or separately (ROC-AUC 0.71 [0.66-0.77]) yielded higher test ROC-AUC (Delong, p<=0.05) and PR-AUC (Wilcoxon, p<=0.05). In a proof-of-principle methodological study, we demonstrate with a small single-center dataset that combining radiomic features from later-development benign and malignant PNs requires biology-aware harmonization.

TL;DR: 本文针对早期肺结节（PNs）诊断中恶性率低和影像采集变异性的挑战，提出使用后期发育结节进行训练集增强，并结合生物学感知的协调方法（harmonization）来提升影像组学模型的性能。在106例早期结节和225例后期结节的小样本单中心数据上，生物学感知协调（按数据集分组或加入协变量）显著提升了ROC-AUC（0.74）和PR-AUC，而生物学无感知协调失败，表明训练增强需要结合生物学信息的协调。
Motivation: CT影像组学机器学习有潜力早期预测肺结节恶性，但早期结节恶性率低和影像采集差异阻碍了模型开发。现有方法仅使用早期结节且协调时忽略生物学因素，性能接近随机。
Method: 采用训练集增强（加入后期发育的良恶性结节），并比较三种协调策略：1) 生物学无感知的ComBat协调；2) 加入区分早期/后期良性/恶性数据集的协变量进行协调；3) 对每个数据集单独协调。模型使用随机森林分类器。
Result: 仅使用早期结节且经ComBat协调的模型性能接近随机。加入训练增强但生物学无感知协调未能一致提升。而带协变量协调（ROC-AUC 0.74 [0.69-0.79]）或单独协调（ROC-AUC 0.71 [0.66-0.77]）显著优于其他方法（Delong p≤0.05，Wilcoxon p≤0.05）。
Conclusion: 在单中心小样本数据上证明，将后期发育肺结节的影像组学特征用于训练增强时，必须采用生物学感知的协调方法（如协变量或分组协调）才能有效提升肺癌预测模型性能。
