papers.title: Whisper-GPT -- Continuous Discrete Hybrid Representation Language Models For Speech And Music
papers.abstract_en: We propose WHISPER-GPT: A generative large language model (LLM) for speech and music that allows us to work with continuous audio representations and discrete tokens simultaneously as part of a single architecture. There has been a huge surge in generative audio, speech, and music models that utilize discrete audio tokens derived from neural compression algorithms, e.g. ENCODEC. However, one of the major drawbacks of this approach is handling the context length. It blows up for high-fidelity generative architecture if one has to account for all the audio contents at various frequencies for the next token prediction. By combining continuous audio representation like the spectrogram and discrete acoustic tokens, we retain the best of both worlds: Have all the information needed from the audio at a specific time instance in a single token, yet allow LLM to predict the future token to allow for sampling and other benefits discrete space provides. We show how our architecture improves the perplexity and negative log-likelihood scores for the next token prediction compared to a token-based LLM for speech and music.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. 50th International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing, Hyderabad, India
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WHISPER-GPT，一种同时使用连续音频表示（如语谱图）和离散音频 token 的生成式大语言模型，用于语音和音乐生成。通过混合表示，该架构在单个 token 中保留所有音频信息，同时允许 LLM 进行下一个 token 预测，从而避免纯离散 token 方法中上下文长度过长的问题。摘要显示该方法在下一个 token 预测的困惑度和负对数似然上优于纯 token 的 LLM。
Motivation: 现有基于离散音频 token 的生成模型（如 ENCODEC）在处理高保真音频时上下文长度过长，导致计算效率低。
Method: 提出混合架构，同时使用连续音频表示（语谱图）和离散声学 token，将每个时间步的完整信息压缩到一个 token 中，并利用 LLM 预测下一个 token。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在下一个 token 预测任务上降低了困惑度和负对数似然得分，优于纯 token 的 LLM。
Conclusion: 连续-离散混合表示能兼顾信息完整性与离散空间采样的优势，改善语音和音乐生成中的上下文长度问题。

papers.title: Visual-TCAV: Concept-based Attribution and Saliency Maps for Post-hoc Explainability in Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have shown remarkable performance in image classification. However, interpreting their predictions is challenging due to the size and complexity of these models. State-of-the-art saliency methods generate local explanations highlighting the area in the input image where a class is identified but cannot explain how a concept of interest contributes to the prediction. On the other hand, concept-based methods, such as TCAV, provide insights into how sensitive the network is to a human-defined concept but cannot compute its attribution in a specific prediction nor show its location within the input image. We introduce Visual-TCAV, a novel explainability framework aiming to bridge the gap between these methods by providing both local and global explanations. Visual-TCAV uses Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) to generate class-agnostic saliency maps that show where the network recognizes a certain concept. Moreover, it can estimate the attribution of these concepts to the output of any class using a generalization of Integrated Gradients. We evaluate the method's faithfulness via a controlled experiment where the ground truth for explanations is known, showing better ground truth alignment than TCAV. Our code is available at https://github.com/DataSciencePolimi/Visual-TCAV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Visual-TCAV框架，旨在桥接局部显著性图和概念归因方法之间的差距。它利用概念激活向量（CAV）生成类无关的显著性图，并泛化集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）来估计概念对任意类输出的归因。在已知解释真值的控制实验中，Visual-TCAV比TCAV表现出更好的真值对齐。
Motivation: CNN在图像分类中表现优异，但模型复杂导致预测难以解释。现有方法要么只提供局部解释（如显著性图）而无法量化概念贡献，要么如TCAV只能提供全局概念敏感性却无法定位或归因到具体预测。
Method: Visual-TCAV使用概念激活向量（CAV）生成类无关的显著性图，指示网络在输入图像中识别特定概念的位置；同时通过集成梯度的泛化来估计这些概念对任意类输出的归因值。
Result: 在控制实验（已知解释真值）中，Visual-TCAV的归因和显著性图比TCAV更忠实于真实解释。
Conclusion: 摘要强调Visual-TCAV同时提供局部和全局解释，弥合了两类方法的鸿沟，并开源了代码。

papers.title: Conditional Vendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation for Generative AI Models and LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Generative models guided by text prompts are widely evaluated for fidelity and prompt alignment, yet their ability to produce outputs remains underexplored. Existing diversity metrics such as Vendi and RKE, which are based on the von Neumann and Rényi entropies of kernel matrices, were developed for unconditional models and cannot distinguish prompt-induced from model-induced variability. We address this gap by introducing \textit{Conditional-Vendi} and \textit{Conditional-RKE}, diversity measures derived from the conditional entropy of positive semidefinite matrices. These scores isolate model-induced diversity in prompt-guided generation, with Conditional-RKE enjoying an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ convergence rate. For Conditional-Vendi, we introduce a truncated-spectrum approximation that yields scalable and consistent estimates. Experiments on text-to-image, image-captioning, and LLM tasks show that the conditional scores recover ground-truth diversity orderings and can also guide diffusion models toward more diverse samples. The codebase is available at https://github.com/mjalali/conditional-vendi.

TL;DR: 本文提出条件多样性度量 Conditional-Vendi 和 Conditional-RKE，用于评估提示引导生成模型的输出多样性。这些度量基于条件熵，能够分离模型自身变异与提示引起的变异，并提供可扩展的估计。实验表明，在文本到图像、图像字幕和 LLM 任务中，条件分数能恢复真实多样性排序，并可用于引导扩散模型生成更丰富的样本。
Motivation: 现有多样性指标（如 Vendi 和 RKE）为无条件生成模型设计，无法区分提示引起的变异与模型自身的变异，因此不足以评估提示引导生成模型的真实输出多样性。
Method: 提出 Conditional-Vendi 和 Conditional-RKE，基于正定矩阵的条件熵定义多样性；Conditional-RKE 具有 O(1/√n) 收敛率，Conditional-Vendi 采用截断谱近似实现可扩展一致估计。
Result: 在文本到图像、图像字幕和 LLM 任务中，条件分数恢复了真实多样性排序，并能指导扩散模型生成更多样的样本。
Conclusion: 条件多样性度量能更准确评估提示引导生成模型的输出多样性，并具有实际应用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Direct Preference Optimization: Datasets, Theories, Variants, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), aligning policy models with human preferences has become increasingly critical. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a promising approach for alignment, acting as an RL-free alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Despite DPO's various advancements and inherent limitations, an in-depth review of these aspects is currently lacking in the literature. In this work, we present a comprehensive review of the challenges and opportunities in DPO, covering theoretical analyses, variants, relevant preference datasets, and applications. Specifically, we categorize recent studies on DPO based on key research questions to provide a thorough understanding of DPO's current landscape. Additionally, we propose several future research directions to offer insights on model alignment for the research community. An updated collection of relevant papers can be found on https://github.com/Mr-Loevan/DPO-Survey.
papers.comment: Accepted by TPAMI 2026. Project page: https://github.com/Mr-Loevan/DPO-Survey
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对直接偏好优化（DPO）的全面综述，覆盖了DPO的理论分析、变体、偏好数据集和应用。文章基于关键研究问题对近期DPO研究进行分类，并提出了未来研究方向，为模型对齐提供见解。
Motivation: 尽管DPO作为RLHF的无强化学习替代方案在大型语言模型对齐中展现出潜力，但文献中缺乏对其挑战和机遇的深入综述。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，系统梳理DPO的理论基础、主要变体、相关数据集和应用场景，并按照关键研究问题进行分类讨论。
Result: 总结了DPO的当前研究格局，并提出了若干未来研究方向，以推动模型对齐领域的发展。
Conclusion: 本文全面回顾了DPO的挑战与机遇，为研究者提供了系统的参考框架和未来探索路径。

papers.title: Active-Passive Federated Learning for Vertically Partitioned Multi-view Data
papers.abstract_en: Vertical federated learning is a natural and elegant approach to integrate multi-view data vertically partitioned across devices (clients) while preserving their privacies. Apart from the model training, existing methods requires the collaboration of all clients in the model inference. However, the model inference is probably maintained for service in a long time, while the collaboration, especially when the clients belong to different organizations, is unpredictable in real-world scenarios, such as concellation of contract, network unavailablity, etc., resulting in the failure of them. To address this issue, we, at the first attempt, propose a flexible Active-Passive Federated learning (APFed) framework. Specifically, the active client is the initiator of a learning task and responsible to build the complete model, while the passive clients only serve as assistants. Once the model built, the active client can make inference independently. In addition, we instance the APFed framework into two classification methods with employing the reconstruction loss and the contrastive loss on passive clients, respectively. Meanwhile, the two methods are tested in a set of experiments and achieves desired results, validating their effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对垂直联邦学习在模型推理阶段需要所有客户端协作的不可靠问题，首次提出主动-被动联邦学习（APFed）框架。该框架中主动客户端（任务发起者）独立构建完整模型，被动客户端仅作为辅助；训练完成后主动客户端可独立推理。基于APFed实例化了两种分类方法，分别使用重构损失和对比损失在被动客户端上，实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有垂直联邦学习方法在模型推理时依赖所有客户端协作，但实际场景中客户端可能因合同取消、网络故障等原因无法参与，导致推理失败。
Method: 提出Active-Passive Federated Learning (APFed)框架，主动客户端负责构建完整模型，被动客户端仅提供辅助。实例化两种方法：在被动客户端上分别采用重构损失和对比损失进行训练。
Result: 在多组实验上取得了期望结果，验证了两种方法在分类任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: APFed框架使得主动客户端在模型构建后可独立推理，提升了垂直联邦学习在实际部署中的灵活性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Curse of Dimensionality: Diffusion Models Efficiently Learn Low-Dimensional Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Despite their empirical success across a wide range of generative tasks, the fundamental principles underlying the ability of diffusion models to learn data distributions are poorly understood. In this work, we develop a new mathematical framework that explains how diffusion models can effectively learn low-dimensional distributions from a finite number of training samples without suffering from the curse of dimensionality. Specifically, motivated by the intrinsic low-dimensional structure of image data, we theoretically analyze a setting in which the data distribution is modeled as a mixture of low-rank Gaussians. Under suitable network parameterization, we show that optimizing the training objective of diffusion models is equivalent to solving the canonical subspace clustering problem over the training samples, where each subspace basis corresponds to the low-rank covariance of a Gaussian component. This equivalence allows us to show that the sample complexity for learning the underlying distribution scales linearly with the intrinsic dimension of the data, rather than exponentially with the ambient dimension. Our theoretical findings are further supported by empirical evidence that demonstrates phase transition phenomena in generalization on both synthetic and real-world image datasets. Moreover, we establish a correspondence between the learned subspace bases and semantic attributes of image data, providing a principled foundation for controllable image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个数学框架，解释扩散模型如何从有限样本中有效学习低维数据分布，而不会遭受维度灾难。在数据分布为低秩高斯混合的假设下，证明训练扩散模型等价于解决子空间聚类问题，样本复杂度与数据内在维度线性相关，与背景维度无关。理论结果在合成和真实图像数据集上得到验证，并建立了学习到的子空间基与图像语义属性之间的对应关系。
Motivation: 扩散模型在生成任务中表现出色，但其学习数据分布的基本原理尚不清晰，尤其在处理高维数据时如何避免维度灾难缺乏理论解释。
Method: 将数据分布建模为低秩高斯混合，在合适的网络参数化下，证明扩散模型的训练目标等价于求解典型子空间聚类问题，其中每个子空间基对应一个高斯分量的低秩协方差。
Result: 理论表明样本复杂度与数据内在维度线性相关，而非背景维度指数相关；在合成和真实图像数据集上观察到泛化中的相变现象；学习到的子空间基与图像语义属性有对应关系。
Conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型学习低维分布提供了理论保证，并揭示了其与子空间聚类的联系，为可控图像生成提供了原则性基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BadRobot: Jailbreaking Embodied LLM Agents in the Physical World
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI represents systems where AI is integrated into physical entities. Large Language Model (LLM), which exhibits powerful language understanding abilities, has been extensively employed in embodied AI by facilitating sophisticated task planning. However, a critical safety issue remains overlooked: could these embodied LLMs perpetrate harmful behaviors? In response, we introduce BadRobot, a novel attack paradigm aiming to make embodied LLMs violate safety and ethical constraints through typical voice-based user-system interactions. Specifically, three vulnerabilities are exploited to achieve this type of attack: (i) manipulation of LLMs within robotic systems, (ii) misalignment between linguistic outputs and physical actions, and (iii) unintentional hazardous behaviors caused by world knowledge's flaws. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of various malicious physical action queries to evaluate BadRobot's attack performance. Based on this benchmark, extensive experiments against existing prominent embodied LLM frameworks (e.g., Voxposer, Code as Policies, and ProgPrompt) demonstrate the effectiveness of our BadRobot. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rookie143/BadRobot.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICLR 2025. Please cite the conference version. Project page: https://Embodied-LLMs-Safety.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BadRobot攻击范式，旨在通过语音交互使具身LLM智能体执行违反安全与伦理的物理动作。利用机器人系统中LLM的可操纵性、语言输出与物理动作的不对齐、以及世界知识的缺陷三个漏洞，构建恶意物理动作查询基准，并在Voxposer、Code as Policies、ProgPrompt等框架上验证攻击有效性。
Motivation: 现有具身AI安全研究忽视了大语言模型驱动机器人可能产生的恶意行为，缺乏针对物理世界攻击的系统性分析。
Method: 提出BadRobot攻击范式，利用三个漏洞：操纵机器人系统中的LLM、语言输出与物理动作不对齐、世界知识缺陷导致意外危险行为，并构建恶意物理动作查询基准进行评估。
Result: 在多个主流具身LLM框架（Voxposer、Code as Policies、ProgPrompt）上的实验证明BadRobot能有效引发违反安全伦理的物理动作。
Conclusion: 具身LLM在物理世界中存在严重安全风险，需警惕语音交互导致的恶意行为，论文呼吁加强相关防御机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Deep Reinforcement Learning Through Adversarial Attacks and Training : A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is a subfield of machine learning for training autonomous agents that take sequential actions across complex environments. Despite its significant performance in well-known environments, it remains susceptible to minor condition variations, raising concerns about its reliability in real-world applications. To improve usability, DRL must demonstrate trustworthiness and robustness. A way to improve the robustness of DRL to unknown changes in the environmental conditions and possible perturbations is through Adversarial Training, by training the agent against well-suited adversarial attacks on the observations and the dynamics of the environment. Addressing this critical issue, our work presents an in-depth analysis of contemporary adversarial attack and training methodologies, systematically categorizing them and comparing their objectives and operational mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文是一篇关于深度强化学习（DRL）中对抗攻击与训练方法的综述，系统分类并比较了当前方法的目标和操作机制，旨在提升DRL对环境变化和扰动的鲁棒性。
Motivation: DRL在实际应用中易受环境条件微小变化的影响，可靠性不足，因此提高其鲁棒性对于实际部署至关重要。
Method: 论文通过对观测和动态环境进行对抗攻击来训练智能体，并系统分类和比较了当前对抗攻击和训练方法。
Result: 论文提供了对当前方法的深入分析，并分类比较了它们的目标和操作机制。
Conclusion: 该综述强调了对抗训练对提升DRL鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: Deeper or Wider: A Perspective from Optimal Generalization Error with Sobolev Loss
papers.abstract_en: Constructing the architecture of a neural network is a challenging pursuit for the machine learning community, and the dilemma of whether to go deeper or wider remains a persistent question. This paper explores a comparison between deeper neural networks (DeNNs) with a flexible number of layers and wider neural networks (WeNNs) with limited hidden layers, focusing on their optimal generalization error in Sobolev losses. Analytical investigations reveal that the architecture of a neural network can be significantly influenced by various factors, including the number of sample points, parameters within the neural networks, and the regularity of the loss function. Specifically, a higher number of parameters tends to favor WeNNs, while an increased number of sample points and greater regularity in the loss function lean towards the adoption of DeNNs. We ultimately apply this theory to address partial differential equations using deep Ritz and physics-informed neural network (PINN) methods, guiding the design of neural networks.
papers.comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2310.10766, arXiv:2305.08466
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从Sobolev损失下的最优泛化误差角度，比较了深度神经网络（DeNN，可灵活增加层数）与宽度神经网络（WeNN，隐含层数有限）的架构选择。分析表明，样本点数、网络参数以及损失函数的正则性会影响架构偏好：参数多时倾向于WeNN，样本点多或损失函数正则性高时倾向于DeNN。最后将理论应用于深度Ritz方法和物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解偏微分方程，指导网络设计。
Motivation: 机器学习社区中关于网络架构“更深还是更宽”的争论长期存在，缺乏从泛化误差角度的严格理论比较。
Method: 基于Sobolev损失推导DeNN与WeNN的最优泛化误差上界，通过分析样本点数、参数数量和损失函数正则性对误差的影响，建立架构选择判据。
Result: 参数数量多时WeNN更优；样本点数多或损失函数正则性高时DeNN更优。
Conclusion: 该理论可指导深度Ritz和PINN方法中网络架构的设计，但论文未涉及具体应用领域。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 基于Sobolev损失推导DeNN与WeNN的最优泛化误差上界，通过分析样本点数、参数数量和损失函数正则性对误差的影响，建立架构选择判据。
summary_sections.result: 参数数量多时WeNN更优；样本点数多或损失函数正则性高时DeNN更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该理论可指导深度Ritz和PINN方法中网络架构的设计，但论文未涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: The Emergence of Reproducibility and Generalizability in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate an intriguing and prevalent phenomenon of diffusion models which we term as "consistent model reproducibility": given the same starting noise input and a deterministic sampler, different diffusion models often yield remarkably similar outputs. We confirm this phenomenon through comprehensive experiments, implying that different diffusion models consistently reach the same data distribution and scoring function regardless of diffusion model frameworks, model architectures, or training procedures. More strikingly, our further investigation implies that diffusion models are learning distinct distributions affected by the training data size. This is supported by the fact that the model reproducibility manifests in two distinct training regimes: (i) "memorization regime", where the diffusion model overfits to the training data distribution, and (ii) "generalization regime", where the model learns the underlying data distribution. Our study also finds that this valuable property generalizes to many variants of diffusion models, including those for conditional use, solving inverse problems, and model fine-tuning. Finally, our work raises numerous intriguing theoretical questions for future investigation and highlights practical implications regarding training efficiency, model privacy, and the controlled generation of diffusion models.
papers.comment: NeurIPS Diffusion Model Workshop 2023 (best paper award), the Forty-first International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现扩散模型存在“一致模型可重现性”现象：给定相同噪声和确定性采样器，不同扩散模型（架构、训练过程不同）往往产生非常相似的输出。实验表明，模型在记忆化（过拟合训练数据）和泛化（学习真实数据分布）两种训练机制下均表现出可重现性，且该性质推广到条件生成、逆问题求解和微调等变体。该发现对训练效率、模型隐私和控制生成具有潜在意义。
Motivation: 探索扩散模型在不同框架、架构和训练过程下输出一致性的原因和条件，理解模型是否学习到相同的数据分布和评分函数。
Method: 通过大量实验观察不同扩散模型在相同噪声和确定性采样器下的输出相似性，分析训练数据规模对可重现性的影响，并区分记忆化和泛化两种训练机制。
Result: 不同扩散模型在相同条件下输出高度相似；可重现性在记忆化和泛化两种训练机制下均存在；该性质推广到条件生成、逆问题求解和微调等变体。
Conclusion: 扩散模型的可重现性是普遍存在的属性，但模型学习到的分布受训练数据规模影响，这引发了对训练效率、模型隐私和控制生成的理论与实践问题。

papers.title: Belief Acquisition as Stochastic Filtering
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies how belief acquisition can be accomplished using stochastic filtering. First, a theoretical foundation for empirical beliefs is outlined. Then stochastic filtering in this context is studied. The paper introduces factored conditional filters, new filtering algorithms for simultaneously tracking states and estimating parameters in high-dimensional state spaces. The conditional nature of the algorithms is used to estimate parameters and the factored nature is used to decompose the state space into low-dimensional subspaces in such a way that filtering on these subspaces gives distributions whose product is a good approximation to the distribution on the entire state space. The conditions for successful application of the algorithms are that observations be available at the subspace level and that the transition schema can be factored into local transition schemas that are approximately confined to the subspaces; these conditions are widely satisfied in computer science, engineering, and geophysical filtering applications. Experimental results on tracking epidemics and estimating parameters in large contact networks show the effectiveness of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究信念获取如何通过随机滤波实现。首先为经验信念提供理论基础，然后研究该背景下的随机滤波。提出了因子条件滤波器，一种新的滤波算法，用于在高维状态空间中同时跟踪状态和估计参数。算法利用条件性质估计参数，并利用因子性质将状态空间分解为低维子空间，使得在这些子空间上的滤波的乘积是对整个状态空间分布的较好近似。成功应用的条件是观测在子空间级别可用，且转移模式可分解为近似局限于子空间的局部转移模式；这些条件在计算机科学、工程和地球物理滤波应用中广泛满足。在追踪流行病和估计大型接触网络参数上的实验结果显示该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有滤波方法在处理高维状态空间时面临计算复杂度和近似精度之间的权衡，尤其当需要同时进行状态跟踪和参数估计时。本文旨在提供一种理论与算法，使得在高维空间中通过分解为低维子空间来高效地进行滤波。
Method: 提出因子条件滤波器，将状态空间分解为低维子空间，每个子空间上独立进行滤波，再通过乘积近似全状态分布。算法同时利用条件分布进行参数估计，并依赖于子空间级别的观测和可分解的局部转移模式。
Result: 在流行病追踪和大型接触网络参数估计任务上，实验显示该方法有效。但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 本文从理论和算法上论证了通过随机滤波进行信念获取的可行性，并展示了因子条件滤波器在满足特定条件（子空间观测、局部转移）的高维应用中的潜力。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Time series forecasting from partial observations via Non-negative Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: In modern time series problems, one aims at forecasting multiple time series with possible missing and noisy values. In this paper, we introduce the Sliding Mask Method (SMM) for forecasting multiple nonnegative time series by means of nonnegative matrix completion: observed noisy values and forecast/missing values are collected into matrix form, and learning is achieved by representing its rows as a convex combination of a small number of nonnegative vectors, referred to as the archetypes. We introduce two estimates, the mask Archetypal Matrix factorization (mAMF) and the mask normalized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (mNMF) which can be combined with the SMM method. We prove that these estimates recover the true archetypes with an error proportional to the noise. We use a proximal alternating linearized method (PALM) to compute the archetypes and the convex combination weights. We compared our estimators with state-of-the-art methods (Transformers, LSTM, SARIMAX...) in multiple time series forecasting on real data and obtain that our method outperforms them in most of the experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出滑动掩码方法 (SMM) 用于多非负时间序列的预测，通过非负矩阵补全将观测到的含噪值和缺失值收集为矩阵形式，利用少量非负向量（原型）的凸组合表示行。介绍了两种估计量：掩码原型矩阵分解 (mAMF) 和掩码归一化非负矩阵分解 (mNMF)，并结合 SMM。证明这些估计量能以与噪声成比例的错误恢复真实原型。使用近端交替线性化方法 (PALM) 计算原型和凸组合权重。在真实数据上将方法与 Transformer、LSTM、SARIMAX 等先进方法比较，大多数实验中表现更优。
Motivation: 现代时间序列问题常涉及多个序列且存在缺失和噪声值，现有方法在非负时间序列预测中可能不够有效，需要既能处理缺失又能利用非负结构的方法。
Method: 提出滑动掩码方法 (SMM)，结合非负矩阵分解，引入掩码原型矩阵分解 (mAMF) 和掩码归一化非负矩阵分解 (mNMF)，使用近端交替线性化方法 (PALM) 求解。
Result: 在真实数据实验中对多种先进方法（Transformer、LSTM、SARIMAX 等），所提方法在大多数测试中取得了更优的预测性能。
Conclusion: 方法通过非负矩阵补全和原型表示有效预测含缺失和噪声的多时间序列，理论保证和实证结果均表明其有效性。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: POPSICLE: Benchmark Datasets for Segmentation and Localization in CryoET
papers.abstract_en: Cryo-electron tomography (cryoET) has emerged as a powerful tool in structural and cellular biology by enabling direct visualization of macromolecular structures within intact cells, thereby linking molecular architecture to cellular organization in a native context. Realizing the full potential of cryoET, however, increasingly depends on advances in computational analysis, particularly machine learning (ML), to interpret its complex and information-rich data. Despite rapid progress, ML development for cryoET remains bottlenecked by the lack of standardized, well-annotated benchmarks. Existing evaluations are typically small, task-specific, and are assembled in isolation, limiting robust comparisons across methods. Here, we present POPSICLE, a benchmark suite for cryoET segmentation and macromolecular localization built from the CryoET Data Portal - an open, ML-ready repository of tomographic data, metadata, and annotations. POPSICLE spans eukaryotic and prokaryotic systems, both purified and fully in situ samples, and dense voxel-wise segmentation as well as sparse localization tasks. Built on a living data resource, it can expand as new datasets and annotations become available. Baseline experiments reveal substantial variation in model rankings across tasks, underscoring the need for benchmarks tailored to the unique characteristics of cryoET rather than evaluation practices adapted from adjacent biomedical imaging domains. POPSICLE thus provides an open and extensible foundation for reproducible ML evaluation in cryoET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POPSICLE 是一个基于 CryoET 数据门户构建的冷冻电镜断层扫描（cryoET）分割与大分子定位基准套件，覆盖真核与原核系统、纯化与原位样本、密集体素分割与稀疏定位任务。基线实验显示模型排名随任务变化显著，表明 cryoET 需要专门设计的基准而非直接沿用相邻生物医学影像领域的评估方法。该套件可随新数据与标注扩展，为可复现的 ML 评估提供开放基础。
Motivation: cryoET 的 ML 发展缺乏标准化、标注完善的基准，现有评估任务小、孤立，限制了方法间的鲁棒比较。
Method: 从 CryoET 数据门户中整理并标准化了多个公开数据集，构建了涵盖分割与定位的基准套件 POPSICLE，并提供了基线实验结果。
Result: 基线实验表明不同任务上模型排名差异较大，揭示了为 cryoET 特性定制基准的必要性。
Conclusion: POPSICLE 为 cryoET 的可复现 ML 评估提供了开放且可扩展的基础，但当前仅基于已有数据，未来可随新数据扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RealMath-Eval: Why SOTA Judges Struggle with Real Human Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved near-perfect performance in \emph{solving} high-school mathematics, their ability to \emph{evaluate} the diverse reasoning processes of real human students remains under-examined. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RealMath-Eval}, a rigorously annotated benchmark of 224 real-world exam responses from high schools. Our initial evaluation reveals that even state-of-the-art LLM judges struggle significantly on this task, exhibiting a high Mean Squared Error ($\sim$2.96) against expert human grading. To probe a plausible explanation, we contrast this performance with a control setting where the same judges evaluate synthetic LLM-generated solutions. We identify a stark ``Evaluation Gap'': judges are considerably more accurate and consistent on synthetic text (MSE $\sim$1.17) but struggle to generalize to authentic student reasoning. Through semantic embedding analysis, we find that synthetic errors suffer from a ``structural collapse'' into predictable, low-dimensional linear subspaces, whereas human errors form a more diverse error space. Furthermore, generative probability probes suggest that human reasoning involves significantly higher information-theoretic surprisal, indicating that student reasoning transitions are more out-of-distribution for current models. Finally, we find that surface-level style transfer fails to close this gap. Our findings suggest that current LLM evaluation pipelines relying heavily on synthetic data may not adequately capture the diversity of authentic student mathematical reasoning.
papers.comment: Code available at https://github.com/RicharMd/RealMath-Eval , Data available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RicharMd/RealMath-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RealMath-Eval基准，包含224个真实高中考试批改样本，发现即使最先进的LLM裁判与专家评分相比均方误差高达2.96，而评估合成LLM解决方案时MSE仅1.17，揭示“评估差距”。分析表明人类推理的误差空间更多样，且概率惊奇度更高，风格迁移无法弥合差距。
Motivation: 现有LLM在解决高中数学问题上表现近乎完美，但评估真实学生多样化推理过程的能力仍不足。
Method: 构建RealMath-Eval基准，包含224个真实考试答案；对比评估真实答案与合成LLM解决方案的性能差异；通过语义嵌入分析、概率惊奇度探测等探究原因。
Result: SOTA LLM裁判在真实答案上MSE约2.96，在合成文本上仅1.17；人类错误空间更多样，推理转换惊奇度更高；风格迁移无效。
Conclusion: 当前依赖合成数据的LLM评估流程可能无法充分捕捉真实学生数学推理的多样性。

papers.title: Multi-Level Analyzation of Imbalance to Resolve Non-IID-Ness in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance is a common problem in deep learning that severely degrades performance. In federated learning (FL), it is a critical factor contributing to non-identically distributed data (non-IID). Building on several previous attempts, we define and analyze imbalance issues in FL at three levels: inter-case, inter-class, and inter-client. Inter-case imbalance addresses the imbalance in every single class; inter-class imbalance compares the number of data between different classes. Inter-client imbalance represents different skewness of local data between clients. Based on these concepts, we propose FedBB, which consists of two main components: (1) Positive Negative Balanced (PNB) loss function addresses the inter-case and inter-class imbalances in local training, enhancing generalization on highly skewed local client datasets. It optimizes both multi-label and multi-class classifications by assigning higher weights to minority cases or classes. (2) Client Balanced Reweighting (CBR) reweights clients based on inter-client imbalance during model aggregation, giving greater weight to models trained on less skewed datasets. Various experiments on X-ray and natural image datasets demonstrate that FedBB outperforms other algorithms in both performance and efficiency. Additionally, it requires limited statistical information, which is beneficial for privacy protection. Through ablation studies, we proved that PNB loss and CBR independently contribute to performance. As FedBB aims to build a global model that accurately classifies all classes, it can serve as a baseline for the generic and personalized FL.

Conclusion: FedBB旨在构建能准确分类所有类别的全局模型，可作为通用和个性化联邦学习的基线方法。

papers.title: When Design Rules Break: Benchmark Composition Determines Whether Label Informativeness Predicts GNN Aggregator Choice
papers.abstract_en: We examine whether graph neural network (GNN) design rules generalize across benchmark families by studying aggregator selection (sum, mean, max) on 24 node-classification datasets spanning citation, heterophilic, LINKX Facebook-100, co-purchase, and co-authorship graphs. Edge homophily is only weakly predictive of the GIN-Sum versus GIN-Mean performance gap. Label informativeness predicts this gap well on legacy benchmarks but degrades substantially when Facebook-100 graphs are included. In these dense friendship networks, near-zero label informativeness coexists with a strong preference for sum aggregation, producing gains of 7-10% and up to 13% under extended training. Stochastic block model ablations, including degree-corrected variants matching Facebook-100 degree scales, fail to reproduce this behavior, indicating that mean degree alone does not explain the effect. Among several label-independent graph statistics, the spectral gap uniquely distinguishes these graphs from other low-informativeness datasets, with the effect localized to one-hop neighborhoods and replicated across architectures. We further identify training regimes that interact with aggregator choice and show that PNA can underperform the best single-aggregator GIN on standard citation benchmarks. Our results suggest that benchmark composition, rather than numerical insufficiency, determines whether design rules appear to generalize, and that the Facebook-100 regime provides a concrete target for future adaptive aggregation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过24个节点分类数据集（包括引文、异配、LINKX Facebook-100、共购买、共作者图）检验了GNN设计规则（聚合器选择）是否跨基准泛化。发现边同质性对GIN-Sum与GIN-Mean性能差异预测较弱；标签信息量在传统基准上预测良好，但加入Facebook-100后显著失效，这些密集友谊网络中标签信息量接近零却偏好求和聚合（增益7-10%，延伸训练达13%）。随机块模型未能复现该行为，而谱间隙唯一区分了这些图，效应局限于一跳邻域。结论指出基准组成而非数值不足决定了设计规则的表观泛化性。
Motivation: 检验GNN设计规则（如聚合器选择）是否在不同基准家族中一致成立，因为现有规则可能在特定基准上有效但无法泛化。
Method: 通过大规模实验（24个节点分类数据集，涵盖多种图类型）比较sum、mean、max聚合器在GIN和PNA上的性能，并结合标签信息量、边同质性、谱间隙等图统计量分析。
Result: 标签信息量在传统基准上能预测聚合器性能差异，但在Facebook-100图上失效（近零标签信息量却偏好求和，增益7-10%）。谱间隙唯一区分这些图，效应局限于一跳邻域。PNA在标准引文基准上可能不如最佳单聚合器GIN。
Conclusion: 基准组成决定设计规则是否看似泛化，Facebook-100图为未来自适应聚合方法提供了具体目标。

papers.title: Linguistically Augmented Audio Speech Data (LinguAS)
papers.abstract_en: Maliciously-created fake speech, including deepfaked and spoofed audio, is proliferating at an alarming rate, and detection models are racing to stay ahead of the curve. Yet, most detection models are trained to make inference on frame-level audio features alone without leveraging valuable linguistic cues at larger timescales. To address this gap, we present Linguistically Augmented Audio Speech Data (LinguAS), a dataset of genuine and deepfaked audio samples annotated with five strategically-chosen, Expert-Defined Linguistic Features (EDLFs) that occur frequently in spoken English and are characteristic of natural human speech. LinguAS contains over 800 audio samples, each of which are annotated with EDLFs. The dataset has a balanced number of four spoofed audio attack types and a proportionate number of genuine speech samples. We also include metadata on speaker gender and the generator/source for each spoofed audio sample, offering more granularity for model training. We found that models trained on data augmented with EDLFs had improved model performance significantly beyond the ASVspoof 2021 deep learning baselines and SSL models like HuBert and XLSR. LinguAS's augmented linguistic, gender, and generator metadata provide audio deepfake researchers with a dataset that emphasizes real human language traits to improve model inference of faked speech. Data and code are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LinguAS数据集，包含真实和深度伪造音频样本，并标注了五种专家定义的语言特征（EDLFs）。超过800个样本，平衡四种伪造攻击类型和真实语音。实验表明，使用EDLFs增强的数据训练模型，性能显著超过ASVspoof 2021基线和HuBert、XLSR等SSL模型。数据集和代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造音频检测模型多仅基于帧级音频特征，忽略了较大时间尺度上的语言线索，导致性能受限。
Method: 构建LinguAS数据集，对真实和伪造音频样本标注五种频繁出现且表征自然语音的专家定义语言特征（EDLFs），并包含说话人性别和伪造音频生成器元数据。
Result: 使用EDLFs增强数据训练的模型，性能显著优于ASVspoof 2021深度学习方法以及HuBert和XLSR等自监督模型。
Conclusion: LinguAS数据集通过强调真实人类语言特征，为音频深度伪造检测提供了改进模型推理的有效资源。

papers.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍YUBI，一种手指对齐的夹爪，用于双手灵巧操作的直观、可扩展数据收集。YUBI采用顺从式手指驱动，直接映射人类手指运动到夹爪运动。作者构建了大规模数据集（8434小时，120万片段，119个任务），并证明在多种双臂机器人上策略可迁移。
Motivation: 现有的手持数据收集系统（如UMI）的笨重手枪式握把设计在精细灵巧操作任务中存在人体工程学和可用性问题。
Method: YUBI采用顺从式手指驱动设计，直接映射人类手指运动到夹爪运动。结合基于VR的6自由度跟踪，构建数据收集系统。收集大规模UMI风格数据集。
Result: 收集了8434小时、120万片段、119个任务的空前规模数据集。实验表明YUBI在复杂双手任务的多样性、灵巧性和操作效率上优于UMI夹爪。单一策略通过简单安装夹爪即可在多种双臂机器人（UR, Franka, ELEY）上迁移。
Conclusion: 本文开源了硬件、软件和数据集，为机器人基础模型的大规模数据获取提供了可复现的路径。

papers.title: DUET -- Dual User Embedding Transformers for Offsite Conversion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Offsite conversion rate (OCVR) prediction is an important ranking problem in computational recommendation systems. This task presents a modeling challenge: click signals are abundant and exhibit short temporal horizons, whereas conversion signals are inherently sparse, long-delayed, and frequently unattributed. Despite these statistical disparities, both signal types must inform models that operate within strict serving-latency constraints. Prior pre-training approaches address this heterogeneity with a single, undifferentiated encoder applied uniformly across both data streams. We propose DUET (Dual User Embedding Transformers), a framework that explicitly partitions user behavioral data into two domain-coherent streams -- clicks and conversions -- and pre-trains dedicated transformer encoders with architectures tailored to each stream's statistical characteristics: multi-layer self-attention for the dense click stream and interleaved cross- and self-attention for the sparse conversion stream. The resulting complementary embeddings are jointly consumed by a downstream ranker without exceeding serving-latency budgets. Evaluation demonstrates up to 0.38% normalized entropy (NE) reduction relative to the strongest baseline, and A/B test shows consistent improvements in OCVR prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DUET框架，针对离站转化率预测中点击和转化信号统计特性不同的问题，将用户行为分为点击和转化两个流，分别用不同结构的Transformer编码器预训练，得到互补嵌入用于下游排序。实验表明归一化熵降低0.38%，A/B测试验证准确度提升。
Motivation: 现有方法对点击和转化信号采用统一编码器，忽视了二者在密度、延迟和稀疏性上的差异，影响OCVR预测精度。
Method: DUET将用户行为数据显式划分为点击流和转化流，为点击流设计多层自注意力Transformer，为转化流设计交织交叉和自注意力的Transformer，分别预训练后得到嵌入，由下游排序器融合使用，且满足服务延迟约束。
Result: 相比最强基线，归一化熵（NE）降低最多0.38%，A/B测试中OCVR预测准确度一致提升。
Conclusion: 针对点击和转化信号异质性设计专用编码器能有效提升OCVR预测，且不增加服务延迟。

papers.title: Regimes: An Auditable, Held-Out-Gated Improvement Loop Demonstrated on LongMemEval with ActiveGraph
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous improvement loops are hard to trust because the improvement process is usually external scaffolding bolted onto the agent: failures go unlogged, diagnoses cannot be replayed, and promote-or-discard decisions land in a side database rather than the agent's own history. We show that an event-sourced agent runtime removes that friction and turns controlled improvement into a first-class workflow. When the agent's state is a deterministic projection of an append-only event log, failures are recorded, a run replays exactly from its log, candidate patches scope to typed pipeline seams, gates are auditable, and every promotion or discard is itself an event. We demonstrate this with Regimes, a loop on the ActiveGraph runtime that diagnoses failed evaluations, proposes a repair at a pipeline point, and promotes it only after static checks, sandbox execution, in-sample evaluation, and held-out validation. The loop is target-agnostic: the same control flow runs against different tasks through a common interface. On LongMemEval-S the dominant failure is not retrieval but reconciliation: the evidence is already in the assembled context, yet the reader answers incorrectly. Across five seeded held-out splits, Regimes discovers reader-prompt repairs that improve final held-out accuracy by +0.05 to +0.10 in four splits and +0.01 in one over-promotion split; two splits are individually significant (seed 5 unadjusted for its sequential promotion structure), and the pooled count is descriptive only, since the splits share one 500-question pool. The durable contributions are ActiveGraph as an auditable substrate that makes controlled improvement loops tractable, the held-out-gated loop it supports, the failure-regime taxonomy routing each failure to a pipeline location (whose marginal value over an unrouted baseline is the primary open question), and the prompt-as-discovery-probe hypothesis.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. Code and committed runs: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/regimes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Regimes，一种基于ActiveGraph事件溯源运行时的自主改进循环，使agent的改进可审计。该方法通过将agent状态建模为只追加事件日志的确定性投影，记录失败、精确重放运行、对候选补丁进行静态检查、沙盒执行、样本内评估和留出验证，最终决定是否推广。在LongMemEval-S上，主要失败模式是调和失败，Regimes发现读者提示修补程序，在五个留出分割中将最终留出准确率提高了+0.05到+0.10。
Motivation: 自主改进循环难以信任，因为改进过程通常是附加在agent上的外部脚手架：失败不被记录，诊断无法重放，推广或丢弃决策落入侧数据库而非agent自身历史。作者希望消除这种摩擦，将受控改进转变为第一类工作流。
Method: 使用事件追踪（event-sourced）的agent运行时，其中agent状态是只追加事件日志的确定性投影。Regimes循环诊断失败评估，在管道点提出修复，并仅通过静态检查、沙盒执行、样本内评估和留出验证后才推广。
Result: 在LongMemEval-S上，主要失败是调和失败。在五个种子留出分割中，Regimes发现读者提示修补程序，将最终留出准确率提高了+0.05到+0.10（四个分割），一个分割提高+0.01；两个分割单独显著。

papers.title: Hyperbolic Neural Population Geometry Benefits Computation
papers.abstract_en: Neural population geometry shapes downstream computation. Recent empirical findings in neurobiology suggest that a hyperbolic structure underlies population activity in the hippocampus. Here we provide a theoretical framework for this phenomenon. First, we propose a plausible construction of hippocampal tuning curves that statistically induces hyperbolic geometry. Next, we establish a connection between neural decoding and associative memory by demonstrating that the Modern Hopfield Network update rule computes the minimum mean-squared-error (MMSE) estimator. Finally, we introduce a novel associative memory model defined in hyperbolic space that yields significantly larger capacity than leading models. Our results suggest that animals encode spatial information as a latent hyperbolic cognitive map, improving both memory capacity and decoding accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架解释海马体神经种群活动的双曲几何结构如何有益于下游计算。作者构建了统计上诱导双曲几何的调谐曲线，证明现代Hopfield网络更新规则等价于最小均方误差估计器，并引入双曲空间中的联想记忆模型，其容量显著优于现有模型。结果表明动物将空间信息编码为潜在双曲认知图，可提升记忆容量和解码精度。
Motivation: 近期神经生物学实证发现海马体种群活动呈现双曲结构，但缺乏理论解释其计算优势。
Method: 提出海马体调谐曲线的构造方案以统计诱导双曲几何；建立神经解码与联想记忆的联系，证明现代Hopfield网络更新规则实现MMSE估计；在双曲空间中定义新的联想记忆模型。
Result: 双曲联想记忆模型容量显著大于现有领先模型，同时提升解码精度。
Conclusion: 动物编码空间信息时可能使用潜在双曲认知图，从而同时改善记忆容量和解码准确性。

papers.title: Minimalist Genetic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Genetic programming (GP) is based on two important insights. First, that any learning task can fundamentally be posed as a program induction problem, where the goal is to construct a symbolic hierarchical model that is expressed as a syntax tree. Second, to pose this task as a search problem, and use evolution to locate the desired model. Since it was proposed, GP has produced notable results in a wide range of tasks and problem domains. This work presents an alternative view by modifying the second core insight of GP, posing the problem as a syntactic derivation task instead. In particular, this paper presents Minimalist Genetic Programming (MGP), an algorithm that like GP is biologically inspired, but instead of evolution it takes inspiration from the Minimalist Program to human language, in which syntax is understood as an optimal solution to the problem of linking two other mental systems. In minimalism, the core computational process is a binary set formation operator called $MERGE$, than can be used to incrementally construct complex syntactic structures using a simple Markovian process. MGP is able to discover the core building blocks of the symbolic expressions, and to incrementally combined them using $MERGE$. The proposed system is benchmarked on symbolic regression tasks that are known to be difficult to solve with standard GP systems because of the propensity for bloat. Results show that when a proper lexicon of atomic syntactic objects are chosen, MGP is able to consistently produce the exact ground truth model on a set of symbolic regression where standard GP struggles to do the same. The insights provided by minimalism are shown to be relevant to the problem of program induction, and should be explored further based on the potential exhibited by MGP in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出最小化遗传编程 (Minimalist Genetic Programming, MGP)，它借鉴语言学中的最简方案思想，用二元合并操作 MERGE 替代传统进化搜索，将程序归纳视为句法推导任务。在易产生膨胀的符号回归基准上，MGP 在给定合适原子词表时能稳定生成精确的真实模型，而标准 GP 难以做到。
Motivation: 标准遗传编程在处理符号回归时容易产生代码膨胀，限制了其发现精确模型的能力。作者希望引入语言学中的最简方案来改进程序归纳的搜索策略。
Method: 提出 MGP 算法，使用类马尔可夫过程的二进制集合形成操作 MERGE 逐步构建符号表达式，而非通过进化搜索。算法从原子句法元素出发，增量组合生成程序语法树。
Result: 在多个已知对标准 GP 困难的符号回归任务上，MGP 在选取合适原子词表时，能一致地找到精确的真实模型，而标准 GP 无法做到同等表现。
Conclusion: MGP 展示了最简方案对程序归纳问题的启示，表明基于句法推导的生成路径具有潜力，值得进一步探索。

papers.title: ANCHOR: Autoregressive Non-intrusive Chunk-Ordered Refinement for Joint Multi-Resolution Speech Quality Modeling
papers.abstract_en: While speech quality is typically assessed on complete utterances, streaming and generative systems require incremental estimation from partial audio. Existing predictors assume full context, degrading on prefix-constrained inputs. Extending ARECHO, we propose ANCHOR, reformulating incremental assessment as a multi-resolution autoregressive task. It models chunk- and utterance-level quality within a single decoder using dual-resolution tokens and a resolution-aware hierarchy for coarse-to-fine refinement. Experiments show substantial robustness under partial input, including a 48% PLCMOS error reduction on 2-second prefixes. Convergence analysis reveals a 4-6 s effective perceptual context horizon. A stress test further isolates structured extrapolation biases under localized corruption. Results demonstrate that hierarchical supervision improves incremental prediction and elucidates how perceptual quality accumulates over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ANCHOR，将增量语音质量评估重新表述为多分辨率自回归任务，使用双分辨率令牌和分辨率感知层次结构进行粗到细的细化。实验表明在部分输入下鲁棒性提升，包括2秒前缀上PLCMOS误差降低48%，收敛分析显示有效感知上下文范围为4-6秒。
Motivation: 现有语音质量评估通常假设完整话语，不适用于流式和生成式系统的增量估计，部分输入下性能下降。
Method: 在ARECHO基础上扩展，提出ANCHOR，将增量评估建模为多分辨率自回归任务，在单一解码器中建模块级和话语级质量，使用双分辨率令牌和分辨率感知层次结构进行粗到细的细化。
Result: 在部分输入下显著鲁棒，包括2秒前缀上PLCMOS误差降低48%；收敛分析显示有效感知上下文范围为4-6秒；压力测试揭示了局部损坏下的结构化外推偏差。
Conclusion: 层次化监督改进了增量预测，并阐明了感知质量随时间累积的方式。

papers.title: What Demonstration Curation Metrics Do to Your Policy
papers.abstract_en: We study whether demonstration-curation metrics that detect defective training episodes also improve the downstream behavior-cloning policy that trains on the curated data. On a contact-rich LIBERO pick-and-place benchmark with a controlled structural defect (early gripper release during the carry phase), we find that the two quantities are sharply decoupled. The metric with the highest defect-detection AUROC (0.804) produces the worst curated policy (13.3% task success), while a metric with a substantially lower AUROC (0.638) produces a policy that nearly matches the oracle trained on ground-truth clean data (90.0% vs. 93.3%). We further show that five of the seven metrics we evaluate exploit episode length as a trivial proxy for the defect label, a confound that inflates reported AUROCs to near-perfect values and disappears once episode length is controlled. Across all conditions, the contaminated baseline succeeds on only 3.3% of rollouts, and the two best curation methods close this to within 3 percentage points of the 93.3% oracle ceiling. Our results argue that curation methods should be evaluated by the policy they produce, not the defects they flag, and that any curation benchmark must control for episode length before reporting detection accuracy. We release the testbed, all metric implementations, and the evaluation pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LIBERO 拾放基准上引入早期释放夹爪的结构缺陷，研究七种演示筛选指标检测缺陷的能力与最终行为克隆策略性能之间的关系。发现指标 defect-detection AUROC 最高（0.804）反而产生最差策略（13.3% 成功率），而 AUROC 较低（0.638）的指标产生几乎与 oracle 相当的策略（90.0% vs 93.3%）。多数指标利用 episode length 作为缺陷的混淆代理，控制长度后 AUROC 急剧下降。最佳筛选方法将成功率从 3.3% 提升至 90% 以上，接近 oracle 的 93.3%。
Motivation: 现有演示筛选指标通常根据检测缺陷演示的能力来评估，但不确定这些指标是否真正改善了后续的行为克隆策略。
Method: 在接触丰富的 LIBERO 基准上，人为注入早期释放夹爪的结构缺陷，使用七种不同指标（基于特征、动作差异等）筛选演示数据，训练行为克隆策略，并对比策略成功率和指标的 defect-detection AUROC。
Result: AUROC 最高（0.804）的指标产生最差策略（13.3%），而 AUROC 较低（0.638）的指标产生接近 oracle 的策略（90.0%）。五分之一指标利用 episode length 作为代理缺陷标签，控制长度后 AUROC 大幅下降。污染基线成功率仅 3.3%，两种最佳筛选方法将成功率提升至 90.0%，接近 oracle 的 93.3%。
Conclusion: 演示筛选方法应根据其产生的策略性能来评估，而非仅依据缺陷检测准确率；任何筛选基准必须在报告检测准确率之前控制 episode length 等混淆因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHAPO: Sharpness-Aware Policy Optimization for Safe Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Safe exploration is a prerequisite for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in safety-critical domains. In this paper, we approach safe exploration through the lens of epistemic uncertainty, where the actor's sensitivity to parameter perturbations serves as a practical proxy for regions of high uncertainty. We propose Sharpness-Aware Policy Optimization (SHAPO), a sharpness-aware policy update rule that evaluates gradients at perturbed parameters, making policy updates pessimistic with respect to the actor's epistemic uncertainty. Analytically we show that this adjustment implicitly reweighs policy gradients, amplifying the influence of rare unsafe actions while tempering contributions from already safe ones, thereby biasing learning toward conservative behavior in under-explored regions. Across several continuous-control tasks, our method consistently improves both safety and task performance over existing baselines, significantly expanding their Pareto frontiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHAPO是一种针对安全探索的强化学习算法，通过在扰动参数上计算梯度来隐式地加权策略梯度，放大罕见危险动作的影响并抑制安全动作，从而在欠探索区域产生保守行为。在多个连续控制任务中，SHAPO在安全性和任务性能上均优于现有基线，显著扩展了Pareto前沿。
Motivation: 在安全关键领域部署强化学习代理时，安全探索是前提条件。现有方法对高不确定性区域的探索不够谨慎，可能导致危险行为。
Method: 提出锐度感知策略优化（SHAPO），通过在扰动参数上评估梯度，使策略更新对代理的认知不确定性持悲观态度。分析表明，这种调整隐式地重新加权策略梯度，放大罕见不安全动作的影响，减弱已安全动作的贡献，从而在欠探索区域偏向保守行为。
Result: 在多个连续控制任务中，SHAPO一致地改进了安全性和任务性能，显著扩展了现有基线的Pareto前沿。
Conclusion: SHAPO通过锐度感知更新规则有效处理安全探索中的认知不确定性，为安全RL提供了一种实用方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Transformer for 3D Neighborhood Interaction and Quality Prediction in Metal Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Metal additive manufacturing enables the fabrication of complex parts, but achieving consistent build quality remains challenging due to interactions induced by repeated layer-wise melting, solidification, and reheating across the 3D build. Advanced sensing provide a great opportunity to collect rich observations of the actual manufacturing process for real-time quality monitoring and control. Yet, existing methods often have limited ability to represent multi-layer interactions and quantify their contributions to quality. In this paper, we develop a novel spatiotemporal graph transformer for modeling 3D neighborhood interactions and learn their effects on build quality in metal additive manufacturing. Specifically, we first introduce a weighted network representation of the manufacturing process, where fusing locations are modeled as nodes, and their spatial- and process-dependent relationships are encoded as edge weights. This representation also enables the integration of multimodal data (e.g., geometric design, process settings, and in-situ sensing data) into a unified structure for downstream learning tasks. Building on this network, we further design a dual-attention graph transformer that captures both within-node feature dependencies and cross-node neighborhood interactions for quality representation learning. Experimental results show that the proposed framework significantly outperforms image-based, sequence-based, and graph-based models in characterizing process-quality relationships. More importantly, the incorporation of cross-layer interactions is critical for improving quality prediction performance. This framework is broadly applicable to other tasks involving network modeling and graph-based representation learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金属增材制造中因逐层熔化、凝固和再加热引起的3D邻域交互难以建模的问题，提出了一种时空图Transformer（Spatiotemporal Graph Transformer）。该方法首先构建加权网络表示制造过程，将熔融位置建模为节点，空间和过程依赖关系编码为边权重，并集成多模态数据；然后设计双注意力图变压器，捕获节点内特征依赖和节点间邻域交互。实验结果表明，该框架在刻画工艺-质量关系上显著优于基于图像、序列和图的方法，且跨层交互的引入对提升质量预测性能至关重要。
Motivation: 现有方法难以表示多层交互及其对质量的贡献，限制了金属增材制造中实时质量监测和控制的能力。
Method: 提出加权网络表示制造过程，以节点表示熔融位置，边权重编码空间和过程依赖关系，并集成几何设计、工艺参数和原位传感等多模态数据；在此基础上设计双注意力图Transformer，同时捕获节点内特征依赖和节点间邻域交互。
Result: 实验表明，所提框架在表征工艺-质量关系上显著优于图像、序列和图模型，且跨层交互的引入是提升质量预测性能的关键。
Conclusion: 该框架广泛适用于涉及网络建模和图表示学习的其他任务。

papers.title: Dual-Branch Gated Fusion for Open-Set Audio Deepfake Source Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Attributing a synthetic utterance to its originating system remains an open challenge: closed-set models fail to reject unseen synthesizers and produce overconfident predictions. To address this, we propose a dual-branch gated fusion framework that pairs XLSR-53 with CORES, a 66-dimensional descriptor that, unlike prior Linear Filter Bank (LFB)-only work, spans cepstral, oscillatory, rhythmic, energy, and spectral dimensions to capture complementary synthesis artifacts. Our analysis shows XLSR-53 remains discriminative in-domain (ID) while CORES generalizes stably under distribution shift (OOD), yet their naive concatenation fails due to SSL representational imbalance. To resolve this, an input-conditioned gate adaptively weights each branch under joint training with cross-entropy, an energy margin loss for ID/OOD separation, and a gate diversity term. On the MLAAD benchmark, our system achieves 97.6\% ID accuracy, 4.9\% EERc, and an 83.5\% relative FPR95 reduction over the Interspeech 2025 baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放场景下的音频深度伪造溯源问题，提出双分支门控融合框架，结合XLSR-53和CORES描述符，并通过输入条件门控自适应加权。在MLAAD基准上，该方法取得了97.6%的域内准确率、4.9%的EERc，并将FPR95相对降低83.5%。
Motivation: 现有闭集模型无法拒绝未见合成器，且会产生过度自信预测，限制了实际应用中的可靠性。
Method: 提出双分支门控融合框架，一个分支使用XLSR-53，另一个使用66维CORES描述符（涵盖倒谱、振荡、节奏、能量和频谱维度）。通过输入条件门控自适应加权两分支，联合训练使用交叉熵、能量边界损失（用于域内/域外分离）和门控多样性项。
Result: 在MLAAD基准上，域内准确率97.6%，EERc为4.9%，相对FPR95较Interspeech 2025基线降低83.5%。
Conclusion: 实验表明，所提框架通过自适应融合互补表示，有效提升了开放场景下音频深度伪造溯源的性能。

papers.title: Fast Exact Nearest-Neighbor Learning for High-Frequency Financial Time Series
papers.abstract_en: AI efficiency at scale is becoming critical in finance as market data volumes surge across equities, ETFs, FX, options, and high-frequency trading streams. This growth creates a core challenge for mature financial AI systems: models must learn from larger historical corpora while still meeting real-time latency constraints in trading, risk management, and derivative pricing. We use exact nearest-neighbor learning for high-frequency financial time series as a concrete case study to show that Mojo-based financial AI can address this challenge. We introduce a Mojo SIMD k-d tree with variance-based splitting, contiguous flat-buffer storage, and compile-time vectorized distance computation. We also provide a runtime result showing that, under standard pruning and implementation-cost assumptions, the Mojo SIMD k-d tree asymptotically dominates Mojo SIMD brute force and scikit-learn's k-d tree in the fixed-stock, large-$n$, moderate-dimensional regime. Empirically, across eight financial datasets on x86 and ARM64 with up to 277K training samples, the method achieves 17.5--21.6$\times$ speedup over scikit-learn's k-d tree on x86 and 28.1--43.5$\times$ over scikit-learn brute force on ARM64 equity/ETF datasets, while preserving exact outputs. Beyond nearest-neighbor inference, Mojo's compiled execution enables an Extra Trees-based implied-volatility pricing model to train on $10\times$ more options data, reducing put-IV RMSE by 8.0\%. These results position Mojo as a scalable, production-ready stack for financial AI and a promising foundation for efficient AI in other data-intensive fields. \keywords{Financial AI \and AI Efficiency \and Mojo \and SIMD \and K-D Trees \and KNN \and High-Frequency Trading \and Financial Time Series \and Scaling}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高频金融时间序列的实时学习需求，提出基于Mojo SIMD的k-d树精确最近邻方法。利用方差分裂、连续扁平缓冲区存储和编译期向量化距离计算，在x86和ARM64上对最多277K样本的八个金融数据集实现17.5–43.5倍加速，并保持精确输出。该方法还使基于Extra Trees的隐含波动率定价模型训练数据量扩大10倍，RMSE降低8.0%。
Motivation: 金融市场数据量激增，成熟AI系统需从更大历史语料学习同时满足实时延迟约束，现有k-d树实现（如scikit-learn）在高频场景下效率不足。
Method: 引入Mojo编程语言实现的SIMD k-d树，使用方差基分裂策略、连续扁平缓冲区存储和编译期向量化距离计算，结合标准剪枝与实现成本假设进行分析。
Result: 在八个金融数据集上，x86平台相比scikit-learn k-d树加速17.5–21.6倍，ARM64上相比scikit-learn暴力搜索加速28.1–43.5倍；Extra Trees模型训练数据量扩展10倍，put-IV RMSE降低8.0%。
Conclusion: Mojo SIMD k-d树在固定股票、大样本、中等维度下渐进主导暴力搜索和scikit-learn的k-d树，Mojo可作为金融AI及其他数据密集型领域的高效生产级框架。

papers.title: Alignment Defends LLMs from Property Inference Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly fine-tuned on domain-specific datasets that may contain sensitive, dataset-level properties. Recent work has shown that such dataset-level information can be effectively extracted through property inference attacks, posing a confidentiality risk. Existing defenses against these attacks primarily operate by modifying the training data distribution and hence require access to the original data and retraining the model, limiting their applicability to settings where data is unavailable or models are already deployed. In this work, we propose alignment-based defenses for mitigating property inference attacks in LLMs. Our approach reshapes the model's output distribution towards a target property ratio via post-training alignment, without modifying the training data. In particular, we adapt two widely used RLHF frameworks--Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)--as our defenses by constructing preference pairs and defining a specific reward function respectively. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our alignment based defenses effectively mitigate property inference attacks while maintaining a strong utility confidentiality tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在微调过程中可能泄露数据集级别属性的问题，提出基于对齐的防御方法，通过后训练对齐重塑模型输出分布，无需访问原始数据或重新训练模型。具体改编了直接偏好优化（DPO）和组相对策略优化（GRPO）两种RLHF框架，构造偏好对或定义奖励函数来防御属性推断攻击。实验表明该方法能有效缓解攻击并保持较好的效用-机密性权衡。
Motivation: 现有的属性推断攻击可以从微调后的LLM中提取数据集级别的敏感属性，而现有防御方法需要修改训练数据分布并重新训练模型，限制了在数据不可用或模型已部署场景下的适用性。
Method: 提出基于对齐的防御，利用DPO和GRPO两种后训练对齐方法，通过构造偏好对或定义特定奖励函数，将模型输出分布重塑为目标属性比例，无需修改训练数据。
Result: 综合实验表明，基于对齐的防御有效缓解了属性推断攻击，同时保持了较强的效用-机密性权衡。
Conclusion: 后训练对齐是一种无需访问原始数据或重新训练即可防御属性推断攻击的可行方案，为已部署模型的隐私保护提供了新途径。

papers.title: A Source Domain is All You Need: Source-Only Cross-OS Transfer Learning for APT Anomaly Detection via Semantic Alignment and Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are stealthy, multi-stage cyberattacks whose detection is difficult due to scarce labeled traces, severe class imbalance, and the challenge of generating realistic malicious behavior. These challenges are amplified in cross-operating-system (cross-OS) settings, where a detector trained on one source platform must be deployed on an unlabeled target platform without access to target-domain labels. We study this source-only cross-OS APT detection problem using system-level provenance traces and propose a transport-based framework for ranking anomalous target processes under zero target supervision. The framework abstracts process behavior into structured natural-language descriptions, embeds them using pretrained language models, and constructs a source-normal reference for target scoring. It combines three evidence channels: semantic deviation from source-normal prototypes, structural deviation captured by graph autoencoding, and geometric deviation measured through Optimal Transport (OT). The main contribution is an OT-based barycentric anomaly score that projects target embeddings onto the source-normal manifold and quantifies residual transport mismatch. We further introduce entropy-weighted, angle-aware, and density-aware OT variants to capture uncertainty, directional drift, and sparse-support behavior. Evaluation on DARPA Transparent Computing data spanning Linux, Windows, BSD, and Android, across two APT scenarios and twelve cross-OS transfer pairs, shows that the proposed framework improves ROC-AUC and nDCG over source-only anomaly-detection baselines. The results demonstrate that source-only provenance modeling, combined with semantic abstraction and OT-based anomaly scoring, can support practical cross-platform APT detection without target-domain supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无目标标签的跨操作系统APT异常检测问题，提出一种基于最优传输的源域异常评分框架。框架将进程行为抽象为结构化自然语言描述，利用预训练语言模型嵌入，并结合语义偏差、结构偏差（图自编码器）和几何偏差（最优传输）三个证据通道。主要贡献是一种最优传输重心异常分数，将目标嵌入投影到源正常流形并量化残余传输不匹配。在DARPA Transparent Computing数据集上（涵盖Linux、Windows、BSD和Android），两个APT场景和12个跨系统迁移对上的实验表明，该方法在ROC-AUC和nDCG上优于仅源域的异常检测基线。
Motivation: APT检测面临标签稀缺、类别不平衡和跨系统部署的挑战，现有方法通常需要目标域标签或访问目标数据，而实际场景中目标域完全无标签，导致跨系统AP检测困难。
Method: 提出一个无需目标标签的传输框架：将系统溯源进程行为转化为文本描述并嵌入，构建源正常参考分布；结合语义偏差（嵌入余弦距离）、结构偏差（图自编码器重构误差）和几何偏差（最优传输距离），其中核心是用最优传输重心分数衡量目标样本与源正常流形的匹配残差，并引入熵加权、角度感知和密度感知变体。
Result: 在DARPA Transparent Computing数据上的两个APT场景和12个跨系统迁移对实验中，所提框架在ROC-AUC和nDCG上均优于仅源域的异常检测基线。
Conclusion: 结论表明，仅利用源域溯源建模，结合语义抽象和最优传输异常评分，可以在无需目标域监督的情况下支持实用的跨平台APT检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Pronunciation Evaluation for Korean Toddler Speech using Speech Diarization and Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Speech sound disorders affect approximately 44% of Korean pediatric communication disorder cases, yet automated assessment tools for Korean toddler speech remain underdeveloped. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for automated pronunciation evaluation of Korean toddler speech, combining neural speaker diarization with self-supervised speech representation learning. We introduce a novel IRB-approved corpus of 53 recordings from Korean-speaking children aged 2-5 years. A subset of 53 subjects was annotated by three independent reviewers, yielding 1,190 consonant and 748 vowel word-level binary correctness labels. We evaluate three diarization models, finding that NeMo SortFormer achieves 88.69% speaker count accuracy and 33.04% diarization error rate (DER) owing to its arrival-time-sorted transformer architecture, which handles the acoustic confound between young female caregivers exhibiting aegyo and toddler speech. For pronunciation scoring, we compare three self-supervised learning (SSL) backbones across multiple pooling strategies. A cross-model ensemble routing consonant prediction to HuBERT-large and vowel prediction to WavLM-large achieves balanced accuracies of 0.720 and 0.845, with a mean of 0.782.

papers.title: Intrinsic Footpoint-invariant Riemannian Cross-covariance
papers.abstract_en: Covariance estimation yields a fundamental second-order statistic underlying representation learning, dimension reduction, and dependence modeling. While covariance has been well understood in Euclidean spaces, it is ill-defined for random objects residing on nonlinear Riemannian manifolds, which increasingly arise in modern machine learning applications involving shapes, symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices, etc. This paper introduces an intrinsic Riemannian cross-covariance for manifold-valued random objects. Our approach defines covariance and correlation by transporting local variations to a common tangent space via parallel transport, yielding a second-order descriptor that is independent of arbitrary coordinate choices. We establish that the proposed covariance inherits desirable properties of its Euclidean counterparts and characterize its asymptotic behavior. Numerical studies on spheres and SPD manifolds, together with real-data experiments on heart valve shapes in Kendall's shape space, demonstrate the effectiveness of our estimators and verify the stated properties. Our results position the Riemannian covariance as a fundamental tool for second-order learning and analysis in non-Euclidean representation spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种内在的黎曼交叉协方差（Riemannian cross-covariance）估计方法，用于非线性黎曼流形上的随机对象。通过平行传输将局部变差映射到公共切空间，得到了与坐标选择无关的二阶描述子。理论证明了其欧几里得协方差类似的性质，并在球面、SPD流形以及Kendall形状空间的心脏瓣膜形状数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 欧几里得空间中的协方差估计在非线性黎曼流形上不适用，而流形值数据（如形状、SPD矩阵）在现代机器学习中日益常见，需要内蕴的二阶统计量。
Method: 通过平行传输（parallel transport）将流形上的局部变差移至公共切空间，定义内蕴的黎曼交叉协方差和相关性，使其不依赖任意坐标选择。
Result: 在球面和SPD流形上的数值实验以及Kendall形状空间的心脏瓣膜形状数据上验证了估计量的有效性，证明了所提协方差继承了欧几里得协方差的理想性质并刻画了渐近行为。
Conclusion: 该黎曼协方差可作为非欧几里得表示空间中二阶学习和分析的基础工具，但目前仅针对流形值随机对象，未涉及时间序列或外部协变量。

papers.title: Less Context, Better Agents: Efficient Context Engineering for Long-Horizon Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models deployed as autonomous agents for enterprise workflows face a key challenge: verbose tool responses from enterprise systems can cause context overflow, stale-state errors, and high inference cost. We study this problem in automated expense itemization in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations using Model Context Protocol tools. We evaluate four GPT-5 configurations on a 50-task hotel expense benchmark: no user model, full conversation history, context pruned to the last 5 tool call/response pairs, and pruning with automated summarization. Results are averaged across 5 independent runs, with the user model held constant for the context-engineering comparison. The no-user-model baseline achieves only 8.0% complete itemization. Full-context retention improves completion to 71.0%, but consumes 1,480,996 tokens and 14.56 hours per benchmark. Pruning to the last 5 tool calls improves completion to 79.0% while reducing token use to 535,274 and runtime to 5.39 hours. Adding summarization achieves the best result: 91.6% complete itemization and 99.64% average amount itemized, with 553,374 tokens and 5.79 hours. We further report confidence intervals, effect-size analysis, sensitivity over pruning and summary windows, failure analysis, results across five expense types grouped into three categories, and cross-model evidence with Claude Sonnet 4.5. These results show that, for this class of enterprise tool-use workflow, selective retention of recent tool interactions plus compact summarization can improve both reliability and efficiency compared with full-history retention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在企业工作流中使用LLM代理时，冗长的工具响应导致上下文溢出、状态过时和高推理成本的问题。通过在Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations的自动化费用明细任务中，使用Model Context Protocol工具，评估了四种GPT-5配置：无用户模型、完整对话历史、上下文修剪到最后5个工具调用/响应对、以及修剪加自动摘要。实验结果表明，修剪到最近的5个工具调用并将完成率提高到79.0%，而增加摘要后达到最佳效果：91.6%的完整明细化和99.64%的平均明细金额，同时显著降低令牌使用和运行时间。
Motivation: 企业工作流中，LLM代理面临工具响应冗长导致的上下文溢出、状态错误和高推理成本问题，需要有效的上下文工程方法来提高可靠性和效率。
Method: 在50个任务酒店费用基准上，评估四种GPT-5配置：无用户模型、完整对话历史、上下文修剪到最后5个工具调用/响应对、以及修剪加自动摘要。结果在5次独立运行中平均，并进行了置信区间、效应量、修剪和摘要窗口敏感性、失败分析等。
Result: 无用户模型仅完成8.0%的完整明细化；完整上下文保留提升到71.0%，但消耗1,480,996个令牌和14.56小时；修剪到最后5个工具调用将完成率提高到79.0%，令牌使用降至535,274个，运行时间5.39小时；添加摘要达到最佳结果：91.6%完整明细化和99.64%平均明细金额，令牌使用553,374个，时间5.79小时。
Conclusion: 对于此类企业工具使用工作流，选择性保留最近的工具交互加上紧凑的摘要可以比保留完整历史同时提高可靠性和效率。

papers.title: Exploration of Foundation Model-Based Robots in Patient and Elderly Care
papers.abstract_en: Demand for older-adult and patient care is growing rapidly as populations age worldwide. Foundation models are increasingly being integrated into robots and interactive agents, with the promise of more flexible communication and personalized assistance. However, care settings require reliable and workflow-compatible systems with accountable human oversight, and it remains unclear whether current embodied systems can translate technical advances into clinical impact. This Perspective synthesizes foundation model-based care robots across three areas: design features, user experience, and evidence for care-related outcomes. Current systems most commonly use foundation models as conversational and reasoning layers within voice-centered socially assistive embodiments, while multimodal grounding and physical autonomy remain limited. Empirical evaluations report positive usability and engagement benefits, but reliability failures persist across the interaction pipeline such as hallucinations and conversational breakdowns. Evidence for care impact remains concentrated in proximal outcomes such as cognitive engagement and participation, with limited evidence for validated clinical or care-related changes. We argue that future research should transition toward care-specific evaluation standards, accountable autonomy, and integration into care workflows to support more responsive and responsible care technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以综述视角探讨基础模型在患者与老年人护理机器人中的应用，涵盖设计特征、用户体验及护理效果证据。当前系统多将基础模型用于语音社交辅助机器人的对话与推理层，多模态感知与物理自主性仍有限。实证显示可用性与参与度提升，但可靠性问题（幻觉、对话中断）持续存在，且护理影响的证据主要集中在认知参与等近端指标，缺乏临床验证的变化。
Motivation: 全球老龄化加剧对老年人及患者护理的需求，基础模型有望提供更灵活的沟通与个性化辅助，但护理场景要求可靠、工作流兼容且有人负责的系统，现有具身系统能否将技术进展转化为临床影响尚不明确。
Method: 本文是Perspective（观点）文章，通过综合现有文献，从设计特征、用户体验和护理效果证据三个维度梳理基于基础模型的护理机器人现状。
Result: 当前系统最常用基础模型作为语音社交辅助机器人的会话与推理层；多模态交互和物理自主性仍有限。实证报告积极可用性与参与度，但可靠性问题（幻觉、对话中断）在交互全链路中存在。护理效果证据集中在认知参与等近端指标，缺乏证实临床或护理层面变化的证据。
Conclusion: 未来研究应转向护理特定的评估标准、可问责的自主性，以及将技术整合到护理工作流中，以支持更响应和负责任的护理技术。

papers.title: An Improved Generative Adversarial Network for Micro-Resistivity Imaging Logging Restoration
papers.abstract_en: An improved GAN-based imaging logging image restoration method is presented in this paper for solving the problem of partially missing micro-resistivity imaging logging images. The method uses FCN as the generative network infrastructure and adds a depth-separable convolutional residual block to learn and retain more effective pixel and semantic information; an Inception module is added to increase the multi-scale perceptual field of the network and reduce the number of parameters in the network; and a multi-scale feature extraction module and a spatial attention residual block are added to combine the channel attention. The multi-scale module adds a multi-scale feature extraction module and a spatial attention residual block, which combine the channel attention mechanism and the residual block to achieve multi-scale feature extraction. The global discriminative network and the local discriminative network are designed to gradually improve the content and semantic structure coherence between the restored parts and the whole image by playing off each other and the generative network. According to the experimental results, the average structural similarity measure of the five sets of imaged logging images with different sizes of missing regions in the test set is 0.903, which is an improvement of about 0.3 compared with other similar methods. It is shown that the method in this study can be used for the restoration of micro-resistivity imaging log images with good improvement in semantic structural coherence and texture details, thus providing a new deep learning method to ensure the smooth advancement of the subsequent interpretation of micro-resistivity imaging log images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的生成对抗网络 (GAN) 用于微电阻率成像测井图像恢复，解决部分缺失问题。生成网络基于全卷积网络 (FCN)，集成深度可分离卷积残差块、Inception 模块、多尺度特征提取模块和空间注意力机制。全局和局部判别网络协同训练以保持语义结构一致性。实验表明，该方法在测试集上平均结构相似性 (SSIM) 达 0.903，较同类方法提升约 0.3。
Motivation: 微电阻率成像测井图像常因传感器故障或井壁条件而部分缺失，影响后续解释。现有图像恢复方法在语义结构和纹理细节上表现不足。
Method: 采用改进的 GAN 框架：生成网络以 FCN 为骨干，添加深度可分离卷积残差块保留像素与语义信息，Inception 模块增加多尺度感受野并减少参数量，多尺度特征提取模块与空间注意力残差块结合通道注意力实现多尺度特征提取；判别网络分为全局和局部两个分支，与生成网络对抗训练逐步提升恢复部分的语义结构一致性。
Result: 在测试集上对五种不同缺失大小的测井图像进行测试，平均结构相似性 (SSIM) 达到 0.903，较其他类似方法提升约 0.3。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效恢复微电阻率成像测井图像，显著改善语义结构连贯性和纹理细节，为后续测井图像解释提供了新深度学习方法。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法能有效恢复微电阻率成像测井图像，显著改善语义结构连贯性和纹理细节，为后续测井图像解释提供了新深度学习方法。

papers.title: A Continuous-Time Markov Chain Framework for Insertion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Insertion Language Models (ILMs) offer several advantages over left-to-right generation and mask-based generation. However, existing formulations of insertion-based generation have largely been ad-hoc. In this paper, we derive a diffusion-style denoising objective for ILMs from first principles by formulating the noising process as a continuous-time Markov chain on the space of variable-length sequences. We show that previous formulations of ILMs can be viewed as special cases of this denoising framework. Through empirical evaluation on a synthetic planning task, we show that the proposed approach retains the benefits of insertion-based generation over left-to-right generation and masked diffusion models. In language modeling, our diffusion-based approach is competitive with left-to-right generation and masked diffusion models, while offering additional flexibility in sampling compared to existing insertion language models.
papers.comment: Accepted at AISTATS 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/dhruvdcoder/ctmc_dilm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了一种基于连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）的插入语言模型（ILM）去噪目标，将插入生成形式化为可变长序列空间上的扩散过程。实验表明，该方法在合成规划任务上优于自左向右生成和掩码扩散模型，在语言建模中与现有方法竞争力相当，并提供了更灵活的采样方式。
Motivation: 现有的插入语言模型（ILM）框架多为启发式设计，缺乏统一的数学基础。本文旨在从第一性原理出发，为ILM建立严格的扩散式去噪框架。
Method: 将噪声过程定义为可变长序列空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），并推导出对应的去噪目标。该框架统一了先前ILM的多种形式。
Result: 在合成规划任务上，所提方法在性能上优于自左向右生成和掩码扩散模型；在语言建模任务上，与自左向右生成和掩码扩散模型相当，且比现有ILM具有更高的采样灵活性。
Conclusion: 该CTMC框架为插入语言模型提供了理论严谨的扩散式公式化，并展示了在规划任务中的优势，但语言建模上的性能尚未超越其他范式。

papers.title: Integral Field Unit Spectroscopy with One Fiber
papers.abstract_en: Integral field unit (IFU) spectroscopy provides spatially resolved spectra across galaxies, offering crucial insights into their evolution. However, its high observational cost limits current IFU datasets to $\sim 10^4$ objects. We present a multi-modal, probabilistic foundation model that predicts high-resolution spectra with calibrated uncertainties at arbitrary spatial locations within a galaxy directly from broadband images. Built on a masked autoencoder framework, our architecture injects fiber positional encodings and redshift aware wavelength encodings, enabling spatially conditioned predictions. Trained on 4.7 million images and single fiber spectroscopic observations from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) survey, our model exploits the natural variance of fiber placements and the morphological self-similarity of galaxies to achieve IFU-like capabilities without any IFU training data. Predicted emission line flux maps match independent IFU observations from the Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO (MaNGA) survey, with performance comparable to a supervised baseline trained directly on IFU data.
papers.comment: Accepted for Conference on Physics and AI at Stanford University (PAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态概率基础模型，直接从宽带图像预测星系内任意空间位置的高分辨率光谱，实现积分场单元光谱仪（IFU）的功能，且无需IFU训练数据。模型基于掩蔽自编码器框架，注入纤维位置编码和红移感知波长编码，在DESI巡天的470万图像和单纤维光谱观测上训练，预测的发射线流量图与MaNGA巡天的独立IFU观测结果相当，性能接近直接在IFU数据上训练的监督基线。
Motivation: IFU光谱观测成本高，现有IFU数据集仅包含约10^4个天体，限制了星系演化的研究。需要一种方法从低成本数据（宽带图像和单纤维光谱）中获得高空间分辨率的光谱信息。
Method: 构建基于掩蔽自编码器的多模态概率基础模型，输入宽带图像和红移，输出任意空间位置的光谱预测。模型使用纤维位置编码和红移感知波长编码进行空间条件预测，在DESI巡天的470万图像和单纤维光谱上训练，利用纤维放置的自然变化和星系形态自相似性实现IFU级能力。
Result: 预测的发射线流量图与MaNGA巡天的独立IFU观测结果一致，性能与直接在IFU数据上训练的监督基线相当。
Conclusion: 该模型能够从廉价观测（宽带图像和单纤维光谱）中合成IFU级光谱，有望大幅扩展可进行空间分辨光谱研究的星系样本。

papers.title: Fisher-Guided Progressive Parameter Selection for Adaptive Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to adapt pretrained models with a small trainable parameter subset, however, most existing methods choose this subset from fixed architectural heuristics rather than using dynamic, task-aware criteria. We introduce \textbf{FisherAdapTune}, a Fisher-guided Adaptive Fine-Tuning framework that progressively selects parameter groups by tracking the temporal drift of their Fisher geometry. Starting from a PAC-Bayesian view of fine-tuning, we decompose the generalization error bound into Fisher-weighted update costs and show that parameter groups whose curvature contribution has stabilized can be frozen to reduce the error bound without interrupting the remaining adaptation dynamics. FisherAdapTune formulates this criterion with a scale-invariant Jensen-Shannon distance between consecutive Fisher distributions, yielding an adaptive active parameter set. We evaluate our approach on a downstream segmentation task, and results show FisherAdapTune improves the in-distribution performance and zero-shot transfer in multiple settings, validating that Fisher structural drift is a useful signal for efficient, task-aware adaptation. We release our \href{https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/FisherAdapTune}{code} publicly to enable further application of our proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FisherAdapTune，一种基于 Fisher 结构漂移的自适应参数高效微调框架，通过渐进式冻结参数组来降低泛化误差界，并在下游分割任务上验证了分布内和零样本迁移性能的提升。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 方法通常依赖固定架构启发式选择参数子集，缺乏动态且任务感知的标准，导致次优的适应效率。
Method: 从 PAC-Bayesian 视角出发，利用 Fisher 信息的几何漂移（Jensen-Shannon 距离）作为准则，逐步冻结 Fisher 曲率贡献稳定的参数组，从而自适应地确定活跃参数集。
Result: 在下游分割任务上，FisherAdapTune 在分布内性能和零样本迁移方面均优于基线，验证了 Fisher 结构漂移作为高效自适应信号的有效性。
Conclusion: Fisher 几何的时序变化是指导参数有效选择的有用信号，能够实现更高效的微调。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MMClima: A Framework for Multimodal Climate Science Data and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Climate change research increasingly requires AI systems that reason across text, dynamic visual content, and scientific figures, yet existing climate QA benchmarks are small, mostly textual, and cover a narrow range of models. We introduce MMClima, a large-scale multimodal climate question answering framework with 104k+ expert-validated question-answer pairs spanning articles, video transcriptions, and figures across five core climate science domains. MMClima is constructed via automated claim extraction and QA synthesis with human-in-the-loop validation to ensure both scale and reliability. Using MMClima, we benchmark state-of-the-art multimodal language models on tasks requiring factual recall, visual interpretation, and cross-modal synthesis. We additionally fine-tune on the textual split to produce mmclima-70b-txt, a domain-adapted baseline that outperforms strong open- and closed-source models on textual QA. We release the dataset, evaluation pipeline, fine-tuned model weights, and data creation framework to support standardized multimodal evaluation for climate science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMClima是一个大规模多模态气候科学问答框架，包含超过10万专家验证的问答对，覆盖文章、视频转录和图表，跨越五个核心气候科学领域。该框架通过自动声明提取和QA合成构建，并经过人工验证。作者使用MMClima评估了最先进的多模态语言模型，并微调了文本分支得到mmclima-70b-txt模型，在文本QA上表现优异。数据集、评估流程和模型权重已开源。
Motivation: 现有气候问答基准规模小、以文本为主，覆盖模型范围窄，无法支持需要跨文本、动态视觉内容和科学图表推理的AI系统。
Method: 提出MMClima框架，采用自动化声明提取和QA合成结合人工验证的方式，构建包含文本、视频转录和图表的多模态气候QA数据集，并基于此微调得到mmclima-70b-txt模型。
Result: mmclima-70b-txt在文本QA上优于多个强开源和闭源模型。
Conclusion: MMClima为气候科学提供了标准化的多模态评估资源，但论文摘要未涉及具体降水预报或资料同化任务。

papers.title: Decision-Calibrated Conformal Uncertainty for Pacing Decisions in Streaming Advertising
papers.abstract_en: We develop a decision-calibrated conformal framework for pacing decisions in streaming advertising. Pacing depends on uncertain future inventory, demand pressure, incremental response, and member-experience load. Instead of calibrating a generic forecast residual, the framework measures forecast error by its largest impact on the policies that could actually be deployed. The main theorem shows that the proposed score is the smallest valid uncertainty measure that uniformly protects all deployable pacing policies. Geometrically, it is the support function of the signed policy sensitivity set. Split conformal calibration gives finite-sample coverage for this score. A high-dimensional separation theorem shows that traditional residual calibration can be arbitrarily more conservative by paying for nuisance inventory dimensions, and a robust pacing result combines inventory, response, and experience uncertainty. On public-data-calibrated pacing replays built from Criteo Uplift and KuaiRand datasets, traditional conformal pacing remains unresolved with high residual radii of 7236.7 on Criteo and 4629.4 on KuaiRand. With the proposed decision calibration approach, the uncertainty radii are reduced to 18.4 and 278.6 respectively, with separate margins for value, delivery, budget, and member load. On Criteo, the proposed method certifies a less aggressive pacing policy than the point-forecast baseline, and reduces held-out any-violation rate from 16.7% to 3.3%, with zero budget and member-load violations. On KuaiRand, the choice remains unresolved. In a nutshell, the paper establishes that forecasts, response estimates, and member-experience models should be judged by whether they shrink the uncertainty that the pacing decision uses, as this leads to confident decisions that are not overly conservative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出决策校准的分位不确定度框架用于流媒体广告中的节奏控制，该框架通过测量预测误差对实际投放策略的最大影响来校准不确定度，而非传统的残差校准。理论证明该分数是有效保护所有可部署节奏策略的最小不确定度量，并给出有限样本覆盖保证。在Criteo和KuaiRand数据集上的实验表明，传统分位方法的不确定度半径高达7236.7和4629.4，而所提方法降至18.4和278.6，同时在Criteo上将违反率从16.7%降至3.3%。
Motivation: 广告节奏控制依赖对未来库存、需求压力等不确定因素的预测，传统残差校准方法未考虑决策影响，导致不确定度量过于保守或无效。
Method: 提出决策校准的分位不确定度框架，定义预测误差对可部署策略的最大影响为分数，通过支撑函数和符号策略敏感性集几何解释，并使用分裂分位校准获得有限样本覆盖。
Result: 在Criteo和KuaiRand数据集上，传统分位方法半径分别为7236.7和4629.4，所提方法降至18.4和278.6；在Criteo上，所提方法将违反率从16.7%降至3.3%，且预算和会员负载违规为零。
Conclusion: 论文主张预测、响应估计和会员体验模型应以是否缩小决策所用的不确定度为评判标准，从而得到自信且不过度保守的决策。
