papers.title: Dropout-GRPO: Variational Stochasticity for Continuous Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) relies on the diversity of $K$ rollouts within each group; otherwise, the group-mean advantage $A^{(k)} = r^{(k)} - μ_r$ collapses to zero. This presents a structural challenge for latent-reasoning models like Coconut, which feed continuous hidden states recurrently in place of discrete chain-of-thought tokens. Because the latent phase is inherently deterministic given the parameters and prompt, multiple rollouts produce identical trajectories, stalling GRPO's progress. Consequently, applying group-relative reinforcement learning to continuous latent reasoning has proven difficult. To address this, we propose sourcing the necessary stochasticity through structured dropout. By applying a single Bernoulli mask held constant across all latent recurrence steps for a given rollout, we generate essential trajectory variance. This shared mask effectively treats each rollout as a posterior sample from a variational distribution over parameters, allowing GRPO to optimize the expected reward of a Bayesian model-average policy. We provide both theoretical justification for this method -- including unbiasedness, variance reduction, and the well-definedness of the latent gradient -- and empirical validation. On GSM8K, dropout-GRPO improves a Coconut baseline from $27.29\%$ to $29.01\%$ pass@1, demonstrating the viability of GRPO learning for latent-reasoning models. Our work positions this as a practical, theoretically grounded approach for post-training latent-reasoning LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对GRPO在多条rollout轨迹完全一致时优势函数失效的问题，提出通过结构化dropout为连续潜在推理引入随机性。具体做法是对每个rollout施加一个在整个潜在循环中恒定的Bernoulli掩码，使得每条轨迹视为参数上的变分后验样本，从而GRPO可以优化贝叶斯集成策略的期望奖励。在GSM8K上，该方法将Coconut基线的pass@1从27.29%提升至29.01%。
Motivation: GRPO依赖组内K条rollout的多样性；但对于Coconut这类连续潜在推理模型，给定参数和提示后潜在阶段是确定性的，多条rollout产生相同轨迹，导致GRPO无法学习。
Method: 提出Dropout-GRPO：对每个rollout在全部潜在递归步骤上施加相同的Bernoulli掩码，生成轨迹方差，使每条rollout相当于从变分分布中对参数采样，从而GRPO可优化贝叶斯模型平均策略的期望奖励。
Result: 在GSM8K上，dropout-GRPO将Coconut基线的pass@1从27.29%提升至29.01%。
Conclusion: 该方法为连续潜在推理模型提供了一种实用且理论可行的GRPO后训练方式，具备无偏性、方差缩减和梯度良定义等理论性质。

papers.title: Making Time Editable in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Modern Diffusion Transformers for video generation provide limited control over the progression of time and the editing of temporal dynamics. We propose a temporal-control methodology that extends a pretrained DiT with explicit time editing, allowing control over motion speed and temporal structure without redesigning the backbone. Its core implementation augments the pretrained model with a lightweight temporal module, preserving the original generative prior while expanding its controllable dynamic range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散Transformer中时间动态控制有限的问题，提出一种时间控制方法，通过在预训练DiT上附加轻量时间模块实现显式时间编辑，无需重新设计主干网络。摘要指出该方法在保持原始生成先验的同时扩展了可控动态范围，但未报告具体实验结果。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散Transformer对时间进程和动态编辑的控制能力不足，限制了运动速度和时序结构的灵活调整。
Method: 提出一种时间控制方法，在预训练的扩散Transformer（DiT）上附加轻量时间模块，实现显式时间编辑，不改变原有主干网络结构。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验指标或性能提升，仅声称方法保持了生成先验并扩展了可控范围。
Conclusion: 该方法为视频生成中的时间控制提供了一种轻量级扩展方案，但缺乏量化验证。

papers.title: Flow Control: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with Simple Real-Time Inputs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce flow control of vision-language-action (VLA) models, a simple and effective way to steer VLA actions in real-time through generic inputs, such as a keyboard. This method can be used out-of-the-box and does not require retraining or fine-tuning VLAs. It enables relatively crude user inputs to steer a VLA to align with user intent. The VLA transforms these inputs into action samples drawn from the VLA expert action distribution learned during training, so that the generated actions are high quality (conformity to the action expert distribution) and high fidelity (reflecting the user's intent). We demonstrate that flow control has many desirable properties: (1) flow control accurately and responsively steers robot actions with user inputs, (2) it is robust to suboptimal user inputs, (3) it enables users to steer VLAs to achieve significantly higher success rates and faster task completion, and (4) fine-tuning a VLA on flow control trajectories improves the autonomous policy. Together, these results provide a simple and intuitive way for users to help steer VLA actions, increasing task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流控制（flow control）方法，通过简单实时输入（如键盘）引导视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的动作，无需重新训练或微调。该方法将用户输入转化为从VLA专家动作分布中采样的动作样本，保证动作高质量且高保真。实验表明流控制能准确响应引导、鲁棒处理次优输入、显著提升任务成功率和完成速度，并且在流控制轨迹上微调VLA可增强自主策略。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型难以在实时任务中灵活融入用户意图，尤其是面对粗糙的用户输入时缺乏有效的干预手段，且现有方法通常需要重新训练或微调，成本高昂。
Method: 提出流控制，通过键盘等通用输入实时引导VLA，利用VLA训练好的专家动作分布将用户输入转化为高质量、高保真的动作样本，无需修改模型参数。
Result: 流控制能准确且响应式地引导机器人动作，对次优用户输入具有鲁棒性，使用户引导下任务成功率显著提升且完成更快，同时在流控制轨迹数据上微调可改善VLA的自主策略。
Conclusion: 流控制提供了一种简单直观的实时用户引导方式，有效提升VLA任务性能，且作为无训练的技术可直接应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trainability of IQP Quantum Circuit Born Machines Under Gaussian Initialization
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Circuit Born Machines (QCBMs) offer a natural approach to generative machine learning by leveraging the Born rule. Recent work has provided a method to classically train QCBMs with Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) circuits via the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) loss. Despite the assumed intractability of sampling from IQP circuits classically, their expectation values can be computed classically, enabling training of these IQP QCBMs. However, quantum machine learning (QML) models have various other challenges, including trainability issues caused by exponential concentration or barren plateaus. While these issues have been explored for parameters sampled from a uniform distribution, little work has been done to rigorously treat the use of arbitrary Gaussian initialization schemes. This work leverages Stein's lemma and Lipschitz concentration bounds for Gaussian random variables to provide an analytical lower bound of the variance of the gradient and a probabilistic concentration bound of the deviation of the gradient from its mean. It discusses strategies to either avoid or encourage exponential concentration, as well as the conditions under which barren plateaus are more likely to occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) 量子电路Born机在Gaussian初始化下的可训练性，利用Stein引理和Lipschitz浓度界给出了梯度方差的下界以及梯度偏离其均值的概率浓度界，讨论了避免或鼓励指数级浓度以及贫瘠高原的条件。
Motivation: 量子机器学习模型面临可训练性问题（如指数级浓度或贫瘠高原），现有研究多针对均匀分布参数，缺乏对任意Gaussian初始化方案的严格分析。
Method: 基于Stein引理和Gaussian随机变量的Lipschitz浓度界，推导了梯度方差的分析下界和梯度偏离均值的概率浓度界，并讨论了不同初始化策略的影响。
Result: 提供了梯度方差的下界和概率浓度界，明确了避免或鼓励指数级浓度的策略以及贫瘠高原更可能发生的条件。
Conclusion: 本文为IQP量子电路Born机在Gaussian初始化下的可训练性提供了理论保证，指出了训练过程中浓度和贫瘠高原的触发条件。

papers.title: A Large Scale Open-Source Image and Video Dataset for Robust Wildfire Detection and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire detection and monitoring are critical for mitigating fire spread and reducing environmental and infrastructural damage. In this work, we introduce GWFP (Global Wildfire Prevention Dataset), a large-scale, open-source dataset of wildfire images and videos designed to support early fire and smoke detection research. GWFP contains geographically diverse wildfire scenes, including flames, smoke, Waterdog/Fog environmental conditions, Near Infrared (NIR) imagery, Ember, and challenging negative samples collected from real-world scenarios worldwide. To evaluate dataset robustness and cross-domain generalization, we benchmark multiple convolutional and transformer-based architectures across both in-domain and cross-dataset settings. Additionally, we explore lightweight frequency--spatial feature interaction using Hadamard-enhanced residual connections (HTE-ResNet) to analyze representation robustness under domain-shift conditions. Experimental results demonstrate strong cross-dataset generalization and practical utility for real-world wildfire monitoring applications. The dataset and source code will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了GWFP（Global Wildfire Prevention Dataset），一个大规模开源野火图像与视频数据集，包含火焰、烟雾、水雾/雾、近红外、余烬等多样化场景及难负样本，旨在支持早期火灾和烟雾检测研究。实验评估了多种卷积和Transformer架构的域内与跨数据集泛化性能，并探索了基于Hadamard增强残差连接（HTE-ResNet）的轻量化频-空特征交互方法。结果表明该方法在跨数据集泛化和实际野火监测中具有实用性。
Motivation: 野火检测和监测对于减缓火势蔓延、减少环境和基础设施破坏至关重要，但缺乏大规模、多样化的开源野火数据集限制了研究进展。
Method: 构建包含地理多样性的GWFP数据集，并基于卷积和Transformer架构进行基准测试；提出基于Hadamard增强残差连接（HTE-ResNet）的轻量级频-空特征交互方法，用于分析域偏移下的表示鲁棒性。
Result: 实验表明该方法在跨数据集泛化方面表现良好，并具有实际野火监测应用的实用价值。
Conclusion: GWFP数据集和所提出的方法为野火检测研究提供了大规模、多样化的资源，并展示了在域偏移条件下的泛化能力，但未提及与降水、临近预报等相关任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Local Is Not a Sufficient Privacy Boundary: Governing OS-Integrated On-Device AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems move into operating systems, privacy no longer turns only on whether a model runs locally. A local assistant may assemble email, calendar entries, files, screenshots, notifications, and app intents; retain embeddings or summaries; invoke tools; emit telemetry; or route difficult requests to cloud infrastructure. Local inference reduces some exposure, but it answers only one question: where computation occurs. It does not answer who may assemble context, what derived state persists, which actions are authorized, or how updates change the system's authority. We develop an OS-centered privacy framework for on-device AI that treats privacy as an institutional accountability problem rather than a deployment attribute. The framework specifies a threat model, a six-part privacy risk taxonomy, privacy-by-architecture controls, and a four-level audit rubric. We demonstrate the rubric through a documentation-bounded comparison of Apple Intelligence/Foundation Models, Android AICore/Gemini Nano, and Microsoft Recall. Meaningful privacy in on-device AI depends on constrained information flow, bounded authority, visible user control, and auditable governance across the operating-system lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出本地计算不足以作为AI隐私的边界，操作系统集成的AI需要关注信息流、持久化状态、权限控制和更新管理。作者提出以操作系统为中心的隐私框架，包含威胁模型、六部分隐私风险分类、架构级隐私控制以及四级审计标准，并通过对Apple Intelligence、Android AICore/Gemini Nano和Microsoft Recall的文档对比展示了该框架的应用。
Motivation: 现有隐私讨论过度聚焦于本地与云端计算位置，忽视了操作系统层面AI系统如何组装上下文、持久化衍生状态、授权操作以及更新权限等关键隐私问题。
Method: 提出OS中心隐私框架，包括威胁模型、六类隐私风险（如信息聚合、状态持久化、工具调用、遥测等）、隐私架构控制（如最小权限、信息流约束）以及四级审计标准（从文档审查到运行时验证），并通过三家主流操作系统AI产品的公开文档进行对比分析。
Result: 通过框架对比发现，Apple Intelligence、Android AICore和Microsoft Recall在信息流约束、用户可见控制、审计能力等方面存在显著差异，例如Microsoft Recall因默认开启且缺乏细粒度控制而隐私风险更高。
Conclusion: 本文强调，有意义的隐私保护必须依赖于操作系统全生命周期中的信息流约束、权限边界、用户可见控制以及可审计的治理机制，而非仅仅依赖本地执行。

papers.title: Learning Entropy and Spatial Adaptation Dynamics of Multilayer Perceptrons for Structural Point Extraction
papers.abstract_en: This paper extends the concept of Learning Entropy (LE) from temporal adaptive systems to spatial learning in multilayer perceptron networks (MLPs) applied to image data. Instead of evaluating image structure directly from gradients or covariance operators, as local neighborhood methods do, the proposed approach analyzes the learning process itself through Learning Entropy. An MLP is trained to predict the intensity of a center pixel from its surrounding spatial context, while LE is evaluated from the incremental adaptation of neural weights during learning across image-derived samples. The resulting Spatial Learning Entropy Maps (SLEM) identify unusual image points and regions that induce strong adaptation of the neural network and therefore have an important role in the learning process. The results indicate that spatial Learning Entropy provides a complementary perspective to conventional feature extraction and explainability methods by highlighting spatial locations that are particularly informative for network learning. Spatial Learning Entropy provides a complementary perspective to conventional feature extraction and explainability methods by identifying image points and regions according to their learning impact rather than their local structural properties. The proposed framework may open new directions for learning-driven image or scene analysis in computer vision, manufacturing, and robotics.

papers.title: FlexPath: Learned Semantic Path Priors for Image-Based Planning
papers.abstract_en: Recent learning-based path planners use neural networks to process visual map representations and approximate heuristics for classical search algorithms, yielding near-optimal paths with reduced search effort. However, these methods are tied to the shortest-path objective implicit in their supervision, which limits their flexibility to accommodate alternative criteria. We introduce FlexPath, a two-stage framework that decouples feasibility from preference. In Stage 1, we use imitation learning to acquire a task-independent spatial prior over feasible paths from visual map inputs. In Stage 2, differentiable Path Shape Objectives (PSOs) adapt this prior toward task-specific criteria without relearning path structure, requiring only efficient objective-level adaptation. A single pretrained model can be adapted to multiple objectives. For shortest-path planning, FlexPath reduces search effort on TMP by 14.3% compared to the state-of-the-art TransPath, while also finding lower-cost paths on average and demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across three unseen domains. For obstacle clearance with minimum clearance distance 2, it achieves 96.8% full obstacle avoidance while maintaining low search cost. The framework further extends to semantic-aware avoidance and waypoint guidance via objective-level adaptation, and remains compatible with classical planners at inference time. Data and code are available at https://github.com/FraunhoferIVI/FlexPath.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexPath两阶段框架，将路径规划的可行性与偏好解耦。第一阶段通过模仿学习从视觉地图输入中学习与任务无关的可行路径空间先验；第二阶段通过可微分的路径形状目标（PSO）将该先验适应到特定任务标准，无需重新学习路径结构。在最短路径规划上，相比TransPath减少14.3%搜索代价，平均路径成本更低，并展现出跨三个未见领域的强零样本泛化能力。在障碍物避开任务上达到96.8%完全避障率。框架还可扩展到语义感知避障和航点引导，并与经典规划器兼容。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的路径规划器受限于最短路径目标，难以灵活适应其他代价标准。
Method: 两阶段框架：阶段1用模仿学习学习任务无关的可行路径空间先验；阶段2用可微分的路径形状目标（PSO）适应特定任务偏好，只需高效的目标级适应。
Result: 最短路径规划上，TMP数据集搜索代价降低14.3%，平均路径成本更低，零样本泛化到三个未见领域；障碍物避开任务（最小间隔2）达到96.8%完全避障，且搜索成本低。
Conclusion: 单个预训练模型可适应多个目标，与经典规划器兼容，展示了通过目标级适应实现灵活路径规划的可能性。

papers.title: Fusing Satellite Imagery and Planimetric Maps for Cross-View Localization
papers.abstract_en: Current cross-view localization methods predominantly rely on satellite imagery as the aerial modality. Although recent work explores planimetric maps (e.g., OpenStreetMap tiles), these approaches often lag in performance. Yet both modalities are widely available and possess complementary properties. Satellite images are closer to ground-level camera imagery, offering finer detail, whereas planimetric maps contain annotated objects (e.g., streetlamps) and remain informative in areas where the ground is occluded, such as by foliage. Despite this, only one prior work provides an end-to-end method to fuse the two modalities, and it does not demonstrate their potential within state-of-the-art methods. To combine the strengths of both modalities, we propose a new fusion module that augments standard encoders and demonstrates that integrating satellite imagery with planimetric maps improves state-of-the-art single-modality methods. The module comprises (i) cross-modal conditioning, which processes each modality's encoding with awareness of the other, and (ii) a patch-level fusion rule that controls the granularity of information exchange. We achieve state-of-the-art results, reducing the mean localization error by 30.13\%. Qualitatively, the fusion adaptively selects the more informative modality, improving overall accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合卫星图像与平面地图（如OpenStreetMap）的跨视角定位方法。方法包含跨模态条件化（cross-modal conditioning）和patch级融合规则，使编码器在处理各模态时能感知另一模态的信息，并控制信息交换粒度。在基准测试上，平均定位误差降低30.13%，达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有跨视角定位方法主要依赖卫星图像，而平面地图虽信息互补（含标注物体、植被遮挡区仍有效）但性能欠佳；仅有的融合方法未展示在先进方法中的潜力。
Method: 提出融合模块，包含跨模态条件化（处理各模态编码时融入另一模态信息）和patch级融合规则（控制信息交换粒度），可增强标准编码器。
Result: 在基准测试上，融合方法将平均定位误差降低30.13%，达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 融合卫星图像与平面地图能自适应选择更优模态，提升跨视角定位准确性，优于单模态方法。

papers.title: Gaming AI-Assisted Peer Reviews Poses New Risks to the Scientific Community
papers.abstract_en: AI is increasingly used to support scientific peer review, from manuscript screening, reviewer assistance to editorial triage. Although such systems promise to reduce reviewer burden and accelerate publication, their robustness to strategic manipulation remains poorly understood. Here we show that AI-mediated peer review is vulnerable to a simple, low-cost manipulation: superficial rephrasing of the manuscript abstract. Without changing the underlying scientific content and communication, and even without knowledge of the reviewing model, adversarially rewritten abstracts substantially improve AI review outcomes. We see this across disciplines and publication venues, for both human-written and AI-generated papers. Our strongest attack achieves an attack-success-rate of about 38%, increasing acceptance ratings by +1.31 for Gemini 3 Flash reviewers and by +0.88 for GPT 5.4 Mini reviewers on a 10-point scale. When the original AI review suggests 'reject', the success rate rises to more than 50%. This effect extends beyond overall score inflation, increasing review confidence and scores on core scientific criteria such as soundness, significance and perceived contribution. The attack is practical, requiring only about 5 minutes and $1 for a 10-page AI conference submission, and is hard to distinguish from ordinary scientific editing. Inflated AI reviews could bias downstream human decision-making, shifting editorial recommendations from rejection towards acceptance. These findings reveal a general vulnerability in AI-assisted scientific evaluation: when AI-generated review influence editorial decisions, authors may be incentivized to optimize manuscripts for AI judgment rather than scientific merit. Our results suggest that AI tools should not be treated as neutral evaluators in high-stakes peer review without systematic robustness testing, transparent safeguards and careful human oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示AI辅助同行评议系统存在严重漏洞：通过简单改写论文摘要（不改变科学内容），即可显著提升AI评审分数，改变编辑决策。攻击成本极低（约5分钟、1美元），成功率约38%，且难以与普通编辑区分。该发现对科学界使用AI评审提出了警示。
Motivation: AI被广泛用于同行评议以减轻负担，但其对策略性操纵的鲁棒性缺乏研究。本文旨在揭示这一潜在风险。
Method: 提出一种对抗性攻击方法：在不改变科学内容的前提下，对论文摘要进行表面重述（superficial rephrasing），以欺骗AI评审系统。攻击无需了解评审模型内部细节。
Result: 最强攻击在10分制上使Gemini 3 Flash评审评分提升+1.31，GPT 5.4 Mini提升+0.88，攻击成功率达38%；当原始评审为reject时，成功率超50%。攻击还提高了评审置信度和科学标准（如合理性、显著性）的评分。
Conclusion: AI评审工具不应被视为中立评价者，在用于高风险同行评议前需进行系统性鲁棒性测试、透明防护和人工监督。作者担心作者可能为迎合AI而非科学价值优化稿件。

papers.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: As recommender systems transition toward agentic, multi-turn conversational interfaces, evaluation paradigms have struggled to keep pace. Current benchmarks often rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluations, which introduce subjectivity, high costs and inconsistency. We present $τ$-Rec, a benchmark for agentic recommender systems that replaces subjective evaluation with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation (RTE) mechanism that controls how task constraints surface during dialogue. By testing agents against structured catalog predicates and employing a pass^k reliability metric, $τ$-Rec provides a systematic test for consistent reasoning. Our evaluation of nine configurations across five model families -- GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3-32B and GPT-5 mini -- reveals a steep reliability cliff, where even the best model achieves only ~57% at pass^1 and ~38% at pass^4, highlighting a critical gap in current conversational agent deployment. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 τ-Rec 基准测试，用于评估智能推荐系统在多轮对话中的一致性推理能力，通过可验证奖励和揭示标记引导机制替代主观的 LLM-as-a-judge 评估。在 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6 等模型上的实验显示，最佳模型 pass^1 仅约 57%，pass^4 约 38%，表明当前对话智能体部署存在严重可靠性缺陷。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统向智能体多轮对话界面转型，但评估依赖 LLM-as-a-judge，具有主观性、高成本和不一致性，缺乏可验证的客观基准。
Method: 提出 τ-Rec 基准，包含结构化目录谓词的可验证奖励、揭示标记引导机制以及 pass^k 可靠性指标，系统测试模型在约束条件下的推理一致性。
Result: 在五个模型家族九种配置上评估，最佳模型 pass^1 约 57%，pass^4 约 38%，揭示可靠性断崖。
Conclusion: τ-Rec 提供了一种可替代传统 LLM-as-a-judge 的客观评估方法，并指出当前对话智能体在一致性推理上的关键差距。

papers.title: Quality Is Not a Safety Proxy Under Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantized checkpoints are often screened first with quality metrics and only later, if at all, with direct safety tests. This paper audits that shortcut on a matched 51-row matrix spanning 6 models, 4 families, a 7-level GGUF ladder, and AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoints. In this matrix the shortcut fails: all 36 quality-safety pairings split direction across models, and 9 hidden-danger rows plus 1 near-hidden-danger row show quality stable or improved while refusal falls by 12-68 percentage points. Seven of the 11 AWQ/GPTQ rows are hidden-danger. A four-probe mechanistic follow-up over the 17 Hugging Face-backed FP16/AWQ/GPTQ cells does not rescue it: entropy, refusal-direction, and calibration probes are weak or null separators of dangerous rows, and although probe-identified safety-associated neurons absorb 1.39$\times$ more quantization error overall ($p < 5 \times 10^{-7}$), the effect is not regime-specific. Claude Sonnet 4 relabels 11,470 items in a predefined stratified set, agrees with the primary gemma3:12b judge on 89.9\% of rows ($κ= 0.873$, 95\% CI [0.866, 0.881]), and changes 0/10 hidden-danger cells. A calibrated study-internal behavioral screen -- the Refusal Template Stability Index (RTSI), built from four refusal-template drift features and calibrated on this matrix -- routes 10/10 hidden- or near-hidden-danger rows to direct safety testing (Wilson 95\% CI lower bound 0.72) while leaving 23 of 45 non-baseline rows in a low-risk bucket under both in-sample scoring and row-level leave-one-out validation; on the same matrix, the best single-feature baselines (unique-prefix-rate-delta, raw refusal-rate delta) recover 9/10 and 8/10 respectively at matched bucket size, and cross-stack transfer requires recalibration. For the quantized checkpoints, model families, and safety outcomes studied here, retained quality cannot waive direct safety evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了量化检查点的质量-安全关系，发现质量指标无法替代直接安全测试。在涵盖6个模型、4个家族、51个量化配置的矩阵中，所有36个质量-安全配对均方向分裂，存在9个隐藏危险行和1个近似隐藏危险行。提出的拒绝模板稳定性指数（RTSI）能有效识别这些危险行，而质量指标无法预警。
Motivation: 当前实践中量化检查点常先用质量指标筛选，再决定是否进行安全测试。本文指出这种捷径可能遗漏安全风险，需要系统审计。
Method: 构建51行矩阵，包含GGUF量化阶梯（7级）及AWQ/GPTQ INT4检查点，测量质量与安全指标。提出拒绝模板稳定性指数（RTSI），基于四个拒绝模板漂移特征校准，用于路由危险行。
Result: 质量-安全配对在模型间方向分裂；9个隐藏危险行中质量稳定或提升而拒绝率下降12-68个百分点。RTSI在样本内和留一验证中能识别全部10个危险/近似危险行，且比单特征基线更可靠。
Conclusion: 保留质量不能作为免除直接安全评估的代理，量化检查点必须进行直接安全测试。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前实践中量化检查点常先用质量指标筛选，再决定是否进行安全测试。本文指出这种捷径可能遗漏安全风险，需要系统审计。
summary_sections.method: 构建51行矩阵，包含GGUF量化阶梯（7级）及AWQ/GPTQ INT4检查点，测量质量与安全指标。提出拒绝模板稳定性指数（RTSI），基于四个拒绝模板漂移特征校准，用于路由危险行。
summary_sections.result: 质量-安全配对在模型间方向分裂；9个隐藏危险行中质量稳定或提升而拒绝率下降12-68个百分点。RTSI在样本内和留一验证中能识别全部10个危险/近似危险行，且比单特征基线更可靠。
summary_sections.conclusion: 保留质量不能作为免除直接安全评估的代理，量化检查点必须进行直接安全测试。

papers.title: Compositional Generative Modeling from Decentralized Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning the compositional nature of the physical world requires joint observation of interacting factors. However, because practical data is often decentralized, these factors are fragmented across isolated silos. Existing decentralized generative approaches focus only on modeling the union of siloed data, overlooking novel combinations implied by the collective whole. To bridge this gap, we introduce Decentralized Compositional Flow Matching (DCFM), a framework that enforces structural constraints across the global set of generative factors, without exchanging any raw data. DCFM enables novel combinations to emerge through peer interactions, even when no single data source can independently support the composition. Empirically, DCFM substantially outperforms federated learning and mixture-of-experts baselines across conditional image generation, robotic spatial planning, and medical attribute co-occurrence modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Decentralized Compositional Flow Matching (DCFM)，一种在去中心化数据上学习组合生成模型的方法，无需交换原始数据，允许通过peer交互产生新颖组合。实验表明在条件图像生成、机器人空间规划、医学属性共现建模上优于联邦学习和混合专家基线。
Motivation: 现实数据经常分散在不同的孤立数据源中，导致影响物理世界组合性的因子被分割，而现有去中心化生成方法只关注合并数据，忽略了集体整体隐含的新颖组合。
Method: 引入Decentralized Compositional Flow Matching (DCFM)，通过在整个生成因子全局集上施加结构约束，无需交换原始数据，利用peer交互使新颖组合涌现。
Result: 在条件图像生成、机器人空间规划、医学属性共现建模任务上，DCFM大幅优于联邦学习和混合专家基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DCFM能够在不交换原始数据的情况下学习去中心化数据的组合生成，并展示了跨多个应用领域的有效性。

papers.title: From Senses to Decisions: The Information Flow of Auditory and Visual Perception in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can listen and see, but how do audio and visual signals actually travel through the network to shape an answer? Despite their growing role in research and real-world applications, the internal pathways through which audio and visual tokens influence the final prediction remain poorly understood. In this study, we examine audio-visual information flow inside Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AVLLMs), tracing how AVLLMs route, utilize, and integrate audio and visual information across two input configurations, audio-visual video and multiple interleaved audio-visual items. We find that for audio-visual video, AVLLMs follow the sequential information flow pathway established for VLMs and VideoLLMs, with audio and visual contribution flowing along this pathway in proportion to the task's reliance on each modality. In settings with multiple interleaved audio-visual items, this routing shifts to different parallel streams. Furthermore, we demonstrate that audio-visual and other token types can be discarded once their information is transferred to LLM, with minimal impact on the model's prediction or even slight improvement, generalizing across multiple tasks and datasets, enabling more efficient inference. These findings hold across multiple models and scales, Qwen2.5-Omni and Video-SALMONN2 Plus at 3B and 7B scales, leading to hypotheses on why these flow structures emerge. Together, these results deliver the first coherent picture of how AVLLMs orchestrate sound and sight inside the network and lay the groundwork for the next wave of interpretability, design, and efficiency advances in audio-visual and broader MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究音频-视觉大语言模型（AVLLMs）内部信息流，追踪音频和视觉令牌如何通过网络影响最终预测。发现对于音视频输入，模型遵循顺序信息流路径，音频与视觉贡献比例取决于任务依赖；对于交错的多项音视频项，路由转向并行流。实验表明，一旦信息传递到LLM，可丢弃音频、视觉等令牌，对预测影响极小甚至略有提升。这些发现适用于Qwen2.5-Omni和Video-SALMONN2 Plus（3B和7B规模），为理解AVLLM工作机制提供基础。
Motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型已被广泛应用，但音频和视觉信号在模型内部如何传播并最终影响决策的机制尚不清晰，缺乏系统性的信息流分析。
Method: 通过分析音频-视觉大语言模型在不同输入配置（音视频视频、交错多项音视频项）下的令牌级信息流，追踪各模态贡献并测试丢弃令牌的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：音视频输入下模型采用顺序信息流路径，模态贡献与任务依赖成正比；交错多项音视频项时转为并行流。丢弃已传递信息的令牌几乎不影响预测，甚至略有提升，该现象跨多个任务和数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 本研究首次呈现AVLLM内部音频与视觉信息流的连贯图景，为后续可解释性、模型设计和效率优化奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D generation have led to substantial improvements in realism, controllability, and efficiency, yet the evaluation of 3D assets remains underexplored. Existing evaluation paradigms, including human evaluation, learned metrics, and vision-language models (VLMs) as judges, suffer from limitations in cost, scalability, resolution handling, or task-specific alignment. In this work, we focus on 3D mesh evaluation and introduce DB-3DME, the Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Mesh Evaluation. DB-3DME contains 2,619 synthetic 3D meshes paired with human ratings on Geometry and Prompt Adherence. Using this dataset, we systematically benchmark state-of-the-art VLMs and identify visual encoding of 3D representations as a key factor for human-aligned evaluation performance. Motivated by this finding, we fine-tune an open-weight VLM, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, for 3D mesh evaluation by adapting the visual encoder while freezing the language model. The fine-tuned model substantially outperforms existing pre-trained VLMs across multiple evaluation dimensions, establishing a new benchmark for automatic 3D mesh evaluation. We publicly release the benchmark dataset on GitHub and Hugging Face to facilitate future research.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 workshop paper. 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Dataset available at GitHub and Hugging Face
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DB-3DME，一个用于3D网格评估的数据集和基准，包含2,619个合成3D网格及其人类评分（几何和提示一致性）。通过系统评估现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的表现，发现3D表示的视觉编码是关键因素。基于此，微调 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 的视觉编码器，冻结语言模型，在多个维度上显著优于现有预训练 VLM。
Motivation: 现有3D生成评估方法（人类评估、学习指标、VLM作为评判）存在成本高、可扩展性差、分辨率处理或任务对齐不足等问题，缺乏专门针对3D网格评估的数据集和基准。
Method: 构建包含2,619个合成3D网格及其人类评分的数据集；系统比较多种VLM；微调 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B，仅调整视觉编码器，冻结语言模型，实现自动评估。
Result: 微调后的模型在几何和提示一致性等多个评估维度上大幅超越现有预训练VLM，建立了新的自动3D网格评估基准。
Conclusion: DB-3DME数据集和微调方法为三维网格评价提供了更好的工具，并公开数据集以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ambiguous Strategic Classification
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption in strategic classification is that the classifier is public knowledge. However, it remains unclear whether, and why, a system would choose to commit to full disclosure. We study a setting in which regulation requires the system to disclose some, but not all, of the information. This induces a learning task in which the learner must jointly optimize the classifier and the uncertainty surrounding it. To this end, we adopt from robust mechanism design the notion of ambiguity, which in our setting allows the learner to reveal a set or range of possible classifiers, while privately choosing which of them to ultimately realize. We investigate how ambiguity affects the learning task, develop efficient algorithms for computing best-responses and training, and empirically explore strategic learning and its outcomes in this novel setting and using our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在战略分类中，系统不完全披露分类器信息的情况。采用鲁棒机制设计中的模糊性概念，允许学习者揭示一组可能的分类器，并私下选择最终实现的分类器。提出了计算最佳响应和训练的高效算法，并进行了实证探索。
Motivation: 战略分类的常见假设是分类器是公开的，但系统为何选择完全披露尚不清楚。本文研究在监管要求系统披露部分信息（而非全部）的场景，引入模糊性来联合优化分类器及其不确定性。
Method: 采用鲁棒机制设计中的模糊性概念，允许学习者揭示一组或一个范围的分类器，并私下选择最终实现的分类器。开发了计算最佳响应和训练的高效算法。
Result: 摘要未提具体数值结果，但声称通过实证探索了该新颖设置下的战略学习及其结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该设置和方法的有效性，但未明确局限性。

papers.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation in remote sensing requires costly pixel-level annotations, and nearly every problem demands a new dataset since models rarely transfer across sensors, platforms, or geographies. Existing human-in-the-loop frameworks expand sparse clicks into dense supervision via auxiliary machinery (pseudo-labels, propagation, CRFs, foundation-model prompts, auxiliary heads), all operating on the model's predictive distribution. A confidently wrong pixel is indistinguishable from a confidently correct one in that distribution by construction, so no rule reading it can separate the two; the distinguishing signal is external to the model. This paper hypothesizes that expert clicks targeting confident model errors, not arbitrary pixels, suffice to match dense supervision, with no expansion machinery. iSAGE (Iterative Sparse Annotation Guided by Expert) realizes this hypothesis on an integrated open-source platform, where an error-weighted loss amplifies the gradient at each click and the annotation record itself is the dataset, extensible, correctable, and auditable. Experiments use a minimum-effort regime: at most one labeled pixel per class per frame. On BsB Aerial, iSAGE recovers 97.2% of dense supervision (74.79% mIoU on 0.040% of pixels) with contrasting class dynamics: amorphous classes (permeable areas) saturate from the seed, while small classes (cars) require late-iteration effort. On ISPRS Vaihingen (external benchmark), iSAGE reaches 76.78% mIoU with 0.011% of pixels, matching the dense baseline (76.65%) and exceeding all published methods. Under the same pipeline, four output-reading mechanisms (oracle entropy across budgets 1--100x, pseudo-labels across thresholds 0.90--0.99, CRF-based propagation, uniform random) plateau 7.4 to 14.5 pp below iSAGE. Across 31 surveyed methods, iSAGE is the only iterative human-in-the-loop framework operating without auxiliary machinery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出iSAGE，一个通过稀疏点标注实现遥感语义分割的人机交互框架。其核心假设是：专家点击针对置信度错误的像素（而非任意像素）足以匹配密集监督的效果，无需辅助扩展机制（如伪标签、CRF等）。在BsB Aerial数据上，仅用0.040%像素标注就达到密集监督的97.2% mIoU（74.79%）；在ISPRS Vaihingen上，用0.011%像素达到76.78% mIoU，匹配甚至超越所有已发表方法。该方法在31种方法中是唯一无需辅助机制的人机交互框架。
Motivation: 遥感语义分割需要昂贵的像素级标注，且模型难以跨传感器、平台或地理区域迁移，导致每个新问题都需要新数据集。现有的人机交互框架依赖辅助机制（伪标签、传播、CRF等）将稀疏点击扩展为密集监督，但无法区分正确和错误的高置信度预测。
Method: 提出iSAGE框架，基于开源平台实现。专家点击针对模型高置信度错误像素，使用错误加权损失放大每个点击的梯度。标注记录本身即为数据集，可扩展、可修正、可审计。实验采用最小努力策略：每类每帧最多一个标注像素。
Result: 在BsB Aerial上，用0.040%像素达到74.79% mIoU（密集监督的97.2%）。在ISPRS Vaihingen上，用0.011%像素达到76.78% mIoU，匹配密集基线（76.65%）并超越所有已发表方法。与四种输出读取机制（oracle熵、伪标签、CRF传播、均匀随机）相比，iSAGE高出7.4至14.5个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调iSAGE是唯一无需辅助机制的迭代式人机交互框架，并指出不同类别有不同动态：无定形类别（如渗透区域）从初始标注即饱和，而小类别（如汽车）需要后期迭代努力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Effective Training Principles of Physical Reservoirs
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computers benefit from the inherent complexity of optical phenomena, which provide rich, often nonlinear dynamics. However, training directly on the reservoir's output renders the system prone to overfitting and computationally inefficient during the training phase. In this work, we investigate strategies to mitigate overfitting and reduce computational overhead through output pruning and regularization. We compare loss-minimizing search methods (Equal Search and Branch and Bound) against an output-oriented statistical filtering approach (Variance Filter) and random pruning, highlighting advantages and disadvantages of each approach and the overall importance of informed reservoir output sampling, particularly for a shrinking latent space. We further demonstrate that enforcing readout selection across the full output spectrum improves performance, especially for non-iterative methods. Additionally, we examine L1 and L2 regularization techniques (LASSO and ridge regression), both of which significantly enhance performance on highly nonlinear tasks such as the Spiral Benchmark. While our methods are of general use, results are obtained from and discussed exemplarily for a nonlinear fiber-optical extreme learning machine. Overall, this study provides a deep analysis of the reservoirs' hidden-layer filtering mechanisms and the output-layer training, enabling optimized performance in physical reservoir computing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了物理储层计算中缓解过拟合和降低计算开销的策略，对比了输出剪枝（等值搜索、分支定界、方差过滤、随机剪枝）和正则化（L1/L2）方法，并在非线性光纤极端学习机上验证。结果表明，L1/L2正则化能显著提升非线性任务性能，而跨全输出谱的读选集选择也有助于非迭代方法。研究为物理储层系统的输出层训练提供了指导。
Motivation: 物理储层计算直接训练储层输出容易过拟合且训练阶段计算效率低，现有方法缺乏对输出剪枝和正则化策略的系统比较。
Method: 比较了基于损失最小化的搜索方法（等值搜索、分支定界）与面向输出的统计过滤方法（方差过滤）以及随机剪枝，并研究了L1和L2正则化（LASSO和岭回归）技术，强调在缩小的潜空间中知情输出采样的重要性。
Result: L1和L2正则化在高度非线性任务（如Spiral Benchmark）上显著提升性能；跨全输出谱强制进行读选集选择改善了非迭代方法的性能。
Conclusion: 本研究提供了物理储层系统中隐藏层过滤机制和输出层训练的深入分析，有助于优化物理储层计算系统的性能。

papers.title: Discovering Interpretable Multi-Parameter Control Policies for Evolutionary Algorithms Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: While deep Reinforcement Learning (deep-RL) has been increasingly applied to parameter control in evolutionary algorithms, rigorous theoretical analysis of parameter control remains largely restricted to single-parameter settings, owing to the difficulty of deriving effective, interpretable multi-parameter policies amenable to formal study. We demonstrate how deep-RL can be leveraged to overcome this barrier, using the (1+($λ$,$λ$))-genetic algorithm optimizing OneMax, one of the few problems where a super-constant speedup of dynamic control has been formally proven, as a representative case study. We first show that standard approaches struggle to converge in this multi-parameter setting, and introduce algorithm-agnostic enhancements targeting action-space decomposition, reward shifting, and long-horizon discounting. With these in place, we compare common deep-RL methods and find that Double Deep Q-Networks uniquely avoid the policy collapse observed in Proximal Policy Optimization, yielding trajectories suitable for downstream analysis. Crucially, we move beyond the ``black-box'' nature of neural networks by distilling the learned behaviors into a transparent, symbolic control policy. This resulting policy does not only offer interpretability for future theoretical analysis but also yields exceptional performance, consistently outperforming existing baselines across a wide range of problem sizes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用深度强化学习为进化算法发现可解释的多参数控制策略，以(1+(λ,λ))-遗传算法优化OneMax问题为案例。标准RL方法在多参数设置下难以收敛，作者提出动作空间分解、奖励平移和长视野折扣等改进，并发现Double Deep Q-Networks能避免策略崩溃。通过将学到的行为蒸馏为符号控制策略，兼具可解释性和优异性能，在多个问题规模上超越现有基线。
Motivation: 进化算法参数控制的理论分析多局限于单参数设置，缺乏有效的可解释多参数策略。
Method: 在(1+(λ,λ))-GA的背景下，使用深度RL（主要比较PPO和Double DQN），引入动作空间分解、奖励平移和长视野折扣等技术改进，并将习得策略蒸馏为符号形式。
Result: Double DQN避免了PPO的策略崩溃，生成的轨迹适合下游分析；蒸馏得到的符号策略在多种问题规模上持续超越现有基线。
Conclusion: 深度RL可以用于发现可解释的多参数控制策略，符号蒸馏为理论分析提供了可能。

papers.title: Pareto-Guided Teacher Alignment for Fair Personalized Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized persuasive text generation can improve relevance and engagement, but demographic conditioning may also introduce unequal framing across groups. We study fairness mitigation in personalized generation as a constrained multi-objective alignment problem: reduce demographic disparities while preserving personalization fidelity. We propose a Pareto-guided teacher alignment framework that combines revision-based candidate generation, pair-aware feasibility gating, Pareto-style candidate selection, and optional preference optimization through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. We evaluate the framework on climate change and vaccination persuasion tasks using a controlled context-rich demographic grid with matched gender and age pairs and a unified five-audit evaluation suite spanning persuasion bias, formality disparity, emotional framing disparity, lexical association disparity, and personalization fidelity. Across both domains and cross-family transfer settings, no single alignment strategy dominates all objectives simultaneously. Instead, methods occupy different regions of a fairness-personalization Pareto frontier: some achieve stronger disparity reductions, while others better preserve personalization or demographic stability. Our results show that fairness mitigation effects are objective-dependent and transfer inconsistently across domains and model families, motivating bounded-regression, multi-audit model selection over single-metric optimization for fairness-sensitive personalized generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究个性化说服性文本生成中的公平性问题，将其建模为约束多目标对齐问题：在保持个性化保真度的同时减少人口统计差异。作者提出Pareto引导的教师对齐框架，结合基于修订的候选生成、成对感知可行性门控、Pareto风格候选选择以及通过监督微调和直接偏好优化的可选偏好优化。在气候变化和疫苗接种说服任务上，使用受控的人口统计网格和统一五审计评估套件进行评估。结果显示，没有单一的校准策略能在所有目标上同时占优，不同方法占据公平性-个性化帕累托前沿的不同区域，公平性缓解效果依赖于目标，并且在领域和模型族之间迁移不一致。
Motivation: 个性化说服文本生成中，人口统计条件可能导致不同群体间的不平等框架，现有方法缺乏对公平性缓解的系统研究。作者将公平性缓解建模为约束多目标对齐问题，需要同时减少人口统计差异和保持个性化保真度。
Method: 提出Pareto引导的教师对齐框架，包括四个阶段：修订式候选生成（revision-based candidate generation）、成对感知可行性门控（pair-aware feasibility gating）、Pareto风格候选选择（Pareto-style candidate selection），以及可选的偏好优化（通过监督微调和直接偏好优化）。
Result: 在气候变化和疫苗接种两个说服任务上，使用包含性别和年龄匹配对的受控人口统计网格进行实验。通过五审计评估套件（包括说服偏差、形式性差异、情感框架差异、词汇关联差异和个性化保真度）评估。发现没有单一校准策略能同时优化所有目标；不同方法在公平性-个性化帕累托前沿上占据不同区域，公平性缓解效果依赖于目标且在领域和模型族间迁移不一致。
Conclusion: 公平性缓解效果是目标依赖且跨领域和模型族迁移不一致的，这促使在公平性敏感的个性化生成中应采用有界回归、多审计模型选择，而非单一指标优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Active Learning for Few-Shot Example Selection in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot example retrieval is the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models (LLMs) in domain-specific text-to-SQL systems. However, the quality of the annotated example bank directly governs system accuracy, and expert annotation is prohibitively expensive. We formalize the active selection of these examples as a constrained experimental design problem over the intrinsic, low-dimensional manifold of semantic query embeddings. Unlike standard active learning frameworks, our setting introduces three critical challenges: varying, query-dependent annotation reliability (heteroscedasticity), strict requirements for spatial diversity across semantic topics (partition matroid constraints), and the inherent reality that the true covariance structure of the embedding space is unknown (misspecification). To address these, we propose a stratified greedy algorithm that maximizes a heteroscedastic mutual information objective. We prove that this objective remains submodular and approximately monotonic on the intrinsic manifold, yielding a theoretical constant-factor approximation guarantee. We establish a spectral bound demonstrating that this approximation guarantee degrades gracefully, rather than catastrophically, when the assumed surrogate kernel diverges from the true underlying data-generating process. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed strategy significantly reduces labeling effort while maintaining high text-to-SQL retrieval accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少样本文本到SQL系统中的示例选择，提出了一种鲁棒的主动学习方法。将示例选择形式化为一个有约束的实验设计问题，考虑了异方差性、分区拟阵约束和模型错误指定。提出了一种分层贪心算法，最大化异方差互信息目标，并证明了近似保证。实验表明，该方法在减少标注努力的同时保持了高检索准确率。
Motivation: 在文本到SQL系统中，高质量的标注示例银行至关重要但成本高昂。现有主动学习框架面临查询依赖的标注可靠性变化、语义主题的空间多样性要求和嵌入空间协方差结构未知的挑战。
Method: 将示例选择形式化为有约束的实验设计问题，提出一种分层贪心算法，最大化异方差互信息目标。理论证明目标函数在内在流形上具有次模性和近似单调性，并给出了常数因子近似保证，且当核函数与实际过程偏离时近似保证优雅退化。
Result: 实验结果表明，所提策略显著减少了标注努力，同时保持了高文本到SQL检索准确率。
Conclusion: 本文的方法在异方差、分区拟阵约束和模型错误指定下有效，适用于少样本文本到SQL示例选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedSteer: Taming Extreme Gradient Staleness in Federated Learning with Corrective Projections and Caching
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is often subject to aggregation variance if clients do not consistently participate in training rounds. While reusing stale model updates from inactive clients is a common technique to reduce this variance, we find that with skewed client participation, the resulting update staleness can become severe enough to destabilize training. To remedy this, we propose FedSteer, a novel method that constructs a gradient subspace from a cache of recent client gradients to serve as a low-dimensional representation of the current optimization landscape. FedSteer projects an active client's true gradient onto this subspace to find a set of optimal coordinates. For an inactive client, FedSteer reuses these coordinates with the now-evolved subspace drifted by other active clients. This process effectively "steers" outdated gradients toward the current global objective. This is complemented by a selective caching strategy that identifies a representative client subset to form the subspace, reducing server memory. Experiments demonstrate that FedSteer significantly outperforms baselines, preventing performance collapse in challenging scenarios while delivering accuracy gains of over 7% in others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSteer 提出了一种联邦学习方法，通过构建梯度子空间和选择性缓存来缓解客户端不活跃导致的梯度陈旧性问题。实验表明，该方法在极端场景下防止性能崩溃，并在其他场景中准确率提升超过7%。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端参与不均会导致聚合方差，重用陈旧梯度虽可减少方差，但陈旧性严重时可能破坏训练稳定性。
Method: 从近期客户端梯度缓存中构建梯度子空间作为低维优化景观表示；对于活跃客户端，将真实梯度投影到子空间找到最优坐标；对于不活跃客户端，利用其他活跃客户端演化的子空间来“导向”陈旧梯度。同时采用选择性缓存策略减少服务器内存。
Result: 实验显示FedSteer显著优于基线，在挑战性场景中防止性能崩溃，在其他场景中准确率提升超过7%。
Conclusion: FedSteer通过梯度子空间投影和缓存有效应对梯度陈旧性，提升了联邦学习的鲁棒性和性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence Rates for Neural-Network Estimation with Current-Status Data
papers.abstract_en: Current-status data arise when an event time is observed only through an indicator of whether it occurred before an examination time. This paper studies a nonparametric neural-network sieve maximum likelihood estimator of the conditional cumulative distribution function of the event time. Under Hölder smoothness assumptions, we establish an explicit convergence rate by combining approximation theory for rectified linear unit neural networks with empirical-process arguments. This result provides theoretical support for neural-network estimation and subsequent inference under current-status observation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当前状态数据（current-status data）下事件时间条件累积分布函数的非参数神经网络筛子最大似然估计。在Hölder光滑性假设下，结合ReLU神经网络逼近理论和经验过程论证，建立了显式收敛速度。该结果为当前状态观测下的神经网络估计和后续推断提供了理论支持。
Motivation: 当前状态数据仅通过事件是否在检查时间之前发生的指标来观测事件时间，需要有效的非参数估计方法，但神经网络在该类数据下的理论性质尚不明确。
Method: 采用非参数神经网络筛子最大似然估计，使用ReLU激活函数的神经网络，并通过经验过程理论推导收敛速度。
Result: 在Hölder光滑性假设下，建立了非参数神经网络筛子最大似然估计的显式收敛速度。
Conclusion: 该结果为当前状态观测下基于神经网络的估计和后续推断提供了理论支持。

papers.title: Improving PET/CT-Based Whole-Body Lesion Segmentation Using Prediction Uncertainty-Augmented Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate lesion segmentation from whole-body Positron Emission Tomography (PET)/Computed Tomography (CT) scans is essential for cancer staging and treatment planning. PET provides functional metabolic information with different radiotracers, while CT offers anatomical localization. Lesion delineation from PET/CT imaging is clinically challenging due to subtle imaging features, confounders, and inter-reader variability. Existing deep learning approaches suffer from training-related stochasticity, inconsistent predictions, missed lesions in high tumor-burden cases, and lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their clinical reliability. Using nnU-Net as a baseline, we propose an uncertainty-aware framework for whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation that integrates (1) Bayesian ensembling to reduce training stochasticity, (2) voxel-wise uncertainty quantification with epistemic and aleatoric decomposition, and (3) epistemic uncertainty-augmented training to improve lesion detection. Two public datasets, AutoPET-III (1,611 scans) and Deep-PSMA (200 scans), comprising FDG and PSMA studies across multiple cancer types, are used for training and evaluation. Bayesian ensembling improves robustness and performance over deterministic nnU-Net models on the unseen AutoPET-III test set. Uncertainty maps highlight regions of model disagreement and correlate with misclassifications, particularly false positives. Uncertainty-augmented training improves lesion recovery at the cost of increased FPVol, reflecting a precision-recall trade-off. A case-adaptive routing strategy further improves Dice by selecting between the base and augmented models. To our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically investigate uncertainty quantification in multi-tracer, pan-cancer PET/CT segmentation and to combine Bayesian ensembling with uncertainty-aware modeling for this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对PET/CT全身病灶分割中训练随机性、预测不一致以及缺乏不确定性量化的问题，以nnU-Net为基线，提出一个不确定性感知框架。该框架整合了贝叶斯集成以降低训练随机性、体素不确定性量化（分解为认知和偶然不确定性）以及认知不确定性增强训练。在AutoPET-III（1611例）和Deep-PSMA（200例）两个公开数据集上评估，贝叶斯集成提升了模型鲁棒性和性能；不确定性图揭示了模型不一致区域并与误分类相关；不确定性增强训练在增加假阳性体积的条件下改善了病灶恢复，体现了精确率-召回率权衡；案例自适应路由策略进一步提升了Dice分数。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在PET/CT病灶分割中受训练随机性、预测不一致、高肿瘤负荷病例漏诊以及缺乏不确定性量化等局限，限制了临床可靠性。
Method: 提出不确定性感知分割框架，包含：1) 贝叶斯集成（多个确定性nnU-Net模型集成）以减少训练随机性；2) 体素不确定性量化并分解为认知不确定性和偶然不确定性；3) 认知不确定性增强训练，利用不确定性图指导模型关注高不确定区域以改善病灶检测。
Result: 在未见过的AutoPET-III测试集上，贝叶斯集成相比确定性nnU-Net提升了鲁棒性和性能。不确定性图显示出模型不一致区域，并与假阳性等误分类相关。不确定性增强训练提高了病灶召回率（代价是增加假阳性体积），揭示了精确率-召回率权衡。案例自适应路由策略（在基线和增强模型间选择）进一步提升了Dice分数。
Conclusion: 这是首次在多示踪剂（FDG和PSMA）、泛癌种PET/CT分割中系统性研究不确定性量化，并将贝叶斯集成与不确定性感知建模相结合的工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emotion Profiling in LLM-Based Literary Translation: Systematic Shifts Across MT and Post-Editing
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether LLM translations exhibit identifiable emotional profiles and how post-editing reshapes them toward human-like norms. We compare LLM translations of Margaret Atwood's Oryx and Crake with their post-edited versions and a human translation, using a large-scale corpus of contemporary Italian science-fiction as a baseline. We examine emotion through lexicon-based and multilingual modeling, conducting a fine-grained analysis of emotional variation across systems. We find that MT systems introduce model-specific and statistically significant emotional fingerprints across translations, leading to a limited preservation of an author's voice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的文学翻译中是否存在可识别的情感轮廓，并对比机器翻译与人工翻译的情感差异。通过分析Margaret Atwood小说《Oryx and Crake》的LLM翻译、后编辑版本及人工翻译，结合意大利语当代科幻语料库基线，使用词典和多语言建模进行细粒度情感分析。发现机器翻译引入模型特定且统计显著的情感指纹，导致作者声音的保留有限。
Motivation: 机器翻译（尤其是LLM）在文学翻译中可能引入情感偏差，但缺乏系统性研究。本文旨在量化LLM翻译的情感特征，并评估后编辑如何使其趋近人类翻译规范。
Method: 使用基于词典的情感分析和多语言模型，对同一源文本的多种翻译版本（包括LLM直译、后编辑版和人工翻译）进行情感分布比较，并以大规模当代意大利科幻语料作为参考基线。
Result: 不同LLM系统产生可辨识且统计显著的情感指纹，与人工翻译和基线语料存在系统性差异，且作者的情感风格在机器翻译中保留有限。
Conclusion: LLM文学翻译会引入模型特定的情感偏移，后编辑能部分修正但无法完全消除，表明机器翻译在情感维度上尚未达到人工翻译的细腻度。

papers.title: Duality for Optimal Multi-Item, Multi-Bidder Auction Design: Revenue Certificates through Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing revenue-optimal auctions for multi-item, multi-bidder settings remains a fundamental open problem, with no known closed-form solution existing beyond restrictive binary-type instances. This has motivated interest in computational approaches to optimal auction design. In this paper, we introduce the first computational framework that directly tackles the dual problem for multi-item, multi-bidder auctions and dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC), generating certified revenue upper bounds. Our approach parametrizes Lagrange multipliers with a structurally guaranteed strict flow-conservation property using neural networks, enabling efficient optimization over feasible dual solutions via gradient descent. To bridge the gap between discrete computational methods and theoretical guarantees for continuous types, we develop a novel lifting technique that maps dual certificates from coarse discretizations to fine refinements. We prove that lifting gives valid revenue upper bounds for multi-item, multi-bidder auctions with continuous uniform valuations. Furthermore, we give a generalized lifting construction for arbitrary continuous distributions and demonstrate that these lifted duals converge to the revenue of the original continuous problem in the discrete limit. We validate this computational framework for the dual auction design problem by recovering known analytical mechanisms for canonical instances. For multi-item multi-bidder problems, our framework establishes a small gap between the optimal revenue and best-known DSIC mechanisms, providing computational certificates of near-optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个计算框架，通过深度学习解决多物品多投标人拍卖的收益上界对偶问题，生成认证的收益上界。方法利用神经网络参数化拉格朗日乘子并满足严格流守恒性质，通过梯度下降优化对偶解。开发了一种提升技术（lifting），将对偶证书从粗离散化映射到精细离散化，并证明在连续均匀估值下有效，且推广到任意连续分布。框架在典型实例上恢复了已知解析机制，并在多物品多投标人问题中建立了最优收益与已知DSIC机制之间的微小间隙，提供近最优性的计算证书。
Motivation: 多物品多投标人拍卖的收益最优特征仍是一个基本开放问题，除受限二元类型实例外没有已知闭式解，需要计算方法。
Method: 引入第一个直接处理多物品多投标人拍卖对偶问题及占优策略激励相容（DSIC）的计算框架：用神经网络参数化具有严格流守恒性质的拉格朗日乘子，通过梯度下降优化可行对偶解；并开发提升技术将对偶证书从粗离散化映射到精细离散化，证明在连续均匀估值和任意连续分布下有效。
Result: 框架在典型实例中恢复已知解析机制；对于多物品多投标人问题，建立了最优收益与已知DSIC机制之间的微小间隙，提供了近最优性的计算证书。
Conclusion: 该计算对偶框架能够为多物品多投标人拍卖生成认证的收益上界，并在离散极限下收敛到原连续问题的最优收益，为计算最优拍卖提供了实用方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nonlinear Estimator: Dual Bayesian Affine Estimators for Parameter Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a nonlinear parameter estimator for Wiener-type state-space models obtained as a fixed-point architecture that couples two affine minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) estimators: one for the unknown parameters and one for latent variables. The architecture retains the functional structure of the optimal affine MMSE parameter estimator while incorporating Dynamic Basis Statistics (DBS) estimates that summarize nonlinear basis-function evaluations. Two DBS construction strategies are developed, leading to two nonlinear estimator frameworks. The dual basis-parameter estimator combines an affine basis estimator with the affine parameter estimator, whereas the dual state-parameter estimator first computes affine state estimates and their covariances, then maps these state-estimate statistics through a Gaussian DBS operator to obtain DBS estimates. Both dual estimators admit fixed-point characterizations that alternate between estimating each component using the updated prior of the other, obtained from that component's plug-in estimate statistics from the previous iteration. The efficacy of the proposed methods is examined via extensive Monte Carlo experiments, showing that the dual basis-parameter estimator attains parameter mean-squared errors comparable to those of the purely affine parameter estimator, while the dual state-parameter estimator achieves the lowest parameter mean-squared error, outperforming both the dual basis-parameter and purely affine parameter estimators, as well as sequential Monte Carlo variants of classical Particle Gibbs and Expectation-Maximization schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对Wiener型状态空间模型的非线性参数估计器，其核心是一个固定点架构，耦合了两个仿射最小均方误差估计器：一个用于未知参数，一个用于潜变量。该架构保留了最优仿射MMSE参数估计器的功能结构，同时引入动态基统计量（DBS）来总结非线性基函数评估。文中发展了两种DBS构建策略，分别得到双基-参数估计器和双状态-参数估计器。蒙特卡洛实验表明，双状态-参数估计器实现了最低的参数均方误差，优于仿射估计器和序贯蒙特卡洛变体。
Motivation: 现有参数估计方法（如仿射MMSE、粒子吉布斯、期望最大化）在非线性状态空间模型中性能有限，需要一种能结合非线性信息且保持计算可行性的新方法。
Method: 提出非线性参数估计器的固定点架构，通过交替更新两个仿射MMSE估计器（参数和潜变量），并使用DBS（动态基统计量）汇总非线性基函数值。两种DBS策略：双基-参数估计器直接估计基统计量；双状态-参数估计器先计算仿射状态估计及其协方差，再通过高斯DBS算子映射。
Result: 蒙特卡洛实验表明：双基-参数估计器达到与纯仿射参数估计器相当的参数均方误差；双状态-参数估计器取得最低参数均方误差，优于双基-参数估计器、纯仿射参数估计器以及粒子吉布斯和期望最大化的序贯蒙特卡洛变体。
Conclusion: 所提出的非线性估计器框架在Wiener型状态空间模型的参数学习上有效，特别是双状态-参数估计器实现了最优性能，且固定点结构为理论分析提供了基础。

summary_sections.result: 蒙特卡洛实验表明：双基-参数估计器达到与纯仿射参数估计器相当的参数均方误差；双状态-参数估计器取得最低参数均方误差，优于双基-参数估计器、纯仿射参数估计器以及粒子吉布斯和期望最大化的序贯蒙特卡洛变体。
summary_sections.conclusion: 所提出的非线性估计器框架在Wiener型状态空间模型的参数学习上有效，特别是双状态-参数估计器实现了最优性能，且固定点结构为理论分析提供了基础。

papers.title: Maximum Matching Accuracy: An Instance Segmentation Evaluation Metric Utilizing Globally Optimal Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of instance segmentation models requires metrics that accurately and consistently reflect segmentation quality. However, the metrics most widely used in biological imaging carry fundamental mathematical weaknesses: hard Intersection-over-Union (IoU) thresholds that produce discontinuous, low sensitivity scoring; per-object normalization that distorts scores under object size variation; and greedy or one-to-many matching procedures that yield non-optimal, order-dependent correspondences. Together, these properties produce unintuitive and unreliable model rankings under common failure modes such as split cells, merged cells, and cell boundary imprecision. We propose Maximum Matching Accuracy (MMA), a threshold-free continuous metric that finds a globally optimal one-to-one matching between predicted and ground truth objects and aggregates total overlap using per-pixel normalization. We evaluate MMA against AP@50, PQ, SEG, and AJI across three experiments: synthetic failure cases, progressive corruption tests, and a model ranking comparison. MMA produces scores that are more stable, more sensitive, and more interpretable than existing alternatives, providing a principled foundation for fair instance segmentation benchmarking in biological cell imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Maximum Matching Accuracy (MMA)，一种用于实例分割评估的无阈值连续指标，通过全局最优的一对一匹配和逐像素归一化聚合总重叠。实验表明，相比 AP@50、PQ、SEG 和 AJI，MMA 在合成失败案例、渐进污染测试和模型排名比较中更稳定、更敏感且更可解释，为生物细胞成像中的公平实例分割基准测试提供了原则性基础。
Motivation: 现有生物成像实例分割评估指标（如硬 IoU 阈值、每对象归一化、贪婪匹配）存在数学缺陷，导致评分不连续、低敏感、扭曲分数和顺序依赖的对应关系，在常见失败模式（分裂细胞、合并细胞、边界不精确）下产生不可靠的模型排名。
Method: 提出 MMA，一种无阈值连续指标，通过全局最优的一对一匹配找到预测与真实对象之间的对应关系，并使用逐像素归一化聚合总重叠。
Result: 在三个实验（合成失败案例、渐进污染测试、模型排名比较）中，MMA 产生比 AP@50、PQ、SEG 和 AJI 更稳定、更敏感、更可解释的分数。
Conclusion: MMA 为生物细胞成像中的公平实例分割基准测试提供了原则性基础。

papers.title: What makes a harness a harness: necessary and sufficient conditions for an agent harness
papers.abstract_en: The term agent harness now circulates widely in software engineering with generative artificial intelligence. It names the layer that wraps a language model and turns it into a coding agent able to act on a repository. The usage is loose and polysemous. Sometimes the term denotes the whole product (Claude Code, Codex CLI); sometimes it denotes the evaluation scaffold that runs an agent against tasks (the SWE-bench harness); sometimes it gets conflated with an agent framework, an SDK, an IDE plugin, or an orchestrator. What is missing is a reference definition that works as an instrument, one that includes and excludes cases consistently. We build that definition through a conceptual analysis that combines works with persistent identifiers and primary grey-literature sources, such as official documentation, glossaries, and engineering reports. We reconstruct the genealogy of the term, from the horse's tack to the classic test harness, to the machine-learning evaluation harness, and finally to the agent harness. We then propose a constitutive definition that states the necessary and sufficient conditions for a system to be an agent harness, we operationalize it as an inclusion and exclusion test, and we draw the boundary of the concept against an agent framework, an agent SDK, an IDE plugin, an eval harness, and an orchestrator. We apply the definition to six real harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Aider, Cline, OpenHands, and SWE-agent) and to deliberate edge cases; the test includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized by design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition of agent harness, with a shared vocabulary, able to guide engineering practice and the scientific comparison of agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过概念分析，构建了 agent harness（代理马具）的操作性定义，给出其必要充分条件，并开发了包含/排除测试。作者从词源学追溯该术语的演变，将其与代理框架、SDK、IDE 插件、评估马具等概念区分开来，并应用于六个实际系统（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Aider、Cline、OpenHands、SWE-agent）及故意设计的边缘案例，测试结果一致。最后提出一个围绕设计张力轴的研究议程。
Motivation: 术语“agent harness”在生成式 AI 软件工程中广泛使用，但含义模糊、多义，常与代理框架、SDK、IDE 插件等混淆，缺乏一个能一致包含和排除案例的参考定义，阻碍工程实践和科学比较。
Method: 采用概念分析方法，结合持久标识符的文献和主要灰色文献（官方文档、术语表、工程报告），重建术语谱系；提出包含必要充分条件的构成性定义，并将其操作化为包含/排除测试，划定与相邻概念（代理框架、代理 SDK、IDE 插件、评估马具、编排器）的边界。
Result: 定义应用于六个真实 agent harness 和边缘案例，包含/排除测试结果一致；贡献了一个操作性定义和共享词汇表，能够指导工程实践和智能体系统的科学比较。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个清晰的 agent harness 操作性定义，能够统一术语使用，并为未来研究提供了基于设计张力轴的研究议程。该定义不包括代理框架、SDK、IDE 插件等。

papers.title: Unsupervised Style Representation Learning for AI-Text Detection via Paraphrase Inversion
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has raised concerns about misuse such as plagiarism, misinformation, and automated influence operations, motivating the need for robust detectors. Recent work has shown that neural representations of writing style are effective for detection and, crucially, robust to adversarial attacks that defeat most existing detectors. However, current style-based detectors rely on authorship labels for training, and are limited to few-shot inference for detection, requiring in-distribution samples that may not always be available. We learn discriminative style features without authorship labels by training a style encoder to reconstruct human-authored text from its machine-generated paraphrase; freezing a semantic encoder during training biases the style encoder to capture only the non-semantic features needed for reconstruction. We evaluate the learned representations via two detection strategies: a few-shot detector and a zero-shot DeepSVDD-based detector. Across benchmarks, our method matches or outperforms all baselines in the few-shot setting and, in the zero-shot regime, is competitive with fully supervised classifiers on in-distribution test data while generalizing better to unseen LLMs. Beyond detection, the learned representations generalize to unseen tasks, achieving competitive performance on authorship verification and fine-grained style discrimination despite never being trained on either objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的风格表示学习方法，通过释义反转任务训练风格编码器：从机器生成的释义中重建人类撰写的原始文本，同时冻结语义编码器以迫使风格编码器仅捕捉非语义特征。该方法无需作者标签，学习到的风格表示可用于AI文本检测（包括少样本和零样本设置），并在多个基准上匹配或超越监督基线，且在未见过的LLM上泛化更好。此外，这些表示还泛化到作者验证和细粒度风格区分任务。
Motivation: 现有基于风格的AI文本检测器依赖作者标签进行训练，且仅能进行少样本推理，需要可能无法获取的分布内样本。本文旨在无需作者标签的情况下学习判别性风格特征。
Method: 训练一个风格编码器，通过释义反转任务：从机器生成的释义中重建人类撰写的原始文本；训练过程中冻结语义编码器，迫使风格编码器仅捕捉重建所需的非语义特征。
Result: 在多个基准上，该方法在少样本设置下匹配或超越所有基线；在零样本设置下，与全监督分类器在分布内测试数据上具有竞争力，且对未见过的LLM泛化更好。此外，表示还泛化到作者验证和细粒度风格区分任务。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无监督风格表示学习可以有效用于AI文本检测，无需作者标签，且具有更好的泛化能力。

papers.title: Predictive Assistance and the Temporal Dynamics of Exploratory Compression
papers.abstract_en: Classical theories of cognition describe problem solving as exploratory search through structured problem spaces in which repeated interaction gradually compresses search into efficient representational structures. Predictive artificial intelligence systems introduce a distinct regime in which stabilization may occur before exploratory diversification unfolds, supplying solutions and decision trajectories prior to internally generated search. This paper develops a geometric dynamical framework in which attention evolves over a landscape of strategies shaped by stabilizing drift, endogenous exploratory perturbation, and responsiveness-gated learning. Predictive assistance is modeled as a process of exogenous exploratory compression that stabilizes trajectories before self-generated exploration broadens the accessible regions of strategy space. The framework yields three main results. First, sustained predictive stabilization reduces exploratory responsiveness by attenuating the effective influence of intrinsic perturbations even when exploratory variability remains present. Second, curvature accumulates and relaxes asymmetrically, producing hysteresis and delayed recovery of exploratory mobility after assistance withdrawal. Third, developmental outcomes depend critically on the timing of stabilization, with early intervention narrowing future exploratory traversal before broad representational diversification has occurred. The framework generates empirically testable predictions concerning exploratory entropy, premature convergence, and delayed recovery following predictive stabilization. More broadly, the results suggest that predictive systems may reshape the geometry of exploratory cognition itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个几何动力学框架，研究预测性人工智能辅助如何改变认知中的探索性压缩过程。该框架将注意力建模为在策略景观上的演化，受稳定漂移、内源探索扰动和响应性门控学习的影响。预测性辅助被视为外源探索性压缩，它在自主探索拓宽策略空间之前稳定轨迹。
Motivation: 经典认知理论认为问题解决是通过结构化问题空间的探索性搜索逐步压缩为高效表征，而预测性AI引入了在探索多样化展开之前就可能发生稳定的新机制。
Method: 建立几何动力学框架，将注意力演化建模为受稳定漂移、内源探索扰动和响应性门控学习影响的策略景观上的过程，并通过外源探索性压缩模型预测性辅助。
Result: 框架给出三个主要结果：1) 持续预测稳定通过减弱内源扰动影响降低探索响应性；2) 曲率不对称积累与松弛导致滞后和辅助撤除后探索能力的延迟恢复；3) 发展结果关键依赖于稳定时机，早期干预在广泛表征多样化之前限制未来探索遍历。
Conclusion: 该框架生成关于预测稳定后探索熵、过早收敛和延迟恢复的可检验预测，表明预测系统可能重塑探索性认知的几何结构。

papers.title: Decision-Making under Combinatorial Risk
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making under risk is typically studied through single-shot lottery choices. Yet many real decisions involve combinatorial risk, where risk arises from multiple risky components, so the lottery over outcomes is induced rather than given outright and can be costly to evaluate exactly. We introduce an investment-allocation task to study decision under combinatorial risk, where investing in a component raises its success probability and thereby reshapes the outcome distribution. Participants favor the option with the larger probability increment, and, when increments are equal, the option with the higher initial success probability. Revealing the induced probability mass function (PMF) substantially changes behavior, making participants less responsive to combinatorial-risk features and reducing choice variance. To explain these patterns, we move beyond standard benchmarks and hand-crafted hypotheses with symbolic regression to discover compact descriptive models. The discovered models rely mainly on combinatorial-risk features, such as the after-investment success probability, rather than exact evaluation of the full induced distribution. Behavior under the displayed PMF is then well explained by augmenting this model with a prospect-theoretic residual model. The results show that people navigate combinatorial risk primarily through its core features, shifting toward lottery valuation only when the induced PMF is displayed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组合风险下的决策问题，通过投资分配任务实验发现，参与者倾向于选择成功概率增量更大的选项，并受初始成功概率影响；展示诱导的概率质量函数会显著改变行为。作者利用符号回归发现简洁的描述性模型，揭示人们主要通过组合风险的核心特征（如投资后成功概率）而非精确评估完整分布来决策。
Motivation: 现实决策常涉及组合风险（多个风险组件共同影响结果），但传统研究多集中于单次抽奖选择，缺乏对组合风险下决策机制的理解。
Method: 设计投资分配任务实验，操纵每个组件的投资与成功概率变化；引入符号回归（symbolic regression）自动发现简洁的描述性模型，并对比展示/不展示诱导概率质量函数的行为差异。
Result: 参与者偏向概率增量更大的选项，增量相同时偏好初始概率更高的选项；展示概率质量函数后，参与者的选择对组合风险特征敏感性降低且方差减小。符号回归发现的模型主要依赖投资后成功概率等组合风险特征，而非完整分布；加入前景理论残差模型可解释展示PMF后的行为。
Conclusion: 人们主要利用组合风险的核心特征进行决策，仅在清晰展示诱导概率质量函数时才转向基于彩票估值的方式。

summary_sections.motivation: 现实决策常涉及组合风险（多个风险组件共同影响结果），但传统研究多集中于单次抽奖选择，缺乏对组合风险下决策机制的理解。
summary_sections.method: 设计投资分配任务实验，操纵每个组件的投资与成功概率变化；引入符号回归（symbolic regression）自动发现简洁的描述性模型，并对比展示/不展示诱导概率质量函数的行为差异。
summary_sections.result: 参与者偏向概率增量更大的选项，增量相同时偏好初始概率更高的选项；展示概率质量函数后，参与者的选择对组合风险特征敏感性降低且方差减小。符号回归发现的模型主要依赖投资后成功概率等组合风险特征，而非完整分布；加入前景理论残差模型可解释展示PMF后的行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人们主要利用组合风险的核心特征进行决策，仅在清晰展示诱导概率质量函数时才转向基于彩票估值的方式。

papers.title: SoK: Colluding Adversaries in Machine Learning Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) models are susceptible to various security, privacy, and fairness risks. Adversaries with different characteristics (i.e., objectives, knowledge, and capabilities) can collude by executing one attack to amplify others. Existing work lacks a systematic framework to explore collusion among adversaries, and to study the implications of the adversaries' characteristics. We present a framework covering collusion (a) between train- and inference-time adversaries, and (b) among inference-time adversaries. Our framework accounts for factors enabling collusion between adversaries. We propose a guideline to conjecture about the potential for collusion using enabling factors. We use it to explain prior work, conjecture about unexplored collusions, and empirically validate five such cases. Finally, we discuss how adversaries' characteristics influence the potential for collusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个系统化框架，用于探索机器学习流水线中训练阶段和推理阶段对手的合谋（collusion），以及推理阶段对手之间的合谋。框架考虑了促进合谋的因素，并提出了基于这些因素推测合谋可能性的指南。作者用该框架解释现有工作、推测未探索的合谋，并实证验证了五种新合谋场景。最后讨论了对手特征如何影响合谋的可能性。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个系统化框架来探索机器学习流水线中不同特征（目标、知识、能力）的对手如何相互合谋以放大攻击效果。
Method: 提出一个覆盖训练-推理对手合谋及推理对手间合谋的框架，包含促进合谋的因素（enabling factors），并设计基于这些因素的推测指南。通过解释现有合谋工作、推测未探索的合谋，并实证验证五个案例来展示框架效用。
Result: 框架能解释现有攻击合谋现象，成功推测出五种未被探索的合谋场景并得到实证验证。
Conclusion: 对手的特征（目标、知识、能力）显著影响合谋的潜力；该框架为系统性研究合谋攻击提供了基础。

papers.title: A Theory on Flow Matching with Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we develop theoretical foundation for flow matching with neural-network-parameterized conditional velocity fields. We establish convergence guarantees for gradient descent in the over-parameterized 2-layered ReLU neural network regime. We derive generalization bounds for the conditional velocity-field matching objective. Building on these results, we provide Wasserstein-distance guarantees for the samples generated by the induced flow. Our analysis is based on generalization bound for multi-task representation learning with unbounded losses, which may be of independent interest beyond flow-based generative modeling. These theoretical results are validated through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world image benchmarks.

papers.title: Interpretable Temporal Facial-Region Motion Analysis for In-the-Wild Parkinson's Disease Video Classification
papers.abstract_en: Reduced facial expressivity is a common motor manifestation of Parkinson's disease (PD), often described as hypomimia or facial bradykinesia. This paper examines whether temporal motion descriptors extracted from facial-region keypoints can support in-the-wild PD-related video classification on the YouTubePD benchmark. Each video is represented using geometric descriptors from 14 predefined facial regions. Static geometry, normalized geometry, velocity-based descriptors, relative-velocity descriptors, and a GRU sequence baseline are compared under the same binary classification protocol. To assess stability and interpretability, the study includes seed-robustness analysis, region-level ablation, and permutation importance. The best result is obtained with normalized velocity descriptors and a Random Forest classifier, reaching a balanced accuracy of 0.826 and an AUROC of 0.855 on the held-out test split. Across 10 random seeds, this representation remains stable, with balanced accuracy of 0.810 +/- 0.018 and AUROC of 0.855 +/- 0.005. Overall, the results suggest that normalized facial-region motion is a lightweight and interpretable representation for YouTubePD video classification. The study is framed as a benchmark-level analysis and does not claim clinical severity assessment or MDS-UPDRS facial-expression scoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从面部区域关键点提取时间运动描述符，用于野外帕金森病（PD）视频分类。在YouTubePD基准上，使用归一化速度描述符和随机森林分类器达到平衡准确率0.826和AUROC 0.855。结果表明归一化面部区域运动是一种轻量且可解释的表示方法。
Motivation: 面部表情减少（运动迟缓）是帕金森病的常见运动症状，但现有的视频分类方法缺乏可解释性或难以在野外场景中鲁棒运行。
Method: 提取14个预定义面部区域的几何描述符，包括静态几何、归一化几何、速度描述符、相对速度描述符，并比较GRU序列基线。使用随机森林分类器和归一化速度描述符。
Result: 归一化速度描述符+随机森林在测试集上达到平衡准确率0.826和AUROC 0.855。在10个随机种子上，平衡准确率稳定在0.810±0.018，AUROC为0.855±0.005。
Conclusion: 归一化面部区域运动是YouTubePD视频分类的轻量且可解释表示，但本研究仅限于基准级别分析，不涉及临床严重性评估或MDS-UPDRS面部表情评分。

papers.title: CodeAlchemy: Synthetic Code Rewriting at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training on raw code teaches syntax but provides sparse signal for diverse real-world task formats. While synthetic data has proven transformative for language models, code remains largely unexplored beyond limited quality improvements. We present CodeAlchemy, a synthetic data generation framework that transforms publicly sourced code into semantically-rich training data through 5 strategies: CodeEnhance (quality-aware rewriting), CodeQA (template-based problems), CodeDev (developer tasks), CodeDialogue (multi-turn conversations), and CodeTrace (execution traces). We process 3 corpora across 15 languages to generate 500B+ tokens of synthetic data plus 350B reasoning tokens, orders of magnitude more than prior efforts. CodeTrace instruments and executes 1.3M+ files across 14 languages and 5K libraries, capturing control flow, state tracking, and library knowledge. We introduce DevEval (developer tasks) and TraceEval (execution prediction) benchmarks; frontier models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieve only 5.6% exact match on TraceEval, revealing critical gaps in semantic understanding. Our 3B models achieve 83.5% on HumanEval, 63.2% on MBPP, 8.09% win rate on DevEval, and 15.36 ROUGE-2 on TraceEval, outperforming frontier models 10x the size including 27B Gemma-3 and 32B Granite-4.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeAlchemy 合成数据生成框架，通过 CodeEnhance、CodeQA、CodeDev、CodeDialogue、CodeTrace 五种策略，从公开源码生成超过 500B token 合成数据和 350B 推理 token，覆盖 15 种语言和 3 个语料库。在 DevEval 和 TraceEval 新基准上，3B 模型在 HumanEval 达到 83.5%，MBPP 达到 63.2%，超越 27B Gemma-3 等大 10 倍模型，而前沿模型 Claude Sonnet 4.5 在 TraceEval 上仅 5.6% 精确匹配，揭示语义理解不足。
Motivation: 预训练于原始代码能学习语法，但缺乏多样真实任务格式的丰富信号；合成数据在语言模型中已显效，但在代码领域规模和质量仍有限。
Method: 提出 CodeAlchemy 框架，包含五种合成策略：CodeEnhance（质量感知重写）、CodeQA（模板问题）、CodeDev（开发者任务）、CodeDialogue（多轮对话）、CodeTrace（执行轨迹）。处理 15 种语言共 3 个语料库，生成 500B+ token 合成数据与 350B 推理 token，并引入 DevEval 和 TraceEval 基准评估。
Result: 3B 模型在 HumanEval 上达 83.5%，MBPP 上 63.2%，DevEval 上 8.09% 胜率，TraceEval 上 15.36 ROUGE-2；相比之下，Claude Sonnet 4.5 在 TraceEval 上仅 5.6% 精确匹配，说明执行轨迹任务极具挑战。
Conclusion: 大规模合成数据可显著提升代码模型的语义理解能力，尤其是执行轨迹数据暴露了当前前沿模型的严重缺陷，为未来研究提供方向。

papers.title: Exploratory Responsiveness and Adaptive Rigidity under AI-Assisted Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory of exploratory adaptation under AI-assisted optimization. The central argument is that the long-run adaptive effects of AI systems depend critically on how predictive assistance interacts with exploratory responsiveness itself. We formalize this mechanism using a dynamical framework in which cognitive, institutional, and technological systems evolve over rugged epistemic landscapes characterized by multiple locally reinforced configurations. A central state variable in the model is adaptive responsiveness, which measures the capacity of a system to traverse unfamiliar conceptual and institutional trajectories under changing conditions. Under convergent predictive regimes, AI systems substitute for exploratory engagement, reducing adaptive responsiveness and generating metastable trapping, hysteresis, premature convergence, and exploration-collapse dynamics in which systems become locally efficient but globally rigid. The framework also identifies contrasting exploration-enhancing regimes in which AI systems amplify exploratory search, conceptual traversal, and adaptive mobility. The effective substitution parameter is therefore responsiveness-dependent: systems possessing weak exploratory routines are more vulnerable to exploratory substitution, whereas systems already possessing high adaptive responsiveness may use AI assistance to expand exploratory mobility across rugged landscapes. The long-run adaptive effects of AI consequently depend not only on AI capability itself, but also on institutional structure, developmental context, and the architecture of human-machine interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，研究AI辅助优化下的探索性适应，认为AI的长期自适应效应取决于预测性辅助如何与探索性响应性交互。通过动态模型分析认知、制度和技术系统在崎岖知识景观上的演化，识别出两种机制：收敛预测机制会导致探索替代、响应性降低和系统陷入局部高效全局刚性；而探索增强机制则能扩大适应性移动。
Motivation: 现有研究未充分考虑AI系统长期自适应效应中探索性响应性的关键作用，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释AI如何影响系统的适应能力和演化路径。
Method: 构建一个动态框架，将自适应响应性作为核心状态变量，建模AI辅助优化下系统在多元局部强化配置的知识景观中的适应过程，并分析预测交互主导的收敛机制与探索增强机制。
Result: 发现收敛预测机制下，AI替代探索性参与导致响应性下降、滞后、过早收敛和探索崩溃，系统变得局部高效但全局刚性；相反，探索增强机制可提升适应性移动。
Conclusion: AI的长期自适应效果不仅取决于AI能力本身，还依赖于制度结构、发展背景和人机交互架构，尤其受系统原有的探索性响应水平调节。

papers.title: Structured Adaptive Tensor Prediction for Streaming Data
papers.abstract_en: Matrix-valued time series arise in a wide range of applications, such as spatio-temporal data from medical imaging and geophysics. Existing methods are mainly designed for static settings and lack adaptability to streaming and time-varying environments. Adaptive filtering techniques have also been largely limited to data with scalar or vector values, leaving adaptive forecasting for matrix-valued time series inadequately understood. To bridge these gaps, we develop an adaptive tensor regression framework that includes Matrix-on-Matrix (MoM) and Tensor-on-Matrix (ToM) formulations for streaming matrix-valued prediction. The two formulations differ in whether to directly model matrix-valued outputs or to exploit temporal structure via higher-order tensor representations. For the proposed tensor regression framework, we develop stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithms for online learning. We show that stacking multiple responses across time into higher-order tensors improves performance; in particular, the ToM achieves lower steady-state error and stronger denoising capability than MoM, motivating our focus on the ToM model. We further characterize the tracking behavior of SGD under time-varying dynamics. From a statistical perspective, we establish fixed-time recovery guarantees for ToM under general low-dimensional structures, including sparsity, low-rankness, and their joint sparselow-rank models.

papers.title: Divide-and-Conquer Modeling for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a divide-and-conquer modeling strategy for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz benchmark, which evaluates chaotic-system prediction across twelve hidden scores and five scenario families: clean forecasting, noisy reconstruction, noisy-input forecasting, few-shot learning, and parametric generalization. Rather than forcing one model class to handle all regimes, the final system matched each prediction block to the evaluation behavior of its task group. The main contributions are: smoothing-based reconstruction for noisy full-trajectory denoising; NG-RC/NVAR models tuned for noisy long-time attractor forecasting; a fitted Lorenz transition correction restricted to the sensitive clean short-time prefix; and a parametric prefix blend for the interpolation task. The resulting system with final public score of 79.63 shows that bounded, scenario-specific updates can outperform broad model replacement on mixed chaotic forecasting benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CTF-4-Science Lorenz基准（评估混沌系统预测的12个隐藏分数和五个场景族）提出分治建模策略。最终系统通过为不同任务组（如干净预测、噪声重建、少样本学习等）匹配专用预测模块（平滑去噪、NG-RC/NVAR模型、Lorenz过渡修正等）获得79.63的公开分数，表明有界场景特定更新优于广泛模型替换。
Motivation: 现有方法通常用单一模型处理所有混沌预测场景（清洁预测、噪声重建、参数泛化等），难以在不同任务族上都取得最优性能，需要针对不同任务组定制模型。
Method: 提出分治建模框架，包括：基于平滑的噪声轨迹重建、针对噪声长时吸引子预测的NG-RC/NVAR模型、针对敏感清洁短时前缀的Lorenz过渡修正，以及插值任务的参数前缀混合。
Result: 最终系统在CTF-4-Science Lorenz基准上获得公开分数79.63，验证了有界场景特定更新优于广泛模型替换。
Conclusion: 在混合混沌预测基准上，为不同任务族设计专用且范围受限的模型更新，比使用单一通用模型更有效。

papers.title: VFUSE: Virulent Feature Understanding with Sparse autoEncoders
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have shown remarkable progress in a variety of domains such as protein design, but such power enables the opaque generation of hazardous proteins. In this work, we introduce VFUSE (Virulent Feature Understanding with Sparse autoEncoders), a mechanistic interpretability approach that trains SAEs on diffusion-transformer activations to audit protein models for hazard-aware features. We apply VFUSE to RoseTTAFold3 and RFDiffusion3, popular open-weight models for protein folding and synthesis. We find that for certain blocks, linear probes detect hazardous designs significantly better when fit in the SAE latent space over the original model's representations: improving interpretability without sacrificing model performance. Furthermore, we identify monosemantic features from the SAE that fire only on hazardous designs at up to AUROC $0.84$ ($q < 10^{-13}$). To our knowledge this is the first SAE trained on an all-atom diffusion model and the first feature-level virulence audit of a protein design model, paving the way towards safe and interpretable protein design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VFUSE 方法，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析扩散-Transformer 的激活，以审计蛋白质设计模型中的毒性特征。在 RoseTTAFold3 和 RFDiffusion3 上的实验表明，SAE 潜在空间的线性探针在检测有害设计上优于原始表示，并识别出仅对有害设计响应的单语义特征，AUROC 达 0.84。
Motivation: 生成模型可设计有害蛋白质，亟需可解释性工具审计模型是否包含毒性特征。
Method: 在扩散-Transformer 的激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），利用 SAE 潜在空间进行毒性特征线性探测。
Result: 在特定层，SAE 潜在空间的线性探针检测有害设计的性能显著优于原始表示；SAE 特征中识别出仅对有害设计激活的单元，AUROC 为 0.84（q < 10^{-13}）。
Conclusion: 这是首个在全原子扩散模型上训练的 SAE 和首个特征级蛋白质设计毒性审计，为安全可解释的蛋白质设计奠定基础。
