papers.title: Temporal Sheaf Neural Networks with Dynamic Orthogonal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Temporal Sheaf Neural Networks (TSNN), a temporal link prediction framework that equips each node with a time-varying orthogonal frame and compares node states only after explicit transport between local coordinate systems. In contrast to existing continuous-time graph models that operate in a shared global embedding space, TSNN models node-specific and evolving interaction semantics through dynamic local frames. The model parameterizes per-node frames via efficient low-rank Householder products, preserves stored hidden states exactly under frame updates, and uses a geometric-residual decoder that anchors predictions on transported distances while learning residual corrections. All computations are strictly causal and use only the pre-event history. We show that the symmetric degree-normalized sheaf Laplacian is orthogonally similar to the symmetric normalized graph Laplacian, with the random-walk normalized form similar in the corresponding degree metric; the full-active, feature-scaled diffusion used by TSNN is exactly a metric-gradient step on the combinatorial sheaf Dirichlet energy, with a degree-free monotone-descent and non-expansiveness guarantee. Frame drift perturbs updates only linearly. Across TGB v2 link-prediction and temporal-heterogeneous leaderboards, together with the DGB benchmark suite, TSNN matches or surpasses the strongest prior methods on most benchmarks, with the largest improvements on graphs exhibiting strong node-role heterogeneity. Ablations confirm the distinct benefit of dynamic frames, orthogonal transport, and geometric-residual decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时序层图神经网络 (Temporal Sheaf Neural Networks, TSNN)，通过为每个节点配备时变正交框架并在局部坐标系之间进行显式传输后比较节点状态，实现时序链接预测。与共享全局嵌入空间的连续时间图模型不同，TSNN 利用动态局部框架建模节点特定且不断演化的交互语义。模型通过低秩 Householder 乘积参数化每个节点的框架，在框架更新下精确保留存储的隐藏状态，并使用几何残差解码器基于传输距离进行预测的同时学习残差校正。所有计算严格因果，仅使用事件前历史。实验表明，TSNN 在 TGB v2 链接预测和时序异质排行榜以及 DGB 基准套件上，在多数基准上匹配或超越最强先前方法，尤其是在节点角色异质性强的图上提升最大。
Motivation: 现有连续时间图模型在共享全局嵌入空间中操作，难以捕捉节点特定且动态变化的交互语义，限制了链接预测性能。
Method: 提出 TSNN 框架，每个节点拥有时变正交框架，通过低秩 Householder 乘积参数化；比较节点状态前进行正交传输对齐；使用几何残差解码器，基于传输距离锚定预测并学习残差校正；所有计算严格因果且仅利用历史事件。
Result: 在 TGB v2 链接预测和时序异质排行榜以及 DGB 基准套件上，TSNN 在多数基准上匹配或超越最强先前方法，在节点角色异质性强的图上提升最大；消融实验证实动态框架、正交传输和几何残差解码的独特优势。
Conclusion: TSNN 通过引入动态局部框架和显式正交传输，为时序图学习提供了新的几何视角，尤其适用于节点角色异质性强的动态图。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Seismic Hazard Assessment Using VQ-VAE and Seismic Statistical Features
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we build upon a previous study in which we demonstrated, using XGBoost and earthquake catalogue data from Japan and Chile, that a set of 60 seismic statistical features (SSFs) had much greater predictive value than a set of 428 generic time series features from the tsfresh package. We here extend this previous work in two key ways, focusing on data from Japan as a large dataset is necessary in order to allow for the training of a deep learning (autoencoder) model. First, we move from whole-region prediction (considering, for each candidate event, the likelihood of an event M $\geq$ 5.0 anywhere in the region in the next 15 days) to localised predictions in which both the region of feature computation and the region of prediction are restricted to a circle of radius 24 km around the candidate event, and we show that performance remains excellent, similar to our previous whole-region study for the same area. Second, we here couple this proven set of SSFs, based on one-dimensional (catalogue) data, with a novel feature based on two-dimensional seismic maps, obtained by training a VQ-VAE model to reproduce such maps as output and identifying a measure of its error in doing so with a localised build-up of crustal stress. We show that while localised prediction based on SSFs can be effective alone, with test AUC values as high as those obtained in the case of Japan in our previous whole-region study, the inclusion of the new natively-spatial VQ-VAE-derived feature, top-ranked by SHAP analysis, can enhance performance and additionally appears to near-wholly replace the traditionally-computed $b$-value in terms of feature usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在先前基于XGBoost和地震统计特征（SSFs）的研究基础上，转向局部预测（半径24公里），并引入由VQ-VAE模型从2D地震图中提取的空间特征。实验表明，单独使用SSFs进行局部预测的测试AUC与先前全区域研究相当，而加入VQ-VAE特征后性能进一步提升，且该特征几乎完全替代了传统b值的功能。
Motivation: 先前研究表明SSFs比通用时间序列特征更具预测价值，但仅用于全区域预测；本文旨在实现局部预测，并探索2D空间特征是否能为地震危险性评估带来额外增益。
Method: 使用60维地震统计特征（SSFs）进行局部预测（半径24公里），同时训练VQ-VAE模型生成2D地震图，将其重构误差作为新的空间特征，并结合SHAP分析评估特征重要性。
Result: 局部预测基于SSFs的测试AUC与先前全区域研究相当；加入VQ-VAE特征后性能进一步提升，且SHAP分析显示该特征排名最高，几乎完全替代了传统b值。
Conclusion: 结合1D目录数据（SSFs）和2D空间特征（VQ-VAE误差）可有效进行局部地震危险性评估，VQ-VAE特征具有高预测价值。

papers.title: Importance-Aware Scheduling for High-Dimensional Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) is essential for building high-performing ML/DL models, yet conventional optimizers often struggle in high-dimensional spaces where evaluations are costly and progress is diluted across many low-impact variables. We propose Greedy Importance First (GIF), an importance-aware scheduling strategy that uses a small-sample warm start to estimate hyperparameter importance, forms importance-based groups, allocates trials proportionally, and retains a full-space fallback. We evaluate GIF under fixed evaluation budgets on five anisotropic analytic functions, Bayesmark, and NAS-Bench-301. On the higher-dimensional benchmarks, GIF reaches better incumbents with faster convergence than TPE, BOHB, Random Search, and Sequential Grouping. On Bayesmark, where the effective dimensionality is smaller, GIF remains competitive but the margins are smaller. Ablation studies show that importance estimation, proportional allocation, and the fallback step all contribute to the gains. We also verify that the HIA component recovers the intended anisotropy on the analytic benchmarks. These results suggest that GIF is a simple and plug-compatible way to improve sample efficiency in high-dimensional HPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GIF（贪心重要性优先）调度策略，用于高维超参数优化。通过小样本预热估计超参数重要性，形成重要性分组并比例分配试验，保留全空间后备。在五个各向异性解析函数、Bayesmark和NAS-Bench-301上评估，在高维基准上比TPE、BOHB等收敛更快且找到更好的最优解，在低维基准上仍有竞争力。消融实验表明各组件均有贡献。
Motivation: 传统优化器在高维空间中评估昂贵且进展被大量低影响变量稀释。
Method: 提出GIF（贪心重要性优先）调度策略，利用小样本预热估计超参数重要性，基于重要性分组，按比例分配试验预算，并保留全空间后备。

Conclusion: GIF是一种简单且即插即用的方法，可提升高维HPO的样本效率。

papers.title: A Controlled Audit of Pretraining Contamination in Public Medical Vision-Language Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are evaluated on public benchmarks whose images and question-answer pairs have been freely downloadable for years, yet reported accuracy assumes these examples were absent from pretraining. We audit open VLMs on SLAKE-En, PathVQA, VQA-RAD, and an auxiliary public OmniMedVQA mirror using four detector families: image-side near-neighbour overlap against PMC-OA-beta, canonical-order exchangeability, cohort-relative Min-K%++ tail enrichment, and cross-model top-K overlap. We find measurable image-side source overlap on SLAKE-En: 19.8% of images are flagged under SigLIP-B-16 and 4.2% under SigLIP-SO400M, while out-of-domain controls produce 0/2000 flags. Manual adjudication shows same-modality, same-projection matches to different patients rather than verified pixel-level duplicates, so we interpret this as source or distributional overlap rather than confirmed per-image memorization. On the text side, Qwen2.5-VL on SLAKE-En shows a canonical-order exchangeability signal that survives ordering ablation and external non-medical baselines. On the OmniMedVQA mirror, exchangeability fires for five medical and general VLMs while BLIP-2 remains clean. In contrast, cohort-relative Min-K%++ tail enrichment and cross-model top-K overlap collapse under an external pre-domain baseline: BLIP-2 reproduces the apparent positive signals despite lacking plausible medical-VQA exposure. We conclude that these cohort-relative detectors are unreliable as standalone membership-inference signals on small medical-VLM cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对公开医学视觉语言模型（VLM）基准中的预训练数据污染进行了控制审计。使用四类检测器在SLAKE-En、PathVQA、VQA-RAD和OmniMedVQA镜像上检测图像和文本侧的污染。发现SLAKE-En上有一定图像重叠但非像素级重复，文本侧Qwen2.5-VL显示顺序交换性信号，但队列相对检测器在小型医学VLM队列中不可靠。
Motivation: 医学VLM在公开基准上评估时，假设测试样本在预训练中未被见到，但实际这些数据已存在多年，需要审计预训练污染以正确解释基准结果。
Method: 使用四类检测器：图像侧近邻重叠（基于PMC-OA-beta）、规范顺序可交换性、队列相对Min-K%++尾部富集、跨模型Top-K重叠。在多个医学VQA基准上审计多种开源VLM。
Result: SLAKE-En图像重叠率4.2-19.8%，但经人工判断为同模态同投影不同患者，非像素级重复。文本侧规范顺序可交换性信号在多个VLM上出现，但队列相对检测器在外部基线（BLIP-2）上产生假阳性。
Conclusion: 队列相对检测器在小规模医学VLM队列上作为成员推断信号不可靠。图像侧存在源或分布重叠但非记忆化。文本侧污染信号需谨慎解释。

papers.title: Bittensor Agent Arenas as a Trajectory Primitive: Distilling a Shopping Agent from ShoppingBench Subnet Traces
papers.abstract_en: Small-model agentic post-training is bottlenecked less by the algorithm than by the trajectory substrate it consumes. Leading recipes (RLVR, group-relative RL, rejection-sampled re-SFT) all need multi-turn traces carrying per-trajectory supervision, and the two existing sources fall short: frontier-synthesised data inherits the synthesizer's biases and collapses the long tail, while unfiltered production logs are unjudged and contaminated by shortcut behaviour. We argue that an incentive-aligned agent arena can be engineered to manufacture such trajectories, and demonstrate this on ORO Subnet 15 (SN15), a Bittensor deployment of the ShoppingBench agentic-commerce benchmark. SN15's race mechanism, LLM reasoning judge, and rotating leak-cluster-guarded problem suite yield a corpus with three properties: incentive-aligned diversity, per-trajectory judging, and anti-memorised held-out evaluation. We introduce a structural-quality filter that converts the raw firehose into a trainable corpus by keeping agentic trajectories (the model itself emits the tool calls) and rejecting sub-task trajectories (the model only classifies or narrates over a deterministic search loop), then post-train Qwen3-4B with a recipe matched to the published ShoppingBench SFT-then-GRPO pipeline. On a leak-cluster-guarded held-out partition scored production-strict, the model lifts from the published Qwen3-4B base of 18.0% ASR to 42.7%, within single-problem noise of the synthetic-data SFT-only baseline (43.6%), while training on a fraction of a single day of subnet output. The supervised stack leaves a large pass@8 to pass@1 gap (53.3% vs 34.8%); a per-step teacher-grounded Dr. GRPO reward converts that headroom into process improvement, and we identify the sub-task firehose as the primary lever for closing the gap to the 48.7% SFT+GRPO bar. We release the filter, the corpus splits, and the arena mechanics.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, Data and Models available at: https://huggingface.co/collections/oro-ai/shoppingbench-sn15-trajectory-primitive

TL;DR: 本文提出利用Bittensor子网SN15的购物竞技场（ShoppingBench）产生的轨迹数据来蒸馏小模型购物智能体。通过结构质量过滤器保留自主智能体轨迹（模型自主调用工具），排除子任务轨迹（模型仅分类或搜索），并使用SFT+GRPO管道对Qwen3-4B进行后训练。在泄漏簇保护的留出集上，ASR从18.0%提升至42.7%，接近合成数据SFT基线的43.6%，且仅使用单天子网输出的小部分数据。
Motivation: 小模型的后训练受限于轨迹数据质量：前沿模型合成的数据存在偏差且长尾缺失，生产日志缺乏评判且包含捷径行为。需要一种激励对齐的智能体竞技场来生成多样、有评判且防记忆的轨迹。
Method: 利用Bittensor SN15的竞技场机制（竞赛、LLM推理评判、泄漏簇保护问题集）生成轨迹。引入结构质量过滤器：保留模型自主发出工具调用的智能体轨迹，拒绝仅分类或叙述的子任务轨迹。随后采用ShoppingBench发布的SFT+GRPO管道对Qwen3-4B进行后训练，并尝试Dr. GRPO逐步骤奖励。
Result: 在泄漏簇保护的严格生产划分上，模型ASR从基线18.0%提升至42.7%，与合成数据SFT基线（43.6%）的差异在单问题噪声范围内。pass@8与pass@1之间存在较大差距（53.3% vs 34.8%），Dr. GRPO奖励可将此差距转化为过程改进。
Conclusion: 释放了过滤器、语料划分和竞技场机制。子任务流水被识别为缩小与SFT+GRPO基线（48.7%）差距的主要杠杆。该方法证明激励对齐的竞技场可以高效生成高质量轨迹数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deployment-Time Memorization in Foundation-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model agents are increasingly long-lived systems that remember users across interactions, making memorization an explicit deployment-time function rather than solely a property of model weights. Existing work addresses parametric memorization or audits fixed memory configurations, but does not characterize how memory-design choices jointly shape personalization utility, extraction risk, and deletion fidelity. We study this surface as deployment-time memorization, formulating agent memory as a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall (PR) and Adversarial Extraction Rate (AER), and sweeping three memory-design knobs: summarization aggressiveness, retrieval breadth (k), and deletion mode. We further introduce the Forgetting Residue Score (FRS) to quantify whether deleted information remains recoverable from derived memory tiers. On LongMemEval, key-fact summarization reduces canary extraction by 76% on Gemma 3 12B and 64% on GPT-4o-mini while preserving nearly all personalization recall; critically, once content is compressed away, increasing k no longer restores leakage. The same compression, however, induces a deletion-fidelity failure: raw-only deletion leaves derived summary copies recoverable in approximately 20% of instances, and only full-pipeline purge or tombstone redaction drives worst-tier residue to zero. Together, these results establish that persistent agent memory must be evaluated as a first-class memorization mechanism -- assessed by what it helps agents recall, what it makes extractable, and what it can truly erase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基础模型代理在部署时的记忆化问题，提出隐私-效用边界，通过三个记忆设计旋钮（总结攻击性、检索广度k、删除模式）来度量，并引入遗忘残留分数（FRS）。在LongMemEval上实验，关键事实总结可减少提取，但存在删除保真度问题。
Motivation: 现有工作关注参数记忆化或固定内存配置，但未描述内存设计选择如何共同塑造个性化效用、提取风险和删除保真度。
Method: 将代理记忆视为隐私-效用前沿，用个性化召回（PR）和对抗性提取率（AER）度量，扫描三个记忆设计旋钮，并引入遗忘残留分数（FRS）量化删除信息是否可从派生内存层恢复。
Result: 关键事实总结在Gemma 3 12B上减少金丝雀提取76%，在GPT-4o-mini上减少64%，同时几乎保持所有个性化召回；但仅原始删除会留下可恢复的派生摘要副本约20%实例，只有全流水线清除或墓碑修订才能将最差层残留归零。
Conclusion: 持久代理内存必须作为第一类记忆机制进行评估——评估其帮助代理回忆的内容、可提取的内容以及真正可擦除的内容。

papers.title: Continuous Neural Reparameterization as a Deep Geometric Prior for Robust Fixed-Chart UV Repair
papers.abstract_en: Traditional UV unwrapping relies on direct optimization of geometric distortion energies and can fail through invalid initialization, local minima, or topological foldovers. We recast fixed-chart UV unwrapping as continuous neural reparameterization: an untrained SIREN maps per-vertex mesh features to UV coordinates, and its weights are optimized for a geometric objective. The practical contribution is a robust chart-solver recipe, combining Laplace--Beltrami spectral inputs, Tutte residual warm-up, a $C^2$ determinant extension, an injectivity barrier, and validity-checked retry/fallback routing, rather than a claim that any single component guarantees validity or that recutting methods should be replaced. NTK--LBO diagnostics show that spectral conditioning changes update geometry, especially at initialization and mid-rank subspaces, but does not by itself predict chart success. On compact pre-cut charts and a 47-chart stratified Thingi10K/xatlas-cut benchmark, the neural solver produces zero flips on all compact charts and 42/47 valid zero-flip stratified solves. BFF and OptCuts comparisons sharpen the scope: recutting can be faster and lower-distortion when allowed, while the neural solver targets supplied-chart validity and validation-first atlas construction. On Amara Spatial generated meshes, the full atlas construction path gives packed-atlas coverage on a 25-asset set and 1000/1000 strict locally valid atlases with zero UV flips in a large-scale Rust atlas run after fallback routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义固定图集UV展开为连续神经重参数化问题：使用未训练的SIREN网络将顶点特征映射到UV坐标，并优化几何目标。结合Laplace-Beltrami谱输入、Tutte残差预热、C^2行列式扩展、单射性屏障及有效性检查重试/回退路由，实现稳健的图集求解。在压缩预切图集和47图集分层Thingi10K/xatlas基准上，神经求解器在所有压缩图集上产生零翻转，在42/47分层求解中有效零翻转。与BFF和OptCuts比较表明，重切方法在允许时更快且失真更低，而神经求解器专注于提供图集有效性和验证优先的图集构建。
Motivation: 传统UV展开依赖几何失真能量的直接优化，可能因无效初始化、局部极小值或拓扑翻转而失败。需要一种更鲁棒的方法来保证固定图集的UV坐标有效性。
Method: 提出连续神经重参数化框架：使用未训练的SIREN网络，输入每顶点特征（包括Laplace-Beltrami谱嵌入），网络权重通过几何目标优化。包含Tutte残差预热、C^2行列式扩展、单射性屏障以及有效性检查的重试/回退路由。
Result: 在压缩预切图集上实现零翻转；在47图集分层Thingi10K/xatlas基准上，42/47个分层求解有效零翻转。在Amara Spatial网格上，完整图集构建路径在25个资产集上实现打包图集覆盖，并在大规模Rust图集运行中通过回退路由实现1000/1000严格局部有效且零UV翻转的图集。
Conclusion: 神经求解器专注于提供给定图集的有效性，而非替代重切方法。对于允许重切的任务，重切可更快且失真更低。NTK-LBO诊断表明谱条件影响更新几何，但不能单独预测图集成功。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inside the Latent Flow: Causal Deciphering of Attention Dynamics in Audio Separation Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching transformers achieve strong audio separation, yet their attention dynamics are opaque. We adapt established causal-intervention principles into a deterministic, inference-time probing protocol for SAM Audio. Orthogonal probing uncovers a dual-pathway text-conditioning mechanism: additive injections control semantic identity, while cross-attention refines acoustic structure. We observe an asynchronous layerwise convergence: stable layers build temporal scaffolds early, whereas fast layers continue resolving artifacts during sampling. The model also attenuates temporal segmentation cues to maintain continuous-flow stability. Using these insights, we propose Layer-Selective Attention Caching (LSAC), a training-free acceleration method that caches attention in stable layers. Across acoustic complexities, LSAC cuts self-attention computation by about ~25% with negligible quality loss and yields up to 6.7x higher quality retention than naive step reduction.

TL;DR: 本文针对流匹配Transformer在音频分离中注意力机制不透明的问题，提出基于因果干预的正交探测协议，揭示了双路径文本调节机制、异步层收敛等现象，并提出了Layer-Selective Attention Caching (LSAC)训练无关加速方法。摘要显示LSAC可减少约25%自注意力计算，质量损失可忽略，质量保持比朴素步长缩减高6.7倍。
Motivation: 流匹配Transformer在音频分离中表现优异，但其注意力动力学尚不透明，缺乏对内部机制的因果解释。
Method: 采用正交探测和因果干预原则，设计确定性推断时探测协议，分析SAM Audio模型的注意力模式，并提出LSAC训练无关加速方法。
Result: 发现双路径文本调节机制：加法注入控制语义身份，交叉注意力细化声学结构；观察到异步层收敛；模型抑制时间分割线索以保持连续流稳定性。LSAC减少约25%自注意力计算，保持相近质量，质量保持比朴素步长缩减高6.7倍。
Conclusion: 揭示了音频分离基础模型注意力动态的因果机制，并提出有效的训练无关加速方法。

papers.title: Business World Model
papers.abstract_en: Businesses are increasingly adopting AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, reduce costs, and enhance products and services. However, the transformative potential of AI extends beyond automating predefined tasks: it lies in enabling intelligent systems to plan, optimize, and execute business initiatives from high-level strategic objectives. This paper introduces the concept and architecture of a business world model (BWM), a world model specialized for business and organizational environments. Inspired by world models in artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and control theory, a BWM encodes business states, dynamics, constraints, objectives, and feasible action space to support autonomous decision-making. We propose a business-semantics-centric formulation in which business states, dynamics and actions are linked to key business entities. Within this framework, agents can simulate alternative action sequences, estimate their effects on future business outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs under uncertainty. The proposed architecture integrates semantic data representations, probabilistic machine learning models, deterministic business rules, and explicit action space into a coherent structure for planning and counterfactual reasoning. Although its individual components are not new, the contribution of BWM lies in organizing them as an executable internal simulator for business initiatives. This work establishes a conceptual foundation for autonomous business systems capable of moving from instruction-based execution toward goal-driven planning and execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出商业世界模型（BWM）的概念与架构，该模型受人工智能、认知科学和控制理论中的世界模型启发，专门针对商业和组织环境。BWM编码商业状态、动态、约束、目标和可行动作空间，以支持自主决策。架构整合语义数据表示、概率机器学习模型、确定性业务规则和显式动作空间，形成可执行的内部模拟器，用于规划和反事实推理。
Motivation: 现有AI工具多用于自动化预定义任务，缺乏从高层战略目标规划、优化和执行商业计划的能力，限制了AI在商业中的转型潜力。
Method: 提出以商业语义为中心的框架，将商业状态、动态和动作链接到关键商业实体；集成语义数据表示、概率机器学习模型、确定性业务规则和显式动作空间，形成用于规划和反事实推理的连贯结构。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，主要贡献是概念和架构建立。
Conclusion: 该工作为从指令执行转向目标驱动的自主商业系统奠定了概念基础，但各组件本身并非全新。

papers.title: Interpreting and Steering a Text-to-Speech Language Model with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly serve as the backbone of text-to-speech (TTS) systems, yet we understand little about the representations they build when text and generated speech tokens share a single residual stream. We train BatchTopK sparse autoencoders on the LM backbone of CosyVoice3 and introduce a modality-aware auto-interp pipeline that labels each feature from where it fires-text-prefix context, 1-second speech clips, or both. The recovered features are interpretable, spanning phonemes, laughter, accent prompts and speaker gender. Steering through the SAE latent space shows these features are causal rather than merely descriptive: targeted interventions raise laughter probability from 0.02 to 0.79, flip perceived speaker gender, and control speech rate while preserving spoken content. SAE features thus serve both as interpretability objects and as control directions for TTS synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用BatchTopK稀疏自编码器对CosyVoice3的语言模型骨干进行可解释性分析，并引入模态感知的自动解释流程，从文本前缀和语音片段中标记特征。恢复的特征具有可解释性，涵盖音素、笑声、口音提示和说话人性别。通过SAE潜在空间进行干预，可因果性地控制笑声概率、感知性别和语速，同时保留语音内容。
Motivation: 文本到语音系统中，语言模型背书的内部表征缺乏理解，尤其是文本和语音token共享残差流时，模型构建了哪些表示尚不清楚。
Method: 训练BatchTopK稀疏自编码器，并提出模态感知的自动解释流程，从文本前缀和1秒语音片段中标注特征，分类为仅文本、仅语音或两者皆发。
Result: 恢复的特征可解释，涵盖音素、笑声、口音和性别等；干预实验显示特征具有因果性：笑声概率从0.02提升至0.79，可翻转感知说话人性别，控制语速而不改变内容。
Conclusion: SAE特征既可作为解释性对象，也可作为TTS合成的控制方向。

papers.title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution. GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions. To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps. Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy. Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting. As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data. This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GHOST框架，通过将视觉运动操作策略分解为高层子目标预测（从多视图RGB-D观测中预测末端执行器位姿分布）和低层目标条件控制器，实现了训练分布外的泛化。该分层结构在多个操作任务上优于平坦扩散策略，并允许利用人类视频演示来训练高层策略，而低层策略仅使用机器人数据。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略在训练分布外泛化能力有限，且难以有效利用人类演示（需要噪声动作重定向）。
Method: GHOST将控制分解为高层策略（预测3D末端执行器位姿作为子目标）和低层目标条件控制器；通过空间接口将3D目标投射到图像平面并表示为末端执行器热图，以条件化基于图像的策略。
Result: 在多个操作任务上，GHOST相比扁平扩散策略持续提升性能和鲁棒性；高层策略可利用人类视频进行训练，适应新物体和任务变体，仅需少量人类演示。
Conclusion: 分层子目标策略结合人类视频训练，可有效提升机器人操作泛化能力，减少对噪声动作重定向的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning the Universe: Posterior Reliability of Neural Generative Models in High-Dimensional Field-Level Inference of Cosmic Initial Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Accurate posterior estimation is central to scientific inference, as uncertainties determine what can be reliably learned from observational data. While Markov chain Monte Carlo methods provide asymptotic convergence guarantees, they are computationally demanding in high-dimensional settings. Neural network-based generative models for entire discretized 3D fields enable fast amortized inference but often lack convergence guarantees and principled accuracy assessment. Using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to obtain reference posterior samples, we conduct a controlled field-level evaluation of an implicit generative model (Stochastic Interpolants) and an explicit likelihood-based model (GLOW normalizing flows). This comparison, unavailable in typical applications, enables the detection of posterior geometry failures that standard metrics cannot capture. As a case study, we consider the cosmological inverse problem of inferring cosmic initial conditions from present-day large-scale structure. To match the precision of modern cosmological data, this problem increasingly relies on complex, non-linear, and non-differentiable simulators, which are incompatible with gradient-based inference frameworks. Generative models offer a route to address these challenges, provided their inferred posteriors are reliable. In this work, we show that matching posterior means, marginal distributions, or achieving high cross-correlation does not imply correct uncertainty structure, as revealed by posterior variance fields and sample-based evaluations. Through this work, we aim to raise awareness of the challenges of uncertainty estimation in high-dimensional field-level settings, highlighting the importance of careful design and validation of neural generative approaches for scientific applications.
papers.comment: This is a Learning the Universe publication. 19 pages, 18 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维场级宇宙初始条件推断问题，使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛作为参考后验，系统评估了隐式生成模型（随机插值）和显式似然模型（GLOW流模型）的后验可靠性。结果表明，即使后验均值、边际分布或交叉相关匹配良好，不确定性结构仍可能错误，揭示了现有评估指标的不足。
Motivation: 高维场级推断中，神经生成模型虽能实现快速摊销推断，但缺乏收敛保证和原则性精度评估，而传统MCMC方法计算昂贵。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过对比参考后验来检验生成模型的后验质量。
Method: 使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛从真实后验采样作为基准，在宇宙初始条件推断任务上对比了隐式生成模型（随机插值）和显式似然模型（GLOW流模型），通过后验方差场和样本基评估来检测后验几何失败。
Result: 发现仅匹配后验均值、边际分布或达到高交叉相关并不能保证正确的后验不确定性结构；后验方差场和样本基评估揭示了标准指标无法捕获的后验几何缺陷。
Conclusion: 本文强调在高维场级科学推断中，不确定性估计面临严峻挑战，需要谨慎设计和验证神经生成模型，以避免误导性的后验结果。

papers.title: SpineReport: Automated 3D Quantification and Reporting of Lumbar Spine Degeneration on MRI
papers.abstract_en: Lumbar spine conditions are a leading cause of disability worldwide, yet reliable quantification of degeneration from MRI remains challenging. In clinical practice, analysis is predominantly performed in two dimensions (2D), as manual three-dimensional (3D) assessment is time-consuming. However, 2D measurements suffer from limited reproducibility, particularly when anatomical structures are not aligned with the imaging plane. Existing automated approaches are often restricted to 2D, rely on discrete grading, or lack robustness and interpretability. We introduce SpineReport, an open-source, fully automated framework for comprehensive 3D morphometric analysis of lumbar spine MRI. Leveraging robust anatomical segmentations, the method extracts quantitative metrics from key structures, including the spinal canal, spinal cord, vertebrae, intervertebral discs, and foramina. These include both morphological and signal-based features, enabling cross-subject and longitudinal assessment. SpineReport further generates subject-specific reports that allow comparison with cohort distributions, improving interpretability and objective characterization of spinal morphology. Clinical relevance was evaluated against radiologist-reported severity grades for central canal, lateral recess, and foraminal stenosis. Metrics showed strong associations with central canal stenosis severity, with T2-weighted CSF signal providing the highest performance (AUC = 0.95). Canal AP diameter and area ratios also demonstrated strong correlations and high discriminative ability (AUC > 0.80). For lateral recess stenosis, associations were moderate, with lateral CSF signal being the most informative (AUC = 0.73). No significant associations were observed for foraminal stenosis despite robust region-of-interest extraction. SpineReport is released as an open-access tool: https://ivadomed.github.io/SpineReport/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpineReport，一个开源的全自动框架，用于腰椎 MRI 的三维形态计量分析。该框架利用鲁棒的解剖分割，提取椎管、脊髓、椎骨、椎间盘和椎间孔等结构的形态学和信号特征，并生成个体报告与人群分布对比。在椎管狭窄分级中，T2 加权脑脊液信号取得了 AUC=0.95 的性能，但侧隐窝和椎间孔狭窄的相关性较弱或不存在。
Motivation: 腰椎退变是全球致残主因，但 MRI 退变量化仍依赖二维手动测量，可重复性差且缺乏三维自动分析工具。现有方法多限于二维、离散分级或鲁棒性不足。
Method: SpineReport 是一个全自动开源框架，基于解剖分割提取腰椎关键结构的形态和信号特征，生成可对比人群分布的个体报告。
Result: 在中央椎管狭窄分级中，T2 脑脊液信号 AUC=0.95，椎管前后径和面积比 AUC>0.80；侧隐窝狭窄中侧方脑脊液信号 AUC=0.73；椎间孔狭窄未见显著关联。
Conclusion: SpineReport 实现了腰椎 MRI 的自动化三维定量分析，对中央椎管狭窄具有高判别能力，但对椎间孔狭窄效果有限，框架已开源。

summary_sections.motivation: 腰椎退变是全球致残主因，但 MRI 退变量化仍依赖二维手动测量，可重复性差且缺乏三维自动分析工具。现有方法多限于二维、离散分级或鲁棒性不足。
summary_sections.method: SpineReport 是一个全自动开源框架，基于解剖分割提取腰椎关键结构的形态和信号特征，生成可对比人群分布的个体报告。
summary_sections.result: 在中央椎管狭窄分级中，T2 脑脊液信号 AUC=0.95，椎管前后径和面积比 AUC>0.80；侧隐窝狭窄中侧方脑脊液信号 AUC=0.73；椎间孔狭窄未见显著关联。
summary_sections.conclusion: SpineReport 实现了腰椎 MRI 的自动化三维定量分析，对中央椎管狭窄具有高判别能力，但对椎间孔狭窄效果有限，框架已开源。

papers.title: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of $>55\%$ in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种快速、无需对应点的局部点云配准方法，利用各向异性核函数在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中连续表示点云，沿法线方向精确对齐、沿切向放松约束。采用二阶流形优化（近似黎曼Hessian）使速度比先前基于RKHS的一阶求解器快达10倍。在LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪任务上精度显著提升；在驾驶场景的LiDAR跟踪中平移和旋转漂移降低超过55%；在物体配准基准上优于ICP方法。
Motivation: 现有的无需对应点的局部配准方法依赖一阶优化，收敛慢且精度受限于几何编码方式；需要一种兼顾速度与对齐质量的方法。
Method: 将点云表示为连续函数，使用点向各向异性核编码局部几何结构；通过二阶流形优化（近似黎曼Hessian）求解配准问题。
Result: 帧间LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度提升；在特征稀疏的驾驶场景中平移和旋转漂移降低>55%；物体配准中优于ICP且有额外鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法在无需对应点的局部配准中实现了快速、高精度的性能，尤其适用于特征稀疏环境。

papers.title: DeRA-MOS: Optimizing Text-to-Music Evaluation via Decoupled Listwise Ranking and Modality Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating text-to-music (TTM) systems remains expensive because music impression (MI) and text alignment (TA) scores rely on human mean opinion scores (MOS). Most automatic MOS estimators are trained with point-wise regression or distributional classification. These objectives do not directly optimize rank-based metrics and provide weak geometric constraints for cross-modal coherence. To address these gaps, we propose DeRA-MOS, a decoupled optimization framework for TTM evaluation. For MI, we introduce a batch-aware listwise ranking loss that models relative order within each mini-batch and better aligns with evaluation based on Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (SRCC). For TA, we introduce a score-anchored modality alignment loss that maps human scores to target audio-text similarity and regularizes the latent space before fusion. By effectively mitigating the point-wise training mismatch and modality drift, experiments on MusicEval demonstrate that our decoupled framework yields substantial improvements in both MI and TA ranking metrics, establishing a robust paradigm for large-scale TTM evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters (SPL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeRA-MOS，一个解耦优化框架，用于评估文本到音乐（TTM）系统。针对音乐印象（MI）和文本对齐（TA）分别引入批感知列表排序损失和分数锚定的模态对齐损失，以直接优化基于排名的指标。在MusicEval数据集上，该方法在MI和TA的排名指标上均取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有自动MOS估计器采用逐点回归或分布分类，不直接优化基于排名的指标，且对跨模态一致性缺乏几何约束，导致评估效果不佳。
Method: 提出解耦优化框架：对于MI，使用批感知列表排序损失（batch-aware listwise ranking loss）建模批次内相对顺序；对于TA，使用分数锚定的模态对齐损失（score-anchored modality alignment loss）将人类分数映射到音频-文本相似度并正则化潜在空间。
Result: 在MusicEval数据集上，解耦框架在MI和TA排名指标上均优于基线，建立了稳健的大规模TTM评估范式。
Conclusion: 通过缓解逐点训练不匹配和模态漂移，DeRA-MOS有效提升了TTM任务的评估质量。

papers.title: Spiking Neural Network inference on FPGAs with hls4ml
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) provide a naturally temporal machine-learning framework. Their neurons maintain an internal state and propagate information through discrete spikes, enabling low-latency temporal inference. Although SNNs are often associated with asynchronous neuromorphic processors, many scientific real-time inference systems rely on conventional synchronous field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and high-level synthesis (HLS) workflows. In this paper we present an extension of hls4ml that enables clock-driven deployment of SNNs trained in pytorch onto FPGA firmware. We demonstrate the workflow using a dense quantised SNN trained on the Heidelberg Spiking Digits dataset where it achieves inference latencies of approximately $34μ$s. We validate the generated design through software reference comparisons, HLS C simulation, HLS synthesis, export, and Vivado synthesis reports. This work opens up the hls4ml toolkit to neuromorphic computing, allowing streamlined optimisation, synthesis, and deployment of SNN models for real-time inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了hls4ml工具，使其能够将基于PyTorch训练的时钟驱动脉冲神经网络（SNN）部署到FPGA固件上。在Heidelberg Spiking Digits数据集上，一个密集量化的SNN实现了约34μs的推理延迟，并通过软件参考比较、HLS C仿真、HLS综合、导出和Vivado综合报告验证了设计。该工作为hls4ml引入了神经形态计算能力，支持SNN模型的优化、综合和部署，用于实时推理。
Motivation: 现有SNN部署通常依赖异步神经形态处理器，但许多科学实时推理系统使用传统的同步FPGA和HLS工作流。本文旨在填补这一空白，使SNN能够利用常见的FPGA和HLS工具实现高效推理。
Method: 提出hls4ml的扩展，支持将PyTorch训练的时钟驱动SNN转换为FPGA固件。工作流包括训练密集量化SNN、通过HLS C仿真和综合验证生成的设计，并输出Vivado综合报告。
Result: 在Heidelberg Spiking Digits数据集上，SNN推理延迟约为34μs。通过多项验证步骤确认了设计的正确性。
Conclusion: 该工作将hls4ml工具的能力扩展到神经形态计算，为SNN模型的实时推理提供了简化的优化、综合和部署流程。

papers.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
papers.abstract_en: We present ABot-Earth 0.5, a generative 3D framework designed to synthesize vast, seamless 3D environments from ubiquitous, geospatially referenced satellite imagery. To achieve this, we propose a novel generative model formulated directly with the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation. The model is trained on a diverse corpus of existing real-world urban reconstructions, learning to generate realistic geometry and textures. At inference, it synthesizes novel 3D scenes conditioned solely on satellite imagery at a scalable rate of under 10 minutes per square kilometer, while demonstrating exceptional realism. The framework is designed for accessibility, with integrated hierarchical level-of-detail (LOD) structures that permit real-time, interactive visualization on web-based map engines. This high-fidelity simulation sandbox effectively mitigates the sim-to-real domain gap, enabling critical downstream Embodied AI applications like closed-loop UAV navigation. By providing an ultra-low-cost and high-efficiency solution, ABot-Earth 0.5 significantly lowers the technical and financial barriers to large-scale 3D reconstruction and empowers the future of global digital earth visualization.
papers.comment: From Amap-cvlab, Alibaba. Official page: https://abot-earth.amap.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ABot-Earth 0.5，一个基于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的生成式框架，能够从地理参考卫星图像合成大规模、无缝的3D环境。模型在真实城市重建数据上训练，推理时每平方公里生成时间少于10分钟，集成层次细节（LOD）结构支持网页端的实时交互可视化。该框架旨在降低大规模3D重建的成本和技术门槛，服务于数字地球可视化和具身AI应用。
Motivation: 现有大规模3D重建方法成本高、效率低，难以普及，需要一种超低成本、高效率的解决方案来生成高保真3D环境，以缩小模拟与真实的差距。
Method: 提出以3D高斯溅射（3DGS）为表示的生成模型，用卫星图像作为条件输入，学习生成真实几何和纹理；并集成层次细节（LOD）结构以实现实时渲染。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能以每平方公里不到10分钟的速度合成新3D场景，生成结果具有高逼真度，并可在网页地图引擎上实时交互可视化。
Conclusion: ABot-Earth 0.5显著降低了大规模3D重建的成本和壁垒，为数字地球可视化和Embodied AI（如无人机导航）提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Anisotropic Boundary Correction for Aerodynamic Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Aerodynamic simulation is a key component of engineering shape design, where core quantities such as the surface pressure coefficient strongly depend on flow dynamics near solid boundaries. Neural operators provide an efficient alternative to expensive Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) solvers. However, conventional methods treat the boundary region isotropically, failing to account for the distinct physical behaviors along the boundaries. In reality, the aerodynamic process exhibits anisotropy: along the tangential direction, flow propagates along the wall; along the normal direction, physical quantities are constrained by the wall. To explicitly model the distinct physical behaviors, we propose GeoABC, a geometry-conditioned anisotropic boundary correction framework. GeoABC leverages the boundary geometries to introduce direction-aware boundary correction into the intermediate representations of neural operators, transforming boundary geometry from static input features into a structural prior that modulates physical prediction. On 2D airfoil and 3D car tasks, GeoABC consistently adapts to multiple neural operator backbones, reducing near-boundary relative $L_2$ error by $\sim$38\% on average, narrowing the structural near-wall gap shared by mainstream neural operators, and advancing neural operators toward high-fidelity aerodynamic simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoABC，一种几何感知的各向异性边界校正框架，用于气动模拟中的神经算子。该方法利用边界几何信息引入方向感知的边界校正，将边界几何从静态输入特征转化为结构先验，从而调节物理预测。在2D翼型和3D汽车任务上，GeoABC将近边界相对L2误差平均降低约38%，缩小了主流神经算子的近壁结构差距。
Motivation: 传统神经算子在处理边界区域时采用各向同性处理，未能区分沿壁面的切向传播和垂直于壁面的约束行为，导致气动模拟精度不足。
Method: GeoABC框架通过边界几何条件，在神经算子的中间表示中引入方向感知的各向异性边界校正，将边界几何结构作为先验信息融入预测。
Result: 在2D翼型和3D汽车任务上，GeoABC在多种神经算子上均取得一致改进，平均降低近边界相对L2误差约38%。
Conclusion: GeoABC有效缓解了主流神经算子在近壁区域的结构性误差，推动了神经算子向高保真气动模拟的发展。

papers.title: Optimality of FSQ Tokens for Continuous Diffusion for Categorical Data with Application to Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion for categorical data is a framework belonging to the diffusion family and aiming at generating discrete data. The scientific interest to such models has been constantly increasing these days because researchers try to achieve a challenging goal of finding reasonable alternatives to autoregressive large language models. In this paper, we study the properties of the structure of the latent space corresponding to discrete tokens expressed in terms of Kullback-Leibler divergence on diffusion path measures and accuracy of the correct token prediction by the optimally trained diffusion model. We find that FSQ tokenization scheme has the latent space structure with the properties that make it best suited for continuous diffusion for categorical data as verified through rigorous theoretical analysis and numerical experiments. To validate our findings in real-life scenario, we train several text-to-speech diffusion models having speech tokens as intermediate acoustic features, and show that the one based on FSQ tokens indeed performs the best, and, moreover, it outperforms its strong LLM-based counterpart, at the same time being significantly smaller and faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续扩散模型（continuous diffusion）用于分类数据（categorical data）时，不同token化方案对潜在空间结构的影响。通过理论分析和数值实验，证明FSQ tokenization（有限标量量化）的潜在空间性质最适合此类模型。在文本到语音（text-to-speech）任务中，基于FSQ tokens的扩散模型不仅优于其他token化方案，还超过了强自回归语言模型（LLM-based counterpart），同时模型更小、推理更快。
Motivation: 自回归大语言模型虽然强大，但研究者希望找到合理的替代方案，如连续扩散模型用于离散数据生成。然而，token化方案的选择对扩散模型性能至关重要，缺乏系统的最优性分析。
Method: 通过KL散度（Kullback-Leibler divergence）在扩散路径测度上的分析，以及最优训练模型正确预测token的准确率，从理论上推导FSQ tokenization的潜在空间结构最优；并在语音token作为中间声学特征的多项文本到语音扩散模型中进行数值验证。
Result: FSQ tokenization在理论度量和实际文本到语音任务中均表现最优；其扩散模型在自然度和质量上超越强LLM基线，且参数量更少、推理速度更快。
Conclusion: FSQ tokenization是连续扩散模型处理分类数据的最佳选择，尤其在文本到语音等需要离散中间表示的任务中。

papers.title: 3SPO: State-Score-Supervised Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) as autonomous agents via reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled frontier models to achieve superhuman performance in long-horizon tasks. However, existing RL algorithms operate at the trajectory level, performing policy optimization only after collecting complete episode rollouts. This coarse-grained approach faces fundamental challenges in multi-turn agent settings where rewards are sparse, delayed, and credit assignment across individual steps is critical. In this work, we propose \textbf{State-Score-Supervised Policy Optimization (3SPO)}, a novel RL algorithm that performs post-step policy optimization with dynamic state score supervision. At each step, 3SPO computes the state score based on historical success rates, supervising step-wise credit assignment, adaptive rollout and post-step policy optimization without requiring value function estimation or additional auxiliary models. Theoretically, under a per-state bandit abstraction, we show that the proposed score-supervised allocation mechanism achieves logarithmic allocation regret and provide sample-complexity guarantees for action identification, score distinguishability, and filtering stability. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct show that 3SPO consistently outperforms GRPO by $+22.6\%$ on ALFWorld and $+15.6$ points on WebShop, while using comparable resources to achieve $2.4\times$ more state exploration and $1.8\times$ faster convergence. Code is available at https://github.com/genalyu/3SPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的强化学习算法3SPO，在每步之后基于状态得分进行策略优化，解决多轮Agent任务中奖励稀疏和信用分配问题。在ALFWorld和WebShop上相比GRPO有显著提升，并保证理论上的对数分配遗憾。
Motivation: 现有RL算法在轨迹级别进行策略优化，面对稀疏延迟奖励和逐步骤信用分配困难。
Method: 3SPO使用基于历史成功率的动态状态得分监督，实现逐步骤信用分配、自适应rollout和策略优化，无需价值函数或额外辅助模型。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，3SPO相比GRPO分别提升22.6%和15.6分，同时实现2.4倍状态探索和1.8倍更快收敛。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该方法有效改善多轮Agent训练中的信用分配问题，具有理论保证和实证优势。

papers.title: HydraCIL: Decoupled Class-Incremental Learning through Prototype-Guided Multi-Head Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: We present HydraCIL, a decoupled continual learning model based on prototype-guided multi-head classifiers, targeting sustainable deployment in embedded and resource-constrained environments. While most Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) methods rely on powerful hardware and long retraining cycles, real-world systems, such as robots or edge AI devices, must adapt quickly with limited resources. HydraCIL addresses this gap by freezing the backbone and decoupling feature extraction from learning. For each task, features are extracted once and a lightweight, task-specific classifier head is created, avoiding costly backbone retraining. At inference, HydraCIL selects the appropriate head via similarity with prototypes. Experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-100, CoRe50, and Flowers102 datasets show that HydraCIL matches or outperforms state-of-the-art CIL methods while significantly reducing training time and carbon footprint, making it a practical solution for continual learning in real-world and embedded settings, where energy efficiency and rapid adaptation are critical.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HydraCIL 是一种面向资源受限环境的解耦式类增量学习模型，通过冻结骨干网络并创建轻量级任务特定分类器头，利用原型相似性选择正确头部。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100、CoRe50 和 Flowers102 数据集上，该方法在匹配或超越现有方法的同时显著减少训练时间和碳排放。
Motivation: 现有类增量学习方法依赖强大硬件和长重训练周期，难以在嵌入式或边缘 AI 设备上快速适应。
Method: 冻结节拍网络，为每个任务提取一次特征并创建轻量级分类器头；推理时通过原型相似性选择对应头部。
Result: 在多个数据集上匹配或超越现有方法，同时显著降低训练时间和碳足迹。
Conclusion: HydraCIL 为实际嵌入式场景提供了节能且快速适应的持续学习方案。

papers.title: Temporal Context Conditioning for Seasonality-Aware Precipitation Nowcasting of High-Intensity Rainfall
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation nowcasting is increasingly being approached with deep learning models that learn directly from recent radar observations. Although such models can efficiently capture short-term precipitation motion, they often lack broader contextual information about the meteorological conditions under which rainfall develops. This paper investigates whether lightweight temporal context can improve radar-based nowcasting, particularly for high-intensity rainfall. We propose the Time-Aware Small-Attention U-Net (TA-SmaAt-UNet), which extends the core SmaAt-UNet model with temporal conditioning layers that use cyclical encodings of time-of-day and time-of-year to modulate intermediate feature representations. Experiments on KNMI radar precipitation data show that temporal conditioning is most beneficial for rare, high-intensity precipitation events, while also improving the representation of seasonal variability and predicted rainfall-intensity distributions. A layer conductance analysis further indicates that the added temporal conditioning layers are actively used by the model despite their small parameter cost. These findings suggest that simple, physically motivated temporal context can improve the realism and reliability of deep learning-based precipitation nowcasts. The implementation of our models and training setup is available on \href{https://github.com/gijsvn/TA-SmaAt-UNet}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间感知的小注意力U-Net（TA-SmaAt-UNet），通过添加时间条件层（包含一天中的时刻和一年中的时间的循环编码）来改进基于雷达的降水临近预报，特别是针对高强度降雨事件。在KNMI雷达降水数据上的实验表明，时间条件化对罕见的高强度降水事件最有益，同时改善了季节性变异性和降雨强度分布的表示。层导纳分析显示，尽管参数成本很小，模型确实有效利用了这些时间条件层。
Motivation: 现有深度学习临近预报模型直接学习雷达观测序列，缺乏更广泛的天气背景信息（如季节和时间），导致对高强度降雨预测不足。
Method: 在SmaAt-UNet基础上添加时间条件层，使用一天中的时刻和一年中的时间的循环编码来调制中间特征表示，时间信息通过条件层输入网络。
Result: 在KNMI雷达降水数据上，时间条件化显著提升了罕见高强度降水事件的预测效果，并改进了季节性变异性和降雨强度分布的表示。层导纳分析证实了这些层被积极使用。
Conclusion: 简单的、基于物理动机的时间上下文信息可以改善基于深度学习的降水临近预报的逼真性和可靠性。
Relevance: 95

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning for Autonomous Driving in Mixed Traffic Environment
papers.abstract_en: In mixed-traffic environments where autonomous and human-driven vehicles may co-exist, motion planning for autonomous vehicles requires anticipating the future behaviors of surrounding human drivers. Existing reinforcement learning-based methods generally directly incorporate the predicted human intents into the observation to enable a proactive planning. However, human intent is inherently uncertain due to the behavioral diversity, perception noise, and partial observability. Treating predicted intends as deterministic states can result in unsafe decisions for autonomous vehicles. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning (UAMP), which incorporates uncertainty in human intent prediction for AV decision-making. Specifically, UAMP first introduces a proximity-aware uncertainty estimator to quantify the interaction-conditioned intent uncertainty and constructs an uncertainty-guided joint intent distribution over surrounding human-driven vehicles. Within this uncertainty set, UAMP further introduces Uncertainty-Calibrated Value Learning (UCVL) to correct value function learning biases arising from directly incorporating uncertain human intent predictions into the observation. Extensive experiments in various mixed-traffic scenarios show that UAMP significantly improves safety and driving comfort, while maintaining traffic efficiency compared with existing approaches. The code is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UAMP-5638.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合交通中自动驾驶车辆的运动规划问题，提出不确定性感知运动规划（UAMP），通过量化人类驾驶员意图的不确定性来提升决策安全性。UAMP包含邻近感知不确定性估计器和不确定性校准价值学习（UCVL），在多种混合交通场景中提升了安全性和驾驶舒适性。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的方法将预测的人类意图视为确定性状态，忽视其固有不确定性（行为多样性、感知噪声、部分可观测性），可能导致不安全决策。
Method: 提出UAMP：首先利用邻近感知不确定性估计器量化交互条件性意图不确定性，构建不确定性引导的联合意图分布；然后引入不确定性校准价值学习（UCVL）修正因直接纳入不确定意图而导致的函数学习偏差。
Result: 在多种混合交通场景的实验中，UAMP显著提升了安全性和驾驶舒适性，同时保持交通效率。
Conclusion: UAMP通过显式建模意图不确定性提高了自动驾驶运动规划的安全性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data-aware Static Analysis: Improving Detection of Semantic Faults in Machine Learning Code Using Data Characteristics
papers.abstract_en: Semantic faults specific to the use of machine learning models are a common problem for machine learning developers, causing suboptimal predictions, high computational cost, or incorrect outputs. For example, one may erroneously use unscaled data to train a scale-sensitive model. Machine learning developers detect these faults after training their models and manually analyzing the results, making it an inefficient process. We propose a novel data-aware static analysis approach to detect semantic faults in machine learning code, allowing developers to reveal these bugs while writing code instead of after training the model. Our approach uses combined data and control flow analysis, and API contracts, enabling data-aware reasoning about machine learning code at a high level of abstraction. We highlight the potential of our solution by analyzing a sample of real-world machine learning notebooks, finding that we can detect faults that require a data-aware approach.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 listings, 1 table; To be published in "2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE-NIER '26)"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据感知的静态分析方法，用于在编写代码时检测机器学习代码中的语义故障，避免训练后手动分析。该方法结合数据流和控制流分析以及API契约，实现对代码的高层数据感知推理。通过对真实世界机器学习notebooks的样本分析，验证了该方法能够检测需要数据感知的语义故障。
Motivation: 机器学习开发者常犯特定于模型使用的语义故障（如用未缩放数据训练尺度敏感模型），而现有做法是训练后手动分析结果，效率低下。
Method: 提出数据感知的静态分析，结合数据流和控制流分析以及API契约，在抽象层次上进行数据感知推理。
Result: 对真实世界ML notebooks样本的分析表明，该方法能够检测需要数据感知方法的语义故障。
Conclusion: 该方法有望让开发者在编码阶段揭示语义故障，提高开发效率。

papers.title: Multi-task LLMs for Bug Classification: Efficient Inference with Auxiliary Decoding Heads
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of LLM-powered code generation has dramatically accelerated software development, yet effective verification methods remain severely underdeveloped. Existing bug localization techniques are either prohibitively expensive, requiring minutes of agentic reasoning and thousands of generated tokens per file, and/or operate at coarse function-level granularity unsuitable for precise debugging. While works that focus on line-level granularity and are more light-weight are often limited in their performance or context size. We introduce a novel line-level bug localization approach that addresses these limitations through three key contributions: (1) a token alignment algorithm that overcomes fundamental tokenization challenges in previous work, (2) a lightweight multi-task LLM for bug localization (MLC) enabling efficient line-level bug classification, and (3) an optimized training recipe for multi-line prediction. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among similar setups on line-level bug localization with full-file context. At the same time we reach comparable performance to agentic approaches on Defects4J and PypiBugs benchmarks while reducing inference latency by orders of magnitudes, requiring only a single generated token per file. We further demonstrate strong generalization by introducing and evaluating on a small out-of-domain evaluation datasets in Python. We will open source our code, models, and datasets upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的多任务LLM（MLC）用于行级bug定位，通过令牌对齐算法、辅助解码头和多行预测训练配方，实现全文件上下文中仅需单个生成令牌即可完成bug分类。该方法在Defects4J和PypiBugs基准上达到与代理方法相当的性能，但推理延迟降低多个数量级。
Motivation: 现有的bug定位技术要么代价高昂（需要分钟级推理和数千个生成令牌），要么粒度粗糙（函数级别），而现有的行级方法性能有限或上下文长度受限。
Method: 提出了三个贡献：1) 令牌对齐算法解决之前工作的分词挑战；2) 轻量级多任务LLM（MLC），使用辅助解码头实现高效行级bug分类；3) 针对多行预测优化的训练配方。
Result: 在全文件上下文行级bug定位中达到同类设置最佳性能；在Defects4J和PypiBugs基准上与代理方法性能相当，但推理延迟降低数个数量级，每个文件仅需单个生成令牌。在Python小规模域外数据集上展示强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文提供的轻量级方法能高效进行行级bug定位，且推理速度远超现有代理方法。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的bug定位技术要么代价高昂（需要分钟级推理和数千个生成令牌），要么粒度粗糙（函数级别），而现有的行级方法性能有限或上下文长度受限。
summary_sections.method: 提出了三个贡献：1) 令牌对齐算法解决之前工作的分词挑战；2) 轻量级多任务LLM（MLC），使用辅助解码头实现高效行级bug分类；3) 针对多行预测优化的训练配方。
summary_sections.result: 在全文件上下文行级bug定位中达到同类设置最佳性能；在Defects4J和PypiBugs基准上与代理方法性能相当，但推理延迟降低数个数量级，每个文件仅需单个生成令牌。在Python小规模域外数据集上展示强泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提供的轻量级方法能高效进行行级bug定位，且推理速度远超现有代理方法。

papers.title: Does Normalization Choice Matter for Causal Large Time-Series Models?
papers.abstract_en: Large models for time-series forecasting have been emerged as a promising paradigm for training models on heterogeneous collections of signals. These models typically rely on causal autoregressive architectures, where each observation is sequentially predicted from past. In practice, real-world time-series exhibit non-stationarities, which significantly influence predictive performance. To mitigate this, normalization is commonly employed. However, in efficient causal settings it might induce information leakage from future observations during training. Recent alternatives, including causal normalization and statistics computed from initial observations, have been proposed to address this issue, but their practical implications remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we evaluate normalization strategies for transformer-based large time-series models trained with patching and efficient causal strategy. We showcase that normalization choice significantly influences both training convergence and forecasting performance.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026 Workshop: Time Series in the Age of Large Models, Apr 2026, Rio De Janeiro, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了因果大型时间序列模型中归一化策略的影响，指出标准归一化在因果设置中可能引入未来信息泄漏。作者评估了多种归一化方案（包括因果归一化和基于初始观察的统计量）在基于Transformer的patch编码因果模型上的表现，发现归一化选择显著影响训练收敛速度和预测性能。
Motivation: 时间序列预测中非平稳性严重影响性能，常用归一化缓解，但因果自回归架构中传统归一化可能造成训练时信息泄漏。现有替代方案的实际影响尚不明确。
Method: 在基于Transformer的大规模时间序列模型（采用patch编码和高效因果策略）上，系统比较了多种归一化策略（包括因果归一化、基于初始观察统计量的方法等）对收敛和预测性能的影响。
Result: 实验表明归一化选择对训练收敛速度和预测性能有显著影响，但未提供具体数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: 归一化选择是因果时间序列模型的关键设计因素，需要谨慎处理以避免信息泄漏并提升性能。

papers.title: Deep Slice Interpolation for Reducing Through-Plane Anisotropy and Noise in Head CT
papers.abstract_en: Head computed tomography (CT) typically uses sub-millimeter in-plane resolution but 2-5 mm through-plane spacing, creating substantial anisotropy that degrades multiplanar reconstructions, volumetric measurements such as hematoma volume estimation, and downstream algorithms that assume near-isotropic voxels. We present a deep learning system that synthesizes intermediate CT slices from pairs of neighboring axial slices, halving the effective through-plane spacing. The system improves three-dimensional visualization while simultaneously producing inherently denoised outputs, yielding two complementary benefits from a single inference pass. To build a reliable system, we systematically evaluate pixel-wise losses, namely mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (L1); structural-similarity losses, namely the structural similarity index (SSIM) and its multi-scale variant (MS-SSIM); and hybrid combinations. On a held-out test set, all converged models outperform classical interpolation baselines and pretrained video frame interpolation methods (RIFE, FILM) on all structural measures, with MS-SSIM+L1 offering the strongest balanced profile. We also document training instability in SSIM-family losses and identify partial remedies: the standard numerical fixes eliminate the dominant failure mode but leave residual divergence at smaller batch sizes. All results are reported with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals and paired statistical tests. As an illustration, we apply the system to an out-of-distribution head CT series from Hospital Universitario Virgen del Rocío: the model synthesizes intermediate slices and exhibits on the real slices the implicit-denoising signature predicted by our theoretical analysis, supporting in a single external case that interpolation quality and implicit denoising are not confined to the training distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对头部CT扫描中层面间距大导致各向异性和噪声的问题，提出一种深度学习系统，通过插值相邻轴向切片来合成中间切片，有效降低有效层面间距并同时去噪。系统评估了多种损失函数，包括MSE、L1、SSIM及其混合，在测试集上均优于传统插值和视频帧插值方法（RIFE、FILM），其中MS-SSIM+L1表现最佳。方法在外部数据上也显示出隐式去噪效果。
Motivation: 头部CT通常层面间距2-5mm，导致各向异性，影响多平面重建、血肿体积测量等下游任务，且噪声存在。需要一种既能插值又能去噪的方法。
Method: 提出深度学习系统，从相邻轴向切片对合成中间切片，同时输出去噪结果。系统系统地比较了像素级损失（MSE、L1）、结构相似性损失（SSIM、MS-SSIM）及其混合组合，并进行了训练稳定性分析。
Result: 所有收敛模型在结构度量上优于经典插值和预训练视频帧插值方法（RIFE、FILM），MS-SSIM+L1提供最佳平衡。训练中SSIM类损失存在不稳定性，通过数值修复可消除主要故障模式，但小批量时仍有残留发散。结果以患者级bootstrap置信区间和配对统计检验报告。
Conclusion: 系统可同时实现插值和隐式去噪，且外部数据验证了其泛化性。摘要强调插值质量和隐式去噪不限于训练分布。

papers.title: Hasse Diagrams for Attention: A Partial Order Framework for Designing Transformer Masks
papers.abstract_en: During the training of large Transformer models, attention masks regulate the scope and direction of information flow across a sequence. Numerous mask variants exist, and operators such as FlexAttention already support arbitrary attention masks. Nevertheless, a systematic formal analysis of the information-flow structure induced by arbitrary masks has been missing. This paper develops a complete theoretical framework. We prove that, with sufficient depth, the information flow of a multi-layer Transformer converges to a Hasse diagram -- a directed acyclic graph representing a partial order. Building on this, we recast the design of parallel training tasks as the problem of finding a minimal common supergraph of Hasse diagrams, and we establish a criterion for the minimal common supergraph. This yields a constructive method to derive attention masks directly from a family of tasks. Applying the framework, we design two novel masks: a block-generation attention mask that ensures training-inference consistency (Block Two-Stream Attention), and a fully supervised bidirectional attention mask (Butterfly Attention). These results demonstrate the framework's capacity to discover new structures.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. Theoretical framework for attention mask design; no experiments included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为Transformer注意力掩码设计建立了一个完整的理论框架。作者证明，在足够深度的多层Transformer中，信息流收敛为一个Hasse图（表示偏序的有向无环图）。基于此，将并行训练任务的设计转化为寻找Hasse图的最小公共超图问题，并给出构造性方法，由此设计出两种新掩码：Block Two-Stream Attention和Butterfly Attention。
Motivation: 现有注意力掩码变体众多，但缺乏对任意掩码所诱导信息流结构的系统形式化分析，导致掩码设计缺乏理论基础。
Method: 证明多层Transformer信息流收敛到Hasse图；将并行任务设计转化为最小公共超图问题；建立构造性方法直接从任务族推导注意力掩码。
Result: 提出两种新掩码：块生成注意力掩码（确保训练-推理一致性）和全监督双向注意力掩码（蝴蝶注意力），展示框架发现新结构的能力。
Conclusion: 该框架为注意力掩码设计提供了理论基础，并展示了从任务需求直接构造掩码的可行性。

papers.title: Integrating Out, Twice:The Open-System Case That Neural-Network Ensemble Theory Is Missing
papers.abstract_en: Averaging a neural network over its random parameters and marginalizing a Gaussian sector are the same operation, the Schur complement of the eliminated block, and when that block is closed it returns a covariance and its inverse. That is all a network ensemble produces, the closed case. The open case is missing, and nuclear reaction theory has it worked out. Projecting a scattering problem onto a chosen set of channels, with the rest carrying probability irreversibly to a continuum, leaves a non-Hermitian effective generator that conserves and itemizes exactly what it loses: the nuclear optical model and its generalized optical theorem. I set the two cases side by side using only the moments of a distribution, the algebra of Gaussians, and block inversion, no field theory, and give the closed-case dictionary in full: the neural tangent kernel is the Fisher sensitivity kernel, the infinite-width Gaussian limit is the Gaussian-process emulator, and the lazy-to-feature transition is the validity boundary of a reduced-basis emulator. I then test the open export on a truncated attention map, a token-level transfer operator, and a sparse expert router, and report a mostly negative result. The conserved flux ledger ports wherever openness is genuinely present, but its distinctive content is absent, an artifact of the chosen partition, or pinned near a floor by the training objective, and the operationally useful uncertainty turns out to be epistemic, living in the closed half of the correspondence, not the open one. The negative has a structural reason this note makes precise: the open case needs an eliminated sector with a continuous spectrum and wave-like, not relaxational, dynamics, which mainstream learning's finite or dissipative objects do not supply. This is a note, not a result; its main finding is that negative one, and its value is the map that locates it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出神经网络集成理论仅处理了“闭系统”情况（对随机参数取平均等于对高斯扇区求边际，即Schur补操作），而“开系统”情况缺失，核反应理论已给出完整框架。作者利用分布矩、高斯代数和块逆，将闭情况字典（神经正切核、无限宽高斯过程、懒到特征过渡）与核光学模型对应，并将开情况导出为具有连续谱和波动动力学的非厄米有效生成器。在截断注意力图、token级转移算子和稀疏专家路由器三个机器学习组件上测试开导出，得到主要为负的结果，其根源在于主流学习对象只有有限或耗散动力学，不满足开系统所需的连续谱和波动行为。本文为笔记性质，主要贡献是明确指出了这一负结果及其结构原因。
Motivation: 神经网络集成理论缺少开系统情况，即当参数排除的扇区具有连续谱且概率不可逆地流失到连续谱时的行为，而核反应理论已解决此问题。
Method: 通过分布矩、高斯代数（algebra of Gaussians）和块逆（block inversion），建立闭情况完整字典（神经正切核、无限宽高斯过程、懒到特征过渡），并将核反应理论中的光学模型广义光学定理导出为开系统框架；随后在三个机器学习组件（截断注意力、token级转移算子、稀疏专家路由器）上对该开导出进行实证测试。
Result: 在截断注意力图、token级转移算子和稀疏专家路由器三个组件上的测试结果主要为负：开系统的守恒通量账簿虽出现，但其独特内容缺失、仅为所选分区的伪迹或被训练目标压制；操作上有用的不确定性反而来自闭一半的对应关系。负结果的结构原因是开系统需要被消除的扇区具有连续谱和波动（wave-like）动力学，而主流学习中的有限或耗散对象不满足。
Conclusion: 本文是一篇笔记而非正式结果论文，主要发现是开系统框架在现有机器学习组件中不成立（负结果），其价值在于绘制了定位该负结果的映射。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Where to Simulate: Generative Active Sampling for Online PDE Surrogate Training
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven PDE surrogates are trained with data produced by numerical PDE solvers. However, when the surrogate's goal is to generalize across a wide range of PDE configurations (e.g., initial conditions and physical coefficients), generating a representative training set is non-trivial. Uniform sampling of configuration parameters often under-represents trajectories exhibiting challenging dynamics, leading to high prediction errors and large error variance in the trained surrogate. Online training, where data generation and surrogate training are coupled, offers a natural advantage by allowing solver parameters to be steered on-the-fly. To efficiently exploit this capability, we introduce Online Generative Active Sampling (OGAS), an active learning method that reactively learns the relationship between configuration parameters and surrogate performance to control the sampling distribution. OGAS trains a fast diffusion model in parallel to the surrogate to act as a conditional sampler, mapping a surrogate-derived difficulty signal (e.g., loss or uncertainty) to configuration parameters. By actively drawing target signals from a prior biased toward high difficulty, OGAS continuously steers data generation toward challenging regimes without delaying the training workflow. We evaluate OGAS across 2D PDEs with distinct challenging dynamics (Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, Navier-Stokes, Gray-Scott) and up to 308 parameters, using multiple surrogate architectures. Across all settings, OGAS consistently improves tail statistics, yielding substantial reductions in errors above the 99th percentile and overall error dispersion compared to uniform sampling. While prioritizing challenging trajectories introduces a trade-off with average error, OGAS effectively ensures worst-case reliability of trained surrogates with negligible wall-time overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在线生成主动采样（OGAS）方法，用于高效训练数据驱动的PDE代理模型。OGAS通过并行训练扩散模型作为条件采样器，根据代理模型导出的困难信号（如损失或不确定性）动态调整采样分布，优先生成具有挑战性的轨迹数据。在多种2D PDE（Kuramoto-Sivashinsky、Navier-Stokes、Gray-Scott）和高达308个参数的实验中，OGAS相比均匀采样显著降低了99百分位以上的误差和误差离散度，同时保证了最差情况下的可靠性，且壁钟时间开销可忽略。
Motivation: 当PDE代理模型需要泛化到广泛的配置参数（如初始条件和物理系数）时，均匀采样难以充分代表具有挑战性动力学的轨迹，导致预测误差大且方差高。在线训练允许实时调整求解器参数，但缺乏高效的主动采样策略来引导数据生成。
Method: 提出在线生成主动采样（OGAS），在代理模型训练期间并行训练一个轻量扩散模型作为条件采样器。该采样器将代理模型产生的困难信号（如损失或不确定性）映射到配置参数，并通过从偏重高难度的先验中主动抽取目标信号，持续将数据生成导向困难区域，而不延迟训练流程。
Result: 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky、Navier-Stokes和Gray-Scott等2D PDE上，采用多种代理架构，OGAS一致地改善了尾部统计量：相比均匀采样，99百分位以上的误差和整体误差离散度大幅降低。平均误差略有增加，但最差情况可靠性显著提升，且壁钟时间开销可忽略。
Conclusion: OGAS通过主动采样有效提升了PDE代理模型在最具挑战性配置上的预测可靠性，为在线训练中的数据生成提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: SPARX: Secure and Privacy-Aware Approximate CNN Acceleration with Edge RISC-V SoC
papers.abstract_en: Edge-AI systems increasingly require real-time CNN inference under strict energy, performance, security, and privacy constraints. Approximate computing improves hardware efficiency by exploiting the error resilience of neural network workloads; however, most approximate CNN accelerators do not jointly consider secure, privacy-aware edge deployment. This paper presents SPARX, a Secure and Privacy-Aware Approximate CNN Acceleration framework integrated within a heterogeneous RV32IMC RISC-V System-on-Chip (SoC). SPARX combines a custom RISC-V instruction extension, an approximate logarithmic CNN acceleration unit, a lightweight differential-noise-based privacy engine, and a challenge-response authentication mechanism. To guide arithmetic selection, an approximation-aware decision framework is introduced that uses the Approximation Severity Index (ASI), Approximation Efficiency (AE), Quality of Approximation (QoA), Approximation Figure-of-Merit (AFOM), and Hardware Acceleration Efficiency (HAE). Evaluation across 11 state-of-the-art approximate MAC architectures identifies the Iterative Logarithmic Multiplier (ILM) as the most suitable design, achieving 51.7% area reduction, 81.5% power reduction, and 2.13x throughput improvement compared with an accurate radix-4 Booth MAC, while only reducing ResNet-20/CIFAR-10 accuracy by 2.82 percentage points. FPGA implementation on a Xilinx VC707 platform achieves 58.4 GOPS/W energy efficiency at 250 MHz, while 28-nm CMOS physical implementation validates ASIC feasibility
papers.comment: Under review in 12th International Symposium on Smart Electronic Systems (iSES) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPARX，一个面向边缘RISC-V SoC的安全隐私感知近似CNN加速框架。它结合自定义RISC-V指令扩展、近似对数计算单元、差分噪声隐私引擎和挑战-响应认证机制。通过近似感知决策框架评估11种MAC架构，选定迭代对数乘法器（ILM）实现51.7%面积减少、81.5%功耗降低和2.13倍吞吐提升，同时ResNet-20/CIFAR-10精度仅下降2.82个百分点。FPGA实现58.4 GOPS/W能效@250 MHz，28nm CMOS验证ASIC可行性。
Motivation: 边缘AI系统需在严格能效、性能、安全和隐私约束下进行实时CNN推理，现有近似CNN加速器未联合考虑安全隐私的边端部署。
Method: 提出SPARX框架，包含自定义RISC-V指令扩展、近似对数CNN加速单元、轻量差分噪声隐私引擎和挑战-响应认证。引入近似感知决策框架，使用ASI、AE、QoA、AFOM和HAE指标指导算术选择，评估11种MAC架构后选定ILM。
Result: 选定ILM相比精确radix-4 Booth MAC实现51.7%面积减少、81.5%功耗降低和2.13倍吞吐提升，ResNet-20/CIFAR-10精度仅降2.82百分点。FPGA实现58.4 GOPS/W能效@250 MHz，28nm CMOS验证ASIC可行性。

papers.title: GAGI: A Gini-Adjusted GDP-per-Capita Index for Distribution-Aware Macroeconomic Welfare Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: GDP per capita is the default lens through which governibng bodies track the economic prosperity and consequences of economic events , yet it is blind to two first-order determinants of lived prosperity: income/wealth distribution and inflation impact. Inequality-adjusted income measures are themselves not new but What is missing from the macroeconomic monitoring toolkit specifically is not a welfare concept but an operational monitoring trigger: a statistic minimal enough to compute annually from public data, transparent enough to audit without modelling assumptions, and normalised so that year-on-year, cross-country change ? the quantity a regulator needs to act on? is legible. We assemble such an instrument, the Gini- Adjusted GDP per Capita Index (GAGI): a reproducible, publicly computable formulation that rescales each country's GDP per capita by its inequality-adjustment factor (1-G) and its price level, normalised to a 2010 baseline. GAGI is a general-purpose welfare index, not inherently specific to AI automation, applicable wherever welfare-adjusted prosperity needs tracking. Applying GAGI to the G7 economies over 2010-2026, we show that welfare-adjusted prosperity has diverged persistently and increasingly from headline GDP growth, that the divergence widens sharply after 2022, temporally coincident with, though not, on this evidence alone, demonstrated to be caused by the after effects of COVID and the acceleration of generative-AI deployment. We argue that GAGI is a necessary complement to GDP-based monitoring: any macroeconomic monitoring instrument that tracks only aggregate output will systematically miss the distributional harm that automation can cause even while reported growth remains strong.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GAGI（基尼调整的人均GDP指数），通过收入不平等（基尼系数）和价格水平调整人均GDP，以2010年为基线标准化，形成可公开计算、可审计的宏观经济福利监测指标。应用于G7国家2010-2026年数据，发现福利调整后的繁荣与GDP增长持续偏离，尤其是2022年后偏离加剧，与COVID后遗症和生成式AI加速部署时间吻合。
Motivation: 人均GDP忽视收入分配和通胀影响，现有不平等调整指标缺乏可作为监管触发器的可操作统计量，需要计算简单、透明、标准化、可用于年度跨国比较的指标。
Method: 构建GAGI指数：每个国家的人均GDP乘以基尼不平等等价调整因子(1-G)和价格水平，并标准化到2010年基线；基于公开数据可复现计算。
Result: 在G7国家2010-2026年分析中，GAGI显示福利调整后的繁荣与GDP增长持续且日益扩大地偏离，2022年后偏离急剧扩大，与COVID后效应和生成式AI加速部署在时间上一致（但未证明因果关系）。
Conclusion: GAGI是GDP监测的必要补充，仅追踪总产出的宏观监测工具会系统性地遗漏自动化可能造成的分配损害，即使报告的增长依然强劲。

papers.title: Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis for Microservice Systems
papers.abstract_en: Microservice systems are widely used to build cloud applications, yet their complexity makes failures inevitable, degrading user experience and causing economic loss. Automated anomaly detection and root cause analysis (RCA) are now active research areas, but existing techniques share five limitations. First, most treat anomaly detection and RCA separately, assuming anomalies are detected correctly, and falter when detection is imprecise due to noise or delay. Second, they focus on metrics, logs, and traces, leaving event data such as API calls and configuration changes underexplored. Third, many require a given service call graph and cannot diagnose without one. Fourth, the field lacks standardised datasets and evaluation frameworks, so methods are hard to compare fairly. Fifth, although causal inference-based RCA has become dominant, its effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness remain unclear. This thesis addresses these limitations through two groups of contributions. The first introduces methods that exploit observability data both independently and collectively. BARO is an end-to-end anomaly detection and RCA approach for metric data. EventADL is an end-to-end framework for event data. TORAI is a multimodal RCA framework that requires no service call graph. Extensive experiments on real microservice systems demonstrate their effectiveness and robustness. The second group delivers benchmarking datasets, an evaluation framework, and systematic evaluation efforts. RCAEval is a comprehensive benchmark providing ready-to-use datasets and reproducible baselines for future research. A systematic evaluation of existing RCA methods, especially causal inference-based approaches, offers insights that guide future directions. This thesis thereby advances automated anomaly detection and RCA for microservice failures, enabling future research on incident mitigation and remediation.
papers.comment: This is the pre-print of my PhD thesis, submitted to RMIT University
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该博士论文针对微服务系统中异常检测和根因分析（RCA）的五项局限性，提出了两组贡献：第一组包括BARO（基于指标的端到端异常检测与RCA）、EventADL（事件数据框架）和TORAI（无需服务调用图的多模态RCA）；第二组构建了RCAEval基准数据集和评估框架，并对现有RCA方法（尤其是因果推断方法）进行了系统评估。实验在真实微服务系统上验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有方法将异常检测和RCA分离处理，假设检测准确，但实际中因噪声和延迟导致不精确；它们主要关注指标、日志和追踪，忽略了事件数据（如API调用和配置变更）；许多方法需要预知服务调用图；缺乏标准化数据集和评估框架；因果推断为基础的RCA方法的有效性、效率和鲁棒性尚不明确。
Method: 提出BARO（用于指标数据的端到端异常检测和RCA）、EventADL（用于事件数据的端到端框架）和TORAI（无需服务调用图的多模态RCA框架）；同时构建RCAEval基准（包含即用数据集和可复现基线）并开展系统性评估。
Result: 在真实微服务系统上的实验表明BARO、EventADL和TORAI在检测和根因分析中有效且鲁棒；系统评估揭示了现有RCA方法（特别是因果推断方法）的优缺点。
Conclusion: 论文综合解决了微服务系统异常检测和RCA的关键限制，为未来的事故缓解和修复研究提供了方法和基准。

papers.title: Stochastic weather generators for high-frequency wind vector time series
papers.abstract_en: Surface winds can vary substantially from one minute to the next, so there is scope for studying its variation on this fine time scale. Restricting to the month of June to minimize seasonality, this work develops a range of machine learning models for generating realistic time series of surface wind vectors at a site in Lamont, Oklahoma based on more than 30 years of high quality measurements at the minute time scale. Such a generator could be used as an input into models from a range of disciplines, notably for wind energy, but also wildfire spread and aviation, among others. The data show complex diurnal structures in both wind speed and direction that would be challenging to capture with standard time series models, so we consider a number of machine learning approaches to producing a stochastic wind generator based on time vector-quantized variational autoencoders. We consider generating a day's worth of data at a time and generating a day of wind vectors conditional on the previous day's winds. We also study methods for incorporating a discrete weather state variable in the generator. We evaluate the generators using a wide range of formal and informal methods. The best of these generators can capture many but not all of the complex features present in the observational data. In particular, the best of our approaches accurately mimic diurnal changes in wind volatility but struggle to match the observed distribution of extreme wind speeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对俄克拉荷马州拉蒙特站点超过30年的分钟级地表风向量测量数据，开发基于时间向量量化变分自编码器（time VQ-VAE）的随机天气生成器系列，以生成高频风速风向时间序列。生成器可逐日生成或条件于前一日生成，并尝试集成离散天气状态变量。评估表明最优模型能准确模拟风速波动的日变化，但难以匹配观测到的极端风速分布。
Motivation: 表面风在分钟尺度上变化显著，标准时间序列模型难以捕捉复杂日结构（风速和风向均有），需要灵活的随机生成模型以支持风能、野火蔓延、航空等领域的应用。
Method: 采用多种机器学习方法，核心为时间向量量化变分自编码器（time VQ-VAE），支持逐日生成和条件于前一日生成，并研究在生成器中引入离散天气状态变量。
Result: 最佳生成器能准确模仿风速波动日变化，但在匹配观测数据中极端风速分布方面仍存在不足。
Conclusion: 生成器能捕捉观测数据中大部分复杂特征但非全部，尤其极端风速分布的模拟需要进一步改进。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Interactions Between Crosscoder Features: A Compact Proofs Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Dictionary learning methods like Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and crosscoders attempt to explain a model by decomposing its activations into independent features. Interactions between features hence induce errors in the reconstruction. We formalize this intuition via compact proofs and make five contributions. First, we show how, \textit{in principle}, a compact proof of model performance can be constructed using a crosscoder. Second, we show that an error term arising in this proof can naturally be interpreted as a measure of interaction between crosscoder features and provide an explicit expression for the interaction term in the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) layers. We then provide three applications of this new interaction measure. In our third contribution we show that the interaction term itself can be used as a differentiable loss penalty. Applying this penalty, we can achieve ``computationally sparse'' crosscoders that retain $60\%$ of MLP performance when only keeping a single feature at each datapoint and neuron, compared to $10\%$ in standard crosscoders. We then show that clustering according to our interaction measure provides semantically meaningful feature clusters, and finally that sleeper agents have significant interactions. Code is available at https://github.com/chainik1125/crosscoders-feature-interactions/tree/arxiv.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过紧凑证明的形式化框架，揭示了字典学习方法（如稀疏自编码器和交叉编码器）中特征交互导致的重构误差，并推导出MLP层中交互项的显式表达式。基于该交互度量，作者提出可微损失惩罚以实现计算稀疏的交叉编码器，在仅保留每个数据点和神经元一个特征时保留60%的MLP性能（标准交叉编码器仅10%），还展示了交互度量在语义聚类和检测潜伏代理（sleeper agents）中的应用。
Motivation: 现有字典学习假设特征独立，但特征间的交互会引入重构误差，缺乏对这种交互的形式化理解和量化手段。
Method: 利用紧凑证明框架，从理论上推导出交叉编码器特征交互的误差项，并给出MLP层中交互项的显式表达式；基于此交互项设计可微损失惩罚，用于训练计算稀疏的交叉编码器，同时利用交互度量进行特征聚类和异常检测。
Result: 交互损失惩罚使计算稀疏交叉编码器在仅保留每个数据点和神经元一个特征时，保留60%的MLP性能（标准交叉编码器仅10%）；交互度量聚类产生语义有意义的特征簇，并成功检测到潜伏代理中的显著交互。
Conclusion: 特征交互度量不仅能提升交叉编码器的计算稀疏性，还能用于语义聚类和安全性检测（如潜伏代理），为理解模型内部特征交互提供了新工具。

papers.title: Gradient-Guided Reward Optimization for Inference-time Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) under distribution drift requires inference-time adaptation. While inference-time alignment methods such as Best-of-$N$ and rejection sampling are widely used, they frame the task as a sampling-intensive, reward-guided search, leading to two key limitations: their performance is bounded by the base model's generation quality, and their reliance on imperfect reward models makes them vulnerable to reward hacking. To address these challenges, we introduce Gradient-Guided Reward Optimization (GGRO), a lightweight inference-time method that performs targeted, minimal intervention during decoding via gradient guidance. Specifically, GGRO monitors token-level entropy to identify high-uncertainty regions indicative of drift or misalignment. Upon detection, it responds by injecting nudging tokens, generated using gradient signals from an off-the-shelf reward model, to steer the generation trajectory rather than merely re-ranking samples. Experiments show that GGRO consistently improves inference-time alignment across safety, helpfulness, and reasoning benchmarks. It also increases coverage of high-quality responses and robustness to reward hacking, with minimal computational overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/GGRO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度引导奖励优化（GGRO），一种轻量级推理时对齐方法，通过监测token级熵识别高不确定区域，并利用奖励模型的梯度信号生成引导token来干预解码过程，避免传统采样方法的性能瓶颈和奖励黑客问题。实验表明GGRO在安全、有用性和推理基准上持续提升对齐质量，且计算开销小。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法如Best-of-N和拒绝采样受限于基础模型生成质量和奖励模型的不可靠性，易出现奖励黑客问题。需要一种更高效、鲁棒的推理时干预方法。
Method: GGRO在解码过程中实时监测token级熵，当检测到高不确定区域（指示漂移或对齐不足）时，使用现成奖励模型的梯度信号生成引导token，注入生成序列以调整轨迹，而非仅重新排序样本。
Result: 在安全、有用性和推理基准上，GGRO持续改进推理时对齐，提高了高质量响应的覆盖率和抗奖励黑客的鲁棒性，且计算开销最小。
Conclusion: GGRO提供了一种有效的推理时对齐手段，克服了采样方法的局限性，但依赖于合适的奖励模型和熵阈值设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Culturally-Aware AI for Cross-Boundary Community Learning: Undergraduate Innovation at the Intersection of Computation and Design
papers.abstract_en: Research on artificial intelligence in education (AIED) is rapidly expanding, yet technical progress often lacks human-centered grounding and adequate attention to cultural context. Community-Based Learning, a pedagogy rooted in social work, remains underrepresented in AIED research, particularly within Asia-Pacific contexts. This paper reports on cross-boundary Community-Based Learning where undergraduate students develop AI-enabled solutions for cultural heritage preservation and sustainable development. We examine how community-engaged computing operationalizes human-centered AIED across three dimensions: education, technology, and culture. We contribute a collaborative framework for culturally-aware AIED that fosters multi-stakeholder collaboration while widening participation by dissolving disciplinary silos between social work and computational science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨人工智能教育（AIED）中缺乏文化背景和以人为本的问题，提出社区参与式学习方法。本科生通过开发文化遗产保护和可持续发展的AI解决方案，实现跨学科协作。贡献了一个融合教育、技术和文化三个维度的文化感知AIED协作框架。
Motivation: AIED研究快速发展，但技术进展常忽略文化背景和以人为本的理念。社区式学习（CBL）在AIED中代表性不足，尤其在亚太地区。
Method: 通过跨边界社区学习项目，让本科生开发AI文化遗产保护与可持续发展方案，并考察社区参与计算在三个维度（教育、技术、文化）的实施。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，主要贡献是一个促进多利益相关方协作、消除社会工作和计算科学学科壁垒的文化感知AIED协作框架。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于推动AIED中的文化意识与社区参与，但需要更多实证研究验证其有效性。
