papers.title: A Sketch-and-Project Analysis of Subsampled Natural Gradient Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Subsampled natural gradient descent (SNG) has been used to enable high-precision scientific machine learning, but standard analyses based on stochastic preconditioning fail to provide insight into realistic small-sample settings. We overcome this limitation by instead analyzing SNG as a sketch-and-project method. Motivated by this lens, we discard the usual theoretical proxy which decouples gradients and preconditioners using two independent mini-batches, and we replace it with a new proxy based on squared volume sampling. Under this new proxy we show that the expectation of the SNG direction becomes equal to a preconditioned gradient descent step even in the presence of coupling, leading to (i) global convergence guarantees when using a single mini-batch of any size, and (ii) an explicit characterization of the convergence rate in terms of quantities related to the sketch-and-project structure. These findings in turn yield new insights into small-sample settings, for example by suggesting that the advantage of SNG over SGD is that it can more effectively exploit spectral decay in the model Jacobian. We also extend these ideas to explain a popular structured momentum scheme for SNG, known as SPRING, by showing that it arises naturally from accelerated sketch-and-project methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过sketch-and-project视角重新分析了子采样自然梯度下降（SNG），提出了基于平方体积采样的新理论代理，替代了传统解耦梯度和预处理器的代理。在该框架下，证明了即使在耦合情况下，SNG方向的期望等于预处理梯度下降步，从而得到了任意大小单小批量的全局收敛保证，并显式刻画了收敛率与sketch-and-project结构的关系。此外，该分析还解释了结构化动量方案SPRING如何从加速sketch-and-project方法自然产生，并揭示了SNG相比SGD的优势在于更有效地利用模型Jacobian的谱衰减。
Motivation: 子采样自然梯度下降（SNG）已被用于高精度科学机器学习，但基于随机预处理的标准分析无法提供对现实小样本设置的洞察。
Method: 将SNG分析为sketch-and-project方法，丢弃传统的解耦梯度与预处理器的双独立小批量代理，取而代之的是基于平方体积采样的新代理。
Result: 在新代理下，证明了即使存在耦合，SNG方向的期望等于预处理梯度下降步，从而得到了任意大小单小批量的全局收敛保证，并显式刻画了收敛率与sketch-and-project结构相关的量。
Conclusion: 这些发现为小样本设置提供了新见解，例如SNG相比SGD的优势在于能更有效地利用模型Jacobian的谱衰减，并且该分析框架扩展解释了SNG的结构化动量方案SPRING。

papers.title: Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction for Multi-step Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) is well-suited for uncertainty quantification in time series forecasting due to its distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, existing multi-step methods often struggle to balance coverage validity with efficiency: they either calibrate horizons independently, ignoring temporal correlations, or enforce strict simultaneous coverage, resulting in overly conservative intervals. In this work, we propose O2CP: Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction, a unified framework for online conformal prediction that explicitly models multi-step error dependencies without sacrificing long-term marginal coverage guarantees. We first prove that standard online conformal updates maintain validity as long as calibration parameters remain within a defined "safe" region. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we introduce a two-layer architecture: an outer layer that defines admissible parameter sets to ensure validity, and an inner layer that performs constrained optimization to model joint error distributions and minimize horizon-wide objectives. To make this computationally feasible, we develop a lightweight sampling strategy that estimates joint distributions without requiring large calibration sets. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets, including autonomous driving, climate forecasting, and public health, demonstrate that O2CP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving target coverage with significantly sharper prediction intervals and reduced regret over long horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 O2CP（Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction），一种用于多步时间序列预测的在线共形预测框架。该框架通过显式建模多步误差依赖性，在不牺牲长期边际覆盖保证的前提下，避免独立校准或过于保守的区间。理论证明标准在线共形更新在参数处于安全区域内时保持有效性，并设计双层架构（外层定义参数集，内层进行约束优化）。轻量采样策略使其计算可行。在自动驾驶、气候预测和公共卫生等真实数据集上，O2CP 实现目标覆盖率，预测区间更窄，且长期遗憾更低。
Motivation: 现有用于多步时间序列预测的共形预测方法在覆盖有效性与效率之间难以平衡：独立校准忽略时间相关性，而严格同时覆盖导致区间过于保守。
Method: 提出 O2CP 框架，包含理论证明（在线更新在安全区域内保持有效性）、双层架构（外层定义可容许参数集确保有效性，内层进行约束优化建模联合误差分布并最小化跨视野目标）以及轻量采样策略（估计联合分布而不需要大量校准集）。
Result: 在自动驾驶、气候预测和公共卫生数据上，O2CP 一致超越基线，达到目标覆盖率，预测区间更尖锐（sharp）且长期遗憾（regret）降低。
Conclusion: O2CP 通过在线约束优化有效建模多步误差依赖，在保持长期边际覆盖的同时提高了预测区间效率，适用于多步时间序列预测。

papers.title: Cyst-X: A Multi-Center MRI Benchmark and Federated Learning Framework for Malignancy-Risk Stratification of Pancreatic Cystic Neoplasm
papers.abstract_en: Pancreatic cancer is projected to be the second-deadliest cancer by 2030, making early detection critical. Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs), key cancer precursors, present a clinical dilemma, as current guidelines struggle to stratify malignancy risk, leading to unnecessary surgeries or missed diagnoses. Here, we introduce Cyst-X, a multi-center MRI benchmark and a federated learning framework for IPMN malignancy-risk stratification. The dataset comprises 1,461 abdominal MRI scans from 764 patients at seven international centers, with three-tier malignancy labels anchored in histopathology or three-year imaging follow-up and expert pancreas segmentations. The pipeline couples the PanSegNet pancreas segmenter with a 3D DenseNet-121 classifier and a parallel radiomics predictor. On internal cross-validation, the deep learning classifier reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.85 (95% confidence interval 0.84-0.86) on T2-weighted MRI for high-risk versus low- or no-risk discrimination, with the average precision rising from a prevalence baseline of 0.23 to 0.64. This performance was preserved (AUC 0.85, FedProx) when training was distributed across institutions without exchange of raw patient images. Benchmarked against three blinded radiologists on a 629-case reader subset evaluated under imaging-only conditions, the classifier matched or exceeded sensitivity at comparable specificity. To accelerate research in early pancreatic cancer detection, we publicly release the Cyst-X dataset, segmentation masks, and trained models as the first large-scale, multi-centre MRI resource for pancreatic cystic neoplasm analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cyst-X是一个多中心MRI基准数据集和联邦学习框架，用于胰腺导管内乳头状黏液性肿瘤（IPMN）的恶性风险分层。数据集包含来自7个国际中心的764名患者的1461次腹部MRI扫描，带有组织病理学或三年影像随访确认的三级恶性标签。管道结合了PanSegNet胰腺分割器、3D DenseNet-121分类器和并行放射组学预测器。在内部交叉验证中，深度学习分类器在T2加权MRI上的高风险与低/无风险区分中达到平均AUC 0.85，并通过联邦学习（FedProx）在不交换原始图像的情况下保持性能。在与三位盲读放射科医生的比较中，分类器在类似特异性下达到或超过其敏感性。
Motivation: 胰腺癌预计到2030年成为第二大致死癌症，早期检测至关重要。IPMN作为关键癌前病变，现有指南在恶性风险分层方面困难重重，导致不必要的手术或漏诊。
Method: 构建了Cyst-X多中心MRI基准数据集，并开发了结合PanSegNet分割、3D DenseNet-121深度学习分类和并行放射组学预测的管道。采用联邦学习（FedProx）实现多机构分布式训练而不交换原始患者图像。
Result: 在内部交叉验证中，T2加权MRI上高风险与低/无风险分类的平均AUC为0.85（95%置信区间0.84-0.86），平均精度从患病率基线0.23提升至0.64。联邦学习条件下AUC保持0.85。在与放射科医生的比较中，分类器在相似特异性下达到或超过其敏感性。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Routing for Efficient Text-To-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are well known for their ability to generate a high-fidelity image for an input prompt through an iterative denoising process. Unfortunately, the high fidelity also comes at a high computational cost due to the inherently sequential generative process. In this work, we seek to optimally balance quality and computational cost, and propose a framework to allow the amount of computation to vary for each prompt, depending on its complexity. Each prompt is automatically routed to the most appropriate text-to-image generation function, which may correspond to a distinct number of denoising steps of a diffusion model, or a disparate, independent text-to-image model. Unlike uniform cost reduction techniques (e.g., distillation, model quantization), our approach achieves the optimal trade-off by learning to reserve expensive choices (e.g., 100+ denoising steps) only for a few complex prompts, and employ more economical choices (e.g., small distilled model) for less sophisticated prompts. We empirically demonstrate on COCO and DiffusionDB that by learning to route to nine already-trained text-to-image models, our approach is able to deliver an average quality that is higher than that achievable by any of these models alone. Code is available at https://github.com/winglicopy/CATImage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种成本感知路由框架，用于文本到图像生成，通过自动将每个提示路由到最合适的生成函数（不同去噪步数或独立模型），在质量和计算成本之间取得最优平衡。在COCO和DiffusionDB上的实验表明，学习路由到九个预训练模型可提供高于任何单一模型的平均质量。
Motivation: 扩散模型生成高质量图像需高计算成本，现有均匀降成本方法（如蒸馏、量化）无法根据提示复杂度动态调整计算量。
Method: 提出路由框架，学习将每个提示自动分配到预定义的文本到图像生成函数（对应不同去噪步数或独立模型），仅对复杂提示使用昂贵选项（如100+步去噪），简单提示使用经济模型。
Result: 在COCO和DiffusionDB上，路由到九个已训练模型获得的平均质量高于任何单一模型。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自适应路由实现质量与计算成本的帕累托最优，代码已开源。

papers.title: ASyMOB: Algebraic Symbolic Mathematical Operations Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to symbolic mathematics, yet existing evaluations often conflate pattern memorization with genuine reasoning. To address this gap, we present \textbf{ASyMOB}, a high-resolution dataset of \textit{35,368} validated symbolic math problems spanning integration, limits, differential equations, series, and hypergeometrics. Unlike prior benchmarks, \textbf{ASyMOB} systematically perturbs each seed problem using symbolic, numeric, and equivalence-preserving transformations, enabling a fine-grained assessment of generalization. Our evaluation reveals three key findings: (1) most models' performance collapses under minor perturbations, while top systems exhibit an apparent \textit{regime shift} in robustness; (2) integrated code tools stabilize performance, particularly for weaker models; and (3) we identify examples where Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) fail while LLMs succeed, as well as problems solved only via a hybrid LLM-CAS approach, highlighting a promising integration frontier. \textbf{ASyMOB} serves as a principled diagnostic tool for measuring and accelerating progress toward building verifiable, trustworthy AI for scientific discovery.
papers.comment: Published in ICML2026: https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/63549 Code repository: https://github.com/RamanujanMachine/ASyMOB Complete benchmark dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Shalyt/ASyMOB-Algebraic_Symbolic_Mathematical_Operations_Benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASyMOB，一个包含35,368个经过验证的符号数学问题的高分辨率基准数据集，涵盖积分、极限、微分方程、级数和超几何等领域。通过符号、数值和等价保持变换对每个种子问题进行系统扰动，实现对模型泛化能力的细粒度评估。实验发现大多数模型在轻微扰动下性能崩溃，而顶级系统表现出稳健性跃迁；集成代码工具可稳定性能；并识别出计算机代数系统失败而LLM成功以及仅通过混合LLM-CAS方法解决的问题。
Motivation: 现有符号数学评估常混淆模式记忆与真正推理，缺乏对模型泛化能力的精细诊断。
Method: 构建包含35,368个问题的基准数据集，并对每个种子问题应用符号、数值和等价保持变换，生成扰动版本以测试泛化能力。
Result: 多数模型在微小扰动下性能大幅下降，而顶级系统出现稳健性跃迁；集成代码工具稳定性能，尤其对弱模型；发现CAS失败而LLM成功及仅由混合LLM-CAS解决的例子。
Conclusion: ASyMOB可作为评估和推动可验证、可信赖AI科学发现的原则性诊断工具。

papers.title: Attacks on Machine-Text Detectors Retain Stylistic Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: Despite considerable progress in the development of machine-text detectors, the ease with which machine-text can be manipulated to evade detection has led to suggestions that the problem is inherently intractable. In this work, we investigate the limits of such evasion strategies. We demonstrate that while current attacks, ranging from prompt engineering to detector-guided optimization can effectively degrade performance of standard detectors, they fail to erase the underlying stylistic "fingerprints" of machine text. We show that few-shot detectors that utilize the stylistic feature space are robust to these evasion attempts, reliably detecting samples even from models explicitly tuned to prevent detection. This raises the question: does style represent a universal defense against machine-detection attacks? We demonstrate that the answer is "no'' by introducing a novel paraphrasing approach that simultaneously optimizes for undetectability and adherence to specific human styles. We show that unlike prior methods, this attack effectively evades all considered detectors, including those that utilize writing style. However, we find that this evasion is not absolute: as the number of documents available for analysis grows, the human and machine distributions become distinguishable again. Overall, our findings suggest that reliable machine-text detection requires moving beyond single-document analysis to multi-document analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器文本检测器在面对攻击时的鲁棒性。作者发现现有攻击（如提示工程和检测器引导优化）虽然能降低标准检测器的性能，但无法消除机器文本的底层风格指纹；基于风格特征空间的少样本检测器对此类逃避攻击具有鲁棒性。作者提出一种同时优化不可检测性和特定人类风格的新释义方法，能有效逃避所有检测器，但多文档分析下仍可区分人类与机器文本。
Motivation: 机器文本检测器易被操纵逃避，有观点认为该问题本质上是不可解的。本文旨在探索逃避策略的极限，并检验风格特征是否构成通用防御。
Method: 提出一种新的释义方法，同时优化不可检测性和与特定人类风格的匹配，以逃避各类检测器。
Result: 该方法能有效逃避包括基于风格检测器在内的所有考虑过的检测器，但多文档分析下人类与机器分布仍可区分。
Conclusion: 可靠的机器文本检测需要从单文档分析转向多文档分析。

papers.title: Post-Training Augmentation Invariance
papers.abstract_en: This work develops a framework for post-training augmentation invariance, in which our goal is to add invariance properties to a pretrained network without altering its behavior on the original, non-augmented input distribution. We define this notion precisely and additionally introduce augmented encoders, which are probabilistic encoders that formalize augmentation-based encoding processes and that serve as our fundamental object of study. We introduce two losses for augmented encoders, namely, Markov-Wasserstein minimization and Wasserstein correlation maximization, and we demonstrate empirically that both losses can be used to train lightweight, one-hidden-layer MLP adapter networks $E_θ$ that, when appended to the latent space of a pretrained network $F$, do indeed lead to (approximate) post-training augmentation invariance. For example, on STL10 with $F=\text{DINO}$ features, the composite network $C\circ E_θ\circ F$, where $C$ is a linear classifier and where $E_θ$ is one of our proposed adapter networks, achieves 94% classification accuracy on arbitrarily rotated images, whereas a network of the form $C\circ F$ without the adapter $E_θ$ drops to 71% accuracy. Similarly, we can boost noise-invariant classification results from 58% up to 86%. Significantly, we obtain these results with no fine-tuning (the weights of $F$ remain frozen throughout), and our methods introduce little corruption to the original features, since $E_θ$ acts nearly isometrically on the non-augmented latent distribution. In contrast, we show that adapter networks trained with alternative candidate losses, specifically SimCLR and HSIC maximization, produce uncompetitive classification results and fundamentally corrupt the original latent space. Code available at https://github.com/keenan-eikenberry/augmentation_invariance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出后训练增强不变性框架，在不改变预训练网络对原始输入行为的前提下，通过轻量级单隐层MLP适配器引入不变性。定义增强编码器并引入 Markov-Wasserstein 最小化和 Wasserstein 相关最大化两种损失函数。实验表明，在 STL10 上使用 DINO 特征时，适配器使旋转图像分类准确率从 71% 提升至 94%，噪声不变准确率从 58% 提升至 86%，且无需微调预训练网络。
Motivation: 希望为预训练网络添加增强不变性，同时不改变其在原始非增强输入分布上的行为。
Method: 提出增强编码器概念，并设计两种损失函数：Markov-Wasserstein 最小化与 Wasserstein 相关最大化。训练一个轻量级单隐层 MLP 适配器网络，将其附加在预训练网络的潜在空间之后，实现近似后训练增强不变性。
Result: 在 STL10 上使用 DINO 特征时，带适配器的网络在任意旋转图像上达到 94% 分类准确率（无适配器为 71%）；噪声不变分类准确率从 58% 提升至 86%。适配器几乎等距作用于非增强潜在分布，几乎不破坏原始特征。
Conclusion: 所提方法无需微调预训练网络即可实现增强不变性，且优于 SimCLR 和 HSIC 最大化等备选损失，后者会破坏原始潜在空间。

papers.title: A Survey on Semantic Modeling for Building Energy Management
papers.abstract_en: Building Energy Management (BEM) is central to reducing energy use and CO2 emissions in the building sector. Although IoT technologies now provide extensive operational data, heterogeneous data models, device descriptions, and contextual representations continue to limit semantic interoperability, limiting the development of generalisable, autonomous, context-aware BEM applications. Ontologies address this challenge by providing structured, machine-interpretable representations of building data, systems, and operational context. This survey examines semantic modelling for BEM during the building operational phase. It reviews 60 semantic models and analyses more than 20 ontology-based BEM use cases. It further quantifies Ontology Instantiation Rates (OIR) and missing concepts across those use cases. To support evidence-based assessment of ontology use, we introduce the notion of Ontology Evidence Completeness (OEC), a measure of whether studies explicitly map operational concepts to the ontology classes used to represent them. Findings show that current semantic models more consistently represent physical building structure, technical systems, sensing devices, and observable operational data than abstract and dynamic operational concepts. Concepts such as key performance indicators, assessments, services, control logic, optimisation tasks, and computational workflows remain less consistently covered. Applied BEM studies therefore frequently depend on ontology reuse, integration, specialisation, external inheritance, or application-specific extension to address coverage and interoperability gaps across BEM. By synthesising these patterns, this survey clarifies the capabilities of existing semantic models and identifies directions for more interoperable, generalisable, and context-aware BEM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了建筑能源管理（BEM）中语义建模的现状，回顾了60个语义模型和20多个基于本体的BEM用例，并提出了本体实例化率（OIR）和本体证据完备性（OEC）指标。研究发现，当前模型对物理结构、技术系统等静态概念表示较好，但对关键绩效指标、控制逻辑等动态操作概念覆盖不足，应用常依赖本体复用和扩展来弥补不足。
Motivation: 建筑能源管理中异构数据模型限制了语义互操作性，阻碍了通用、自主、上下文感知的BEM应用发展。本体可提供结构化表示，但现有模型对抽象动态概念覆盖不足，需要系统评估。
Method: 通过调查60个语义模型和20多个基于本体的BEM用例，引入本体实例化率（OIR）和本体证据完备性（OEC）指标，量化本体实例化率和缺失概念，评估本体使用情况。
Result: 当前语义模型对物理建筑结构、技术系统、传感设备和可观测操作数据表示一致，但对关键绩效指标、评估、服务、控制逻辑、优化任务和计算工作流等抽象动态概念覆盖不足。应用常需依赖本体复用、集成、专门化、外部继承或特定扩展。
Conclusion: 综述明确了现有语义模型的能力与不足，指出了实现更可互操作、通用且上下文感知的BEM系统的发展方向。

summary_sections.method: 通过调查60个语义模型和20多个基于本体的BEM用例，引入本体实例化率（OIR）和本体证据完备性（OEC）指标，量化本体实例化率和缺失概念，评估本体使用情况。
summary_sections.result: 当前语义模型对物理建筑结构、技术系统、传感设备和可观测操作数据表示一致，但对关键绩效指标、评估、服务、控制逻辑、优化任务和计算工作流等抽象动态概念覆盖不足。应用常需依赖本体复用、集成、专门化、外部继承或特定扩展。
summary_sections.conclusion: 综述明确了现有语义模型的能力与不足，指出了实现更可互操作、通用且上下文感知的BEM系统的发展方向。

papers.title: Mixtures of Neural Operators Reduce Active Complexity in Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Operator-learning systems are not governed solely by total parameter count; for one query, the relevant bottleneck can be the model that must be loaded and evaluated. We study this distinction for classical neural operators on compact Sobolev subsets through a constructive comparison between routed mixtures of neural operators (MoNOs) and a fixed single-neural-operator construction. The comparison concerns expert-active complexity relative to that baseline, with total stored size and routing search accounted separately. A MoNO routes each input function through a tree to one expert. Our main theorem shows that every scalar uniformly continuous nonlinear operator with bounded output Sobolev radius on the approximation set admits a MoNO approximation whose active expert has smaller depth, width, and rank scaling than the analyzed single-neural-operator construction; for Lipschitz targets these expert quantities are bounded by $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-1})$. The theorem turns localization into an operator-level accounting of active expert size, routing depth, and number of experts. We also prove a quantitative universal approximation theorem for the underlying neural-operator architecture, with explicit dependence on compact-set diameter and modulus of continuity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究算子学习中的活跃复杂度（active complexity），提出混合神经算子（MoNO）框架，通过路由每个输入函数到树形结构中的一个专家，在理论上证明MoNO能以更小的活跃专家深度、宽度和秩逼近均匀连续非线性算子，优于固定单神经算子构造。
Motivation: 现有算子学习系统仅考虑总参数量，忽略了模型加载和评估的瓶颈。本文旨在研究路由混合策略如何降低活跃专家复杂度。
Method: 提出MoNO：将输入函数通过决策树路由到不同的专家神经算子。理论分析比较了MoNO与固定单神经算子构造的活跃复杂度，并证明了通用逼近定理。
Result: 主要定理表明，对于均匀连续非线性算子，MoNO的活跃专家深度、宽度和秩缩放小于单神经算子构造；对于Lipschitz目标，这些量被O(ε^{-1})界约束。
Conclusion: 论文将局部化转化为算子级的活跃复杂度核算，并给出了显式的逼近依赖。该工作为混合神经算子提供理论基础。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: RKSC: Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing and Confident Early Exit for Multi-Step LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RKSC (Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing), a training-free inference framework that eliminates two structural redundancies in multi-branch LLM reasoning pipelines. ASKS (Attention-Similarity KV Sharing) computes the prefix KV cache once and broadcasts it to all semantically similar branches via hidden-state cosine similarity, strictly generalising the token-exact prefix caching used by vLLM and SGLang. CGEE (Confidence-Gated Early Exit) applies two complementary exit mechanisms: (1) it skips the verification forward pass entirely when generation confidence is decisive across branches, and (2) it terminates the verification pass at an intermediate layer when per-layer entropy stabilises, using lightweight hooks on the transformer backbone. RSBCM (Reasoning-Selective Block Cache Manager) prevents unbounded cache growth via attention-weighted depth-priority eviction. Across five model families (7B-10B), four benchmarks, and 1,000 evaluated problems, RKSC achieves a mean speedup of 3.008x over the No-KV baseline (peak 3.990x), a 1.66x mean improvement over vLLM-equivalent prefix caching, with a CGEE-induced error rate of only 0.37% (6 errors out of 1,616 verify calls). No fine-tuning or architecture changes are required. Code is available at https://github.com/AnirudhSekar/RKSC.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Statistical Frameworks for Uncertainty in Agentic Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RKSC，一个无需训练的多分支 LLM 推理加速框架，通过注意力相似性 KV 缓存共享（ASKS）、置信门控早退（CGEE）和推理选择性块缓存管理（RSBCM）消除冗余。在五种模型家族（7B-10B）和四个基准上，平均加速比相比无 KV 基线达 3.008 倍，相比 vLLM 等价前缀缓存提升 1.66 倍，CGEE 引入的错误率仅 0.37%。
Motivation: 多分支 LLM 推理流水线中存在 KV 缓存计算冗余和验证前向传播的不必要开销，现有前缀缓存（如 vLLM、SGLang）未充分利用语义相似性，且缺乏针对多步推理的早退机制。
Method: 包含三个组件：ASKS 基于隐藏状态余弦相似度共享前缀 KV 缓存；CGEE 在生成置信度决定时跳过整个验证前向传播，或在中间层熵稳定时提前终止；RSBCM 通过注意力加权深度优先级驱逐策略限制缓存增长。
Result: 在 1,000 个问题上平均加速 3.008x（峰值 3.990x），比 vLLM 等效前缀缓存提升 1.66x，CGEE 仅导致 0.37% 错误率（1,616 次验证调用中 6 次错误）。
Conclusion: RKSC 无需微调或架构修改，即可显著加速多步 LLM 推理，且保持极低的错误率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Lens, Many Worlds : A Capability-Typed Interface for World-Model Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: World models are now built on substantially different computational substrates. Latent recurrent state-space models such as PlaNet and the Dreamer family compress observations into recurrent states; token-based models such as IRIS quantize observations into a learned codebook and predict autoregressively with a transformer; and joint-embedding predictive architectures such as I-JEPA predict in a learned latent space with no pixel decoder. The interpretability methods applied to these models, including probing, activation patching, sparse autoencoders, and surprise analysis, share a common set of primitives, yet they are re-implemented from scratch for each architecture because existing hook-and-cache tooling assumes a transformer language model with no notion of actions, environment steps, or imagined rollouts. We argue that this fragmentation reflects the tooling rather than the models, and that the shared structure of world models is captured by a small typed interface. We present WorldModelLens, an open-source interpretability substrate organized around a capability-typed adapter: every model implements four required methods (encode, transition, initial state, sample) and declares a set of optional heads (decode, reward, continue, actor, critic) through an explicit capability descriptor, so that reinforcement-learning and self-supervised world models are first-class without either imitating the other. A single hook and cache layer exposes time-indexed activations, imagination rollouts, and intervention replay over this interface, allowing each analysis to be written once.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对世界模型（如PlaNet、Dreamer、IRIS、I-JEPA）的可解释性工具碎片化问题，提出WorldModelLens，一个基于能力类型接口（capability-typed adapter）的开源解读平台。该接口要求每个模型实现四个必需方法（encode, transition, initial state, sample）并声明可选头部（decode, reward, continue, actor, critic），通过统一hook和缓存层暴露时间索引激活、想象rollout和干预回放，使分析工具只需编写一次即可适用于不同架构。
Motivation: 现有世界模型的可解释性方法因工具假设（如hook-and-cache工具仅适用于transformer语言模型）而需为每种架构重复实现，导致碎片化。作者认为这种碎片化源于工具而非模型本身，世界模型共享的结构可被一个小型类型接口捕获。
Method: 提出WorldModelLens，围绕能力类型适配器设计：每个模型强制实现四个方法并声明能力描述符，通过单一hook和缓存层暴露时间索引的激活、想象轨迹和干预回放，支持强化学习和自监督世界模型的统一分析。
Conclusion: 作者通过类型接口统一世界模型解读，使得分析工具可跨架构复用，无需为每个模型重新实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GitInject: Real-World Prompt Injection Attacks in AI-Powered CI/CD Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: AI-powered agents are increasingly embedded in continuous integration and continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to autonomously review pull requests (PRs), triage issues, and maintain codebases. These agents ingest untrusted content while operating with elevated repository permissions, making them a natural target for prompt injection attacks with supply chain consequences. We present GitInject, an open-source framework for evaluating prompt injection vulnerabilities in real, live GitHub workflows, a widely deployed instance of CI/CD pipelines. Unlike prior agent security benchmarks that simulate tool calls, GitInject provisions ephemeral repositories and triggers actual workflow runs, so that sandbox constraints, credential handling, and permission boundaries behave exactly as in production. Using GitInject, we study workflow configurations across four AI providers and document eleven named attacks spanning config-file injection, credential exfiltration, judgment manipulation, and availability. We find that all tested providers are susceptible to at least one attack class in their default configuration, and that the most critical vulnerabilities are structural: they arise from how CI/CD infrastructure handles credentials and configuration files, not from any specific model's behavior. For each confirmed attack class, we identify the minimum-cost workflow-level countermeasure and analyze its coverage and limitations. GitInject is released publicly to facilitate further research in this direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GitInject，一个用于评估AI驱动的CI/CD流水线中提示注入漏洞的开源框架。通过在真实GitHub工作流中触发实际运行，研究发现了跨四个AI供应商的11种攻击类型，包括配置注入、凭证泄露、判断操纵和可用性攻击，所有供应商默认配置均存在至少一类漏洞。
Motivation: AI代理在CI/CD流水线中具有高权限并处理不可信内容，容易受到提示注入攻击，但缺乏在真实生产环境中的系统评估工具。
Method: GitInject框架通过配置临时仓库并触发真实GitHub工作流运行，模拟生产环境中的沙箱约束、凭证处理和权限边界，对多家AI供应商进行攻击测试。
Result: 所有测试AI供应商在默认配置下均易受至少一类攻击，关键漏洞源于CI/CD基础设施处理凭证和配置文件的方式，而非模型行为。
Conclusion: 已确认的攻击类别均可通过工作流级最小成本对策进行防御，但覆盖范围和局限性需进一步分析；框架已开源以促进后续研究。

papers.title: nCMD: Benign-Anchored Feature Selection for Imbalanced Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is critical for network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) operating under high-dimensional, highly imbalanced traffic, as found in operational and defense networks. Traditional filter methods rank features using global statistics computed symmetrically across classes and thus fail to capture the asymmetry of intrusion detection, where attacks are best characterized as deviations from dominant benign traffic. We propose benign-anchored Classwise Mean Deviation (nCMD), a lightweight and interpretable method that scores feature relevance based on the deviation of attack-class distributions from the benign-class mean, rather than a globally biased reference. This approach aligns feature selection with the operational semantics of NIDS at no additional computational cost. Across four benchmark datasets (CICIDS2017, CICDDoS2019, NSL-KDD, and UNSW-NB15), multiple feature budgets, and three downstream classifiers, nCMD matches or exceeds classical filter baselines in macro-averaged F1-score. It achieves the best result on three of the four datasets and under every classifier, with the strongest improvements observed under tight feature budgets and severe class imbalance. These results support benign-anchored ranking as a scalable and interpretable preprocessing component for resource-constrained NIDS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于良性锚定的类均值偏差（nCMD）特征选择方法，用于网络入侵检测中不平衡高维数据。该方法通过计算攻击类分布与良性类均值的偏差来评分特征相关性，而非全局对称统计。在四个基准数据集上，nCMD匹配或超越经典过滤基线的宏平均F1分数，尤其在紧特征预算和严重类别不平衡下表现最佳。
Motivation: 传统过滤方法使用跨类对称的全局统计，无法捕捉入侵检测中攻击作为良性流量偏差的本质特征，导致在不平衡数据下效果不佳。
Method: 提出良性锚定的类均值偏差（nCMD），一种轻量级可解释方法，基于攻击类分布与良性类均值的偏差来评分特征，而非全局偏置参考。
Result: 在CICIDS2017、CICDDoS2019、NSL-KDD和UNSW-NB15四个数据集上，使用多种特征预算和三个下游分类器，nCMD在宏平均F1分数上匹配或超越经典基线，并在三个数据集上取得最佳结果，尤其在紧特征预算和严重不平衡下改进最大。
Conclusion: 良性锚定排序可作为资源受限NIDS的可扩展且可解释的预处理组件。

papers.title: When RL Fails after SFT: Rejuvenating Model Plasticity for Robust SFT-to-RL Handoff
papers.abstract_en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a standard pipeline for Large Language Model (LLM) post-training. SFT is expected to provide a useful behavioral prior for RL to further enhance model capabilities. However, checkpoints with excessive SFT often show limited improvement during RL. We attribute this failure to the loss of model plasticity: the reduced ability of an SFT-initialized policy to be effectively reshaped by subsequent RL. To better understand this phenomenon, we conduct detailed analysis from multiple perspectives, including parameter changes, output spaces, and RL optimization dynamics. Our results show that models from excessive SFT tend to produce over-confident token distributions and exhibit sharp parameter landscapes, which make them harder to optimize in the RL stage. To enable a more robust SFT-to-RL handoff, we propose \texttt{Rejuvenation}, a simple yet effective method that restores plasticity while preserving useful SFT-acquired priors. Rejuvenation leverages base-anchored model fusion to reduce excessive SFT-induced drift with targeted neuron reset to mitigate model rigidity. Experimental results on both math reasoning tasks and agentic tasks demonstrate that our approach consistently improves RL performance on over-trained SFT models, while also enhancing generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示过度监督微调（SFT）会导致模型可塑性丧失，削弱后续强化学习（RL）的优化效果。通过分析参数变化、输出空间和优化动态，发现过度SFT模型产生过度自信的token分布和尖锐的参数景观。提出Rejuvenation方法，利用基于基线的模型融合和定向神经元重置恢复可塑性，同时保留SFT先验。在数学推理和智能体任务上验证了该方法能持续提升过度SFT模型的RL性能及分布外泛化能力。

Method: 提出Rejuvenation方法，包括base-anchored model fusion（缩小过度SFT导致的参数偏移）和targeted neuron reset（缓解模型刚性），在保持有用SFT先验的同时恢复可塑性。
Result: 在数学推理和智能体任务上，Rejuvenation在过度SFT模型上一致提升了RL性能，并增强了对分布外任务的泛化能力。
Conclusion: Rejuvenation提供了一种简单有效的SFT-to-RL过渡策略，通过恢复模型可塑性实现更稳健的流水线，尤其适用于SFT过度的场景。

papers.title: A Note on the Strategic Confinement Problem
papers.abstract_en: Lampson's confinement problem asks how to prevent a program that processes confidential information from leaking it to a third party. We introduce the strategic confinement problem, which arises when the communicating parties are strategic agents with shared coordination resources. In this setting, residual communication capacity can be concentrated on low-entropy, high-impact predicates of the confidential data. Consequently, bounds on information leakage need not induce corresponding bounds on worst-case harm: a channel with negligible capacity may still suffice to select damaging outcomes. We argue that systems of learnt strategic agents naturally instantiate this problem because they do not admit complete behavioural specifications, their learnt conventions generally cannot be predicted or reproduced by an external observer, and sufficiently capable agents can construct covert communication schemes that are difficult to detect or eliminate. Our contribution is therefore not a new theory of communication, but a reinterpretation of confinement in the presence of strategic agents. Classical confinement bounds what information may flow; strategic confinement highlights that this need not bound what strategic agents can jointly achieve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新诠释了Lampson的约束问题，引入战略约束问题，考虑通信方是战略智能体且共享协调资源。作者指出剩余通信容量可集中在高影响低熵谓词上，因此信息泄露的界限并不一定限制战略智能体造成的最大危害。认为学习型战略智能体系统自然实例化此问题，因为缺乏完整行为规范，其习得惯例无法被外部观察者预测或重现，且足够强大的智能体可构建难以检测的隐蔽通信方案。贡献不是新通信理论，而是对约束问题的重新解释。
Motivation: 经典约束问题考虑如何防止程序泄露机密信息，但未考虑通信方是战略智能体且共享协调资源的情况。战略智能体可利用剩余容量造成危害，即使信道容量很小也可能导致严重结果。
Method: 通过战略约束问题重新分析，指出在学习型战略智能体系统中，由于行为不可完全指定、惯例不可预测、隐蔽通信难以检测，经典信息泄露界限不足以防范战略危害。
Result: 残余通信容量可以集中在低熵高影响谓词上，因此信息泄露的界限并不等价于危害界限。
Conclusion: 经典约束限制了什么信息可以流动，而战略约束突显了这并不限制战略智能体共同实现的目标。

papers.title: Compile Once, Differentiate Everywhere: A Differentiable Meta-Circular Interpreter
papers.abstract_en: The boundary between program execution and gradient-based optimization has long limited the use of code itself as a learnable scientific model. We present a compiler that translates a self-hosting subset of Scheme into differentiable computation graphs for autograd backends. Because the subset can compile its own evaluator, this yields differentiable meta-circular interpretation (DMCI): a compiled Scheme interpreter executes programs supplied as data, while reverse-mode autodiff propagates gradients to continuous constants embedded in those programs. The interpreter is compiled once, so new programs inherit differentiability without recompilation or custom gradient machinery, while retaining closures, recursion, and data structures. We prove that gradients through the compiled interpreter are correct almost everywhere and show that they match direct compilation to numerical precision across 171 recursive and higher-order program-seed pairs. We then use DMCI for program-and-parameter co-search, where a large language model proposes Scheme programs and exact gradients calibrate their continuous parameters through a single frozen interpreter. This enables OpenEvolve-style program search in which an outer loop proposes discrete program structures and DMCI supplies exact gradient-based calibration of each candidate's continuous parameters. On battery capacity-fade data, the search recovers a knee-like degradation structure and improves held-out extrapolation over hand-crafted baselines on the harder early-extrapolation split, matching them on the later split. On a high-dimensional El Nino inverse problem, DMCI optimizes an interpreted Kalman-filter likelihood where gradient-free search fails. These results extend symbolic regression and neurosymbolic search from closed-form expressions to executable, stateful programs, making model-generated code directly optimizable against data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种编译器，将自宿主 Scheme 子集翻译为可微分计算图，实现可微分元循环解释（DMCI）。该解释器编译一次后，新程序无需重新编译即可自动获得可微分性，保留了闭包、递归和数据结构。在 171 个程序-种子对上的验证表明梯度精度与直接编译匹配至数值精度。应用于电池容量衰减和厄尔尼诺反问题，在早期外推分裂上优于手工基线，并成功优化了高维卡尔曼滤波器似然。
Motivation: 现有方法中程序执行和梯度优化之间存在界限，限制了代码本身作为可学习科学模型的使用。论文旨在消除这一界限，使任意程序通过单一编译的解释器实现可微分。
Method: 开发了一个编译器，将自宿主 Scheme 子集编译为自动微分后端可用的计算图，实现可微分元循环解释。该解释器编译一次后，新程序无需重新编译即可继承可微分性，同时保留闭包、递归和数据结构。
Result: 在 171 个递归和高阶程序-种子对上验证梯度精度与直接编译匹配至数值精度。在电池容量衰减数据上恢复了膝形退化结构，并在早期外推分裂上优于手工基线。在高维厄尔尼诺反问题上成功优化了卡尔曼滤波器似然，而基于梯度的搜索失败。
Conclusion: 该方法将符号回归和神经符号搜索从闭式表达式扩展到可执行、有状态的程序，使模型生成的代码可直接针对数据优化。

papers.title: Between Amnesia and Chaos: A Memory Stability Expressivity Trilemma for Trainable Dissipative Oscillator Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physical reservoir computing harnesses nonlinear mechanical dynamics but, by convention, freezes the substrate and trains only a linear readout, presuming the substrate is not usefully trainable. We revisit that premise for networks of nonlinear oscillators whose mass, damping, and stiffness are learned end-to-end through a symplectic integrator. Our central result is a trilemma: memory horizon, gradient stability, and dynamical expressivity cannot be simultaneously maximized, because all three are governed by the damping. The backward gradient decays at a rate set by the damping, capping how far back credit can propagate, while forward sensitivities grow exponentially in the largest Lyapunov exponent, so usable gradients require damping above a stability floor. Since the Lyapunov exponent falls as damping rises while the memory ceiling falls as the horizon grows, stable training is confined to a band that contracts with horizon and closes at a critical point. We test every step on a twenty-oscillator network. A damping sweep finds the largest Lyapunov exponent monotone and crossing zero at a well-defined stability floor, confirming the theorem's key assumption. A compute-matched comparison of learned versus frozen substrate on delayed recall across nine horizons shows the learned substrate dominating at short horizons and the advantage closing and reversing near a horizon of eleven steps, the predicted signature of band closure; trained models settle near the stability floor, seeking the edge of chaos unprompted. The analytic ceiling overestimates the empirical crossover roughly fivefold, a gap between detectable and learnable gradient that we report rather than tune away. The contribution is a confirmed account of when training a physical substrate beats freezing it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可训练耗散振荡器网络的记忆-稳定性-表达性三方困境（trilemma），指出阻尼同时控制记忆范围、梯度稳定性和动态表达性，导致三者无法同时最大化。通过20振荡器网络实验验证了理论预测：在短记忆范围下训练基板优于冻结基板，但在长记忆范围下优势消失并反转。
Motivation: 物理储层计算通常冻结非线性基板，只训练线性读出层，但本文重新审视基板是否可训练的问题，试图揭示训练整个非线性振荡器网络的固有限制。
Method: 通过辛积分器端到端学习非线性振荡器网络的质量、阻尼和刚度参数，理论分析阻尼对记忆范围、梯度稳定性和最大李雅普诺夫指数的影响，并推导出稳定训练所需的阻尼下限。
Result: 理论发现记忆范围、梯度稳定性和动态表达性存在三方困境；实验证实阻尼扫描时李雅普诺夫指数单调变化，在短延迟任务中训练基板优于冻结基板，但在延迟约11步时优势消失并反转；分析上限高估经验交叉点约5倍。
Conclusion: 本文提供了何时训练物理基板优于冻结基板的确认性解释，并指出实际可学习梯度范围窄于理论可检测范围。

papers.title: Forward-Only Convolutional Neural Networks with Learnable Channel-Class Assignment
papers.abstract_en: The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm offers a biologically inspired alternative to backpropagation by replacing gradient-based credit assignment with local, forward-only objectives. While recent extensions have adapted FF to convolutional neural networks (CNNs), existing formulations rely on static channel-class partitions and struggle to perform effectively in complex tasks. In this work, we introduce a learnable channel-class assignment mechanism that enables adaptive, data-driven specialization of convolutional channels, supported by entropy and orthogonality regularization to promote learning performance. We further propose a loss-aware layer contribution strategy that adaptively weights intermediate-layer predictions based on their validation performance, enhancing the effectiveness of forward-only inference. Integrated into residual CNNs, the proposed method achieves consistently superior performance across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet compared to existing similar forward-only methods. Notably, it establishes new state-of-the-art performance among FF-based models, substantially narrowing the gap with backpropagation. These findings demonstrate that introducing learnable channel specialization and layer contribution weighting significantly enhances the representational capacity of forward-only learning in deep CNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对前向-前向(FF)算法在CNN中依赖静态通道-类别划分的不足，提出可学习的通道-类别分配机制，并引入熵和正交正则化以及损失感知的层贡献加权策略。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上，该方法优于现有FF方法，达到新的最佳性能，显著缩小了与反向传播的差距。
Motivation: 现有FF算法在CNN中依赖静态通道-类别划分，在复杂任务上表现不佳，缺乏自适应通道专门化。
Method: 提出可学习的通道-类别分配机制，通过熵和正交正则化促进学习；引入损失感知的层贡献策略，根据验证性能自适应加权中间层预测。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上，该方法一致优于现有FF方法，建立了新的最佳性能，显著缩小了与反向传播的差距。
Conclusion: 可学习通道专门化和层贡献加权显著增强了前向学习在深度CNN中的表示能力。

papers.title: Trainable Smooth-Rotation Transforms with Learned Channel Scales for LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is one of the most practical ways to reduce the serving cost of Large Language Models (LLMs), but activation quantization remains difficult because outlier-dominated channels lead to large quantization errors. This paper investigates whether part of this degradation is caused by over-migration in scaling-based equivalent transformations. We introduce a quantile-robust scaling policy for SmoothRot-style transforms by replacing max-based activation statistics with high quantiles, and we complement it with constrained gradient-based optimization of channel scales. On LLaMA-3.2-1B under W4A4 quantization, quantile-only policy search improves selected-layer error by 11.1% over the SmoothRot baseline, joint (alpha, q) search improves it by 12%, and training reaches 18.5%. Replaying the best selected-layer policy on all decoder-block down-projection layers reduces the corresponding full-layer mean error from 97.51 to 78.08 (19.9%). The results show that robust migration control and lightweight scale learning provide consistent gains over max-based fixed policies while preserving the equivalent-transform framework.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to IEEE INES 2026 conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM量化中激活值量化因异常值通道导致误差大的问题，提出可训练的平滑旋转变换方法。通过用高分位数替代最大统计量改进缩放策略，并结合通道尺度的梯度优化，在LLaMA-3.2-1B的W4A4量化下，选定层误差较基线降低11.1%至18.5%，整层平均误差降低19.9%。
Motivation: 当前PTQ中激活量化因异常值通道导致误差大，而基于最大值的等价变换可能引发过度迁移，需要更鲁棒的缩放策略和可学习尺度。
Method: 提出分位数鲁棒缩放策略（高分位数替代最大值）用于SmoothRot变换，并加入约束梯度优化对通道尺度进行学习。

papers.title: Sample Where You Struggle: Sharpening Base Model Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Power Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from the sequence-level power distribution $p^α$ elicits RL-level reasoning from base language models without any parameter updates, but the standard Metropolis--Hastings (MH), a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampler, is both expensive and slow-mixing. We trace both to a structural mismatch: $p^α$ mainly departs from $p$ at a sparse, spatially clustered set of high-entropy decision points, yet MH proposes resampling positions uniformly along the prefix -- wasting compute on near-degenerate conditionals while under-mixing precisely where modes diverge. We propose Entropy-Guided Power Sampling (EGPS), a training-free and verifier-free sampler that re-derives its proposal from token-level entropy already in the forward pass. EGPS skips deterministic blocks, localizes each MCMC move to a high-entropy neighborhood, and applies Multiple-Try Metropolis at decision points -- making sampling cost scale with \emph{entropy mass rather than sequence length}. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B, EGPS reaches best or tied-best accuracy on all three benchmarks (MATH500 $75.8\%$, HumanEval $62.2\%$, GPQA $42.4\%$) at up to a $12.6\times$ wall-clock speedup over the MH baseline.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、无需验证器的采样方法EGPS，通过利用前向传播中token级别的熵信息，指导MCMC采样集中在高熵决策区域，从而在无参数更新的情况下提升基础语言模型的推理能力。在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，EGPS在MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA三个基准上达到最佳或并列最佳准确率，相比标准MH方法实现最高12.6倍的加速。

Method: 提出Entropy-Guided Power Sampling (EGPS)，一种无需训练和验证器的采样方法，从token级熵重新推导提议分布，跳过确定性块，将每个MCMC移动定位到高熵邻域，并在决策点应用Multiple-Try Metropolis。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，EGPS在MATH500 (75.8%)、HumanEval (62.2%)、GPQA (42.4%)达到最佳或并列最佳准确率，相比MH基线实现最高12.6倍墙钟加速。
Conclusion: EGPS通过使采样成本与熵质量而不是序列长度成比例，显著加速并提升推理质量。

papers.title: Sigma-Branch: Hierarchical Single-Path Network Reconstruction for Dynamic Inference with Reduced Active Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Deploying deep neural networks on memory-constrained edge accelerators is bottlenecked by per-inference off-chip weight transfer rather than computation: the dense network cannot be retained on-chip, and every parameter must be loaded for every input. Existing model compression reduces this transfer only at the cost of permanent capacity loss. We propose Sigma-Branch (SigmaB), a framework that restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree composed of a shared backbone, hierarchical routers, and specialized leaves. Pretrained weights are distributed across the tree via activation-based spherical k-means clustering, which jointly initializes router weights and per-branch channel allocations; soft-routing fine-tuning then aligns each leaf with its routed input subset. At inference, the resulting network executes only a single root-to-leaf path, reducing the active-parameter footprint while storing the complete dense parameter set in memory. Across CIFAR-100 / ResNet-50, ImageNet-1K / ResNet-50, and ModelNet40 / PointNet++, SigmaB-Net reduces per-inference active parameters by 58-60% while remaining within 1.72 percentage points (pp) of the dense baseline Top-1. At comparable ImageNet-1K Top-1, the active-parameter reduction exceeds static structured pruning (FPGM, HRank) by 14-23 pp. The cross-modal evaluation, spanning 2D vision and 3D point-cloud backbones, substantiates a framework-level claim that decouples per-inference memory traffic from the total parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sigma-Branch (SigmaB) 框架，将预训练的稠密网络重构为层级二叉树结构（共享骨干、层级路由器、特化叶子），通过激活空间的球面 k-means 聚类初始化路由器权重和通道分配，并通过软路由微调对齐。推理时仅执行单条根到叶路径，显著减少活跃参数数量，同时将完整稠密参数集存储在内存中。在 CIFAR-100/ResNet-50、ImageNet-1K/ResNet-50 和 ModelNet40/PointNet++ 上，SigmaB-Net 将每次推理的活跃参数减少 58-60%，Top-1 精度损失在 1.72 个百分点以内；在 ImageNet-1K 上，活跃参数减少量比静态结构化剪枝（FPGM, HRank）多 14-23 个百分点。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在内存受限的边缘加速器上部署时，每次推理的片外权重传输成为瓶颈，而非计算本身；现有模型压缩方法以减少总参数量为代价，却永久降低了网络容量。
Method: 提出 Sigma-Branch 框架，将预训练稠密网络重构为层级二叉树：包括共享骨干、层级路由器和特化叶子。通过基于激活的球面 k-means 聚类联合初始化路由器权重和每个分支的通道分配；然后进行软路由微调，使每个叶子与其路由的输入子集对齐。推理时仅执行单条根到叶路径，从而减少每推理活跃参数。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100/ResNet-50、ImageNet-1K/ResNet-50 和 ModelNet40/PointNet++ 上，SigmaB-Net 将每推理活跃参数减少 58-60%，Top-1 精度损失在 1.72 个百分点以内。在 ImageNet-1K 上，活跃参数减少量比 FPGM 和 HRank 等静态结构化剪枝方法多 14-23 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要声称通过将每次推理的内存流量与总参数数量解耦，该框架在 2D 视觉和 3D 点云骨干网络上进行了跨模态评估，验证了框架级的设计主张。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Neural Operators: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification in Physics Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators such as the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), achieving speedups of several orders of magnitude over traditional numerical solvers. However, deploying these models in safety-critical engineering applications -- such as thermal management of electronic components and battery systems -- requires not only accurate point predictions but also rigorous uncertainty guarantees. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for neural operators, including Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles, provide only relative uncertainty estimates without formal coverage guarantees. In this work, we propose the first application of split conformal prediction to neural operator-based physics simulation, providing distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantees. We further introduce a normalized conformal prediction scheme that leverages MC Dropout uncertainty to produce adaptive-width intervals, yielding tighter intervals in regions of low uncertainty and wider intervals where the model is less certain. Full-scale experiments (33.7M parameters, 800 training samples, 5 ensemble members, NVIDIA V100) on steady-state heat conduction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves 89.1% empirical coverage at the target level of alpha=0.1, while producing spatially adaptive prediction intervals that reflect the underlying physical uncertainty structure. We also provide an uncertainty decomposition framework that separates epistemic uncertainty (68% of total) from aleatoric uncertainty (32% of total), offering actionable guidance for data collection and model improvement. Our method is implemented in an open-source platform with REST API endpoints and interactive 3D visualization.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 7 figures. Full-scale experiments on NVIDIA V100
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将分割共形预测 (split conformal prediction) 应用于基于神经算子的物理模拟，为傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 等模型提供无分布假设的有限样本覆盖保证。提出一种归一化共形预测方案，结合蒙特卡洛 Dropout 不确定性生成自适应宽度区间。在稳态热传导基准上，目标水平 α=0.1 时达到 89.1% 经验覆盖，不确定性分解显示认知不确定性占总不确定性的 68%。
Motivation: 神经算子在安全关键的工程应用（如电子元件热管理）中需要严格的置信保证，而现有不确定性量化方法（如 MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles）仅提供相对估计，缺乏正式覆盖保证。
Method: 提出分割共形预测与归一化共形预测方案：先拟合神经算子，再用校准集计算残差分位数得到预测区间；利用 MC Dropout 不确定性归一化残差以实现区间宽度自适应。
Result: 在稳态热传导基准上，使用 3370 万参数、800 训练样本、5 个集成成员的设置下，目标覆盖水平 α=0.1 时达到 89.1% 经验覆盖，不确定性分解显示认知不确定性占 68%、任意不确定性占 32%。
Conclusion: 所提方法为神经算子在安全关键场景的应用提供了有覆盖保证的不确定性量化工具，开源平台包含 REST API 和交互式 3D 可视化。

papers.title: The Bioelectrical Information Theory: Investigating the theoretical compression limit of bioelectrical signals under artificial intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Bioelectrical signals are increasingly acquired at scales that challenge the bandwidth of brain-computer interfaces. However, their compression is still often framed as a problem of waveform preservation, limited by the entropy of the raw signal. Here we propose an information-theoretic framework in which the effective information of bioelectrical data is determined not only by signal fidelity, but also by physiological structure, model capacity and downstream task requirements. We formulate bioelectrical compression as a three-level hierarchy. At the signal level, noise is reduced to the information they carry about latent physiological sources. At the physiological level, parametric encoders map purified signals into compact, structured and quantized representations. At the semantic level, task-irrelevant information is discarded, while deep learning models exploit causal dependencies to replace marginal entropy with conditional entropy. This perspective reframes the compression limit of bioelectrical signals as a model- and task-conditioned quantity rather than a fixed property of the waveform. As increasingly expressive models become integrated with neural and physiological interfaces, bioelectrical compression may shift from transmitting signals to transmitting only the residual information required for task-level interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个信息论框架，将生物电信号压缩视为三级层次结构：信号水平降噪、生理水平参数编码器映射为紧凑表示、语义水平丢弃任务无关信息并利用因果依赖。该框架重新定义压缩极限为模型和任务条件量，而非固定波形属性。
Motivation: 现有生物电信号压缩受限于波形保真度和原始信号熵，未充分考虑生理结构、模型能力和下游任务需求。
Method: 提出三级压缩层次：信号水平将噪声降至潜在生理源的信息量；生理水平通过参数编码器生成紧凑结构化量化表示；语义水平丢弃任务无关信息，利用深度学习模型的因果依赖以条件熵替代边际熵。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，而是提出一个理论框架，将生物电信号压缩极限重新定义为模型和任务条件量。
Conclusion: 随着更强大模型集成到神经和生理接口，生物电压缩可能从传输完整信号转变为仅传输任务级解释所需的残余信息。

papers.title: Co-GLANCE: Uncertainty-Aware Active Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Perceptual uncertainty is a central challenge for heterogeneous robot teams operating in unstructured outdoor environments, where no single viewpoint affords reliable scene understanding. Perceptual uncertainty, arising from sources such as occlusions, manifests differently across robot viewpoints depending on scene structure. Detecting and resolving sources of perceptual uncertainty requires both scene-based contextual reasoning and capability-aware robot allocation. While vision-language models provide strong semantic priors for both, they are computationally prohibitive for onboard inference and lack calibrated uncertainty quantification. We introduce Co-GLANCE, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams. Co-GLANCE distills the semantic reasoning capabilities of a vision-language model into an end-to-end model for occlusion segmentation and robot allocation, eliminating the need for cloud-based inference. To quantify perceptual uncertainty, Co-GLANCE combines conformal prediction with selective abstention to provide statistically valid coverage guarantees for segmentation, robot allocation, and detection outputs. These calibrated uncertainty estimates directly trigger active perception, dispatching the most appropriate robot to acquire informative viewpoints and resolve uncertainty. Across real-world scenarios, Co-GLANCE outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy by 25% and 36%, respectively, while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x. We also release an air-ground dataset for future research. Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/ .
papers.comment: Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Co-GLANCE系统，用于异构机器人团队在非结构化环境中实时处理感知不确定性。系统将VLM的语义推理能力蒸馏为端到端模型，结合保形预测和选择性弃权提供统计有效的不确定性量化，并触发主动感知。实验表明，在遮挡分割和机器人分配上优于基于云的VLM基线，准确率分别提升25%和36%，推理延迟降低350倍。
Motivation: 异构机器人团队在户外环境中面临感知不确定性（如遮挡），单个视角难以可靠理解场景，而现有VLM计算开销大且缺乏校准的不确定性量化，需要实时机载解决方案。
Method: 提出Co-GLANCE，包括：1) 将VLM的语义推理能力蒸馏为端到端模型用于遮挡分割和机器人分配；2) 结合保形预测与选择性弃权，为分割、分配和检测输出提供统计有效的覆盖保证；3) 利用校准的不确定性估计触发主动感知，调度最合适的机器人获取信息视角。
Result: 在真实场景中，Co-GLANCE在遮挡分割和机器人分配准确率上分别比基于云的VLM基线提升25%和36%，帧推理延迟降低350倍。
Conclusion: Co-GLANCE实现了异构机器人团队中实时、校准的主动感知，无需云端推理，并发布了空地数据集以促进未来研究。

papers.title: SPDM: Geometry-Modulated State Space Modeling with Manifold Constraints for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing the continuously evolving correlation structure among interacting variables. Existing state-space models process time series by scanning tokenized temporal or spatial sequences, discarding the evolutionary geometric structure. We address this limitation by introducing manifold constraints into state-space modeling: treating the cross-variable correlation structure as a continuous trajectory on the symmetric positive definite manifold, whose Riemannian geometric features, tangent space linearity, and Frechet mean centrality act as a principled geometric regularizer that guides and stabilizes the selective scanning dynamics of SSMs. We propose SPDM, a geometry-aware SSM architecture that realizes this principle through two cooperating mechanisms: a manifold trajectory path that projects dynamically evolving covariance matrices from the SPD manifold to a Euclidean tangent space, and a geometric gating scheme that directly modulates SSM's internal selective parameters based on geometric signals derived from the manifold trajectory. The parameterization preserves the linear-time complexity of the Mamba parallel scan while embedding rich structural constraints, making the architecture preserve prediction accuracy and computational efficiency simultaneously. Extensive experiments on eleven real-world benchmark datasets establish state-of-the-art forecasting performance, and further studies confirm that geometrically constrained state-space dynamics are the dominant architectural factor behind its performance gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPDM，一种几何感知的状态空间模型（SSM），将多变量时间序列中变量间的相关结构建模为对称正定（SPD）流形上的连续轨迹。通过流形轨迹路径和几何门控机制，利用黎曼几何特征引导SSM的选择性扫描动态，在保持Mamba线性复杂度同时嵌入结构约束。在11个真实世界基准数据集上取得最先进预测性能。
Motivation: 现有状态空间模型处理时间序列时丢弃了变量间相关结构的演化几何信息，导致无法捕捉连续变化的互相关模式。
Method: 引入流形约束：将交叉变量相关结构建模为SPD流形上的连续轨迹；设计两个合作机制——流形轨迹路径（将协方差矩阵投影到欧几里得切空间）和几何门控方案（基于几何信号调制SSM内部选择性参数）。
Result: 在11个真实世界基准数据集上实现最先进预测性能；消融实验确认几何约束的状态空间动态是性能提升的主导因素。
Conclusion: 提出几何正则化方法，在保持预测精度和计算效率的同时嵌入结构约束，为时间序列预测提供了新的几何感知SSM架构。

papers.title: IntentKV: Cross-Turn Intent-Aware KV Cache Pruning for Agent Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn LLM agents fan short queries into long trajectories of tool calls, search results, and intermediate reasoning. Both KV memory and KV read bandwidth grow by orders of magnitude across a single trajectory, making the key-value (KV) cache, not parameter compute, the dominant serving bottleneck for long-horizon agents. We introduce IntentKV, learned KV pruning that keeps the base LLM frozen. IntentKV maintains a session-level QueryMemory of cross-turn intent, scores live history tokens with a memory-attention rule, and adds a zero-initialized residual head with cross-attention over current-query K-vectors. To stay composable with prefix caches, eviction is a slot-map redirection: dropped positions route to a sentinel dead slot while surviving K/V rows, RoPE phases, and slot identities stay in place. IntentKV matches the no-pruning full-cache baseline with almost no accuracy drop under tight KV budgets: at an 8k KV budget, mean peak request tokens drop 23.9% on Qwen3-8B and 30.7% on Qwen2.5-14B. On the 100 longest BCP queries that all methods complete on Qwen2.5-14B, IntentKV-8k further cuts worst-case peak request tokens from 92.3k to 20.5k, a 77.8% reduction, and worst-case raw KV reads from 411M to 31M, a 92.6% reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IntentKV，一种针对多轮LLM agent推理的跨轮次意图感知KV缓存剪枝方法。该方法保持基础LLM冻结，通过维护会话级的QueryMemory记录跨轮次意图，利用记忆注意力规则为历史token打分，并添加零初始化的残差头与当前查询的K向量进行交叉注意力。驱逐策略采用槽位重定向，将丢弃的位置路由到哨兵死槽位，同时保留存活的K/V行、RoPE相位和槽位标识。实验表明，在严格KV预算下，IntentKV几乎不损失精度：在8k KV预算下，Qwen3-8B的平均峰值请求token减少23.9%，Qwen2.5-14B减少30.7%；在Qwen2.5-14B上处理100个最长BCP查询时，IntentKV-8k将最坏情况峰值请求token从92.3k降至20.5k（减少77.8%），最坏情况原始KV读取从4.11亿降至3100万（减少92.6%）。
Motivation: 多轮LLM agent的短期查询会演变为包含大量工具调用、搜索结果和中间推理的长轨迹，导致KV缓存的大小和读取带宽快速增长，成为服务瓶颈。现有KV剪枝方法多针对单轮场景，难以有效处理跨轮次依赖。
Method: IntentKV提出跨轮次意图感知的KV剪枝：维护会话级QueryMemory存储历史意图；通过记忆注意力规则对历史token评分；添加零初始化的残差头，利用当前查询的K向量进行交叉注意力；驱逐时采用槽位重定向，丢弃的token映射到一个哨兵死槽位，不影响其他存活KV行。
Result: 在8k KV预算下，Qwen3-8B平均峰值请求token减少23.9%，Qwen2.5-14B减少30.7%。在Qwen2.5-14B上处理100个最长BCP查询时，最坏情况峰值请求token从92.3k降至20.5k（减少77.8%），最坏情况原始KV读取从4.11亿降至3100万（减少92.6%）。
Conclusion: IntentKV在严格KV预算下几乎不损失精度，显著降低峰值请求token和KV读取量，适用于长时域LLM agent推理场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mix, Don't Pick: Why Synthetic Corpus Composition Matters for Time Series Foundation Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Choosing the wrong synthetic generator for time-series foundation model pretraining is costly: under identical training budgets, the best and worst generators produce up to a $2\times$ gap in forecasting error, yet the field has no principled way to make this choice. The problem is compounded by the fact that generator rankings are not stable across architectures: across 11 generator families evaluated on Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small trained from scratch, we find that which generators are useful depends on the model architecture. Rather than solving the generator selection problem, we sidestep it: a simple equal-weight mixture of all generators matches or beats the best individual generator for both architectures, and composing this mixture with real data yields the strongest pretraining corpora overall. Synthetic pretraining is therefore a corpus composition problem, not a generator selection problem, and composition choices should be validated per model family rather than assumed to transfer.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在时间序列基础模型预训练中，选择错误的合成数据生成器会导致预测误差最多相差2倍，且生成器的有效性依赖于模型架构。作者提出使用所有生成器的简单等权混合，其效果匹配或超越最佳单一生成器，并与真实数据混合后获得最强预训练语料。因此，合成预训练本质上是语料组成问题而非生成器选择问题。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型预训练依赖合成数据，但生成器选择缺乏原则性指导，且生成器排名在不同架构间不稳定，导致训练成本浪费。
Method: 作者在Chronos-T5-Mini和Moirai-Small两种架构上，从零训练评估11个生成器家族，并提出简单等权混合所有生成器，以及将混合语料与真实数据结合的方法。
Result: 最佳与最差生成器之间预测误差差距达2倍；等权混合匹配或超越最佳单一生成器；加入真实数据后获得最强预训练语料。
Conclusion: 合成预训练应被视为语料组成问题，且组成选择需针对每个模型家族验证，而非假设可迁移。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Bypassing Copyright Protection in Diffusion-based Customization via Two-Stage Latent Feature Optimization
papers.abstract_en: With the growing concerns over copyright infringement in diffusion-based customization, adversarial attacks have emerged as a prominent defense strategy to prevent malicious content forgery in personalized image generation. However, current defenses typically introduce persistent perturbations in the latent space of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), which remain susceptible to adaptive bypasses by adversaries. In this paper, we introduce Two-Stage Latent Feature Optimization (TS-LFO), an efficient and effective copyright-stealing attack against protected diffusion-based customization. We begin by observing that existing defenses primarily disrupt the mapping between input images and their latent representations, thereby degrading the model's ability to produce personalized outputs. To counteract this, TS-LFO restores the broken mapping through a two-stage optimization process. In the Latent Denoising Stage, we enhance semantic consistency between latent codes and input images by jointly minimizing a Latent-Image Alignment Loss and a Latent Diffusion Loss with timestep-dependent weights, effectively suppressing the high-frequency noise introduced by defenses. In the Latent Reconstruction Stage, we recover low-frequency semantic information using pixel-level constraints to refine the latent features. Extensive experiments show that TS-LFO consistently bypasses state-of-the-art (SOTA) copyright defenses and outperforms SOTA copyright attacks such as DiffPure, GrIDPure and IMPRESS across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段潜在特征优化（TS-LFO）攻击方法，用于绕过扩散模型定制化中的版权保护。通过在潜在去噪阶段和潜在重建阶段分别优化，恢复被防御破坏的输入图像与潜在表示之间的映射，从而成功窃取版权内容。实验表明该方法优于现有版权攻击。
Motivation: 现有防御在潜在空间中引入持续扰动，但易被自适应绕过，本文旨在设计更有效的版权窃取攻击以揭示防御的脆弱性。
Method: 提出 TS-LFO，包含两个阶段：(1) 潜在去噪阶段，联合优化潜在-图像对齐损失和时间步依赖的潜在扩散损失，抑制防御引入的高频噪声；(2) 潜在重建阶段，使用像素级约束恢复低频语义信息。
Result: 实验表明 TS-LFO 持续绕过 SOTA 版权防御，并优于 DiffPure、GrIDPure、IMPRESS 等攻击方法。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了现有版权防御的不足，并提供了更强大的攻击方法，有助于推动更鲁棒防御的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IDP-Bench: Benchmarking ability of LLMs to protect personal information in interdependent privacy contexts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming widely deployed as personal AI assistants with access to sensitive user data, making privacy a major challenge for their design and evaluation. Prior work focuses mainly on individual-level risks, overlooking \textbf{interdependent privacy (IDP)}--where one person's data may be revealed by others without their knowledge or consent. We address this gap by introducing \textbf{IDP-Bench}: the first LLM benchmark for IDP scenarios, grounded in the Contextual Integrity (CI) framework. We evaluate eight open-source LLMs on their understanding of IDP scenarios across three levels of IDP reasoning using two LLM judges. Results show strong co-ownership recognition (6/8 models exceed 90\%) but persistent weaknesses in identifying CI parameters (information attribute, primary subject) and IDP-specific parameters such as secondary subjects, where 7/8 models score below 74\%. Models also struggle to judge sharing appropriateness (5/8 scoring below 77\%). While the ability to judge the appropriateness of sharing improves with scale, performance tends to decline in smaller models, and prompt sensitivity remains high on IDP-specific questions--highlighting the need for more targeted study of IDP in LLM privacy research. Data \& code available \href{https://github.com/tisl-lab/Interdependent_Privacy_Bench}{here}.

TL;DR: 本文提出IDP-Bench，首个针对大语言模型在相互依赖隐私（IDP）场景下能力的基准测试，基于情境完整性（CI）框架。评估了8个开源LLM在三级IDP推理上的表现，发现模型在共同所有权识别上表现良好（6/8模型超过90%），但在识别CI参数和IDP特定参数（如次要主体）上存在持续弱点（7/8模型低于74%），且对共享适当性的判断能力较弱（5/8低于77%）。
Motivation: 现有LLM隐私研究主要关注个体层面的风险，忽视了相互依赖隐私（IDP）——一个人的数据可能被他人无意或未经同意地泄露。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 基于情境完整性（CI）框架构建IDP-Bench基准，包含三级IDP推理任务，使用两个LLM法官评估8个开源LLM的表现。

Conclusion: 本文强调LLM在IDP场景下的隐私理解仍存在显著不足，需要更有针对性的研究。基准和代码已开源。

papers.title: LongMoE: Longitudinal Multimodal Learning via Trajectory-Aware Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal clinical learning is increasingly important for integrating diverse patient data, including imaging, text, and personalised health records. However, it faces two fundamental challenges: i) modality missingness, where arbitrary subsets of modalities are unavailable at a given patient visit, ii) longitudinal dynamics, where the diagnostic significance of an observation depends on the patient's evolving disease trajectory over time. Existing methods address these challenges in isolation: missing-modality frameworks treat each visit as an independent static snapshot and discard temporal context, while longitudinal models often assume complete modality availability and degrade under systematic modality incompleteness. We propose LongMoE (Longitudinal Mixture-of-Experts), the unified framework to jointly address both challenges. LongMoE combines a context-aware imputation module with an attentional tokenization module that captures frequency-domain temporal patterns across irregular visit sequences, a trajectory-aware encoder for modeling disease progression, and context-conditioned Sparse MoE routing for patient-specific expert selection. Experiments on ADNI, OASIS-3, and MIMIC-IV show that LongMoE improves robustness under missing or weak contemporaneous modalities and remains competitive in full-modality settings, establishing a strong foundation for longitudinally-aware multimodal clinical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LongMoE框架，统一处理多模态临床学习中的模态缺失和纵向动态两大挑战。该方法结合上下文感知插补模块、频域时序注意标记化、轨迹感知编码器和上下文条件稀疏MoE路由。在ADNI、OASIS-3和MIMIC-IV数据集上，LongMoE在模态缺失或弱模态下表现鲁棒，在全模态设置中同样具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有方法孤立处理模态缺失（将每次就诊视为独立快照）或纵向动态（假设模态完整），无法同时应对两种真实场景。
Method: LongMoE包含四个核心组件：上下文感知插补模块处理缺失模态；注意标记化模块捕捉不规则就诊序列的频域时序模式；轨迹感知编码器建模疾病进展；上下文条件稀疏MoE路由实现患者特定专家选择。
Result: 在ADNI、OASIS-3和MIMIC-IV上，LongMoE在缺失或弱模态下提升鲁棒性，全模态设置下保持竞争性能。
Conclusion: LongMoE为纵向感知的多模态临床学习建立了统一框架，同时应对模态缺失和时间动态。

papers.title: The Whale That Outswam Evolution: Swarm Intelligence Maximises Memory in Connectome Reservoirs
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing exploits the fixed dynamics of a recurrent network for temporal processing, requiring only a trained linear readout. Biological neural connectomes, shaped by millions of years of evolution, may encode computational structure beyond what random reservoirs provide, yet whether that structure can be further enhanced by principled optimisation remains an open question. We address it by applying four gradient-free, bio-inspired optimisers (Particle Swarm Optimisation, Differential Evolution, Grey Wolf Optimiser, and Whale Optimisation Algorithm) to the edge weights of connectome-based echo-state networks across six species spanning six orders of magnitude in neural complexity: C. elegans (279 neurons), Drosophila (49 nodes), mouse (112), rat (73), macaque (29 regions, continuous FLNe synaptic strengths), and human structural MRI connectivity (83 parcels). Each connectome is evaluated on four canonical reservoir computing benchmarks: Memory Capacity (MC), Lorenz attractor prediction, NARMA-10 system identification, and Mackey-Glass chaotic time-series prediction. All four optimisers consistently outperform unoptimised biological baselines across every task and species when initialised from biological weights. WOA achieves the largest gains on every task: up to a 17x MC improvement (C. elegans: 1.39 to 23.91) and up to 89% NRMSE reduction (Mackey-Glass, human), corresponding to an average 214% improvement across all species and tasks. Crucially, random initialisation on the same topology reliably underperforms biology, establishing biological weight values as an essential inductive bias that topology alone cannot recover. These results position bio-inspired, biologically-initialised optimisation as a principled and broadly effective strategy for connectome reservoir computing across the animal kingdom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物连接组储备池计算，应用四种无梯度的生物启发优化器（粒子群、差分进化、灰狼优化、鲸鱼优化）对六种物种的连接组权值进行优化。结果表明，在四个基准任务上，所有优化器都优于未优化的生物基线，其中鲸鱼优化算法提升最大（记忆容量提升17倍，Mackey-Glass预测NRMSE降低89%）。初始化为生物权值对性能至关重要，随机初始化效果更差。
Motivation: 生物神经连接组经进化形成的计算结构可能优于随机储备池，但能否通过优化进一步提升尚不清楚。
Method: 对六种物种的连接组（线虫、果蝇、小鼠、大鼠、猕猴、人类）应用粒子群、差分进化、灰狼、鲸鱼四种无梯度优化器调整边权，评估记忆容量、洛伦兹吸引子预测等四个任务。
Result: 所有优化器在所有任务和物种上均超过未优化基线；鲸鱼优化取得最大增益：记忆容量提升17倍，NRMSE最多降低89%，平均改进214%。随机初始化效果显著差于生物初始化。
Conclusion: 生物启发的、生物初始化的优化是连接组储备池计算的有效策略，生物权值提供了拓扑无法替代的重要归纳偏置。

papers.title: On the Controllability-Fidelity Frontier in Diffusion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based generative models enable powerful image editing capabilities, but achieving precise control while maintaining fidelity and safety remains challenging. We present a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study of controllable diffusion-based image editing, analyzing the trade-offs between adherence to user intent, preservation of non-target content, and output quality. Our work spans text- and mask-guided edits, point/drag manipulation, and inversion-based pipelines. We derive mathematical formulations of editing objectives and analyze dynamics of noise injection, score guidance, and inversion error. We provide theoretical bounds on reconstruction error, stability under repeated edits, and locality of changes. We propose algorithmic frameworks (with pseudocode) for mask-localized and instruction-guided editing, and present extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods (e.g.\ TF-ICON \cite{lu2023tficone}, DragFlow \cite{zhou2025dragflow}, InstructPix2Pix \cite{brooks2023instructpix2pix}, UltraEdit \cite{zhao2024ultraedit}) on multiple tasks and metrics (FID, identity similarity, CLIP alignment, artifact scores, etc). Our results reveal key failure modes, such as identity drift, prompt sensitivity, and compositional errors. We also discuss ethical considerations in image editing, including misuse risks, bias, consent, and concept erasure techniques (e.g.\ MACE \cite{lu2024mace}, ANT \cite{li2025ant}, EraseAnything \cite{gao2024eraseanything}) as safeguards. We conclude with best practices and future directions for responsible, high-fidelity diffusion-based editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对扩散模型图像编辑中的可控性与保真度权衡进行了全面的理论和实证研究。研究涵盖文本引导、掩码引导、点/拖动操作和反演管线，推导了编辑目标的数学形式，分析了噪声注入、分数引导和反演误差的动态。提出了掩码局部和指令引导编辑的算法框架，并在多个任务上使用FID、身份相似度、CLIP对齐等指标比较了TF-ICON、DragFlow、InstructPix2Pix、UltraEdit等SOTA方法。结果揭示了身份漂移、提示敏感性和组合错误等关键失败模式，并讨论了伦理问题。
Motivation: 扩散模型图像编辑虽功能强大，但实现精确控制的同时保持保真度和安全性仍具挑战，现有方法缺乏对可控性与保真度之间系统性的理论分析。
Method: 提出编辑目标的数学公式，分析噪声注入、分数引导和反演误差的理论界限；给出掩码局部和指令引导编辑的伪代码框架；在多个任务上实验比较SOTA方法。
Result: 实验揭示了身份漂移、提示敏感性和组合错误等失败模式；在FID、身份相似度、CLIP对齐等指标上提供了系统对比。
Conclusion: 总结了高保真扩散编辑的最佳实践和未来方向，并讨论了滥用风险、偏见和概念擦除等伦理考虑。

papers.title: Less Context, More Accuracy: A Bi-Temporal Memory Engine for LLM Agents Where a Lean Retrieved Context Beats the Full History
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is the missing layer for LLM agents: across sessions they forget, and the common workaround -- replaying the whole history into the prompt -- is expensive, slow, and, as distractors accumulate, less accurate. Most memory systems win on cost or latency but still lose to the full-context baseline on accuracy, and benchmark numbers are reported on inconsistent, non-reproducible harnesses, so one system appears at wildly different scores across sources. We present Engram, an open-source, dual-process memory engine on a bi-temporal data model. A fast write path appends lossless episodes with no LLM on the critical path; an asynchronous path extracts atomic (subject, predicate, object) facts, builds a bi-temporal knowledge graph, and resolves contradictions without an LLM call per fact -- invalidating, never deleting, so every fact keeps provenance and a supersession chain. A hybrid read path fuses dense, lexical, graph, and recency/salience signals, applies a point-in-time ("as-of") filter, and assembles a compact, provenance-tagged context. On the full 500-question LongMemEval_S, graded by the official category-specific judge, Engram's lean configuration -- answering from a ~9.6k-token retrieved slice, never the full history -- scores 83.6% vs. 73.2% for full-context (+10.4 points, McNemar p < 10^-6) at ~8x fewer tokens (9.6k vs. 79k), with 0/500 errored. The gain needs a hybrid read path: facts alone lose recall, while facts plus retrieved chunks recover detail. We also contribute a neutral, in-repo evaluation harness with the official judge baked in and the full-context baseline in every table, publish the raw per-question logs, and document the measurement-integrity pitfalls (truncation, home-grown judges, full-history leaks) that silently distort memory benchmarks. Every number ships with a command to reproduce it.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code, reproducible harness, and raw per-question logs: https://github.com/ly-wang19/engram
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Engram，一种基于双时间数据模型的开源双过程记忆引擎，用于提升 LLM 代理的长期记忆能力。快速写入路径以无损方式追加会话事件，无需 LLM 参与关键路径；异步路径提取原子事实（主语、谓语、宾语）并构建双时间知识图谱，通过无效化而非删除来解决事实矛盾，保留每个事实的溯源和继承链。混合读取路径融合密集检索、词法检索、图检索及时间/显著性信号，应用时间点过滤，生成紧凑且带有溯源标记的上下文。在 LongMemEval_S 基准上，Engram 的轻量配置（约 9.6k token 检索片段）达到 83.6% 准确率，超越全上下文基准（73.2%），且 token 数减少约 8 倍，无错误输出。论文还提供了可复现的评估框架和每问题日志，并揭示了内存基准测试中常见的测量完整性陷阱。
Motivation: LLM 代理在跨会话交互中缺少有效的长期记忆，常见做法是将完整历史重放到提示中，但成本高、速度慢且随着干扰项积累导致准确率下降。现有记忆系统在成本或延迟上虽有优势，但准确率仍不及全上下文基线，且基准测试缺乏一致性。
Method: 提出 Engram 引擎，包含双处理路径：快速写入路径将事件以无损格式追加存储，不阻塞 LLM；异步路径从事件中提取原子事实并构建双时间知识图谱，通过标记无效而非删除来处理事实冲突，确保每个事实有完整溯源和继承链。读取时混合密集检索、词法检索、图检索和时效性/显著性信号，并应用时间点过滤以生成紧凑且带溯源标记的上下文。
Result: 在 LongMemEval_S 的全部 500 个问题上，Engram 使用约 9.6k token 的检索片段达到 83.6% 准确率，优于使用 79k token 全上下文的 73.2%（提升 10.4 个百分点，McNemar p < 10^-6），且无任何错误。同时，token 数减少约 8 倍。实验表明混合读取路径是关键：仅使用事实会损失召回率，需结合事实与检索块才能恢复细节。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过双时间记忆模型和混合读取路径，轻量检索上下文可以超越全历史上下文的准确率，同时大幅降低计算成本。作者提供了可复现的代码、评估框架和原始日志，并指出了内存基准测试中常见的测量完整性陷阱（如截断、自建评判标准、历史泄漏），呼吁标准化评估。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 Engram 引擎，包含双处理路径：快速写入路径将事件以无损格式追加存储，不阻塞 LLM；异步路径从事件中提取原子事实并构建双时间知识图谱，通过标记无效而非删除来处理事实冲突，确保每个事实有完整溯源和继承链。读取时混合密集检索、词法检索、图检索和时效性/显著性信号，并应用时间点过滤以生成紧凑且带溯源标记的上下文。
summary_sections.result: 在 LongMemEval_S 的全部 500 个问题上，Engram 使用约 9.6k token 的检索片段达到 83.6% 准确率，优于使用 79k token 全上下文的 73.2%（提升 10.4 个百分点，McNemar p < 10^-6），且无任何错误。同时，token 数减少约 8 倍。实验表明混合读取路径是关键：仅使用事实会损失召回率，需结合事实与检索块才能恢复细节。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明，通过双时间记忆模型和混合读取路径，轻量检索上下文可以超越全历史上下文的准确率，同时大幅降低计算成本。作者提供了可复现的代码、评估框架和原始日志，并指出了内存基准测试中常见的测量完整性陷阱（如截断、自建评判标准、历史泄漏），呼吁标准化评估。

papers.title: When Attribution Patching Lies: Diagnosis and a Second-Order Correction
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of mechanistic interpretability is to identify which internal components causally drive a language model's behavior. Because these importance estimates serve as the evidence for identifying circuits, systematic errors can lead to the misidentification of the underlying mechanisms. While activation patching provides a gold-standard causal metric, its computational cost is prohibitive at scale. Practitioners instead rely on attribution patching, a gradient-based, first-order approximation whose reliability remains poorly understood. In this work, we characterize the source of this unreliability, demonstrating that the dominant error stems from the non-linearities in the downstream network rather than local curvature at the patched component. This insight yields three practical tools: (i) a reliability score to detect untrustworthy estimates, (ii) error bounds quantifying potential attribution mis-specifications, and (iii) a Hessian-vector-product (HVP) correction that eliminates the leading-order error with only one additional backward pass. In evaluations across five model families (124M-9B parameters) and both random-token and naturalistic (name-swap) perturbations, HVP is the only second-order correction feasible at larger scale, where standard baselines like Integrated Gradients become computationally prohibitive. In comparative experiments, a multi-step HVP variant matches or exceeds the accuracy of Integrated Gradients at significantly lower compute, outperforming prior second-order baselines. These improvements lead to higher-fidelity circuit recovery on standard benchmarks and support a Screen-Flag-Fix workflow that targets computational effort only toward the components flagged as unreliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了归因修补（attribution patching）在语言模型机制可解释性中的不可靠性，指出其主要误差来源于下游网络的非线性而非局部曲率。基于此，提出了可靠性分数、误差界以及Hessian-向量积（HVP）修正方法，仅需额外一次反向传播即可消除主导误差。在五个模型家族（124M-9B参数）和多种扰动设置下，HVP变体以显著更低的计算成本匹配或超越了集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）的精度，并提升了电路恢复的保真度。
Motivation: 归因修补作为激活修补的轻量级替代方案被广泛使用，但其一阶近似的可靠性尚未被充分理解，可能导致电路识别中的系统性错误。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，将误差归因于下游网络非线性，并据此设计三项工具：可靠性分数（检测不可靠估计）、误差界（量化潜在错误）以及基于Hessian-向量积的二阶修正（仅增加一次反向传播）。
Result: 在124M-9B参数的五个模型家族上，多步HVP变体在显著降低计算成本的同时，匹配或超越了集成梯度的准确性，并优于先前的二阶基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法可支持“筛选-标记-修复”工作流，将计算资源仅集中在被标记为不可靠的组件上，从而提升电路恢复的保真度。

papers.title: TRAPS: Therapeutic Response Analysis via Pathway-informed Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Cancer treatment planning requires decisions across multiple clinical dimensions at once. Clinicians must determine whether a patient should receive targeted molecular therapy, radiation therapy, and whether they are likely to survive beyond six months. Existing pathway-informed deep learning models have been developed and tested in isolation, making fair comparison across architectures impossible. We present the first unified benchmark for pathway-guided therapy response modeling, evaluating three biologically informed architectures, BINN, GraphPath, and PATH, across five cancer cohorts drawn from The Cancer Genome Atlas, representing 2,622 patients encoded using Reactome pathway activity scores. Each model is trained jointly on all three clinical outcomes under identical data and evaluation conditions, the first study to treat pathway-structured deep learning as a combined therapy and survival prediction problem. Our results show that no single architecture wins across all tasks: PATH performs best for targeted molecular therapy prediction overall, BINN is most reliable for survival prediction, and no model produces useful predictions for radiation therapy, as the key drivers of that decision are clinical variables not captured in gene expression data. Most strikingly, GraphPath achieves an AUROC of 0.92 on prostate targeted molecular therapy prediction, the highest score in the entire benchmark, demonstrating that lateral co-regulation structure produces exceptional discriminative power when matched to a cohort with a narrow targetable driver programme, even under conditions of extreme class imbalance at only 11\% positive prevalence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个跨架构统一的通路引导癌症治疗反应建模基准（TRAPS），在TCGA五个队列（2622名患者）上公平比较BINN、GraphPath和PATH三种生物信息学模型，同时预测靶向治疗反应、放疗反应和六个月生存率。结果显示无模型在所有任务上一致最优：PATH在靶向治疗预测上整体最佳，BINN在生存预测上最可靠，GraphPath在前列腺癌靶向治疗预测上取得AUROC 0.92（阳性率仅11%），而所有模型对放疗预测均无效，因为关键驱动因素未包含在基因表达数据中。
Motivation: 现有通路引导的深度学习模型各自独立开发测试，缺乏统一比较框架，无法公平评估不同架构在联合治疗反应与生存预测上的表现。
Method: 构建首个统一基准TRAPS，使用Reactome通路活性分数编码五个癌症队列（2622名患者），在相同数据划分和评估条件下联合训练三个已知架构（BINN、GraphPath、PATH）同时预测三个临床结局（靶向治疗、放疗、生存）。
Result: PATH在靶向分子治疗预测上整体AUROC最高，BINN在生存预测上最可靠，GraphPath对前列腺癌靶向治疗预测达到AUROC 0.92（阳性率仅11%），所有模型对放疗预测的AUROC均未显著优于随机。
Conclusion: 研究表明通路结构化深度学习在联合预测治疗反应和生存时，不同架构擅长的任务不同，放疗预测需要临床变量而非常规基因表达特征；该基准为未来方法提供公平评估平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HMAF: A Hierarchical Multi-Slot GD-RTB Allocation Framework
papers.abstract_en: In modern online advertising platforms, Guaranteed Delivery (GD) contracts coexist and bid with Real-Time Bidding (RTB) auctions. Recent approaches either decouple GD and RTB optimization or rely on heuristic priority rules, and thus fail to effectively balance short-term revenue maximization with long-term contract delivery under complex multi-slot delivery and impression constraints. To address these challenges, we propose HMAF (Hierarchical Multi-Slot Allocation Framework), a unified framework designed to optimize impression allocation in GD--RTB advertising platforms. HMAF employs the Plan--Calibrate--Execute paradigm as its core structure, and integrates offline constraint optimization with online decision-making, balancing offline GD resource planning, dynamically calibrating GD--RTB competitiveness, and making real-time listwise rank decisions across multi-slot environments. HMAF has been implemented in multiple marketing scenarios at Meituan, one of the world's largest online food delivery platforms, leading to a 3.72% increase in GD delivery rate and a 1.59% increase in total advertisement revenue.
papers.comment: Accepted by KDD 2026 Applied Data Science Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HMAF（分层多槽位分配框架）以统一优化在线广告中的保证交付（GD）合同与实时竞价（RTB）拍卖。该框架采用“计划-校准-执行”范式，整合离线约束优化与在线决策，平衡GD资源规划、动态校准GD-RTB竞争力，并在多槽位环境中做出实时排序决策。在美团平台实现后，GD交付率提升3.72%，广告总收入增长1.59%。
Motivation: 现有方法将GD与RTB优化解耦或依赖启发式优先级规则，无法在复杂多槽位投放和曝光约束下有效平衡短期收入最大化与长期合同交付。
Method: 提出HMAF框架，采用Plan-Calibrate-Execute核心结构，集成离线约束优化与在线决策，包括离线GD资源规划、动态校准GD-RTB竞争力，以及实时列表级排序决策。
Result: 在美团多个营销场景中实施后，GD交付率提升3.72%，广告总收入提升1.59%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调HMAF通过统一框架有效平衡了GD交付与广告收入，并在实际平台中验证了其有效性。
Relevance: 0
