papers.title: A Navigable Manifold of Hypothesized Consciousness-Spectrum States in Language Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Across contemplative, philosophical, and psychological accounts, human consciousness is often described along a similar spectrum, ranging from reactive and self-focused patterns to more integrative and coherent ones. Understanding whether language models encode such a structured, human-interpretable consciousness spectrum in representation space is important for model guidance, evaluation and alignment. In this work, we study the geometric structure and dynamics of patterns along this spectrum in transformer embedding spaces. We show that embeddings exhibit a globally organized geometry aligned with this spectrum: sentences associated with similar states cluster into locally coherent regions, forming a structured manifold. In particular, higher-level and lower-level regions exhibit convexity-like stability, while intermediate regions form a transition corridor. Dynamically, both utility-guided and geometry-only greedy trajectories consistently traverse from lower- to higher-level regions, passing through intermediate tiers, indicating that navigability is an intrinsic property of the representation space, guided but not dictated by a global directional signal. These results suggest that embedding spaces encode structured and navigable geometry aligned with a hypothesized consciousness-spectrum taxonomy, broadly inspired by recurring structural descriptions of human consciousness across contemplative traditions, philosophy, and modern psychology, providing a representation-level perspective for analyzing and guiding model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型（LM）表征空间中与人类意识光谱对应的几何结构与动态。作者发现Transformer嵌入空间中句子状态沿假设的意识光谱形成全局有序的流形：高低层次区域具有凸性稳定，中间区域为过渡走廊；贪婪轨迹趋向于从低层到高层穿过中间区域，表明该流形具有内在的可导航性。该结果为模型行为分析与引导提供了表征层面的视角。
Motivation: 理解语言模型是否在表征空间中编码了与人类意识光谱相一致的、可解释的结构，对于模型引导、评估和对齐具有重要意义。
Method: 分析Transformer嵌入空间中句子状态的几何结构与动态；利用假设的意识光谱分类标签，研究局部聚类、凸性稳定区域以及走廊过渡性质；使用基于效用或纯几何的贪婪轨迹探索可导航性。
Result: 嵌入空间呈现全局有序的流形结构：高低层区域表现凸性稳定，中间区域形成过渡走廊；贪婪轨迹（不论是否含效用引导）均从低层区域经中间区域到达高层区域，表明可导航性是表征空间的内在属性。
Conclusion: 嵌入空间编码了与人类意识光谱假设一致的结构化、可导航的几何性质，为分析及引导模型行为提供了表征层面的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FG-Attn: Leveraging Fine-Grained Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Using diffusion transformers for media generation may require evaluating attention over extremely long sequences, with attention layers accounting for the majority of generation latency. Exploiting sparsity in attention maps offers a promising opportunity to reduce this cost. In this work, we show that attention maps in diffusion transformers exhibit significant fine-grained sparsity in video generation models. Existing sparse attention methods, however, are too coarse-grained, leaving a large fraction of redundant computation unaddressed, or incur high overheads at finer granularity. We propose FG-Attn, a novel, low-overhead fine-grained sparse attention mechanism that skips score computations at the granularity of a MxN tile, where N>=1 and M>=16, and where each block is the result of query-key dot products between M queries and N keys. FG-Attn addresses the key challenge of hardware underutilization in sparse attention kernels on GPUs, without incurring the overheads of irregular memory access and redundant operations. FG-Attn can fully supersede existing sparse attention methods and extend block sparse attention methods to finer granularities on modern GPUs. At 70% sparsity, FG-Attn is up to 2.45X faster than the state-of-art FlashInfer, and reduces attention kernel time by 14.7% on average. FG-Attn speeds up end-to-end video generation times by up to 1.40X (1.18X on average) over Flash Attention 3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FG-Attn，一种用于视频扩散模型的细粒度稀疏注意力机制，以 MxN tile 为粒度跳过 query-key 点积计算（M≥16, N≥1），解决 GPU 硬件利用不足的问题。实验表明，在 70% 稀疏度下，FG-Attn 比最先进的 FlashInfer 快 2.45 倍，平均减少 14.7% 的注意力核时间，并实现端到端视频生成速度最高 1.40 倍（平均 1.18 倍）的提升。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型中注意力层占推理延迟的大部分，现有稀疏注意力方法要么粒度过粗留下大量冗余计算，要么在更细粒度下引入高开销。
Method: 提出 FG-Attn，一种低开销的细粒度稀疏注意力机制，通过在 MxN tile 粒度跳过计算来减少冗余，同时避免不规则内存访问和冗余操作，适用于现代 GPU。
Result: 在 70% 稀疏度下，FG-Attn 的注意力核比 FlashInfer 快 2.45 倍，平均快 14.7%；端到端视频生成时间比 Flash Attention 3 最多快 1.40 倍（平均 1.18 倍）。
Conclusion: FG-Attn 可完全替代现有稀疏注意力方法，并将块稀疏注意力扩展到更细粒度，提升视频扩散模型的效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tractogram foundation model
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography is the only noninvasive approach for mapping white-matter pathways in the living human brain. It represents each brain as a tractogram: a large, unordered set of three-dimensional streamlines that includes information about both local streamline geometry and whole-brain anatomical organization. This structure makes tractograms a natural but challenging target for representation learning. Existing methods treat streamline classification and subject-level prediction as separate problems: streamline classifiers focus on geometric patterns, whereas subject-level prediction often depends on hand-crafted features. As a result, current methods do not learn reusable representations that connect streamline anatomy with whole-brain inter-subject variation. Here we introduce TractFM, a tractogram foundation model that learns reusable representations directly from whole-brain streamline sets. TractFM combines a local streamline encoder with a permutation-equivariant tractogram encoder, allowing all streamlines from a subject to be contextualized jointly in a single forward pass. Pretraining on dense anatomical tract parcellation, i.e., assigning anatomical labels to individual streamlines, yields two complementary representations: contextualized streamline-level embeddings for tract parcellation and compact subject-level descriptors for downstream prediction of subject phenotypes. Across three tractography algorithms and five dMRI datasets, TractFM transfers to both streamline-level and subject-level tasks. Its frozen representations achieve accurate tract parcellation and predict age and sex across independent datasets. These results show that whole-brain geometric context, learned once, can generalize across tractography pipelines, datasets, and prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TractFM，一个针对脑白质纤维束图 (tractogram) 的基础模型，直接从全脑流线集合中学习可复用表示。模型结合局部流线编码器和置换等变束编码器，在一次前向传播中联合上下文化所有流线。在密集解剖束分割上预训练后，产生流线级嵌入用于束分割和紧凑的主体级描述符用于预测。在三个纤维追踪算法和五个 dMRI 数据集上，冻结表示能准确进行束分割并预测年龄和性别。
Motivation: 现有方法将流线分类和主体水平预测分离，流线分类器关注几何模式，而主体预测常依赖手工特征，无法学习连接流线解剖与跨主体变化的可复用表示。
Method: TractFM 包含局部流线编码器和置换等变束编码器，可对同一主体的所有流线进行联合上下文编码。预训练任务为密集解剖束分割，输出两种互补表示：上下文感知的流线级嵌入和紧凑的主体级描述符。
Result: 在三个纤维追踪算法和五个 dMRI 数据集上，TractFM 的冻结表示能准确完成束分割任务，并在独立数据集中预测年龄和性别。
Conclusion: 全脑几何上下文一旦学习，可泛化到不同纤维追踪流程、数据集和预测任务，表明该方法具有跨任务迁移能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LMT: A Bayesian Framework for Causal Discovery from Textual Alarm Records in Manufacturing Systems
papers.abstract_en: Textual event records, such as alarm logs, have become an increasingly common data source in engineering and manufacturing systems. Beyond identifying correlations or recurring patterns, engineers are often interested in understanding which types of events causally trigger or influence other events during system operation. Textual event descriptions may contain semantic clues about such causal relationships, and recent large language models (LLMs) provide a promising tool for extracting these signals. However, relying solely on LLM-encoded textual information is insufficient for accurate causal discovery, since semantic patterns do not directly reveal causal mechanisms and may confuse causation with correlation or frequent sequential patterns. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{LMT}, a Bayesian causal discovery framework for engineering event data that jointly leverages textual descriptions and timestamps. Specifically, LMT first uses LLMs to extract semantic causal signals from event descriptions and constructs a prior distribution over causal graphs among event types or event clusters. It then incorporates temporal evidence through a Poisson-process-based likelihood, allowing the LLM-informed prior to be refined by timestamp-based statistical evidence. By integrating the textual and temporal information, LMT produces a causal graph that is both interpretable and data-supported. Simulation studies show that the proposed framework is effective across different settings and is especially advantageous in small-sample alarm-event scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LMT，一个贝叶斯因果发现框架，用于从制造系统的文本告警记录中推断事件之间的因果关系。LMT结合大语言模型（LLM）从文本描述中提取语义因果信号构建先验，再通过基于泊松过程的似然函数整合时间戳证据，得到数据支持的因果图。模拟实验表明该方法在小样本告警场景下尤其有效。
Motivation: 工程系统中文本告警记录日益普遍，工程师希望理解事件间的因果机制，但仅靠LLM编码的文本信息不足以准确发现因果关系，因为语义模式可能混淆因果与相关或频繁序列模式。
Method: LMT框架首先利用LLM从事件描述中提取语义因果信号，构建因果图的先验分布；然后通过基于泊松过程的似然函数结合时间戳证据，更新先验得到后验因果图。
Result: 模拟研究显示LMT在不同设置下有效，尤其在小样本告警事件场景中具有优势。
Conclusion: LMT通过整合文本语义和时间戳信息，为制造系统告警数据提供了一种可解释且数据支持的因果发现方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Representation Curriculum: Stagewise Training for Robust Ranking and Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Ranking in digital marketplaces is a dynamic exposure-allocation mechanism: displayed items shape discovery trajectories and success events logged by the platform to update future allocation policies. Modern ranking systems rely heavily on exposure-confounded signals (e.g. popularity estimates, CTR/CVR aggregates, and ID-based representation), because they are highly predictive under stationary demand. Yet this predictive power can become a learning shortcut: early access to exposure-dependent belief signals steers optimization toward over-reliance on them and away from exposure-independent merit signals (e.g., content-based competitiveness and semantic affinity). Consequently, the learned policy tends to entrench incumbents and degrade cold-start generalization and robustness under distribution shift. We propose Representation Curriculum (RC), a training-time intervention that temporally stages feature utilization. RC foregrounds content-based merit signals initially, then introduces exposure-dependent belief signals while anchoring the content pathway near the learned merit representation, curbing shortcut reliance on historical signals and mitigating gradient starvation on content signals. We formalize RC independently of task and hypothesis class and provide ranking-specific instantiations. In a Gaussian linear ridge setting, we derive closed-form solutions and sufficient conditions under which RC strictly reduces population risk on a cold-start target distribution, with a quantified Pareto tradeoff against source performance. Experiments on public learning-to-rank and recommendation benchmarks, and randomized online experiments in a large-scale e-commerce search system, show that RC measurably shifts reliance from historical belief signals toward content-based merit signals and yields consistent gains on cold populations with a controlled trade-off in head performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表示课程（Representation Curriculum, RC），一种分阶段训练方法，用于鲁棒的排序和分配。RC先强调基于内容的信号，后引入暴露依赖信号，并锚定内容路径，以减少对历史信号的捷径依赖。理论分析（高斯线性岭回归）和实验（包括大规模电商搜索的在线实验）表明RC能改善冷启动泛化。
Motivation: 现代排序系统过度依赖暴露混淆信号（如流行度、CTR），这些信号在静态需求下预测性强，但会导致学习捷径，忽视与暴露无关的基于内容的信号，从而削弱冷启动泛化和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出表示课程（RC），一种训练时干预，通过分阶段特征利用：先引入基于内容的信号，后引入暴露依赖信号，同时锚定内容路径，抑制对历史信号的捷径依赖，缓解内容信号上的梯度饥饿。
Result: 在公开的学习排序和推荐基准上，以及大规模电商搜索系统的随机在线实验中，RC可衡量地减少了模型对历史信念信号的依赖，转向基于内容的信号，并在冷群体上取得一致改进，同时头部性能仅受可控权衡。
Conclusion: RC是一种与任务和假设类无关的训练策略，能有效提高排序模型的冷启动鲁棒性，并在理论上提供了帕累托权衡的量化分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PreAct-Bench: Benchmarking Predictive Monitoring in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents capable of executing multi-step action trajectories toward a given objective. While existing safety research has focused on detecting unethical behavior from complete trajectories, this paradigm is fundamentally retrospective: it identifies harm only after it has already occurred. In this work, we study a critical yet overlooked safety task, which we term Predictive Monitoring: given only a partial action trajectory, can a model infer whether it will culminate in an unethical action before the overt action is executed? To support this task, we present PreActBench, a benchmark of 1,000 paired ethical and unethical action trajectories spanning five domains. We evaluate a range of LLMs, safety guardrail models, and latent probing methods across varying fractions of the action trajectory using our Prefix Foresight F1 metric. Results show that while humans achieve promising performance, predictive monitoring remains challenging even for strong models, highlighting the need for future-oriented risk reasoning in LLM safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Predictive Monitoring任务：给定部分动作轨迹，预测是否会导向不道德行为。为支持该任务，构建了包含1000对轨迹的PreActBench基准，涵盖五个领域。实验表明人类表现良好，但现有模型在此任务上仍具挑战。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全研究主要基于完整轨迹进行事后检测，无法在危害发生前预警。本文旨在填补这一空白，转向面向未来的风险推理。
Method: 定义Predictive Monitoring任务，构建PreActBench基准（1000对轨迹，五个领域），并提出Prefix Foresight F1评估指标。测试多种LLM、安全护栏模型及潜在探针方法。
Result: 人类在该任务上表现有希望，但即使强模型也面临挑战，表明需要未来导向的风险推理能力。
Conclusion: Predictive Monitoring是LLM安全中重要但困难的任务，现有模型能力不足，需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optuna Constrained Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator Is a Joint Density Generalization of c-TPE
papers.abstract_en: Constrained hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is common in practice, yet Optuna's widely used constrained TPE lacks algorithmic analysis. While c-TPE proposes an expected constrained improvement (ECI) approach assuming independence between the objective and constraints, Optuna uses a single joint density over both. We show that Optuna's constrained TPE is joint c-TPE -- the same ECI acquisition function using a joint likelihood. We demonstrate joint c-TPE is invariant to constraint duplication whereas independent c-TPE degrades as the product accumulates duplicated factors. We outline practical tradeoffs between the formulations and directions for future study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了Optuna中广泛使用的约束TPE算法，指出其实际上是联合c-TPE，即使用联合似然度的ECI采集函数。与独立c-TPE不同，联合c-TPE对约束重复具有不变性，而独立c-TPE会因重复因子乘积而性能下降。文章讨论了两种公式之间的实际权衡和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 约束超参数优化在实际中常见，但Optuna的约束TPE缺乏算法分析。
Method: 通过理论分析表明Optuna的约束TPE是联合c-TPE，并比较了联合c-TPE与独立c-TPE的性质。
Result: 联合c-TPE对约束重复具有不变性，而独立c-TPE随着重复因子增加性能下降。
Conclusion: 指出了两种公式之间的实际权衡，并为未来研究提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SinkRec: Mitigating Semantic State Sink in Long Sequence Recommendation with Memory-Conditioned Gated Delta Networks
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention provides an efficient backbone for long-sequence recommendation by avoiding the quadratic cost of standard Transformers, but its compressed recurrent state can be dominated by repetitive behavior patterns. We identify this phenomenon as semantic state sink, where recurring semantics over-occupy the recurrent state and bias subsequent readouts. To mitigate semantic state sink, we propose SinkRec, a hybrid memory-transition looped architecture that decouples collaborative behavioral pattern storage from dynamic transition modeling. SinkRec externalizes recurring local patterns into a learnable conditional memory through residual vector quantization, reinjects the retrieved codes, and exposes memory key-value pairs to the attention block. It further introduces Temporal-Aware State-Relation Differential Gated DeltaNet (TDGD), which uses memory to purify recurrent writing and reading by suppressing memory-covered updates and removing memory-aligned readout responses. This design turns recurring semantics from state-competing signals into memory-retrievable patterns, allowing the recurrent state to focus on dynamic transitions and alleviating semantic state sink with linear-time efficiency. Experiments on public and industrial datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of SinkRec.

papers.title: SocraticPO: Policy Optimization via Interactive Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models usually supervises reasoning with scalar outcome rewards, such as binary correctness. Such rewards provide an optimization direction but rarely explain how a model should revise its mistaken reasoning, which can encourage shortcut learning and brittle policies. We propose \textbf{SocraticPO} (Socratic Policy Optimization), a policy-optimization framework that augments RL rollouts with Socratic-style natural-language guidance. During rollout, the student first answers independently; if the answer is incorrect, a teacher diagnoses the attempt and provides concise corrective guidance, after which the student continues under the expanded context. Crucially, this guidance is paired with reward decay: correct answers obtained after teacher intervention only receive decayed rewards, preventing the policy from treating teacher help as a free path to reward. Since SocraticPO only modifies the rollout process while leaving the standard expected-reward objective intact, it can be plugged into existing policy-gradient backends such as Reinforce++. Moreover, because the teacher provides only text-level guidance, SocraticPO can leverage stronger black-box teacher models without requiring access to logits or distribution matching. On undergraduate-level scientific reasoning benchmarks from SciKnowEval, SocraticPO improves over strong RL and self-distillation baselines. Ablations show that both targeted guidance and reward decay are necessary, with reward decay mitigating reliance on assisted correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SocraticPO，一种在强化学习（RL）中通过苏格拉底式自然语言指导来优化策略的框架。在 rollout 过程中，学生模型先独立回答，若答案错误，教师模型诊断并提供纠正性指导，学生再在扩展上下文中继续推理。同时，教师帮助后的正确回答仅获得衰减奖励，防止策略依赖辅助修正。该方法仅修改 rollout 过程，可集成到 Reinforce++ 等策略梯度后端，且教师无需访问 logits。在 SciKnowEval 本科级科学推理基准上，SocraticPO 优于强 RL 和自蒸馏基线。消融实验表明，针对性指导和奖励衰减均不可或缺。
Motivation: 现有 RL 训练大语言模型时通常仅使用标量结果奖励（如正确性），这提供了优化方向但未解释如何修正错误推理，容易导致捷径学习和脆弱策略。
Method: 提出 SocraticPO 框架，在 RL rollout 中引入教师苏格拉底式自然语言指导：学生先独立回答，错误时教师诊断并给出简洁纠正指导，学生继续推理。指导伴随奖励衰减，即教师帮助后正确的回答仅获得衰减奖励。该方法保持标准期望奖励目标，可插入现有策略梯度后端（如 Reinforce++），且教师仅需文本指导，无需 logits 或分布匹配。
Result: 在 SciKnowEval 本科级科学推理基准上，SocraticPO 优于强 RL 和自蒸馏基线。消融实验表明，同时使用针对性指导和奖励衰减是必要的，其中奖励衰减缓解了对辅助修正的依赖。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过苏格拉底式自然语言指导配合奖励衰减，可以有效提升策略的鲁棒性，减少对辅助修正的依赖。

papers.title: SHAPE: Coalition-Aware Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models achieve strong quality with low per-token compute, yet their deployment is often limited by the memory wall: the full expert pool must remain resident to support token-dependent routing. Expert pruning is a direct remedy, but prior criteria typically score experts independently and overlook that MoE inference is inherently \emph{coalitional}, where outputs arise from routed top-$k$ expert combinations. We propose \textbf{SHAPE}, a task-driven pruning framework that explicitly models \emph{intra-layer} expert cooperation. SHAPE formulates routing traces on a small calibration set as an empirical cooperative game and assigns interaction-aware expert values via a Shapley-style attribution over observed top-$k$ coalitions, enabling the identification of experts that are essential for high-utility collaborations rather than merely frequent. To preserve MoE topology under a global pruning budget, SHAPE further introduces a \emph{quality-coverage} selection rule that retains, in each layer, the minimal expert subset covering an $α$ fraction of non-negative Shapley mass, while using bisection to match a target keep rate. Experiments on three modern MoE backbones (Qwen3-30B-A3B, GPT-OSS-20B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite) across diverse benchmarks show that SHAPE consistently improves robustness over global and layer-wise pruning variants, maintaining competitive accuracy under 20\% and 40\% expert pruning without additional training and delivering clear reductions in peak GPU memory footprint. The open-source code is available at https://github.com/Alizen-1009/Shapley-Moe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出SHAPE框架，利用合作博弈论的Shapley值对稀疏MoE大语言模型进行专家剪枝，显式建模专家间的合作而非独立评分。通过质量-覆盖选择规则在全局剪枝预算下保留关键专家，在Qwen3-30B-A3B、GPT-OSS-20B和DeepSeek-V2-Lite三个模型上，20%和40%专家剪枝下保持竞争性精度并减少峰值GPU内存。
Motivation: 现有专家剪枝方法独立评估每个专家，忽略了MoE推理中输出来自路由到的top-k专家组合这一合作性质，导致剪枝效果不佳。
Method: 将小规模校准集上的路由轨迹建模为经验合作博弈，通过Shapley式归因分配考虑交互的专家价值；引入质量-覆盖选择规则，每层保留覆盖α比例非负Shapley质量的最小专家子集，并通过二分法匹配目标保留率。
Result: 在三个现代MoE骨干模型上，20%和40%专家剪枝下保持竞争性精度，并显著降低峰值GPU内存占用。
Conclusion: 显式建模专家合作可在无需额外训练的情况下提升剪枝鲁棒性，开源代码已发布。

papers.title: TENP: Trapezoidal Expert Neuron Pruning For Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts large language models (LLMs) scale efficiently through sparse activation, yet their deployment is fundamentally constrained by the large static parameter footprint of experts. Existing compression approaches either remove entire experts, disrupting routing topology and harming performance, or rely on unstructured weight pruning with limited practical efficiency. To address the limitations, we propose TENP, a structured Trapezoidal ExpertNeuron Pruning framework. Using a few samples, we identify and retain important experts, while applying expert neuron pruning (ENP) to less important experts, reserving model parameters in a trapezoidal pattern from shallow to deep layers. When evaluating expert importance, we jointly consider both the magnitude of the expert output and its ability to change the direction of the input vector. For ENP, we measure each neuron's projected contribution to the expert output to identify and retain important neurons. We conduct extensive experiments on the Qwen and DeepSeek models. Under a routing expert sparsity of 40% and an average of 63.76% activated expert parameters, the DeepSeek model suffers only a 1-point drop in accuracy compared to the full-parameter model. Moreover, it outperforms the full-parameter model by 10% on code generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出TENP（梯形专家神经元剪枝）框架，针对混合专家大语言模型，通过少量样本识别重要专家，对不重要专家进行结构化神经元剪枝，并在浅层到深层保留梯形参数模式。实验表明，在Qwen和DeepSeek模型上，路由专家稀疏40%且平均激活参数63.76%时，DeepSeek模型准确率仅下降1%，代码生成任务甚至提升10%。
Motivation: 现有混合专家大语言模型部署受静态大参数负担限制，压缩方法要么移除整个专家破坏路由拓扑，要么非结构化剪枝效率有限。
Method: 提出TENP框架，包括：1）使用少量样本，联合考虑专家输出幅度和改变输入方向的能力来评估专家重要性；2）对不重要专家进行基于神经元投影贡献的剪枝；3）从浅到深保留梯形参数模式。
Result: 在DeepSeek模型上，采用40%路由专家稀疏度和63.76%平均激活专家参数时，准确率仅下降1%，而在代码生成任务上比全参数模型提升10%。
Conclusion: TENP在保持性能的同时显著压缩混合专家模型参数，验证了结构化和非对称剪枝的有效性。

papers.title: Failure Modes of Deep Multi-Agent RL in Asynchronous Pricing: Reproducible Triggers, Trace Diagnostics, and a Partial Fix
papers.abstract_en: We study two reproducible failure modes of deep multi-agent reinforcement learning in continuous-time pricing markets: (i) tacit cartel formation between competing DDPG agents, and (ii) actor--critic instability at high event rates. We instantiate both inside a single CT-MARL benchmark (Poisson-clocked price updates, observation latency $δ$, interior-optimum logit demand), show that synchronous DDPG agents reliably trigger Failure Mode 1 with collusion index $Δ= 0.69 \pm 0.11$, and quantify a partial microstructure fix: asynchrony alone cuts collusion by 48\% and adding latency drives it to a minimum of $Δ= 0.28$. The fix has clearly documented costs: it is partial ($Δ$ remains supra-Bertrand), it is non-monotone in $δ$, and it does not survive Failure Mode 2, which emerges as DDPG critic divergence at $λ= 5$ and corrupts the phase-diagram cell at $(λ{=}5, δ{=}1)$. We accompany the scalar collusion index with trajectory-level trace diagnostics that expose the within-episode signalling collapse and the post-shock non-recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间定价市场中深度多智能体强化学习的两种可复现失败模式：竞争性DDPG代理之间的隐性卡特尔形成和高事件率下的演员-评论家不稳定性。在同步DDPG代理中，卡特尔指数Δ=0.69±0.11，而异步机制可减少48%的合谋，加上延迟后Δ最低降至0.28。但修复是部分的、非单调的，且在第二类失败模式下失效。
Motivation: 异步定价环境中深度多智能体强化学习存在未充分分析的失败模式，可能导致合谋或不稳定，威胁市场效率。
Method: 在Poisson时钟价格更新、观察延迟δ和内部最优对数需求的CT-MARL基准测试中，通过同步DDPG代理触发两种失败模式，并评估异步和延迟作为部分修复的效果。
Result: 同步DDPG可靠触发合谋（Δ=0.69±0.11）；异步机制单独减少合谋48%，加入延迟后Δ降至0.28；但修复非单调，且在高事件率（λ=5）下演员-评论家发散导致Fix失效。
Conclusion: 论文强调异步和延迟只能部分缓解合谋，且无法应对高事件率下的不稳定性，需要更鲁棒的解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TD-Grokking: Learning from Zero-Reward Problems by Training-Time Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in reasoning tasks, largely driven by post-training paradigms, especially reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, a critical bottleneck persists: RLVR fails on highly challenging zero-reward problems, where all sampled reasoning trajectories yield uniformly failed outcomes, providing no optimization signal to drive model improvement. Prior efforts to address this limitation, such as dense process supervision, partial reward assignment, or prefix-guided exploration, suffer from inherent task constraints or do not fully equip the policy model with the capabilities necessary to solve the original intractable problems. To address this, we propose TD-Grokking, a training-time decomposition framework for zero-reward problems. It recursively decomposes intractable root problems into self-contained, verifiable subproblems, forming hierarchical trees where solvable leaves provide non-zero rewards. Evaluations on mathematical and medical tasks show that TD-Grokking outperforms vanilla GRPO as well as all baseline approaches. Together with detailed analysis, these results confirm that training-time decomposition effectively converts zero-reward examples into usable training signals, enabling consistent performance gains. Our code and datasets are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TD-Grokking-6567/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TD-Grokking，一个训练时分解框架，用于解决强化学习在零奖励问题（所有轨迹都失败，无法提供优化信号）上的瓶颈。该方法递归地将难解根问题分解为自包含、可验证的子问题，形成层次树，其中可解的叶子节点提供非零奖励。在数学和医学任务上的评估表明，TD-Grokking 优于 vanilla GRPO 和所有基线方法。
Motivation: RLVR 在零奖励问题上失败，因为所有采样轨迹都失败，没有优化信号。先前的密集过程监督、部分奖励分配或前缀引导探索等方法受限于任务约束或不能完全赋予策略模型解决原始难问题的能力。
Method: 提出训练时分解框架 TD-Grokking，递归地将难解问题分解为自包含、可验证的子问题，构建层次树，使得可解的叶子节点提供非零奖励，从而将零奖励示例转化为可用训练信号。
Result: 在数学和医学任务上，TD-Grokking 优于 vanilla GRPO 和所有基线方法。
Conclusion: 训练时分解能有效地将零奖励示例转化为可用的训练信号，实现一致的性能提升。

papers.title: WHU-Infra3D: A Full-stack Multi-modal Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Roadside Infrastructure Inventory
papers.abstract_en: The paradigm of digital twin cities is shifting from coarse visual mapping toward more precise and actionable digitization of urban assets. However, existing datasets predominantly focus on coarse visual perception, lacking the strict multi-modal alignment and attribute and status diagnosis required for automated infrastructure maintenance. To bridge this gap, we introduce WHU-Infra3D, a large-scale, multi-modal benchmark dataset dedicated to roadside infrastructure inventory. Covering 53.8 km across three cities, WHU-Infra3D uniquely integrates panoramic imagery and LiDAR point clouds with rigorous 2D-3D instance association and cross-frame tracking. Comprising over 175k multi-view 2D bounding boxes alongside thousands of 3D infrastructure instances, the dataset provides over 181k detailed attribute and status annotations (e.g., rust, occlusion) to empower operational health assessment. We establish comprehensive baselines across five core tasks: 2D detection, 2D cross-view matching, 3D geo-identification, 3D point cloud segmentation, and attribute recognition. Extensive evaluations expose significant cross-city domain gaps and inherent vulnerabilities of current models on long-tailed defective statuses, establishing WHU-Infra3D as an essential testbed for advancing scalable, AI-driven urban infrastructure inventory and lifecycle management. The WHU-Infra3D dataset is available at https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Infra3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍WHU-Infra3D，一个大规模多模态路边基础设施数据集，包含全景图像和LiDAR点云，覆盖53.8公里，具有严格的2D-3D实例关联和跨帧跟踪，提供超过18万详细属性标注（如锈蚀、遮挡）。建立了2D检测、2D跨视角匹配、3D地理识别、3D点云分割和属性识别等五个任务的基线，评估显示显著跨城市域差距和当前模型在长尾缺陷状态上的脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有数据集主要聚焦于粗略视觉感知，缺乏严格的多模态对齐和属性状态诊断，无法支持自动化基础设施维护。
Method: 采集三个城市53.8公里的全景图像和LiDAR点云，进行2D-3D实例关联和跨帧跟踪，提供超过18万条详细属性与状态标注，并建立五个核心任务的基线。
Result: 大量评估揭示显著的跨城市域差距，当前模型对长尾缺陷状态（如锈蚀、遮挡）存在固有脆弱性。
Conclusion: WHU-Infra3D作为可扩展、AI驱动的城市基础设施清单与生命周期管理的重要测试平台，有助于推动该领域发展。

papers.title: Toward Calibrated, Fair, and accurate Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detectors show large performance gaps across demographic groups. Existing fairness approaches require demographic labels, retraining, or sacrifice accuracy. We introduce Face-Fairness (FF), a plug-and-play framework for bias mitigation. Our primary contribution, Face-Feature Tuning (FFT), is the first demographic label-free fairness method demonstrated for deepfake detection: a lightweight calibrator that performs a logit remapping conditioned on frozen face embeddings. We complement FFT with two variants: FF-Max, which maximizes worst-group accuracy when demographics are available, and FF-Discover, which does the same with embedding-discovered groups. Across in-domain and cross-dataset test settings, FF consistently reduces FPR/TPR gaps and improves minimum group accuracy while maintaining (often improving) overall accuracy. The approach is detector-agnostic, adds negligible runtime overhead, and requires no access to identity attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Face-Fairness (FF)框架，用于缓解深度伪造检测中的偏差。核心贡献是Face-Feature Tuning (FFT)，这是首个无需人口统计标签的深度伪造检测公平性方法，通过基于冻结人脸嵌入的logit重映射实现。实验表明，在域内和跨数据集测试中，FF一致减少了FPR/TPR差距并提高最小组准确性，同时保持或提高总体准确性。该方法检测器无关，运行时开销可忽略，无需身份属性。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在不同人口统计组之间存在性能差距，而现有的公平性方法需要人口统计标签、重训练或牺牲准确性。
Method: 提出Face-Fairness (FF)框架，包含三种变体：FFT（无需人口统计标签，通过冻结人脸嵌入进行logit重映射）、FF-Max（利用人口统计标签最大化最小组准确率）、FF-Discover（利用嵌入发现组别以最大化最小组准确率）。
Result: 在域内和跨数据集测试中，FF显著降低FPR/TPR差异，提高最小组准确率，同时保持或提升整体准确率。方法检测器无关，运行时开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无需人口统计标签即可实现深度伪造检测的公平性，且不影响整体性能，具有即插即用的实用价值。

papers.title: Hyperparameter Learning for Latent Factorization of Tensors for Representation Learning to Large-scale Dynamic Weighted Directed Network
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale dynamic weighted directed networks (DWDNs) are widely used to model time-varying interactions among nodes. Latent factorization of tensors (LFT) extracts target knowledge from DWDNs via low-rank embedding. However, similar to many machine learning models, the performance of LFT heavily depends on the selection of hyperparameters. In practice, these parameters are often tuned manually or through grid search, which requires significant computational resources and human effort. Motivated by this challenge, this paper proposes an automated hyperparameter optimization framework based on Differential Evolution (DE) for LFT (DE-LFT). The proposed method integrates DE into the training process of the LFT model to automatically learn optimal regularization parameters $λ_1$, $λ_2$ and $λ_3$. As a result, the model can adaptively search the hyperparameter space and improve prediction accuracy. Experimental results on four real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves lower MAE and RMSE compared with manually tuned baselines while reducing the need for extensive parameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模动态加权有向网络（DWDN）的张量分解（LFT）模型中的超参数选择问题，提出基于差分进化（DE）的自动超参数优化框架DE-LFT。该框架将DE集成到LFT训练过程中，自动学习三个正则化参数。实验表明，在四个真实数据集上，DE-LFT比手动调参的基线获得更低的MAE和RMSE，减少了人工调参成本。
Motivation: LFT模型的性能高度依赖超参数选择，手动调参或网格搜索需要大量计算资源和人力，而现有方法缺乏自动优化手段。
Method: 提出DE-LFT，将差分进化算法嵌入LFT模型训练流程，自动搜索最优的正则化参数λ1、λ2、λ3，实现超参数自适应优化。
Result: 在四个真实世界数据集上，DE-LFT相比手动调参的基线取得了更低的MAE和RMSE，同时减少了大量参数调整的工作量。
Conclusion: 自动超参数优化框架能有效提升LFT模型在DWDN上的预测精度，降低人工干预。

papers.title: Operator Fusion for LLM Inference on the Tensix Architecture
papers.abstract_en: This study addresses on-device inference bottlenecks of Transformer models on Tenstorrent's Tensix architecture and proposes an operator fusion strategy that enhances data locality. RMSNorm is fused with matrix multiplication in self-attention and in the FFN, enabling back-to-back execution of memory-bound and compute-bound operators in on-chip SRAM to significantly reduce DRAM reads/writes of intermediate results and scheduling overhead. To support multi-core parallelism, a NoC-based multicast mechanism is leveraged in which row/column master nodes efficiently distribute inputs and weights across the core mesh, alleviating DRAM bandwidth contention. Experiments on the Wormhole platform with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen3-0.6B, and Qwen3-4B show up to 37.44% latency reduction for attention and 15.89% for MLP, with up to 7.91% reduction per decoder layer, while Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) remains above 98.75%, confirming significant end-to-end efficiency gains under numerical consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对Tensix架构上Transformer模型推理的内存瓶颈，提出算子融合策略，将RMSNorm与矩阵乘法融合，利用片上SRAM减少DRAM读写，并采用NoC多播机制实现多核并行。在Wormhole平台上测试Qwen2.5-0.5B等模型，attention延迟降低37.44%，MLP降低15.89%，每解码层降低7.91%，PCC保持98.75%以上。
Motivation: Tensix架构上Transformer模型推理受限于DRAM带宽和调度开销，内存密集型与计算密集型算子交替执行导致中间结果频繁读写DRAM，影响效率。
Method: 提出算子融合策略，将RMSNorm与矩阵乘法（self-attention和FFN中）融合，使内存密集型与计算密集型算子在片上SRAM中连续执行；利用NoC多播机制，由行/列主节点分发输入和权重，减少DRAM带宽竞争。
Result: 在Wormhole平台上，Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-4B模型上attention延迟降低37.44%，MLP延迟降低15.89%，每解码层延迟降低7.91%，Pearson相关系数保持98.75%以上。
Conclusion: 该方法显著提升Tensix架构上LLM推理的端到端效率，同时保持数值一致性，适用于资源受限的芯片推理场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FailureScope: Cross-Regime Behavioral Diagnosis of Language Model Weaknesses
papers.abstract_en: Standard benchmarks report aggregate accuracy, but practitioners need to know which specific capabilities a model lacks. We introduce FailureScope, a behavioral-diagnosis method that clusters evaluation probes by their cross-model pass/fail patterns (leave-one-model-out, LOMO), and show it yields stable, interpretable failure taxonomies across three regimes usually studied separately: single-turn benchmarks, multi-turn dialogue, and adversarial agent attacks. On 2,664 single-turn tasks across 18 models, taxonomy-conditioned sampling reaches Kendall's tau = 0.81 at 50 tasks (versus 0.34 for random selection), and cross-model failure prediction reaches AUC 0.88. The same primitive recovers interpretable clusters on a 363-task multi-turn corpus and on 630 adversarial agent traces, where it exposes a meta-failure mode: a 73-100 percentage-point gap between LLM-judge ASR and real execution. Cluster cohesion remains strong across all three regimes, which we take as evidence that behavioral clustering is a portable diagnosis primitive that generalizes beyond any single benchmark. We release the pipeline, three annotated corpora, and the cross-regime taxonomies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FailureScope，一种跨模型行为诊断方法，通过 leave-one-model-out (LOMO) 模式聚类评估探针，在单次基准、多轮对话和对抗性攻击三个体制上生成稳定、可解释的失败分类。
Motivation: 标准基准只报告整体准确率，但实践者需要知道模型缺乏哪些具体能力；现有方法缺乏跨体制的通用诊断工具。
Method: FailureScope 利用交叉模型通过/失败模式（LOMO）对评估探针进行聚类，并应用于三个通常独立研究的体制：单轮基准、多轮对话和对抗性 agent 攻击。
Result: 在 18 个模型的 2,664 个单轮任务上，基于分类的采样在 50 个任务时达到 Kendall's tau=0.81（随机为 0.34），跨模型失败预测 AUC=0.88。在 363 任务的多轮语料和 630 个对抗性 agent 轨迹上也得到可解释的聚类，并揭示了一个元失败模式：LLM 评判的 ASR 与实际执行之间存在 73-100 百分点的差距。
Conclusion: 行为聚类是一种可移植的诊断原语，能泛化到单个基准之外；论文发布 pipeline、三个标注语料库和跨体制分类法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Streaming Knowledge Compilation: Proactive Materiality-Scored Pinning for Time-Evolving LLM Wikis
papers.abstract_en: LLM wiki systems compile knowledge into pre-filled KV caches for efficient inference, but assume a static corpus -- an assumption that fails whenever the underlying information landscape evolves. We formalize Streaming Knowledge Compilation: given a document stream, a fixed token budget, and future queries unknown at ingestion time, maintain a compiled wiki that minimizes cumulative regret against an offline oracle with perfect foresight. The enabling insight is a materiality signal $φ_t(k,n)\in[0,1]$ that scores document importance for entity $k$ at time $t$, acting as a query-relevance surrogate for proactive pinning before queries arrive; we prove an $O(\sqrt{T\log K})$ regret bound where $\varepsilon=\mathbb{E}[|φ_t-\hatφ_t|]$ is the only domain-specific quantity. We instantiate in two domains: finance, where $φ_t$ is abnormal stock volatility predicted by frozen Llama 3.1 8B classification head (AUROC = 0.728 on 76K articles, strict temporal split; $1.49\times$ higher realized forward volatility for predicted-material articles); and Wikipedia, where $φ_t$ is the Abnormal Edit Ratio (AER), a cross-sectionally normalized edit velocity -- showing the same algorithm generalizes beyond the finance domain. End-to-end QA evaluation on 173 matched pairs (finance) and 119 (Wikipedia) reveals a pervasive LLM-as-judge confound on post-training knowledge, establishing that regret analysis -- not absolute QA scores -- is the reliable evaluation metric for compiled knowledge systems. Finance cumulative regret converges to -20.0 (-0.12/step); Wikipedia to +16.0 (+0.13/step), with the positive sign confirming that Wikipedia edit content is genuinely post-training -- richer context consistently improves scores (No Wiki 3.80 vs. Oracle 4.74) -- and eliminates this confound. The $O(\sqrt{T\log K})$ guarantee applies to any domain where knowledge gaps can be predicted from streaming signals.

papers.title: Calibrating Overconfidence Without Sacrificing Confidence: Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often express high confidence in answers that are wrong. Standard calibration remedies typically act globally or at the score level, reducing unwarranted confidence but also risking erosion of warranted confidence on correct answers. We introduce Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention (PCHI), an inference-time method that uses a frozen probe to detect likely wrong-but-confident responses and conditionally rescales downstream attention-head outputs during confidence generation. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct solving OpenMathInstruct problems with a structured binary confidence field, readout-token PCHI converts 82.2% of originally wrong-yes confidence readouts to $\texttt{no}$, while a joint intervention across upstream confidence-template tokens reduces ECE from 21.9% to 9.2% and damages only 5.1% of originally correct-yes readouts. The readout-token effect also appears on Gemma3-4B, though upstream interventions are weaker and more mask-dependent. These results show that verbalized overconfidence can be selectively reduced through conditionally applied internal intervention, partially decoupling the suppression of unwarranted confidence from the loss of warranted confidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出探针条件头干预（PCHI），一种推理时方法，通过冻结探针检测LLM可能错误但自信的回答，并条件性地重新缩放注意力头输出，以减少过度自信而不损害正确自信。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct上，读出头PCHI将82.2%原本错误-自信的读数转为“否”，联合干预使ECE从21.9%降至9.2%，仅损害5.1%原本正确-自信的读数。
Motivation: LLM常在错误答案上表达高自信，现有校准方法通常全局或分数级操作，减少不必要自信的同时也可能侵蚀正确答案的自信。
Method: 提出PCHI，使用冻结探针检测可能错误但自信的响应，条件性地在置信度生成期间重新缩放下游注意力头输出。
Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct上，读出头PCHI将82.2%原本错误-自信的读数为“否”；联合干预将ECE从21.9%降至9.2%，仅损害5.1%原本正确-自信的读数。在Gemma3-4B上也有类似效果，但上游干预较弱。
Conclusion: 语言化过度自信可以通过条件性内部干预选择性减少，部分解耦抑制不必要自信与损失必要自信。

papers.title: Integrating Local and Global Entropy for Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models hallucinate confidently, making uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for reliable deployment. Existing methods rely predominantly on token-level signals, leaving the geometric structure of intermediate hidden states underused. In this paper, we take the geometric complexity of hidden-state matrices as a measure of the global uncertainty of LLMs, while treating token-level uncertainty estimation as a local metric. We show that hidden-state geometric entropy (global uncertainty) and token-level entropy (local uncertainty) are statistically near-orthogonal, capturing distinct failure regimes for reliability prediction. In particular, global geometry recovers the confident-but-wrong failure mode that local signals systematically miss. Building on this, we propose Global-Local Uncertainty (GLU), an unsupervised, single-pass score that fuses the two signals via a multiplicative gate. Across three model families and six benchmarks, GLU matches or outperforms all unsupervised baselines while requiring only a single forward pass and remaining length-normalized and architecture-agnostic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全局-局部不确定性（GLU）评分方法，融合隐藏状态几何熵（全局不确定性）与token级熵（局部不确定性），用于大型语言模型的不确定性量化。实验表明两种信号近乎正交，能捕捉不同失败模式，包括局部信号遗漏的“自信但错误”情况。GLU为无监督单次前向传播方法，在三个模型家族和六个基准上匹配或超越现有无监督基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM不确定性量化方法主要依赖token级信号，忽视了中间隐藏状态的几何结构，导致难以识别模型“自信但错误”的失败模式。
Method: 提出GLU评分，利用隐藏状态矩阵的几何复杂度作为全局不确定性，与token级局部熵通过乘法门融合，实现无监督、单次前向传播的不确定性量化。
Result: 在三个模型家族和六个基准上，GLU匹配或超越所有无监督基线，且能检测出局部信号无法捕捉的“自信但错误”实例。
Conclusion: 作者强调融合全局几何与局部token熵可更全面表征LLM不确定性，GLU具有架构无关性和长度归一化优势，适用于可靠性预测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Disjoint or Overlapping? Inference Windowing for Reconstruction-Based Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction-based methods are widely used for time series anomaly detection, where models are trained to reconstruct subsequences, and anomalies are identified through reconstruction errors. However, reported results are often hard to compare due to heterogeneous evaluation practices and underspecified inference procedures. In this paper, we revisit reconstruction-based anomaly detection in the univariate offline setting and study the role of the inference stride, which controls whether subsequences are processed as disjoint windows or with overlap. We propose a unified training, tuning, and multi-seed evaluation protocol on the curated TSB-AD benchmark, and study how overlapping inference affects anomaly detection performance for a range of reconstruction models, including PCA-based baselines, DLinear, an AutoEncoder, TimesNet, and Transformer variants. The results show that across all models, overlapping windows yield consistent improvements, with average relative gain up to +28%, and can alter method rankings. We further analyze variability across datasets, random seeds, and hyperparameter configurations. Finally, we complement the benchmark study with an evaluation on the full UCR archive using localization criteria aligned with sliding-window reconstruction. Overall, our results highlight that reconstruction-based anomaly detection performance depends not only on model architecture and training, but also on inference choices, motivating a clear and reproducible protocol. Our results show that reconstructionbased baselines achieve strong performance on both TSB-AD and UCR benchmarks, supporting them as competitive and practical approaches for univariate time series anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了基于重构的时间序列异常检测方法，重点研究推断步长（重叠窗口与不重叠窗口）对性能的影响。作者在TSB-AD和UCR基准上提出了统一的训练、调优和多随机种子评估协议，实验表明所有模型在重叠窗口下均有稳定提升，平均相对增益达+28%，并可能改变方法排名。研究指出异常检测性能不仅取决于模型架构和训练，还依赖于推断选择，强调了可重复协议的重要性。
Motivation: 现有基于重构的时间序列异常检测方法在评估协议上存在异质性，推断过程细节常被忽略，导致结果难以比较。
Method: 提出统一的训练、调优和多随机种子评估协议，在TSB-AD基准上研究推断步长（重叠与不重叠窗口）对PCA、DLinear、AutoEncoder、TimesNet和Transformer变体等模型异常检测性能的影响。
Result: 所有模型在重叠窗口下均获得一致改进，平均相对增益高达+28%，且可能改变方法排名；进一步在UCR存档上基于滑动窗口重构的定位标准评估了性能。
Conclusion: 基于重构的基线方法在TSB-AD和UCR基准上表现出强性能，是单变量时间序列异常检测的竞争性和实用方法；推断选择对性能有显著影响，需要清晰可复现的协议。

papers.title: Rotate2Think: Geometric Priming via Orthogonal Rotation to Improve Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning traces before producing a final answer. Yet the internal structure of representation space when reasoning remains poorly understood: how do a model's hidden representations differ during thinking versus the embeddings of the input prompt, and can this structure be exploited to elicit stronger reasoning at inference time? We show that both input embeddings and thinking embeddings (mean-pooled last-layer hidden states over the prompt and reasoning trace, respectively) exhibit extremely high conicity, with all vectors clustering tightly around a single mean direction. Crucially, these mean input and thinking directions are non-collinear, with thinking embeddings occupying a geometrically distinct region of embedding space across many different models and benchmark tasks. This observation motivates casting the input-to-thinking transition as a rotation problem admitting a closed-form solution via orthogonal Procrustes analysis. We propose Rotate2Think, a training-free method that estimates this rotation from a small set of correctly solved examples and injects the resulting synthetic thinking vector between thinking delimiters at inference time, providing a geometric primer at the onset of the reasoning trace. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks and model families, Rotate2Think improves accuracy in 30 of 32 model-benchmark configurations across mathematics, science, and code tasks, and generalizes zero-shot to multimodal reasoning on MATH-Vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型在推理时的隐藏表示（thinking embeddings）与输入嵌入（input embeddings）具有高锥度且方向不同，并利用正交Procrustes分析提出Rotate2Think方法，通过从少量正确示例中估计旋转并注入合成思考向量来提升推理性能。在数学、科学和代码等32个模型-基准配置中，30个准确率得到提升，并零样本泛化到多模态推理。
Motivation: 推理模型虽表现强劲，但其内部表示空间在推理时的结构尚不明确，输入嵌入与思考嵌入的几何差异未被充分利用。
Method: 提出Rotate2Think，一种无需训练的方法，通过正交Procrustes分析从少量正确示例中估计输入到思考嵌入的旋转，并在推理时将合成的思考向量注入思考分隔符之间，作为几何初值。
Result: 在30/32个模型-基准配置（涵盖数学、科学、代码任务）中提升准确率，并零样本泛化到MATH-Vision多模态推理任务。
Conclusion: 旋转估计和注入合成思考向量是一种有效且无需训练的推理增强手段，且可推广至多模态场景。

papers.title: PatchSTG: Scalable Spatiotemporal Graph Transformers for Traffic Forecasting on Irregular Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting is a fundamental component of intelligent transportation systems, yet remains challenging in real-world settings due to irregular sensor distributions and the high computational cost of modeling large-scale spatiotemporal dependencies. In practical traffic networks, sensors are unevenly distributed across regions, leading to non-uniform spatial structures that limit the effectiveness and scalability of existing graph-based and attention-based models. To address these challenges, we propose PatchSTG, a patch-based spatiotemporal graph Transformer designed for efficient forecasting on irregular sensor networks. The key idea is to introduce a hierarchical spatial representation that partitions sensors into balanced, locality-preserving patches based on geographic information. On top of this structure, a dual attention encoder alternates between intra-patch attention for capturing local interactions and inter-patch attention for modeling global dependencies, reducing computational complexity from quadratic to near-linear scaling. We evaluate PatchSTG on real-world traffic data from Rhode Island and additional large-scale datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves stable and competitive forecasting performance across multiple horizons, while significantly improving computational efficiency. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of spatial partitioning and dual attention in capturing both local and long-range traffic dynamics. These results suggest that patch-based spatiotemporal modeling provides a scalable and effective framework for traffic forecasting under irregular spatial settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PatchSTG，一种基于分块的时空图Transformer，用于不规则传感器网络上的交通预测。通过将传感器按地理位置划分为平衡的局部保持块（patches），并采用双注意力编码器（块内注意力和块间注意力），将计算复杂度从二次降低到近线性。在罗德岛等真实交通数据集上，PatchSTG在多个预测时域上取得稳定且有竞争力的性能，同时显著提升计算效率。消融实验验证了空间分块和双注意力机制的有效性。
Motivation: 现有图模型和注意力模型在处理不规则传感器分布的大规模交通网络时，存在空间结构非均匀导致的可扩展性和有效性不足的问题。
Method: 提出层次化空间表示，将传感器根据地理信息划分为平衡的局部保持块；构建双注意力编码器，交替进行块内注意力（捕捉局部交互）和块间注意力（建模全局依赖），实现近线性计算复杂度。
Result: 在罗德岛等真实交通数据集上，模型在多个预测时域上取得稳定且具有竞争力的性能，并显著提升计算效率；消融实验验证了分块和双注意力的有效性。
Conclusion: 分块时空建模为不规则空间设置下的交通预测提供了可扩展且有效的框架。

papers.title: SD-GRPO: Verifiable Segment Decomposition for Long-Form Vision-Language Generation
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants, originally developed for Large Language Models (LLMs), have recently been applied to Multimodal LLMs and produced strong results. However, their coarse-grained holistic credit assignment from a single scalar advantage underfits vision-language (VL) tasks, where outputs are often long-form responses grounded in semantically rich images. To address this limitation, we exploit a structured signal that single-scalar formulations discard: the natural segmentation of long-form VL outputs. Concretely, we propose Segment-Decomposed GRPO (SD-GRPO), which z-normalizes verifiable per-segment rewards across the rollout group, yielding a vector of per-segment advantages in place of a single scalar. We evaluate SD-GRPO across three settings spanning controlled and real-world long-form VL generation, organized by increasing semantic entanglement across segments. On a controlled multi-panel dense-captioning task constructed from DOCCI, where segments are semantically independent, SD-GRPO consistently outperforms the GRPO baseline, with larger gains at higher segment counts. Extending to a controlled multi-chart long-form VQA task constructed from MultiChartQA, we show both theoretically and empirically that rollout-level rewards suffer from cross-segment credit misattribution that scales with output length. On a real-world scientific figure captioning task on the MMSci dataset, where subfigure captions share context across the figure, blending holistic and per-segment rewards further improves on both, suggesting per-segment normalization alone is insufficient when segments are semantically entangled. Finally, by integrating SD-GRPO into Dr. GRPO, we confirm that it can be applied to any GRPO framework with minimal implementation overhead to enhance long-form VL generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长格式视觉-语言生成任务中GRPO粗粒度全局信用分配不足的问题，提出片段分解GRPO（SD-GRPO），通过z标准化每个片段的可验证奖励得到片段级优势向量。在三个长格式VL生成任务上（多面板密集描述、多图表长形式VQA、科学图表字幕生成）评估，显示优于GRPO基线，并且可以集成到任何GRPO框架中。
Motivation: 现有GRPO及其变体将长格式视觉-语言输出视为整体，使用单一标量优势进行信用分配，忽略了输出内部自然的分段结构，导致欠拟合。
Method: 提出SD-GRPO，对长格式输出进行自然分段，对每组内可验证的每片段奖励进行z标准化，得到片段级优势向量，替代单一标量。
Result: 在DOCCI多面板密集描述任务上，SD-GRPO一致优于GRPO基线，且片段数越多收益越大。在多图表VQA任务中，证明整次奖励存在跨片段信用错误归因，且随输出长度扩大。在MMSci数据集上，混合整体和每片段奖励进一步改善，表明语义纠缠时仅每片段标准化不足。
Conclusion: SD-GRPO可应用于任何GRPO框架且实现开销小，能增强长格式VL生成。

papers.title: QSplitFL: Capability Aware Deep Q-Learning for Optimal Split Point Selection in Split Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) combined with Split Learning (SL) is a privacy preserving paradigm that enables training deep neural networks (DNNs) on resource constrained devices while reducing overall training cost. However, determining the optimal split point, meaning the layer where the model is divided still remains a critical challenge, especially when clients have heterogeneous hardware capabilities. Fixed split points can overload weak devices and increase the communication and server load, which slows convergence and reduces stability. This paper introduces QSplitFL, a novel capability-aware Deep Q-Network (DQN) framework for optimal split point selection in Split learning based Federated Learning (SFL) environments. Unlike existing approaches that rely on high-dimensional model weight representations, QSplitFL employs a lightweight state representation derived directly from client hardware metrics, including CPU utilization, memory, battery level, and network latency. The proposed framework incorporates a decayed loss-drop reward function that prioritizes early convergence, and a committee-based DQN architecture with majority voting to mitigate reward hacking. Extensive experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 datasets using CNN, ResNet50, MobileNetV4, and ConvNeXt architectures demonstrate that our approach achieves better convergence and higher accuracy compared to existing methods, while effectively adapting to heterogeneous device resources. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIPO-Lab/QSplitFL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QSplitFL，一种基于深度Q网络（DQN）的框架，用于在拆分联邦学习（SFL）中根据客户端硬件能力（如CPU、内存、电量、网络延迟）自适应选择最优模型分割点。该方法采用轻量级状态表示、衰减损失下降奖励函数和委员会式DQN架构，在多个数据集和模型架构上实现了更快的收敛和更高的准确率。
Motivation: 现有拆分联邦学习在客户端异构硬件条件下，固定分割点会导致弱设备过载、通信和服务器负载增加，从而减慢收敛并降低稳定性。
Method: 提出QSplitFL框架，使用客户端硬件指标作为轻量级状态，设计衰减损失下降奖励函数以促进早期收敛，并采用基于多数投票的委员会式DQN架构来缓解奖励攻击问题。
Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，使用CNN、ResNet50、MobileNetV4和ConvNeXt架构的实验表明，该方法比现有方法收敛更快、准确率更高，且能有效适应异构设备资源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作通过能力感知的深度强化学习自适应选择分割点，提升了异构环境下拆分联邦学习的效率和稳定性。

papers.title: SPACE: Source-free Proxy Anchor Concept Erasure for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face growing privacy risks and regulatory constraints, machine unlearning (MU) has emerged as a crucial solution for removing sensitive data while preserving model performance. However, existing MU methods typically rely on visual data of the target concepts, which is often unavailable due to strict data retention policies, thus creating a demand for source-free unlearning approaches that operate without access to the target data. In this work, we propose Source-free Proxy Anchor Concept Erasure (SPACE), the first source-free unlearning framework specialized for MLLMs. SPACE consists of two stages: (1) Text-Guided Proxy Anchor Selection (TPAS), which retrieves semantically aligned proxy anchors from the shared feature space. (2) Dual-Constraint Semantic Isolation (DCSI), which optimizes these anchors to indirectly erase target concepts. DCSI confines updates to the null space of retained knowledge, ensuring structural integrity. We theoretically prove that SPACE strictly bounds the perturbation on retained knowledge and maximizes feature spectral entropy, thereby maintaining the model's performance. Furthermore, extensive experiments across six datasets show that SPACE achieves performance comparable to that of state-of-the-art data-dependent methods, validating its effectiveness in source-free MU scenarios. The source code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPACE，首个专为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）设计的无源（source-free）机器遗忘框架，通过文本引导的代理锚点选择和双约束语义隔离，在不访问目标概念视觉数据的情况下擦除敏感概念。理论证明该方法能严格限制对保留知识的扰动并最大化特征谱熵，实验表明其在无源场景下效果可与有数据依赖的方法媲美。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通常需要目标概念的视觉数据，但严格的数据保留政策常使这些数据不可用，因此需要无源遗忘方法。针对MLLMs的无源遗忘研究尚属空白。
Method: SPACE 包含两阶段：(1) 文本引导的代理锚点选择（TPAS），从共享特征空间检索语义对齐的代理锚点；(2) 双约束语义隔离（DCSI），通过将更新限制在保留知识的零空间来优化锚点，间接擦除目标概念。理论分析保证了扰动有界和特征谱熵最大化。
Result: 在六个数据集上的实验表明，SPACE 在无源遗忘场景下达到了与依赖数据的最先进方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: SPACE 是首个针对 MLLMs 的无源遗忘框架，理论保证模型性能保持，实验验证其有效性。代码将开源。

papers.title: EstRTL: Functional Estimation Guided RTL Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing register transfer level (RTL) code is of vital importance in hardware design. Large language models (LLMs) provide new methods for the automatic generation and optimization of RTL code, offering the potential to significantly accelerate the design process and reduce human effort. However, existing methods for generating RTL code often focus on model fine-tuning and the use of various expansion techniques to enhance the RTL code generation capabilities, lacking attention to the functional correctness. Ensuring that the generated RTL code not only compiles successfully but also behaves as intended in real hardware implementations remains a critical challenge. To address this issue, we propose EstRTL, an LLM-powered collaborative agent framework for RTL code generation based on static functional score estimation. EstRTL operates a three-stage paradigm: Generation, Estimation and Correction. During the stages, the functional estimation agent statically evaluates the generated code based on score and assessment results, and decides whether to output the code directly, return it for regeneration, or forward it to the code correction agent. This framework can be applied to various LLMs that designed for RTL code generation, further enhancing the correctness of the generated code. By providing quantitative scores and human-readable requirements comparisons, it improves the transparency of AI-assisted RTL code generation. Experiments show that EstRTL significantly improves the correctness of RTL code generation by generic LLM by 3.2\%-9.0\%, demonstrating the practical value of our system. The codes and experimental results are open-sourced at link: https://anonymous.4open.science/status/EstRTL-E200/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EstRTL，一个基于 LLM 的协作智能体框架，通过静态功能得分估计来增强 RTL 代码生成的功能正确性。框架包含生成、估计和修正三个阶段，可应用于多种专为 RTL 代码生成的 LLM。实验表明，EstRTL 使通用 LLM 的 RTL 代码生成正确性提升 3.2%-9.0%。
Motivation: 现有 RTL 代码生成方法侧重模型微调和扩展技术，缺乏对功能正确性的关注，导致生成的代码可能编译通过但实际硬件实现行为不符合预期。
Method: 提出 EstRTL 框架，包含生成、估计和修正三阶段。功能估计智能体基于静态得分和评估结果决定直接输出、重新生成或交由代码修正智能体处理，并提供定量得分和可读需求对比。
Result: 实验表明 EstRTL 将通用 LLM 的 RTL 代码生成正确性提升 3.2%-9.0%。
Conclusion: EstRTL 通过静态功能估计提升了 RTL 代码生成的正确定性和透明度，展示了 AI 辅助硬件设计的实用价值。

papers.title: Two to Tango: Coupled Task-Reference Selection for Safe LLM Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning safety aligned large language models (LLMs) on downstream data improves adaptation but may erode learned safety behavior. Existing methods use fixed safety examples, global constraints, or one-sided task filtering. Our diagnostics show task updates expose different safety constraints, motivating joint selection of relevant references and compatible task samples. We propose DualSelect, a coupled framework for task and reference selection that refreshes task conditioned safety references before filtering whole task samples compatible with the induced reference direction. Under a minimax view, DualSelect selects safety references with high preservation loss and task conflict, together with compatible task samples, through entropy-regularized scoring surrogates, lazy reference refresh, and gradient correction. On 1B-8B LLMs, DualSelect preserves safety without losing task utility; using the REDORCA judge, it improves Safety Avg. over the strongest baseline by at least 5.10 points and remains highest in Safety Avg. across judges with moderate overhead. This view extends to retention focused continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对下游微调可能侵蚀LLM安全对齐的问题，提出DualSelect框架，联合选择任务相关的安全参考样本和兼容的任务样本，通过对抗性视角、熵正则评分、惰性参考更新和梯度矫正实现安全保持。在1B-8B规模LLM上，使用REDORCA评判器，安全平均分比最强基线提升至少5.10，且在不同评判器下均保持最高安全分，开销适中。
Motivation: 现有方法使用固定安全样本、全局约束或单方面任务过滤，但诊断发现任务更新会暴露不同的安全约束，需要联合选择相关参考和兼容任务样本。
Method: 提出DualSelect耦合框架：在任务过滤前，先通过高保持损失和任务冲突选择安全参考，并配合熵正则评分代理、惰性参考刷新和梯度矫正，从极小极大视角选择兼容任务样本。
Result: 在1B-8B LLM上，DualSelect保持安全性的同时不损失任务效用；使用REDORCA评判器，安全平均分比最强基线提升至少5.10分，且在不同评判器下安全平均分最高。
Conclusion: 该方法可扩展到以保留为重点的持续学习，强调通过耦合任务与参考选择来平衡安全与效用。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对下游微调可能侵蚀LLM安全对齐的问题，提出DualSelect框架，联合选择任务相关的安全参考样本和兼容的任务样本，通过对抗性视角、熵正则评分、惰性参考更新和梯度矫正实现安全保持。在1B-8B规模LLM上，使用REDORCA评判器，安全平均分比最强基线提升至少5.10，且在不同评判器下均保持最高安全分，开销适中。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法使用固定安全样本、全局约束或单方面任务过滤，但诊断发现任务更新会暴露不同的安全约束，需要联合选择相关参考和兼容任务样本。
summary_sections.method: 提出DualSelect耦合框架：在任务过滤前，先通过高保持损失和任务冲突选择安全参考，并配合熵正则评分代理、惰性参考刷新和梯度矫正，从极小极大视角选择兼容任务样本。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法可扩展到以保留为重点的持续学习，强调通过耦合任务与参考选择来平衡安全与效用。

papers.title: LLM-as-a-Discriminator: When Synthetic Tables Still Look Real
papers.abstract_en: Privacy and data sharing are often in tension. Many organizations use synthetic data to reduce privacy risk and still share useful data. For tabular data, auditing privacy remains hard. In many cases, even humans cannot easily tell if a table is real or synthetic. In this paper, we propose a method based on LLM discrimination. We ask an LLM to classify each table sample as REAL or SYNTHETIC. We test two settings: C1 with table only, and C2 with table plus distributional metadata. We use LLaMA as an open model and Gemini as a reference model. In our experiments, we run three synthesis models, CTGAN, TVAE, and Gaussian Copula, on two public datasets, UCI Adult and ACS Census. We collect 451 valid trials. Our results show clear differences between models. On Adult, LLaMA reaches DRS=0% in reported cells, while Gemini reaches DRS=100% for CTGAN and TVAE. On Census, LLaMA predicts SYNTHETIC for most samples, while Gemini stays high in C1 but drops for CTGAN and TVAE in C2. We also compare with a classifier two-sample test (C2ST) and record linkage as distributional baselines, and with a human pilot of 2 annotators and 240 trials. Our results show that LLM discrimination is a practical privacy audit signal when model choice, per provider reporting, and data encoding are handled with care. For reproducibility, code and experiment scripts are available at https://github.com/SlokomManel/LLM-as-a-Discriminator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用大语言模型（LLM）作为判别器，区分真实表格数据与合成表格数据，用于隐私审计。在UCI Adult和ACS Census数据集上，使用CTGAN、TVAE和Gaussian Copula三种合成模型，评估了LLaMA和Gemini两种LLM的判别能力。实验表明，LLM判别效果因模型、数据编码和设置而异，可作为实用性隐私审计信号。
Motivation: 合成数据广泛用于隐私保护数据共享，但表格数据的隐私审计困难，人类难以区分真实与合成样本。需要一种可扩展、自动化的审计方法。
Method: 通过LLM对表格样本进行二分类（REAL/SYNTHETIC），设置两种条件：仅含表格数据（C1）和表格加分布元数据（C2）。使用LLaMA（开源）和Gemini（参考模型），在多个合成模型和数据集上测试，并与分类器双样本检验（C2ST）和记录链接（record linkage）基线以及人类实验对比。
Result: 在Adult数据集上，LLaMA达到DRS=0%（即完全无法区分），而Gemini对CTGAN和TVAE达到DRS=100%。在Census数据集上，LLaMA预测大多数样本为合成，Gemini在C1下表现高，但在C2下对CTGAN和TVAE的DRS下降。共收集451次有效试验，并有人类试点（2名标注员，240次试验）佐证。
Conclusion: LLM判别作为隐私审计信号实用，但需谨慎处理模型选择、提供商报告和数据编码。代码已开源以供复现。

papers.title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache quantization is widely used to reduce Large Language Model (LLM) inference memory, yet existing evaluations solely focus on measuring perplexity and accuracy without assessing the safety impact. In this study, we explore alignment preservation under KV cache quantization. Across eleven instruction-tuned models (3.8B-72B) and five benchmarks (1,894 prompts), we find that low-bit quantization can silently destroy safety alignment: Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals at only 1.03x perplexity, and no universal safe bit-width exists, with sharp model-specific phase transitions invisible to standard metrics. We identify that the root cause is geometric: safety features occupy a low-dimensional activation subspace 10^2-10^3x more vulnerable to quantization noise than the full representation space perplexity averages over. Inspired by this observation, we propose Per-Channel Reduction (PCR), a diagnostic that classifies each model into one of three mechanistic failure modes: outlier-crushes-safety, where safety lives in non-outlier channels collaterally damaged by outlier-driven scale factors; outlier-as-safety, where safety overlaps outlier channels and finer granularity cannot rescue it; and multi-layer dilution, where safety is distributed across many layers and per-layer fixes fail. PCR predicts the correct mitigation direction on all nine primary models and one held-out model from an independent family using 20 calibration prompts. PCR generalizes across unseen prompts, models, and production quantizers, including KIVI with up to 97.2% recovery, succeeding where attention-based allocation methods fail. The resulting training-free protocol, requiring approximately 35 GPU-minutes, recovers up to 97% of lost alignment at minimal memory overhead, addressing vulnerabilities confirmed in production vLLM serving with FP8 KV cache on NVIDIA GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究KV缓存量化对大型语言模型安全对齐的影响，发现低比特量化会无声地破坏安全对齐（如Mistral-7B在仅1.03倍困惑度增加下拒绝率下降15.2%），且不存在通用安全位宽。根因为安全特征存在于低维激活子空间，对量化噪声的脆弱性比全表示空间高出10^2-10^3倍。基于此提出Per-Channel Reduction (PCR)诊断，将模型归为三种故障模式，并用20个校准提示正确预测所有主要模型及独立族模型的缓解方向。所提出的免训练协议（约35 GPU分钟）能恢复高达97%的对齐损失，内存开销极小。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存量化评估仅关注困惑度和准确率，未考虑安全影响；低比特量化可能破坏对齐，且标准指标无法察觉。
Method: 进行系统性诊断，识别安全特征在低维子空间的脆弱性，提出Per-Channel Reduction (PCR)诊断方法，将模型分为三类故障模式（outlier-crushes-safety、outlier-as-safety、multi-layer dilution），并据此设计免训练对齐恢复协议。
Result: 在11个指令微调模型（3.8B-72B）和5个基准（1894个提示）上，发现量化对齐崩溃现象；PCR用20个校准提示正确预测所有主模型和独立族模型的缓解方向；恢复协议在KIVI量化器上最高恢复97.2%的对齐损失，所需约35 GPU分钟。
Conclusion: 量化中安全对齐丢失是几何原因导致的，通过诊断模型的故障模式可以针对性地恢复对齐，且方法泛化到未见提示、模型和生产量化器（如vLLM中的FP8 KV缓存）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can fail silently by asserting task completion when the environment state shows otherwise. We study this failure mode, false success, across two agent benchmarks: 9,876 tau2-bench trajectories from 8 model families and 1,879 AppWorld trajectories from 4 model families with text-independent ground truth. False success is common but varies by setting: 45--48% of failures in single-control tau2-bench domains, 3% in dual-control telecom, and 75.8% among AppWorld self-assessing coding-agent trajectories with explicit status claims. LLM judges fail reliably: no configuration across 5 judges, 5 prompt strategies, and full task specifications exceeds AUROC 0.65 on tau2-bench, and the same judges reach only 0.54 AUROC on AppWorld API-call traces. Judges rely on surface completion proxies -- confident closing language in tau2-bench and coarse action-sequence volume in AppWorld -- rather than verified state changes. Lightweight TF-IDF detectors achieve task-disjoint AUROC 0.83 on tau2-bench and 0.95 on AppWorld, recovering 4--8x more false successes than the best judge at the same flag rate with 3,300x lower latency. These results suggest that production monitoring should use lightweight, domain-calibrated detectors as triage signals rather than relying on LLM judges as the primary monitor for false success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM智能体（agent）的“虚假成功”失效模式，即智能体声称任务完成但环境状态未改变。在tau2-bench和AppWorld两个基准上，虚假成功分别占失败的45-48%和75.8%。研究发现LLM评判器（judge）无法可靠检测虚假成功，最高AUROC仅0.54-0.65，而轻量级TF-IDF检测器可在相同标记率下多发现4-8倍虚假成功，延迟降低3300倍。
Motivation: LLM智能体可能在不正确的状态下断言任务完成，这种“虚假成功”在监控中难以捕捉，现有LLM评判器用于检测的可靠性未知，亟需系统评估和更有效的检测方法。
Method: 在两个基准（tau2-bench和AppWorld）上收集大量轨迹，使用文本无关的真实标签标注虚假成功；对比多种LLM评判器（5种模型、5种提示策略）与轻量级TF-IDF检测器的检测性能，包括AUROC和延迟。
Result: 虚假成功普遍存在：tau2-bench单域中占失败45-48%，AppWorld编码智能体自评估轨迹中达75.8%。LLM评判器对tau2-bench和AppWorld的AUROC分别不超过0.65和0.54，而TF-IDF检测器在任务不相交数据上达到AUROC 0.83和0.95，恢复虚假成功数量是最好LLM评判器的4-8倍，延迟低3300倍。
Conclusion: 生产环境中应使用轻量级、领域校准的检测器作为虚假成功的初步筛查信号，而非依赖LLM评判器作为主要监控工具。

papers.title: Blurry Window Attention
papers.abstract_en: The Softmax Attention operation in Transformer language models has a quadratic complexity in the sequence length and a growing state size in the form of KV cache, which becomes a bottleneck in long context scenarios. To overcome this limitation, alternative architectures with linear complexity and finite state size have been introduced, such as State-Space Models (SSMs), Linear Attention (LA), and Attention with Bounded-memory Control (ABC). Though linear models achieve similar language perplexity as Transformers, they are still behind in tasks which require retrieval or recall of specific information. In this work, we introduce Blurry Window Attention (BLA) a novel ABC method inspired by SSMs. BLA stores a frequency window from which a blurry KV history is reconstructed via interpolation using Dirichlet kernels. BLA can be understood as a generalization of Sliding Window Attention (SWA) depending on the Dirichlet kernels resolution or as a special case of the Gated Slot Attention (GSA), where the decay factor is implemented with Dirichlet kernels. We describe in details the theory and efficient implementation of BLA. On the Multi-Query Associate Recall (MQAR) synthetic task, we show that the state efficiency of BLA is 8$\times$ better than SWA and is competitive with popular linear attention models, and in the RegBench synthetic task, only BLA and SWA improve their performance as the state size grows among the linear models we tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Blurry Window Attention (BLA)，一种受状态空间模型 (SSM) 启发的新型有界内存控制注意力方法。BLA 存储频率窗口，并通过 Dirichlet 核插值重构模糊的 KV 历史，从而实现线性复杂度。在 MQAR 合成任务上，BLA 的状态效率比滑动窗口注意力 (SWA) 高 8 倍，与流行的线性注意力模型相当；在 RegBench 上，仅 BLA 和 SWA 的性能随状态大小增长而提升。
Motivation: Softmax 注意力在长上下文场景中面临二次复杂度和 KV 缓存增长瓶颈，现有线性架构（如 SSM、线性注意力）在检索或召回任务上仍落后于 Transformer。
Method: BLA 存储频率窗口，通过 Dirichlet 核插值重构模糊 KV 历史。可视为 SWA 的泛化（取决于 Dirichlet 核分辨率）或门控槽注意力 (GSA) 的特例（衰减因子由 Dirichlet 核实现）。
Result: 在 MQAR 合成任务上，BLA 的状态效率是 SWA 的 8 倍，且与主流线性注意力模型竞争。在 RegBench 中，仅 BLA 和 SWA 的性能随状态大小增加而提升。
Conclusion: BLA 结合了 SSM 和注意力的优势，在合成任务上展现了优于 SWA 的状态效率，但需要在真实语言任务上进一步验证。

papers.title: Time Series as Language: A Universal Tokenizer for General-Purpose Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: While Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has unified LLM pretraining, its adaptation to unbounded, continuous time series (TS) remains open. To bridge the gap, we introduce UniTok, a universal tokenizer that transforms TS into discrete tokens, and UniTok-FM, a foundation model pretrained via NTP on these tokens. UniTok-FM is a general-purpose foundation model that supports zero-shot and prompt-boosted forecasting, as well as few-shot generation and classification via training-free in-context inference--a capability not achieved by prior works. Technically, UniTok is a vector-quantized autoencoder incorporating prefix normalization for scale stabilization, a progressive-resolution causal architecture for encoding and decoding, and a structure-preserving reconstruction loss for training. UniTok-FM adopts an off-the-shelf LLM architecture without TS-specific modifications. Instead of pretraining on isolated TS, it performs NTP on context windows formed by multiple series with similar patterns, aiming to capture their shared dynamics. Experiments on forecasting, generation, and classification show that a single unified UniTok-FM consistently outperforms statistical and supervised baselines, achieves competitive performance with task-specific foundation models, and uniquely enables training-free in-context inference across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniTok，一种将连续时间序列转化为离散 token 的通用 tokenizer，并构建基于 NTP 预训练的基础模型 UniTok-FM。UniTok-FM 支持零样本、提示增强的预测，以及无需训练的上下文推理（in-context inference）。实验表明，单一统一模型在预测、生成、分类任务上优于统计和监督基线，与任务特定基础模型性能相当，并能跨任务实现无需训练的上下文推理。
Motivation: 尽管 Next-Token Prediction (NTP) 统一了 LLM 预训练，但将其应用于无界、连续的时间序列仍面临挑战。现有工作缺乏通用 tokenizer 和统一基础模型。
Method: UniTok 是一种向量量化自编码器（vector-quantized autoencoder），包含前缀归一化（prefix normalization）用于尺度稳定、渐进分辨率因果架构（progressive-resolution causal architecture）用于编解码、结构保持重建损失（structure-preserving reconstruction loss）用于训练。UniTok-FM 采用现成的 LLM 架构，无需时间序列特定修改，并在由多个相似模式序列组成的上下文窗口上进行 NTP 预训练。
Result: 在预测、生成、分类任务上，UniTok-FM 一致优于统计和监督基线，与任务特定基础模型竞争力相当，并独特地实现了无需训练的上下文推理。
Conclusion: UniTok-FM 作为通用时间序列基础模型，支持多种任务，并首次实现无需训练的上下文推理，展示了统一框架的潜力。

papers.title: Conformal Risk Prediction for Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Using Gradient Boosting with Distribution-Free Coverages
papers.abstract_en: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) affects roughly 25% of global adults, posing substantial hepatic and cardiovascular risks. Yet, population-level screening tools remain inadequate. We present Method, a machine-learning framework for NAFLD risk prediction coupling gradient-boosted decision trees with conformal prediction to yield calibrated, distribution-free coverage guarantees on individual risk estimates. It integrates a mutual-information-based stability selection procedure to identify a compact, clinically interpretable feature subset via bootstrap resampling, constructing prediction sets whose marginal coverage provably exceeds a user-specified confidence level. We evaluated Method on a multicenter cohort from Guangzhou, China (primary n=2,187; external validation n=412) using 78 candidate features across demographics, metabolic biomarkers, and lifestyle factors. Method achieves an AUROC of 0.912 internally and 0.891 externally, outperforming deep neural networks, TabNet, support vector machines, and logistic regression. Conformal prediction sets achieve 91.3% empirical coverage at the 90% nominal level. A three-tier risk stratification derived from these scores separates the population into distinct groups, with the high-risk subgroup showing a 12-month progression rate 4.7 times that of the low-risk tier. The selected features -- notably waist circumference, ALT, GGT, triglycerides, fasting glucose, and BMI -- align with established metabolic risk factors, providing biological plausibility.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合梯度提升决策树与共形预测（conformal prediction）的非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD）风险预测框架，在华南多中心队列上取得AUROC 0.912（内部）和0.891（外部验证），共形预测集在90%名义水平下达到91.3%经验覆盖率，并识别出腰围、ALT、GGT等临床可解释特征。
Motivation: 全球约25%成年人受NAFLD影响，但缺乏有效的群体筛查工具，现有机器学习模型缺乏分布自由的覆盖保证。
Method: 使用梯度提升决策树（gradient-boosted decision trees）结合共形预测，通过基于互信息的稳定性选择（mutual-information-based stability selection）筛选紧凑特征子集，构建边缘覆盖超过用户指定置信水平的预测集。
Result: 内部AUROC 0.912，外部AUROC 0.891，优于深度神经网络、TabNet、SVM和逻辑回归；90%名义覆盖率下实现91.3%经验覆盖；高风险亚组12个月进展率是低风险组的4.7倍。
Conclusion: 该框架提供校准的、分布自由的覆盖保证，且选定特征与已知代谢风险因素一致，具有生物学合理性。

papers.title: Mitigating Manifold Departure: Uncertainty-Aware Subspace Rectification for Trustworthy MLLM Decoding
papers.abstract_en: MLLMs frequently hallucinate objects inconsistent with visual inputs. This issue is typically attributed to the over-reliance on language priors, which can override the visual context. Recent training-free decoding strategies address this by penalizing language priors. However, these methods overlook the dual nature of language priors, where they can be both helpful and harmful depending on the alignment with visual evidence. In particular, blindly suppressing language priors often disrupts the model's semantic manifold, leading to performance degradation, a phenomenon we term Manifold Departure. To address this, we propose Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection (MGAP), a geometry-aware, training-free decoding method that mitigates hallucinations while preserving representation structure. MGAP first constructs a language-prior subspace from blind hidden states via SVD. During decoding, MGAP projects each multimodal hidden state onto this subspace and applies a consistency-aware gate to adaptively attenuate only the projected prior component, yielding a subspace-selective update that largely preserves the orthogonal semantic components. Extensive experiments on POPE and CHAIR show that MGAP outperforms prior decoding baselines, achieving stronger hallucination suppression without sacrificing coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的解码方法MGAP，用于缓解多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的幻觉问题。通过SVD构建语言先验子空间，并对多模态隐藏状态进行自适应投影，有选择地削弱先验成分，避免盲目抑制导致语义流形偏离（Manifold Departure）。在POPE和CHAIR基准上，MGAP在抑制幻觉的同时保持了生成连贯性。
Motivation: MLLM经常产生与视觉输入不一致的幻觉，现有训练自由解码方法盲目抑制语言先验，但语言先验有双面性，盲目抑制会破坏语义流形（Manifold Departure），导致性能下降。
Method: 提出MGAP（Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection），一种无需训练的几何感知解码方法。先通过SVD从盲隐藏状态构建语言先验子空间，在解码时对多模态隐藏状态进行投影，并使用一致性感知门控自适应地衰减投影的先验成分，保留正交的语义成分。
Result: 在POPE和CHAIR基准上，MGAP优于现有解码基线，实现更强的幻觉抑制且不牺牲生成连贯性。
Conclusion: 通过几何感知的自适应投影，可以在保留表示结构的同时有效缓解MLLM幻觉，避免Manifold Departure。

papers.title: Support sufficiency as action-sufficient compression: a single-cycle rate-regret formulation
papers.abstract_en: Robust decision-making requires compression. A system that forms a rich support state cannot usually preserve its full structure at the point of action. It must retain only those distinctions needed to act, verify, abstain, or defer under the current consequence geometry. This paper formalizes support sufficiency as action-sufficient compression. Let $H$ denote a full support state, $\mathcal{A}$ a finite action set, and $Z$ a consequence geometry specifying payoff structure. For fixed $Z$, the coarsest exactly action-sufficient compression is the quotient of support space by policy equivalence. Two support states may be merged exactly when they require the same optimal action. This clarifies why content-only and scalar-confidence-only arbitration fail whenever their induced partitions cross action boundaries. Approximate sufficiency is then defined by bounded expected policy regret. In the finite single-cycle setting, this yields a rate-regret problem with source $H$, reproduction alphabet $\mathcal{A}$, and distortion given by consequence-sensitive regret. The optimal stochastic action channel inherits the standard rate-distortion Gibbs form, applied here to support states with regret distortion. The contribution is interpretive: action adequacy is distinguished from reconstruction fidelity, information-bottleneck prediction, and rational inattention. Robust single-cycle arbitration does not require preserving all support, but it does require preserving the distinctions that consequence geometry makes action-relevant.
papers.comment: 22 pages. Submitted to Journal of Mathematical Psychology. Formal single-cycle model of action-sufficient support compression and rate-regret sufficiency
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了支持充分性 (support sufficiency) 作为行动充分压缩 (action-sufficient compression) 的概念。给定一个完整支持状态空间 H、有限动作集 A 和后果几何 Z，最粗糙的恰好行动充分压缩是支持空间按策略等价关系的商空间。近似充分性通过有界期望策略遗憾定义，在有限单周期设定下转化为速率-遗憾问题，最优随机动作通道具有经典率失真吉布斯形式。本文的贡献在于区分了行动充分性与重构保真度、信息瓶颈预测和理性疏忽等概念。
Motivation: 鲁棒决策需要压缩，但系统在动作时刻通常无法保留完整支持状态的全部结构，需要只保留与动作相关的区分。现有方法如仅内容或仅标量置信度的仲裁在跨越动作边界时失效，因此需要形式化支持充分性作为行动充分压缩。
Method: 通过策略等价关系定义恰好行动充分压缩，将支持状态空间商化；近似充分性则用有界期望策略遗憾来定义，在有限单周期下构建速率-遗憾问题，其中源为 H、复制字母表为 A、失真为后果敏感遗憾，最优随机动作通道继承标准率失真吉布斯形式。
Result: 给出了恰好行动充分压缩的商空间形式，以及近似充分性下的率失真问题解（Gibbs 形式）。区分了行动充分性与重构保真度、信息瓶颈预测和理性疏忽等概念。
Conclusion: 鲁棒单周期仲裁不需要保留全部支持，但需要保留后果几何所决定的动作相关区分。本文是解释性的，形式化了行动充分压缩与速率-遗憾充分性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sampling Triangulations and Calabi-Yau Threefolds with Autoregressive GNNs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce `dualGNN', an autoregressive message-passing GNN for sampling fine, regular triangulations (FRTs) of convex polytopes. dualGNN operates on a generalization of the dual graph of a triangulation, with edges labeled by `signed circuits' -- combinatorial invariants from oriented matroid theory which we show are both necessary and sufficient for exposing regularity. The model is independent of the number of points in the polytope and invariant under the polytope's orientation-preserving symmetries ($\mathrm{SL}(d,\mathbb{Z}) \ltimes \mathbb{Z}^d$). When implemented with a certain masking procedure, one can also guarantee that every rollout produces a fine triangulation (in $2$D). On unseen polygons with $N_\mathrm{pts} \leq 40$, dualGNN is the most uniform FRT sampler we tested, and even a model trained on a single polygon generalizes well to other polygons. The model is small ($\sim92$k parameters), trains in $\sim7.5$ hours on a single consumer GPU, and runs without modification on an M1 MacBook Pro. We apply dualGNN to string theory, uniformly sampling Calabi-Yau threefolds at $h^{1,1}=86$ and consistent with uniformity at $h^{1,1}=128$. This is an order of magnitude beyond previous learned methods with a model $\sim1000\times$ smaller. Code, training scripts, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/natemacfadden/dualGNN .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 dualGNN，一个自回归消息传递图神经网络，用于采样凸多面体的细正则三角剖分（FRTs）。模型基于带符号电路标签的三角剖分对偶图，独立于多面体点数且具有对称性不变性。在二维未见过多边形上实现了最均匀的 FRT 采样，并成功应用于弦理论中 Calabi-Yau 三流形的均匀采样，在 h^{1,1}=86 和 128 上优于先前学习方法一个数量级，模型仅约 92k 参数。
Motivation: 现有三角剖分采样方法难以保证均匀性和正则性，且无法扩展到高维或大量点数的场景；弦理论中 Calabi-Yau 三流形的构造需要高效均匀的三角剖分采样方法。
Method: dualGNN 使用自回归消息传递架构，操作于通用化的三角剖分对偶图，边带有来自有向拟阵理论的符号电路标签，以确保正则性；通过掩码过程保证输出为细三角剖分（二维时），并利用对称性不变性。
Result: 在二维未见过多边形（点数 ≤40）上，dualGNN 是最均匀的 FRT 采样器；在 Calabi-Yau 三流形采样中，实现了 h^{1,1}=86 和 128 的均匀采样，规模比先前学习方法大一个数量级，模型大小仅为对手的约 1/1000。
Conclusion: dualGNN 为均匀采样凸多面体三角剖分提供了高效、可扩展的工具，在弦理论中展示了实际应用潜力；代码和模型已公开。
